lemmas.def_zh: 这，那；这些，那些（定冠词，用于特指特定或已知的人或事物）
lemmas.def_en: definite article used to refer to specific or previously mentioned people or things

examples.en: Could you please pass the salt?
examples.zh: 你能把那罐盐递给我吗？

examples.en: She looked up at the moon in the quiet night sky.
examples.zh: 她抬头望向寂静夜空中的明月。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语指示代词演变，核心功能是指示或特指语境中已知、独一无二或上下文已明确的人、物或概念。

lemmas.def_zh: 是；存在；位于；成为
lemmas.def_en: to exist, occur, or have a specified quality, identity, or state

examples.en: To be honest, I was surprised by how smoothly the entire transition went.
examples.zh: 说实话，整个过渡过程如此顺利让我感到很惊讶。

examples.en: There must be a logical explanation for the sudden drop in performance.
examples.zh: 性能的突然下降必然有一个合乎逻辑的解释。

lemmas.def_zh: 存在的性质
lemmas.def_en: the state or fact of existing

examples.en: Meditation helps one connect with the pure beingness that underlies all human experience.
examples.zh: 冥想有助于人们与构成所有人类体验基础的纯粹存在性相联结。

lemmas.def_zh: 不存在的事, 无
lemmas.def_en: the state of not being

examples.en: Ancient philosophers often debated whether absolute nonbeing could truly exist in the universe.
examples.zh: 古代哲学家经常争论宇宙中是否真能存在绝对的“无”。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古印欧语多个表示“存在”、“生长”和“居所”的异干词根的合并，演变出英语中最核心的存在动词与系动词，用于表达存在、本质特征或构成时态与语态。

lemmas.def_zh: 向，朝；到，至；给，对；（动词不定式符号）
lemmas.def_en: expressing motion or direction toward a person, place, or thing; used before a verb to form the infinitive

examples.en: We walked down to the station together in the rain.
examples.zh: 我们冒雨一起步行前往车站。

examples.en: Please send the finalized report directly to the manager.
examples.zh: 请将定稿的报告直接发送给经理。

examples.en: She made a firm decision to learn a new language this year.
examples.zh: 她下定决心今年要学习一门新语言。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语，核心语义为“朝向目标或终点”，引申出物理方向、到达终点、受动对象、范围边界以及引导动作倾向（动词不定式符号）等多重功能。

lemmas.def_zh: 和，与；而且，并且；然后；那么（表结果）
lemmas.def_en: used to connect words of the same part of speech, phrases, or clauses

examples.en: She grabbed her coat and walked out the door.
examples.zh: 她抓起外套，走出了门。

examples.en: Keep practicing and you will see steady improvement.
examples.zh: 坚持练习，你就会看到稳定的进步。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 and/ond，原始印欧语根与“面对、并置”相关，引申为连接同类词语或分句的核心连词，表达并列、相加、递进或顺承逻辑。

lemmas.def_zh: 关于；属于；由……制成；在……之中；（表示所属、数量或部分）
lemmas.def_en: expressing the relationship between a part and a whole, belonging, origin, substance, or connection

examples.en: She is the director of the marketing department.
examples.zh: 她是市场部的总监。

examples.en: The table is made of solid oak.
examples.zh: 这张桌子是用实心橡木制成的。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古英语，本义为“离开、出自”（与off同源），后虚化为表示所有、所属、来源、构成成分及关联等广泛核心关系的介词

lemmas.def_zh: 在...期间, 在...之内, 处于...之中, 从事于, 按照, 穿着
lemmas.def_en: a unit of length equal to one twelfth of a foot

examples.en: She enjoys reading alone in her room during quiet rainy Sunday afternoons.
examples.zh: 在安静下雨的周日午后，她喜欢独自在房间里看书。

lemmas.def_zh: 执政者, 交情
lemmas.def_en: a unit of length equal to one twelfth of a foot

examples.en: She enjoys reading alone in her room during quiet rainy Sunday afternoons.
examples.zh: 在安静下雨的周日午后，她喜欢独自在房间里看书。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语 *en*（在内），核心语义为“处于空间、时间或状态的内部”，后引申出“处于圈子内部、具有内部特权或门路”的名词用法。
family_guide.core_distinction: 介词 in 表示物理或抽象的“在……里面/期间”；名词 in 常用于口语或特定搭配（如 have an in），指“内部关系、门路”或指在台的政党。

lemmas.def_zh: 为了，给；适合，作为；赞成，支持；因为；达，计（表示时间或距离）
lemmas.def_en: used to indicate purpose, intended recipient, support, reason, or a period of time/distance

examples.en: This gift is for you, to thank you for all your support.
examples.zh: 这份礼物是送给你的，感谢你一直以来的支持。

examples.en: We have lived in this quiet neighborhood for over ten years.
examples.zh: 我们在这个安静的街区已经居住了十多年。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于原始印欧语 *per-（向前、在前面），核心语义为指向某个目标、对象或原因，由此引申出“为了、给、赞成、因为、持续（时间/距离）”等多重关系用法。

lemmas.def_zh: 那个；那（用于指代较远或已知的人或事物）
lemmas.def_en: used to identify a specific person, thing, or idea that is distant in space/time or has already been mentioned

examples.en: Look at that bird singing on the chimney.
examples.zh: 瞧那只在烟囱上唱歌的鸟。

examples.en: I will never forget that day we spent in the mountains.
examples.zh: 我永远不会忘记我们在山里度过的那一天。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语中性单数指示代词 þæt，核心语义是指向在空间、时间或心理距离上相对较远、或上文已提及的特定事物。

lemmas.def_zh: 拥有；进行，经历；吃，喝；使，让；[助]已经
lemmas.def_en: to possess, hold, or own; to experience, undergo, or consume; used as an auxiliary verb to form perfect tenses

examples.en: We need to have an open discussion about the budget before making any decisions.
examples.zh: 在做出任何决定之前，我们需要就预算问题展开一次公开讨论。

examples.en: She had already left the office by the time the client called.
examples.zh: 客户打电话来的时候，她已经离开办公室了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语中表示“握住、抓住”的词根，其核心概念从物理上的“拿持”延伸为抽象的“拥有、经历、体验”及辅助完成体的语法助动词。

lemmas.def_zh: 你；你们；（泛指）任何人，大家
lemmas.def_en: used to refer to the person or people being addressed, or to people in general

examples.en: Thank you for letting me know in advance.
examples.zh: 谢谢你提前告诉我。

examples.en: You never really know what the future holds.
examples.zh: 你永远不会真正知道未来会发生什么。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语第二人称复数宾格代词，经历史演变兼并了单复数及主宾格功能，核心指代谈话对象，亦可泛指任何人。

lemmas.def_zh: 它；这，那；（作形式主语或形式宾语）
lemmas.def_en: used to refer to a thing, animal, situation, or idea previously mentioned; used as a dummy subject or object

examples.en: I picked up the phone and answered it immediately.
examples.zh: 我拿起电话，立刻接听了。

examples.en: It is essential to back up your files regularly.
examples.zh: 定期备份文件是至关重要的。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语中性单数代词 hit，核心用于指代前文提及的无生命物体、动物或抽象概念，并演化为指代天气、时间及充当形式主语的虚词。

lemmas.def_zh: 在...之上
lemmas.def_en: in operation or operational

examples.en: The artist placed a small vase of fresh roses carefully on the wooden table.
examples.zh: 艺术家把一小瓶新鲜玫瑰小心地放在了木桌上。

lemmas.def_zh: 正起作用的
lemmas.def_en: in operation or operational

examples.en: The artist placed a small vase of fresh roses carefully on the wooden table.
examples.zh: 艺术家把一小瓶新鲜玫瑰小心地放在了木桌上。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 on/an（接触、附着），核心意象为物理上的“表面接触与支撑”，后引申为状态上的“接通、运作与进行”以及抽象的“依托、关于”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 介词 on 表空间接触、依附、特定时间或论述主题；形容词 on 则多作表语，表示设备处于开启接通状态，或事件照常举行。

lemmas.def_zh: 和……在一起；具有；带有；用（工具/手段）；随着；关于
lemmas.def_en: accompanied by; having or possessing; using; in opposition or connection to

examples.en: She went to the gallery with a few close friends.
examples.zh: 她和几位好友一起去了美术馆。

examples.en: He opened the locked wooden box with a small silver key.
examples.zh: 他用一把银色的小钥匙打开了那个锁着的木盒。

examples.en: Please handle these fragile ceramic plates with great care.
examples.zh: 请非常小心地轻拿轻放这些易碎的瓷盘。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 wið（原意为‘相对、对抗’，今保留于 withdraw/withstand 中），中古英语时期与表示‘伴随’的词融合，演变为现代表示‘伴随、具有、工具、方式’等关系的核心介词

lemmas.def_zh: 这，这个；今，本（指当下的时间）
lemmas.def_en: used to identify a specific person, thing, or situation close at hand or being currently experienced

examples.en: Could you take a quick look at this report and let me know your thoughts?
examples.zh: 你能快速浏览一下这份报告并告诉我你的想法吗？

examples.en: We are planning to launch the new marketing campaign later this week.
examples.zh: 我们计划在本周晚些时候启动新的营销活动。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语指示代词，核心语义为指代在空间、时间或心理认知上处于“近处、眼前或当下”的人、事物或情况。

lemmas.def_zh: 字母A；最高等级，优（成绩）；（音）A音
lemmas.def_en: the first letter of the English alphabet; the highest grade; the musical note A

examples.en: She studied diligently all semester and received straight A's on her report card.
examples.zh: 她整个学期都勤奋学习，成绩单上拿的全是A（优）。

family_guide.root_logic: as 源自古英语 ealswā（all + so，意为“完全如此”），常作介词和连词；而在词形还原与语法库中，名词 a（字母 A，其复数常写作 As/A's）常被归并关联。

lemmas.def_zh: 在（特定地点或时刻）；向，朝；处于（某种状态）；以（特定速度或比率）
lemmas.def_en: used to indicate a point in space, time, state, or target of an action

examples.en: We agreed to meet at the entrance of the museum at noon.
examples.zh: 我们约好中午在博物馆门口见面。

examples.en: The vehicle was traveling at a dangerous speed along the winding road.
examples.zh: 那辆车在蜿蜒的道路上以危险的速度行驶。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语中表示“靠近、向着”的介词，核心逻辑是锁定空间、时间、状态或动作目标上的精确定位“点”。

lemmas.def_zh: 不；没；未（用于构成否定式或简略表达否定）
lemmas.def_en: used with an auxiliary verb or 'be' to form the negative, or to express a negative condition or response

examples.en: She decided not to accept the offer until she had reviewed all the terms.
examples.zh: 她决定在仔细审阅所有条款之前，先不接受该聘约。

examples.en: I might be tied up tomorrow morning, but if not, I'll join you for coffee.
examples.zh: 我明天早上可能会抽不开身，但如果不忙的话，我就去找你喝咖啡。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 nāwiht（即 no thing / nothing，字面意为“绝无、全无”），经语音弱化缩略为现代英语中最基础的否定标记词。

lemmas.def_zh: 他（主格，指代男性或雄性动物）
lemmas.def_en: used as the subject of a verb to refer to a man, boy, or male animal previously mentioned

examples.en: He promised to call back as soon as he arrived at the office.
examples.zh: 他答应一到办公室就立刻回电话。

examples.en: Whenever he encounters a difficult problem, he stays remarkably calm.
examples.zh: 每当遇到难题时，他总是表现得异常冷静。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语第三人称阳性代词 hē，追溯至原始印欧语指示代词词根 *k̂i-（意为“这、此”），在演变中确立为指代已知男性或雄性主格的核心代词。

lemmas.def_zh: 靠近，在……旁边；通过，借由；不迟于，在……之前；由，被
lemmas.def_en: near or next to; through the means or agency of; not later than

examples.en: She prefers to sit by the window to get plenty of natural light.
examples.zh: 她喜欢坐在窗边，以便获得充足的自然光。

examples.en: You can sign up for the workshop by filling out the online form.
examples.zh: 你可以通过填写在线表格来报名参加研讨会。

examples.en: Please make sure your final report is submitted by Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 请务必在周五下午之前提交你的最终报告。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古英语表示“靠近、挨着”的词根，由物理空间上的“紧邻/依傍”，引申出时间上的“临近/不晚于”，进而发展出手段、途径（通过依靠某物）以及动作的施发者（由……完成）。

lemmas.def_zh: 做，执行；处理；完成；（助动词）用于构成疑问、否定或强调
lemmas.def_en: to perform an action, activity, or task; to deal with or complete; used as an auxiliary verb

examples.en: We need to do something about this issue before it gets completely out of hand.
examples.zh: 在这个问题彻底失控之前，我们必须采取行动来解决它。

examples.en: I do believe that open communication is the key to resolving conflicts.
examples.zh: 我确实坚信坦诚沟通是解决冲突的关键。

lemmas.def_zh: 行为者, 实干家
lemmas.def_en: a person who acts and gets things done

examples.en: The company needs a decisive doer rather than another passive dreamer right now.
examples.zh: 公司现在需要的是一个果断的实干家，而不是又一个被动的梦想家。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 dōn（行动、放置、造成），核心语义为“付诸行动或处理事务”，后延伸发展出用于构成疑问、否定及强调的基础助动词功能。
family_guide.core_distinction: 本条目仅包含核心动词 do，需区分其作为实义动词（执行动作、处理事务）与助动词（构成疑问句、否定句或加重语气）的不同语法角色。

lemmas.def_zh: 很，非常；大量的；大量，许多
lemmas.def_en: to a great degree; a large amount of; a great quantity

examples.en: I feel much better after getting some rest.
examples.zh: 休息了一会儿后，我感觉好多了。

examples.en: We don't have much time left before the deadline.
examples.zh: 在截止日期前，我们剩下的时间不多了。

examples.en: Much of what he said turned out to be true.
examples.zh: 他所说的话中，大部分后来被证实是真的。

lemmas.def_zh: 主要地；大部分，通常
lemmas.def_en: mainly; for the most part or generally

examples.en: The attendees at the conference were mostly software engineers.
examples.zh: 参加这次会议的大多是软件工程师。

lemmas.def_zh: 很，非常；大量的；大量，许多
lemmas.def_en: to a great degree; a large amount of; a great quantity

examples.en: I feel much better after getting some rest.
examples.zh: 休息了一会儿后，我感觉好多了。

examples.en: We don't have much time left before the deadline.
examples.zh: 在截止日期前，我们剩下的时间不多了。

examples.en: Much of what he said turned out to be true.
examples.zh: 他所说的话中，大部分后来被证实是真的。

lemmas.def_zh: 大量, 很多
lemmas.def_en: greatness of quantity or measure or extent

examples.en: The two modern art proposals are really of a muchness in overall quality.
examples.zh: 这两个现代艺术方案在整体质量上其实大差不差。

lemmas.def_zh: 很，非常；大量的；大量，许多
lemmas.def_en: to a great degree; a large amount of; a great quantity

examples.en: I feel much better after getting some rest.
examples.zh: 休息了一会儿后，我感觉好多了。

examples.en: We don't have much time left before the deadline.
examples.zh: 在截止日期前，我们剩下的时间不多了。

examples.en: Much of what he said turned out to be true.
examples.zh: 他所说的话中，大部分后来被证实是真的。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 mycel（大、多的），核心逻辑始终围绕“量大、程度深”，并与表示比较级的 more 及最高级的 most 同源派生。
family_guide.core_distinction: much 侧重修饰不可数事物的数量大或程度深；mostly 则由 most 派生而来，侧重表示整体中的“主要地、绝大部分”。

lemmas.def_zh: 从；来自；离；出于；自……起
lemmas.def_en: indicating the point in space or time at which an action, motion, or state begins, or the source/cause of something

examples.en: The train runs from London to Edinburgh in about four hours.
examples.zh: 这趟列车从伦敦开往爱丁堡大约需要四个小时。

examples.en: She took a deep breath to stop herself from crying.
examples.zh: 她深吸了一口气，免得自己哭出来。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语，本义为“向前、离开”，在演变中核心固化为表示“起点”，由此引申出空间、时间、来源、原因及分离等一系列语义。

lemmas.def_zh: 但是，然而；除了；只是
lemmas.def_en: used to introduce a phrase or clause contrasting with what has already been mentioned; except

examples.en: The proposal was ambitious, but the team managed to deliver it on schedule.
examples.zh: 该方案雄心勃勃，但团队还是按期完成了交付。

examples.en: He had no choice but to accept the final decision.
examples.zh: 他别无选择，只能接受最终决定。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 be-ūtan（be-“在旁”+ ūtan“在外面”），原义为“在……之外”，后引申出排除、转折与让步等连接逻辑，演变为核心转折连词“但是”。

lemmas.def_zh: 我的；（用于感叹或惊奇）哎呀，天哪
lemmas.def_en: belonging to or associated with the speaker; used to express surprise

examples.en: I must have left my keys on the kitchen counter.
examples.zh: 我一定是把钥匙落在厨房台面上了。

examples.en: My, you've certainly changed since the last time I saw you!
examples.zh: 哎呀，自打我上次见你，你变了可真不少！

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语第一人称所有格 mīn 的缩略形（在辅音前脱落鼻音 -n），核心用于修饰名词，表示与说话者本人的领属、关联或亲密属性。
family_guide.core_distinction: my 为形容词性物主代词（限定词），后必须紧跟名词（如 my coat）；mine 为名词性物主代词，独立使用不带名词（如 That coat is mine）。

lemmas.def_zh: 或者，还是；否则，不然；即，也就是
lemmas.def_en: used to link alternatives, introduce a consequence, or rephrase a preceding word

examples.en: Would you prefer tea or coffee with your breakfast?
examples.zh: 你早餐想喝茶还是咖啡？

examples.en: Hurry up, or we will miss the last train home.
examples.zh: 快点，否则我们就赶不上回家的末班车了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古英语并列连词，核心功能在于连接具有替代、选择、转折或同位解释关系的两项或多项事物。

lemmas.def_zh: 我们（第一人称复数主格）；人们，大家
lemmas.def_en: used by a speaker to refer to himself or herself and one or more other people considered together

examples.en: We need to finalize the proposal before tomorrow's meeting.
examples.zh: 我们需要在明天的会议之前定稿提案。

examples.en: If we work together, we can easily overcome these challenges.
examples.zh: 只要我们齐心协力，就能轻松克服这些挑战。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语第一人称复数代词，用于指代说话者本人及与其一同行动、关联的一个或多个群体成员（“我们”）。

lemmas.def_zh: 一（个、件、只……）；任何一个（用于元音音素开头的单数可数名词前）
lemmas.def_en: used instead of 'a' before words beginning with a vowel sound to refer to a single person or thing

examples.en: She took an apple and an orange from the fruit bowl.
examples.zh: 她从果盘里拿了一个苹果和一个橙子。

examples.en: It was an honor to work with such an experienced team.
examples.zh: 能与这样一支经验丰富的团队共事是一件荣幸的事。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语表示“一”的数词 ān，是不定冠词 a 在元音音素前的语音变体，表示泛指的单个个体。
family_guide.core_distinction: 与 a 同源且意义相同，区别在于 an 严格用于以元音音素（而非元音字母）开头的词前。

lemmas.def_zh: 你的；你们的
lemmas.def_en: belonging to or associated with the person or people being addressed

examples.en: Don't forget to take your keys before you leave the house.
examples.zh: 出门前别忘了带上你的钥匙。

examples.en: Thank you all for your time and support throughout the project.
examples.zh: 感谢大家在整个项目期间所付出的时间和支持。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语第二人称代词属格 ēower，核心用于指代属于听话者（单数或复数）的人或事物，演变为现代英语的基本物主限定词。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意区分形容词性物主代词 your（后接名词）与名词性物主代词 yours（独立使用，不接名词）及缩略形式 you're（you are）。

lemmas.def_zh: 因此，所以；以便，好让
lemmas.def_en: used to show the reason, result, or purpose of an action

examples.en: It was getting dark, so we decided to head back.
examples.zh: 天色渐暗，所以我们决定往回走。

examples.en: Speak clearly so everyone can understand you.
examples.zh: 说话清楚些，好让大家都能听懂。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 swā，本义为“以那种方式”，在语法化演进中从指代方式的副词延伸出表顺承、结果及目的的连词功能。

lemmas.def_en: quantifier; used with either mass or count nouns to indicate the whole number or amount of or every one of a class

examples.en: All members of the team agreed to meet early for the crucial presentation.
examples.zh: 团队的所有成员都同意早点碰头准备这场重要的演示。

lemmas.def_zh: 所有的, 全部的, 一切的
lemmas.def_en: quantifier; used with either mass or count nouns to indicate the whole number or amount of or every one of a class

examples.en: All members of the team agreed to meet early for the crucial presentation.
examples.zh: 团队的所有成员都同意早点碰头准备这场重要的演示。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语 *allaz 及古英语 eall（全部的、彻底的），核心语义指代一个整体或集合中的每一个组成部分，无一遗漏。
family_guide.core_distinction: 限定词 all 常位于名词或限定词/代词之前表示全体（如 all the people）；形容词 all 侧重表示“整个的、全部的”（如 all day）或“唯一的”（如 all she wanted）。

lemmas.def_zh: 获得，得到；变得；到达；理解
lemmas.def_en: to receive, obtain, become, or arrive at a place

examples.en: It is starting to get dark, so we should head home.
examples.zh: 天开始变黑了，我们该回家了。

examples.en: Did you get my email about tomorrow's schedule?
examples.zh: 你收到我关于明天日程安排的邮件了吗？

lemmas.def_zh: 获得，到达（get的过去式及英式过去分词）；[与have连用] 拥有，必须
lemmas.def_en: past tense of get, and past participle in British English; used with 'have' to indicate possession or obligation

examples.en: I got an unexpected phone call early this morning.
examples.zh: 今天一大早我接到了一个意外的电话。

examples.en: We've got plenty of time before the train leaves.
examples.zh: 在火车开出前，我们还有充裕的时间。

lemmas.def_zh: 获得，变成，到达（get的美式过去分词）
lemmas.def_en: past participle of get in American English, denoting obtaining, changing state, or moving

examples.en: Things have gotten much better since the new policy was introduced.
examples.zh: 自新政策出台以来，情况已经好转了许多。

examples.en: She has gotten a lot of valuable experience from this project.
examples.zh: 她从这个项目中获得了许多宝贵的经验。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺斯语，核心概念是“抓取、获取”，引申出从未拥有或未处于某种状态转变到“获得”、“变成”或“到达”的动态演变过程。
family_guide.core_distinction: got 为过去式及英式英语通用的过去分词；gotten 为美式英语表示“获得/变成/到达”等动态过程的标准过去分词（但在表示“拥有”或“必须”的 have got 结构中英美均用 got）。

lemmas.def_zh: 他的；他的（所有物）
lemmas.def_en: belonging to or associated with a male person or animal previously mentioned

examples.en: He packed his bags and left for the airport early in the morning.
examples.zh: 他收拾好行李，大清早就动身去机场了。

examples.en: That coat looks just like his, but the color is slightly darker.
examples.zh: 那件外套看着很像他的那件，只是颜色略深一些。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语第三人称阳性代词 he 的属格形式，核心表示“属于他的”领属与关联关系。

lemmas.def_zh: 他们，她们，它们；（指代单数且性别未知或非二元的人）他/她；人们
lemmas.def_en: used to refer to two or more people or things previously mentioned, or to a single person whose gender is unspecified or non-binary

examples.en: The students worked hard, and they all passed the final exam.
examples.zh: 学生们都很努力，并且他们都通过了期末考试。

examples.en: If a customer has a question, they can contact support at any time.
examples.zh: 顾客如有疑问，随时可以联系客服支持。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺斯语指示代词 þeir，在中古英语时期借入以取代本土的复数代词，用作第三人称复数主格，现代亦广泛扩展为指代未知性别或非二元性别的单数代词。

lemmas.def_zh: 一致的, 完整的
lemmas.def_en: used of a single unit or thing; not two or more

examples.en: Only one candidate met all the strict requirements for the research position.
examples.zh: 只有一名候选人符合该研究职位的全部严格要求。

lemmas.def_zh: 一(个)
lemmas.def_en: the smallest whole number or a numeral representing this number

examples.en: Only one candidate met all the strict requirements for the research position.
examples.zh: 只有一名候选人符合该研究职位的全部严格要求。

lemmas.def_zh: 单一性, 同一性, 统一性
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being united into one

examples.en: Standing atop the quiet mountain, he felt a deep sense of oneness with nature.
examples.zh: 站在寂静的山顶上，他体会到一种与大自然融为一体的深刻感觉。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语 *oi-no-（单一的、独一的），核心表达基本数量单位“1”以及单一、整体与不可分割的概念。
family_guide.core_distinction: 作为形容词强调数量的单一或身份的唯一/特定；作为名词或代词则指代具体的单个数字、事物或泛指‘一个人’。

lemmas.def_zh: 我（代词 I 的宾格形式）
lemmas.def_en: used as the objective form of 'I', referring to the speaker or writer as the object of a verb or preposition

examples.en: If you have any questions about the plan, please let me know.
examples.zh: 如果你对这个计划有任何疑问，请随时告诉我。

examples.en: She sat next to me during the entire presentation.
examples.zh: 在整场演示过程中，她都坐在我旁边。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语第一人称单数斜格词根 *me-，自古英语时期起便专职作为第一人称（I）的宾格和斜格形式，指代说话者自身。

lemmas.def_zh: 如果，假如；是否；即使
lemmas.def_en: introducing a conditional clause; whether; even though

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, the outdoor concert will be moved inside.
examples.zh: 如果明天下雨，室外音乐会将改在室内举行。

examples.en: I was wondering if you could give me some advice on this matter.
examples.zh: 我想知道你是否能就这件事给我一些建议。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 gif，核心语义为设定未决的前提、条件或假设，引申出表示疑虑的“是否”。

lemmas.def_zh: 装罐
lemmas.def_en: preserve in a can or tin

examples.en: Every autumn, my grandmother teaches us how to can fresh peaches for winter.
examples.zh: 每年秋天，祖母都会教我们如何把新鲜桃子制成罐头以备过冬。

lemmas.def_zh: 罐头, 容器
lemmas.def_en: airtight sealed metal container for food or drink or paint etc.

examples.en: Every autumn, my grandmother teaches us how to can fresh peaches for winter.
examples.zh: 每年秋天，祖母都会教我们如何把新鲜桃子制成罐头以备过冬。

lemmas.def_zh: 罐头厂
lemmas.def_en: a factory where food is canned

examples.en: My grandfather spent thirty years working at the local salmon cannery.
examples.zh: 我祖父在当地的鲑鱼罐头厂工作了三十年。

family_guide.root_logic: 情态动词 can 源自古英语‘知晓、懂得’，引申出‘能够’；名词 can 源自古英语‘容器、杯’，二者在词源上独立但现代共形。
family_guide.core_distinction: 情态动词 can 表能力、许可或可能性，后接动词原形；名词 can 指装食品或饮料的金属罐/听。

lemmas.def_zh: 象, 如同
lemmas.def_en: a similar kind; ,

examples.en: He walked swiftly through the dark forest, moving quietly like a hunting shadow.
examples.zh: 他飞快地穿过黑暗的森林，像一道狩猎的影子般悄无声息。

lemmas.def_zh: likely（很可能的）的比较级形式

examples.en: With improved weather conditions, the rescue team feels a successful operation is far likelier.
examples.zh: 随着天气状况的好转，救援队觉得搜救成功的可能性大得多了。

examples.en: Heavy rain remains the likeliest reason for the unexpected cancellation of the flight.
examples.zh: 暴雨仍然是航班意外取消的最可能原因。

lemmas.def_zh: 喜欢, 愿意, 想；喜欢, 希望
lemmas.def_en: prefer or wish to do something

examples.en: He walked swiftly through the dark forest, moving quietly like a hunting shadow.
examples.zh: 他飞快地穿过黑暗的森林，像一道狩猎的影子般悄无声息。

lemmas.def_zh: 相似的, 同样的
lemmas.def_en: resembling or similar; having the same or some of the same characteristics; often used in combination

examples.en: He walked swiftly through the dark forest, moving quietly like a hunting shadow.
examples.zh: 他飞快地穿过黑暗的森林，像一道狩猎的影子般悄无声息。

lemmas.def_zh: 有可能的, 合适的, 前途有望的
lemmas.def_en: has a good chance of being the case or of coming about

examples.en: The local meteorologist warned that strong evening thunderstorms are very likely today.
examples.zh: 当地气象学家警告说，今天傍晚极有可能出现强烈雷雨。

lemmas.def_zh: 不太可能的
lemmas.def_en: not likely to be true or to occur or to have occurred

examples.en: Given the strict schedule, it is unlikely that we can finish the report today.
examples.zh: 鉴于日程紧张，我们今天不太可能完成这份报告。

lemmas.def_zh: 可爱的, 值得喜欢的, 迷人的
lemmas.def_en: (of characters in literature or drama) evoking empathic or sympathetic feelings

examples.en: His cheerful nature and warm humor made him an instantly likeable young colleague.
examples.zh: 他开朗的性格和热情的幽默感使他成了一个立刻讨人喜欢的年轻同事。

lemmas.def_zh: 可爱的
lemmas.def_en: (of characters in literature or drama) evoking empathic or sympathetic feelings

examples.en: The new manager has a very likable personality that puts everyone at ease.
examples.zh: 新经理的性格非常随和讨喜，让大家都感到轻松自在。

lemmas.def_zh: 不讨喜的; 不可爱的
lemmas.def_en: (of characters in literature or drama) tending to evoke antipathetic feelings

examples.en: His arrogant behavior in meetings made him an extremely unlikable colleague among peers.
examples.zh: 他在会议上的傲慢举止使他在同僚中成了一个极不讨喜的同事。

lemmas.def_zh: 不讨喜的
lemmas.def_en: (of characters in literature or drama) tending to evoke antipathetic feelings

examples.en: The author deliberately created an unlikeable protagonist to challenge the readers' moral assumptions.
examples.zh: 作者特意塑造了一个不讨喜的主角，以挑战读者的道德预设。

lemmas.def_zh: 相象, 相似物, 样子
lemmas.def_en: similarity in appearance or character or nature between persons or things

examples.en: The portrait bears an astonishing likeness to her late grandmother.
examples.zh: 这幅肖像与她已故的祖母惊人地相似。

lemmas.def_zh: 可能
lemmas.def_en: the probability of a specified outcome

examples.en: There is a strong likeliness that the flight will be delayed.
examples.zh: 该航班很有可能会被延误。

lemmas.def_zh: 不大可能,不一样
lemmas.def_en: the improbability of a specified outcome

examples.en: Despite the unlikeliness of success, she never stopped trying.
examples.zh: 尽管成功的可能性极小，但她从未停止尝试。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语表示“身体、形态”的词根，核心引申为“具有相同外形”，由此演化出“相像、如同”（介/形），并进一步衍生出“合意、喜爱”（动）以及“看起来会发生的、很可能”（形）。
family_guide.core_distinction: like 作形容词强调“相似的”（多修饰名词），而 likely/unlikely 侧重事情“可能/不大可能”发生的概率。

lemmas.def_zh: 用意志的力量驱使, 决意, 愿意, 立遗嘱；下决心, 愿意
lemmas.def_en: decree or ordain

examples.en: She managed to will her tired body to cross the finish line.
examples.zh: 她靠意志力支撑着疲惫的身躯冲过了终点线。

lemmas.def_zh: 意志, 决心, 意愿, 意向, 干劲, 遗嘱
lemmas.def_en: the capability of conscious choice and decision and intention; - George Meredith

examples.en: She managed to will her tired body to cross the finish line.
examples.zh: 她靠意志力支撑着疲惫的身躯冲过了终点线。

lemmas.def_zh: 乐意；意愿；心甘情愿
lemmas.def_en: the quality or state of being prepared or ready to do something

examples.en: Career growth often depends on your willingness to embrace new challenges.
examples.zh: 职业成长往往取决于你迎接新挑战的意愿。

lemmas.def_zh: 不情愿；不愿意
lemmas.def_en: the trait of being unwilling

examples.en: His unwillingness to compromise eventually led to the collapse of the peace talks.
examples.zh: 他不愿妥协的态度最终导致了和谈的破裂。

lemmas.def_zh: 不愿意的；勉强的
lemmas.def_en: not ready, eager, or prepared to do something; reluctant

examples.en: Management was unwilling to meet the workers' demands for higher pay.
examples.zh: 管理层不愿满足工人们提高薪资的要求。

lemmas.def_zh: 乐意地；自愿地；欣然地
lemmas.def_en: readily, gladly, or of one's own free will

examples.en: He willingly took on extra shifts to support his team during the crisis.
examples.zh: 在危机期间，他欣然承担了额外的轮班以支援团队。

lemmas.def_zh: 不情愿地, 勉强地; 勉勉强强
lemmas.def_en: in an unwilling manner

examples.en: He unwillingly admitted that his rival had presented a far better proposal.
examples.zh: 他不情愿地承认竞争对手提出了一个好得多的方案。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语族核心词，根本语义为“意愿、欲望与决心”，由“主观心愿”衍生出情态/将来时助动词（动词），以及意志力、意图和生前遗愿即遗嘱（名词）。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词作为情态助动词表将来预测或主观意愿（亦可作实义动词表示立遗嘱或用意念驱动）；名词则具体化为意志力、自主选择权或法律效力的遗嘱。

lemmas.def_zh: 制造，做；产生；使成为；迫使
lemmas.def_en: to create, produce, or cause something to exist or happen

examples.en: We need to make a final decision before the deadline.
examples.zh: 我们需要在截止日期之前做出最终决定。

examples.en: The unexpected news made her reconsider her plans.
examples.zh: 这个意外的消息促使她重新考虑自己的计划。

lemmas.def_zh: unmake的过去式和过去分词
lemmas.def_en: deprive of certain characteristics

examples.en: He walked into the bedroom and saw the bed was still unmade.
examples.zh: 他走进卧室，看到被褥依然没有整理。

lemmas.def_zh: 使恢复原状, 撤...的职, 毁灭, 改变
lemmas.def_en: deprive of certain characteristics

examples.en: No one can unmake the past, but we can shape the future.
examples.zh: 没有人能改变过去，但我们可以塑造未来。

lemmas.def_zh: 制造，发展过程；素质，潜质
lemmas.def_en: the process of creating something; the essential qualities needed to become something

examples.en: This historic agreement was several years in the making.
examples.zh: 这项历史性协议历时数年才得以达成。

examples.en: He clearly has the makings of a great leader.
examples.zh: 他显然具备成为一名伟大领袖的潜质。

lemmas.def_zh: 制造者，制作者；出资/制定者
lemmas.def_en: a person, machine, or company that creates or produces something

examples.en: The car maker announced plans to develop electric vehicles.
examples.zh: 该汽车制造商宣布了研发电动汽车的计划。

examples.en: Policy makers are meeting to discuss measures against inflation.
examples.zh: 政策制定者正在开会商讨对抗通货膨胀的措施。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 macian（构筑、整理、产生），核心逻辑是从无到有地“塑形、创制”，后引申为使处于某种状态或促成某种结果。
family_guide.core_distinction: maker 侧重制造者或决策主体（如 watchmaker, decision-maker）；making 侧重制造过程，或指成为某类人/事物所需的内在潜质（常用于 in the making 或 the making of）。

lemmas.def_zh: adv. 正好，恰好；仅仅，只是；刚才；adj. 公正的，合情合理的
lemmas.def_en: adv. exactly; only or simply; a moment ago; adj. morally fair, reasonable, and right

examples.en: The size is just right, and it arrived just as I was leaving.
examples.zh: 尺码正好合适，而且它刚好在我正要离开时送到了。

examples.en: Don't worry, it was just an honest mistake.
examples.zh: 别担心，这只不过是一个无心之失。

examples.en: The jury worked hard to ensure a fair and just verdict.
examples.zh: 陪审团努力确保作出一项公平且公正的裁决。

lemmas.def_zh: 不义地, 不法地
lemmas.def_en: in an unjust manner

examples.en: He felt he had been unjustly blamed for the team's failure.
examples.zh: 他觉得自己为团队的失败背了黑锅，很不公平。

lemmas.def_zh: 公正地, 理由充分地, 正当地
lemmas.def_en: with honesty

examples.en: The artist was justly praised for her remarkable contribution to modern art.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家因对现代艺术的杰出贡献而理所应当地受到赞誉。

lemmas.def_zh: adv. 正好，恰好；仅仅，只是；刚才；adj. 公正的，合情合理的
lemmas.def_en: adv. exactly; only or simply; a moment ago; adj. morally fair, reasonable, and right

examples.en: The size is just right, and it arrived just as I was leaving.
examples.zh: 尺码正好合适，而且它刚好在我正要离开时送到了。

examples.en: Don't worry, it was just an honest mistake.
examples.zh: 别担心，这只不过是一个无心之失。

examples.en: The jury worked hard to ensure a fair and just verdict.
examples.zh: 陪审团努力确保作出一项公平且公正的裁决。

lemmas.def_zh: 不公平的
lemmas.def_en: not fair; marked by injustice or partiality or deception

examples.en: The citizens took to the streets to protest against the unjust law.
examples.zh: 市民们走上街头抗议这项不公正的法律。

lemmas.def_zh: 公正, 正当, 正确
lemmas.def_en: conformity with some esthetic standard of correctness or propriety

examples.en: Nobody in the court could question the justness of the judge's decision.
examples.zh: 法庭上没有人质疑法官判决的正当性。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 justus（公正、合法），本义为“符合法则或标准的”，形容词保留了道德与法律上的“公平正义”，副词则引申为程度或时空上的“恰好达标、不偏不倚”，进而演化出“正好”、“刚才”与“仅仅”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词用法专指道德或法规上的“公正合理”；副词用法则转向程度与时间的精准限定，表示“正好、刚才”或轻微程度的“仅仅”。

lemmas.def_zh: 好的, 优良的, 上等的, 愉快的, 有益的, 好心的, 慈善的, 虔诚的
lemmas.def_en: having desirable or positive qualities especially those suitable for a thing specified

examples.en: Eating fresh vegetables every day is really good for your overall health.
examples.zh: 每天吃新鲜蔬菜对你的整体健康非常有益。

lemmas.def_zh: 漂亮的, 颇大的, 不错的, 好的, 讨人喜欢的
lemmas.def_en: large in amount or extent or degree

examples.en: She donated a goodly sum of money to the local children's hospital.
examples.zh: 她向当地儿童医院捐赠了相当大的一笔钱。

lemmas.def_zh: 善行, 好处, 利益
lemmas.def_en: benefit

examples.en: Eating fresh vegetables every day is really good for your overall health.
examples.zh: 每天吃新鲜蔬菜对你的整体健康非常有益。

lemmas.def_zh: 善良，仁慈；美德；营养精华
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being morally good or virtuous; the beneficial or nutritious part of something

examples.en: Despite facing constant adversity, she never lost her faith in human goodness.
examples.zh: 尽管历经磨难，她从未失去对人性本善的信念。

examples.en: Gently steaming vegetables helps to retain all their natural goodness and flavor.
examples.zh: 温和地蒸煮蔬菜有助于保留其全部的天然营养与风味。

lemmas.def_zh: 改进, 改善, (不动产)增值
lemmas.def_en: a change for the better; progress in development

examples.en: He dedicated his entire life to the betterment of the local community.
examples.zh: 他毕生致力于改善当地社区的状况。

lemmas.def_en: surpass in excellence

examples.en: The ambitious young athlete was determined to better her previous record.
examples.zh: 这位雄心勃勃的年轻运动员决心刷新她以往的纪录。

lemmas.def_zh: 打赌；下赌注；敢说，确信
lemmas.def_en: to risk money on the result of an event; to feel sure that something is true or will happen

examples.en: I bet five dollars that he wouldn't finish the race.
examples.zh: 我下注五美元赌他跑不完全程。

examples.en: I bet you're exhausted after that twelve-hour flight.
examples.zh: 坐了12个小时的飞机，我敢说你一定累坏了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语，核心本义为“聚合相宜的、令人满意的”，引申为符合道德或质量标准的“好的（adj.）”，后转为名词指代“益处、福祉（n.）”，加上抽象名词后缀 -ness 则表“善良美德或精华成分”。
family_guide.core_distinction: good 作名词常指实际的“益处、利益或善举”（如 do good, for the good of）；goodness 则特指抽象的“善良、仁慈品质”或食物中的“营养精华”。

lemmas.def_zh: 去，走；离开；运转；进展；变为
lemmas.def_en: to move or travel from one place to another; to depart; to function, proceed, or change state

examples.en: We are planning to go to Japan for our vacation this autumn.
examples.zh: 我们打算今年秋天去日本度假。

examples.en: Things didn't go as smoothly as we had hoped during the product launch.
examples.zh: 在产品发布期间，事情的进展并没有我们预期的那么顺利。

lemmas.def_zh: 离去的游人(或客人), 走动的东西
lemmas.def_en: someone who leaves

examples.en: As an avid theater goer, she rarely missed any major Broadway production.
examples.zh: 作为一名狂热的剧场常客，她很少错过任何百老汇大制作。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 gān，核心动作意象为“由近及远的位移”，进而引申为向特定方向前行、状态的转变、进程的推移以及机制的运转。

lemmas.def_zh: 关于，涉及；在……周围，在……各处；大约
lemmas.def_en: on the subject of; in or around a place; approximately

examples.en: We need to have a serious conversation about our future plans.
examples.zh: 我们需要就未来的计划认真谈一谈。

examples.en: Tourists were wandering about the historic town all afternoon.
examples.zh: 整个下午游客们都在这座历史名城的各处漫步。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 onbūtan（在……外部/周围），核心意象为“环绕某处”，演变为空间上的“在……四周/各处”，进而引申为“围绕某主题（关于）”及数值上的“在……上下（大约）”。

lemmas.def_zh: 在...上面, 向...的较高处
lemmas.def_en: raise

examples.en: We walked slowly up the steep hill to watch the morning sunrise.
examples.zh: 我们慢慢走上陡峭的山坡去看日出。

lemmas.def_en: raise

examples.en: We walked slowly up the steep hill to watch the morning sunrise.
examples.zh: 我们慢慢走上陡峭的山坡去看日出。

lemmas.def_zh: 向上的, 起床的, 涨的
lemmas.def_en: being or moving higher in position or greater in some value; being above a former position or level

examples.en: We walked slowly up the steep hill to watch the morning sunrise.
examples.zh: 我们慢慢走上陡峭的山坡去看日出。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语 *upo（从下方往上），核心意象始终围绕“向上移动、处于高位、达到完全/开启/终止状态”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 作为介词表示沿空间向高处或沿着道路/河流延伸；作为动词表示突然增加或提高（如提价）；作为形容词常用于表语，表示起床、时间到或情绪高昂。

lemmas.def_zh: 出自, 离去, 向
lemmas.def_en: (baseball) a failure by a batter or runner to reach a base safely in baseball

examples.en: The tired child looked out the car window at the passing trees.
examples.zh: 疲惫的孩子望向车窗外掠过的树木。

lemmas.def_zh: 外面的, 熄灭的, 结束的
lemmas.def_en: not allowed to continue to bat or run

examples.en: The tired child looked out the car window at the passing trees.
examples.zh: 疲惫的孩子望向车窗外掠过的树木。

lemmas.def_en: to state openly and publicly one's homosexuality

examples.en: The tired child looked out the car window at the passing trees.
examples.zh: 疲惫的孩子望向车窗外掠过的树木。

lemmas.def_zh: 郊游, 远足
lemmas.def_en: a journey taken for pleasure

examples.en: The whole company went on a pleasant weekend outing to the countryside.
examples.zh: 全公司去乡下度过了一个愉快的周末远足。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语表达“向外、离开”的方位词，核心意象是从内部移至外部，进而引申出“在外面（不在场）”、“暴露于公众视野”以及动词层面的“揭露、公之于众”。
family_guide.core_distinction: out 作动词特指公开揭露（常指性取向或隐秘身份）；而动名词派生的 outing 最常指休闲“远足、出游”，但在特定语境下也可指“揭秘事件”。

lemmas.def_zh: 什么；……的事物/情况；多么
lemmas.def_en: used in questions to ask for information about something, or used to refer to the thing or things that

examples.en: What did she say when you told her the news?
examples.zh: 你告诉她那个消息时，她说了什么？

examples.en: Listen carefully to what I am about to tell you.
examples.zh: 仔细听好我接下来要对你说的话。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语疑问代词中性形式 *hwat（古英语 hwæt），核心功能是指代未知的事物、性质或概念，兼具疑问与名词性关系代词功能。

lemmas.def_zh: 时间, 时侯, 时机, 时期, 期限, 次数, 节拍, 暂停, 规定时间
lemmas.def_en: an instance or single occasion for some event

examples.en: She realized it was time to leave for the airport immediately.
examples.zh: 她意识到该立刻动身去机场了。

lemmas.def_zh: 时间选择, 时间测定, 定时, 调速
lemmas.def_en: the time when something happens

examples.en: His entrance was perfect, showing impeccable timing for the dramatic scene.
examples.zh: 他的入场非常完美，为这场戏剧性的场景展现了绝佳的时机把控。

lemmas.def_zh: 计时员, 计时器
lemmas.def_en: a timepiece that measures a time interval and signals its end

examples.en: She set the kitchen timer for twenty minutes before putting the bread in.
examples.zh: 放入面包前，她把厨房定时器设为了二十分钟。

lemmas.def_zh: [经] 时间性, 及时性
lemmas.def_en: being at the right time

examples.en: The timeliness of the emergency medical response ultimately saved the patient's life.
examples.zh: 急救医疗响应的及时性最终挽救了患者的生命。

lemmas.def_zh: 无时间限制
lemmas.def_en: a state of eternal existence believed in some religions to characterize the afterlife

examples.en: Her classical architecture possesses a sense of timelessness that never goes out of style.
examples.zh: 她的古典建筑拥有一种永恒感，永远不会过时。

lemmas.def_zh: 测定...的时间, 记录...的时间, 计时, 定时
lemmas.def_en: measure the time or duration of an event or action or the person who performs an action in a certain period of time

examples.en: The coach used a digital stopwatch to carefully time each runner during practice.
examples.zh: 教练在训练期间用数字秒表为每位跑步者仔细计时。

lemmas.def_zh: 使不合时宜
lemmas.def_en: time incorrectly

examples.en: The young actor mistimed his entrance and walked onto the stage too early.
examples.zh: 那位年轻演员搞错了入场时间，过早走上了舞台。

lemmas.def_zh: 及时的, 适时的
lemmas.def_en: before a time limit expires

examples.en: Thanks to your timely intervention, we managed to avoid a very costly technical error.
examples.zh: 多亏了你及时的干预，我们才避免了一次代价高昂的技术错误。

lemmas.def_zh: 无时间限制的, 不受时间影响的, 永恒的
lemmas.def_en: unaffected by time

examples.en: The novel remains a timeless masterpiece that continues to inspire readers across generations.
examples.zh: 这部小说仍是一部永恒的杰作，不断激励着一代又一代的读者。

lemmas.def_zh: 不到时候的, 不合时令的, 不适时的
lemmas.def_en: badly timed

examples.en: The sudden downpour brought an untimely end to our outdoor family picnic yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天的突降暴雨让我们户外的家庭野餐过早收场。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 tīma，核心语义指“持续流逝的维度”、“特定阶段或时刻”，由此延伸出对“事件发生时机的测量与把控”。
family_guide.core_distinction: timely 强调“及时的、适时的（发生在恰当点）”；timeless 强调“永恒的、超越时间限制的”；timing 侧重“时机的把控或选择”，而 timer 是具体的“计时器具或人员”。

lemmas.def_zh: 说；讲；表明；表达
lemmas.def_en: to utter words so as to convey information, an opinion, or a message

examples.en: It goes without saying that hard work is essential for success.
examples.zh: 不言而喻，努力是成功的关键。

examples.en: What did the doctor say about your test results?
examples.zh: 医生对你的检查结果怎么说？

lemmas.def_zh: say的过去式和过去分词
lemmas.def_en: express in words

examples.en: She said nothing during the meeting, but took detailed notes in her journal.
examples.zh: 她在会议期间什么也没说，但在笔记本上做了详细的记录。

lemmas.def_zh: 上述的
lemmas.def_en: being the one previously mentioned or spoken of

examples.en: She said nothing during the meeting, but took detailed notes in her journal.
examples.zh: 她在会议期间什么也没说，但在笔记本上做了详细的记录。

lemmas.def_zh: 谚语；格言；俗话
lemmas.def_en: a well-known phrase or statement that expresses a general truth or piece of advice

examples.en: As the old saying goes, actions speak louder than words.
examples.zh: 正如常言所说，事实胜于雄辩。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 secgan，核心意象为“用言语表达或陈述”，后续延伸出过去分词转化的公文用形容词（前述的）以及动名词转化的名词（格言、俗话）。
family_guide.core_distinction: said 作形容词时专用于正式公文或法律文书，指“上述的”；saying 则指代代相传的“谚语、老话”。

lemmas.def_zh: 当……时；在……的时候；既然
lemmas.def_en: at or during the time that; considering that

examples.en: Please give me a call when you arrive at the station.
examples.zh: 你到达车站时请给我打个电话。

examples.en: How can you expect to improve when you never practice?
examples.zh: 既然你从不练习，又怎能指望有所进步呢？

family_guide.root_logic: 源自印欧疑问代词词干，核心逻辑为标记或询问事件发生的“时间点或时间段”，由时间关系进一步引申出因果与背景对比。

lemmas.def_en: a negative

examples.en: There was no doubt in anyone's mind about who deserved the final award.
examples.zh: 大家心里都丝毫没有怀疑谁理应获得最终的奖项。

lemmas.def_zh: 不, 拒绝, 否决票
lemmas.def_en: a negative

examples.en: There was no doubt in anyone's mind about who deserved the final award.
examples.zh: 大家心里都丝毫没有怀疑谁理应获得最终的奖项。

lemmas.def_zh: 没有, 不是, 绝非
lemmas.def_en: quantifier; used with either mass nouns or plural count nouns for indicating a complete or almost complete lack or zero quantity of

examples.en: There was no doubt in anyone's mind about who deserved the final award.
examples.zh: 大家心里都丝毫没有怀疑谁理应获得最终的奖项。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 nā（由 ne'不' + ā'永远/任何时候'融合而成，原义为'绝不'），演变中固化为表示绝对否定、零数量或拒绝的核心词根词。
family_guide.core_distinction: 限定词用于名词前表示'全无/零'；名词指'否定的回答或反对票'；形容词常用于修饰名词性表语，强调'绝不是/绝非'。

lemmas.def_zh: 谁；什么人；（关系代词）…的人
lemmas.def_en: what or which person or people; used in relative clauses to refer to a person

examples.en: Who is responsible for organizing the conference this year?
examples.zh: 今年谁负责筹办这次会议？

examples.en: She is the architect who designed the city's new library.
examples.zh: 她就是设计了这座城市新图书馆的建筑师。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语疑问代词 hwā，专用于指代人，演变为现代英语中指称人称主体的核心疑问代词与关系代词。

lemmas.def_zh: 他们的；她们的；它们的；（指代单数未指定性别的人）他/她的
lemmas.def_en: belonging to or associated with the people, animals, or things previously mentioned; used to refer to a person of unspecified sex

examples.en: The children put on their coats before heading outside into the snow.
examples.zh: 孩子们穿上外套，然后走向外面的雪地。

examples.en: If someone calls, please ask them to leave their name and number.
examples.zh: 如果有人打电话来，请让他们留下姓名和电话号码。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺斯语属格代词 þeira，为第三人称代词 they 的形容词性物主代词（限定词），表示“属于他们/她们/它们的”，现代英语中亦常用于单数泛指人物。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意与同音异形词 there（地点副词/代词）和 they're（they are 的缩写）区分拼写与语法功能。

lemmas.def_zh: 在那里
lemmas.def_en: in or at that place

examples.en: Please leave the package over there on the front porch near the door.
examples.zh: 请把包裹放在门前走廊那边的门旁。

lemmas.def_en: a location other than here; that place

examples.en: Please leave the package over there on the front porch near the door.
examples.zh: 请把包裹放在门前走廊那边的门旁。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 þǣr，与指示词 that/the 同源，核心概念为指示远离说话者的“那个地点/方向”，并引申出引导存现句的虚义功能。
family_guide.core_distinction: 副词形式最为常见，修饰动作地点或引导存现句（There is/are）；名词形式主要出现在介词之后（如 from there），直接充当处所或阶段的代称。

lemmas.def_zh: 哪一个，哪一些；（引导关系从句）所……的那个/那些；这（指代整件事）
lemmas.def_en: used in questions to specify one or more items from a limited set, or as a relative pronoun referring to things or preceding clauses

examples.en: Which of these two candidates do you think is best suited for the role?
examples.zh: 这两个候选人中，你认为哪一个最适合这个职位？

examples.en: He decided to resign without notice, which came as a shock to the whole team.
examples.zh: 他决定在未提前通知的情况下辞职，这让整个团队都大为震惊。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语复合词 hwilc（即 who + like，字面为'何种模样的'），核心语义为在已知或限定的范围中'挑选、指代特定的人或事物'。

lemmas.def_zh: 她的；她（宾格）
lemmas.def_en: belonging to or associated with a female person previously mentioned; used as the object of a verb or preposition to refer to a female person

examples.en: She took off her coat and hung it behind the door.
examples.zh: 她脱下外套，挂在了门后。

examples.en: Her dedication to the research project earned her widespread recognition.
examples.zh: 她对该研究项目的投入为她赢得了广泛的认可。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语第三人称单数阴性代词属格与与格形式 hire，现代英语中主要用作形容词性物主代词（限定词，意为“她的”）及代词宾格（意为“她”）。
family_guide.core_distinction: 作为限定词的 her 必须后接名词（如 her car），需与名词性物主代词 hers（独立使用，如 The car is hers）区分开。

lemmas.def_zh: 知道；认识；了解；确信
lemmas.def_en: to have information in your mind; to be familiar with someone or something

examples.en: I know from experience that rushing rarely saves time.
examples.zh: 我凭经验知道，匆匆忙忙很少能节省时间。

lemmas.def_zh: know的过去分词
lemmas.def_en: be cognizant or aware of a fact or a specific piece of information; possess knowledge or information about

examples.en: The local chef is widely known for creating traditional dishes with modern twists.
examples.zh: 这位当地厨师因将传统菜肴融入现代风味而广为人知。

lemmas.def_zh: 知道；认识（know 的过去式）
lemmas.def_en: past tense of know; had information or familiarity in the past

examples.en: Deep down, she knew she had made the right decision.
examples.zh: 在她心底深处，她知道自己做出了正确的决定。

lemmas.def_zh: 已知的, 有名的
lemmas.def_en: apprehended with certainty

examples.en: The local chef is widely known for creating traditional dishes with modern twists.
examples.zh: 这位当地厨师因将传统菜肴融入现代风味而广为人知。

lemmas.def_zh: 不能知道的, 不可知的
lemmas.def_en: not knowable

examples.en: The true origins of the ancient universe remain largely unknowable to modern scientists.
examples.zh: 古代宇宙的真正起源对现代科学家来说在很大程度上仍是不可知的。

lemmas.def_zh: 可知的, 能认识的, 易知的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being known

examples.en: The basic principles of physics are fully knowable through careful study and experimentation.
examples.zh: 通过仔细的学习和实验，物理学的基本原理是完全可认识的。

lemmas.def_zh: 未知事物；默默无闻的人
lemmas.def_en: a person, thing, or place that is unfamiliar or not identified

examples.en: Facing a major career change felt like stepping into the unknown.
examples.zh: 面对重大的职业转变，感觉就像是踏入了未知的领域。

lemmas.def_en: ignorance (especially of orthodox beliefs)

examples.en: In a state of pure unknowing, the novice made several avoidable early mistakes.
examples.zh: 在一种全然不知的状态下，这个新手犯了几个本可避免的初期错误。

lemmas.def_zh: 认识者；理解者
lemmas.def_en: a person who knows or apprehends

examples.en: As a deep knower of human nature, she easily predicted their next move.
examples.zh: 作为深刻洞悉人性的人，她轻松预测了他们的下一步行动。

lemmas.def_zh: 知道
lemmas.def_en: having knowledge of

examples.en: A brief flash of knowingness appeared in her eyes as he started speaking.
examples.zh: 当他开始说话时，她眼中闪过一丝心领神会的神情。

lemmas.def_zh: 故意地，明知故犯地；心照不宣地
lemmas.def_en: in a way that shows full awareness, often deliberately or with secret understanding

examples.en: He was accused of knowingly submitting false tax documents.
examples.zh: 他被指控故意提交虚假的税务文件。

lemmas.def_zh: 无意中, 非存心地, 不知不觉地
lemmas.def_en: without knowledge or intention

examples.en: He unknowingly dropped his leather wallet while hurrying across the busy train station.
examples.zh: 他在匆忙穿过繁忙的火车站时不自觉地掉落了皮夹。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语根 *gno-（认知、辨别），其演变核心始终在于“通过感官或心智获取信息，并在心中确立熟悉度与确定性”。
family_guide.core_distinction: known 侧重客观上“被众人所知晓或公认”，而 knowingly 侧重主观上“自身心知肚明、明知故犯地采取行动”。

lemmas.def_zh: 将（will的过去式）；会，想要（表假设、意愿或委婉请求）；过去常常（表习惯）
lemmas.def_en: used as the past form of 'will', to express conditional or hypothetical situations, polite requests, or past habits

examples.en: If I had enough time, I would definitely travel around the world.
examples.zh: 如果我有足够的时间，我一定会去环游世界。

examples.en: Would you mind closing the window? It's getting a bit chilly.
examples.zh: 你介意把窗户关上吗？天气有点转凉了。

examples.en: When we were kids, my grandfather would take us fishing every summer.
examples.zh: 我们小的时候，祖父每年夏天都会带我们去钓鱼。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 wolde（will 的过去式），核心意为“意愿”，演变为主表情态的助动词，用于虚拟假设、委婉请求或过去的习惯行为。

lemmas.def_zh: 拿取；接受；花费；乘坐；认为
lemmas.def_en: to grasp, accept, acquire, or use something; to require time or effort

examples.en: It will take approximately forty minutes to reach the airport by train.
examples.zh: 乘火车去机场大约需要四十分钟。

examples.en: Please take a moment to read the terms and conditions carefully.
examples.zh: 请花一点时间仔细阅读这些条款和条件。

lemmas.def_zh: 犯错, 误认；误解, 弄错
lemmas.def_en: identify incorrectly

examples.en: People often mistake the quiet twin for his much more outgoing older brother.
examples.zh: 人们常常把这个安静的双胞胎之一误认为他更外向的哥哥。

lemmas.def_zh: 拿取，获取；（复数 takings）营业额，进账
lemmas.def_en: the act of seizing or acquiring; (plural) the amount of money earned or taken in

examples.en: Daily takings at the shop were lower than expected due to the bad weather.
examples.zh: 由于恶劣天气，这家商店的每日营业额低于预期。

examples.en: The taking of hostages is strictly condemned under international law.
examples.zh: 根据国际法，劫持人质的行为受到严厉谴责。

lemmas.def_zh: 错误, 误会
lemmas.def_en: a wrong action attributable to bad judgment or ignorance or inattention

examples.en: People often mistake the quiet twin for his much more outgoing older brother.
examples.zh: 人们常常把这个安静的双胞胎之一误认为他更外向的哥哥。

lemmas.def_zh: 取者, 捕者, 接受者, 收取者
lemmas.def_en: one who accepts an offer

examples.en: He offered an extra ticket for the concert, but found no eager taker.
examples.zh: 他多提供了一张音乐会门票，但没有找到愿意接受的人。

lemmas.def_zh: 错误地, 被误解地
lemmas.def_en: in a mistaken manner

examples.en: I mistakenly sent the confidential report to the wrong client yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天误把机密报告发给了错误的客户。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古诺斯语 taka（抓取、握住），核心语义是“主动出手抓取并纳为己有”，后引申出携带、消耗时间/精力、接受及理解等抽象维度。
family_guide.core_distinction: taking 作名词常以复数 takings 表示“营业额/进账”；mistake（前缀 mis- 错误 + take 拿取/理解）则聚焦于“认错、抓错或想错”的失误行为与结果。

lemmas.def_zh: 思考，考虑；认为，以为；料想
lemmas.def_en: to use the mind to consider, reason, or form opinions

examples.en: I need some quiet time to think about the job offer.
examples.zh: 我需要安静地考虑一下这份工作邀请。

examples.en: Most experts think that inflation will ease by the end of the year.
examples.zh: 大多数专家认为通货膨胀将在年底前有所缓解。

lemmas.def_zh: 想法，主意；思想，思考；念头
lemmas.def_en: an idea, opinion, or mental process produced by thinking

examples.en: The thought of starting over in a new city excited her.
examples.zh: 在一座新城市重新开始的念头让她感到兴奋。

examples.en: He stood by the window, lost in deep thought.
examples.zh: 他站在窗边，陷入了沉思。

lemmas.def_zh: 思想者, 思想家
lemmas.def_en: an important intellectual

examples.en: She was regarded as one of the most brilliant thinkers of her generation.
examples.zh: 她被认为是她那一代人中最杰出的思想家之一。

lemmas.def_zh: 体贴；思虑
lemmas.def_en: a calm, lengthy, intent consideration

examples.en: We truly appreciated her thoughtfulness during such a difficult time for us.
examples.zh: 在我们如此艰难的时刻，非常感激她的体贴。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 疏忽, 不注意
lemmas.def_en: the quality of failing to be considerate of others

examples.en: His sheer thoughtlessness almost ruined our chances of winning the contract.
examples.zh: 他的极其轻率几乎毁掉了我们赢得合同的机会。

lemmas.def_zh: 体贴的，关切的；沉思的，若有所思的
lemmas.def_en: showing care and consideration for others; absorbed in thought

examples.en: It was very thoughtful of you to remember my birthday.
examples.zh: 你还记得我的生日，真是太贴心了。

examples.en: He fell into a thoughtful silence after reading the letter.
examples.zh: 读完信后，他陷入了若有所思的沉默中。

lemmas.def_zh: 不顾别人的, 轻率的
lemmas.def_en: lacking regard for the rights or feelings of others

examples.en: Playing extremely loud music late at night is completely inconsiderate to your resting neighbors.
examples.zh: 深夜大声播放音乐对正在休息的邻居来说完全是不顾及他人的。

lemmas.def_zh: 欠考虑的, 无深虑的, 轻率的
lemmas.def_en: showing lack of careful thought

examples.en: It was very thoughtless of him to leave the front door wide open.
examples.zh: 他大开着前门，真是太粗心欠考虑了。

lemmas.def_zh: 欠考虑的, 不留心的, 无思考能力的
lemmas.def_en: not exhibiting or characterized by careful thought

examples.en: His unthinking reaction offended several people who were in the room.
examples.zh: 他欠考虑的反应冒犯了房间里的好几个人。

lemmas.def_zh: unthink的过去式和过去分词
lemmas.def_en: so unexpected as to have not been imagined

examples.en: Such vast global changes were entirely unthought of a few centuries ago.
examples.zh: 如此巨大的全球性变化在几个世纪前是完全不可想象的。

lemmas.def_zh: 未深思的, 考虑不周的, 轻率的,粗心的
lemmas.def_en: not exhibiting or characterized by careful thought

examples.en: Her unthoughtful remarks hurt his feelings more than she realized.
examples.zh: 她那考虑不周的话语对他的伤害超出了她的想象。

lemmas.def_zh: 沉思地；体贴地, 亲切地
lemmas.def_en: in a thoughtful manner

examples.en: He thoughtfully packed an umbrella for her when he saw the dark clouds.
examples.zh: 看到乌云时，他很体贴地替她装了一把雨伞。

lemmas.def_zh: 草率地, 不体贴地; 混; 等闲
lemmas.def_en: in a thoughtless manner

examples.en: She thoughtlessly threw away the receipt before checking the warranty terms.
examples.zh: 她在核对保修条款之前就草率地扔掉了收据。

lemmas.def_zh: 不假思索地；轻率地
lemmas.def_en: in a thoughtless manner

examples.en: He unthinkingly clicked the suspicious link and infected his laptop with malware.
examples.zh: 他不假思索地点了可疑链接，导致笔记本电脑感染了恶意软件。

lemmas.def_zh: 不替别人考虑地, 考虑不周地, 轻率地
lemmas.def_en: without consideration; in an inconsiderate manner

examples.en: inconsiderately, he asked to be invited for dinner

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 þencan（在大脑中构建概念），核心语义围绕人类的‘思维活动’展开，向外派生出思维产物（想法）与思维特质（体贴/沉思）。
family_guide.core_distinction: thought 兼指具象的‘想法’与抽象的‘思维过程’，其派生词 thoughtful 既可形容人‘若有所思’，更常表示对他人‘体贴周到’。

lemmas.def_zh: 年，一年；学年，年度；岁数
lemmas.def_en: the period of 365 or 366 days; a specific period of twelve months

examples.en: The company reported record profits for the fiscal year.
examples.zh: 该公司报告了本财政年度创纪录的利润。

examples.en: She took a gap year before starting her university degree.
examples.zh: 她在上大学前休学体验了一年。

lemmas.def_zh: 年刊，年报；一年一度的出版物
lemmas.def_en: a newspaper, magazine, or book published once a year

examples.en: The society publishes an illustrated yearly for its members.
examples.zh: 该学会为其会员出版一份带插图的年刊。

examples.en: Statistical data is collected and compiled into a comprehensive financial yearly.
examples.zh: 统计数据被收集并汇编成一份综合财务年报。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 gēar，核心语义为地球绕太阳公转一周的“时间周期（年）”，派生出以此周期循环的事物。
family_guide.core_distinction: year 指基础的时间度量单位（年）；yearly 作名词时特指按年发行或举行的“年刊、年报”。

lemmas.def_zh: 她；（指雌性动物或拟人化指代船只、国家等）它
lemmas.def_en: used as the subject of a verb to refer to a female person, female animal, or personified entity previously mentioned

examples.en: She decided to accept the job offer and move to a new city.
examples.zh: 她决定接受这份工作邀请，搬去一座新城市。

examples.en: The captain looked proudly at his ship, confident that she could survive the storm.
examples.zh: 船长自豪地看着自己的船，深信它能经受住这场风暴。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语指示代词的阴性主格形式（sēo），演变并固定为现代英语中指代女性个体、雌性动物或拟人化对象（如船只、国家）的第三人称单数主格代词。

lemmas.def_zh: 新的；新近出现的；刚开始的；不熟悉的
lemmas.def_en: recently made, built, invented, or experienced for the first time; not existing before

examples.en: She decided to leave her hometown and start a completely new life in London.
examples.zh: 她决定离开家乡，去伦敦开始一段崭新的生活。

examples.en: Don't worry if you make mistakes at first; you are still new to the job.
examples.zh: 一开始犯错别担心，毕竟你对这项工作还不熟悉。

lemmas.def_zh: 崭新, 新奇, 珍奇
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being new; the opposite of oldness

examples.en: The exciting newness of the modern apartment quickly wore off after moving in.
examples.zh: 搬进去之后，这套现代公寓带来的新奇感很快就消退了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语 *néwos（新的），核心逻辑指刚出现、刚产生或未曾体验过的崭新状态与事物。

lemmas.def_zh: 人, 人民, 民族, 平民
lemmas.def_en: (plural) any group of human beings (men or women or children) collectively

examples.en: Thousands of people gathered in the central square to watch the fireworks.
examples.zh: 成千上万的人聚集在中心广场观看烟花表演。

lemmas.def_zh: 使住满人, 居住于
lemmas.def_en: fill with people

examples.en: Thousands of people gathered in the central square to watch the fireworks.
examples.zh: 成千上万的人聚集在中心广场观看烟花表演。

lemmas.def_zh: 人口减少的, 无人居住的
lemmas.def_en: with no people living there

examples.en: The explorers finally crossed the unpeopled desert after two grueling weeks.
examples.zh: 探险家们经过两周艰难的跋涉，终于穿过了那片无人荒漠。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 populus（人民、大众），核心意象指代人类群体或特定社群，作动词时引申为使某地拥有居民或充斥某种形象。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词作复数指“人/人们”，作可数名词指“民族/国民”；动词常用于被动语态 be peopled with，表示“充满或居住着某种人或物”。

lemmas.def_zh: 怎样，如何；多么，何等；以何种方式或程度
lemmas.def_en: in what way or manner; to what degree or extent

examples.en: Can you explain how this new system works?
examples.zh: 你能解释一下这个新系统是如何运作的吗？

examples.en: You would be surprised at how much difference a small change can make.
examples.zh: 你会惊讶于一个微小的改变能带来多么巨大的不同。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语疑问词根 *kʷo-，核心逻辑是指代或询问动作发生的“方式、手段、状态或程度”。

lemmas.def_zh: 看见；理解，明白；查明；会见；经历
lemmas.def_en: perceive with the eyes; understand; ascertain; meet; experience

examples.en: I looked closely, but I couldn't see anything in the thick fog.
examples.zh: 我仔细看了看，但在浓雾中什么也看不见。

examples.en: Once he explained the solution step by step, I began to see what he meant.
examples.zh: 当他一步步解释解决方案后，我开始明白他的意思了。

examples.en: Please check the schedule to see if the manager is free this afternoon.
examples.zh: 请查看一下日程表，看经理今天下午是否有空。

lemmas.def_zh: 不注意的, 视而不见的
lemmas.def_en: not consciously observing

examples.en: She stared with unseeing eyes as the disturbing news sank in slowly.
examples.zh: 随着这一令人不安的消息被慢慢消化，她眼神空洞地凝视着。

lemmas.def_zh: 预言者, 先知, 幻想家
lemmas.def_en: a person with unusual powers of foresight

examples.en: The king consulted a blind seer before marching his troops to war.
examples.zh: 国王在率军出征前向一位盲人先知请教。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 seon（感知、观察），核心语义为通过眼睛接收视觉信息，并由此自然引申出认知层面的“理解”、“查明”以及社交层面的“会见”和“经历”。

lemmas.def_zh: 工作，劳动；运转，奏效；加工，塑造
lemmas.def_en: to exert mental or physical effort; to function or produce a desired effect

examples.en: She works hard to meet all her project deadlines.
examples.zh: 她努力工作以赶在所有项目截止日期前完成。

examples.en: The medicine didn't work as quickly as the doctor had expected.
examples.zh: 这药见效没有医生预想的那么快。

lemmas.def_zh: （work的古过去式/分词）促成，造成；精工制作
lemmas.def_en: archaic past and past participle of work; brought about or fashioned

examples.en: The severe hurricane wrought havoc across the coastal towns.
examples.zh: 这场强飓风在沿海城镇造成了巨大破坏。

examples.en: The gate was carefully wrought by skilled blacksmiths.
examples.zh: 这扇大门是由技术熟练的铁匠精心锻造的。

lemmas.def_zh: 工作，劳动；运转，奏效；加工，塑造
lemmas.def_en: to exert mental or physical effort; to function or produce a desired effect

examples.en: She works hard to meet all her project deadlines.
examples.zh: 她努力工作以赶在所有项目截止日期前完成。

examples.en: The medicine didn't work as quickly as the doctor had expected.
examples.zh: 这药见效没有医生预想的那么快。

lemmas.def_zh: 运行，运作方式；（常复数 workings）内部机制，运作细节
lemmas.def_en: the manner in which something functions; (plural) the internal mechanism or structure

examples.en: A good manager understands the daily working of the company.
examples.zh: 优秀的管理者懂得公司的日常运作方式。

examples.en: He was fascinated by the inner workings of the human mind.
examples.zh: 他对人类心智的内在机制深感着迷。

lemmas.def_zh: 工人，劳动者；工作者
lemmas.def_en: a person who works, especially someone doing manual or industrial labor

examples.en: The factory employs over five hundred factory workers.
examples.zh: 这家工厂雇用了五百多名车间工人。

examples.en: Social workers provide vital support to families in crisis.
examples.zh: 社会工作者为陷入危机的家庭提供重要支持。

lemmas.def_zh: 可经营的, 可使用的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being done with means at hand and circumstances as they are

examples.en: The committee managed to find a workable compromise for all parties involved.
examples.zh: 委员会设法为所有相关各方找到了一个切实可行的折中方案。

lemmas.def_zh: 难运转的, 不能实行的
lemmas.def_en: not capable of being carried out or put into practice

examples.en: The proposed schedule proved completely unworkable due to persistent weather delays.
examples.zh: 由于持续的天气延误，拟定的时间表被证明完全不可行。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语词根，核心语义为“施加体力或智力以促成行动、创造实体或使系统正常运转”。
family_guide.core_distinction: wrought 是 work 的古态过去分词，现多指精细加工或造成剧烈后果；work 作名词多指劳动、工作或作品本身，而 working 强调运转过程、机制或操作方式。

lemmas.def_zh: 使用, 利用, 运用, 耗费；惯常
lemmas.def_en: put into service; make work or employ for a particular purpose or for its inherent or natural purpose

examples.en: You can use this software to edit your video clips very easily.
examples.zh: 你可以使用这款软件非常轻松地剪辑你的视频片段。

lemmas.def_zh: 使用, 习惯, 使用价值, 用法, 使用权
lemmas.def_en: the act of using

examples.en: You can use this software to edit your video clips very easily.
examples.zh: 你可以使用这款软件非常轻松地剪辑你的视频片段。

lemmas.def_zh: 用户；使用者；吸毒者
lemmas.def_en: a person who uses or operates something, especially a computer, system, or service

examples.en: The newly designed software provides a much smoother user experience.
examples.zh: 这款新设计的软件提供了更加流畅的用户体验。

examples.en: The social network now has over two billion active users worldwide.
examples.zh: 该社交网络在全球已拥有超过二十亿的活跃用户。

lemmas.def_en: the act of using
lemmas.def_zh: 使用；用法；惯例

examples.en: The dictionary provides clear examples of modern English usage.
examples.zh: 这本词典提供了现代英语用法的清晰例证。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 服务能力, 可服务性, 可维修性, 可用性
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being able to provide good service

lemmas.def_zh: 未用过的；闲置的；未被消耗的
lemmas.def_en: not being used or never having been used; left over

examples.en: Any unused budget at the end of the quarter must be returned.
examples.zh: 季度末任何未使用的预算必须归还。

examples.en: She converted the unused guest room into a home office.
examples.zh: 她把闲置的客房改造成了家庭办公室。

lemmas.def_zh: 可用的, 方便使用的, 能用的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being put to use

examples.en: After the heavy storm, only a small portion of the road remained usable.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过后，只有一小部分道路仍然可以使用。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 不可用的
lemmas.def_en: not capable of being used

lemmas.def_zh: 有用的, 耐用的
lemmas.def_en: ready for service or able to give long service

examples.en: Although the old computer was slow, it was still serviceable for basic daily tasks.
examples.zh: 尽管那台旧电脑运行缓慢，但用来处理日常基本任务还是挺管用的。

lemmas.def_zh: 可用的, 能用的, 合用的, 便于使用的
lemmas.def_en: fit or ready for use or service

examples.en: The old device is still fully useable despite having a few minor scratches.
examples.zh: 尽管有几处轻微划痕，这台旧设备仍然完全能用。

lemmas.def_zh: 无用的, 不适用的, 无耐用的
lemmas.def_en: not ready for service

examples.en: unserviceable equipment may be replaced

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 uti（使用、利用、享受），核心语义始终围绕“为了特定目的使某物发挥效用或价值”展开。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词与名词拼写相同但发音不同（动词发 /juːz/，名词发 /juːs/）；衍生词 unused 特指“全新的、未曾用过的”或“闲置的”。

lemmas.def_en: quantifier; used with either mass nouns or plural count nouns to indicate an unspecified number or quantity

examples.en: Could you please pour me some fresh coffee from that pot over there?
examples.zh: 你能从那边的壶里给我倒一些新鲜的咖啡吗？

lemmas.def_zh: 一些的, 少许的, 某一的
lemmas.def_en: quantifier; used with either mass nouns or plural count nouns to indicate an unspecified number or quantity

examples.en: Could you please pour me some fresh coffee from that pot over there?
examples.zh: 你能从那边的壶里给我倒一些新鲜的咖啡吗？

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 sum（某一、某种程度），核心逻辑表示“未确指、非特定的存在或数量”，后续在口语中引申出表示程度极高或非凡的用法。
family_guide.core_distinction: 限定词用于修饰名词表不确定的数量（一些）或特定但不明确的对象（某个）；形容词多用于口语感叹，强调对象非同寻常或极其出色（真算得上了不起的）。

lemmas.def_zh: 也；同样；而且
lemmas.def_en: in addition; too; furthermore

examples.en: She is fluent in French and also speaks conversational German.
examples.zh: 她法语很流利，而且也会说一些德语日常口语。

examples.en: He not only composed the music, but also directed the entire performance.
examples.zh: 他不仅创作了音乐，还执导了整场演出。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 'all so'（完全如此、同样地），后语义凝固为表示补充、递进或并列的副词“也、同样”。

lemmas.def_zh: 他们；她们；它们；（代指未知性别的单数个人）他/她
lemmas.def_en: used as the object of a verb or preposition to refer to people, animals, or things previously mentioned, or to a single person of unspecified gender

examples.en: I picked some fresh strawberries and shared them with my neighbors.
examples.zh: 我摘了一些新鲜草莓，并把它们分给了邻居。

examples.en: If anyone calls while I'm out, please tell them I'll be back soon.
examples.zh: 如果我不在时有人打电话来，请告诉他/她我很快就回来。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺斯语第三人称复数与格/宾格形式 þeim，借入中古英语后取代了原有的本土形式，专门用作第三人称复数（及现代英语中非特定单数个体）的宾格代词。

lemmas.def_zh: 要, 希望, 应该, 缺少；生活困苦, 需要, 缺少
lemmas.def_en: feel or have a desire for; want strongly

examples.en: I really want to visit Japan during the upcoming spring break holiday.
examples.zh: 我真想在即将到来的春假期间去日本旅游。

lemmas.def_zh: 需要的东西, 缺乏, 贫困, 需要
lemmas.def_en: a state of extreme poverty

examples.en: I really want to visit Japan during the upcoming spring break holiday.
examples.zh: 我真想在即将到来的春假期间去日本旅游。

lemmas.def_zh: 缺[贫]乏者
lemmas.def_en: a person who wants or needs something

examples.en: The charity provides warm food and shelter to every wanter in the cold district.
examples.zh: 该慈善机构为寒冷地区的每位贫困者提供温热的食物和住所。

lemmas.def_zh: 不受欢迎的；不需要的；多余的
lemmas.def_en: not wanted, needed, or desired

examples.en: She installed an app to block unwanted marketing calls.
examples.zh: 她安装了一款软件来拦截不需要的推销电话。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺斯语 vanta（缺乏、缺少），核心逻辑由客观上的“匮乏”引申出因短缺而产生心理渴求的“想要、需要”。
family_guide.core_distinction: want 作动词时主流语义为“想要”，但作名词时常保留古义表示“缺乏”（如 for want of）；unwanted 则是由分词派生而来的形容词，指“不被需要的、不受欢迎的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 现在, 刚才, 目前
lemmas.def_en: in the historical present; at this point in the narration of a series of past events

examples.en: She used to live in London, but now she works from a quiet coastal town.
examples.zh: 她过去住在伦敦，但现在在一个宁静的沿海小镇远程工作。

lemmas.def_zh: 现在
lemmas.def_en: the momentary present

examples.en: She used to live in London, but now she works from a quiet coastal town.
examples.zh: 她过去住在伦敦，但现在在一个宁静的沿海小镇远程工作。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 nū，核心意义为说话发生的当下时间点，后由时间副词扩展为可与介词搭配表示“眼下/当今”的名词用法。
family_guide.core_distinction: 副词 now 修饰动作发生的时间（此时、马上），而名词 now 几乎总是与介词连用（如 by now、until now）表示“目前、眼下”这一时间阶段。

lemmas.def_zh: 另外的，其他的；其余的，剩下的；不同的
lemmas.def_en: referring to a person or thing that is different or distinct from one already mentioned or known

examples.en: Do you have any other questions before we conclude the meeting?
examples.zh: 在我们结束会议之前，您还有其他问题吗？

examples.en: She decided to look at the situation from the other side.
examples.zh: 她决定从另一个角度来看待这一局面。

lemmas.def_zh: 相异, 不同, 差异性
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being not alike; being distinct or different from that otherwise experienced or known

examples.en: Traveling alone in a remote country made him acutely aware of his cultural otherness.
examples.zh: 独自在偏远国家旅行让他敏锐地意识到了自己的文化相异性。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语词根，原本带有比较级后缀表示“两者中的第二个”，后引申为泛指“另外的、不同的或其余的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 真的, 真实的, 实际的, 实在的, 不动(产)的, 实数的
lemmas.def_en: being or occurring in fact or actuality; having verified existence; not illusory; ; ; ; ; ; - Longfellow

examples.en: She wore a beautiful necklace made of real pearls to the annual charity gala.
examples.zh: 她戴着一条真珍珠项链出席了一年一度的慈善晚会。

lemmas.def_zh: 假的, 虚构的, 不真实的, 幻想的
lemmas.def_en: lacking in reality or substance or genuineness; not corresponding to acknowledged facts or criteria

examples.en: The visual effects in that sci-fi movie were so stunning they felt completely unreal.
examples.zh: 那部科幻电影的视觉效果极其震撼，令人感觉很不真实。

lemmas.def_zh: 实际上, 真实地, 实在
lemmas.def_en: in accordance with truth or fact or reality

examples.en: I did not expect the final exam to be really that difficult for everyone.
examples.zh: 我真没想到期末考试对每个人来说都会那么难。

lemmas.def_zh: 实数, 现实
lemmas.def_en: any rational or irrational number

examples.en: She wore a beautiful necklace made of real pearls to the annual charity gala.
examples.zh: 她戴着一条真珍珠项链出席了一年一度的慈善晚会。

lemmas.def_zh: 实在, 事实, 实体, 逼真
lemmas.def_en: all of your experiences that determine how things appear to you

examples.en: He wanted to travel the world, but financial reality forced him to keep working.
examples.zh: 他想环游世界，但严酷的现实迫使他继续工作。

lemmas.def_zh: 真诚；真实性
lemmas.def_en: the state of being actual or real

examples.en: Fans love the singer because of the raw realness she displays in every interview.
examples.zh: 歌迷们喜欢这位歌手，因为她在每次采访中都展现出纯粹的真实感。

lemmas.def_zh: 不真实, 非现实, 不存在之物
lemmas.def_en: the quality possessed by something that is unreal

examples.en: After hearing the shocking news, she drifted through the day in a state of unreality.
examples.zh: 听到那个令人震惊的消息后，她恍恍惚惚地度过了一整天。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 res（事物、实物），核心义为“客观存在的、非虚构的”，由此演化出描述本质真实、现实状态及副词强调等形态。
family_guide.core_distinction: real (adj.) 侧重属性上的真伪与实在，reality (n.) 强调宏观的现实境况或客观存在，real 作为名词则常用于特定术语（实数）或口语习语（for real）。

lemmas.def_zh: 来，来到；发生；达到（某种状态）
lemmas.def_en: to move toward or reach a place, person, or result; to happen

examples.en: Can you come to my office when you have a moment?
examples.zh: 你方便的时候能来一下我的办公室吗？

examples.en: Great opportunities rarely come at a convenient time.
examples.zh: 绝佳的机遇往往不会在方便的时候降临。

lemmas.def_zh: 来，来到（come 的过去式）
lemmas.def_en: past tense of come; moved toward or arrived at a place

examples.en: They came all the way from London just to support us.
examples.zh: 他们千里迢迢从伦敦赶来，只为了支持我们。

examples.en: A sudden realization came to her during the discussion.
examples.zh: 讨论期间，她突然恍然大悟。

lemmas.def_zh: 到来；降临；问世
lemmas.def_en: the arrival or advent of someone or something important

examples.en: The coming of spring brought new life and color to the garden.
examples.zh: 春天的到来为花园带来了生机与色彩。

examples.en: The invention heralded the coming of a digital revolution.
examples.zh: 这项发明预示着一场数字革命的降临。

lemmas.def_zh: 来的人, 新来者, 有成功希望的人
lemmas.def_en: someone with a promising future

examples.en: The annual marathon welcomed all comers, from seasoned athletes to enthusiastic local beginners.
examples.zh: 一年一度的马拉松赛欢迎所有来者，无论是经验丰富的运动员还是热情的初学者。

lemmas.def_zh: 清秀, 美丽, 合宜
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being good looking and attractive

examples.en: Her natural comeliness and gentle manners charmed everyone who attended the evening party.
examples.zh: 她天然的美貌和温文尔雅的举止吸引了参加晚会的每个人。

lemmas.def_zh: 清秀的, 标致的, 美丽的
lemmas.def_en: according with custom or propriety

examples.en: The artist painted a portrait of a comely young woman standing beside the river.
examples.zh: 画家画了一幅站在河边的清秀年轻女子的肖像。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 cuman，核心义为朝向参照点移动或到达，引申表示发生、出现或达到某种状态。
family_guide.core_distinction: come 为原形与一般现在时动词，came 为其过去时形态，coming 作为名词常指重要事件、人物或时节的“到来、降临”。

lemmas.def_zh: 我们的
lemmas.def_en: belonging to or associated with the speaker and one or more other people

examples.en: We must all work together to protect our environment for future generations.
examples.zh: 为了子孙后代，我们必须携手保护我们的环境。

examples.en: Our flight was delayed by two hours due to severe weather conditions.
examples.zh: 由于恶劣的天气条件，我们的航班延误了两个小时。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语第一人称复数代词 we 的所有格形式，核心概念为说话者与他人共同所有的归属关系。
family_guide.core_distinction: our 作为限定词必须修饰名词；与其同源的 ours 为名词性物主代词，独立充当句法成分。

lemmas.def_zh: （儿童捉人游戏中的）抓人者，当鬼者；独特魅力；关键之物
lemmas.def_en: the player who must catch others in a game; an indefinable quality or supreme excellence

examples.en: Tag, you're it!
examples.zh: 抓到你了，轮到你当鬼了！

examples.en: She has that undeniable 'it' factor that turns heads whenever she walks in.
examples.zh: 她身上有一种不可否认的独特魅力，一走进来就能吸引所有人的目光。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古英语中性人称代词 hit，its 为其后起的所有格限定词，用于指代无生命物体、动物或概念；it 在用作名词时，通常引申指特定游戏中的“抓人者”或某种不可言喻的独特魅力与关键特质。
family_guide.core_distinction: its 是限定词/物主代词（意为“它的”，注意勿与 it's 即 it is/has 混淆）；it 作名词时指代具体身份（如捉人游戏中的‘鬼’）或抽象的‘关键特质’。

lemmas.def_zh: 看, 注意, 朝着, 显得；打量, 看上去与...一样, 以眼色(或脸色)显示, 期待
lemmas.def_en: perceive with attention; direct one's gaze towards

examples.en: If you look closely at this painting, you can see subtle brush strokes.
examples.zh: 如果你仔细看这幅画，就能看到细腻的笔触。

lemmas.def_zh: 一看, 神色, 样子, 面容
lemmas.def_en: the feelings expressed on a person's face

examples.en: If you look closely at this painting, you can see subtle brush strokes.
examples.zh: 如果你仔细看这幅画，就能看到细腻的笔触。

lemmas.def_zh: 观看的人, 检查员
lemmas.def_en: a close observer; someone who looks at something (such as an exhibition of some kind)

examples.en: The security guard was a careful looker who noticed the suspicious open window immediately.
examples.zh: 那名保安是个细心的检查员，立刻注意到了那扇可疑的开着的窗户。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 看起来……的，有……相貌的（通常构成复合词）
lemmas.def_en: appearing to be as specified; usually used in combination
lemmas.usage_note: 极少单独使用，几乎总是与副词或形容词连用构成复合形容词，如 good-looking, strange-looking, professional-looking 等。

examples.en: He was a distinguished-looking gentleman in his late fifties.
examples.zh: 他是一位五十多岁、相貌出众的绅士。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 lōcian，核心意象为“主动将目光或注意力投向某处”，后从“注视”引申出“显现、呈现出的样子/神态”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词聚焦于“看”的主动动作或“看起来”的状态评估；名词则特指“看的一眼/注视”或是展现出的“外观、风格”。

lemmas.def_zh: 需要, 必需；贫困, 有必要
lemmas.def_en: require as useful, just, or proper

examples.en: Many small plants need plenty of bright sunlight and regular watering to flourish properly.
examples.zh: 许多小植物需要充足的明亮阳光和定期浇水才能茁壮成长。

lemmas.def_zh: 需要, 必须, 缺乏
lemmas.def_en: a condition requiring relief

examples.en: Many small plants need plenty of bright sunlight and regular watering to flourish properly.
examples.zh: 许多小植物需要充足的明亮阳光和定期浇水才能茁壮成长。

lemmas.def_en: needy people collectively

examples.en: During the harsh winter, local volunteers distributed warm coats and blankets to the needy.
examples.zh: 在严冬期间，当地志愿者向穷困者分发了厚外套和毛毯。

lemmas.def_zh: 穷困, 贫穷
lemmas.def_en: a state of extreme poverty

examples.en: His constant neediness and demand for attention exhausted his close friends over time.
examples.zh: 久而久之，他不断的匮乏感和对关注的苛求让身边的朋友精疲力竭。

lemmas.def_zh: 不需要的, 不必要的
lemmas.def_en: unnecessary and unwarranted

examples.en: Canceling the outdoor event proved to be a needless precaution as the rain stopped.
examples.zh: 随着雨停了，取消室外活动被证明是一个不必要的防范措施。

lemmas.def_zh: 不需要的
lemmas.def_en: not necessary

examples.en: The office donated all unneeded furniture and equipment to a nearby community center.
examples.zh: 办公室将所有不需要的家具和设备捐赠给了附近的社区中心。

lemmas.def_zh: 必要的, 需要的
lemmas.def_en: necessary for relief or supply

examples.en: Please sign the application form and provide the needful documents for your background check.
examples.zh: 请在申请表上签字，并为背景调查提供必要的文件。

lemmas.def_zh: 不必要地；无用地
lemmas.def_en: without need

examples.en: The argument escalated needlessly because neither of them was willing to listen and compromise.
examples.zh: 争吵不必要地升级了，因为他们俩都不愿意倾听和妥协。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 nēod，核心义为“匮乏、困境与迫切需求”，由此延伸出表示“必需/需要”的动词与名词，以及表示“极度贫乏（needy）”和“毫无必要（needless）”的派生词。
family_guide.core_distinction: needy 强调由于缺乏基本物资而处于“贫困匮乏状态的人群（常作 the needy）”，needless 则强调某事物“多余无益、毫无必要”。

lemmas.def_zh: 仅仅，只；唯独；刚才，不过
lemmas.def_en: exclusively; merely; and no other or no more than

examples.en: Tickets are available online only.
examples.zh: 门票仅限线上购买。

examples.en: She only arrived a few minutes ago.
examples.zh: 她才刚到几分钟。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 ānlīc（one + -ly，即“像一个一样的”），核心语义为“单一、唯一”，引申为排除其他所有可能的“仅、只”。

lemmas.def_zh: 一天，一日；白天，白昼；时期，时代
lemmas.def_en: a period of 24 hours; the time between sunrise and sunset; a particular period of time

examples.en: She works hard during the day and studies at night.
examples.zh: 她白天努力工作，晚上坚持学习。

examples.en: In those days, few people in the village owned a car.
examples.zh: 在那个年代，村里很少有人买得起汽车。

lemmas.def_zh: 日报
lemmas.def_en: a newspaper that is published every day

examples.en: Local staff members clean and sanitize all gym equipment daily for member safety.
examples.zh: 为了会员的安全，当地工作人员每天都会清洁和消毒所有健身器材。

lemmas.def_zh: 每日地, 日常地
lemmas.def_en: every day; without missing a day

examples.en: Local staff members clean and sanitize all gym equipment daily for member safety.
examples.zh: 为了会员的安全，当地工作人员每天都会清洁和消毒所有健身器材。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 dæg，本义与光照、温暖相关，核心语义演变为由日出日落界定的“白天”，进而泛指一个昼夜的“一日”或特定“时期”。

lemmas.def_zh: 第一的
lemmas.def_en: preceding all others in time or space or degree

examples.en: This is her first attempt at baking a chocolate cake by herself.
examples.zh: 这是她第一次尝试自己烤巧克力蛋糕。

lemmas.def_zh: 开始, 第一
lemmas.def_en: the first or highest in an ordering or series

examples.en: This is her first attempt at baking a chocolate cake by herself.
examples.zh: 这是她第一次尝试自己烤巧克力蛋糕。

lemmas.def_zh: 第一, 首先
lemmas.def_en: before anything else

examples.en: Firstly, we must gather all necessary data before making any final decisions.
examples.zh: 首先，我们在做出任何最终决定之前必须收集所有必要的数据。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 fyrst（fore 的最高级），核心逻辑为“在空间、时间、顺序或重要性上位于最前端/首位”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 列举要点时 first 和 firstly 常可互换，但 firstly 仅用于按顺序陈述论点（与 secondly 对应），不可用于表达时间上的“起初”或“首次”。

lemmas.def_zh: 到……里面；朝向；进入……状态；撞上；热衷于
lemmas.def_en: to the inside or middle of something; expressing movement, change of state, or collision

examples.en: She stepped into the room and immediately felt the warmth of the fireplace.
examples.zh: 她走进房间，立刻感受到了壁炉带来的暖意。

examples.en: Over the past few months, the small startup has developed into a major competitor.
examples.zh: 在过去的几个月里，这家初创小公司已经成长为一个强劲的竞争对手。

family_guide.root_logic: 由表示内部的 in 与表示方向的 to 复合而成，核心逻辑为“朝向内部的运动”，由此引申出空间进入、状态转变、碰撞接触及深入参与等语义。

lemmas.def_zh: 他（he 的宾格）
lemmas.def_en: used as the object of a verb or preposition to refer to a male person or animal

examples.en: I met him at the station yesterday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我昨天下午在车站碰到了他。

examples.en: She handed the important documents directly to him.
examples.zh: 她把重要文件直接递交给了他。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语第三人称单数阳性代词的与格形式，现代英语中固定用作男性个体的动词或介词宾格。

lemmas.def_zh: 在……之后；追寻；仿照；鉴于
lemmas.def_en: following in time, place, or order; in pursuit of; in imitation of

examples.en: We decided to take a short walk along the river after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭后，我们决定沿着河边散一会儿步。

examples.en: The police are currently after the suspect involved in the robbery.
examples.zh: 警方目前正在追捕参与这起抢劫案的嫌疑人。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 æfter（由 off/away 加比较级后缀构成），核心逻辑为“在空间或时间上更靠后”，引申为时间次序、追逐目标以及模仿效法。

lemmas.def_en: being one more than one

examples.en: She ordered two cups of hot coffee to stay awake during the meeting.
examples.zh: 她点了两杯热咖啡以便在开会时保持清醒。

lemmas.def_en: the cardinal number that is the sum of one and one or a numeral representing this number

examples.en: She ordered two cups of hot coffee to stay awake during the meeting.
examples.zh: 她点了两杯热咖啡以便在开会时保持清醒。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语根 *dwo-（二），核心表义即基数“2”，后续语法化演变出用作限定/修饰的形容词及指代该数字或组合的名词。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词用法用于修饰可数名词复数（表示数量为二）；名词用法则指代数字本身、牌面点数或由两个个体构成的组合（如 in twos）。

lemmas.def_zh: 玩耍；演奏；参赛；扮演；戏剧，剧本
lemmas.def_en: to engage in activity for enjoyment; perform music or act; a theatrical performance or script

examples.en: She plays the violin with remarkable emotional depth.
examples.zh: 她拉小提琴时带有非凡的情感深度。

examples.en: We bought tickets to see a new Broadway play this weekend.
examples.zh: 我们买了这周末看一部新百老汇戏剧的门票。

lemmas.def_zh: 玩耍；演奏；参赛；扮演；戏剧，剧本
lemmas.def_en: to engage in activity for enjoyment; perform music or act; a theatrical performance or script

examples.en: She plays the violin with remarkable emotional depth.
examples.zh: 她拉小提琴时带有非凡的情感深度。

examples.en: We bought tickets to see a new Broadway play this weekend.
examples.zh: 我们买了这周末看一部新百老汇戏剧的门票。

lemmas.def_zh: 运动员，选手；演奏者；播放器
lemmas.def_en: a person who takes part in a sport or game; a musician; a device for reproducing media

examples.en: He is widely considered one of the most talented basketball players in the league.
examples.zh: 他被公认为该联赛中最有天赋的篮球运动员之一。

lemmas.def_zh: 活泼快乐, 戏谑; 童心
lemmas.def_en: a festive merry feeling

examples.en: His natural playfulness made him very popular among the younger neighborhood children.
examples.zh: 他天生的爱玩个性让他在邻里的小孩中很受欢迎。

lemmas.def_zh: 失误
lemmas.def_en: (baseball) a failure of a defensive player to make an out when normal play would have sufficed

examples.en: A single misplay by the goalkeeper cost the team their final victory.
examples.zh: 守门员的一次失误让球队痛失了最终的胜利。

lemmas.def_zh: 顽皮的，闹着玩的；充满趣意的
lemmas.def_en: fond of games and amusement; lighthearted and humorous

examples.en: The puppy gave her a playful nip on the fingers.
examples.zh: 小狗顽皮地轻咬了咬她的手指。

lemmas.def_zh: 开玩笑地；好游玩地
lemmas.def_en: in a playful manner

examples.en: The kitten playfully chased the red wool yarn across the living room.
examples.zh: 小猫在客厅里开玩笑似地追逐着红毛线球。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 plegian（轻快运动、演练、嬉戏），核心意象是从身体的无拘嬉戏，引申至文体娱乐、竞技对抗、角色扮演及乐器演奏。
family_guide.core_distinction: player 指参与活动的具体人或播放设备；playful 则专指人或动物爱打闹、开玩笑的顽皮性情与态度。

lemmas.def_zh: prep. 在…上方；越过；超过；adj. 结束的；完结的；n. (板球)一轮投球
lemmas.def_en: prep. above, across, or exceeding; adj. finished or ended; n. a sequence of consecutive balls bowled in cricket

examples.en: A flock of birds flew over the lake at sunset.
examples.zh: 黄昏时分，一群鸟从湖面上空飞过。

examples.en: Don't worry, the worst of the crisis is finally over.
examples.zh: 别担心，危机最严重的阶段终于结束了。

examples.en: The bowler took two vital wickets in his final over.
examples.zh: 那名投球手在最后一轮投球中拿下了关键的两个三柱门。

lemmas.def_zh: prep. 在…上方；越过；超过；adj. 结束的；完结的；n. (板球)一轮投球
lemmas.def_en: prep. above, across, or exceeding; adj. finished or ended; n. a sequence of consecutive balls bowled in cricket

examples.en: A flock of birds flew over the lake at sunset.
examples.zh: 黄昏时分，一群鸟从湖面上空飞过。

examples.en: Don't worry, the worst of the crisis is finally over.
examples.zh: 别担心，危机最严重的阶段终于结束了。

examples.en: The bowler took two vital wickets in his final over.
examples.zh: 那名投球手在最后一轮投球中拿下了关键的两个三柱门。

lemmas.def_zh: adv. 过度地；过分地；太
lemmas.def_en: excessively or unduly; to an unnecessary degree

examples.en: We shouldn't be overly sensitive to constructive criticism.
examples.zh: 我们不必对建设性的批评过于敏感。

lemmas.def_zh: prep. 在…上方；越过；超过；adj. 结束的；完结的；n. (板球)一轮投球
lemmas.def_en: prep. above, across, or exceeding; adj. finished or ended; n. a sequence of consecutive balls bowled in cricket

examples.en: A flock of birds flew over the lake at sunset.
examples.zh: 黄昏时分，一群鸟从湖面上空飞过。

examples.en: Don't worry, the worst of the crisis is finally over.
examples.zh: 别担心，危机最严重的阶段终于结束了。

examples.en: The bowler took two vital wickets in his final over.
examples.zh: 那名投球手在最后一轮投球中拿下了关键的两个三柱门。

lemmas.def_zh: 躺在...上面, 压在...上面, 盖得使窒息, 压得...闷死
lemmas.def_en: lie upon; lie on top of

examples.en: Thick layers of volcanic ash directly overlie the ancient ruins of the town.
examples.zh: 厚厚的火山灰层直接覆盖在古镇的废墟之上。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语 *uper（在…之上），核心空间意象为“在垂直上方”与“跨越上方”，由此引申出“超过限度（过度）”和“翻转至终点（结束）”。
family_guide.core_distinction: over 作为副词或形容词可表示“结束、越过”，而派生副词 overly 则专门用于修饰形容词或副词，强调程度“过分、过甚”。

lemmas.def_zh: 给，送给；提供；交给；让步，变松
lemmas.def_en: to freely transfer possession or deliver something to someone; to produce or yield

examples.en: She decided to give him another chance to explain his decision.
examples.zh: 她决定再给他一次机会来解释他的决定。

lemmas.def_zh: 给，送给（give 的过去式）
lemmas.def_en: past tense of give

examples.en: The doctor gave her a prescription to relieve the chronic pain.
examples.zh: 医生给她开了处方以缓解慢性疼痛。

lemmas.def_zh: 疑虑；使怀疑
lemmas.def_en: suggest fear or doubt

examples.en: Her strange behavior began to misgive me about her true hidden motives.
