lemmas.def_zh: 使丧失生命, 忘却(自己过去的经历), 清除(以往过失/丑行)的痕迹
lemmas.def_en: live so as to annul some previous behavior

examples.en: He wished desperately that he could unlive that terrible evening and undo his mistakes.
examples.zh: 他极度希望自己能抹去那个糟糕的夜晚，挽回犯下的过错。

lemmas.def_zh: 活的, 生动的, 精力充沛的, 实况转播的
lemmas.def_en: actually being performed at the time of hearing or viewing

examples.en: After spending years abroad, they decided to return home and live in the countryside.
examples.zh: 在国外生活多年后，他们决定回国并定居在乡村。

lemmas.def_zh: 精力充沛的；生动活泼的；热烈的
lemmas.def_en: full of energy, enthusiasm, or activity

examples.en: The panel held a lively debate on the ethical implications of artificial intelligence.
examples.zh: 专家组就人工智能的伦理影响展开了热烈的辩论。

lemmas.def_zh: 生活过得有价值的, (生活)过得去的, 值得过的, 适于居住的
lemmas.def_en: fit or suitable to live in or with

examples.en: Good public transport and abundant parks make this city a very livable modern community.
examples.zh: 便利的公共交通和丰富的公园绿地让这座城市成为非常宜居的现代社区。

lemmas.def_zh: 生活过得有价值的, (生活)过得去的, 值得过的, 适于居住的
lemmas.def_en: fit or suitable to live in or with

examples.en: The city offers affordable rent and plenty of green spaces, making it very liveable.
examples.zh: 这座城市租金实惠且绿地充足，非常宜居。

lemmas.def_zh: 不宜居住的, 不舒适的
lemmas.def_en: unfit or unsuitable to live in or with

examples.en: Extreme summer heat and poor ventilation made the tiny attic completely unlivable.
examples.zh: 夏日的酷热和极差的通风让狭小的阁楼完全无法居住。

lemmas.def_zh: 穿制服的, 穿号衣的
lemmas.def_en: wearing livery

examples.en: liveried footmen stood on the palace steps

lemmas.def_zh: 无生命的,缺乏生命
lemmas.def_en: not endowed with life

examples.en: Viruses exist in a gray area between living organisms and nonliving matter.
examples.zh: 病毒处于有生命有机体与无生命物质之间的灰色地带。

lemmas.def_zh: 不适于居住的
lemmas.def_en: unfit or unsuitable to live in or with

examples.en: Without air conditioning, the top-floor apartment becomes virtually unliveable in July.
examples.zh: 如果没有空调，顶层的公寓在七月份几乎无法居住。

lemmas.def_zh: 生计，谋生之道；生活方式
lemmas.def_en: the money earned from work to pay for housing, food, and basic necessities; a manner of life

examples.en: It takes years of hard work to make a decent living as a freelance artist.
examples.zh: 作为一名自由艺术家，需要多年的苦干才能谋得体面的生计。

lemmas.def_en: large and complicated reddish-brown glandular organ located in the upper right portion of the abdominal cavity; secretes bile and functions in metabolism of protein and carbohydrate and fat; synthesizes substances involved in the clotting of the blood; synthesizes vitamin A; detoxifies poisonous substances and breaks down worn-out erythrocytes
lemmas.def_zh: 肝脏

examples.en: Excessive alcohol consumption can cause irreversible damage to the liver.
examples.zh: 过量饮酒会对肝脏造成不可逆的损害。

lemmas.def_zh: 制服, 侍从
lemmas.def_en: uniform worn by some menservants and chauffeurs

examples.en: The palace footmen wore traditional gold and crimson livery for the royal ceremony.
examples.zh: 宫廷侍从们身着传统的金红相间的制服出席皇家典礼。

lemmas.def_zh: 活泼, 快活, 热闹
lemmas.def_en: general activity and motion

examples.en: Her natural charm and liveliness quickly brought energy to the dull meeting.
examples.zh: 她天生的魅力和活力很快让沉闷的会议活跃起来。

lemmas.def_zh: 活性, 活跃度；现场感
lemmas.def_en: the property of being animated; having animal life as distinguished from plant life

examples.en: The identity verification app uses facial recognition to check for human liveness.
examples.zh: 该身份验证应用使用人脸识别技术来检测真人活体。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 libban/lifian（存在、活着），核心意象为“处于有生命、持续运作或即时发生的状态”，由此向动词（生存、居住）、形容词（活体、实况）及名词（生计、生命）延伸。
family_guide.core_distinction: live 作形容词读 /laɪv/，多作定语表“活着的”或“现场直播的/通电的”；lively 强调“充满活力、生动热闹的”；living 作名词常与 make/earn 连用表示“谋生、生计”。

lemmas.def_zh: 学校, 鱼群, 门派, 学派
lemmas.def_en: an educational institution

examples.en: A large school of fish darted beneath our boat in the clear water.
examples.zh: 一群鱼在清澈的水中从我们的船底飞快游过。

lemmas.def_zh: 繁琐哲学, 墨守成规, 经院哲学
lemmas.def_en: the system of philosophy dominant in medieval Europe; based on Aristotle and the Church Fathers

lemmas.def_zh: 教育, 训练, 培养；成群地游
lemmas.def_en: educate in or as if in a school

examples.en: A large school of fish darted beneath our boat in the clear water.
examples.zh: 一群鱼在清澈的水中从我们的船底飞快游过。

lemmas.def_zh: 学校的, 学校教育的, 学者的, 学究的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to schools

examples.en: The university recognizes students who demonstrate outstanding scholastic achievements each year.
examples.zh: 该大学每年都会表彰取得杰出学术成就的学生。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 学业上地
lemmas.def_en: with respect to scholastic activities

examples.en: scholastically apt

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古希腊语 skholē（原意为‘闲暇’，后演变为利用闲暇进行学术讨论的地方），核心语义由‘传授知识的场所/学派’引申出动词‘严格训练、培养或克制’。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词侧重学习机构、思想流派或群体（如鱼群）；动词则强调经过系统刻意的‘训练、训诫’或对情绪习惯的‘约束’。

lemmas.def_zh: 同一的；相同的；无变化的
lemmas.def_en: identical, not different; unchanged in character or condition

examples.en: We arrived at the exact same conclusion independently.
examples.zh: 我们各自独立得出了完全相同的结论。

examples.en: They have lived on the same street for over twenty years.
examples.zh: 他们在这条街上住了二十多年，一直没搬过家。

lemmas.def_zh: 相同, 同样, 千篇一律
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being alike

examples.en: He grew tired of the dull sameness of his daily office routine.
examples.zh: 他对办公室日常工作的乏味雷同感到厌倦。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语根 *sem-（一、合、同），核心意象为“一体、无差异”，演变为表示同一性或无变化的词义。

lemmas.def_zh: 创立，创建；把……建立在（某基础上）
lemmas.def_en: to establish an organization, institution, or system; to base something on a principle or idea

examples.en: The university was founded in 1895 by a group of philanthropists.
examples.zh: 这所大学于1895年由一群慈善家创立。

examples.en: Their successful partnership is founded on mutual trust and transparency.
examples.zh: 他们成功的合作关系建立在相互信任与透明的基础之上。

lemmas.def_zh: 使沉没, 使摔倒, 弄跛, 浸水, 破坏；沉没, 摔到, 变跛, 倒塌, 失败
lemmas.def_en: fail utterly; collapse

examples.en: Peace talks began to founder when neither side agreed on territorial boundaries.
examples.zh: 当双方在领土边界上互不相让时，和谈开始破裂。

lemmas.def_zh: 地基，基础；基金会；创办
lemmas.def_en: the base of a building; the basis or groundwork of an idea; a charitable organization

examples.en: Mastering basic grammar provides a solid foundation for learning any language.
examples.zh: 掌握基础语法为学习任何语言都提供了坚实的基础。

examples.en: The charitable foundation donated two million dollars to cancer research.
examples.zh: 该慈善基金会向癌症研究捐赠了200万美元。

lemmas.def_zh: 创立者, 建立者
lemmas.def_en: inflammation of the laminated tissue that attaches the hoof to the foot of a horse

examples.en: Peace talks began to founder when neither side agreed on territorial boundaries.
examples.zh: 当双方在领土边界上互不相让时，和谈开始破裂。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 fundus（底部、基底），核心逻辑为“立足于底部/奠基”，由此演化出“建立、创建”，以及另一条源于古法语的“沉入水底/崩塌”之意。
family_guide.core_distinction: founder 作为名词表示“创始人”，而同形动词 founder 则由“沉入水底”引申为“（计划、机构等）惨遭失败、瓦解”，两者含义与感情色彩迥异。

lemmas.def_zh: (n.) 房屋，住宅；议院；(v.) 为……提供住处；容纳，收藏
lemmas.def_en: (n.) a building for human habitation; (v.) to provide shelter, accommodation, or space for

examples.en: They decided to buy an old Victorian house and renovate it themselves.
examples.zh: 他们决定买下一栋老旧的维多利亚风格住宅并亲自翻新。

examples.en: The museum was built to house a world-renowned collection of modern art.
examples.zh: 修建这座博物馆是为了收藏享誉世界的现代艺术品。

lemmas.def_zh: 住房，住宅；住房供给；（机械的）外壳，机壳
lemmas.def_en: buildings for people to live in collectively; the provision of shelter; a protective covering for a mechanism

examples.en: The city is struggling to provide enough affordable housing for low-income families.
examples.zh: 该市正竭力为低收入家庭提供充足的经济适用房。

lemmas.def_zh: 满屋
lemmas.def_en: as many as a house will accommodate

examples.en: We hosted a houseful of lively guests during the long holiday weekend.
examples.zh: 在漫长的假日周末，我们接待了满满一屋子充满活力的客人。

lemmas.def_zh: (n.) 房屋，住宅；议院；(v.) 为……提供住处；容纳，收藏
lemmas.def_en: (n.) a building for human habitation; (v.) to provide shelter, accommodation, or space for

examples.en: They decided to buy an old Victorian house and renovate it themselves.
examples.zh: 他们决定买下一栋老旧的维多利亚风格住宅并亲自翻新。

examples.en: The museum was built to house a world-renowned collection of modern art.
examples.zh: 修建这座博物馆是为了收藏享誉世界的现代艺术品。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古英语 hūs（庇护所、住宅），核心概念为'提供遮蔽与栖身之所'，后延伸为具体居所、接纳容纳的动作以及泛指的住房总和。
family_guide.core_distinction: house 侧重具体的一栋房屋或'安置、收容'的动作；housing 为集合或抽象名词，指整体的住房条件、房屋供给或机械保护外壳。

lemmas.def_zh: 学习, 研究, 学科, 论文, 求学, 书房, 试作
lemmas.def_en: a detailed critical inspection

examples.en: A recent medical study suggests that daily walking significantly reduces stress levels.
examples.zh: 最近的一项医学研究表明，每天散步能显著降低压力水平。

lemmas.def_zh: 学生, 研究者, 学者
lemmas.def_en: a learner who is enrolled in an educational institution

examples.en: Every diligent student in the program received a certificate of completion yesterday.
examples.zh: 该项目中每位勤奋的学生昨天都获得了结业证书。

lemmas.def_zh: 学生身分, (英)大学奖学金
lemmas.def_en: the position of student

examples.en: She was awarded a prestigious research studentship to fund her doctoral degree.
examples.zh: 她获得了一笔著名的研究奖学金来资助她的博士学位。

lemmas.def_zh: 学习, 研究；课题；书房；学问 (study的变形)

examples.en: As a careful studier of human behavior, he noticed the suspect's nervous twitch.
examples.zh: 作为一名敏锐的人类行为观察者，他注意到了嫌疑人紧张的抽搐。

lemmas.def_zh: 好学
lemmas.def_en: diligent study

examples.en: Her remarkable studiousness helped her earn top marks in every challenging course.
examples.zh: 她非凡的刻苦好学帮助她在每门高难度课程中都名列前茅。

lemmas.def_zh: 学习, 读书, 研究, 考虑, 计划；学习, 思索
lemmas.def_en: consider in detail and subject to an analysis in order to discover essential features or meaning

examples.en: A recent medical study suggests that daily walking significantly reduces stress levels.
examples.zh: 最近的一项医学研究表明，每天散步能显著降低压力水平。

lemmas.def_zh: 爱好学问的, 用功的, 勤学的, 故意的
lemmas.def_en: marked by care and effort

examples.en: The quiet library was filled with studious teenagers preparing for final exams.
examples.zh: 安静的图书馆里坐满了备考期末的用功青少年。

lemmas.def_zh: 未学得的, 不通晓的, 不故意做作的, 自然的, 即席而成的, 随便的
lemmas.def_en: not by design or artifice; unforced and impromptu

examples.en: Her simple, unstudied elegance always impressed everyone she met at social gatherings.
examples.zh: 她在社交聚会上自然不做作的优雅总是给遇到的每个人留下深刻印象。

lemmas.def_zh: 故意地；好学地；注意地
lemmas.def_en: in a studious manner

examples.en: He studiously avoided eye contact with his former boss during the conference.
examples.zh: 在会议期间，他刻意避免与前老板进行眼神接触。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 studium（热诚、专注追求），核心逻辑由“倾注热情于某事”演变出“专注学习、深入研究、求学之人”等义项。
family_guide.core_distinction: study 兼具名词与动词属性，侧重学习/研究行为本身或其产物（如调查报告、书房）；student 则是实施学习行为的主体（学生、学者）。

lemmas.def_zh: 每一个，每个；每隔；充分的，完全的
lemmas.def_en: used to refer to all the individual members of a group without exception; used to indicate repetition or regular intervals

examples.en: She checked every single detail of the contract before signing it.
examples.zh: 她在签字之前仔细核对了合同中的每一个细节。

examples.en: The commuter trains depart every ten minutes during peak hours.
examples.zh: 在高峰时段，通勤列车每隔十分钟发出一班。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 'ǣfre ǣlc'（即 ever each，字面意为‘始终存在的每一个’），核心逻辑是指代整体中的每一个个体，强调毫无例外的全面性与概括性。

lemmas.def_zh: 两个都；双方；既……（又）
lemmas.def_en: used to refer to two things or people together

examples.en: Both options have their own advantages and disadvantages.
examples.zh: 两种选择都各有优缺点。

examples.en: She speaks both English and French with great fluency.
examples.zh: 她英语和法语都说得非常流利。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 bā þā（两者皆），核心语义始终专指“两个实体构成的整体”，强调两者兼有、无一例外。

lemmas.def_zh: 迟到的，晚的；末期的，晚期的；已故的
lemmas.def_en: arriving or happening after the expected time; near the end of a period; deceased

examples.en: Hurry up, or we're going to be late for the meeting.
examples.zh: 快点，不然我们开会要迟到了。

examples.en: The artist achieved international fame in her late fifties.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家在五十多岁接近花甲之年时获得了国际声誉。

lemmas.def_zh: 迟, 晚
lemmas.def_en: quality of coming late or later in time

examples.en: She apologized profusely for her lateness due to an unexpected traffic jam.
examples.zh: 她因突如其来的交通堵塞导致迟到而连连道歉。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 læt（缓慢的、迟缓的），核心演变逻辑由“时间滞后、动作缓慢”引申至“接近某一时段末尾”乃至“前不久去世的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 大的；巨大的；重大的；重要的
lemmas.def_en: of considerable size, extent, or intensity; of great importance

examples.en: Buying a house is a big decision that requires careful planning.
examples.zh: 买房是一个重大的决定，需要周密的规划。

examples.en: They live in a big house with a beautiful garden.
examples.zh: 他们住在一栋带漂亮花园的大房子里。

lemmas.def_zh: 大, 伟大, 重大
lemmas.def_en: the property of having a relatively great size

examples.en: The sheer bigness of the corporate empire intimidated many smaller rival companies.
examples.zh: 该商业帝国的庞大规模令许多较小的竞争对手望而生畏。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于中古英语，词源可能与北欧方言相关，核心逻辑表示在尺寸、规模、数量或重要性上超出寻常。

lemmas.def_zh: 三的，三个的；三，数字3
lemmas.def_en: amounting to three; the number equivalent to the sum of one and two

examples.en: She decided to stay in Paris for three weeks.
examples.zh: 她决定在巴黎停留三周。

examples.en: The hands of the clock were pointing to three.
examples.zh: 钟表的指针正指着三点。

lemmas.def_zh: 三的，三个的；三，数字3
lemmas.def_en: amounting to three; the number equivalent to the sum of one and two

examples.en: She decided to stay in Paris for three weeks.
examples.zh: 她决定在巴黎停留三周。

examples.en: The hands of the clock were pointing to three.
examples.zh: 钟表的指针正指着三点。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语基本数词 *tréyes（三），在印欧各语系中高度同源且词义极其稳定，专指介于二与四之间的基数概念。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词用法充当数词限定词修饰名词；名词用法指代数字符号、钟点或由三人/物构成的组合。

lemmas.def_zh: 允许，让；出租（房屋等）；假设
lemmas.def_en: to allow or permit; to rent out property to someone

examples.en: They decided to let their spare room to an international student.
examples.zh: 他们决定把空闲的房间出租给一名留学生。

examples.en: Please let me know as soon as you arrive at the station.
examples.zh: 你一到车站请立刻告诉我。

lemmas.def_zh: v. 用字母标明；书写字母于
lemmas.def_en: n. a written message; a symbol of an alphabet | v. to inscribe or print letters on something

examples.en: She sealed the envelope and posted the letter this morning.
examples.zh: 她今天早上封好信封并把信寄了出去。

examples.en: The wooden sign was carefully lettered by hand with gold paint.
examples.zh: 木质招牌是用金漆手工精心题字的。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 信，函件；字母 |
lemmas.def_en: n. a written message; a symbol of an alphabet | v. to inscribe or print letters on something

examples.en: She sealed the envelope and posted the letter this morning.
examples.zh: 她今天早上封好信封并把信寄了出去。

examples.en: The wooden sign was carefully lettered by hand with gold paint.
examples.zh: 木质招牌是用金漆手工精心题字的。

lemmas.def_zh: （房屋、土地等的）出租；出租房；租期
lemmas.def_en: the act of renting out a property, or a rented accommodation

examples.en: Short-term holiday lettings are strictly regulated in the city center.
examples.zh: 市中心对短期度假房屋出租有严格的监管。

lemmas.def_zh: 出租人
lemmas.def_en: someone who grants a lease

examples.en: The lessor agreed to cover the cost of repairing the broken heating system.
examples.zh: 出租人同意承担维修损坏供暖系统的费用。

lemmas.def_zh: 文字书写员；文字雕刻员
lemmas.def_en: a painter of letters

examples.en: The comic book publisher hired a skilled letterer to format all the dialogue.
examples.zh: 漫画出版商雇佣了一位技术娴熟的嵌字员来排版所有对话。

family_guide.root_logic: 核心源自古英语 lǣtan（允许、放任、让出/出租）；现代衍生中 letting 直接表‘出租行为/租约’，而 letter（信件/字母/印字）虽形态重合，词源实则源自拉丁语 littera，现作为高频形近词一并梳理。
family_guide.core_distinction: let 为核心动词（允许/出租）；letting 为动名词转化为的名词（特指房屋等财产的出租或租期）；letter 则独立作名词（字母/信件）或动词（题字/印字母）。

lemmas.def_zh: 成年女子；妇女；女性
lemmas.def_en: an adult female human being

examples.en: She made history as the first woman to be appointed director of the research institute.
examples.zh: 她创造了历史，成为首位被任命为该研究所所长的女性。

lemmas.def_zh: 女子成年身分, 女子成年期, 女子成年资格, 女子气质, 女子特性
lemmas.def_en: the state of being an adult woman

examples.en: She celebrated reaching womanhood with a memorable gathering of close family members.
examples.zh: 她与亲密家人举行了难忘的聚会，庆祝自己跨入成年期。

lemmas.def_zh: 玩弄女性的人; 风流坯子; 色鬼; 洋葱男
lemmas.def_en: a man who likes many women and has short sexual relationships with them

examples.en: He earned a reputation as a reckless womanizer during his college years.
examples.zh: 他在大学期间落下了放荡花心、玩弄女性的名声。

lemmas.def_zh: 女性气质
lemmas.def_en: the trait of being womanly; having the characteristics of an adult female

examples.en: Her natural grace and gentle voice were seen as the very essence of womanliness.
examples.zh: 她天生的优雅与轻柔的嗓音被视作女性气质的精髓。

lemmas.def_zh: 像女人的；有女子气质的
lemmas.def_en: befitting or characteristic of a woman especially a mature woman

examples.en: She possessed a calm, womanly strength that comforted everyone in difficult times.
examples.zh: 她拥有一种沉静而具女性特质的力量，在艰难时刻抚慰了所有人。

lemmas.def_zh: 不像女人的, 女人不应有的
lemmas.def_en: not womanly

examples.en: In the nineteenth century, expressing strong political opinions was often considered unwomanly behavior.
examples.zh: 在19世纪，公开发表强烈的政治观点常被认为是不合妇道的行为。

lemmas.def_zh: 使带女子气, 使柔弱；(非正式)追求女色, 与女人私通
lemmas.def_en: have amorous affairs; of men

examples.en: His reputation was ruined by his constant tendency to drink heavily and womanize.
examples.zh: 他嗜酒如命且四处寻花问柳的恶习彻底毁掉了自己的名声。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语复合词 wīfmann，由 wīf（女性/妻子）与 mann（人）构成，本义即“女性人类”，后语音弱化合并演变为指代成年女性的基础词。

lemmas.def_zh: 名字, 名称, 姓名, 名义, 名誉, 文件名
lemmas.def_en: a language unit by which a person or thing is known

examples.en: Please write your full name clearly at the top of the application form.
examples.zh: 请在申请表顶端清楚地写下您的全名。

lemmas.def_zh: 匿名, 姓氏不明
lemmas.def_en: the state of being anonymous

examples.en: The whistleblower requested complete anonymity before sharing the sensitive internal documents with journalists.
examples.zh: 举报人在向记者分享敏感内部文件前要求完全匿名。

lemmas.def_zh: 命名者, 指名者
lemmas.def_en: a person who gives a name or names

examples.en: As the namer of the new species, the biologist followed strict scientific conventions.
examples.zh: 作为该新物种的命名者，这位生物学家遵循了严格的科学惯例。

lemmas.def_zh: 命名, 称呼, 任命, 提名, 列举
lemmas.def_en: assign a specified (usually proper) proper name to

examples.en: Please write your full name clearly at the top of the application form.
examples.zh: 请在申请表顶端清楚地写下您的全名。

lemmas.def_zh: 即，也就是（用于具体指明或列举）
lemmas.def_en: that is to say; used to introduce more exact information or specify what has been mentioned

examples.en: Only one student passed the final exam, namely Sarah.
examples.zh: 只有一名学生通过了期末考试，那就是萨拉。

examples.en: We face a single major hurdle, namely a lack of funding.
examples.zh: 我们面临着一个主要障碍，即资金匮乏。

lemmas.def_en: without giving a name
lemmas.def_zh: 不具名地；化名地

examples.en: A generous donor anonymously contributed one million dollars to the local children's hospital fund.
examples.zh: 一位慷慨的捐赠者匿名向当地儿童医院基金捐赠了一百万美元。

lemmas.def_en: having no known name or identity or known source
lemmas.def_zh: 匿名的；无特色的

examples.en: The charity received a massive donation from an anonymous benefactor.
examples.zh: 该慈善机构收到了一位匿名捐赠者的大笔善款。

lemmas.def_zh: 无名的, 匿名的, 不可名状的
lemmas.def_en: being or having an unknown or unnamed source

examples.en: The generous donor wished to remain nameless and quietly left the charity event.
examples.zh: 这位慷慨的捐赠者希望保持匿名，便悄悄离开了慈善活动。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语 *no-men-（名字、标记），核心概念为“用特定称谓来指认、区分事物”，由此衍生出命名、提名、声誉以及具体列举等含义。
family_guide.core_distinction: namely 是专门用于引出具体说明或精确列举的插入语副词（意为“即、也就是”），不可误作形容词或与动词 name 混淆。

lemmas.def_zh: 感谢，向……道谢；归因于（常用语 have sb/sth to thank for）
lemmas.def_en: to express gratitude to someone for a favor, gift, or service

examples.en: I wanted to thank you personally for all your support over the past few weeks.
examples.zh: 我想就过去几周你给予的所有支持，亲自向你表示感谢。

examples.en: We have the local volunteers to thank for the quick cleanup after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨后能如此迅速地清理完毕，我们多亏了当地的志愿者。

lemmas.def_zh: 感激的；庆幸的，欣慰的
lemmas.def_en: feeling or showing gratitude; pleased and relieved

examples.en: She was deeply thankful that no one was injured in the accident.
examples.zh: 事故中没有人受伤，她感到万分庆幸。

examples.en: During difficult times, we become more thankful for the simple things in life.
examples.zh: 在艰难时刻，我们会对生活中那些平凡的小事更加心存感恩。

lemmas.def_zh: 不感谢的, 忘恩的, 不知感恩的
lemmas.def_en: not feeling or showing gratitude; ; - Shakespeare

examples.en: Cleaning up the messy office kitchen every evening felt like a completely thankless task.
examples.zh: 每天傍晚清理杂乱的办公室茶水间感觉是一项吃力不讨好的差事。

lemmas.def_zh: 不被领情的, 不感恩的, 不知感谢的
lemmas.def_en: not feeling or showing gratitude; ; - Shakespeare

examples.en: He appeared selfish and unthankful after receiving so much help from his neighbors.
examples.zh: 在得到邻居们如此多的帮助后，他却显得自私且不知感恩。

lemmas.def_zh: 谢天谢地，幸亏；感激地
lemmas.def_en: used to express relief that something bad was avoided or something good happened

examples.en: Thankfully, the rain stopped just as the outdoor ceremony was about to begin.
examples.zh: 谢天谢地，户外仪式正要开始时雨就停了。

examples.en: He thankfully accepted the cup of hot coffee after walking through the snow.
examples.zh: 在雪中走了一阵后，他感激地接过了那杯热咖啡。

lemmas.def_zh: 感激
lemmas.def_en: warm friendly feelings of gratitude

examples.en: She felt a deep sense of thankfulness toward everyone who supported her recovery.
examples.zh: 她对所有支持她康复的人心怀深深的感激。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，与 think（想、思量）同源，原指在心中思念他人的善意并表达出来，后演变为‘感谢、感激’的核心含义。
family_guide.core_distinction: thankful 常侧重于因脱离险境、免于不幸或事情有好结果而感到‘庆幸的、欣慰的’；thankfully 则多用作句首评注副词，相当于 fortunately（谢天谢地，幸好）。

lemmas.def_zh: 移动, 开动, 感动, 搬(家)；移动, 离开, 运行, 迁移, 摇动, 搬家, 交往, 进展, 脱手
lemmas.def_en: change location; move, travel, or proceed, also metaphorically

examples.en: We decided to move our furniture to make more room for the party.
examples.zh: 我们决定搬动家具，以便为聚会腾出更多空间。

lemmas.def_en: show, express or direct through movement
lemmas.def_zh: 打手势

examples.en: The bus came to a sudden halt, throwing all the passengers forward.
examples.zh: 公共汽车突然停下，使所有的乘客都向前倾。

lemmas.def_zh: 移动, 迁居, 步骤
lemmas.def_en: the act of deciding to do something

examples.en: We decided to move our furniture to make more room for the party.
examples.zh: 我们决定搬动家具，以便为聚会腾出更多空间。

lemmas.def_zh: 运动, 动作, 运转, 移动, 倾向, 变化, 活动, 乐章
lemmas.def_en: a change of position that does not entail a change of location

examples.en: The sudden movement of the shadows caught the watchful security guard's attention immediately.
examples.zh: 阴影的突然移动立刻引起了警惕的保安的注意。

lemmas.def_en: the use of movements (especially of the hands) to communicate familiar or prearranged signals
lemmas.def_zh: 移动, 手势, 动作, 意向, 请求, 提议

examples.en: The bus came to a sudden halt, throwing all the passengers forward.
examples.zh: 公共汽车突然停下，使所有的乘客都向前倾。

lemmas.def_zh: 移动的人, 原动力, 鼓动者
lemmas.def_en: workman employed by a moving company

examples.en: The hired mover carefully carried the antique wooden cabinet down the narrow stairs.
examples.zh: 雇来的搬运工小心翼翼地把古董木柜抬下狭窄的楼梯。

lemmas.def_zh: 活动的东西, 动产
lemmas.def_en: personal as opposed to real property; any tangible movable property (furniture or domestic animals or a car etc)

examples.en: The law distinguishes between real property and movable personal goods like jewelry or tools.
examples.zh: 法律对不动产与诸如珠宝、工具等动产进行了区分。

lemmas.def_zh: 可动, 易动, 可动性
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being movable; capable of being moved or rearranged

examples.en: Engineers tested the joint for maximum movability without compromising its overall structural stability.
examples.zh: 工程师们测试了关节的最大可动性，同时未牺牲其整体结构稳定性。

lemmas.def_en: not in physical motion
lemmas.def_zh: 不动的, 静止的

examples.en: The deer remained completely motionless until the predator passed through the woods.
examples.zh: 这只鹿保持完全静止，直到捕食者穿过树林。

lemmas.def_zh: 可动的, 可移动的, 不定的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being moved or conveyed from one place to another

examples.en: The office features moveable walls that can quickly create private meeting spaces.
examples.zh: 该办公室配有活动隔墙，能够迅速隔出私密会议空间。

lemmas.def_zh: 没有动过的, 不动摇的, 坚决的, 冷静的
lemmas.def_en: emotionally unmoved

examples.en: Despite the emotional plea from the defense, the judge remained completely unmoved.
examples.zh: 尽管辩方进行了动情的恳求，法官依然完全不为所动。

lemmas.def_zh: 不感动人的, 不动人的
lemmas.def_en: not in motion

examples.en: The deer stood completely unmoving in the clearing, blending with the surrounding trees.
examples.zh: 那只鹿一动不动地伫立在林间空地上，与周围的树木融为一体。

lemmas.def_zh: 固定的, 不动的, 不改变的
lemmas.def_en: not able or intended to be moved

examples.en: A massive, unmovable boulder blocked the narrow mountain pass after the violent storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过后，一块巨大且不可移动的巨石堵住了狭窄的山口。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or characterized by motion
lemmas.def_zh: 运动的

examples.en: The device accurately measures both static weight and subtle motional changes in real time.
examples.zh: 该设备能实时精确测量静态重量和微妙的运动变化。

lemmas.def_zh: 不动的
lemmas.def_en: not in motion

examples.en: Traffic police issued tickets to all nonmoving vehicles parked along the emergency lane.
examples.zh: 交警对所有停在应急车道上的静止车辆开具了罚单。

lemmas.def_zh: 感人地, 动人地
lemmas.def_en: in a moving manner

examples.en: The elderly veteran spoke movingly about the comrades he had lost during the war.
examples.zh: 这位老兵动情地讲述了他在战争中失去的战友们。

lemmas.def_en: without moving; in a motionless manner
lemmas.def_zh: 不动地（motionless的副词）

examples.en: The patient lay motionlessly on the bed while the nurse monitored his vitals.
examples.zh: 护士监测生命体征时，病人一动不动地躺在床上。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 movere（移动、促动），核心语义从物理位置的“位移”引申到抽象的“采取行动、搬迁”以及情绪上的“触动与感动”。
family_guide.core_distinction: move (n.) 偏指具体的单次位移、搬家或策略性行动（如下棋的“一步”）；movement (n.) 则侧重持续的运动过程、身体动作幅度，或群体性的社会政治运动。

lemmas.def_zh: 在……之间；介于……之中；连接；在（两者或多个独立对象）中做选择/分配
lemmas.def_en: in or through the space, time, or relationship that separates two or more distinct entities

examples.en: She had to choose between staying in her hometown and accepting the job offer abroad.
examples.zh: 她必须在留在家乡与接受海外的工作机会之间做出选择。

examples.en: A close friendship soon developed between the two researchers.
examples.zh: 两位研究人员之间很快建立了亲密的友谊。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 be-（在……旁）与 twēonum（以二者为单位，与 two 同源），核心逻辑始终为“处在两个（或多个明确独立的）实体之间或连接彼此”。

lemmas.def_zh: 围绕；在……周围；在……各处；大约
lemmas.def_en: located or moving on every side of; surrounding; approximately

examples.en: The students sat around the teacher to listen to the story.
examples.zh: 学生们围坐在老师身边听故事。

examples.en: The meeting is scheduled to start around three o'clock.
examples.zh: 会议预计在三点左右开始。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中古英语 'a-round'（处于圆圈中），核心意象为'环形或圆圈'，后引申出环绕、附近以及近似等空间与数值语义。

lemmas.def_zh: 朋友，友人；支持者，赞助者
lemmas.def_en: a person whom one knows and with whom one has a bond of mutual affection

examples.en: A true friend will always stand by you through thick and thin.
examples.zh: 真正的朋友总会与你同甘共苦、不离不弃。

lemmas.def_zh: 友好的，友善的（adj.）；（体育比赛的）友谊赛（n.）
lemmas.def_en: behaving in a kind and pleasant way towards someone (adj.); a match that is not part of a serious competition (n.)

examples.en: The staff were exceptionally friendly and ready to help.
examples.zh: 工作人员格外友善，乐于提供帮助。

examples.en: The national team will play a warm-up friendly next Tuesday.
examples.zh: 国家队将于下周二踢一场热身友谊赛。

lemmas.def_zh: 友谊，友情；朋友关系
lemmas.def_en: the state of being friends; a relationship between friends

examples.en: Their friendship has stood the test of time for more than thirty years.
examples.zh: 他们的友谊经受住了三十多年的岁月考验。

lemmas.def_zh: 友谊, 亲切, 亲密
lemmas.def_en: a feeling of liking for another person; enjoyment in their company

examples.en: The natural friendliness of the local villagers made the travelers feel instantly welcome.
examples.zh: 当地村民天生的友善让旅行者们瞬间感受到了热情欢迎。

lemmas.def_zh: 不友好
lemmas.def_en: dislike experienced as an absence of friendliness

examples.en: His cold silence and apparent unfriendliness made the new employees feel quite uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 他冷漠的沉默和显而易见的不友好让新员工们感到十分不自在。

lemmas.def_zh: 友好的，友善的（adj.）；（体育比赛的）友谊赛（n.）
lemmas.def_en: behaving in a kind and pleasant way towards someone (adj.); a match that is not part of a serious competition (n.)

examples.en: The staff were exceptionally friendly and ready to help.
examples.zh: 工作人员格外友善，乐于提供帮助。

examples.en: The national team will play a warm-up friendly next Tuesday.
examples.zh: 国家队将于下周二踢一场热身友谊赛。

lemmas.def_en: not easy to understand or use

examples.en: The complex new software interface proved extremely unfriendly to beginner computer users.
examples.zh: 这个复杂的新软件界面对电脑初学者来说非常难用。

lemmas.def_zh: 没有朋友的, 无依无靠的
lemmas.def_en: excluded from a society

examples.en: He felt completely friendless and isolated after moving to the bustling new city.
examples.zh: 搬到这个繁华的新城市后，他感到无依无靠，十分孤单。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语‘爱、喜爱’之义，核心表意为‘因互爱情谊而联结的人’，由此衍生出抽象的‘友谊状态’（friendship）以及外显的‘亲善特质’与体育界的‘友谊赛’（friendly）。
family_guide.core_distinction: friendly 兼具形容词（友好的）与名词（体育中的友谊赛）；friendship 则是纯抽象名词，专指人与人之间的朋友关系或友谊情义。

lemmas.def_zh: 点, 小数点, 标点, 地点, 要点, 特点, 尖端, 分数, 得分, 穴位
lemmas.def_en: a geometric element that has position but no extension

examples.en: The main point of the meeting was to discuss the new budget proposals.
examples.zh: 这次会议的要点是讨论新的预算提案。

lemmas.def_zh: 指示物, 教鞭, 暗示, 指针
lemmas.def_en: a mark to indicate a direction or relation

examples.en: The coach gave us a few helpful pointers before the final game began.
examples.zh: 决赛开始前，教练给了我们一些有用的建议。

lemmas.def_zh: 无意义, 空洞
lemmas.def_en: total lack of meaning or ideas

examples.en: She realized the sheer pointlessness of arguing with someone who refused to listen.
examples.zh: 她意识到和一个不听劝的人争吵纯粹是毫无意义的。

lemmas.def_zh: 指向;强调
lemmas.def_en: the property of a shape that tapers to a sharp tip

examples.en: The sharp pointedness of her remark left everyone in the meeting room speechless.
examples.zh: 她那番话极具针对性，让会议室里的所有人都哑口无言。

lemmas.def_zh: 弄尖, 强调, 指出, 加标点于, 瞄准；指, 指向, 表明
lemmas.def_en: indicate a place, direction, person, or thing; either spatially or figuratively

examples.en: The main point of the meeting was to discuss the new budget proposals.
examples.zh: 这次会议的要点是讨论新的预算提案。

lemmas.def_zh: 不尖的, 钝的, 不得要领的
lemmas.def_en: not having a point especially a sharp point

examples.en: Continuing this heated debate without any new evidence is completely pointless.
examples.zh: 在没有任何新证据的情况下继续这场激烈的辩论毫无意义。

lemmas.def_zh: 指向地；尖锐地
lemmas.def_en: in such a manner as to make something clearly evident

examples.en: He looked pointedly at his watch to signal that the meeting should end.
examples.zh: 他特意看了看手表，示意会议该结束了。

lemmas.def_zh: 无意义地, 无用地, 无益地
lemmas.def_en: in a pointless manner

examples.en: They pointlessly delayed the project by arguing over trivial administrative details.
examples.zh: 他们为琐碎的行政细节争论不休，毫无意义地耽误了项目。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 pungere（刺、戳），从物理上的“尖端、刺出的小孔”引申为几何或时间空间的“特定点”，再抽象为思维交流中的“核心观点/目的”以及“指向”的动作。
family_guide.core_distinction: pointer 常指具象的“指针”或抽象的“建议/提示”；pointless 则由“无目的、无重点”派生为“无意义的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 书写；写作；给……写信
lemmas.def_en: to mark letters, words, or symbols on a surface; to compose text or a literary work

examples.en: She prefers to write her first drafts by hand before typing them.
examples.zh: 在打字之前，她更喜欢先手写初稿。

lemmas.def_zh: 书写，写了（write 的过去分词）
lemmas.def_en: past participle of write

examples.en: The novel was written in the early twentieth century.
examples.zh: 这部小说写于二十世纪初。

lemmas.def_zh: 书写，写了（write 的过去式）
lemmas.def_en: past tense of write

examples.en: He wrote a comprehensive report detailing the project's progress.
examples.zh: 他写了一份详尽的报告，详细说明了项目的进展。

lemmas.def_zh: 书写，写了（write 的过去分词）
lemmas.def_en: past participle of write

examples.en: The novel was written in the early twentieth century.
examples.zh: 这部小说写于二十世纪初。

lemmas.def_zh: 非书面的, 没有写的, 没有记录的, 口头的
lemmas.def_en: based on custom rather than documentation; ; - J.L.T.C.Spence

examples.en: There was an unwritten rule in the office that nobody leaves before six.
examples.zh: 办公室里有一条不成文的规定，那就是六点前谁都不能走。

lemmas.def_zh: 书写；笔迹；作品，文章
lemmas.def_en: the activity of composing text; a person's handwriting; written work

examples.en: Her creative writing course helped her discover her authentic voice.
examples.zh: 她的创意写作课程帮助她找到了自己独特的风格。

lemmas.def_zh: 作家；作者；写作者
lemmas.def_en: a person who writes books, articles, or other literary works

examples.en: She works as a freelance writer for several technology magazines.
examples.zh: 她是一名自由撰稿人，为多家科技杂志供稿。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古英语 wrītan（刻、划），核心意象是通过在载体上留下刻痕或标记来记录语言，后引申为通用的书写、创作与文字表达。
family_guide.core_distinction: written 兼具过去分词与形容词用法（强调书面形式与口头相对）；writing 侧重书写行为、手迹或文字作品；writer 则指代创作者本人。

lemmas.def_zh: 总是；一直；永远；一向
lemmas.def_en: at all times; on every occasion; forever

examples.en: She always takes the time to listen to her team's concerns.
examples.zh: 她总是抽出时间倾听团队成员的疑虑。

examples.en: I will always remember the kindness you showed me.
examples.zh: 我将永远记住你对我的善意。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语‘all way’（走完全程），由空间上的‘全程’引申为时间上的‘自始至终、总是’。

lemmas.def_zh: 队, 组
lemmas.def_en: a cooperative unit (especially in sports)

examples.en: Our marketing team worked together through the weekend to finish the big proposal.
examples.zh: 我们的营销团队整个周末都在通力合作，以完成这份重要提案。

lemmas.def_zh: 联畜运输车驾驶者, 卡车驾驶员
lemmas.def_en: the driver of a team of horses doing hauling

examples.en: My grandfather was a proud teamster who drove trucks across the country.
examples.zh: 我的祖父是一名自豪的卡车司机，曾开车载货穿梭全国。

lemmas.def_zh: 把马(牛)套在同一辆车上, 把...编成一组；驾驶卡车, 协作
lemmas.def_en: form a team

examples.en: Our marketing team worked together through the weekend to finish the big proposal.
examples.zh: 我们的营销团队整个周末都在通力合作，以完成这份重要提案。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，原指套在一起拉车的一副牲口，引申为为了共同目标分工协作的“团队”及“协同合作”之意。

lemmas.def_zh: 放，安置；使处于（某种状态）；表达，陈述
lemmas.def_en: to move something into a particular position; to cause someone or something to be in a certain condition; to express in words

examples.en: She put the keys on the desk and hung up her coat.
examples.zh: 她把钥匙放在桌上，并挂好了外套。

examples.en: To put it simply, we need to cut costs immediately.
examples.zh: 简单地说，我们需要立即削减成本。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古英语表示'推、戳'的词根，后演变为将某物推移至特定位置或状态，核心表'放置、安置或使处于某种情境'。

lemmas.def_zh: 自……以来；从……以后；既然，因为
lemmas.def_en: from a particular time in the past until a later time or the present; because or as

examples.en: We haven't seen each other since we graduated from college.
examples.zh: 自大学毕业以来，我们一直没见过面。

examples.en: Since you are already here, you might as well join us for dinner.
examples.zh: 既然你已经来了，不妨留下来和我们一起吃晚饭。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语‘从那之后’（siþþan），核心意象是从某一起点向后延伸，由时间上的‘自……以来’引申出因果逻辑上的‘既然、因为’。

lemmas.def_zh: 阅读，看懂；朗读；理解，领悟；显示（数据或信息）
lemmas.def_en: to look at and understand written words; to interpret meaning; to display a certain value or message

examples.en: She spent the rainy afternoon reading a fascinating historical novel.
examples.zh: 她在那个雨天的下午读了一本引人入胜的历史小说。

examples.en: You need to read between the lines to understand what he actually meant.
examples.zh: 你需要体会言外之意才能明白他的真正意图。

lemmas.def_zh: 读错, 看错
lemmas.def_en: read or interpret wrongly

examples.en: He misread the map and accidentally drove several miles in the wrong direction.
examples.zh: 他看错了地图，不小心朝错误的方向开了好几英里。

lemmas.def_zh: 阅读，朗读；读物；（仪表上的）读数；解读，理解
lemmas.def_en: the activity of reading; written material; a value shown on a measuring instrument; an interpretation

examples.en: The professor provided a comprehensive list of required reading for the semester.
examples.zh: 教授提供了本学期必读书目的完整清单。

examples.en: The technician took a careful reading of the pressure gauge.
examples.zh: 技术人员仔细记录了压力表的读数。

lemmas.def_zh: 读者；电子阅读器；读本，简易读物
lemmas.def_en: a person who reads; a book designed for learners; an electronic device for reading digital texts

examples.en: As an avid reader, she usually finishes two or three books a week.
examples.zh: 作为一名狂热的读者，她通常一周能读完两三本书。

examples.en: This graded reader is specially designed for intermediate English learners.
examples.zh: 这本分级读物是专为中级英语学习者设计的。

lemmas.def_zh: 读者, 读者人数
lemmas.def_en: the audience reached by written communications (books or magazines or newspapers etc.)

examples.en: The local newspaper has seen a dramatic increase in its online readership lately.
examples.zh: 这家地方报纸最近的网络读者人数大幅增加。

lemmas.def_zh: 没有人读过的, 读书不多的, 无学问的
lemmas.def_en: not informed through reading; - V.L.Parrington

examples.en: She woke up to find dozens of unread emails waiting in her inbox.
examples.zh: 她醒来后发现收件箱里有几十封未读邮件。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 rǣdan，本义为“思索、推断、领会”，后专指通过辨认符号来理解文字信息，核心逻辑是“解码并领悟含义”。
family_guide.core_distinction: reader 指执行阅读行为的主体（读者）或读取工具（阅读器/读本）；reading 则指阅读的动作过程、具体读物、仪器的测量读数或对事物的个人解读。

lemmas.def_zh: 周；星期；礼拜；工作周
lemmas.def_en: a period of seven consecutive days, typically from Sunday to Saturday or Monday to Sunday

examples.en: She works forty hours a week and spends the weekends with her family.
examples.zh: 她每周工作四十个小时，周末则陪伴家人。

examples.en: The project deadline was extended by another week.
examples.zh: 该项目的截止日期又延长了一周。

lemmas.def_zh: 周报；周刊
lemmas.def_en: a newspaper or magazine that is published once every week

examples.en: He writes a satirical column for a popular satirical weekly.
examples.zh: 他为一家颇受欢迎的讽刺周刊撰写讽刺专栏。

examples.en: The local weekly covers community news and upcoming events.
examples.zh: 这家地方周报主要报道社区新闻和即将开展的活动。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古英语表示“变动、轮转”的词汇，后特指由七天构成的轮替时间周期“星期”，派生词则延伸至以该周期发行的出版物。
family_guide.core_distinction: week 指七天的时间跨度；weekly 作名词时特指按周出版的“周报”或“周刊”。

lemmas.def_en: any of various alternatives; some other

examples.en: Would you like another cup of hot coffee before we start the session?
examples.zh: 在我们开始会议之前，你想再喝一杯热咖啡吗？

lemmas.def_zh: 另外的, 再一的, 不同的
lemmas.def_en: any of various alternatives; some other

examples.en: Would you like another cup of hot coffee before we start the session?
examples.zh: 在我们开始会议之前，你想再喝一杯热咖啡吗？

family_guide.root_logic: 源于中古英语‘an other’（an + other），核心语义为‘再一个（同一类别的增加）’或‘另一个（不同对象的替换）’。
family_guide.core_distinction: det. 侧重数量上的‘追加一个’或泛指‘另一个人/物’；adj. 侧重性质上的‘不同/别样的’或‘如同第二个人/物的’。

lemmas.def_zh: 公司, 友伴, 交往, 连队, 朋友, 一群
lemmas.def_en: an institution created to conduct business

examples.en: I really enjoy his company because he always tells such hilarious travel stories.
examples.zh: 我非常喜欢和他在一起，因为他总是讲一些搞笑的旅行故事。

lemmas.def_zh: 陪伴；交往
lemmas.def_en: be a companion to somebody

examples.en: I really enjoy his company because he always tells such hilarious travel stories.
examples.zh: 我非常喜欢和他在一起，因为他总是讲一些搞笑的旅行故事。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 com-（共同）+ panis（面包），字面本义为“一起吃面包的人/伙伴”，后引申为“陪伴”，进而演变为志同道合的团体、商业组织（公司）及军事编制（连队）。
family_guide.core_distinction: 现代英语中 company 绝大多数场合用作名词；动词用法属于古旧或文学表达，现已被 accompany 全面取代。

lemmas.def_zh: 家庭；家族；亲属；（动植物分类的）科
lemmas.def_en: a group consisting of parents and children living together, or people related by blood or marriage; a group of related items

examples.en: She comes from a large, close-knit family that gathers for dinner every Sunday.
examples.zh: 她来自一个关系紧密的大家庭，每个周日全家人都会聚在一起吃晚餐。

examples.en: Lions, tigers, and domestic cats all belong to the cat family.
examples.zh: 狮子、老虎和家猫都属于猫科动物。

lemmas.def_zh: 家族的, 家庭的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or having the characteristics of a family

examples.en: She felt a strong familial obligation to take care of her elderly parents.
examples.zh: 她感到有一种强烈的家庭责任去照顾年迈的父母。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 familia（家属、家庭仆从），核心意指“以血缘或婚姻为纽带共同生活的亲族”，后引申为具有共同源流、特征的群体或生物分类中的“科”。

lemmas.def_zh: 讲话, 演讲, 说话, 谈话, 交流, 闲聊, 说闲话；讲, 说, 讨论, 谈论
lemmas.def_en: exchange thoughts; talk with

examples.en: The professor gave an inspiring talk on the future of renewable energy technologies.
examples.zh: 这位教授就可再生能源技术的未来发表了一场鼓舞人心的演讲。

lemmas.def_zh: 谈话, 交谈, 会谈, 讲话, 演讲, 空谈, 谣言, 方言, 语言
lemmas.def_en: an exchange of ideas via conversation

examples.en: The professor gave an inspiring talk on the future of renewable energy technologies.
examples.zh: 这位教授就可再生能源技术的未来发表了一场鼓舞人心的演讲。

lemmas.def_zh: 说话的人, 饶舌者, 空谈者
lemmas.def_en: someone who expresses in language; someone who talks (especially someone who delivers a public speech or someone especially garrulous)

examples.en: My brother is a smooth talker who can make friends almost anywhere instantly.
examples.zh: 我哥哥是个健谈的人，几乎在任何地方都能迅速交到朋友。

lemmas.def_zh: 有声电影
lemmas.def_en: a movie with synchronized speech and singing

examples.en: The transition from silent films to the first talkies transformed the movie industry.
examples.zh: 从默片到早期有声电影的转变彻底改变了电影工业。

lemmas.def_zh: 爱说话, 爱讲话；饶舌
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being wordy and talkative

examples.en: His sudden talkativeness surprised everyone, as he was usually quiet during meetings.
examples.zh: 他突然变得多话让大家很惊讶，因为他平时开会总是很安静。

lemmas.def_zh: 喜欢说话的, 饶舌的, 多嘴的
lemmas.def_en: full of trivial conversation

examples.en: She becomes very talkative whenever the topic turns to modern art and design.
examples.zh: 每当话题转向现代艺术和设计时，她就会变得非常健谈。

lemmas.def_zh: 对话过多的
lemmas.def_en: full of trivial conversation

examples.en: Critics complained that the movie was too talky and lacked sufficient visual action.
examples.zh: 影评人抱怨这部电影台词过多，缺乏足够的视觉动作场面。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 talian（计数、叙述，与 tell 同源），核心逻辑是通过口头言语交流思想、信息或达成理解。

lemmas.def_zh: 支付, 付清, 补偿, 偿还, 对...有利, 为...涂防水物；付款, 付出代价, 偿还, 得到报应, 获得好处
lemmas.def_en: give money, usually in exchange for goods or services

examples.en: He had to pay extra fees because his luggage exceeded the weight limit.
examples.zh: 因为行李超重，他不得不支付额外的费用。

lemmas.def_zh: pay的过去式和过去分词
lemmas.def_en: give money, usually in exchange for goods or services

examples.en: They paid fifty dollars for the concert tickets online yesterday afternoon.
examples.zh: 他们昨天下午在网上花了五十美元购买音乐会门票。

lemmas.def_zh: 薪资, 付款, 补偿
lemmas.def_en: something that remunerates

examples.en: He had to pay extra fees because his luggage exceeded the weight limit.
examples.zh: 因为行李超重，他不得不支付额外的费用。

lemmas.def_zh: 付款, 支付的款项(或实物), 偿还, 报应, 惩罚
lemmas.def_en: a sum of money paid or a claim discharged

examples.en: The landlord requires payment of the rent on the first day of each month.
examples.zh: 房东要求在每月的首日支付房租。

lemmas.def_zh: 支付者, 付款人
lemmas.def_en: a person who pays money for something

examples.en: The insurance company acts as the primary payer for all related medical expenses.
examples.zh: 保险公司担任所有相关医疗费用的主要支付方。

lemmas.def_zh: 收款人, 领款人
lemmas.def_en: a person to whom money is paid

examples.en: Please write the name of the payee clearly on the front of the check.
examples.zh: 请在支票正面清楚地写下收款人的姓名。

lemmas.def_zh: 不支付
lemmas.def_en: act of failing to meet a financial obligation

examples.en: His cell phone service was suspended due to the nonpayment of recent bills.
examples.zh: 由于未支付最近的账单，他的手机服务被暂停了。

lemmas.def_zh: 受雇的, 付清的
lemmas.def_en: marked by the reception of pay

examples.en: They paid fifty dollars for the concert tickets online yesterday afternoon.
examples.zh: 他们昨天下午在网上花了五十美元购买音乐会门票。

lemmas.def_zh: 未付款的, 不支薪水的
lemmas.def_en: not paid

examples.en: She gained valuable clinical experience through an unpaid internship at the local hospital.
examples.zh: 她通过在当地医院的无薪实习获得了宝贵的临床经验。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 pacare（使和平、平息，与 peace 同源），经古法语演变而来，核心逻辑是通过交割金钱、报酬或承担代价使债权人“满意/平息争端”，现代引申为支付、薪酬及付出代价获得回报。
family_guide.core_distinction: pay 作为名词专指因工作或劳动定期获得的“薪资、报酬”；而 payment 侧重指具体的“单次付款行为、款项金额或支付方式”。

lemmas.def_zh: 询问，打听；请求，要求；邀请
lemmas.def_en: to put a question to someone, or to request information, help, or permission

examples.en: If you don't understand the instructions, don't hesitate to ask.
examples.zh: 如果你不理解这些说明，尽管开口问。

examples.en: She called to ask for advice on how to handle the situation.
examples.zh: 她打电话来就如何处理这种情况征求意见。

lemmas.def_zh: 发问者, 请求者
lemmas.def_en: someone who asks a question

examples.en: The speaker paused briefly to look directly at the asker before responding.
examples.zh: 演讲者在回答前稍作停顿，直视提问者。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 āscian，核心语义为通过言语向对方索取，主要演变出“索取信息（询问/打听）”与“索取行动或物品（请求/要求）”两大核心支柱。

lemmas.def_zh: 在...之下, 低于
lemmas.def_en: located below or beneath something else

examples.en: The small dog curled up comfortably under the heavy wooden dining table.
examples.zh: 那只小狗舒服地蜷缩在厚重的木制餐桌下。

lemmas.def_zh: 下面的, 从属的
lemmas.def_en: located below or beneath something else

examples.en: The small dog curled up comfortably under the heavy wooden dining table.
examples.zh: 那只小狗舒服地蜷缩在厚重的木制餐桌下。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语，核心意象为“在……之下”，从物理空间位置的低处，延伸至等级地位、数量幅度、管辖控制及所处的状态。
family_guide.core_distinction: 作介词时连接宾语，表空间位置、数量下限、受制或进行中的状态；作形容词时多作前置定语，表示“底层的”或“较低的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 儿童，小孩；子女
lemmas.def_en: a young human being below the age of puberty; a son or daughter

examples.en: As a child, she spent hours reading in the local library.
examples.zh: 小时候，她在当地图书馆里度过了许多阅读时光。

examples.en: They have three grown-up children who now live abroad.
examples.zh: 他们有三个已经成年的孩子，如今都在国外生活。

lemmas.def_zh: 童年，儿童时代
lemmas.def_en: the state or period of being a child

examples.en: He had a happy childhood growing up on a farm.
examples.zh: 他在农场长大，度过了一个快乐的童年。

examples.en: Vivid memories from her childhood often inspired her novels.
examples.zh: 童年时期的生动记忆常常激发她的写作用灵感。

lemmas.def_zh: childless（无子女的）的变形
lemmas.def_en: the condition of being without offspring

examples.en: The couple embraced their childlessness and spent most of their time traveling abroad.
examples.zh: 这对夫妇坦然接受无子女的生活，把大部分时间都花在出国旅行上。

lemmas.def_zh: 无儿女的
lemmas.def_en: without offspring

examples.en: Many childless couples in the neighborhood frequently volunteer to help local youth programs.
examples.zh: 社区里许多无子女的夫妇经常自愿协助当地的青少年项目。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 cild（胎儿、新生儿），核心概念是“未成年的个体”，后续通过添加状态/时期后缀 -hood 扩展为生命发展阶段。
family_guide.core_distinction: child 指代具体的未成年人或子女实体；childhood 指代处于这一生命阶段的状态或时期（童年）。

lemmas.def_zh: 甚远地, 很, 到很深的程度, 到很远的距离
lemmas.def_en: to a considerable degree; very much

examples.en: The old train station is far from here, so we should take a taxi.
examples.zh: 那个老火车站离这里很远，所以我们应该打车去。

lemmas.def_zh: 远的, 久远的, 遥远的
lemmas.def_en: located at a great distance in time or space or degree

examples.en: The old train station is far from here, so we should take a taxi.
examples.zh: 那个老火车站离这里很远，所以我们应该打车去。

lemmas.def_zh: 更远的, 此外的, 更多的
lemmas.def_en: more distant in especially degree

examples.en: The ambitious young scientist took courses abroad to further her career in biotechnology.
examples.zh: 这位雄心勃勃的年轻科学家在国外进修，以促进她在生物技术领域的职业发展。

lemmas.def_zh: 更远的, 进一步的
lemmas.def_en: more distant in especially space or time

examples.en: The tired hikers decided not to walk any farther up the steep mountain.
examples.zh: 疲惫的登山者决定不再沿着陡峭的山路往前走了。

lemmas.def_zh: 最远的, 最遥远的
lemmas.def_en: (comparatives of `far') most remote in space or time or order

examples.en: That tiny village on the hill is the furthest point on our hiking route.
examples.zh: 山上的那个小村庄是我们徒步路线上最远的一点。

lemmas.def_zh: 最远的, 最久的
lemmas.def_en: (comparatives of `far') most remote in space or time or order

examples.en: He managed to throw the heavy metal ball to the farthest corner of the field.
examples.zh: 他成功地把那个沉重的金属球扔到了场地最远的角落。

lemmas.def_zh: 遥远的, 恍惚的, 出神的
lemmas.def_en: very far away in space or time

examples.en: He listened to the story with a dreamy, faraway expression in his eyes.
examples.zh: 他听着故事，眼神里流露出若有所思的出神神情。

lemmas.def_zh: 促进, 增进, 助长
lemmas.def_en: promote the growth of

examples.en: The ambitious young scientist took courses abroad to further her career in biotechnology.
examples.zh: 这位雄心勃勃的年轻科学家在国外进修，以促进她在生物技术领域的职业发展。

lemmas.def_en: a terrorist organization that seeks to overthrow the government dominated by Tutsi and to institute Hutu control again

examples.en: The old train station is far from here, so we should take a taxi.
examples.zh: 那个老火车站离这里很远，所以我们应该打车去。

lemmas.def_zh: 助成, 促进, 援助的方法, 提供援助者
lemmas.def_en: encouragement of the progress or growth or acceptance of something

examples.en: She donated a large sum of money in furtherance of cancer research.
examples.zh: 她捐赠了一大笔钱以促进癌症研究。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语，核心语义为“向前、超越”，后引申为空间、时间或程度上的“偏远”与“延展”。
family_guide.core_distinction: farther/farthest 侧重可测量的物理距离；further/furthest 既可指物理距离，更常用于抽象的深度、程度或追加（further 亦可作动词表“促进”）。

lemmas.def_zh: 在……期间；在……的过程中
lemmas.def_en: throughout the entire course of, or at some point in the period of

examples.en: She woke up several times during the night.
examples.zh: 她在夜里醒来好几次。

examples.en: The museum attracts millions of visitors during the summer months.
examples.zh: 该博物馆在夏季数月间吸引了数百万游客。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 durare（持续，与 durable 同源），原为古法语动词'持续'的现在分词，字面义为'当……持续之时'，后演变为表示时间段的核心介词。

lemmas.def_zh: 变成，成为；适合，相称
lemmas.def_en: to begin to be or grow to be; to suit or look good on someone

examples.en: She worked hard to become a certified public accountant.
examples.zh: 她努力工作，最终成为了一名注册会计师。

examples.en: Such rude behavior does not become a person of your position.
examples.zh: 这样粗鲁的举止与你的身份不相称。

lemmas.def_zh: 变成了，成为了（become 的过去式）
lemmas.def_en: past tense of become

examples.en: As night fell, it became increasingly difficult to find the trail.
examples.zh: 夜幕降临后，找到那条小径变得越来越困难。

lemmas.def_zh: 不适合的, 不合体的, 不相配的
lemmas.def_en: not in keeping with accepted standards of what is right or proper in polite society

examples.en: Such rude behavior is entirely unbecoming of a professional teacher.
examples.zh: 如此粗鲁的行为与专业教师的身份完全不相符。

lemmas.def_zh: 合适地, 适当地
lemmas.def_en: in a becoming manner

examples.en: Her dark hair was becomingly styled for the annual dinner party.
examples.zh: 她为年度晚宴做了一个非常得体大方的深色发型。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语前缀 be-（强化、达到）+ come（来到），由“来到某处”引申为状态或身份的转变，即“成为、变得”，并衍生出“与……相配”之意。
family_guide.core_distinction: became 仅为 become 的过去式形式（过去分词恢复为 become），语义与用法完全承接原形动词。

lemmas.def_zh: 数, 数字, 数目, 号码
lemmas.def_en: the property possessed by a sum or total or indefinite quantity of units or individuals

examples.en: A significant number of students passed the final examination this year.
examples.zh: 今年有相当数量的学生通过了期末考试。

lemmas.def_zh: 数, 计算, 共计；计算, 报数
lemmas.def_en: add up in number or quantity

examples.en: A significant number of students passed the final examination this year.
examples.zh: 今年有相当数量的学生通过了期末考试。

lemmas.def_zh: 数字的, 数值的, 以数字表示的, 擅长于计数的
lemmas.def_en: measured or expressed in numbers

examples.en: Please arrange all the confidential client files in strict numerical order today.
examples.zh: 今天请将所有保密的客户档案严格按数字顺序排列。

lemmas.def_zh: 无数的, 无号数的
lemmas.def_en: too numerous to be counted

examples.en: We sat on the beach and gazed at the numberless stars above.
examples.zh: 我们坐在海滩上，凝视着头顶无数的繁星。

lemmas.def_zh: 数字, 数值, 用数字表示
lemmas.def_en: in number; with regard to numbers

examples.en: in ten years' time the Oxbridge mathematicians, scientists, and engineers will not be much more significant numerically than the Oxbridge medical schools are now

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 numerus（数目、数量），核心语义始终围绕“计量、计数与标记”，由抽象的“数量/数值”引申为具象的“编号”，进而发展为动词“计算、编号、总计达到”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 该词名动同形，作名词表示“数字、号码或数量”，作动词表示“编页码/编号”或“总数达到”。

lemmas.def_zh: 使高兴；取悦；（用于礼貌请求）请
lemmas.def_en: to cause someone to feel happy and satisfied; used as a polite way of asking for something

examples.en: It always pleases him to see his students succeed.
examples.zh: 看到学生取得成功总是让他感到十分欣慰。

examples.en: Please let me know if you need any further assistance.
examples.zh: 如需进一步协助，请随时告诉我。

lemmas.def_zh: 令人愉快的；宜人的；和蔼可亲的
lemmas.def_en: giving a sense of happy satisfaction or enjoyment; friendly and likable

examples.en: We had a very pleasant conversation over a cup of coffee.
examples.zh: 我们喝着咖啡，进行了一次非常愉快的交谈。

examples.en: The coastal breeze made the hot afternoon surprisingly pleasant.
examples.zh: 海风让炎热的午后变得出奇地宜人。

lemmas.def_zh: 令人不快的；难闻的；粗鲁讨厌的
lemmas.def_en: not enjoyable or comfortable; causing discomfort, displeasure, or offense

examples.en: An unpleasant odor drifted into the room as soon as the door opened.
examples.zh: 门一打开，一股难闻的气味就飘进了房间。

examples.en: The manager had the unpleasant task of letting several employees go.
examples.zh: 经理不得不承担解雇几名员工这一令人痛苦的任务。

lemmas.def_zh: 使人不愉快的
lemmas.def_en: lacking graciousness

examples.en: The harsh fluorescent lighting gave the room an unpleasing, sterile atmosphere.
examples.zh: 刺眼的荧光灯使房间显得冰冷而不讨人喜欢。

lemmas.def_zh: 和蔼地, 亲切地；友好地；愉快地
lemmas.def_en: in a cheerful manner

examples.en: We were pleasantly surprised by the high quality of the hotel food.
examples.zh: 我们对酒店食物的高水准感到惊喜。

lemmas.def_zh: 令人不愉快地, 不讨人喜欢地
lemmas.def_en: in an unpleasant manner

examples.en: The cold wind blew unpleasantly across our faces all morning long.
examples.zh: 整个上午，刺骨的寒风都令人不快地吹在我们脸上。

lemmas.def_zh: 高兴地；喜欢地
lemmas.def_en: in a pleasing manner

examples.en: The modern living room is pleasingly decorated in soft neutral tones.
examples.zh: 这间现代客厅采用了柔和的中性色调，装潢十分赏心悦目。

lemmas.def_en: a fundamental feeling that is hard to define but that people desire to experience
lemmas.def_zh: n. 快乐；满足；乐事；荣幸

examples.en: It was an absolute pleasure meeting you.
examples.zh: 与您相见真是一件极其荣幸的事。

lemmas.def_zh: please的变形
lemmas.def_en: a pleasing entertainer

examples.en: Always being a people pleaser often leads to unnecessary stress and fatigue.
examples.zh: 总是当一个讨好型人格的人往往会导致不必要的压力与疲惫。

lemmas.def_zh: 不愉快, 煞风景, 不愉快事件, 争执
lemmas.def_en: the feeling caused by disagreeable stimuli; one pole of a continuum of states of feeling

examples.en: They quickly resolved the misunderstanding to avoid any further unpleasantness between them.
examples.zh: 他们迅速消除了误会，以避免彼此之间发生更多不愉快。

lemmas.def_zh: 乐园, 愉快, 乐事, 快乐
lemmas.def_en: a pleasant and secluded part of a garden; usually attached to a mansion

examples.en: The castle garden served as a peaceful pleasance for the royal family.
examples.zh: 城堡花园曾是供王室游憩散心的宁静乐园。

lemmas.def_zh: 愉快
lemmas.def_en: the feeling caused by agreeable stimuli; one pole of a continuum of states of feeling

examples.en: Her natural pleasantness makes everyone feel immediately welcome in her home.
examples.zh: 她天生的亲和力让每个人在她家中立刻感到宾至如归。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 placere（使满意、使喜欢），核心语义始终围绕“让人产生愉悦感或顺从心意”展开，派生出使动动词及描述感受的形容词。
family_guide.core_distinction: pleasant 侧重指外界事物或环境“令人愉悦的、宜人的”，而同根形容词 pleased 则多用来形容人“感到高兴的、满意的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 服务, 贡献, 雇佣, 公职, 服役, 功劳, 仪式, 送达, 行政部门
lemmas.def_en: work done by one person or group that benefits another

examples.en: The mechanic will service your car thoroughly before the long road trip.
examples.zh: 在长途旅行之前，技工会彻底检修你的汽车。

lemmas.def_zh: 保养, 维修
lemmas.def_en: be used by; as of a utility

examples.en: The mechanic will service your car thoroughly before the long road trip.
examples.zh: 在长途旅行之前，技工会彻底检修你的汽车。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 servus（奴仆、服侍），核心语义由最初的“为他人提供劳役或服侍”扩展至现代的“公共服务、客户协助以及对机器的检修保养”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词侧重“提供的协助、公共事业或检修行为”；动词则专指“检修/保养（车辆、设备）”或金融领域的“偿付（债务利息）”。

lemmas.def_zh: 支援, 支撑, 帮助, 支持, 忍受, 供养, 证实
lemmas.def_en: give moral or psychological support, aid, or courage to

examples.en: Her close family gave her full support during the difficult recovery period.
examples.zh: 在艰难的康复期间，她的挚亲给予了她全力支持。

lemmas.def_zh: 支持, 支撑, 援助, 供养, 支撑物
lemmas.def_en: the activity of providing for or maintaining by supplying with money or necessities

examples.en: Her close family gave her full support during the difficult recovery period.
examples.zh: 在艰难的康复期间，她的挚亲给予了她全力支持。

lemmas.def_zh: 支持者, 后盾, 迫随者, 护身织物
lemmas.def_en: a person who backs a politician or a team etc.

examples.en: He has been an active supporter of the local football club for years.
examples.zh: 多年来，他一直是当地足球俱乐部的积极支持者。

lemmas.def_zh: 支撑, 支承, 资助, 赞助, 支援, 经受, 忍受, 扶养, 证实, 鼓励, 维持, 伴奏
lemmas.def_en: furnishing support or assistance

examples.en: My supervisor was extremely supportive when I applied for the advanced degree.
examples.zh: 当我申请进修更高学位时，我的导师非常支持我。

lemmas.def_zh: 未经证实的, 未得到支持的, 未得到赞助的, 未得到支援的, 无支撑的
lemmas.def_en: not sustained or maintained by nonmaterial aid

examples.en: His bold claims were completely unsupported by any reliable scientific evidence.
examples.zh: 他大胆的主张完全没有任何可靠的科学证据支持。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 不值得拥护的
lemmas.def_en: not furnishing support or assistance

examples.en: Working with an unsupportive team can make daily tasks much harder to finish.
examples.zh: 与不提供支持的团队共事会使日常任务更难完成。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 sub-（自下方）与 portare（承载、携带），核心逻辑为“从底部托住”，由此引申出物理上的支撑、经济上的赡养以及精神与政治上的支持、援助。
family_guide.core_distinction: supporter 指提供支持的人（拥护者/球迷）；supportive 则是形容词，强调态度上“关怀体贴的、给予鼓励与支持的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 打开, 公开, 开放；展开, 开始, 展现
lemmas.def_en: cause to open or to become open

examples.en: Please open the main window to let some fresh air inside.
examples.zh: 请打开主窗户，让一些新鲜空气进来。

lemmas.def_zh: 开着的, 开放的, 开阔的, 营业着的, 公开的, 悬而未决的
lemmas.def_en: affording unobstructed entrance and exit; not shut or closed

examples.en: Please open the main window to let some fresh air inside.
examples.zh: 请打开主窗户，让一些新鲜空气进来。

lemmas.def_zh: 没有开的, 未展开的, 未启封的
lemmas.def_en: not yet opened or unsealed

examples.en: Several unopened letters have been sitting on his desk since last week.
examples.zh: 自上周以来，几封未拆封的信件一直放在他的桌子上。

lemmas.def_zh: 公开地；坦率地；直言不讳地
lemmas.def_en: without concealment, deception, or hesitation; frankly or publicly

examples.en: They openly criticized the government's new economic policy.
examples.zh: 他们公开批评了政府的新经济政策。

lemmas.def_zh: 孔洞；空缺职位；开端；开幕式
lemmas.def_en: a hole, gap, or passage; an available job vacancy; the beginning or start of an event

examples.en: There is a promising job opening in our design department.
examples.zh: 我们设计部有一个前景不错的工作空缺。

examples.en: Hundreds of guests attended the grand opening of the museum.
examples.zh: 数百名嘉宾出席了该博物馆的盛大开幕式。

lemmas.def_zh: 开启工具（如开瓶器、开罐器）；开场白；揭幕战
lemmas.def_en: a device or tool used to open something; the first event, remark, or game in a series

examples.en: I can't seem to find the can opener in this drawer.
examples.zh: 我似乎在这个抽屉里找不到开罐器。

examples.en: The team secured a convincing victory in their season opener.
examples.zh: 该队在赛季揭幕战中取得了一场令人信服的胜利。

lemmas.def_zh: 公开；宽阔；率真
lemmas.def_en: without obstructions to passage or view

examples.en: Trust is easily built through honesty and openness in any relationship.
examples.zh: 在任何关系中，坦诚和开放都容易建立起信任。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语表示“未覆盖、不受阻挡”的词根，从空间上的“敞开”延伸至动作上的“打开”，并进一步引申出“坦率、公开、开端”等抽象概念。
family_guide.core_distinction: opening 多指“孔隙、职位空缺或开端/开幕”，而 opener 则具体指“开启用的工具（如开瓶器）”或“开场活动/揭幕战”。

lemmas.def_zh: 放, 安置, 放置, 设定, 使凝结, 点燃, 确定, 点缀, 使就位, 树立, 分配, 调整；日落, 凝固, 定型, 搁住, 结果, 适合
lemmas.def_en: put into a certain place or abstract location

examples.en: She set the alarm for six in the morning and went to bed.
examples.zh: 她把闹钟定在早上六点，然后就去睡了。

lemmas.def_zh: 日落, 同伙, 组合, 集合, 装置
lemmas.def_en: a group of things of the same kind that belong together and are so used

examples.en: She set the alarm for six in the morning and went to bed.
examples.zh: 她把闹钟定在早上六点，然后就去睡了。

lemmas.def_zh: 环境, 背景, 布景, 镶嵌, 调整, 沉落, 一副餐具
lemmas.def_en: the context and environment in which something is set

examples.en: The peaceful countryside provides an ideal setting for writing his new novel.
examples.zh: 宁静的乡村为他创作新小说提供了理想的背景。

lemmas.def_zh: 决心的, 规定的, 故意的, 持久的, 固定的, 老套的, 准备好的
lemmas.def_en: (usually followed by `to' or `for') on the point of or strongly disposed

examples.en: She set the alarm for six in the morning and went to bed.
examples.zh: 她把闹钟定在早上六点，然后就去睡了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 settan（使坐下、安放），核心逻辑为“使某物在特定位置稳定固定”，由此引申出“放置、确立标准、日落、成套聚集以及背景设定”等网状语义。
family_guide.core_distinction: set 作名词常指“成套的人或物”或“拍摄布景”，setting 偏向“抽象或自然的环境背景”及“机器的调节档位”，set 作形容词则强调“既定的、固定的”或“准备妥当的状态”。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 性交；毫厘，丝毫；v. 与……性交；搞砸，毁坏
lemmas.def_en: n. an act of sexual intercourse; the slightest bit; v. to have sex with; to ruin or damage

examples.en: I honestly don't give a fuck what they think about the decision.
examples.zh: 老实说，我一点也不在乎他们对这个决定怎么看。

examples.en: He completely fucked the engine by running it without any oil.
examples.zh: 他没加机油就开，把整个发动机给彻底搞报废了。

lemmas.def_zh: 混蛋，讨厌鬼；家伙（亦可指棘手难办的物件）
lemmas.def_en: a despicable or annoying person; a difficult or stubborn thing

examples.en: Some fucker scratched the side of my car and drove off.
examples.zh: 某个混蛋把我的车身刮了之后直接开溜了。

examples.en: This rusty old bolt is a stubborn fucker to remove.
examples.zh: 这颗生锈的老螺栓真是个顽固难拆的破玩意儿。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 性交；毫厘，丝毫；v. 与……性交；搞砸，毁坏
lemmas.def_en: n. an act of sexual intercourse; the slightest bit; v. to have sex with; to ruin or damage

examples.en: I honestly don't give a fuck what they think about the decision.
examples.zh: 老实说，我一点也不在乎他们对这个决定怎么看。

examples.en: He completely fucked the engine by running it without any oil.
examples.zh: 他没加机油就开，把整个发动机给彻底搞报废了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于日耳曼语系表示“推击、拍打”的词根，由本义“性交”逐步演化为英语中最常见、语义最多维的粗俗禁忌语，广泛用于表达强烈情绪、侮辱、损坏或极致强调。
family_guide.core_distinction: fuck 可作动词（性交/毁坏）或名词（性行为/极少的事物），用于动作或纯粹语气强调；fucker 是指人或物的名词代称，用于指称令人厌恶、棘手或特定的对象。

lemmas.def_zh: 团体, 组, 团, 群
lemmas.def_en: any number of entities (members) considered as a unit

examples.en: The teacher asked the students to group together and discuss the project.
examples.zh: 老师要求学生们聚在一起讨论这个项目。

lemmas.def_zh: 分组
lemmas.def_en: any number of entities (members) considered as a unit

examples.en: The grouping of players was determined by their current skill levels.
examples.zh: 选手的组别划分是根据他们现有的技术水平决定的。

lemmas.def_zh: 聚合, 成群
lemmas.def_en: arrange into a group or groups

examples.en: The teacher asked the students to group together and discuss the project.
examples.zh: 老师要求学生们聚在一起讨论这个项目。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自意大利语 gruppo（结、团、堆），核心隐喻为“将分散的个体捆扎、聚拢成一个整体或类别”。
family_guide.core_distinction: group 是静态且通用的“群体/组”；grouping 则强调“分组的方式、排列组合或特定划分下的小阵营/派系”。

lemmas.def_zh: 确信的，有把握的；必然的，可靠的
lemmas.def_en: confident in one's knowledge or beliefs; certain to happen or be reliable

examples.en: Please make sure that all the doors and windows are locked before you leave.
examples.zh: 离开前请务必确认所有门窗都已锁好。

examples.en: He wasn't entirely sure of the answer, so he hesitated before speaking.
examples.zh: 他对这个答案不是很有把握，所以开口前犹豫了一下。

lemmas.def_zh: 不确定的，没有把握的；缺乏自信的
lemmas.def_en: not certain or confident about something

examples.en: She was still unsure about which career path to pursue after graduation.
examples.zh: 毕业后她依然不确定该走哪条职业道路。

examples.en: His tone sounded tentative and unsure during the presentation.
examples.zh: 他在演讲时的语气听起来有些试探且缺乏自信。

lemmas.def_zh: 想必，必定；无疑，确实
lemmas.def_en: used to express belief that something is probable, obvious, or to emphasize a statement

examples.en: Surely you don't expect him to finish the entire project in just two days.
examples.zh: 你总不至于指望他在短短两天内完成整个项目吧。

examples.en: Slowly but surely, the team began to regain its competitive edge.
examples.zh: 缓慢但稳步地，这支团队开始重获竞争优势。

lemmas.def_zh: 确实, 踏实, 安全
lemmas.def_en: freedom from doubt; belief in yourself and your abilities

examples.en: He answered every difficult question with remarkable calmness and absolute sureness.
examples.zh: 他以非凡的从容和十足的把握回答了每一个难题。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 securus（se- 无 + cura 担忧，即'免于忧虑'），核心语义从'安心无虑'演变为'确信的、稳固可靠的、必然发生的'。
family_guide.core_distinction: sure 与 unsure 构成'确信'与'犹疑'的正反对应；surely 多用于口语中表达说话人强烈的主观推断（想必、难道）或陈述修饰，带有明显的情感色彩。

lemmas.def_zh: 办公室；公职，职务；办事处
lemmas.def_en: a room or building used for business or professional work; a position of authority or trust

examples.en: She was elected to public office after years of community service.
examples.zh: 在多年服务社区之后，她当选担任公职。

examples.en: The firm is planning to open a new branch office in Tokyo next year.
examples.zh: 该事务所计划明年在东京开设新的分支机构。

lemmas.def_zh: 官员，要员；公职人员
lemmas.def_en: a person who holds a position of authority in an organization or government

examples.en: Government officials met behind closed doors to negotiate the trade agreement.
examples.zh: 政府官员举行闭门会议以就贸易协定进行谈判。

examples.en: A senior health official warned that preventive measures must remain in place.
examples.zh: 一位高级卫生官员警告称，预防措施必须继续保持。

lemmas.def_zh: 官场, 官僚圈子, 公务员, 官僚主义
lemmas.def_en: people elected or appointed to administer a government

examples.en: Local officialdom often delays small business permits with endless paperwork.
examples.zh: 地方官僚层常常因无休止的文书工作而拖延小企业的许可证发放。

lemmas.def_zh: 宗教仪式的司仪
lemmas.def_en: a clergyman who officiates at a religious ceremony or service

examples.en: The wedding officiant asked the couple to exchange their vows and rings.
examples.zh: 婚礼司仪请这对新人交换誓言和戒指。

lemmas.def_zh: 正式地；官方地；依据公职身份
lemmas.def_en: in a formal, authorized, or publicly acknowledged manner

examples.en: The national park will be officially opened to the public next month.
examples.zh: 该国家公园将于下月正式向公众开放。

examples.en: Although the results are known, the winner has not been officially announced.
examples.zh: 尽管结果已知，但获胜者尚未被正式公布。

lemmas.def_zh: 非公认地；非正式地
lemmas.def_en: without official authorization

examples.en: The news was unofficially confirmed by an insider before the press release.
examples.zh: 在新闻发布会之前，一名内部人士非正式地证实了该消息。

lemmas.def_zh: 非官方的；非正式的；未经授权的
lemmas.def_en: not authorized, approved, or confirmed by an official authority

examples.en: According to unofficial estimates, the strike cost the company millions.
examples.zh: 据非官方估计，此次罢工使公司损失了数百万美元。

examples.en: They reached an unofficial agreement before drafting the legal paperwork.
examples.zh: 在起草法律文件之前，他们达成了一项非正式协议。

lemmas.def_zh: 执行, 司仪, 担任(体育比赛)裁判；主持宗教仪式, 行使职务
lemmas.def_en: act in an official capacity in a ceremony or religious ritual, such as a wedding

examples.en: A retired judge was invited to officiate at the couple's quiet wedding.
examples.zh: 一位退休法官受邀主持这对新人的低调婚礼。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 officium（职责、公务，由 opus'工作' + facere'做' 组合而成），核心语义演进为“职责/职务”以及履行职务的“办公场所”，后引申出带有公职或法定权威特征的“官方”概念。
family_guide.core_distinction: official 既指拥有法定权力的公职人员（名），也强调经正规授权的“官方性质”；与加否定前缀的 unofficial（未获授权或非正式的）形成对立。

lemmas.def_zh: 第二的, 其次的, 次要的, 附加的, 辅助的
lemmas.def_en: coming next after the first in position in space or time or degree or magnitude

examples.en: I will happily second your motion to postpone the vote until tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我非常乐意赞同你将投票推迟到明天的提议。

lemmas.def_zh: 秒, 瞬间, 第二名, 支持者, 助手
lemmas.def_en: 1/60 of a minute; the basic unit of time adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites

examples.en: I will happily second your motion to postpone the vote until tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我非常乐意赞同你将投票推迟到明天的提议。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 暂调, 调用
lemmas.def_en: a speech seconding a motion

examples.en: She spent six months on secondment to the company's regional branch.
examples.zh: 她在公司地区分部借调工作了六个月。

lemmas.def_zh: 后援者, 附议者
lemmas.def_en: someone who endorses a motion or petition as a necessary preliminary to a discussion or vote

examples.en: Every proposal needs both a proposer and a seconder before the discussion.
examples.zh: 每项提案在讨论前都需要一名提案人和一名附议人。

lemmas.def_zh: 当...助手, 支持
lemmas.def_en: give support or one's approval to

examples.en: I will happily second your motion to postpone the vote until tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我非常乐意赞同你将投票推迟到明天的提议。

lemmas.def_zh: 第二, 其次
lemmas.def_en: in the second place

examples.en: First, the price is too high, and secondly, the quality is poor.
examples.zh: 首先，价格太高；其次，质量也很差。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 sequi（跟随），核心意象为“紧随第一之后的”；后衍生为序数词“第二”、天文时间度量中的“第二次细分（秒）”，以及引申为“随从/附议支持”之意。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词与名词涵盖序数“第二”与时间单位“秒”，动词特指正式语境下的“赞同、附议”，副词 secondly 则严格用于列举观点时的“第二/其次”。

lemmas.def_zh: 家伙, 支索
lemmas.def_en: an informal term for a youth or man

examples.en: The workers had to guy the tall antenna firmly against the wind.
examples.zh: 工人们不得不用牵索将高天线牢牢固定以抵御大风。

lemmas.def_zh: 用支索撑住, 取笑, 嘲弄；逃跑
lemmas.def_en: subject to laughter or ridicule

examples.en: The workers had to guy the tall antenna firmly against the wind.
examples.zh: 工人们不得不用牵索将高天线牢牢固定以抵御大风。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自英国历史人物盖伊·福克斯（Guy Fawkes），原指节日焚烧的滑稽假人，后引申为泛指‘人/家伙’；动词由假人形象派生出‘戏弄、嘲笑’之意，另有一同形异义词源指工程上的‘牵索/拉绳’。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词常用于口语中泛指‘家伙’或复数称呼‘大家’；动词主要用于书面语中表示‘讽刺、嘲弄’，两者语体差异明显。

lemmas.def_zh: 遇见, 引见, 认识, 满足, 对付；相遇, 接触
lemmas.def_en: come together

examples.en: Hundreds of athletes will gather next week for the national track meet.
examples.zh: 数百名运动员将于下周齐聚一堂，参加全国田径运动会。

lemmas.def_zh: 相遇；满足（meet 的过去式和过去分词）
lemmas.def_en: past tense and past participle of meet

examples.en: All environmental standards were fully met before the factory opened.
examples.zh: 工厂开业前，所有环保标准均已完全达标。

lemmas.def_zh: 会, 集会
lemmas.def_en: a meeting at which a number of athletic contests are held

examples.en: Hundreds of athletes will gather next week for the national track meet.
examples.zh: 数百名运动员将于下周齐聚一堂，参加全国田径运动会。

lemmas.def_zh: 会议；会面；集会
lemmas.def_en: an occasion when people come together to discuss things or make decisions

examples.en: The board held an emergency meeting to discuss the merger proposal.
examples.zh: 董事会召开紧急会议，讨论合并提案。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古英语 mētan，核心意向为“两方朝向彼此移动并在某一点交汇”，由“物理上的相遇”引申至“聚集开会”以及“与标准/需求相符（满足）”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 作名词时，meet 专指有组织的体育竞赛或运动会（如 track meet）；meeting 则指人与人聚集讨论事务的“会议”或泛指“会面”。

lemmas.def_zh: 坏的，差的；严重的，糟糕的；坏事，不利的一面；（口语）过失
lemmas.def_en: of poor quality, unpleasant, or severe; that which is bad, harmful, or unfortunate

examples.en: The bad weather forced the organizers to cancel the outdoor concert.
examples.zh: 恶劣的天气迫使主办方取消了户外音乐会。

examples.en: In any long-term investment, you have to learn to take the bad with the good.
examples.zh: 在任何长期投资中，你都必须学会好坏坦然承受。

examples.en: Sorry I stepped on your foot, my bad!
examples.zh: 抱歉踩到你的脚了，是我的错！

lemmas.def_zh: 严重的；严厉的；严峻的；剧烈的
lemmas.def_en: very bad, serious, or unpleasant; strict or harsh in attitude or manner

examples.en: The region is suffering from a severe shortage of drinking water.
examples.zh: 该地区正面临着严重的饮用水短缺问题。

examples.en: He faced severe criticism for his handling of the financial crisis.
examples.zh: 他因对此次金融危机的处理方式而遭到了严厉批评。

lemmas.def_zh: 坏的，差的；严重的，糟糕的；坏事，不利的一面；（口语）过失
lemmas.def_en: of poor quality, unpleasant, or severe; that which is bad, harmful, or unfortunate

examples.en: The bad weather forced the organizers to cancel the outdoor concert.
examples.zh: 恶劣的天气迫使主办方取消了户外音乐会。

examples.en: In any long-term investment, you have to learn to take the bad with the good.
examples.zh: 在任何长期投资中，你都必须学会好坏坦然承受。

examples.en: Sorry I stepped on your foot, my bad!
examples.zh: 抱歉踩到你的脚了，是我的错！

lemmas.def_zh: 严重性；严厉；严峻程度
lemmas.def_en: the fact or condition of being severe; seriousness or harshness

examples.en: Doctors were deeply concerned about the severity of her symptoms.
examples.zh: 医生们对她症状的严重程度深感担忧。

examples.en: The severity of the winter weather brought transport to a complete standstill.
examples.zh: 严酷的冬季天气导致交通彻底陷入瘫痪。

lemmas.def_zh: 坏, 恶, 不良
lemmas.def_en: that which is below standard or expectations as of ethics or decency

examples.en: He failed to grasp the sheer badness of his careless actions.
examples.zh: 他未能意识到自己鲁莽行为的严重危害性。

lemmas.def_zh: 严重地；严厉地；极其
lemmas.def_en: very seriously or to a great degree; in a harsh or strict manner

examples.en: The historic building was severely damaged during the earthquake.
examples.zh: 这座历史建筑在地震中遭受了严重损毁。

examples.en: Anyone found breaking the rules will be severely punished.
examples.zh: 任何被发现违反规则的人都将受到严厉惩罚。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中古英语 badde，最初含'劣质、软弱、无用'之意，后全面取代古英语 yfel (evil) 的一般世俗含义，成为涵盖所有'不良、恶劣、有害'的核心词，并引申出名词指代'坏事、坏的方面'。

lemmas.def_zh: 再一次，又；回到原状；此外
lemmas.def_en: one more time; once more; returning to a previous position or state

examples.en: Could you please say that again? I didn't quite catch it.
examples.zh: 你能再说一遍吗？我刚才没太听清。

examples.en: After resting for a few days, he felt strong and healthy again.
examples.zh: 休息几天后，他感觉自己又恢复了强健与活力。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 ongegn（相对、朝向对面），核心意象为“折返、回退”，由此引申出“回到原处/原状”及“再一次、又”等含义。

lemmas.def_zh: 紧接着的；下一次的；紧邻的
lemmas.def_en: coming immediately after in time, order, or space

examples.en: We can discuss the details of the project at our next meeting.
examples.zh: 我们可以在下次会议上讨论该项目的细节。

examples.en: The couple bought the house next to their daughter's school.
examples.zh: 这对夫妇买下了紧邻他们女儿学校的那所房子。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古英语形容词 near 的最高级形式（即 nearest），核心逻辑是‘距离最近的’，后引申指在时间、空间或次序上紧挨着、接下去的。

lemmas.def_zh: 建造，构筑；建立，逐渐发展；体形，体格
lemmas.def_en: to construct something by putting parts together; to gradually establish; the proportions of a person's body

examples.en: It takes years to build a reputation of integrity and trust.
examples.zh: 建立起正直与信任的声誉需要数年时间。

examples.en: He had the solid, muscular build of a rugby player.
examples.zh: 他拥有橄榄球运动员那样结实健壮的体格。

lemmas.def_zh: 建造（build 的过去式与过去分词）；健格结实的，健壮的
lemmas.def_en: past tense and past participle of build; (informal) having a muscular, well-developed body

examples.en: The bridge was built in the early nineteenth century.
examples.zh: 这座桥建于十九世纪初。

examples.en: The actor hit the gym every day to get built for his superhero role.
examples.zh: 这位演员每天去健身房锻炼，以便为超级英雄角色练出一身健硕肌肉。

lemmas.def_zh: 建造，构筑；建立，逐渐发展；体形，体格
lemmas.def_en: to construct something by putting parts together; to gradually establish; the proportions of a person's body

examples.en: It takes years to build a reputation of integrity and trust.
examples.zh: 建立起正直与信任的声誉需要数年时间。

examples.en: He had the solid, muscular build of a rugby player.
examples.zh: 他拥有橄榄球运动员那样结实健壮的体格。

lemmas.def_zh: 建筑物，楼房；建造，建筑（过程）
lemmas.def_en: a structure with walls and a roof, such as a house or factory; the activity of constructing something

examples.en: The new office building meets the highest environmental standards.
examples.zh: 新办公楼达到了最高的环保标准。

lemmas.def_zh: 建筑工人；建筑商，营造商
lemmas.def_en: a person or company whose job is to build or repair houses and other structures

examples.en: They hired a reputable builder to handle the house extension.
examples.zh: 他们聘请了一位信誉良好的建筑承包商来扩建房屋。

lemmas.def_zh: 建造（build 的过去式与过去分词）；健格结实的，健壮的
lemmas.def_en: past tense and past participle of build; (informal) having a muscular, well-developed body

examples.en: The bridge was built in the early nineteenth century.
examples.zh: 这座桥建于十九世纪初。

examples.en: The actor hit the gym every day to get built for his superhero role.
examples.zh: 这位演员每天去健身房锻炼，以便为超级英雄角色练出一身健硕肌肉。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 byldan（建屋、构造），核心动作是由零开始层层组合、构筑，后延伸至抽象事物的创立发展以及人体的骨架体格。
family_guide.core_distinction: build 既指建造动作也可指人的“体格”，building 指具体“建筑物”，builder 指“建筑商/建造者”，而形容词 built 常用来形容人“体格健壮”。

lemmas.def_zh: 关心，在乎；照料，关怀；小心
lemmas.def_en: to feel concern or interest; the provision of what is necessary for protection or welfare; serious attention

examples.en: She cares deeply about environmental issues and volunteers regularly.
examples.zh: 她非常关心环境问题，并定期参与志愿服务。

examples.en: Handle these fragile antique vases with great care.
examples.zh: 搬运这些易碎的古董花瓶时要格外小心。

lemmas.def_zh: 关心，在乎；照料，关怀；小心
lemmas.def_en: to feel concern or interest; the provision of what is necessary for protection or welfare; serious attention

examples.en: She cares deeply about environmental issues and volunteers regularly.
examples.zh: 她非常关心环境问题，并定期参与志愿服务。

examples.en: Handle these fragile antique vases with great care.
examples.zh: 搬运这些易碎的古董花瓶时要格外小心。

lemmas.def_zh: 粗心大意
lemmas.def_en: the quality of not being careful or taking pains

examples.en: A single moment of carelessness caused the sensitive data to leak online.
examples.zh: 一时的粗心大意导致敏感数据在网上泄露。

lemmas.def_zh: 小心, 仔细, 慎重
lemmas.def_en: the trait of being cautious; being attentive to possible danger

examples.en: The chemist measured the potent mixture with extreme carefulness and patience.
examples.zh: 化学家极其细致耐心地测量了这种强效混合物。

lemmas.def_zh: 小心的，谨慎的；仔细的
lemmas.def_en: making sure of avoiding potential danger, mishap, or error; thorough

examples.en: Be careful not to spill hot coffee on your laptop.
examples.zh: 小心别把热咖啡洒在笔记本电脑上。

examples.en: After careful consideration, the committee approved the proposal.
examples.zh: 经过仔细考虑，委员会批准了该提案。

lemmas.def_zh: 粗心的，马虎的；轻率的
lemmas.def_en: not giving sufficient attention or thought to avoiding harm or errors

examples.en: A careless mistake in the spreadsheet cost the company thousands of dollars.
examples.zh: 电子表格中的一个粗心错误让公司损失了数千美元。

examples.en: It was careless of him to leave his front door unlocked.
examples.zh: 他没锁前门真是太疏忽大意了。

lemmas.def_zh: 心不在焉的, 不注意的
lemmas.def_en: lacking affection or warm feeling

examples.en: The politician was criticized for showing an uncaring attitude toward struggling families.
examples.zh: 这位政客因对困难家庭表现出漠不关心的态度而受到批评。

lemmas.def_zh: 仔细地，认真地；小心翼翼地
lemmas.def_en: in a way that involves great attention and effort to avoid problems or danger

examples.en: Please read the contract carefully before signing it.
examples.zh: 签字前请仔细阅读合同。

examples.en: He walked carefully across the slippery icy pavement.
examples.zh: 他小心翼翼地走过结冰湿滑的人行道。

lemmas.def_zh: 不注意地, 粗心地
lemmas.def_en: without care or concern

examples.en: He carelessly tossed his car keys onto the crowded kitchen counter.
examples.zh: 他漫不经心地把车钥匙扔在堆满杂物的厨房台面上。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，核心意象为'挂念、操心'，由此引申出倾注精力的'照料、在乎'以及防止出错的'小心、谨慎'。
family_guide.core_distinction: careful 与 careless 是一对反义派生词，分别借助后缀 -ful 与 -less 表示'细心谨慎的'与'粗心大意的'。

lemmas.def_zh: 没有；缺乏；在没有……的情况下
lemmas.def_en: in the absence of; not accompanied by or having

examples.en: He walked out of the meeting without saying a single word.
examples.zh: 他一句话也没说就走出了会议室。

examples.en: You cannot achieve true mastery without persistent practice.
examples.zh: 没有持之以恒的练习，你不可能达到真正的精通。

family_guide.root_logic: 由古英语介词 with（原本表示'对着、靠着'）与 out（在外部）复合而成，字面本义为'在……之外'，后引申为'缺乏、没有……伴随'。

lemmas.def_zh: 每个；各自的
lemmas.def_en: every one of two or more people or things, considered separately

examples.en: Each student received a certificate at the end of the course.
examples.zh: 课程结束时，每位学生都获得了一张证书。

examples.en: We spent three days in the city, and each day brought a new surprise.
examples.zh: 我们在城里待了三天，每一天都带来了新的惊喜。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语复合词，本义为“各自相同”，核心语义演化为将群体中的每一个成员视作独立个体逐一考量（侧重个体性与逐一性）。

lemmas.def_zh: 保存, 握住, 拿住, 占据, 持有, 拥有；支持, 持续, 有效
lemmas.def_en: keep in a certain state, position, or activity; e.g.,

examples.en: She managed to hold the heavy door open for the elderly couple.
examples.zh: 她设法为那对老夫妇撑住了沉重的门。

lemmas.def_zh: 握住；举行；持有（hold 的过去式和过去分词）
lemmas.def_en: past tense and past participle of 'hold'

examples.en: He held his breath in anticipation as the envelope was opened.
examples.zh: 信封打开时，他屏住呼吸满怀期待。

lemmas.def_zh: 把握, 把持力, 柄, 控制, 掌握, 监禁；保留
lemmas.def_en: the act of grasping

examples.en: She managed to hold the heavy door open for the elderly couple.
examples.zh: 她设法为那对老夫妇撑住了沉重的门。

lemmas.def_zh: 持有的财产，股份（常用复数 holdings）；持有，拥有
lemmas.def_en: land, shares, or other property owned by a person or company

examples.en: The investment group sold part of its extensive holdings in renewable energy.
examples.zh: 该投资集团出售了其在可再生能源领域的部分大额持股。

lemmas.def_zh: 持有者，持有人；支架，托架
lemmas.def_en: a person who holds a particular status, document, or position; a device for keeping something in place

examples.en: Passports must be signed by the rightful holder upon receipt.
examples.zh: 护照收到后必须由合法持有人亲笔签名。

examples.en: He placed his mobile phone into the car dashboard holder.
examples.zh: 他把手机放进了车载仪表盘支架里。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 healdan（照料、守护、握住），核心语义演进逻辑由身体层面的“用手抓紧、握住”引申至抽象层面的“容纳、支撑、持有某种状态/观点/资产”以及“召开集会”。
family_guide.core_distinction: hold 作名词强调动作本身（抓握力、掌控、货舱）；holding 多作复数指持有的资产/股权；holder 则指代持有者（人）或专用支架/容器（物）。

lemmas.def_zh: 运气, 签, 抽签, 份额, 许多, 一堆
lemmas.def_en: (often followed by `of') a large number or amount or extent

examples.en: They parked their car in the empty lot behind the supermarket.
examples.zh: 他们把车停在超市后面的空地上。

lemmas.def_zh: 划分；抽签, 抓阄
lemmas.def_en: divide into lots, as of land, for example

examples.en: They parked their car in the empty lot behind the supermarket.
examples.zh: 他们把车停在超市后面的空地上。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语中用于抽签决定的筹码，核心概念为“分配的份额”，由此引申出“签与命运”、“划分的一块土地/一批物品”，并在现代口语中演化出“大量（一整份）”的含义。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词涵盖“大量、地块、一批、命运”等多重核心引申义；动词指“按批划分”或“分派”，现代英语中多以加前缀的 allot 更为常见。

lemmas.def_zh: 系统；体系；制度；体制
lemmas.def_en: an organized set of connected things or parts working together; a set of principles or procedures

examples.en: The hospital introduced a computerised system to streamline patient records.
examples.zh: 该医院引入了一套计算机系统来简化病历管理。

examples.en: Reforming the current tax system has become a top priority for policymakers.
examples.zh: 改革现行税收制度已成为政策制定者的当务之急。

lemmas.def_en: characterized by order and planning
lemmas.def_zh: 有系统的, 分类上的, 体系的

examples.en: She conducted a systematic review of all recent research on climate change.
examples.zh: 她对近期所有关于气候变化的研究进行了系统性审查。

lemmas.def_en: lacking systematic arrangement or method or organization
lemmas.def_zh: 无体系的, 无系统的, 无组织的

examples.en: His unsystematic approach to organizing files made finding important documents nearly impossible.
examples.zh: 他毫无章法的文件整理方式让寻找重要文件变得几乎不可能。

lemmas.def_en: in a systematic or consistent manner
lemmas.def_zh: 有系统地, 有组织地, 有条理地

examples.en: The technician systematically checked every component to identify the cause of failure.
examples.zh: 技术人员系统地检查了每个组件，以查明故障原因。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 systema，由 syn-（共同、一起）与 histanai（放置、立起）结合而成，核心逻辑是“将多个部分组合在一起形成协同运作的有序整体”。

lemmas.def_zh: 反对；逆着；倚靠；紧贴；以……为背景（衬托）
