lemmas.def_en: in opposition to; in physical contact or collision with; in contrast to

examples.en: The majority of the committee voted against the proposed tax increase.
examples.zh: 委员会的大多数人投票反对提议的加税方案。

examples.en: He leaned his bicycle against the garden fence and walked inside.
examples.zh: 他把自行车靠在花园篱笆上，然后走了进去。

examples.en: The white sail stood out sharply against the dark evening sky.
examples.zh: 白色的船帆在昏暗的夜空衬托下显得格外醒目。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 on gegn（相对、面对），核心空间意象是“正对/顶着”，由此引申出物理上的“紧贴/倚靠”、立场上的“反对/逆着”以及视觉认知上的“以……为对照或衬托”。

lemmas.def_zh: 必须，应当；必定，想必
lemmas.def_en: to be obliged or required to; to be logically necessary or inferred to be

examples.en: All passengers must wear seat belts during takeoff and landing.
examples.zh: 起飞和降落期间，所有乘客必须系好安全带。

examples.en: You have been driving for ten hours; you must be exhausted.
examples.zh: 你已经连续开了十个小时的车，一定累坏了。

lemmas.def_zh: 发霉的, 霉臭的, 落伍的
lemmas.def_en: covered with or smelling of mold

examples.en: The abandoned attic was filled with old furniture and a distinct musty smell.
examples.zh: 废弃的阁楼里堆满了旧家具，弥漫着一股明显的霉味。

lemmas.def_zh: 霉臭, 陈腐, 无力气
lemmas.def_en: the quality of smelling or tasting old or stale or mouldy

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语表示“能够、有余地”的动词过去式，经历史演变固定为表示道义责任、强制必要性（必须）以及强逻辑推论（必定）的情态动词。

lemmas.def_zh: 权力；力量；电力；驱动，提供动力
lemmas.def_en: the ability or capacity to act or control; electrical energy; to supply with energy or force

examples.en: Knowledge gives people the power to make informed decisions.
examples.zh: 知识赋予了人们做出明智决定的力量。

examples.en: The backup generator powers the hospital during blackouts.
examples.zh: 停电期间，备用发电机为医院提供电力。

lemmas.def_zh: 无力, 无能为力
lemmas.def_en: the quality of lacking strength or power; being weak and feeble

examples.en: A deep sense of powerlessness overwhelmed him during the crisis.
examples.zh: 危机期间，一种强烈的无力感压倒了他。

lemmas.def_zh: 有力;强烈
lemmas.def_en: possession of controlling influence

examples.en: The sheer powerfulness of the engine impressed all the race judges.
examples.zh: 发动机强大的动力给所有比赛评委留下了深刻印象。

lemmas.def_zh: 权力；力量；电力；驱动，提供动力
lemmas.def_en: the ability or capacity to act or control; electrical energy; to supply with energy or force

examples.en: Knowledge gives people the power to make informed decisions.
examples.zh: 知识赋予了人们做出明智决定的力量。

examples.en: The backup generator powers the hospital during blackouts.
examples.zh: 停电期间，备用发电机为医院提供电力。

lemmas.def_zh: 强有力的；有权势的；有说服力的
lemmas.def_en: having great strength, authority, force, or influence

examples.en: She delivered a powerful speech that moved the entire audience.
examples.zh: 她发表了一场极具感染力的演讲，打动了在场的所有听众。

lemmas.def_zh: 无力的, 无权的, 无效能的
lemmas.def_en: lacking power

examples.en: Citizens felt powerless to stop the construction of the highway.
examples.zh: 市民们感到无力阻止这条高速公路的修建。

lemmas.def_zh: 无动力的
lemmas.def_en: not having or using power

examples.en: The pilot safely landed the unpowered glider in an open field.
examples.zh: 飞行员将无动力滑翔机安全降落在一片开阔地上。

lemmas.def_zh: 强有力, 强大, 效力大, 有权威, 权力大, 有影响, 很多, 相当, 非常
lemmas.def_en: in a powerful manner

examples.en: Her emotional speech powerfully influenced the final decision of the board.
examples.zh: 她动情的演讲有力地影响了董事会的最终决定。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 potere（能够），核心内涵是“拥有做某事的能力”，由此引申出“掌控权、力量”，并在工业时代延伸为物理层面的“动力、电力”。
family_guide.core_distinction: power 兼有名词（权力/电力）与动词（驱动/供电）属性；powerful 是其形容词，强调具备巨大的力量、权势或深远的影响力。

lemmas.def_zh: 城市；都市；全城居民
lemmas.def_en: a large town that is usually a center of population, commerce, and culture

examples.en: Living in a big city offers abundant job opportunities, but the cost of living is often high.
examples.zh: 生活在大城市提供了丰富的工作机会，但生活成本通常很高。

examples.en: The city council recently launched a project to improve public transportation.
examples.zh: 市议会最近启动了一个改善公共交通的项目。

examples.en: The citied regions of the country attract millions of young job seekers.
examples.zh: 该国的城市化地区吸引了数百万年轻的求职者。

lemmas.def_zh: 使都市化
lemmas.def_en: accustom to urban ways

examples.en: Rapid development began to citify the quiet rural town within years.
examples.zh: 快速的发展在数年内使这个宁静的乡村小镇都市化了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 civitas（公民共同体、城邦），演变指具有一定人口规模、行政地位和经济文化中心功能的大型城镇与社区。

lemmas.def_zh: 报告, 汇报, 转述, 报道, 揭发, 使报到；报告, 写报道, 报到
lemmas.def_en: to give an account or representation of in words

examples.en: Employees must report any safety hazards to the manager immediately.
examples.zh: 员工必须立即向经理报告任何安全隐患。

lemmas.def_zh: 报告, 报道, 传说, 案情报告, 爆炸声, 成绩单
lemmas.def_en: a written document describing the findings of some individual or group

examples.en: Employees must report any safety hazards to the manager immediately.
examples.zh: 员工必须立即向经理报告任何安全隐患。

lemmas.def_zh: 记者, 报告者
lemmas.def_en: a person who investigates and reports or edits news stories

examples.en: The young reporter asked tough questions during the morning press conference.
examples.zh: 这位年轻记者在早间新闻发布会上提出了尖锐的问题。

lemmas.def_zh: 新闻报道, 报告文学
lemmas.def_en: the news as presented by reporters for newspapers or radio or television

examples.en: His brilliant reportage captured the harsh reality of living in war zones.
examples.zh: 他出色的新闻报道捕捉到了生活在战区的残酷现实。

lemmas.def_zh: 根据传说, 根据传闻, 据报道
lemmas.def_en: according to reports or other information

examples.en: The famous tech company is reportedly planning to launch a new smartphone.
examples.zh: 据报道，这家著名科技公司正计划推出一款新智能手机。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 未告发的, 未揭发的, 未引起的
lemmas.def_en: not reported

examples.en: Many minor crimes remain unreported to the police in big cities.
examples.zh: 在大城市，许多轻微犯罪仍然没有向警方报案。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语前缀 re-（回/向后）+ portare（携带），字面义为“带回（信息）”，演变为传递信息、汇报工作或公开报道。
family_guide.core_distinction: reporter 指从事采访和报道的“记者”；副词 reportedly 专用于转述未完全证实的消息源，意为“据报道/据说”。

lemmas.def_zh: 张帖, 邮递, 公布, 登入帐, 使熟悉, 布置；快速行进
lemmas.def_en: affix in a public place or for public notice

examples.en: Please post this urgent notice on the community bulletin board today.
examples.zh: 请今天把这份紧急通知张贴在社区公告栏上。

lemmas.def_zh: 柱, 杆, 准星, 邮件, 邮政, 标竿, 职位, 岗位, 哨所, 兵营
lemmas.def_en: the position where someone (as a guard or sentry) stands or is assigned to stand

examples.en: Please post this urgent notice on the community bulletin board today.
examples.zh: 请今天把这份紧急通知张贴在社区公告栏上。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 记入, 记录, 稿件, 邮件
lemmas.def_en: a sign posted in a public place as an advertisement

examples.en: Her latest online posting attracted hundreds of comments from curious readers.
examples.zh: 她最新的网络发帖吸引了数百名好奇读者的评论。

lemmas.def_zh: 海报, 招贴, 驿马
lemmas.def_en: a sign posted in a public place as an advertisement

examples.en: They hung a colorful concert poster on the bedroom wall yesterday.
examples.zh: 他们昨天在卧室墙上挂了一张色彩鲜艳的音乐会海报。

lemmas.def_zh: 邮资
lemmas.def_en: the charge for mailing something

examples.en: You need to pay extra postage to send this heavy package abroad.
examples.zh: 把这个沉重的包裹寄往国外需要支付额外邮资。

lemmas.def_zh: 邮政的, 邮局的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the system for delivering mail

examples.en: The strike severely delayed the delivery of all standard postal services.
examples.zh: 罢工严重延误了所有标准邮政服务的投递。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ponere（放置、安放），由固定的“木桩/立柱”引申为固定位置的“驿站/岗位”，进而演化出现代的“邮递”、“张贴/网络发帖”以及“任命外派”等核心含义。
family_guide.core_distinction: posting 侧重网上发布的帖子或职位外派，poster 指纸质宣传海报（亦可指发帖人），postage 专指邮费，postal 则作形容词修饰邮政系统。

lemmas.def_zh: 忙碌的, 热闹的, 没空的
lemmas.def_en: actively or fully engaged or occupied

examples.en: The restaurant staff was extremely busy preparing food for the dinner rush.
examples.zh: 餐厅员工忙着为晚餐高峰期准备食物。

lemmas.def_zh: 生意, 事情, 业务, 商业, 商行, 职责
lemmas.def_en: a commercial or industrial enterprise and the people who constitute it

examples.en: They decided to start an online retail business together after graduating from college.
examples.zh: 大学毕业后，他们决定一起创办一家线上零售公司。

lemmas.def_zh: 繁忙, 忙碌
lemmas.def_en: the state of being or appearing to be actively engaged in an activity

examples.en: The constant busyness of modern life often leaves little time for self reflection.
examples.zh: 现代生活的持续忙碌往往让人很少有时间进行自我反省。

lemmas.def_zh: 忙碌地
lemmas.def_en: in a busy manner

examples.en: The chefs were busily preparing meals for the evening rush in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 厨师们正在厨房里忙着为晚间客流高峰准备餐食。

lemmas.def_zh: 使忙；忙碌
lemmas.def_en: keep busy with

examples.en: She busied herself with rearranging the bookshelves to pass the quiet afternoon.
examples.zh: 她忙着重新整理书架，以此度过安静的下午。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 bisig（忙碌的、专心致志的），核心语义为“处于充满活动、专注或运转的状态”，由此衍生出表示日常事务与商业贸易的名词。
family_guide.core_distinction: busy 作动词时多用于反身搭配 busy oneself with（使自己忙于某事），而 business 则从原始的“忙碌状态”引申固化为“商业活动”与“个人事务/职责”。

lemmas.def_zh: 情形, 情况, 箱, 容器, 事实, 病例, 案例, 框子
lemmas.def_en: an occurrence of something

examples.en: The police solved the mysterious theft case within forty-eight hours of investigation.
examples.zh: 警方经过四十八小时的调查，破获了这起离奇的盗窃案。

lemmas.def_zh: 箱, 盒, 包装, 框, 套管
lemmas.def_en: the housing or outer covering of something

examples.en: The protective outer casing of the smartphone cracked when it hit the floor.
examples.zh: 智能手机的外保护壳掉在地上时摔裂了。

lemmas.def_zh: 窗, 玻璃窗
lemmas.def_en: a window sash that is hinged (usually on one side)

examples.en: He pushed open the tall casement to let fresh morning air into the room.
examples.zh: 他推开高大的平开窗，让清晨的新鲜空气进入房间。

lemmas.def_zh: 装箱, 包盖
lemmas.def_en: look over, usually with the intention to rob

examples.en: The police solved the mysterious theft case within forty-eight hours of investigation.
examples.zh: 警方经过四十八小时的调查，破获了这起离奇的盗窃案。

lemmas.def_zh: 除去套子, (从箱子中)取出, 泄露
lemmas.def_en: get undressed

examples.en: The musician carefully uncases his vintage violin before beginning the evening rehearsal.
examples.zh: 乐手在开始晚间排练前，小心翼翼地从盒中取出他的老式小提琴。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于拉丁语，主要融合了两大语义源流：一是表“降临、发生”（演变为情况、案例、案件），二是表“盒子、容器”（演变为外壳、套子及相关动作）。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词 case 范围极广，涵盖抽象的情况/案件与具体的箱盒；casing 专指机器、结构或食物的外壳与套层；动词 case 常用于俚语指犯罪前的“踩点侦察”，亦可指装箱包装。

lemmas.def_zh: 发生；碰巧，恰好
lemmas.def_en: to take place or occur, often by chance or without being planned

examples.en: I happened to see James at the supermarket yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天碰巧在超市见到了詹姆斯。

examples.en: No one knows exactly what happened on the night of the fire.
examples.zh: 没有人确切知道火灾当晚究竟发生了什么。

lemmas.def_zh: 事件，发生的事情；（不寻常的）偶发事件
lemmas.def_en: an event or occurrence, especially one that is unusual, remarkable, or spontaneous

examples.en: There have been strange happenings in the old house recently.
examples.zh: 最近那座老房子里发生了一些诡异的事情。

examples.en: Keep me informed of the latest happenings at the office while I'm away.
examples.zh: 我不在的时候，办公室有最新动向随时告诉我。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中古英语名词 hap（运气、偶然），核心语义演变路径为‘凭运气降临’到‘偶然出现’，最终泛化为现代英语中通用的‘发生’。
family_guide.core_distinction: happen 是动作本身（发生/碰巧）；happening 是其名词化形式，多指引人注目的事件、怪事或前卫的即兴艺术活动。

lemmas.def_zh: 丢失，遗失；输掉，失败；失去，丧失
lemmas.def_en: be deprived of or cease to retain; fail to win a game or contest

examples.en: She was careful not to lose her passport while traveling abroad.
examples.zh: 她在国外旅行时格外小心，以免弄丢护照。

examples.en: The team fought hard until the final whistle, refusing to lose hope.
examples.zh: 球队奋战至终场哨响，始终不肯放弃希望。

lemmas.def_zh: 迷路的，迷失的；丢失的；(与the连用作名词) 迷失者，丧失之物
lemmas.def_en: unable to find one's way or no longer possessed; (as noun) those who are lost or ruined

examples.en: A kind stranger helped the lost tourists find their way back to the hotel.
examples.zh: 一位好心的陌生人帮助迷路的游客找到了回酒店的路。

examples.en: The outreach program offers guidance and shelter to the lost and forgotten.
examples.zh: 该外展援助项目为那些迷途受难与被遗忘的人群提供指引和庇护。

lemmas.def_zh: 失败者，输家；处于劣势者
lemmas.def_en: a person who is defeated in a competition or is generally unsuccessful

examples.en: A good sportsman knows how to be a gracious loser.
examples.zh: 具备良好体育精神的人懂得做一个有风度的输家。

lemmas.def_zh: 迷路的，迷失的；丢失的；(与the连用作名词) 迷失者，丧失之物
lemmas.def_en: unable to find one's way or no longer possessed; (as noun) those who are lost or ruined

examples.en: A kind stranger helped the lost tourists find their way back to the hotel.
examples.zh: 一位好心的陌生人帮助迷路的游客找到了回酒店的路。

examples.en: The outreach program offers guidance and shelter to the lost and forgotten.
examples.zh: 该外展援助项目为那些迷途受难与被遗忘的人群提供指引和庇护。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 losian（迷失、毁灭、丢失），核心义围绕“脱离掌控或原有状态”，引申出“失去”、“输掉”及“迷路”等语义。
family_guide.core_distinction: lose 为动作动词；lost 主要作形容词表示“迷失的/丢失的”，亦可与 the 连用作集合名词指“迷途者”；loser 专指竞赛或生活中的“失败者/输家”；表示一般抽象“损失”的名词通常为 loss。

lemmas.def_zh: 发展；开发；逐渐形成；患（病）
lemmas.def_en: to grow, mature, or produce something over time; to begin to have a skill, quality, or illness

examples.en: The tech firm is working to develop a more efficient battery for electric vehicles.
examples.zh: 这家科技公司正致力于为电动汽车研发更高效的电池。

examples.en: He developed a sudden fever and had to cancel his presentation.
examples.zh: 他突然发烧，不得不取消了演讲。

lemmas.def_zh: 发展；开发；研制；新情况
lemmas.def_en: the process of developing or being developed; a recent event or change that affects a situation

examples.en: Adequate sleep and nutrition are vital for a child's healthy physical development.
examples.zh: 充足的睡眠和营养对儿童健康的身体发育至关重要。

examples.en: The police announced significant developments in the ongoing criminal investigation.
examples.zh: 警方宣布正在进行的刑事调查有了重大进展。

lemmas.def_zh: 开发者（尤指软件研发人员）；房地产开发商
lemmas.def_en: a person or company that designs software or builds properties on land

examples.en: She works as a front-end developer for an e-commerce platform.
examples.zh: 她在一个电子商务平台担任前端开发工程师。

examples.en: Property developers are planning to turn the old industrial site into luxury apartments.
examples.zh: 房地产开发商计划将这片旧工业区改造成豪华公寓。

lemmas.def_zh: 发展的；生长发育的；成长阶段的
lemmas.def_en: relating to the process of growing, developing, or maturing

examples.en: Speech delay can be an early sign of a developmental disorder in young children.
examples.zh: 语言迟缓可能是幼儿发育障碍的早期迹象。

examples.en: The prototype is still in its early developmental stages and requires further testing.
examples.zh: 该原型仍处于早期研发阶段，需要进一步测试。

lemmas.def_zh: 未充分发育的, 未开发的
lemmas.def_en: not developed

examples.en: Large areas of undeveloped land on the outskirts were recently sold to investors.
examples.zh: 郊区大片未开发的土地最近被卖给了投资者。

lemmas.def_zh: [医]adv.发育地
lemmas.def_en: with respect to development

examples.en: The pediatrician confirmed that the young child was developmentally on track for his age.
examples.zh: 儿科医生确认这名幼儿的发育情况完全符合其年龄标准。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 desveloper（des- '解开' + veloper '包裹'），本义为‘解开包裹、展现出来’，引申出使潜在事物显露并逐渐成熟、壮大的‘发展、开发、成长’之义。
family_guide.core_distinction: development 侧重过程、结果或新事态；developer 指从事开发的人或实体（如软件工程师、开发商）；developmental 则是学术或专业形容词，专指与生长发育或特定发展阶段相关的。

lemmas.def_zh: 以...作基础
lemmas.def_en: use as a basis for; found on

examples.en: She decided to base her new historical novel on true wartime events.
examples.zh: 她决定将自己的新历史小说建立在真实的战时事件之上。

lemmas.def_zh: 底部, 垒, 基础, 基地
lemmas.def_en: installation from which a military force initiates operations

examples.en: She decided to base her new historical novel on true wartime events.
examples.zh: 她决定将自己的新历史小说建立在真实的战时事件之上。

lemmas.def_zh: 地下室, 墙脚
lemmas.def_en: the lowermost portion of a structure partly or wholly below ground level; often used for storage

examples.en: We store all our old family photo albums and winter clothes in the basement.
examples.zh: 我们把所有的旧家庭相册和冬装都存放在地下室里。

lemmas.def_zh: 卑鄙, 下贱
lemmas.def_en: unworthiness by virtue of lacking higher values

examples.en: His complete baseness was revealed when he betrayed his closest friend for money.
examples.zh: 当他为了钱出卖最好的朋友时，他彻底暴露了其卑劣本性。

lemmas.def_zh: 卑鄙的, 低劣的
lemmas.def_en: serving as or forming a base

examples.en: She decided to base her new historical novel on true wartime events.
examples.zh: 她决定将自己的新历史小说建立在真实的战时事件之上。

lemmas.def_zh: 基础的, 基本的
lemmas.def_en: especially of leaves; located at the base of a plant or stem; especially arising directly from the root or rootstock or a root-like stem

examples.en: Regular exercise can help boost your basal metabolic rate and burn more calories.
examples.zh: 经常锻炼有助于提高你的基础代谢率并消耗更多热量。

lemmas.def_zh: 无根据的
lemmas.def_en: without a basis in reason or fact

examples.en: The company firmly denied the baseless rumors circulating on various social media platforms.
examples.zh: 该公司坚决否认在各个社交媒体平台上流传的毫无根据的谣言。

lemmas.def_zh: 基部的, 颅骨底部的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or located at the base

examples.en: The surgeon carefully examined the basilar artery to prevent any dangerous bleeding during surgery.
examples.zh: 外科医生仔细检查了基底动脉，以防止手术中发生危险的出血。

lemmas.def_zh: 下贱地, 卑鄙地
lemmas.def_en: in a despicable, ignoble manner

examples.en: He acted basely by taking full credit for a project his colleague completed.
examples.zh: 他卑鄙地将同事独立完成的项目成果全部归功于自己。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于希腊语与拉丁语中表示“底座、低矮”的词根，核心概念指“底部与根基”，演化出“设立基准/立足点（动词）”、“底座/基地（名词）”、“建筑底层（地下室）”，以及道德层面上的“低劣、卑鄙（形容词）”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意 base 作为形容词时专指“卑劣的、不道德的”；名词 base 指抽象或具象的“基础/基地”，而 basement 专指房屋建筑中的“地下室”。

lemmas.def_zh: 旋转；转动；转弯；改变方向；转变；变成
lemmas.def_en: to move in a circular direction; to change direction, position, or state

examples.en: Turn left at the traffic lights and the hotel is on your right.
examples.zh: 在红绿灯处左转，酒店就在你的右手边。

examples.en: The weather suddenly turned cold overnight.
examples.zh: 天气在一夜之间突然变冷了。

lemmas.def_zh: 旋转；转动；转弯；改变方向；转变；变成
lemmas.def_en: to move in a circular direction; to change direction, position, or state

examples.en: Turn left at the traffic lights and the hotel is on your right.
examples.zh: 在红绿灯处左转，酒店就在你的右手边。

examples.en: The weather suddenly turned cold overnight.
examples.zh: 天气在一夜之间突然变冷了。

lemmas.def_zh: 车工；旋工；翻铲；锅铲
lemmas.def_en: a person who shapes wood or metal on a lathe; a flat cooking utensil used for turning food

examples.en: Use a silicone turner to flip the fish gently in the pan.
examples.zh: 用硅胶锅铲轻轻在平底锅中把鱼翻面。

examples.en: He trained as an apprentice wood turner in a traditional furniture workshop.
examples.zh: 他曾在一间传统家具作坊里当木旋工学徒。

lemmas.def_zh: 未翻转的
lemmas.def_en: not turned

examples.en: The detective promised that no stone would be left unturned during the investigation.
examples.zh: 侦探承诺在调查过程中决不放过任何蛛丝马迹。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 tornare（用车床旋转车削），核心意象为“回旋/旋转”，后引申出方向、位置、状态的转变以及循环序列中的“轮流”。
family_guide.core_distinction: turn 兼具动词与名词用法，涵盖动作本身、方向改变及轮候次序；turner 则为加后缀 -er 的名词，特指车削操作者（车工）或烹饪中的翻动器具（翻铲）。

lemmas.def_zh: 在任何时候；曾经；以往；到底（用于加强语气）
lemmas.def_en: at any time; at all times; used for emphasis in questions or comparisons

examples.en: Have you ever considered starting your own business?
examples.zh: 你曾考虑过自己创业吗？

examples.en: With the deadline approaching, the team is working harder than ever.
examples.zh: 随着截止日期临近，团队比以往任何时候都更加努力工作。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 æfre，核心意象为“在任何时间点”，后演变为表示时间维度的泛指（曾经、在任何时候）以及用于最高级或疑问句中的强化语气（究竟、比以往任何时候）。

lemmas.def_en: physical strength

examples.en: The legendary hero struck the stone gate with all his might to break through.
examples.zh: 传奇英雄用尽全身力量撞击石门以求突围。

lemmas.def_zh: 力量, 权力
lemmas.def_en: physical strength

examples.en: The legendary hero struck the stone gate with all his might to break through.
examples.zh: 传奇英雄用尽全身力量撞击石门以求突围。

lemmas.def_en: physical strength
lemmas.def_zh: 强烈, 强大, 强力

examples.en: Visitors were stunned by the sheer mightiness of the ancient stone fortress.
examples.zh: 游客们被这座古老石头要塞的宏伟威势所震撼。

lemmas.def_en: having or showing great strength or force or intensity; ; ; - Bulwer-Lytton
lemmas.def_zh: 有势力的, 强大的, 有力的

examples.en: The mighty river carved a deep canyon through the solid rock over centuries.
examples.zh: 千百年来，这条强大的河流在坚硬的岩石中冲刷出一条深谷。

lemmas.def_en: powerfully or vigorously
lemmas.def_zh: 强烈地, 非常地

examples.en: The young athlete struggled mightily to finish the exhausting marathon race.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的运动员竭尽全力完成了令人疲惫的马拉松比赛。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于日耳曼语表示“力量、能力”的词根；动词作为 may 的屈折形式演化为表示推测与假设的“可能”，名词则直接保留“巨大的力量与威力”之义。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词作为情态动词表可能性、推测或委婉建议；名词为不可数抽象名词，专指极大的物理力量、政治权力或军事威力。

lemmas.def_zh: 关, 结束, 使靠近, 封闭, 使接近；关闭, 结束, 靠近
lemmas.def_en: move so that an opening or passage is obstructed; make shut

examples.en: Please close the front door gently so you do not wake the baby.
examples.zh: 请轻轻关上前门，以免吵醒正在睡觉的婴儿。

lemmas.def_en: terminate debate by calling for a vote
lemmas.def_zh: v. 终止辩论

examples.en: The closure of the factory left hundreds of people unemployed.
examples.zh: 工厂的倒闭导致数百人失业。

lemmas.def_zh: 结束, 完结
lemmas.def_en: the temporal end; the concluding time

examples.en: Please close the front door gently so you do not wake the baby.
examples.zh: 请轻轻关上前门，以免吵醒正在睡觉的婴儿。

lemmas.def_zh: 关闭者, 闭合器, 关闭器
lemmas.def_en: a person who closes something

examples.en: The technician replaced the faulty automatic door closer at the main hospital entrance.
examples.zh: 技术人员更换了医院大门处出现故障的自动闭门器。

lemmas.def_zh: 结束
lemmas.def_en: the act of closing something

examples.en: The chairman made a brief speech at the closing of the annual conference.
examples.zh: 主席在年会闭幕时发表了简短的讲话。

lemmas.def_en: approaching a particular destination; a coming closer; a narrowing of a gap
lemmas.def_zh: n. 关闭；终止；（心理上的）解脱，释怀

examples.en: The closure of the factory left hundreds of people unemployed.
examples.zh: 工厂的倒闭导致数百人失业。

lemmas.def_zh: [建] 密闭, 紧密
lemmas.def_en: a feeling of being intimate and belonging together

examples.en: The physical closeness of the houses in this neighborhood leaves very little privacy.
examples.zh: 这个社区房屋之间的紧密相邻几乎没有留下任何隐私。

lemmas.def_zh: 靠近的, 亲近的, 亲密的, 严密的, 关闭的, 狭窄的, 秘密的
lemmas.def_en: at or within a short distance in space or time or having elements near each other

examples.en: They have remained close friends ever since they met during their college years.
examples.zh: 自从大学时代相遇以来，他们一直保持着亲密的朋友关系。

lemmas.def_zh: 接近地
lemmas.def_en: in a close relation or position in time or space

examples.en: The security team is monitoring the situation closely to prevent any further trouble.
examples.zh: 安保团队正在密切监控局势，以防止进一步的麻烦。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 claudere（关闭），核心概念为“收拢、无缝隙”，由此延展出空间的阻隔与靠近、关系的亲密无间以及动作或时间的终结。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词 close 及名词“结束”读 /kloʊz/，形容词 close 则读 /kloʊs/；名词中 close 指终点/收尾，closing 侧重闭幕仪式或交易结算流程，closer 则指促成结果的关键人事物或终结者。

lemmas.def_zh: 增加，添加；补充说；做加法
lemmas.def_en: to put something with something else to increase the number or amount; to say further

examples.en: Add a pinch of salt to bring out the natural flavor of the soup.
examples.zh: 加一小撮盐以带出汤的原汁原味。

examples.en: "We expect profits to rise this quarter," she added.
examples.zh: “我们预计本季度利润会有所增长，”她补充道。

lemmas.def_zh: 加，增加；加法；增加的人或物
lemmas.def_en: the process of adding something; a mathematical operation; a person or thing that is added

examples.en: Her extensive experience makes her a welcome addition to our team.
examples.zh: 她丰富的经验使她成为我们团队极受欢迎的新成员。

examples.en: In addition to his salary, he receives a generous performance bonus.
examples.zh: 除了基本工资外，他还会收到一笔丰厚的绩效奖金。

lemmas.def_zh: 添加物
lemmas.def_en: something added to enhance food or gasoline or paint or medicine

examples.en: This healthy snack contains no artificial additive, preserving its natural fruit flavor completely.
examples.zh: 这种健康零食不含人工添加剂，完全保留了天然水果风味。

lemmas.def_zh: 蝰蛇, 猪鼻蛇, 加法器
lemmas.def_en: a person who adds numbers

examples.en: We spotted a venomous adder sunbathing quietly on the warm stone pathway.
examples.zh: 我们发现一条有毒的蝰蛇正安静地在温暖的石路上晒太阳。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 addere（ad- '向、到' + dare '给、置放'），核心语义为'放置到……上去'，由此引申出添加、相加和补充说话之意。
family_guide.core_distinction: add 为动词表示'增加或相加'的动作；addition 为其名词，既指加法或增加的过程，也常指'新增加的人或物'。

lemmas.def_zh: 停止, 被塞住；塞住, 堵塞, 阻止, 击落, 停止, 终止, 断绝
lemmas.def_en: come to a halt, stop moving

examples.en: The driver managed to stop the bus right before reaching the intersection.
examples.zh: 司机设法在到达十字路口之前及时停住了公共汽车。

lemmas.def_zh: 用塞子塞住, 闭嘴
lemmas.def_en: close or secure with or as if with a stopper

examples.en: Remember to stopper the medicine bottle securely after taking your daily dose.
examples.zh: 每天服完药后，请记得一定要把药瓶塞紧。

lemmas.def_zh: 停止, 车站, 逗留, 填塞, 障碍, (风琴的)音栓
lemmas.def_en: the event of something ending

examples.en: The driver managed to stop the bus right before reaching the intersection.
examples.zh: 司机设法在到达十字路口之前及时停住了公共汽车。

lemmas.def_zh: 直达车, 直达行驶
lemmas.def_en: a flight made without intermediate stops between source and destination

examples.en: We booked tickets on the morning nonstop from New York to London.
examples.zh: 我们订了上午从纽约直飞伦敦的直达航班。

lemmas.def_zh: 停止, 中止, 阻塞, 阻碍, 堵塞, 故障, 停付, 扣除, 扣留, 停工, 罢工
lemmas.def_en: the state of inactivity following an interruption

examples.en: The sudden work stoppage caused significant delays across the entire assembly line.
examples.zh: 突然的停工导致整条装配线出现了严重的延误。

lemmas.def_zh: 阻止的人, 木塞, 制止器
lemmas.def_en: an act so striking or impressive that the show must be delayed until the audience quiets down

examples.en: Remember to stopper the medicine bottle securely after taking your daily dose.
examples.zh: 每天服完药后，请记得一定要把药瓶塞紧。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自通俗拉丁语 stuppare（用麻屑塞住、堵塞），语义由‘堵塞孔穴、阻挡’引申为‘中止动作、停下脚步’。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词侧重停止、阻拦或停留的动作；名词侧重停顿点、车站、中止状态或堵塞物。

lemmas.def_zh: 自由的, 享受政治权力的, 允许的, 免费的, 丰富的
lemmas.def_en: able to act at will; not hampered; not under compulsion or restraint

examples.en: Volunteers worked tirelessly to free the trapped dolphin from the fishing net.
examples.zh: 志愿者们不知疲倦地工作，把受困的海豚从渔网中解救出来。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 不自由的
lemmas.def_en: held in servitude

examples.en: Historical documents revealed the harsh living conditions endured by unfree agricultural laborers.
examples.zh: 历史文献揭示了不自由的农业劳工所忍受的艰苦生活条件。

lemmas.def_zh: 释放, 解放, 使自由
lemmas.def_en: grant freedom to; free from confinement

examples.en: Volunteers worked tirelessly to free the trapped dolphin from the fishing net.
examples.zh: 志愿者们不知疲倦地工作，把受困的海豚从渔网中解救出来。

lemmas.def_zh: 自由地, 随意地, 无拘束地, 直率地, 坦白地, 慷慨地, 免费地, 大量地
lemmas.def_en: in a free manner

examples.en: Visitors are allowed to walk freely through the magnificent historic botanical gardens.
examples.zh: 游客可以在这座宏伟的历史植物园中自由漫步。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，最初指“拥有自主身份的非奴隶亲族”，后演化为“不受约束、自主选择”，并进一步引申出“免除负担/费用”的核心语义。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意作状语时的区别：free 常用于固定搭配表示“免费”或状态免除（如 toll-free, get in free），而 freely 侧重行为方式，表示“无拘无束地”或“坦率慷慨地”。

lemmas.def_zh: 头, 头脑, 领袖, 脑袋, 最前的部分
lemmas.def_en: the upper part of the human body or the front part of the body in animals; contains the face and brains

examples.en: He nodded his head in complete agreement with the proposed business strategy.
examples.zh: 他点头表示完全赞同提议的商业策略。

lemmas.def_zh: （文章或章节的）标题，小标题；（航行）航向
lemmas.def_en: a title at the head of a page or section; the direction in which a vessel or aircraft points

examples.en: Please file the information under the appropriate heading.
examples.zh: 请将这些信息归类到相应的标题下。

examples.en: The pilot maintained a steady heading toward the coast.
examples.zh: 飞行员保持稳定的航向飞往海岸。

lemmas.def_zh: （文档）页眉；（足球）头球
lemmas.def_en: text printed at the top of every page of a document; a shot or pass made with the head in soccer

examples.en: Insert the document title and page number into the header.
examples.zh: 在页眉中插入文档标题和页码。

examples.en: The striker scored the winning goal with a powerful header.
examples.zh: 前锋以一记有力的头球攻入了制胜一分。

lemmas.def_zh: 领导人地位, 能力, 校长职务
lemmas.def_en: the position of headmaster or headmistress

examples.en: She served during her headship of the school with remarkable vision and energy.
examples.zh: 在担任该校校长期间，她展现出了非凡的远见与活力。

lemmas.def_zh: 为首, 朝向, 前进, 用头顶；朝特定方向行进, (作物)结穗
lemmas.def_en: to go or travel towards

examples.en: He nodded his head in complete agreement with the proposed business strategy.
examples.zh: 他点头表示完全赞同提议的商业策略。

lemmas.def_zh: 无头的, 无领导者的, 无知的
lemmas.def_en: not having a head or formed without a head

examples.en: The revolutionary organization became disorganized and chaotic once it was left headless.
examples.zh: 该革命组织一旦群龙无首，便陷入了混乱和无序。

lemmas.def_zh: 顽固的, 任性的, 性急的, 猛烈的
lemmas.def_en: marked by the exercise of good judgment or common sense in practical matters

examples.en: The heady perfume of blooming jasmine filled the entire garden each evening.
examples.zh: 每当傍晚，盛开茉莉的浓烈香气便弥漫了整个花园。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语，核心本义为解剖学上的“头”，后自然引申为空间上的“顶端/前端”、权力与组织上的“首领/主管”，以及动词化后表示“朝向/前行”。
family_guide.core_distinction: heading 常指文本中的“章节标题”或航行的“航向”；header 则专指排版中的“页眉”或体育运动中的“头球”。

lemmas.def_zh: 手, 爪, 指针, 掌握, 协助, 人手, 手艺, 手迹, 支配, 插手
lemmas.def_en: the (prehensile) extremity of the superior limb

examples.en: Please hand your completed examination papers directly to the proctor before leaving.
examples.zh: 离开前，请将填写完毕的试卷直接交给监考老师。

lemmas.def_zh: 少数, 一把, 棘手事
lemmas.def_en: a small number or amount

examples.en: Only a handful of brave volunteers showed up to clean the beach.
examples.zh: 只有少数勇敢的志愿者赶来清理海滩。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 左利或右利(偏于用一侧手工作)
lemmas.def_en: the property of using one hand more than the other

examples.en: Scientists are studying how genetic factors determine the handedness of human infants.
examples.zh: 科学家们正在研究基因因素如何决定人类婴儿的利手倾向。

lemmas.def_zh: 交给, 支持, 搀扶
lemmas.def_en: place into the hands or custody of

examples.en: Please hand your completed examination papers directly to the proctor before leaving.
examples.zh: 离开前，请将填写完毕的试卷直接交给监考老师。

lemmas.def_zh: 把手从...移开, 将...放掉
lemmas.def_en: remove the hand from

examples.en: The detective demanded that the suspect unhand the victim immediately.
examples.zh: 便衣警察要求嫌疑人立刻放开受害者。

lemmas.def_zh: 无手的, 手笨拙的
lemmas.def_en: without a hand or hands

examples.en: A handless robotic arm was designed to test magnetic lifting capabilities.
examples.zh: 一个没有手部结构的机械臂被设计用于测试磁力提升功能。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语，本义为身体部位“手”，由此引申出“协助、掌控、传递（用手交递）”以及度量概念（“一把之量”）等动作与比喻义。
family_guide.core_distinction: hand 作动词强调“用手传递、递送”的具体动作；衍生词 handful 则从物理上的“一手抓起的量”引申为“少数”或“棘手难管的人事物”。

lemmas.def_zh: 相信；认为；信任
lemmas.def_en: to accept that something is true, genuine, or real

examples.en: I firmly believe that practice is the key to mastering any skill.
examples.zh: 我坚信练习是掌握任何技能的关键。

examples.en: She doesn't believe in making quick decisions without enough data.
examples.zh: 她不赞成在没有充分数据的情况下匆忙做决定。

lemmas.def_zh: 难以置信的；极好的；令人吃惊的
lemmas.def_en: extremely surprising, improbable, or impressive

examples.en: The team pulled off an unbelievable comeback in the final minutes.
examples.zh: 该队在最后几分钟完成了一场不可思议的逆转。

examples.en: The view from the top of the mountain was absolutely unbelievable.
examples.zh: 从山顶俯瞰的景色真是美得令人难以置信。

lemmas.def_zh: 可信的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being believed

examples.en: Her detailed explanation made the strange excuse sound entirely believable.
examples.zh: 她详尽的解释让这个奇怪的借口听起来完全可信。

lemmas.def_zh: 不相信的, 不信教的, 多疑的
lemmas.def_en: rejecting any belief in gods

examples.en: He stared at the winning lottery ticket with an unbelieving expression.
examples.zh: 他带着难以置信的表情凝视着那张中奖彩票。

lemmas.def_en: any cognitive content held as true
lemmas.def_zh: 信念, 相信, 信仰

examples.en: Her deep belief in justice gave her the courage to speak out.
examples.zh: 她对正义的坚定信念给了她大胆发声的勇气。

lemmas.def_zh: 信徒；坚定支持者；坚信……的人
lemmas.def_en: a person who has religious faith or who strongly supports an idea

examples.en: He is a firm believer in the power of daily habits.
examples.zh: 他是日常习惯力量的坚定信奉者。

examples.en: The church welcomed dozens of new believers into the community.
examples.zh: 该教会欢迎数十名新信徒加入社区。

lemmas.def_en: a rejection of belief
lemmas.def_zh: 不信, 疑惑, 不信仰

examples.en: He stared in total unbelief as his favorite team lost the match.
examples.zh: 眼见自己支持的球队输掉比赛，他难以置信地瞪大了眼。

lemmas.def_zh: 不相信者, 无宗教信仰者
lemmas.def_en: someone who refuses to believe (as in a divinity)

examples.en: As a confirmed unbeliever, he questioned every dogma presented to him.
examples.zh: 作为一个坚定的不信教者，他质疑摆在面前的每条教义。

lemmas.def_zh: 可信度
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being believable or trustworthy

examples.en: The poor visual effects severely damaged the movie's overall believability.
examples.zh: 拙劣的视觉效果严重削弱了这部电影的整体可信度。

lemmas.def_zh: 没有信仰的人, 不信上帝的人
lemmas.def_en: someone who refuses to believe (as in a divinity)

examples.en: The local church welcomed both devout followers and any curious nonbeliever.
examples.zh: 当地教堂既欢迎虔诚的信徒，也接纳任何好奇的非信徒。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语词根，与 love 同源，本义为“视为珍爱或真实”，演变为“深信、确信”的核心概念。
family_guide.core_distinction: unbelievable 多用于口语修饰惊人或极好的事物；believer 既指宗教信徒，也常用于日常指某理念的“坚定支持者”。

lemmas.def_zh: 夜晚，夜间；黑夜；夜晚的时光
lemmas.def_en: the period of darkness between sunset and sunrise

examples.en: She prefers to study late at night when the house is completely quiet.
examples.zh: 她喜欢在深夜房子完全安静下来的时候学习。

examples.en: They decided to spend the night at a cozy inn near the station.
examples.zh: 他们决定在车站附近一家温馨的小旅馆过夜。

lemmas.def_zh: 每夜的, 夜间的
lemmas.def_en: happening every night

examples.en: The hotel provides a nightly turndown service for all premium guests.
examples.zh: 这家酒店为所有尊贵客人提供夜间开床服务。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语 *nókʷts（夜晚），核心语义指日落到日出之间的黑暗时段，引申为夜晚活动、就寝时分及黑暗沉寂的状态。

lemmas.def_zh: 钱；货币；资金；财富
lemmas.def_en: what is used as a medium of exchange in the form of coins or banknotes, or wealth/funds in general

examples.en: She managed to save a considerable amount of money by cooking at home.
examples.zh: 通过自己在家做饭，她省下了相当可观的一笔钱。

examples.en: The startup is actively raising money to expand into overseas markets.
examples.zh: 该初创公司正在积极筹集资金以拓展海外市场。

lemmas.def_zh: [经] 铸币人(者)
lemmas.def_en: a skilled worker who coins or stamps money

examples.en: In medieval times, the royal moneyer oversaw the minting of coins.
examples.zh: 在中世纪，皇家铸币人负责监督硬币的铸造。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or involving money
lemmas.def_zh: 货币的，金钱的；金融的

examples.en: The central bank adjusted its monetary policy to curb rising inflation.
examples.zh: 央行调整了货币政策以抑制不断上升的通货膨胀。

lemmas.def_zh: 没钱的
lemmas.def_en: not based on the possession of money

examples.en: After losing his wallet, he found himself completely moneyless in town.
examples.zh: 丢了钱包后，他发现自己在城里身无分文。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古罗马女神 Juno Moneta（意为警示者，其神庙曾设为国家铸币厂），后词义由铸币厂与硬币演变泛指通用的交换媒介、货币与财富。

lemmas.def_zh: 国家；国土；乡下，农村
lemmas.def_en: a nation with its own government, territory, and people; land outside towns and cities

examples.en: She has traveled to more than twenty different countries around the world.
examples.zh: 她曾游历过世界上二十多个不同的国家。

examples.en: They decided to leave the bustling city and move to the country.
examples.zh: 他们决定离开喧嚣的大都市，搬到乡下去生活。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 contra（面对、对面），本义指“展现在眼前的一片土地”，后引申为地域，并演变出“国家/疆土”以及“乡间/农村”两大核心语义。

lemmas.def_zh: 听见，听到；得知，获悉；审理
lemmas.def_en: perceive with the ear the sound made by someone or something; be told or learn of

examples.en: I could hear footsteps approaching in the quiet hallway.
examples.zh: 我能听见安静的走廊里有脚步声走近。

examples.en: Have you heard from Sarah lately?
examples.zh: 你最近有萨拉的消息吗？

lemmas.def_zh: 听见；得知（hear 的过去式和过去分词）
lemmas.def_en: past tense and past participle of hear

examples.en: She heard a strange noise coming from the basement.
examples.zh: 她听到地下室传来一阵奇怪的声音。

examples.en: His voice was so quiet that it could barely be heard.
examples.zh: 他的声音太轻了，几乎听不见。

lemmas.def_zh: 听力，听觉；听证会，审讯
lemmas.def_en: the faculty of perceiving sounds; an official meeting to gather information or evidence

examples.en: Loud music can cause permanent damage to your hearing.
examples.zh: 大音量的音乐会对你的听力造成永久性损伤。

examples.en: The committee held a public hearing on the proposed environmental law.
examples.zh: 委员会就拟议的环境法案举行了公众听证会。

lemmas.def_zh: 听者, 听众
lemmas.def_en: someone who listens attentively

examples.en: The speaker captivated every hearer in the packed university auditorium.
examples.zh: 演讲者吸引了拥挤的大学礼堂里的每一位听众。

lemmas.def_zh: 没有被听到的, 未予倾听的, 未予考虑的
lemmas.def_en: not necessarily inaudible but not heard

examples.en: Her desperate cries for help went completely unheard in the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨中，她绝望的求救声完全没有人听到。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 hīeran，核心本义为通过耳朵感知声音，后引申为获悉消息、倾听意见以及司法上的正式审理。
family_guide.core_distinction: heard 为不规则过去式和过去分词；hearing 名词化后既指生理上的听力/听觉，也常特指法律或官方程序中的听证会。

lemmas.def_zh: 法律；法规；法学；规律
lemmas.def_en: a rule or system of rules recognized by a community as governing actions; a natural principle

examples.en: Everyone is expected to obey the law, regardless of their status.
examples.zh: 无论身份如何，人人都应当遵守法律。

examples.en: She decided to study law after graduating from high school.
examples.zh: 高中毕业后，她决定攻读法学专业。

lemmas.def_zh: 律师；法律顾问
lemmas.def_en: a person who practices or studies law, especially an attorney representing clients

examples.en: You should consult a lawyer before signing any formal contract.
examples.zh: 在签署任何正式合同之前，你都应该先咨询律师。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺斯语，与 lie/lay 同源，原义指“固定、确立之物”，引申为共同遵守的规章、法令及法律体系。
family_guide.core_distinction: law 指法律规则或法律体系本体；lawyer 带有从业者后缀 -yer，特指从事法律事务的专业人员（律师）。

lemmas.def_zh: 书, 书籍, 帐簿, 名册, 工作簿
lemmas.def_en: a written work or composition that has been published (printed on pages bound together)

examples.en: She borrowed a fascinating book about ancient civilizations from the library.
examples.zh: 她从图书馆借了一本关于古代文明的引人入胜的书。

lemmas.def_zh: 预订，预约；预订的客房（或票位）
lemmas.def_en: an arrangement to have something held for your use at a later time

examples.en: The hotel sent an email confirming our reservation and booking details.
examples.zh: 酒店发来电子邮件，确认了我们的预订和详细信息。

lemmas.def_zh: 预订者；（演出、活动的）节目统筹人，演出经纪人
lemmas.def_en: a person who books tickets or accommodation; an agent who books performers, guests, or models

examples.en: Music festival bookers are always searching for promising independent bands.
examples.zh: 音乐节的节目统筹人总是在发掘有潜力的独立乐队。

lemmas.def_zh: 小册子
lemmas.def_en: a small book usually having a paper cover

examples.en: The tourist center provides a free booklet containing maps and local attractions.
examples.zh: 旅游中心提供一份包含地图和当地景点的免费小册子。

lemmas.def_zh: 登记, 预订
lemmas.def_en: engage for a performance

examples.en: She borrowed a fascinating book about ancient civilizations from the library.
examples.zh: 她从图书馆借了一本关于古代文明的引人入胜的书。

lemmas.def_zh: 可预定的, 可预约的, 可预购的
lemmas.def_en: subject to being reserved or booked

examples.en: These private meeting rooms are bookable up to two weeks in advance.
examples.zh: 这些私人会议室最多可提前两周预订。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古日耳曼语‘山毛榉’（古人在山毛榉木片上刻字），核心意象由‘文字载体/书本’引申为登记事项的‘账簿/名册’，再由在名册上记录衍生出动词‘预订、登记’。
family_guide.core_distinction: booking 指预订行为或已预订的席位/单据；booker 指预订者或专门负责敲定演出、嘉宾的活动统筹经纪人。

lemmas.def_zh: 计划, 设计, 意欲；订计划
lemmas.def_en: have the will and intention to carry out some action

examples.en: We should carefully plan our travel budget before booking the flights.
examples.zh: 我们在订机票之前应该仔细规划旅行预算。

lemmas.def_zh: 计划, 方案, 策略, 方法, 进度表, 程序表, 平面图, 设计图, 轮廓, 示意图
lemmas.def_en: a series of steps to be carried out or goals to be accomplished

examples.en: We should carefully plan our travel budget before booking the flights.
examples.zh: 我们在订机票之前应该仔细规划旅行预算。

lemmas.def_zh: 计划者, 设计者, 安排者
lemmas.def_en: a person who makes plans

examples.en: The event planner coordinated all vendors to ensure a seamless wedding.
examples.zh: 活动策划人协调了所有供应商，以确保婚礼顺利举行。

lemmas.def_zh: 无计划的, 未经筹划的, 意外的, 在计划外的
lemmas.def_en: without apparent forethought or prompting or planning

examples.en: An unplanned road detour added nearly two hours to our journey.
examples.zh: 一次计划外的道路绕行给我们的旅程增加了将近两个小时。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语表示“平面”的词根（与 plane 同源），最初指在图纸上绘制的平面建筑草图，后引申为在行动前预先构思、布局的方案与行为。
family_guide.core_distinction: plan 指计划本身或制定计划的动作，而 planner 既可指制定方案的“规划师”，也可指记录安排的“日程簿/规划工具”。

lemmas.def_zh: 月；月份；一个月的时间
lemmas.def_en: one of the twelve periods of time into which a year is divided, or a period of about four weeks

examples.en: She spent three months working on her final dissertation.
examples.zh: 她花了三个月的时间撰写毕业论文。

examples.en: The rent is due at the beginning of each month.
examples.zh: 房租应在每个月初缴纳。

lemmas.def_zh: 月刊；按月发行的出版物
lemmas.def_en: a magazine or periodical that is published once every month

examples.en: He writes a regular column on personal finance for a glossy monthly.
examples.zh: 他为一家精美的高档月刊撰写个人理财定期专栏。

examples.en: The library subscribes to several literary monthlies.
examples.zh: 这家图书馆订阅了数种文学月刊。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，与 moon（月亮）同源，本义为以月亮盈亏周期计量的时间段，后固定为历法中的“月份”及相关周期概念。
family_guide.core_distinction: month 表示基础的时间单位“月份”；monthly 作名词时特指“月刊”或按月出版发行的刊物。

lemmas.def_zh: 次序, 规则, 命令；顺序, 阶数
lemmas.def_en: (often plural) a command given by a superior (e.g., a military or law enforcement officer) that must be obeyed

examples.en: The teacher arranged the students' names in alphabetical order.
examples.zh: 老师按字母顺序排列了学生们的名字。

lemmas.def_zh: 护理员, 清道夫, 传令兵, 勤务兵
lemmas.def_en: a soldier who serves as an attendant to a superior officer

examples.en: The hospital orderly gently pushed the patient's wheelchair down the hallway.
examples.zh: 医院护工轻轻推着病人的轮椅走过走廊。

lemmas.def_zh: 整齐状态, 条理性, 秩序井然
lemmas.def_en: the quality of appreciating method and system

examples.en: The strict librarian took great pride in the orderliness of the shelves.
examples.zh: 严谨的图书管理员对书架的整齐有序感到非常自豪。

lemmas.def_zh: [经] 开证申请人
lemmas.def_en: someone who places an order to buy

examples.en: The bank contacted the orderer to verify the international wire transfer details.
examples.zh: 银行联系了开证申请人以核实国际电汇的详细信息。

lemmas.def_zh: 命令, 定货；整理, 命令, 定购
lemmas.def_en: give instructions to or direct somebody to do something with authority

examples.en: The teacher arranged the students' names in alphabetical order.
examples.zh: 老师按字母顺序排列了学生们的名字。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 无序的
lemmas.def_en: not arranged in order

examples.en: The database returned an unordered list of customer names after the query.
examples.zh: 查询后，数据库返回了一份未排序的客户名单。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ordo（行列、次序），核心逻辑从物理上的“排列、条理”引申为社会规范下的“秩序”，再延伸出确立规则的“命令/指示”以及商业流转中的“订购/订单”。

lemmas.def_zh: 大的；大规模的；广泛的
lemmas.def_en: of considerable size, extent, capacity, or amount

examples.en: The company invested a large amount of money in renewable energy.
examples.zh: 该公司在可再生能源领域投入了巨额资金。

examples.en: By and large, the new regulations have been well received by the public.
examples.zh: 大体上说，新规受到了公众的普遍认可。

lemmas.def_zh: 广阔的；广泛的；大量的
lemmas.def_en: covering a large area; wide in range, amount, or scope

examples.en: The storm caused extensive damage across the entire region.
examples.zh: 暴风雨对整个地区造成了严重的破坏。

examples.en: She conducted extensive research before publishing the monograph.
examples.zh: 她在出版这本专著之前进行了广泛深入的研究。

lemmas.def_en: capable of being comprehended or understood
lemmas.def_zh: 可理解的

examples.en: Her clear explanation made the complex legal terms comprehensible to everyone in the courtroom.
examples.zh: 她清晰的解释让法庭上的每个人都能理解复杂的法律术语。

lemmas.def_zh: 可展开的, 可延长的, 可扩张的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being protruded or stretched or opened out

examples.en: The software architecture is highly extensible and supports custom third-party plugins.
examples.zh: 该软件架构具有高度的可扩展性，支持自定义第三方插件。

lemmas.def_zh: 外延的, 事实的, 具体的, 客观现实的
lemmas.def_en: defining a word by listing the class of entities to which the word correctly applies

examples.en: The philosopher provided an extensional definition by listing every applicable example.
examples.zh: 这位哲学家通过列举每一个适用实例给出了外延定义。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 可扩充的, 可扩展的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being lengthened

examples.en: We bought an extendible dining table to accommodate more holiday guests.
examples.zh: 我们买了一张可延伸的餐桌，以便容纳更多的节日宾客。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 无空间维度的
lemmas.def_en: not extended or stretched out

examples.en: Descartes argued that the human mind is an unextended thinking substance.
examples.zh: 笛卡尔认为人类心灵是一种没有空间广延的思维实体。

lemmas.def_zh: 主要地；在很大程度上
lemmas.def_en: to a great extent; mainly or mostly

examples.en: Her success was largely due to her perseverance and adaptability.
examples.zh: 她的成功在很大程度上归功于她的毅力和适应能力。

examples.en: The conference was largely unattended due to the severe snowstorm.
examples.zh: 由于严重暴风雪，这次会议基本上无人出席。

lemmas.def_zh: 广泛地；大量地
lemmas.def_en: to a great degree; in a way that covers or affects a wide area

examples.en: This topic has been extensively discussed in recent academic literature.
examples.zh: 这一主题在近期的学术文献中已被广泛讨论。

lemmas.def_en: in an all-inclusive manner
lemmas.def_zh: 包括地；包括一切地

examples.en: The committee reviewed the new safety proposal comprehensively before making their decision.
examples.zh: 委员会在做出决定前全面地审查了这项新的安全提案。

lemmas.def_en: the point or degree to which something extends
lemmas.def_zh: 范围, 程度, 区域

examples.en: We did not realize the full extent of the damage until daybreak.
examples.zh: 直到破晓时分，我们才意识到受损程度有多严重。

lemmas.def_zh: 延伸；延期；扩建部分；（电话）分机
lemmas.def_en: an addition that lengthens or enlarges something; an extra period of time; a branch phone line

examples.en: He requested a one-week extension to finish his master's thesis.
examples.zh: 他申请延期一周以完成他的硕士论文。

examples.en: If you wish to speak to Mr. Davis, please dial extension 402.
examples.zh: 如果您想与戴维斯先生通话，请拨分机号 402。

lemmas.def_en: an intensive examination testing a student's proficiency in some special field of knowledge
lemmas.def_zh: [经] 广泛的, 综合的, 全面的

examples.en: Students must pass a rigorous comprehensive exam before graduating from the program.
examples.zh: 学生从该专业毕业前必须通过一项严格的综合考试。

lemmas.def_en: an ability to understand the meaning or importance of something (or the knowledge acquired as a result)
lemmas.def_zh: 理解, 包含

examples.en: Reading difficult classic literature can greatly improve your reading comprehension skills.
examples.zh: 阅读高难度的古典文学可以极大提升你的阅读理解能力。

lemmas.def_zh: 伸肌
lemmas.def_en: a skeletal muscle whose contraction extends or stretches a body part

examples.en: He strained his extensor muscle while lifting heavy boxes at work.
examples.zh: 他在工作搬运重箱子时不慎拉伤了伸肌。

lemmas.def_en: completeness over a broad scope
lemmas.def_zh: 详尽; 综合性

examples.en: The comprehensiveness of the medical report impressed all the consulting doctors.
examples.zh: 这份医疗报告的详尽程度给所有会诊医生留下了深刻印象。

lemmas.def_zh: 巨大, 广大, 大量
lemmas.def_en: the capacity to understand a broad range of topics

examples.en: The sheer largeness of the ancient hall completely overwhelmed the visiting tourists.
examples.zh: 这座古老大厅的宏大规模彻底震撼了来访的游客。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of comprehensible language or thought
lemmas.def_zh: 可了解性；能理解

examples.en: Using simpler everyday words improved the overall comprehensibility of the article.
examples.zh: 使用更简单的日常词汇提高了整篇文章的可理解性。

lemmas.def_zh: [计]扩展（性）, 延伸（性）
lemmas.def_en: large or extensive in breadth or importance or comprehensiveness

examples.en: The true extensiveness of the flood damage became clear after daylight.
examples.zh: 天亮后，洪水破坏程度的深远广泛才彻底显现出来。

lemmas.def_zh: 延伸；延长；扩大；提供，给予
lemmas.def_en: to stretch out, make longer in time or space, or offer formally

examples.en: The university decided to extend the application deadline by two weeks.
examples.zh: 大学决定将申请截止日期延长两周。

examples.en: We would like to extend a warm welcome to all our guests.
examples.zh: 我们谨向所有来宾致以热烈的欢迎。

lemmas.def_en: get the meaning of something
lemmas.def_zh: 理解, 包括

examples.en: It took him several minutes to comprehend the instructions on the test.
examples.zh: 他花了数分钟才理解测试上的说明。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 largus（宽大的、慷慨的），演变至现代英语中核心指物理体积、范围或规模的“巨大/广泛”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词 large 侧重物理尺寸、数量或规模的“大”，而副词 largely 则脱离了具象空间，专指抽象程度上的“很大程度上、主要地”。

lemmas.def_zh: 杀死，致死；终结，破坏（计划、感情等）
lemmas.def_en: to cause the death of a living organism; to put an end to or destroy something

examples.en: The sudden freeze killed all the young fruit trees.
examples.zh: 突如其来的严寒冻死了所有幼小的果树。

examples.en: The manager decided to kill the project due to budget cuts.
examples.zh: 由于预算削减，经理决定终止该项目。

lemmas.def_zh: 杀死，致死；终结，破坏（计划、感情等）
lemmas.def_en: to cause the death of a living organism; to put an end to or destroy something

examples.en: The sudden freeze killed all the young fruit trees.
examples.zh: 突如其来的严寒冻死了所有幼小的果树。

examples.en: The manager decided to kill the project due to budget cuts.
examples.zh: 由于预算削减，经理决定终止该项目。

lemmas.def_zh: 杀害，谋杀；暴利，巨额收益
lemmas.def_en: an act of causing death, especially unlawfully; a large and quick profit

examples.en: The police launched an investigation into the mysterious killing.
examples.zh: 警方对这起离奇的杀人案展开了调查。

examples.en: They made a killing on the stock market during the tech boom.
examples.zh: 在科技繁荣期，他们在股市上大赚了一笔。

lemmas.def_zh: 凶手，杀手；致命因素；极难对付的事物
lemmas.def_en: a person, animal, or factor that causes death; something that is extremely difficult or impressive

examples.en: Heart disease remains the leading killer of adults in the country.
examples.zh: 心脏病仍然是该国成年人的头号致命杀手。

examples.en: That final hill on the race course was an absolute killer.
examples.zh: 赛道上的最后一个山坡简直要了人的命。

lemmas.def_zh: 吸引人地
lemmas.def_en: in a very humorous manner

examples.en: She flashed a killingly charming smile that captured everyone's attention instantly.
examples.zh: 她绽放出极其迷人的微笑，瞬间吸引了所有人的注意。

lemmas.def_zh: kill的变形
lemmas.def_en: fit to kill, especially for food

examples.en: In this video game, every monster is killable if you use the right strategy.
examples.zh: 在这款电子游戏中，只要策略得当，每只怪物都是可以杀死的。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中古英语 cullen（击打、杀死），核心义为‘剥夺生命’，引申至‘终止、消灭或破坏某物的存在与效力’。
family_guide.core_distinction: killer 指实施杀戮的主体或致命因素；killing 指杀戮的行为或事件（引申为‘暴利’）；名词 kill 则专指捕猎的成果（猎物）或猎杀动作本身。

lemmas.def_zh: 地区，区域；面积；领域，方面
lemmas.def_en: a particular part of a place, city, or country; the size of a surface; a subject or activity

examples.en: Crime rates have dropped significantly in this residential area.
examples.zh: 该居民区的犯罪率已大幅下降。

examples.en: She has established herself as a leading expert in the area of digital privacy.
examples.zh: 她已成为数字隐私领域的顶尖专家。

lemmas.def_zh: 地区的；面积的；广大的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or involving an area

examples.en: Researchers conducted an areal survey to measure the exact extent of forest loss.
examples.zh: 研究人员进行了一项面积调查，以测量森林流失的确切范围。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 area（开阔地、打谷场），核心意象是一片划定的平面或空间，后引申为地理上的“区域”、几何上的“面积”以及抽象活动中的“领域”。

lemmas.def_zh: 使联系；叙述；理解并产生共鸣
lemmas.def_en: to connect two or more things; to tell a story; to understand and feel sympathy for someone

examples.en: Many students found it difficult to relate the theoretical concepts to real-world situations.
examples.zh: 许多学生觉得很难将理论概念与现实情境联系起来。

examples.en: I can completely relate to what you are going through right now.
examples.zh: 我完全能对你现在的经历感同身受。

lemmas.def_zh: （人际或恋爱）关系；关联
lemmas.def_en: the way in which people or things are connected, especially an emotional or interpersonal bond

examples.en: Effective communication is essential for maintaining a healthy and lasting relationship.
examples.zh: 有效沟通对于维持健康长久的关系至关重要。

lemmas.def_zh: 关联；关系；亲戚，亲属
lemmas.def_en: a connection between two or more things; formal connections between groups or countries; a family member

examples.en: Diplomatic relations between the two nations have steadily improved over the past decade.
examples.zh: 两国之间的外交关系在过去十年中稳步改善。

examples.en: Is he any relation to the famous novelist with the same surname?
examples.zh: 他和那位同姓的著名小说家有亲戚关系吗？

lemmas.def_zh: 与…有亲戚关系, 有关系
lemmas.def_en: a particular manner of connectedness

examples.en: Genetic tests confirmed a close relatedness between the two isolated animal populations.
examples.zh: 基因检测证实了这两个孤立动物种群之间存在密切亲缘关系。

lemmas.def_zh: 不相关的；无亲属关系的
lemmas.def_en: not connected with each other; not belonging to the same family

examples.en: Police confirmed that the two crimes were completely unrelated.
examples.zh: 警方证实这两起罪案完全没有关联。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 relatus（re- 回 + latus 携带/放置），本义为‘带回、叙述’，后引申出‘使相互产生联系’与‘共鸣’等核心涵义。
family_guide.core_distinction: relation 偏指宏观、抽象或正式的联系（如国际关系、事物逻辑关联或亲戚），而 relationship 更强调人与人之间具体的情感联结或两者间的动态互动。

lemmas.def_zh: 列, 线, 绳, 电线, 线路, 路线, 航线, 作业线, 界线, 战线, 外形, 排, 家系
lemmas.def_en: a formation of people or things one beside another

examples.en: People waited in a long line outside the theater to buy tickets.
examples.zh: 人们在剧院外排起长队买票。

lemmas.def_zh: （衣物或容器的）衬里，内层
lemmas.def_en: a layer of material covering the inside surface of clothing or other items

examples.en: The smooth silk lining makes the suit jacket very comfortable to wear.
examples.zh: 光滑的真丝衬里让这件西装外套穿起来格外舒适。

examples.en: Don't lose hope—every cloud has a silver lining.
examples.zh: 别灰心，困境中总有一线希望（否极泰来）。

lemmas.def_zh: 定期客轮（班轮）；眼线笔；衬垫物
lemmas.def_en: a large passenger ship; a cosmetic tool for drawing lines; a protective interior layer

examples.en: The luxury cruise liner docked at the harbor early in the morning.
examples.zh: 这艘豪华游轮清晨停靠在港口。

examples.en: She used a waterproof liquid liner to accentuate her eyes.
examples.zh: 她用了防水液体眼线笔来勾勒突出眼部。

lemmas.def_zh: 划线
lemmas.def_en: the line that appears to bound an object

examples.en: Geologists carefully examined the distinct lineation visible on the surface of the rock.
examples.zh: 地质学家仔细检查了岩石表面可见的清晰线状构造。

lemmas.def_zh: 排成一行, 顺...排列, 划线于, 加衬里, 使有线条, 使起皱纹；排队
lemmas.def_en: be in line with; form a line along

examples.en: People waited in a long line outside the theater to buy tickets.
examples.zh: 人们在剧院外排起长队买票。

lemmas.def_zh: 直系的, 正统的, 嫡出的
lemmas.def_en: in a straight unbroken line of descent from parent to child

examples.en: He claimed to be a lineal descendant of the country's first president.
examples.zh: 他声称自己是该国第一任总统的直系后裔。

lemmas.def_zh: [化] 不镶衬的
lemmas.def_en: not having a lining or liner

examples.en: She wore an unlined cotton jacket that was perfect for warm spring afternoons.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件无内衬的棉质夹克，非常适合温暖的春日午后。

lemmas.def_zh: 直系地, 嫡系地
lemmas.def_en: by an unbroken line of descent

examples.en: The royal title was passed lineally from father to son for centuries.
examples.zh: 几个世纪以来，王室爵位一直由父子代代直系相传。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 linea（亚麻线、麻绳），由‘线状物’引申出‘线条、行列、路线、边界’，动词派生出‘排成行’以及源自亚麻缝缀的‘加衬里’。
family_guide.core_distinction: lining 专指衣服或容器内部缝入的‘衬里/内层’；liner 则指沿固定路线运行的‘班轮/客轮’、眼线笔或可替换的保护性衬垫。

lemmas.def_zh: 有人, 某人
lemmas.def_en: a human being

examples.en: Someone left an umbrella in the hallway, but nobody knows who owns it.
examples.zh: 有人把雨伞落在了走廊里，但没人知道是谁的。

lemmas.def_en: a human being

examples.en: Someone left an umbrella in the hallway, but nobody knows who owns it.
examples.zh: 有人把雨伞落在了走廊里，但没人知道是谁的。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 some（某个）与 one（人/个体）组合而成的复合词，核心指代不确定的某个人，名词用法引申指‘被看作一个角色的人’，即‘重要人物’。
family_guide.core_distinction: 代词表示泛指、未指名的‘某人’；名词常与不定冠词连用（a someone），特指‘有地位或影响力的人物’（反义词为 nobody）。

lemmas.def_zh: 带来；携带；引起；导致
lemmas.def_en: to take or carry someone or something to a place or a person, or to cause a particular result

examples.en: Don't forget to bring an umbrella; it looks like rain.
examples.zh: 别忘了带把伞，看起来要下雨了。

examples.en: The new policy is expected to bring about significant economic growth.
examples.zh: 这项新政策预计将带来显著的经济增长。

lemmas.def_zh: 带来；引起（bring 的过去式和过去分词）
lemmas.def_en: past tense and past participle of bring

examples.en: She brought a delicious homemade pie to the dinner party.
examples.zh: 她带了一份美味的自制派去参加晚宴。

examples.en: The crisis has brought several unresolved issues to the surface.
examples.zh: 这场危机使几个未解决的问题浮出了水面。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 bringan，核心语义为“将某人或某物自他处移动或引导至说话者所处的位置”，引申表示“引起、导致某种结果或状态的出现”。
family_guide.core_distinction: brought 为 bring 的不规则过去式与过去分词，仅在时态与体貌上有形态变化，词义完全一致。

lemmas.def_zh: 很少的；几乎没有的；不多的
lemmas.def_en: not many; a small number of

examples.en: Very few people actually understand the complex mathematical model.
examples.zh: 极少有人真正理解这个复杂的数学模型。

examples.en: He had few friends in the new city and often felt isolated.
examples.zh: 他在新城市几乎没有什么朋友，常常感到孤单。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语根 *pau-（少量、弱小），核心概念为“数量上的微小与匮乏”，专用于修饰或指代可数名词。
family_guide.core_distinction: 单独使用时带有否定含义，强调“极少、几乎没有”；与带冠词的 a few（肯定含义，意为“有一些”）形成语用对比。

lemmas.def_zh: 左边的, 左倾的, 左侧的, 左派的
lemmas.def_en: being or located on or directed toward the side of the body to the west when facing north

examples.en: Take a sharp turn at the next intersection to reach the hotel.
examples.zh: 在下一个十字路口向左急转弯即可到达酒店。

lemmas.def_zh: 左, 左面, 左派
lemmas.def_en: location near or direction toward the left side; i.e. the side to the north when a person or object faces east

examples.en: Take a sharp turn at the next intersection to reach the hotel.
examples.zh: 在下一个十字路口向左急转弯即可到达酒店。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 lyft（意为“虚弱的、愚钝的”），因多数人惯用右手，左手被视作较弱的一侧，后演变为方位“左侧”及政治上的“左翼”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词用于修饰具体方位或政治属性（如 left hand, left wing），名词则指代左方空间、转向动作或政治上的左派群体（如 on the left, the Left）。

lemmas.def_zh: 离开，远离；不在，离家；消失，消逝
lemmas.def_en: to or at a distance from a particular place, person, or thing; absent from a place

examples.en: She packed her bags and walked away without looking back.
examples.zh: 她收拾好行李，头也不回地走开了。

examples.en: The sound of the train slowly faded away into the night.
examples.zh: 火车的轰鸣声在夜色中渐渐消逝。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语‘on weg’（在路上），核心语义演化为‘脱离原位、向远处移动或逐渐消逝’。

lemmas.def_zh: v. 希望，期盼；n. 希望，期望
lemmas.def_en: v. to want something to happen and believe that it is possible; n. a feeling of expectation and desire

examples.en: We sincerely hope that the talks will lead to a lasting peace.
examples.zh: 我们真诚地希望这次谈判能带来持久的和平。

examples.en: The breakthrough gave fresh hope to patients with the rare disease.
examples.zh: 这一突破为该罕见病患者带来了新的希望。

lemmas.def_zh: 单脚跳行；（鸟、昆虫等）齐足跳跃；快速前往
lemmas.def_en: to move by jumping on one foot, or to move quickly from one place to another

examples.en: A robin hopped across the grass looking for worms.
examples.zh: 一只知更鸟在草地上跳来跳去寻找虫子。

lemmas.def_zh: v. 希望，期盼；n. 希望，期望
lemmas.def_en: v. to want something to happen and believe that it is possible; n. a feeling of expectation and desire

examples.en: We sincerely hope that the talks will lead to a lasting peace.
examples.zh: 我们真诚地希望这次谈判能带来持久的和平。

examples.en: The breakthrough gave fresh hope to patients with the rare disease.
examples.zh: 这一突破为该罕见病患者带来了新的希望。

lemmas.def_zh: 有希望成功的人；抱有希望的候选者
lemmas.def_en: a person who aspires or is considered likely to succeed, especially in an election or competition

examples.en: Hundreds of young hopefuls auditioned for the lead role in the musical.
examples.zh: 数百名满怀憧憬的年轻人参加了这部音乐剧主角的试镜。

lemmas.def_zh: 绝望
lemmas.def_en: the despair you feel when you have abandoned hope of comfort or success

examples.en: A heavy feeling of hopelessness filled the room after they heard the bad news.
examples.zh: 听到这个坏消息后，房间里弥漫着沉重的绝望感。

lemmas.def_zh: 抱有希望
lemmas.def_en: full of hope

examples.en: Her bright eyes showed a sense of hopefulness despite the difficult circumstances.
examples.zh: 尽管处境艰难，她明亮的双眼中依然透露着希望。

lemmas.def_zh: 希望者, 期望者
lemmas.def_en: a person who hopes

examples.en: He was always an eternal hoper, expecting things to improve against all odds.
examples.zh: 他总是一个永远抱有希望的人，无论多难都期待事情会好转。

lemmas.def_zh: 但愿，希望；满怀希望地
lemmas.def_en: used to express what you want to happen; in a hopeful manner

examples.en: Hopefully, the bad weather will clear up before our trip tomorrow.
examples.zh: 但愿恶劣天气能在我们明天出发前转晴。

lemmas.def_zh: 绝望地, 无可奈何地
lemmas.def_en: in a hopeless manner

examples.en: The small fishing boat was hopelessly lost in the dense coastal fog.
examples.zh: 这艘小渔船在沿海的浓雾中彻底迷失了方向。

lemmas.def_zh: 绝望的；毫无希望的；无能的
lemmas.def_en: feeling or causing despair; without expectation of success or improvement

examples.en: Despite their tireless efforts, the situation seemed utterly hopeless.
examples.zh: 尽管他们付出了不懈的努力，局势似乎依然毫无希望。

family_guide.root_logic: 核心词 hope 源于古英语 hopian，本义为“怀抱积极期望并信赖未来”；需特别注意形近词 hop（跳跃）在词源上与之无关，仅因拼写及屈折变化相似而常被归入易混对比。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意区分形近动词 hope（期盼）与 hop（跳跃）；另需注意 hopeful 除作形容词外，常作名词特指“有希望成功的人/竞争者”。

lemmas.def_zh: 提供，供给；规定，约定
lemmas.def_en: to make something available to someone; to stipulate or lay down as a condition

examples.en: The organization aims to provide clean drinking water for rural communities.
examples.zh: 该组织旨在为农村社区提供清洁饮用水。

lemmas.def_zh: 供给...食物及必需品
lemmas.def_en: supply with provisions

examples.en: The contract includes a special provision regarding the early termination of services.
examples.zh: 合同中包含一项关于提前终止服务的特殊条款。

lemmas.def_zh: (政府提供的)钱和设备, 准备, 供应品, 规定, 条款
lemmas.def_en: a stipulated condition

examples.en: The contract includes a special provision regarding the early termination of services.
examples.zh: 合同中包含一项关于提前终止服务的特殊条款。

lemmas.def_zh: 提供者；供应商，服务商；养家糊口的人
lemmas.def_en: a person or company that supplies a particular service or good; a breadwinner

examples.en: Consumers are advised to compare rates across different internet service providers.
examples.zh: 建议消费者对比不同网络服务提供商的收费标准。

lemmas.def_en: the capital and largest city of Rhode Island; located in northeastern Rhode Island on Narragansett Bay; site of Brown University
lemmas.def_zh: 天意，上天的保佑；远见

examples.en: By some divine providence, no one was injured in the massive explosion.
examples.zh: 承蒙某种天意的保佑，巨大的爆炸中竟然无人受伤。

lemmas.def_zh: 粮食供应者
lemmas.def_en: a supplier of victuals or supplies to an army

examples.en: The local provisioner supplied the sailing crew with fresh water and dry food.
examples.zh: 当地的补给商为船员提供了淡水和干粮。

lemmas.def_zh: 有先见之明的, 有远虑的, 节俭的
lemmas.def_en: providing carefully for the future

examples.en: A provident planner always saves a portion of their income for unforeseen emergencies.
examples.zh: 有远虑的规划者总是会存下一部分收入以备不时之需。

lemmas.def_en: peculiarly fortunate or appropriate; as if by divine intervention
lemmas.def_zh: 天意的, 根据神意的, 天佑的, 幸运的

examples.en: Finding an open shelter during the blizzard was a truly providential stroke.
examples.zh: 暴风雪中找到一间开门的避难所真是天赐的幸运。

lemmas.def_en: in a fortunately providential manner
lemmas.def_zh: 照天意, 靠天佑

examples.en: Providentially, a passing doctor treated his injury immediately after the crash occurred.
examples.zh: 所幸的是，车祸发生后恰好有一位路过的医生立即为他包扎了伤口。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 providere（pro- 向前/提前 + videre 看），本义为“向前看、未雨绸缪”，引申出“预先筹划准备”，最终演变为“提供所需之物或保障”。
family_guide.core_distinction: provide 为通用动词“提供”；provision 作动词时多特指“为…补给物资”或IT领域的“配置资源”，作名词则兼有“提供/准备”、“条款规定”及“粮秣补给(常用复数)”等义；provider 指提供者或服务商。

lemmas.def_zh: 工作, 零活, 职业, 事情
lemmas.def_en: the principal activity in your life that you do to earn money

examples.en: She applied for a new job at an international marketing firm yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天向一家跨国营销公司申请了一份新工作。

lemmas.def_zh: 做零工, 打杂, 做股票经纪, 假公济私；代客买卖, 批发, 承包, 欺骗
lemmas.def_en: profit privately from public office and official business

examples.en: She applied for a new job at an international marketing firm yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天向一家跨国营销公司申请了一份新工作。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于中古英语，本义为‘一小块、小宗差事’，后逐渐演变为表示具体的‘活计、任务’，并进一步泛指‘职业、受薪工作’，作动词时则表示承揽或分包工作、做零活。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词侧重指‘职位或具体任务’；动词用法较专业，多用于短语（如 job out）表示‘转包、外包’或指‘做临时零工’。

lemmas.def_zh: 小时；时间；时刻
lemmas.def_en: a period of time equal to 60 minutes; a particular time or moment

examples.en: The meeting lasted for over an hour and covered several key issues.
examples.zh: 会议持续了一个多小时，涵盖了几个关键问题。

examples.en: Staff are required to remain available during normal working hours.
examples.zh: 员工在正常工作时间内须保持可联系状态。

lemmas.def_zh: 每小时的；按钟点计算的
lemmas.def_en: occurring, done, or calculated once every hour

examples.en: The company decided to raise the hourly wage for part-time workers.
examples.zh: 公司决定提高兼职员工的时薪。

examples.en: The news channel provides hourly weather updates throughout the day.
examples.zh: 该新闻频道全天每小时播报一次最新天气信息。

lemmas.def_zh: 指示钟点的, 计数时间的, 每小时的
lemmas.def_en: relating to the hours

examples.en: The astrologer cast a horary chart to answer the client's urgent specific question.
examples.zh: 占星师绘制了一张占卜盘，以解答客户紧急的具体问题。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语和拉丁语中表示“时刻、时间”的词根，后演变为基本的时间计量单位（小时）及其衍生概念
family_guide.core_distinction: hour 为名词核心词，表示“小时”或特定“时刻”；hourly 为派生词，作形容词表示“每小时的”或“按小时计算的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 直到……为止；在……以前
lemmas.def_en: up to the point in time or the event mentioned

examples.en: Let's wait here until the rain stops.
examples.zh: 我们在这儿一直等到雨停吧。

examples.en: He didn't realize how late it was until the clock struck midnight.
examples.zh: 直到午夜钟声敲响，他才发觉已经这么晚了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺斯语前缀 und-（达到、朝向）与 till（直到）的合成，核心逻辑指某一动作或状态持续进行，直抵特定的时间或临界事件。

lemmas.def_zh: 成员；会员；构件；肢体
lemmas.def_en: a person, animal, or thing that belongs to a group, club, or organization; a limb or part of a structure

examples.en: She has been an active member of the committee for over ten years.
examples.zh: 十多年来，她一直是该委员会的活跃成员。

examples.en: All European Union member states are required to follow these regulations.
examples.zh: 所有欧盟成员国都必须遵守这些法规。

lemmas.def_zh: 会员身份；会员资格；全体会员
lemmas.def_en: the state of being a member of a group; the collective body of members

examples.en: You can renew your annual gym membership online.
examples.zh: 你可以在线续订你的健身房年度会员资格。

examples.en: The club's membership has grown significantly since the expansion.
examples.zh: 自扩建以来，该俱乐部的会员总数显著增加。

lemmas.def_zh: 非会员
lemmas.def_en: a person who is not a member

examples.en: Any nonmember who attends the conference must pay a slightly higher registration fee.
examples.zh: 参加会议的任何非会员都必须支付稍高的注册费。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 membrum（肢体、躯体的一部分），引申指构成整体的一个组成单元，即“成员”或“构件”。
family_guide.core_distinction: member 指具体的“成员、个体”，而 membership 指抽象的“成员资格、会员身份”或集合名词“全体成员”。

lemmas.def_zh: 不同的，有差异的；各种各样的
lemmas.def_en: not the same as another or each other; distinct in nature, form, or quality

examples.en: Her approach to solving the problem was completely different from mine.
examples.zh: 她解决这个问题的方法与我的截然不同。

examples.en: We explored three different options before making the final decision.
examples.zh: 在做出最终决定之前，我们探讨了三种不同的方案。

lemmas.def_zh: 无差别的, 一致的, 尚未显出差别的
lemmas.def_en: not differentiated

examples.en: The company struggled to sell its undifferentiated products against stronger, established brands.
examples.zh: 面对实力更强的成熟品牌，该公司很难售出其毫无特色的产品。

lemmas.def_zh: 不同地；有差别地
lemmas.def_en: in a way that is not the same; in another manner

examples.en: If I had the chance to start over, I would handle the situation very differently.
examples.zh: 如果我有重新开始的机会，我会以完全不同的方式处理这种情况。

examples.en: People from various cultural backgrounds often perceive time differently.
examples.zh: 来自不同文化背景的人对时间的感知往往有所不同。

lemmas.def_zh: 区别地
lemmas.def_en: in a differential manner

examples.en: The two patient groups responded differentially to the newly developed medical treatment.
examples.zh: 两组患者对这种新疗法表现出了截然不同的反应。

lemmas.def_zh: 相异，不同；持不同看法，意见分歧
lemmas.def_en: to be dissimilar or unlike; to disagree in opinion

examples.en: The two brothers differ widely in their tastes and political views.
examples.zh: 这两兄弟在品味和政治观点上大相径庭。

examples.en: I beg to differ, but the data does not support your conclusion.
examples.zh: 恕我不能苟同，这些数据并不支持你的结论。

lemmas.def_zh: 区分，辨别；使具有差别，构成…的独特性
lemmas.def_en: to recognize or show the difference between things; to make someone or something distinct

examples.en: It is difficult to differentiate between genuine antiques and clever fakes.
examples.zh: 要区分真古董与高仿赝品十分困难。

examples.en: Exceptional customer service helps the brand differentiate itself from competitors.
examples.zh: 卓越的客户服务有助于该品牌在竞争对手中脱颖而出。

lemmas.def_zh: 差异，不同之处；差额；意见分歧
lemmas.def_en: the way in which people or things are not the same; the amount by which things differ

examples.en: There is a noticeable difference between the draft and the final version.
examples.zh: 草案与最终版本之间存在显著差异。

examples.en: A balanced diet and regular exercise can make a big difference to your health.
examples.zh: 均衡饮食和规律运动会对你的健康产生重大积极影响。

lemmas.def_zh: 差额，级差；差速器
lemmas.def_en: a difference in amount, rate, or status between related groups; a gear allowing wheels to turn at different speeds

examples.en: The union is negotiating to close the wage differential between male and female workers.
examples.zh: 工会正在谈判以缩小男女员工之间的工资差距。

examples.en: A limited-slip differential provides better traction on slippery roads.
examples.zh: 限滑差速器在湿滑路面上能提供更好的抓地力。

lemmas.def_zh: 区别, 分化, 变异
lemmas.def_en: a discrimination between things as different and distinct

examples.en: Product differentiation helps the brand stand out in a heavily saturated market.
examples.zh: 产品差异化有助于该品牌在高度饱和的市场中脱颖而出。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 微分电路; 微分器
lemmas.def_en: a person who (or that which) differentiates

examples.en: Exceptional customer service serves as the primary differentiator for our small business.
examples.zh: 优质的客户服务是我们这家小企业的主要差异化优势。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语前缀 dis-（分开）与词根 ferre（携带），字面义为“向不同方向运送”，引申出“产生分歧、存在差异”的核心含义。

lemmas.def_zh: 难题，困难；逻辑/数学题
lemmas.def_en: a matter or situation regarded as unwelcome or harmful and needing to be dealt with; an inquiry or puzzle needing a solution

examples.en: The government is trying to solve the problem of rising unemployment.
examples.zh: 政府正在努力解决日益严峻的失业问题。

examples.en: Lack of regular exercise can lead to serious health problems.
examples.zh: 缺乏规律运动可能会引发严重的健康问题。

lemmas.def_en: open to doubt or debate
lemmas.def_zh: 成问题的, 未定的, 疑难的, 有疑问的, 盖然性的, 或然性的

examples.en: Relying entirely on unstable foreign markets has become increasingly problematic for the industry.
examples.zh: 对该行业而言，完全依赖不稳定的海外市场已经变得越来越成问题。

lemmas.def_en: easy and not involved or complicated
lemmas.def_zh: 不成问题的, 没有疑问的

examples.en: The software update was completely unproblematic and finished in just a few minutes.
examples.zh: 这次软件更新完全没有问题，几分钟就完成了。

lemmas.def_zh: 成问题的, 未定的, 疑难的, 有疑问的, 盖然性的, 或然性的
lemmas.def_en: open to doubt or debate

examples.en: Securing enough funding for the expedition proved far more problematical than initially expected.
examples.zh: 事实证明，为这次考察争取充足的资金远比最初预想的更为困难棘手。

lemmas.def_zh: 成问题地, 有疑问地
lemmas.def_en: in such a way as to pose a problem

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 pro-（向前）+ ballein（投掷），字面指“摆在面前的事物”，引申为需要面对和解决的难题或课题。

lemmas.def_zh: 公众的, 公共的, 公立的, 公用的
lemmas.def_en: not private; open to or concerning the people as a whole

examples.en: Local authorities invested heavily to improve public transportation systems across the city.
examples.zh: 地方当局大力投资以改善全市的公共交通系统。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 非公开
lemmas.def_en: not invested with or related to prominent position or status etc.

examples.en: The committee decided to review all sensitive financial documents in a nonpublic session.
examples.zh: 委员会决定在一次非公开会议上审查所有敏感的财务文件。

lemmas.def_zh: 公众, 民众
lemmas.def_en: people in general considered as a whole

examples.en: Local authorities invested heavily to improve public transportation systems across the city.
examples.zh: 地方当局大力投资以改善全市的公共交通系统。

lemmas.def_zh: 名声, 宣传, 公开场合
lemmas.def_en: a message issued in behalf of some product or cause or idea or person or institution

examples.en: The controversial advertising campaign generated a tremendous amount of free publicity worldwide.
examples.zh: 这个颇具争议的广告活动在全球范围内获得了极大的免费宣传效应。

lemmas.def_zh: 公然地, 以公众名义
lemmas.def_en: in a manner accessible to or observable by the public; openly

examples.en: The mayor publicly apologized for the sudden disruption caused by the construction project.
examples.zh: 市长就施工项目造成的突发混乱向公众公开道歉。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 公然
lemmas.def_en: in a manner accessible to or observable by the public; openly

examples.en: He publically defended his team's controversial decisions during the live televised press interview.
examples.zh: 他在电视直播的新闻采访中公然为团队的争议决定辩护。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于拉丁语 publicus（衍生自 populus，意为“人民、民众”），核心逻辑为“属于人民的、向所有人开放的”，由此引申出公共、公开、公众及宣传等含义。
family_guide.core_distinction: public 作名词时指“公众/大众”（人群本身）；publicity 则指“公众关注度、宣传报道”（媒体曝光与信息传播）。

lemmas.def_zh: 行动, 表演, 假装, 见效, 表现, 担当；扮演, 装作
lemmas.def_en: perform an action, or work out or perform (an action)

examples.en: We must act swiftly before the harsh winter conditions worsen the current crisis.
examples.zh: 在恶劣的冬季天气加剧当前危机之前，我们必须迅速行动。

lemmas.def_zh: 行动，举措；行为；诉讼；情节
lemmas.def_en: the process of doing something to achieve a purpose; deeds or conduct; legal proceedings

examples.en: We need to take immediate action to resolve the customer's complaint.
examples.zh: 我们需要立即采取行动来解决客户的投诉。

examples.en: The company is facing legal action over copyright infringement.
examples.zh: 该公​​司正因侵犯版权而面临法律诉讼。

lemmas.def_zh: 开动, 驱使, 激励
lemmas.def_en: put in motion or move to act

examples.en: A simple electric current is required to actuate the building's emergency sprinkler system.
examples.zh: 只需微弱的电流就能启动这栋建筑的紧急喷淋系统。

lemmas.def_zh: 行动, 行为, 幕, 法案
lemmas.def_en: a legal document codifying the result of deliberations of a committee or society or legislative body

examples.en: We must act swiftly before the harsh winter conditions worsen the current crisis.
examples.zh: 在恶劣的冬季天气加剧当前危机之前，我们必须迅速行动。

lemmas.def_zh: 行动，举措；行为；诉讼；情节
lemmas.def_en: the process of doing something to achieve a purpose; deeds or conduct; legal proceedings

examples.en: We need to take immediate action to resolve the customer's complaint.
examples.zh: 我们需要立即采取行动来解决客户的投诉。

examples.en: The company is facing legal action over copyright infringement.
examples.zh: 该公​​司正因侵犯版权而面临法律诉讼。

lemmas.def_zh: 男演员, 行动者
lemmas.def_en: a theatrical performer

examples.en: The talented actor received widespread praise for his convincing portrayal of the detective.
examples.zh: 这位才华横溢的演员因令人信服地饰演该侦探而备受赞誉。

lemmas.def_zh: 开动者, 激励者, 致动器
lemmas.def_en: a mechanism that puts something into automatic action

examples.en: The robotic arm failed to move because its primary mechanical actuator was damaged.
examples.zh: 由于主要的机械执行器损坏，机械臂无法移动。

lemmas.def_zh: 开动, 激励
lemmas.def_en: the act of propelling

examples.en: Rapid actuation of the safety valves prevented a catastrophic explosion in the laboratory.
examples.zh: 安全阀的迅速启动防止了实验室发生灾难性爆炸。

lemmas.def_zh: 可提起诉讼的
lemmas.def_en: affording grounds for legal action

examples.en: His false statements caused financial damage and were deemed actionable by the court.
examples.zh: 他的虚假言论造成了经济损失，被法院认定为可提起诉讼。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 agere/actum（驱动、做、付诸行动），由‘具体去做某事’延伸至‘表现举止、扮演角色’及具有约束力的‘法规行为’。
family_guide.core_distinction: act 既作核心动词表示行动或表演，也作名词指单次行为、法案或戏剧幕次；actor 则是施动者，专指演员或具有行动影响力的参与主体。

lemmas.def_zh: 政府；政体；统治，管辖
lemmas.def_en: the group of people with the authority to govern a country or state, or the system by which it is governed

examples.en: The federal government announced a series of new economic measures to curb inflation.
examples.zh: 联邦政府公布了一系列遏制通货膨胀的新经济措施。

examples.en: Freedom of the press is vital to maintaining a democratic form of government.
examples.zh: 新闻自由对维系民主政体至关重要。

lemmas.def_zh: 州长；省长；总督；（机构的）理事，董事
lemmas.def_en: the elected or appointed head of a state or province; a member of a governing body

examples.en: The state governor issued an executive order to protect coastal wetlands.
examples.zh: 州长签署了一项行政命令以保护沿海湿地。

examples.en: He serves as a governor of the central bank, overseeing monetary policy.
examples.zh: 他担任央行理事，负责监管货币政策。

lemmas.def_zh: 治理；管理方式；管辖机制
lemmas.def_en: the action, manner, or system of governing a country, corporation, or organization

examples.en: The board pledged to strengthen corporate governance and improve financial transparency.
examples.zh: 董事会承诺加强公司治理并提高财务透明度。

examples.en: Effective global governance is required to tackle cross-border environmental challenges.
examples.zh: 应对跨境环境挑战需要行之有效的全球治理机制。

lemmas.def_zh: 统治者的职位/任期
lemmas.def_en: the office of governor

examples.en: During his four-year governorship, the state experienced significant economic growth.
examples.zh: 在他担任州长的四年任期内，该州经济显著增长。

lemmas.def_zh: 恶政, 政治腐败, 治国无方
lemmas.def_en: government that is inefficient or dishonest

examples.en: Decades of severe economic misgovernment led to widespread shortages of essential basic goods.
examples.zh: 数十年严重的经济恶政导致基本必需品大范围短缺。

lemmas.def_zh: 统治；治理；支配，控制
lemmas.def_en: to conduct the policy and affairs of a state or organization; to control or influence directly

examples.en: The country has been governed by a fragile coalition for the past decade.
examples.zh: 在过去的十年里，这个国家一直由一个脆弱的执政联盟治理。

examples.en: Basic economic principles govern the pricing of commodities in a free market.
examples.zh: 基本经济法则支配着自由市场中商品的价格。

lemmas.def_zh: 州长的, 统治者的
lemmas.def_en: relating to a governor

examples.en: Debates intensified as the upcoming gubernatorial election drew closer across the entire state.
examples.zh: 随着全州即将举行的州长选举临近，辩论愈演愈烈。

lemmas.def_zh: 不受统治(或支配、控制)的,粗野的,放纵的,放肆的
lemmas.def_en: not restrained or controlled

examples.en: His ungoverned temper often caused serious problems during important business meetings.
examples.zh: 他那难以控制的脾气常在重要商务会议上惹出大麻烦。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 gubernare（掌舵、驾驶、统治），后加表示行为或结果的名词后缀 -ment，引申为管理、统治国家或机构的组织与体制。

lemmas.def_zh: 上帝，天主；神，神祇；极受崇拜的人（或物）
lemmas.def_en: the creator and ruler of the universe (capitalized); a superhuman being or spirit; a person or thing that is greatly admired

examples.en: Many ancient cultures believed that the sun was a powerful god.
examples.zh: 许多古代文明认为太阳是一位法力高强的神祇。

examples.en: To millions of young fans, the rock star was nothing short of a god.
examples.zh: 对数以百万计的年轻歌迷来说，这位摇滚明星无异于偶像天神。

lemmas.def_zh: 虔诚, 敬神, 信仰
lemmas.def_en: piety by virtue of being a godly person

examples.en: The quiet village was famous for its traditional values of humility and godliness.
examples.zh: 这个寂静的村庄以谦逊和虔诚的传统价值观而闻名。

lemmas.def_zh: 不虔诚, 违反神旨
lemmas.def_en: impiety by virtue of not being a godly person

examples.en: The strict preacher constantly warned his congregation against the dangerous temptations of ungodliness.
examples.zh: 严厉的传教士不断警告他的教众要抵御不敬神的危险诱惑。

lemmas.def_zh: 敬神的, 虔诚的, 神的
lemmas.def_en: showing great reverence for god

examples.en: She dedicated her long life to charitable works, earning praise as a godly woman.
examples.zh: 她将漫长的一生奉献给慈善事业，赢得了虔诚女性的赞誉。

lemmas.def_zh: 不敬畏神的, 不可思议的, 邪恶的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by iniquity; wicked because it is believed to be a sin

examples.en: The team was forced to wake up at an ungodly hour to catch their flight.
examples.zh: 队员们被迫在极其荒谬的大清早起床去赶航班。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语，核心语义为“被祈求或被祭拜的超自然存在”，现代英语中既可指一神教中唯一的创造者与主宰（大写God），也可指多神体系中的神祇或引申指备受崇拜的人事物（小写god）。

lemmas.def_zh: 创造，创建；引起，造成
lemmas.def_en: to bring something into existence; to cause something to happen

examples.en: The government aims to create thousands of new jobs in the tech sector.
examples.zh: 政府旨在科技领域创造数千个新的就业机会。

examples.en: His sudden resignation created a great deal of confusion among the staff.
examples.zh: 他的突然辞职在员工中引起了极大的混乱。

lemmas.def_zh: 有创造力的，创新的；创造性的
lemmas.def_en: involving the use of imagination or original ideas to make something

examples.en: We are looking for creative solutions to this longstanding problem.
examples.zh: 我们正在寻找针对这一长期存在问题的创新解决方案。

examples.en: She channeled her energy into creative writing and painting.
examples.zh: 她把精力投入到了创意写作和绘画中。

lemmas.def_zh: 缺乏创造性的, 枯燥无味的
lemmas.def_en: not creative

examples.en: Critics dismissed the new movie as a completely uncreative sequel lacking fresh ideas.
examples.zh: 评论家批评这部新电影是毫无创意、缺乏新意的续集。

lemmas.def_zh: 创造，创立；创造物，作品
lemmas.def_en: the act of making something, or something that has been made

examples.en: The museum displays the fashion designer's latest creations.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出了这位服装设计师的最新作品。

examples.en: The creation of an independent committee ensured complete transparency.
examples.zh: 设立独立委员会确保了充分的透明度。

lemmas.def_zh: 创作者，制造者；创造者
lemmas.def_en: a person or thing that brings something into existence

examples.en: The platform allows digital content creators to monetize their work directly.
examples.zh: 该平台允许数字内容创作者直接将其作品变现。

examples.en: Walt Disney is remembered as the creator of Mickey Mouse.
examples.zh: 沃尔特·迪士尼被世人铭记为米老鼠的创造者。

lemmas.def_en: a living organism characterized by voluntary movement
lemmas.def_zh: 生物，动物，人

examples.en: The deep ocean is home to many strange creatures.
examples.zh: 深海是许多奇特生物的家园。

lemmas.def_zh: 创造力，独创性
lemmas.def_en: the ability to produce original and unusual ideas or make new things

examples.en: The art class encourages children to express their creativity freely.
examples.zh: 美术课鼓励孩子们自由表达他们的创造力。

examples.en: Rigid rules can often stifle innovation and workplace creativity.
examples.zh: 死板的规则往往会扼杀创新和职场创造力。

lemmas.def_zh: 创造性；才思
lemmas.def_en: the ability to create

examples.en: Her natural creativeness allowed her to develop innovative solutions under very tight deadlines.
examples.zh: 她与生俱来的创造力使她能在紧迫的截止日期前拿出创新的解决方案。

lemmas.def_zh: 创造性地；有创造力地
lemmas.def_en: in a creative manner

examples.en: The design team solved the complex spatial layout problem creatively and within budget.
examples.zh: 设计团队创造性地解决了复杂的空间布局问题，且未超预算。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 creare（产生、生长、制造），核心语义逻辑为“从无到有地生成、发明或引起新事物”。
family_guide.core_distinction: creation 侧重创造的“动作过程”或“产物/作品”；creativity 侧重主体具备的“创造才能与独创性”；creator 则指“创造者”。

lemmas.def_zh: 顶部, 顶端, 极点, 上面, 上部, 顶篷, 最高地位, 首位, 陀螺
lemmas.def_en: the upper part of anything
