examples.en: We finally reached the rocky top of the mountain after five strenuous hours.
examples.zh: 经过五个小时的艰苦跋涉，我们终于到达了岩石嶙峋的山顶。

lemmas.def_zh: 除顶部, 修剪树稍, 剪落之小树枝
lemmas.def_en: a flavorful addition on top of a dish

examples.en: Chocolate syrup remains my favorite topping for freshly baked vanilla ice cream desserts.
examples.zh: 巧克力糖浆依然是我最喜欢的现烤香草冰淇淋甜点配料。

lemmas.def_zh: 第一流的人物, 高档的东西, 胜过以前同类物的东西, 大礼帽, 轻便大衣
lemmas.def_en: a worker who makes or adds the top to something

examples.en: The final spectacular firework display served as a magnificent topper to the festival.
examples.zh: 最后一场壮观的焰火表演为整个节日庆典画上了精彩绝伦的句号。

lemmas.def_zh: 盖, 加以顶, 高达, 超越；结束, 达到顶点, 高出
lemmas.def_en: be superior or better than some standard

examples.en: We finally reached the rocky top of the mountain after five strenuous hours.
examples.zh: 经过五个小时的艰苦跋涉，我们终于到达了岩石嶙峋的山顶。

lemmas.def_zh: 最高的, 顶上的, 头等的
lemmas.def_en: situated at the top or highest position

examples.en: She reached the top shelf without needing a stool.
examples.zh: 她不用凳子就能够到最高的架子。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语，核心语义为“顶端、最高点”，由此引申出具象的“上衣、覆盖物”、抽象的“首位/顶尖地位”以及动作“超越、位居…之首”。
family_guide.core_distinction: top 兼具名词（顶部/上衣）、形容词（最高/顶级的）和动词（超越/加顶）；topping 则专指加在食物顶部的配料或浇头。

lemmas.def_zh: 小的, 少的, 小型的, 低微的, 小气的, 细微的
lemmas.def_en: limited or below average in number or quantity or magnitude or extent

examples.en: He rubbed the small of his back after heavy lifting.
examples.zh: 重体力劳动后，他揉了揉后腰部位。

lemmas.def_zh: 狭小部分
lemmas.def_en: the slender part of the back

examples.en: He rubbed the small of his back after heavy lifting.
examples.zh: 重体力劳动后，他揉了揉后腰部位。

lemmas.def_zh: 小, 贫乏, 小气
lemmas.def_en: the property of having a relatively small size

examples.en: The smallness of the apartment made storage quite difficult.
examples.zh: 公寓的狭小让储物变得十分困难。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语，核心语义始终围绕“体量、尺寸、数量或程度的细小、微弱”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词指“小的、微小的”；名词用法极为特定，单数常指人体细窄处（如后腰），复数口语中可指“小件内衣”。

lemmas.def_zh: 决定；裁决；解决
lemmas.def_en: to make a choice or judgment after considering the options; to resolve an issue

examples.en: She decided to accept the job offer after weighing all the pros and cons.
examples.zh: 在权衡利弊之后，她决定接受这份工作邀请。

examples.en: A sudden shift in public opinion could decide the outcome of the election.
examples.zh: 公众舆论的突变可能会决定选举的结果。

lemmas.def_zh: 决定，抉择；决断力
lemmas.def_en: a choice or judgment arrived at after deliberation; the ability to decide firmly

examples.en: The board will announce its final decision at tomorrow's press conference.
examples.zh: 董事会将在明天的记者会上宣布最终决定。

examples.en: In moments of crisis, hesitation is costly; leaders must act with decision.
examples.zh: 在危机时刻犹豫代价巨大，领导者必须果断行动。

lemmas.def_zh: 果断性
lemmas.def_en: the trait of resoluteness as evidenced by firmness of character or purpose

examples.en: Her decisiveness in critical moments impressed the whole team.
examples.zh: 她在关键时刻的果断给整个团队留下了深刻印象。

lemmas.def_zh: 决定性的；果断的，坚决的
lemmas.def_en: having a crucial effect on the outcome; showing an ability to make decisions quickly and firmly

examples.en: Her swift intervention played a decisive role in resolving the conflict.
examples.zh: 她的迅速介入在平息这场冲突中起到了决定性作用。

examples.en: The team needs a decisive manager who can take risks under pressure.
examples.zh: 该团队需要一位能在压力下敢于承担风险、行事果断的管理者。

lemmas.def_zh: 未定的, 不明确的
lemmas.def_en: not brought to a conclusion; subject to further thought

examples.en: The committee remains undecided about the proposed budget changes.
examples.zh: 委员会对提议的预算变动仍悬而未决。

lemmas.def_zh: 决定了, 坚决, 明显, 显而易见, 显然, 明确, 果断, 毫无疑问
lemmas.def_en: without question and beyond doubt

examples.en: The weather turned decidedly cooler after the evening storm.
examples.zh: 傍晚的风暴过后，天气明显变凉了。

lemmas.def_zh: 果断地；决然地
lemmas.def_en: with firmness

examples.en: The general acted decisively to protect the border city.
examples.zh: 将军果断采取行动以保护边境城市。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 decidere（de- '彻底' + caedere '砍、切'），字面意为‘一刀切断’，引申指斩断犹豫、作出裁决。
family_guide.core_distinction: decisive 兼具客观的‘决定性的（影响结果）’与主观的‘果断的（性格/作风）’两种用法。

lemmas.def_zh: 脸, 面容, 正面, 外观
lemmas.def_en: the front of the human head from the forehead to the chin and ear to ear

examples.en: We must face the truth and find a realistic solution.
examples.zh: 我们必须正视现实，寻找一个切实的解决办法。

lemmas.def_zh: 贴边, 饰面
lemmas.def_en: a lining applied to the edge of a garment for ornamentation or strengthening

examples.en: The jacket has a stylish velvet facing on the collar.
examples.zh: 这件夹克的衣领有一层时尚的丝绒贴边。

lemmas.def_zh: 美颜, 脸部按摩
lemmas.def_en: cranial nerve that supplies facial muscles

examples.en: She booked a relaxing facial before her wedding ceremony.
examples.zh: 她在婚礼前预约了一次舒缓的面部护理。

lemmas.def_zh: 面对, 朝, 正视, 面临；朝, 向
lemmas.def_en: deal with (something unpleasant) head on

examples.en: We must face the truth and find a realistic solution.
examples.zh: 我们必须正视现实，寻找一个切实的解决办法。

lemmas.def_zh: 无面的, 无个性的, 匿名的, 无名的
lemmas.def_en: without a face or identity

examples.en: Large corporations often seem faceless to the general public.
examples.zh: 大企业在公众眼中往往显得冷漠无个性。

lemmas.def_zh: 从脸部
lemmas.def_en: with respect to the face

examples.en: Although they are twins, they do not look facially identical.
examples.zh: 虽然他们是双胞胎，但面容看起来并不完全相同。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 facies（外貌、脸、外表），核心语义围绕人或物体的“正面、表层”展开，衍生出面向、直面（动词）及外层修饰、面部护理等名词词义。
family_guide.core_distinction: facing 多指建筑表面的贴面饰层或衣物贴边，而 facial 作名词时专指美容护肤中的“面部护理”。

lemmas.def_zh: 看, 注视, 照顾, 看守, 守护, 监视；观看, 注视, 守侯
lemmas.def_en: look attentively

examples.en: He checked his watch and realized he was already late.
examples.zh: 他看了一眼手表，意识到自己已经迟到了。

lemmas.def_zh: 观察, 手表, 看守, 守护, 监视, 值班人
lemmas.def_en: a small portable timepiece

examples.en: He checked his watch and realized he was already late.
examples.zh: 他看了一眼手表，意识到自己已经迟到了。

lemmas.def_zh: 看守人, 守望者, 哨兵
lemmas.def_en: a close observer; someone who looks at something (such as an exhibition of some kind)

examples.en: The silent bird watcher spotted an eagle across the lake.
examples.zh: 那位安静的观鸟者在湖对岸发现了一只鹰。

lemmas.def_zh: 警惕, 戒备, 不眠
lemmas.def_en: the process of paying close and continuous attention

examples.en: Security requires constant watchfulness in this crowded airport area.
examples.zh: 在这个拥挤的机场区域，安保需要时刻保持警惕。

lemmas.def_zh: 注意的, 警戒的, 警醒的, (时间)醒着换过的
lemmas.def_en: engaged in or accustomed to close observation

examples.en: The mother cat kept a watchful eye on her new kittens.
examples.zh: 母猫警惕地看护着她刚出生的小猫。

lemmas.def_zh: 警惕地, 留心地
lemmas.def_en: in a watchful manner

examples.en: The guard looked watchfully around the bank entrance at night.
examples.zh: 夜间警卫警惕地环视着银行入口四周。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 wæccan（保持清醒、警惕），与 wake（醒来）同源，核心意象是从“醒着守夜”引申为专注注视、监视警戒以及计时的手表。

lemmas.def_zh: 管理，负责；设法做到，应付
lemmas.def_en: to be in charge of; to succeed in doing something difficult

examples.en: She manages a team of twenty software engineers.
examples.zh: 她管理着一个由二十名软件工程师组成的团队。

examples.en: How did you manage to finish the project ahead of the deadline?
examples.zh: 你是如何设法赶在截止日期前完成这个项目的？

lemmas.def_zh: 处置失当, 对...管理不善
lemmas.def_en: manage badly or incompetently

examples.en: Inexperienced leaders can easily mismanage valuable public funds.
examples.zh: 缺乏经验的领导者很容易对宝贵的公共资金管理不善。

lemmas.def_zh: 管理，经营；管理层，资方
lemmas.def_en: the control and organization of something; the people in charge of an organization

examples.en: Good time management is essential for academic success.
examples.zh: 良好的时间管理对学业成功至关重要。

examples.en: The dispute between workers and management has finally been resolved.
examples.zh: 工人们与管理层之间的纷争终于得到了解决。

lemmas.def_zh: 经理；主管；管理者
lemmas.def_en: a person responsible for controlling or administering an organization or group of staff

examples.en: You need to discuss your leave request with the project manager.
examples.zh: 你需要和项目经理商讨你的请假申请。

lemmas.def_zh: 管理不善；处置失当
lemmas.def_en: management that is careless or inefficient

examples.en: The company failed mainly due to poor financial mismanagement.
examples.zh: 这家公司的倒闭主要是由于严重的财务管理不善。

lemmas.def_zh: 易办, 易处理, 顺从
lemmas.def_en: capable of being managed or controlled

examples.en: Reducing classroom size greatly improves the manageability of students.
examples.zh: 缩减班级规模能极大提高学生管理的便利性。

lemmas.def_zh: 经理地位
lemmas.def_en: the position of manager

examples.en: Under his strict managership, the branch achieved record profits.
examples.zh: 在他的严格管理下，该分公司创下了利润纪录。

lemmas.def_zh: 管理的；经营上的；经理的
lemmas.def_en: relating to the duties or responsibilities of a manager

examples.en: She has strong technical skills but lacks managerial experience.
examples.zh: 她专业技能很强，但缺乏管理经验。

lemmas.def_zh: 易办的, 易管理的, 易控制的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being managed or controlled

examples.en: Break the large project into smaller, more manageable tasks.
examples.zh: 把这个大项目分解成更小、更易处理的任务。

lemmas.def_zh: 难管理的, 难处理的, 难操纵的, 处理不了的
lemmas.def_en: difficult to use or handle or manage because of size or weight or shape

examples.en: The classroom became unmanageable when the teacher stepped out for a moment.
examples.zh: 老师暂时离开时，教室变得难以管束。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 manus（手），经由驯马和操纵工具的语境，演变出用手掌控、处理事务并使之顺服的核心义。
family_guide.core_distinction: management 侧重管理的抽象行为、手段或总称意义上的“管理层”；manager 则是具体的职务担当者个体；managerial 专用于修饰与管理职责相关的属性。

lemmas.def_zh: 打破, 弄破, 弄坏, 破坏, 违反, 打断, 削弱, 放弃；破碎, 决裂, 破晓, 突变, 变弱, 暂停
lemmas.def_en: terminate

examples.en: Be careful not to break the delicate vase while dusting the shelf.
examples.zh: 给架子除尘时，当心别打碎那个精致的花瓶。

lemmas.def_zh: break的过去分词
lemmas.def_en: terminate

examples.en: The child sat on the pavement, crying over his broken plastic toy.
examples.zh: 孩子坐在人行道上，对着摔坏的塑料玩具哭泣。

lemmas.def_zh: break的过去式
lemmas.def_en: terminate

examples.en: He accidentally broke his sister's favorite coffee mug while washing the dishes.
examples.zh: 他在洗碗时不小心打碎了姐姐最喜欢的咖啡杯。

lemmas.def_zh: 休息, 中断, 破裂处, 绝交, 破晓, 突变；分隔符
lemmas.def_en: some abrupt occurrence that interrupts an ongoing activity

examples.en: Be careful not to break the delicate vase while dusting the shelf.
examples.zh: 给架子除尘时，当心别打碎那个精致的花瓶。

lemmas.def_zh: 断路器
lemmas.def_en: a quarry worker who splits off blocks of stone

examples.en: The circuit breaker tripped immediately when she plugged in the faulty heater.
examples.zh: 当她插上有故障的取暖器时，断路器立刻跳闸了。

lemmas.def_zh: 破坏, 破损处, 破损量
lemmas.def_en: the quantity broken

examples.en: The moving company promised to cover any breakage that occurred during transit.
examples.zh: 搬家公司承诺赔偿运输过程中发生的所有破损。

lemmas.def_zh: 易破的东西, 易碎的东西
lemmas.def_en: an article that is fragile and easily broken

examples.en: Please pack the breakables in bubble wrap before putting them in boxes.
examples.zh: 在装箱之前，请用气泡膜把易碎品包裹好。

lemmas.def_zh: 坏掉的, 打破的, 断掉的
lemmas.def_en: physically and forcibly separated into pieces or cracked or split

examples.en: The child sat on the pavement, crying over his broken plastic toy.
examples.zh: 孩子坐在人行道上，对着摔坏的塑料玩具哭泣。

lemmas.def_zh: 一文不名的
lemmas.def_en: lacking funds

examples.en: He accidentally broke his sister's favorite coffee mug while washing the dishes.
examples.zh: 他在洗碗时不小心打碎了姐姐最喜欢的咖啡杯。

lemmas.def_zh: 未破损的, 未被征服的, 未打垮的, 不屈服的, 不涣散的, 整齐的, 未中断的
lemmas.def_en: marked by continuous or uninterrupted extension in space or time or sequence

examples.en: Miraculously, the ancient glass bowl remained unbroken after the severe earthquake.
examples.zh: 奇迹般的是，那只古老的玻璃碗在大地震后完好无损。

lemmas.def_zh: 不会破的, 不易打碎的
lemmas.def_en: impossible to break especially under ordinary usage

examples.en: These outdoor plates are made of durable plastic and are virtually unbreakable.
examples.zh: 这些户外餐盘由耐用塑料制成，几乎摔不破。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 brecan，核心表象为“施力使原本完整的物体断裂、分开”，后延伸至抽象层面的“中断延续”、“破坏规则”与“精神挫败”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 作形容词时，broken 强调物体损坏、关系/精神破裂或语言不流利；broke 则专指口语中“身无分文、破产”的状态。

lemmas.def_zh: 宴会, 党, 政党, 团体, 当事人, 聚会
lemmas.def_en: an organization to gain political power

examples.en: Our department decided to party at a local restaurant after finishing the project.
examples.zh: 完成项目后，我们部门决定在当地一家餐馆聚餐庆祝。

examples.en: They partied late into the night to celebrate their successful graduation.
examples.zh: 他们通宵狂欢聚会，庆祝顺利毕业。

lemmas.def_zh: 举办聚会
lemmas.def_en: have or participate in a party

examples.en: Our department decided to party at a local restaurant after finishing the project.
examples.zh: 完成项目后，我们部门决定在当地一家餐馆聚餐庆祝。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 partire（分开、分成部分），核心逻辑从“（整体中的）一部分或一方”演变为政党、法律当事方，后进一步引申为志趣相投者的“聚会”及“狂欢”行为。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词兼具“聚会、政党、当事方”等多重领域含义；动词则专指“尽情狂欢、参加派对”。

lemmas.def_zh: 音乐；乐曲
lemmas.def_en: vocal or instrumental sounds combined in such a way as to produce beauty of form, harmony, and expression of emotion

examples.en: She enjoys listening to classical music to unwind after a long day.
examples.zh: 漫长的一天结束后，她喜欢听古典音乐来放松身心。

examples.en: The festival features live music from bands across the country.
examples.zh: 该音乐节汇集了来自全国各地乐队的现场音乐表演。

lemmas.def_zh: 音乐剧；歌舞片
lemmas.def_en: a play or movie in which singing and dancing play an essential part

examples.en: The new Broadway musical received rave reviews from critics.
examples.zh: 这部新的百老汇音乐剧获得了剧评家的一致好评。

lemmas.def_zh: 音乐家；乐手
lemmas.def_en: a person who plays a musical instrument or writes music, especially professionally

examples.en: Talented jazz musicians gathered in the club for an impromptu jam session.
examples.zh: 才华横溢的爵士乐手们聚集在俱乐部进行即兴演奏。

lemmas.def_zh: 音乐技巧,音乐感,音乐才能,音乐修养, 音乐鉴赏力
lemmas.def_en: artistry in performing music

examples.en: The pianist demonstrated extraordinary musicianship throughout the entire difficult performance.
examples.zh: 这位钢琴家在整场高难度演出中展现了非凡的音乐修养。

lemmas.def_zh: 和谐, 音乐才能, 悦耳
lemmas.def_en: the property of sounding like music

examples.en: Her natural musicality made her effortlessly master the complex violin piece.
examples.zh: 她与生俱来的音乐才能让她轻松掌握了那首复杂的小提琴曲。

lemmas.def_zh: 音乐上
lemmas.def_en: in a musical manner

examples.en: Both sisters are musically gifted and regularly perform in the school orchestra.
examples.zh: 两姐妹在音乐上都很有天赋，经常在学校管弦乐团演出。

lemmas.def_zh: 不合调的, 不悦耳的, 演奏音乐不熟练的, 对音乐不感兴趣的
lemmas.def_en: lacking interest in or talent for music

examples.en: The old engine produced a harsh, unmusical grinding sound that bothered everyone.
examples.zh: 旧引擎发出刺耳嘈杂的摩擦声，让所有人都觉得心烦。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 非穆斯林
lemmas.def_en: lacking interest in or talent for music

examples.en: The camp offers several nonmusical activities, including hiking, painting, and competitive sports.
examples.zh: 该营地提供多种非音乐类活动，包括徒步、绘画和体育竞技。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊神话掌管文艺的缪斯女神（Muses），核心含义贯穿‘音乐艺术’及其表演形式与从业者。
family_guide.core_distinction: musical 作名词时特指‘音乐剧/歌舞片’；musician 则是指演奏或创作的‘音乐家/乐手’。

lemmas.def_zh: 坚硬的；困难的，费力的；严厉的，艰难的
lemmas.def_en: solid, firm, and resistant to pressure; difficult to do, understand, or deal with; harsh or severe

examples.en: The winter frost made the soil too hard to dig.
examples.zh: 冬天的霜冻让土壤变得太坚硬，难以挖掘。

examples.en: She had to make a hard decision between her career and her family.
examples.zh: 她不得不在事业与家庭之间做出艰难的抉择。

lemmas.def_zh: 坚硬, 困难, 严厉, 勇气
lemmas.def_en: the property of being rigid and resistant to pressure; not easily scratched; measured on Mohs scale

examples.en: Geologists use a special scale to measure the relative hardness of minerals.
examples.zh: 地质学家使用专门的硬度表来测量矿物的相对硬度。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语，本义为“坚固、紧实”，后由物理上的“坚硬耐抗”引申为抽象维度的“费力困难的”以及态度/环境上的“严苛冷酷的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意 hard 既可作形容词也可作副词（意为“努力地/猛烈地”），切勿与副词 hardly（意为“几乎不”）混淆。

lemmas.def_zh: 指示, 指挥, 命令, 导演；指导, 指挥
lemmas.def_en: command with authority

examples.en: A police officer stood at the busy intersection to direct peak-hour traffic.
examples.zh: 一名警察站在繁忙的十字路口指挥高峰时段的交通。

lemmas.def_zh: 误导, 写错地址
lemmas.def_en: corrupt morally or by intemperance or sensuality

examples.en: A typo in the postal code will inevitably misdirect the important package.
examples.zh: 邮政编码中的打字错误难免会使这个重要包裹寄错地址。

lemmas.def_zh: 直接的, 坦白的
lemmas.def_en: direct in spatial dimensions; proceeding without deviation or interruption; straight and short

examples.en: A police officer stood at the busy intersection to direct peak-hour traffic.
examples.zh: 一名警察站在繁忙的十字路口指挥高峰时段的交通。

lemmas.def_zh: 未受指导的, 无姓名和地址的
lemmas.def_en: aimlessly drifting

examples.en: Without a clear agenda, the meeting became an undirected and unproductive discussion.
examples.zh: 由于缺乏明确的议程，会议变成了一场毫无指导、徒劳无果的讨论。

lemmas.def_zh: 主管；董事；导演
lemmas.def_en: a person in charge of an organization, department, or artistic production

examples.en: She was appointed as the creative director of the advertising agency.
examples.zh: 她被任命为该广告公司的创意总监。

lemmas.def_zh: 指令；指导方针；行政命令
lemmas.def_en: an official instruction or authoritative order

examples.en: The European Union issued a new directive on environmental protection.
examples.zh: 欧盟发布了一项关于环境保护的新指令。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 错误指示, 错误指导
lemmas.def_en: an incorrect charge to a jury given by a judge

examples.en: The judge's misdirection to the jury led to an immediate appeal of the verdict.
examples.zh: 法官对陪审团的错误指引导致该判决立即被上诉。

lemmas.def_zh: 笔直, 率直
lemmas.def_en: trueness of course toward a goal

examples.en: I appreciate her directness when giving feedback on our team's creative projects.
examples.zh: 我很欣赏她在对我们团队的创意项目提出反馈时的坦率。

lemmas.def_zh: 管理者的职位
lemmas.def_en: the position of a director of a business concern

examples.en: He accepted the directorship of the new medical research institute last month.
examples.zh: 他上个月接任了这家新医学研究所的所长职位。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 指向性, 方向性
lemmas.def_en: the property of a microphone or antenna of being more sensitive in one direction than in another

examples.en: The antenna's high directivity ensures a strong signal over very long distances.
examples.zh: 该天线的高方向性确保了超长距离内的强信号传输。

lemmas.def_zh: 直接地；径直地；立即
lemmas.def_en: without anyone or anything in between; straight; immediately

examples.en: The new tax regulation will directly affect small business owners.
examples.zh: 新的税收法规将直接影响小企业主。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 dirigere（彻底使笔直/引向目标），核心意象为“笔直到达”与“规范指引”，引申出“直接的”、“指导/管理”以及具体的人或指令。
family_guide.core_distinction: director 是发出指示、负责管理的人（总监、导演）；directive 则是官方发布的书面指引或行政指令本身。

lemmas.def_zh: 全面的, 大体的, 总的, 一般的, 普遍的
lemmas.def_en: applying to all or most members of a category or group

examples.en: There is a general consensus among scientists that the climate is changing rapidly.
examples.zh: 科学家们普遍认同气候正在迅速变化。

lemmas.def_zh: 一般, 将军, 大体；常规
lemmas.def_en: a general officer of the highest rank

examples.en: There is a general consensus among scientists that the climate is changing rapidly.
examples.zh: 科学家们普遍认同气候正在迅速变化。

lemmas.def_zh: 概论, 概说, 大要
lemmas.def_en: an idea or conclusion having general application

examples.en: The report spoke only in vague generalities and offered no practical solutions.
examples.zh: 该报告尽是些空泛的概论，并未提供切实可行的解决方案。

lemmas.def_zh: 将军的才能, 将军职, 将军任期
lemmas.def_en: the leadership ability of a military general

examples.en: The army's swift victory was credited to the brilliant generalship of its commander.
examples.zh: 军队的迅速胜利归功于其指挥官卓越的统帅才能。

lemmas.def_zh: 通常, 逐渐地, 普遍地
lemmas.def_en: usually; as a rule

examples.en: The local trains are generally on time, though delays happen during heavy snow.
examples.zh: 当地火车通常很准时，不过大雪天也会延误。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 常规
lemmas.def_en: command as a general

examples.en: There is a general consensus among scientists that the climate is changing rapidly.
examples.zh: 科学家们普遍认同气候正在迅速变化。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 genus（种属、族类），本义为‘涉及整个群类的’，引申出‘普遍的、全盘的’，后指统领全局的最高军事长官（将军）。
family_guide.core_distinction: general 既可作形容词（普遍的、总括的）也可作名词（陆军将官），动词用法极少且专门表示‘统率、指挥军队’。

lemmas.def_zh: 兴趣, 嗜好, 利息, 利益, 爱好, 趣味, 势力
lemmas.def_en: a sense of concern with and curiosity about someone or something

examples.en: She showed a keen interest in learning modern software development and design.
examples.zh: 她对学习现代软件开发和设计表现出浓厚的兴趣。

lemmas.def_zh: 兴趣性
lemmas.def_en: the power of attracting or holding one's attention (because it is unusual or exciting etc.)

examples.en: The editor evaluated each submitted article for its factual accuracy and overall interestingness.
examples.zh: 编辑评估了每篇投稿的事实准确性和整体趣味性。

lemmas.def_zh: 使感兴趣, 与...有关系
lemmas.def_en: excite the curiosity of; engage the interest of

examples.en: She showed a keen interest in learning modern software development and design.
examples.zh: 她对学习现代软件开发和设计表现出浓厚的兴趣。

lemmas.def_zh: 有趣地；引人注意地；有趣的是（常作评注性副词）
lemmas.def_en: used to introduce a piece of information that is unexpected, noteworthy, or interesting

examples.en: Interestingly, female voters turned out in higher numbers than male voters.
examples.zh: 有趣的是，女性选民的投票率高于男性选民。

lemmas.def_zh: 不感兴趣的, 无利害关系的
lemmas.def_en: not having or showing interest

examples.en: He seemed completely uninterested in joining our weekend hiking trip through the mountains.
examples.zh: 他似乎对参加我们周末穿越山区的徒步旅行毫无兴趣。

lemmas.def_zh: 引不起兴趣的, 无趣味的, 乏味的
lemmas.def_en: arousing no interest or attention or curiosity or excitement

examples.en: The lecture turned out to be dull and uninteresting, putting several students to sleep.
examples.zh: 讲座结果枯燥无味，让好几个学生都睡着了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 interesse（处于其间、与自身切身相关），由‘关涉自身切身利益’逐步延伸出‘吸引注意力的兴趣’及金融层面的‘利息’。
family_guide.core_distinction: 分词派生词 interested 描述主体感受（感到感兴趣的），interesting 描述事物属性（令人感兴趣的），而 interestingly 常用作句子状语引出值得玩味的信息。

lemmas.def_zh: 女孩；姑娘；年轻女性
lemmas.def_en: a female child or young woman

examples.en: She has been a bright, curious girl since early childhood.
examples.zh: 她从小就是一个聪明且充满好奇心的女孩。

examples.en: I'm going out for dinner with the girls from work tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚我要和单位里的女同事们一起出去吃晚饭。

lemmas.def_zh: 少女时代, 少女们
lemmas.def_en: the childhood of a girl

examples.en: She spent her sunny girlhood exploring the quiet beaches of a coastal town.
examples.zh: 她在探索一座沿海小镇宁静海滩的过程中度过了明媚的少女时代。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中古英语，最初泛指任何性别的“幼童或年轻人”，后语义逐渐窄化专指“女童、年轻女性”。

lemmas.def_zh: 低的，低矮的；低于平均水平的；[动]（牛）发出哞哞叫声
lemmas.def_en: situated close to the ground, or below normal level; (v.) to make a deep, mournful moo sound

examples.en: The central heating was kept on a low setting to save energy.
examples.zh: 中央暖气开在低温档以节省能源。

examples.en: Cattle were lowing softly in the twilight.
examples.zh: 暮色中，牛群正发出阵阵低沉的哞叫声。

lemmas.def_zh: 低的，低矮的；低于平均水平的；[动]（牛）发出哞哞叫声
lemmas.def_en: situated close to the ground, or below normal level; (v.) to make a deep, mournful moo sound

examples.en: The central heating was kept on a low setting to save energy.
examples.zh: 中央暖气开在低温档以节省能源。

examples.en: Cattle were lowing softly in the twilight.
examples.zh: 暮色中，牛群正发出阵阵低沉的哞叫声。

lemmas.def_zh: 降低；减少；放下，降下
lemmas.def_en: to move something down; to reduce the quantity, degree, or intensity of something

examples.en: The central bank decided to lower interest rates to encourage borrowing.
examples.zh: 央行决定降低利率以鼓励借贷。

examples.en: He lowered his voice to avoid attracting attention.
examples.zh: 他压低了声音，以免引人注意。

lemmas.def_zh: 低下, 卑贱, 微弱
lemmas.def_en: a position of inferior status; low in station or rank or fortune or estimation

examples.en: The extreme lowness of his voice made it difficult for the audience to hear.
examples.zh: 他的声音极度微弱，使得听众很难听清。

family_guide.root_logic: low 源自古诺斯语 lágr（低矮的、平缓的），核心概念为“靠近地面或基准、程度较小”，其派生比较级动词 lower 意为“使降低”；动词 low 则为同形异源词，源自古英语拟声词，专指牛的低沉鸣叫。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词 low（低的）与动词 lower（降低）同源；而动词 low（哞叫）是完全不同词源的拟声词，仅书写形式相同。

lemmas.def_zh: 问题, 询问
lemmas.def_en: an instance of questioning

examples.en: The teacher paused to answer a difficult question raised by one of the students.
examples.zh: 老师停顿了一下，回答了一名学生提出的难题。

lemmas.def_zh: 质问者, 发问者
lemmas.def_en: someone who asks a question

examples.en: The speaker turned politely toward the questioner in the back row to clarify his point.
examples.zh: 演讲者礼貌地转向后排的提问者，以阐明自己的观点。

lemmas.def_zh: 询问, 审问, 怀疑
lemmas.def_en: challenge the accuracy, probity, or propriety of

examples.en: The teacher paused to answer a difficult question raised by one of the students.
examples.zh: 老师停顿了一下，回答了一名学生提出的难题。

lemmas.def_zh: 不提出疑问的, 不提出质询的, 不犹豫的
lemmas.def_en: not inclined to ask questions

examples.en: Good soldiers are traditionally expected to provide unquestioning obedience to their commanding officers.
examples.zh: 传统上，优秀的士兵被期望对指挥官保持绝对服从。

lemmas.def_zh: 无条件地, 不犹豫地, 绝对地
lemmas.def_en: in an unquestioning manner

examples.en: The loyal dog followed its young master unquestioningly through the dense dark forest.
examples.zh: 忠诚的狗毫不犹豫地跟随小主人穿过茂密黑暗的森林。

lemmas.def_zh: 质问地, 疑惑地
lemmas.def_en: in a curious and questioning manner

examples.en: She tilted her head and looked questioningly at him when he arrived late again.
examples.zh: 当他再次迟到时，她歪着头疑惑地看着他。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 quaerere（寻找、探求、询问），核心逻辑是通过“发问与求索”来获取信息或探求真相，引申为“疑问、议题”及对其“质疑”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词表示提出的疑问或讨论的议题；动词兼具中性的“询问/审问”与带怀疑态度的“质疑”。

lemmas.def_zh: 发行, 流出, 造成...结果, 传下；使流出, 放出, 发行, 发布, 发给
lemmas.def_en: prepare and issue for public distribution or sale

examples.en: The government will issue new digital passports to all citizens starting next month.
examples.zh: 政府将从下个月开始向所有公民发放新的电子护照。

lemmas.def_zh: 发行, 问题, 后果, 流出, 出口, 争端
lemmas.def_en: an important question that is in dispute and must be settled

examples.en: The government will issue new digital passports to all citizens starting next month.
examples.zh: 政府将从下个月开始向所有公民发放新的电子护照。

lemmas.def_zh: 发行者
lemmas.def_en: an institution that issues something (securities or publications or currency etc.)

examples.en: The credit card issuer declined the transaction due to suspicious activity.
examples.zh: 由于可疑活动，信用卡发卡行拒绝了这笔交易。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 exire（走出去、流出），核心意象为“自内向外流出/流露”，引申为官方“发布、签发”，以及由某事件生发出来的“问题、议题或期号”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词侧重官方或正式的“发布、签发”这一动作，名词则引申为由此引出的“议题、问题”或出版物的“期号”。

lemmas.def_zh: 人；个人；（身体或仪态上的）人身；人称
lemmas.def_en: a human being regarded as an individual; an individual human body

examples.en: You need to apply for the visa in person rather than online.
examples.zh: 你必须亲自去申请签证，而不能在网上办理。

examples.en: She is a remarkably warm and generous person.
examples.zh: 她是一个极其热情、大度的人。

lemmas.def_en: an actor's portrayal of someone in a play
lemmas.def_zh: 人, 人物, 角色, 外表印象, 人格面具

examples.en: Behind his tough public persona, the politician was actually quiet and very gentle.
examples.zh: 在他强硬的公众形象背后，这位政客实际上沉默寡言且十分温柔。

lemmas.def_zh: 扮演, 装扮, 模仿
lemmas.def_en: a representation of a person that is exaggerated for comic effect

lemmas.def_zh: 拟人, 人格化, 拟人法, 化身, 象征
lemmas.def_en: a person who represents an abstract quality

examples.en: In many ancient myths, the fierce storm was viewed as the personification of anger.
examples.zh: 在许多古代神话中，狂风暴雨被视为愤怒的化身。

lemmas.def_zh: 做人,人格
lemmas.def_en: being a person

examples.en: Philosophers often debate the precise qualities that define human personhood.
examples.zh: 哲学家们经常争论界定人类人格的精确特质。

lemmas.def_zh: 演员；模拟艺人
lemmas.def_en: someone who (fraudulently) assumes the appearance of another

lemmas.def_zh: 没落人物, 被冷落的人
lemmas.def_en: a person regarded as nonexistent and having no rights; a person whose existence is systematically ignored (especially for ideological or political reasons)

examples.en: After criticizing the regime, the dissident was treated as an unperson.
examples.zh: 批评该政权后，这名异见人士被彻底当作边缘人物对待。

lemmas.def_zh: 模仿, 扮演, 体现, 使人格化
lemmas.def_en: assume or act the character of

examples.en: The con artist tried to impersonate a police officer to avoid arrest.
examples.zh: 那名骗子试图冒充警察以逃避抓捕。

lemmas.def_zh: 看做人, 赋与人性, 使人格化, 体现, 是...的化身
lemmas.def_en: invest with or as with a body; give body to

examples.en: In classical mythology, the gods often personify distinct natural forces.
examples.zh: 在古典神话中，众神往往代表着不同的自然力量。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 persona，原指戏剧演员所戴的“面具”或所扮演的“角色”，后引申为具有独立社会身份与法律人格的“个体、人”。

lemmas.def_zh: 开车, 驱使, 推动, 驾驶；开车, 猛击, 飞跑
lemmas.def_en: operate or control a vehicle

examples.en: I prefer to drive along the scenic coastal route every weekend.
examples.zh: 我喜欢每个周末沿着风景优美的沿海路线开车。

lemmas.def_zh: drive的过去分词
lemmas.def_en: operate or control a vehicle

examples.en: As an ambitious entrepreneur, she is extremely driven to achieve lasting success.
examples.zh: 作为一名雄心勃勃的企业家，她为了取得长久成功而极具进取心。

lemmas.def_en: be in motion due to some air or water current
lemmas.def_zh: 漂流；漂移；大意 (n.) / 漂流；偏离 (v.)

examples.en: As the night fell, the abandoned boat began to drift toward the open sea.
examples.zh: 夜幕降临，那艘废弃的小船开始漂向公海。

lemmas.def_zh: 驾车, 快车道, 推进力, 驱动, 动力, 击球, 驱动器
lemmas.def_en: the act of applying force to propel something

examples.en: I prefer to drive along the scenic coastal route every weekend.
examples.zh: 我喜欢每个周末沿着风景优美的沿海路线开车。

lemmas.def_zh: 驾驶员, 驱动器, 驱动程序
lemmas.def_en: the operator of a motor vehicle

examples.en: The bus driver waited patiently until all the passengers had boarded.
examples.zh: 公交车司机耐心地等待着，直到所有乘客都上了车。

lemmas.def_zh: 畜群
lemmas.def_en: a group of animals (a herd or flock) moving together

examples.en: A large drove of cattle slowly crossed the dusty country road.
examples.zh: 一大群牲畜缓缓穿过尘土飞扬的乡间小道。

lemmas.def_en: a force that moves something along
lemmas.def_zh: 漂流；漂移；大意 (n.) / 漂流；偏离 (v.)

examples.en: As the night fell, the abandoned boat began to drift toward the open sea.
examples.zh: 夜幕降临，那艘废弃的小船开始漂向公海。

lemmas.def_en: a wanderer who has no established residence or visible means of support
lemmas.def_zh: 漂流者, 漂流物, 漂网渔船

examples.en: The lonely drifter traveled from town to town looking for temporary odd jobs.
examples.zh: 这个孤独的流浪者在不同城镇间辗转，寻找临时的零工。

lemmas.def_zh: 有紧迫感的
lemmas.def_en: compelled forcibly by an outside agency

examples.en: As an ambitious entrepreneur, she is extremely driven to achieve lasting success.
examples.zh: 作为一名雄心勃勃的企业家，她为了取得长久成功而极具进取心。

family_guide.root_logic: 核心源于原始日耳曼语中‘驱赶、向前推动’的概念，后引申为驾驶载具、强力逼迫或推进，并进一步衍生出内在动力、被驱赶的群体等意义。
family_guide.core_distinction: drove 作名词常指成群移动的牲畜或人群（常用复数 droves）；driven 作形容词则专指‘受……驱动的’或人‘极其专注拼搏、受强烈野心驱使的’。

lemmas.def_zh: 旁边, 侧, 方面, 胁, 侧边, 血统
lemmas.def_en: a place within a region identified relative to a center or reference location

examples.en: The children decorated both sides of the paper with bright colors.
examples.zh: 孩子们用鲜艳的色彩装饰了纸张的两面。

lemmas.def_zh: 侧线, 旁轨, 边宽
lemmas.def_en: a short stretch of railroad track used to store rolling stock or enable trains on the same line to pass

examples.en: The freight train moved onto the siding to let the passenger train pass.
examples.zh: 货运列车驶入旁轨，以便让客运列车先行通过。

lemmas.def_zh: 旁的, 侧的, 次要的
lemmas.def_en: located on a side

examples.en: The children decorated both sides of the paper with bright colors.
examples.zh: 孩子们用鲜艳的色彩装饰了纸张的两面。

lemmas.def_zh: 同意, 支持；支持, 赞助
lemmas.def_en: take sides for or against; ; m siding against the current candidate"

examples.en: The children decorated both sides of the paper with bright colors.
examples.zh: 孩子们用鲜艳的色彩装饰了纸张的两面。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语表示“肋腹、躯干侧面”的词根，核心义为“物体的侧面或边缘”，后自然延伸至辩论或冲突中的“立场/阵营”，并衍生出“次要的”及“站队支持”等用法。
family_guide.core_distinction: side 作为名词多指“侧面、立场或方面”，而名词 siding 则是具体实物名词，特指铁路的“侧线/避让线”或建筑外墙的“护墙板”。

lemmas.def_zh: 实际的；真实的；现存的
lemmas.def_en: existing in fact; real rather than imagined, assumed, or projected

examples.en: The actual cost of the project was much higher than the initial estimate.
examples.zh: 该项目的实际花费远高于最初的预估。

examples.en: I know he was angry, but what were his actual words?
examples.zh: 我知道他很生气，但他原话到底是怎么说的？

lemmas.def_zh: 实际上；事实上；居然/竟然
lemmas.def_en: in truth or fact; used to correct a misconception or emphasize something surprising

examples.en: I thought the movie would be boring, but it was actually quite good.
examples.zh: 我原以为那部电影会很无聊，但事实上相当不错。

examples.en: Did she actually believe that excuse?
examples.zh: 她竟然真的相信了那个借口？

lemmas.def_zh: 事实, 现实, 现状
lemmas.def_en: the state of actually existing objectively

examples.en: The documentary exposed the harsh actuality of living in modern slums.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片揭露了现代贫民窟生活的残酷现状。

lemmas.def_zh: 现实化
lemmas.def_en: making real or giving the appearance of reality

examples.en: She viewed the new art exhibition as the ultimate actualization of her vision.
examples.zh: 她将这个新艺术展视为自己愿景的终极实现。

lemmas.def_zh: 实行, 使现实化
lemmas.def_en: make real or concrete; give reality or substance to

examples.en: With hard work and discipline, you can actualize your creative dreams.
examples.zh: 通过努力和自律，你可以将自己的创意梦想变为现实。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 actus（行动、做），由‘付诸行动的’引申为‘客观存在的、现实的’，强调实际发生而非臆想或推测。

lemmas.def_zh: 引起, 使产生, 使遭受
lemmas.def_en: give rise to; cause to happen or occur, not always intentionally

examples.en: Careless driving can cause severe traffic accidents on wet roads.
examples.zh: 粗心驾驶可能会在潮湿路面上引发严重的交通事故。

lemmas.def_zh: 原因, 目标
lemmas.def_en: events that provide the generative force that is the origin of something

examples.en: Careless driving can cause severe traffic accidents on wet roads.
examples.zh: 粗心驾驶可能会在潮湿路面上引发严重的交通事故。

lemmas.def_zh: 因果关系, 原因
lemmas.def_en: the act of causing something to happen

examples.en: Researchers struggled to establish a direct link of causation between these factors.
examples.zh: 研究人员难以在这两个因素之间建立直接的因果关系。

lemmas.def_zh: 因果关系
lemmas.def_en: the relation between causes and effects

examples.en: Correlation does not always imply direct causality in complex scientific experiments.
examples.zh: 在复杂的科学实验中，相关性并不总是意味着直接的因果关系。

lemmas.def_zh: 原因的, 因果关系的, 表示原因或理由的
lemmas.def_en: involving or constituting a cause; causing

examples.en: The committee found no clear causal relationship between the policy and inflation.
examples.zh: 委员会没有发现这项政策与通货膨胀之间存在明确的因果关系。

lemmas.def_zh: 成为原因的
lemmas.def_en: producing an effect

examples.en: Smoking is considered a primary causative agent in various respiratory diseases.
examples.zh: 吸烟被认为是导致多种呼吸道疾病的主要原因。

lemmas.def_zh: 无原因的, 偶然的
lemmas.def_en: having no justifying cause or reason

examples.en: His sudden, causeless panic made everyone in the room feel uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 他那突如其来且毫无缘由的恐慌让房间里的每个人都很不自在。

lemmas.def_zh: 有原因地
lemmas.def_en: in a causal fashion

examples.en: Scientists investigated whether the two environmental phenomena were causally connected.
examples.zh: 科学家们调查了这两种环境现象是否存在因果关联。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 causa（原因、诉由、理由），核心逻辑是从引发后果的“源头与诱因”引申到为之辩护、追求的“理由与事业”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词侧重行为上的“致使/诱发”；名词既可指产生某种结果的具体“起因”，也可指激发群体行动、值得为之奉献的崇高“事业/宗旨”。

lemmas.def_zh: 包含，包括；将……列入
lemmas.def_en: to contain something as part of a whole, or make someone or something part of a group

examples.en: The total price includes breakfast, tax, and service charges.
examples.zh: 总价包含了早餐、税费以及服务费。

examples.en: Please include your contact details when submitting the form.
examples.zh: 提交表格时请附上您的联系方式。

lemmas.def_zh: 包含；列入；包容，融合
lemmas.def_en: the action or state of including or being included within a group or structure

examples.en: His unexpected inclusion in the squad delighted the fans.
examples.zh: 他意外入选阵容让球迷们欣喜若狂。

examples.en: The university is committed to fostering diversity and social inclusion.
examples.zh: 该大学致力于促进多元化与社会包容。

lemmas.def_zh: 包含全部费用的；包容广阔的；兼收并蓄的
lemmas.def_en: including everything, or deliberately not excluding any section of society

examples.en: We booked an all-inclusive resort for our family vacation.
examples.zh: 我们为家庭度假预订了一家全包式度假村。

examples.en: The company strives to create an inclusive work culture where everyone feels valued.
examples.zh: 公司努力营造一种让每个人都感到受重视的包容性工作文化。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 in-（向内）+ claudere（关闭），字面为“关在内部”，引申为把某人或某物纳入整体之中。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词 include 表“包含或列入”；名词 inclusion 常指社会层面的“融合/包容”或“纳入”的行为；形容词 inclusive 侧重“包罗万象的、含全款的”或“具包容性的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 购买，买；相信，接受（非正式）；收买
lemmas.def_en: to obtain something by paying money for it; to accept the truth of something

examples.en: He decided to buy a second-hand car to save money.
examples.zh: 为了省钱，他决定买一辆二手车。

examples.en: I told him the excuse, but I don't think he bought it.
examples.zh: 我向他解释了借口，但我认为他并没有相信。

lemmas.def_zh: buy的过去式和过去分词；已购买的
lemmas.def_en: past tense and past participle of buy

examples.en: She bought a lovely woolen scarf at the Christmas market.
examples.zh: 她在圣诞集市上买了一条漂亮的羊毛围巾。

examples.en: Goods bought on sale cannot usually be exchanged.
examples.zh: 打折购买的商品通常不予调换。

lemmas.def_zh: 买方，买家；（公司的）采购员
lemmas.def_en: a person who buys something; a person whose job is to choose and buy goods for a store or company

examples.en: It is currently a buyer's market, so property prices are negotiable.
examples.zh: 目前是买方市场，因此房产价格是可以商量的。

examples.en: She works as a senior fashion buyer for a luxury department store.
examples.zh: 她在一家高档百货公司担任资深时尚采购员。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 bycgan，核心语义为“通过支付金钱或对价获取物品或服务”，引申出“认可/相信”及“收买”等抽象义。
family_guide.core_distinction: buy 为动词原形，bought 为其不规则过去式与过去分词；buyer 为派生施事名词，指购买者或专职采购员。

lemmas.def_zh: 然而，不过；无论如何，不管怎样；无论到何种程度
lemmas.def_en: used to introduce a contrast or contradiction; in whatever way or to whatever extent

examples.en: The project was difficult; however, the team managed to complete it on time.
examples.zh: 这个项目难度很大；然而，团队还是按时完成了任务。

examples.en: However hard he tried, he could not solve the puzzle.
examples.zh: 无论他多么努力尝试，都无法解开这个谜题。

family_guide.root_logic: 由疑问代词 how（以何种方式/到何种程度）与后缀 -ever（无论）复合而成，本义为“无论以何种方式/程度”，引申出表对比转折的“然而、不过”。

lemmas.def_zh: 离开, 剩下, 遗忘, 委托, 丢弃；出发, 离开, 生叶
lemmas.def_en: go away from a place

examples.en: She decided to leave the office early to catch the last train home.
examples.zh: 她决定早点离开办公室，去赶回家的末班车。

lemmas.def_zh: 许可, 告别, 请假, 休假
lemmas.def_en: the period of time during which you are absent from work or duty

examples.en: She decided to leave the office early to catch the last train home.
examples.zh: 她决定早点离开办公室，去赶回家的末班车。

lemmas.def_zh: 离开者（常指学校毕业生）
lemmas.def_en: someone who leaves

examples.en: Many school leavers are struggling to find decent entry-level jobs this summer.
examples.zh: 许多中学毕业生今年夏天都在努力寻找体面的初级工作。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 lǣfan（遗留、留下），核心概念为“脱离某处”以及由此衍生出的“让某物保持原状/留置”；名词形式引申为“离开的许可”即“准假”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词 leave 侧重“离开”动作或“遗留”状态；名词 leave 专指经官方批准的“休假”或离开的“许可”（常用于 on leave, sick leave 等固定搭配）。

lemmas.def_zh: 早期的；早到的；提早的
lemmas.def_en: happening, arriving, or done near the beginning of a period, or before the expected time

examples.en: In the early stages of the research, the team encountered unexpected challenges.
examples.zh: 在研究的早期阶段，团队遇到了一些意料之外的挑战。

examples.en: Early diagnosis is crucial for the effective treatment of the disease.
examples.zh: 早期诊断对于该疾病的有效治疗至关重要。

lemmas.def_zh: 早熟
lemmas.def_en: quality of coming early or earlier in time

examples.en: The earliness of the spring flowers surprised local gardeners this warm year.
examples.zh: 在这个温暖的年份，春花的早开让当地的花匠感到惊讶。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 ǣr（意为“较早、先前”）加形容词后缀 -līc，核心逻辑始终围绕“处于时间、序列或预期之初”。

lemmas.def_zh: 结果, 成绩, 答案
lemmas.def_en: a phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon

examples.en: The final test result showed that the treatment had been entirely successful.
examples.zh: 最终检测结果表明，该治疗非常成功。

lemmas.def_zh: 结果, 合力, 生成物
lemmas.def_en: the final point in a process

examples.en: The storm hit the coast, and the resultant flood caused widespread property damage.
examples.zh: 风暴袭击了海岸，造成的洪水导致了大范围的财产损失。

lemmas.def_zh: 产生, 结果, 致使
lemmas.def_en: issue or terminate (in a specified way, state, etc.); end

examples.en: The final test result showed that the treatment had been entirely successful.
examples.zh: 最终检测结果表明，该治疗非常成功。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 resultare（回弹、反冲），由 re-（回）+ salire（跳）构成，由物理上的“撞击后反弹出来”引申为事物发展后“涌现出的后果或结局”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 作动词时通过介词区分因果方向：result in 表示“导致（某结果）”，result from 表示“起因于（某原因）”。

lemmas.def_zh: 似乎；好像；看来
lemmas.def_en: to give the impression of being; to appear

examples.en: Things are not always what they seem.
examples.zh: 事情往往并不像表面看上去那样。

examples.en: It seems that everyone is on board with the new strategy.
examples.zh: 看来大家都赞成这项新策略。

lemmas.def_zh: 貌似；表面上；看来
lemmas.def_en: appearing to be true or real, though perhaps not actually so

examples.en: The team pulled off a seemingly impossible comeback.
examples.zh: 该团队完成了一场看似不可能的逆转。

examples.en: He walked away seemingly unhurt after the collision.
examples.zh: 碰撞之后，他走开了，表面看来并未受伤。

lemmas.def_zh: 不合适的, 不适宜的, 不得体的
lemmas.def_en: not in keeping with accepted standards of what is right or proper in polite society

examples.en: Their loud argument at the solemn funeral was considered completely unseemly by guests.
examples.zh: 他们在庄严的葬礼上大声争吵，被客人们认为极不得体。

lemmas.def_zh: 适当的, 恰当的, 合适的, 好看的
lemmas.def_en: according with custom or propriety

examples.en: It is hardly seemly to arrive late and demand everyone's full attention.
examples.zh: 迟到却要求所有人关注自己，这实在不太得体。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺斯语，原义为“合适、得体”，后引申为“看起来符合某种情形”，现代核心语义统一为“表面呈现出的样子、似乎”。
family_guide.core_distinction: seem 是动词，表达基于表象的主观推断；seemingly 是副词，常用于修饰形容词，多暗示“表面上如此，但实际情况可能相反”。

lemmas.def_zh: 产生, 生产, 提出, 出示；生产, 制造
lemmas.def_en: bring forth or yield

examples.en: The local farm can produce enough fresh vegetables to feed the entire town.
examples.zh: 这个当地农场能生产出足以为全镇提供新鲜蔬菜的粮食。

lemmas.def_zh: 制造, 生产, 产物
lemmas.def_en: the act or process of producing something

examples.en: The factory halted car production due to an unexpected global chip shortage.
examples.zh: 由于意外的全球芯片短缺，该工厂暂停了汽车生产。

lemmas.def_zh: 产品，制品；产物，结果；乘积
lemmas.def_en: something manufactured or grown for sale; a result of a process or situation; a quantity obtained by multiplication

examples.en: The company plans to launch several new software products later this year.
examples.zh: 该公司计划在今年晚些时候推出几款新的软件产品。

examples.en: His cynical attitude is largely a product of his difficult upbringing.
examples.zh: 他愤世嫉俗的态度在很大程度上是他坎坷成长经历的产物。

lemmas.def_zh: 生产品, 物产, 后代
lemmas.def_en: fresh fruits and vegetable grown for the market

examples.en: The local farm can produce enough fresh vegetables to feed the entire town.
examples.zh: 这个当地农场能生产出足以为全镇提供新鲜蔬菜的粮食。

lemmas.def_zh: 生产者, 制作者, 制作人
lemmas.def_en: someone who manufactures something

examples.en: The movie producer secured enough funding to begin shooting the independent film.
examples.zh: 这位电影制片人筹集到了足够的资金来开拍这部独立电影。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 pro-（向前）+ ducere（引导、引出），核心意象为“向前引出/展现在眼前”，演变为“拿出/出示”，后引申为“生产、产出”。
family_guide.core_distinction: produce 作名词时重音在前，专指新鲜果蔬等“农产品”；production 强调“生产过程、产量”或戏剧影视的“制作与作品”。

lemmas.def_zh: 故事；虚构情节；新闻报道；楼层（美拼）
lemmas.def_en: an account of imaginary or real events told for entertainment; a news report; a floor or level of a building

examples.en: She told the children an engaging bedtime story before tucking them in.
examples.zh: 她在给孩子们掖好被子前，讲了一个生动有趣的睡前故事。

examples.en: The investigative journalist broke the front-page story that exposed the corporate scandal.
examples.zh: 这位调查记者爆出了揭露企业丑闻的头版报道。

lemmas.def_zh: 传说上有名的, 以历史画装饰的, 分层的
lemmas.def_en: having an illustrious past

examples.en: The university has a storied tradition of excellence in both science and arts.
examples.zh: 这所大学在科学和艺术领域都有着享誉盛名的悠久传统。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 historia（叙述、历史），在中古英语中与 history 分化，专指虚构或非虚构的具体叙事、事件经过或新闻报道。

lemmas.def_zh: 艺术；美术作品；技巧，手艺
lemmas.def_en: the expression of human creative skill and imagination; a practical skill acquired by experience or study

examples.en: She decided to study modern art at university.
examples.zh: 她决定在大学攻读现代艺术。

examples.en: Negotiation is a subtle art that requires patience and empathy.
examples.zh: 谈判是一门需要耐心与共情能力的精妙技艺。

lemmas.def_zh: 艺术家；美术家（尤指画家）；有特殊技能的人
lemmas.def_en: a person who produces works of art, especially painting or drawing; a skilled performer or practitioner

examples.en: The exhibition showcases works by contemporary graphic artists.
examples.zh: 这次展览展出了当代平面艺术家的作品。

examples.en: The makeup artist completely transformed the actor's appearance.
examples.zh: 这位化妆师彻底改变了演员的样貌。

lemmas.def_zh: 艺术的；有艺术天赋的；富有美感的
lemmas.def_en: connected with art or artists; showing skill and good taste in art or creative endeavors

examples.en: He has a great deal of artistic talent, though he rarely shows his work.
examples.zh: 他极具艺术天赋，不过很少展示自己的作品。

examples.en: The director maintained complete artistic control over the film.
examples.zh: 导演对这部电影拥有完全的艺术掌控权。

lemmas.def_zh: 装作爱好艺术的, 附庸风雅的
lemmas.def_en: showily imitative of art or artists

examples.en: She bought several quirky prints to give her studio an arty atmosphere.
examples.zh: 她买了几幅奇特的版画，想让工作室带点附庸风雅的气息。

lemmas.def_zh: 富有艺术地, 在艺术上
lemmas.def_en: in an artistic manner

examples.en: The plates were artistically arranged with fresh herbs before serving the guests.
examples.zh: 在上菜给客人之前，盘子里富有艺术感地摆放了新鲜香草。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ars（技巧、手艺），核心概念是“运用人类心智与熟练技能进行的创造”，由最初的手工艺逐步演化为现代的美学创造与艺术表达。
family_guide.core_distinction: artistic 专指“与艺术相关的、有审美才能的”，需注意与同源派生词 artful（圆滑狡黠的、巧妙的）和 artificial（人工的、人造的）区分。

lemmas.def_zh: 理解；懂得；获悉
lemmas.def_en: to perceive the intended meaning, nature, or significance of something

examples.en: I can completely understand why you feel frustrated about the sudden delay.
examples.zh: 我完全能理解你为什么对这次突然的延误感到沮丧。

lemmas.def_zh: 理解（understand的过去式与过去分词）；公认的；默契的
lemmas.def_en: past tense and past participle of understand; implicitly agreed or accepted

examples.en: It is an understood rule in the office that headphones mean 'do not disturb'.
examples.zh: 办公室里有一条不成文的默契规则：戴上耳机就意味着‘请勿打扰’。

lemmas.def_zh: 误解（misunderstand的过去式与过去分词）；被误解的
lemmas.def_en: incorrectly interpreted; not appreciated or properly judged

examples.en: The artist felt misunderstood by critics who failed to see the irony in his work.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家觉得自己被评论家误解了，因为他们没能看懂他作品中的讽刺意味。

lemmas.def_zh: 误解, 误会
lemmas.def_en: interpret in the wrong way

examples.en: Please read the instructions carefully so you do not misunderstand the requirements.
examples.zh: 请仔细阅读说明，以免误解要求。

lemmas.def_zh: 可以理解的；合情理的
lemmas.def_en: able to be understood; natural and reasonable under the circumstances

examples.en: Her nervousness before the final defense was entirely understandable.
examples.zh: 她在毕业答辩前的紧张情绪是完全可以理解的。

lemmas.def_zh: 理解；体谅；协议，共识
lemmas.def_en: the ability to comprehend; sympathetic awareness; an informal agreement

examples.en: The two sides finally reached a mutual understanding after days of negotiation.
examples.zh: 经过数天的谈判，双方最终达成了相互理解的共识。

lemmas.def_zh: 误会；误解
lemmas.def_en: a failure to understand something correctly; a minor disagreement

examples.en: A brief email can easily clear up any misunderstanding about the project deadline.
examples.zh: 一封简短的邮件就能轻松消除关于项目截止日期的误会。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 可理解性
lemmas.def_en: the quality of comprehensible language or thought

examples.en: The manual was rewritten to improve the overall understandability of the system.
examples.zh: 手册被重写以提高整个系统的可理解性。

lemmas.def_zh: 领悟地
lemmas.def_en: with understanding

examples.en: The teacher nodded understandingly when the student explained why he was late.
examples.zh: 当学生解释迟到原因时，老师心领神会地点了点头。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语‘under-’（在……之中/彻底）结合‘stand’（站立），字面义为‘站在其间观察’，由此引申为彻底领会事物结构、洞悉本义与建立认知。
family_guide.core_distinction: understandable强调情理上的‘可理解、符合常情’；understanding作名词时侧重‘理解力或共识’，作形容词时侧重人格特质上的‘善解人意的、体谅的’。

lemmas.def_zh: 最终的，决定性的；决赛，期末考试
lemmas.def_en: coming at the end or being conclusive; the last game in a tournament or an end-of-term exam

examples.en: The referee's decision is final and cannot be overturned.
examples.zh: 裁判的裁决是最终决定，不可推翻。

examples.en: Both teams fought hard to secure a place in the tournament final.
examples.zh: 两支球队全力拼搏以争夺锦标赛决赛的一个席位。

lemmas.def_zh: 终于，最终；最后（引出最后一项）
lemmas.def_en: after a long time or delay; as the last point or item

examples.en: After months of grueling negotiations, the two sides finally signed the treaty.
examples.zh: 经过数月艰苦的谈判，双方终于签署了条约。

lemmas.def_zh: 最终的，决定性的；决赛，期末考试
lemmas.def_en: coming at the end or being conclusive; the last game in a tournament or an end-of-term exam

examples.en: The referee's decision is final and cannot be overturned.
examples.zh: 裁判的裁决是最终决定，不可推翻。

examples.en: Both teams fought hard to secure a place in the tournament final.
examples.zh: 两支球队全力拼搏以争夺锦标赛决赛的一个席位。

lemmas.def_zh: 终结, 定局, 终结性言行
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being final or definitely settled

examples.en: She closed the door behind him with a chilling sense of finality.
examples.zh: 她关上了他身后的门，带着一种令人心寒的决绝感。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 finis（边界、末端、终点），核心语义始终围绕“到达尽头、终局或不可更改的最终状态”展开。
family_guide.core_distinction: final 兼具形容词（最终的、决定性的）与名词（决赛、期末考）属性；finally 为副词，常表示经过漫长等待“终于”发生，或用于列举项的“最后”。

lemmas.def_zh: 水, 雨水, 海水, 水位, 水面, 流水
lemmas.def_en: binary compound that occurs at room temperature as a clear colorless odorless tasteless liquid; freezes into ice below 0 degrees centigrade and boils above 100 degrees centigrade; widely used as a solvent

examples.en: Remember to water the plants every evening during the hot summer months.
examples.zh: 炎热的夏季，记得每天傍晚给植物浇水。

lemmas.def_zh: 供给饮水的人, 供牲畜饮水的器具, 供家禽饮水的器具
lemmas.def_en: someone who waters plants or crops

examples.en: He installed an automatic waterer in the barn to keep the horses hydrated.
examples.zh: 他在马厩里安装了一个自动饮水器，以确保马匹有充足的水喝。

lemmas.def_zh: 给...浇水, 供以水, 注入水, 使湿；流泪, 流口水, 加水
lemmas.def_en: supply with water, as with channels or ditches or streams

examples.en: Remember to water the plants every evening during the hot summer months.
examples.zh: 炎热的夏季，记得每天傍晚给植物浇水。

lemmas.def_zh: 水的, 湿的, 平淡的, 稀薄的, 水淋淋的
lemmas.def_en: filled with water

examples.en: The hospital cafeteria served a thin, watery soup that lacked any real flavor.
examples.zh: 医院食堂提供的汤又稀又淡，没有任何真正的味道。

lemmas.def_zh: 无水的, 干的, 不用水的
lemmas.def_en: lacking sufficient water or rainfall

examples.en: The hikers struggled to cross the vast, waterless desert under the scorching sun.
examples.zh: 徒步旅行者们在烈日下艰难地穿过广阔无水的沙漠。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语及原始日耳曼语的核心基础词，本义指维持生命的基本液体“水”，后自然派生为“给……供水/浇水”及生理上的“分泌液体（流泪、流口水）”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词侧重指代液体物质或水域，动词侧重动作（浇灌、提供水）或生理分泌现象（eyes/mouth watering）。

lemmas.def_zh: 话, 消息, 词, 诺言, 命令
lemmas.def_en: a unit of language that native speakers can identify

examples.en: He gave me his word that the project would be finished on time.
examples.zh: 他向我承诺该项目会按时完成。

lemmas.def_zh: 用言辞表达
lemmas.def_en: put into words or an expression

examples.en: She struggled to word her apology carefully so nobody would feel offended.
examples.zh: 她努力斟酌道歉的措辞，以免冒犯到任何人。

lemmas.def_zh: 沉默的, 无言的
lemmas.def_en: expressed without speech; ; ; - Emily Dickinson; ; ; - Thomas Wolfe

examples.en: They shared a wordless understanding after working together for so many years.
examples.zh: 共事多年后，他们之间达成了一种无言的默契。

lemmas.def_zh: 默默无言地, 沉默地
lemmas.def_en: without speaking

examples.en: He wordlessly handed her a warm cup of coffee and sat down.
examples.zh: 他默默地递给她一杯热咖啡，然后坐了下来。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语 *were-（言说、表达），核心概念始终围绕“语言的最小表达单位”，由具象的“单词”延伸至抽象的“话语、诺言、消息”，并衍生出动词的“措辞”之义。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词 word 涵盖词汇实体、话语及诺言，动词 word 则特指以特定的方式“措辞、选词表述”。

lemmas.def_zh: 战争, 战争状态, 战术, 军事, 冲突, 斗争, 竞争
lemmas.def_en: the waging of armed conflict against an enemy

examples.en: The prolonged war caused immense suffering to millions of innocent civilians.
examples.zh: 旷日持久的战争给数百万无辜平民带来了巨大的苦难。

lemmas.def_zh: 战士, 勇士, 武士, 鼓吹战争的人, 战斗, 尚武
lemmas.def_en: someone engaged in or experienced in warfare

examples.en: The ancient warrior fought bravely to defend his homeland from invaders.
examples.zh: 这位古代勇士英勇作战，保卫家园免受侵略者侵害。

lemmas.def_zh: 进行战争, 作战, 打仗, 战斗
lemmas.def_en: make or wage war

examples.en: The prolonged war caused immense suffering to millions of innocent civilians.
examples.zh: 旷日持久的战争给数百万无辜平民带来了巨大的苦难。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古日耳曼语系词根，原意为“混乱、纷争”，后专指国家或群体间的大规模武装冲突，并引申出参与战斗的人员。
family_guide.core_distinction: warrior 侧重具有高超战斗技巧与英勇品质的“武士、勇士”，带有历史或文学色彩，常区别于现代体制内的普通士兵（soldier）。

lemmas.def_zh: 开始；着手；开动
lemmas.def_en: to start to happen or exist, or to start doing something

examples.en: Let's begin the meeting by reviewing the minutes from last week.
examples.zh: 我们先回顾一下上周的会议纪要，然后正式开会。

lemmas.def_zh: 开始；着手（begin 的过去式）
lemmas.def_en: past tense of begin

examples.en: She began her journalism career at a small local newspaper.
examples.zh: 她在一家地方小报开启了自己的新闻职业生涯。

lemmas.def_zh: 开始；着手（begin 的过去分词）
lemmas.def_en: past participle of begin

examples.en: Construction has already begun on the new subway line.
examples.zh: 新地铁线路的施工已经动工。

lemmas.def_zh: 开端；起点；初创阶段
lemmas.def_en: the start of something; the first part

examples.en: At the beginning of the semester, students are encouraged to set clear goals.
examples.zh: 学期伊始，学校鼓励学生制定明确的目标。

lemmas.def_zh: 初学者；新手；生手
lemmas.def_en: a person who is starting to learn or do something and has little experience

examples.en: This coding course is designed specifically for complete beginners.
examples.zh: 这门编程课程是专为零基础初学者设计的。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 beginnan（前缀 be- 加强语气 + ginnan 开启），本义为‘撕开、打开切口’，后演化为‘开启、着手做某事’的核心语义。
family_guide.core_distinction: began 为一般过去式，begun 为完成时/被动式的过去分词；名词 beginning 指‘开端/起点’，beginner 指‘初学者/新手’。

lemmas.def_zh: 等候, 期待, 延缓, 伺候, 推迟；等, 等候, 耽搁, 伺候用餐
lemmas.def_en: stay in one place and anticipate or expect something

examples.en: We had to wait outside the station until the rain finally stopped.
examples.zh: 我们不得不站在车站外等候，直到雨终于停了。

lemmas.def_zh: 等待, 等候
lemmas.def_en: time during which some action is awaited

examples.en: We had to wait outside the station until the rain finally stopped.
examples.zh: 我们不得不站在车站外等候，直到雨终于停了。

lemmas.def_en: a person whose occupation is to serve at table (as in a restaurant)
lemmas.def_zh: （餐馆男）服务员

examples.en: The waiter recommended the chef's special pasta for dinner.
examples.zh: 服务员推荐了主厨特制意大利面作为晚餐。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 等待的；备用的
lemmas.def_en: remaining ready and available for use; serving to wait
lemmas.usage_note: 多作定语修饰特定名词，如 a waiting car/taxi（随时候命的车）、waiting room（候诊/车室）等。

examples.en: He hurried out of the airport and hopped into a waiting taxi.
examples.zh: 他急匆匆走出机场，跳上了一辆等候在那里的出租车。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古北方法语，本义为“守望、注视”，后引申为停留在原地以期某事发生或某人出现，核心逻辑是“保持停顿，期待发生”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词表示“等待、等候”的动作或状态，亦可引申为延缓；名词则特指“等待的这段时间或过程”。

lemmas.def_zh: 小轿车，汽车；（火车的）车厢；（电梯、缆车的）轿厢
lemmas.def_en: a four-wheeled road vehicle powered by an engine; a railway carriage or elevator compartment

examples.en: She decided to leave her car at home and commute by subway to avoid rush-hour traffic.
examples.zh: 为了避开早高峰的拥堵，她决定把车留在家里，改乘地铁通勤。

examples.en: The conductor walked through the rear car of the train to check passengers' tickets.
examples.zh: 列车长穿过火车的后部车厢去查票。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自高卢-拉丁语 carrus（轮式战车/运载工具），在现代英语中演变为指代各类轨道车厢、缆车轿厢，并最终专指四轮机动车（小轿车）。

lemmas.def_zh: 形状, 形体, 类型, 方式, 表格, 形式；表单
lemmas.def_en: the phonological or orthographic sound or appearance of a word that can be used to describe or identify something

examples.en: Clouds began to form over the mountains as the humid afternoon progressed.
examples.zh: 随着潮湿午后的推移，群山之上开始聚集成云。

lemmas.def_zh: 形成；构成；队形；地质构造
lemmas.def_en: the act or process of forming; a particular arrangement or geological structure

examples.en: The cooling of lava led to the formation of these unique rock structures.
examples.zh: 熔岩冷却促成了这些独特岩石结构的形成。

examples.en: The fighter jets flew overhead in tight formation.
examples.zh: 战斗机以紧凑的编队从头顶飞过。

lemmas.def_zh: 构词要素
lemmas.def_en: minimal language unit that has a syntactic (or morphological) function

examples.en: In linguistics, a formative combines with other elements to build complex words.
examples.zh: 在语言学中，构词要素与其他成分结合以构成复合词。

lemmas.def_zh: 形成, 排列, (使)组成
lemmas.def_en: create (as an entity)

examples.en: Clouds began to form over the mountains as the humid afternoon progressed.
examples.zh: 随着潮湿午后的推移，群山之上开始聚集成云。

lemmas.def_zh: 无定形的, 形体不明的, 没有形状的
lemmas.def_en: having no definite form or distinct shape

examples.en: A formless shadow moved slowly across the garden wall in the moonlight.
examples.zh: 月光下，一个没有形状的影子在花园围墙上缓缓移动。

lemmas.def_zh: 未成形的, 无定型的, 未充分发展的
lemmas.def_en: not having form or shape

examples.en: Her thoughts on the complex matter were still largely unformed and hesitant.
examples.zh: 对于这个复杂的问题，她的想法在很大程度上还未成形且犹豫不决。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 forma（外形、模子），核心逻辑围绕“赋予轮廓、构成形态、建立规则或结构载体”展开。
family_guide.core_distinction: form 作名词时强调“既有的形态、类别或纸质表格”，而 formation 则侧重“形成的动态过程、结构或特定的编队/构造”。

lemmas.def_zh: 充满的, 完全的, 丰富的, 完美的, 丰满的, 详尽的
lemmas.def_en: containing as much or as many as is possible or normal

examples.en: The restaurant was completely full, so we decided to try another place.
examples.zh: 餐馆已经完全客满了，所以我们决定去别家看看。

lemmas.def_zh: 满, 充满, 丰富
lemmas.def_en: completeness over a broad scope

examples.en: The rich fullness of the orchestra filled the entire concert hall beautifully.
examples.zh: 管弦乐团饱满浑厚的音色美妙地充盈了整个音乐厅。

lemmas.def_zh: 把(衣服等)缝得宽松, 漂洗
lemmas.def_en: beat for the purpose of cleaning and thickening

examples.en: The restaurant was completely full, so we decided to try another place.
examples.zh: 餐馆已经完全客满了，所以我们决定去别家看看。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语，核心语义为“盛满、达到极限或完整无缺”，作动词时由形容词直接转化，主要引申为“变满、圆满”。
family_guide.core_distinction: full 作形容词是极高频词，表示“满的”或“完全的”；作动词使用频率较低，主要用于天象语境指“（月亮）变圆”。

lemmas.def_zh: 今天，今日；当今，现今
lemmas.def_en: the present day; the present time or modern era

examples.en: Today marks the tenth anniversary of the company's founding.
examples.zh: 今天标志着公司成立十周年。

examples.en: In today's fast-paced world, continuous learning is essential for career growth.
examples.zh: 在当今快节奏的世界中，持续学习对职业发展至关重要。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语介词短语 to dæġe（在这一天），由 to（在……之时）与 day（日子）复合演变而来，核心指代当前的这一天或当今时代。

lemmas.def_zh: 水平, 水准, 平地
lemmas.def_en: a position on a scale of intensity or amount or quality

examples.en: Workers used heavy machinery to level the ground before pouring the foundation.
examples.zh: 工人们在浇筑地基前用重型机械将地面铲平。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 校平器
lemmas.def_en: a radical who advocates the abolition of social distinctions

examples.en: The construction crew used a laser leveler to ensure the floor was even.
examples.zh: 施工队使用激光校平器来确保地面完全平整。

lemmas.def_zh: 弄平, 夷平, 使同等, 瞄准, 对准；变平, 拉平
lemmas.def_en: aim at

examples.en: Workers used heavy machinery to level the ground before pouring the foundation.
examples.zh: 工人们在浇筑地基前用重型机械将地面铲平。

lemmas.def_zh: 同高的, 平坦的, 齐平的, 水平的
lemmas.def_en: having a surface without slope, tilt in which no part is higher or lower than another

examples.en: Workers used heavy machinery to level the ground before pouring the foundation.
examples.zh: 工人们在浇筑地基前用重型机械将地面铲平。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语表示“天平、水准仪”的词汇，核心意象为“水平状态与度量高度”，由此引申出高度层级（名）、平坦或持平的（形）以及抹平或推平（动）。
family_guide.core_distinction: level 同词异性：名词聚焦于“高度/等级标准”，形容词强调“平坦的/不分上下的”，动词则表示“使平整/推倒/拉平差距”。

lemmas.def_zh: 任何事物；任何东西；无论何事
lemmas.def_en: a thing of any kind; used in questions, negative sentences, or to mean whatever thing

examples.en: Is there anything I can do to help you with the project?
examples.zh: 有什么我可以帮忙推进这个项目的吗？

examples.en: You can achieve anything if you truly put your mind to it.
examples.zh: 只要你全心投入，任何事情你都能做到。

family_guide.root_logic: 由不定代词 any（任何）与 thing（事物）组合而成，核心逻辑是指代不确定或无限制的“任何事物”。

lemmas.def_zh: interj. 什么也没有, 无
lemmas.def_en: a quantity of no importance

examples.en: There was nothing left in the refrigerator, so we ordered some takeout.
examples.zh: 冰箱里什么也没有了，所以我们点了外卖。

lemmas.def_zh: 无, 不关紧要之事, 零
lemmas.def_en: a quantity of no importance

examples.en: There was nothing left in the refrigerator, so we ordered some takeout.
examples.zh: 冰箱里什么也没有了，所以我们点了外卖。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语“no thing”（没有一件事物），核心本义为“虚无、空无”，后自然引申为代词“无一物”及名词“微不足道的人或事物”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 作代词时客观陈述“没有任何事物或数量”；作名词时主观强调其“无关紧要、毫无价值”或指“从零开始”。

lemmas.def_zh: 已经；早已
lemmas.def_en: before now or before a specified time; earlier than expected

examples.en: I've already finished the report, so we can submit it early.
examples.zh: 我已经把报告写完了，所以我们可以提前提交。

examples.en: Is it midnight already? Time really flies when you're busy.
examples.zh: 已经午夜了吗？忙起来时间过得真快。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语短语 all ready（完全准备就绪），后词义由'完全就绪'虚化为时间副词，表示动作或状态在预期之前'已经'完全发生或成立。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意与形近词组 all ready（全都准备好了，ready为形容词）区分：already 表示时间上的'已经'。

lemmas.def_zh: 力量, 武力, 势力, 影响力, 军队, 力, 效力
lemmas.def_en: a powerful effect or influence

examples.en: The sudden force of the wind blew open the heavy wooden doors.
examples.zh: 突如其来的强风一下子吹开了沉重的木门。

lemmas.def_zh: [医]强有力, 坚强
lemmas.def_en: physical energy or intensity

examples.en: The forcefulness of her argument convinced the entire committee to agree.
examples.zh: 她论点的强有力说服了整个委员会表示赞同。

lemmas.def_zh: 强迫, 强夺, 推动, 提高
lemmas.def_en: to cause to do through pressure or necessity, by physical, moral or intellectual means :

examples.en: The sudden force of the wind blew open the heavy wooden doors.
examples.zh: 突如其来的强风一下子吹开了沉重的木门。

lemmas.def_zh: 激烈地；强有力地；有说服力地
lemmas.def_en: with full force

examples.en: She argued forcefully that the proposed policy would harm small local businesses.
examples.zh: 她有力地辩论称，拟议的政策会损害当地小企业的利益。

lemmas.def_zh: 有力的, 强烈的, 有说服力的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by or full of force or strength (often but not necessarily physical)

examples.en: The director made a forceful speech that inspired the entire production team.
examples.zh: 导演发表了一番有说服力的演讲，激励了整个制作团队。

lemmas.def_zh: 强制的, 强迫的, 有气力的
lemmas.def_en: impelled by physical force especially against resistance

examples.en: The police had to resort to forcible entry after nobody answered the door.
examples.zh: 无人应门后，警察不得不采取强行破门的方式。

lemmas.def_zh: 非强迫的, 自然的, 不勉强的
lemmas.def_en: not brought about by coercion or force

examples.en: His warm and unforced smile immediately put all the nervous guests at ease.
examples.zh: 他那温暖而自然的微笑立刻让所有紧张的客人放松下来。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 fortis（强壮的、有力的），核心语义始终围绕“具备或施加足以改变物体状态、突破阻力或违背他人意愿的强大力量”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词侧重指抽象或具象的“力量、物理力或武装力量”；动词则指将该力量付诸行动，即“强迫、迫使”或“强行撬开/突破”。

lemmas.def_zh: v. 未击中；错过；想念；漏掉；n. 未击中；失误；落空
lemmas.def_en: to fail to hit, reach, catch, or notice; to feel the absence of; an instance of failing to hit or achieve

examples.en: Hurry up, or we will miss the last train home.
examples.zh: 快点，否则我们要错过回家的末班火车了。

examples.en: His first shot hit the bullseye, but the second was a complete miss.
examples.zh: 他的第一枪正中靶心，但第二枪却完全脱靶了。

lemmas.def_zh: v. 未击中；错过；想念；漏掉；n. 未击中；失误；落空
lemmas.def_en: to fail to hit, reach, catch, or notice; to feel the absence of; an instance of failing to hit or achieve

examples.en: Hurry up, or we will miss the last train home.
examples.zh: 快点，否则我们要错过回家的末班火车了。

examples.en: His first shot hit the bullseye, but the second was a complete miss.
examples.zh: 他的第一枪正中靶心，但第二枪却完全脱靶了。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 丢失的；失踪的；缺少的
lemmas.def_en: not able to be found; absent or lost
lemmas.usage_note: 极为常见，常与 go 连用（go missing），也可作定语修饰 person, page, part 等。

examples.en: Two pages were missing from the ancient manuscript.
examples.zh: 这份古手稿缺失了两页。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古英语，核心意象为“未触及、偏离预定目标”，由此引申出空间上的“未击中”、时间上的“错过”，以及因某人某物缺席而在心理上产生的“想念”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词 miss 聚焦“错过、未命中、想念”的动作与心理体验；名词 miss 则指代“未命中、失误”的具体结果（如 near miss 险情/虚惊一场）。

lemmas.def_zh: 健康（状况）；卫生；兴旺
lemmas.def_en: the state of being free from illness or injury; the general condition of body or mind

examples.en: Regular exercise and adequate sleep are essential for maintaining good physical health.
examples.zh: 规律运动和充足睡眠对保持身体健康至关重要。

examples.en: Air pollution has become a serious threat to public health in urban areas.
examples.zh: 空气污染已成为城市地区公众健康的严重威胁。

lemmas.def_zh: 健康, 健全
lemmas.def_en: the state of being vigorous and free from bodily or mental disease

examples.en: Regular exercise and fresh air contribute greatly to the overall healthiness of children.
examples.zh: 经常运动和新鲜空气极大地促进了儿童的整体健康。

lemmas.def_zh: [n. 于健康有益；卫生
lemmas.def_en: the quality of promoting good health

examples.en: Many nutritionists praise the natural healthfulness of a traditional Mediterranean diet.
examples.zh: 许多营养学家称赞传统地中海饮食对健康的自然益处。

lemmas.def_zh: 不健康的;有害的
lemmas.def_en: a state in which you are unable to function normally and without pain

examples.en: The unhealthiness of fast food has become a major topic of public concern.
examples.zh: 快餐的不健康已成为公众关注的主要话题。

lemmas.def_zh: 健康的；有益健康的；大量的，可观的
lemmas.def_en: in good physical or mental condition; promoting good health; thriving or large

examples.en: A healthy diet rich in vegetables can significantly lower the risk of heart disease.
examples.zh: 富含蔬菜的健康饮食可以显著降低患心脏病的风险。

examples.en: The company reported a healthy profit increase despite the economic downturn.
examples.zh: 尽管经济低迷，该公司仍实现了可观的利润增长。

lemmas.def_zh: 不健康的；有害健康的；病态的
lemmas.def_en: harmful to health; not in good physical or mental condition; abnormal or excessive

examples.en: Sitting at a desk all day can lead to an unhealthy and sedentary lifestyle.
examples.zh: 整天坐在办公桌前会导致一种久坐且不健康的生活方式。

examples.en: He developed an unhealthy obsession with monitoring his social media metrics.
examples.zh: 他对监控自己的社交媒体数据产生了一种病态的执念。

lemmas.def_zh: 有益健康的, 使人健康的, 卫生的
lemmas.def_en: conducive to good health of body or mind

examples.en: Doctors recommend eating fresh vegetables daily as part of a healthful lifestyle.
examples.zh: 医生建议每天吃新鲜蔬菜，作为健康生活方式的一部分。

lemmas.def_zh: 影响健康的, 不卫生的, 对身体有害的
lemmas.def_en: not sanitary or healthful

examples.en: Living near that polluted chemical factory exposes residents to unhealthful environmental conditions.
examples.zh: 生活在被污染的化工厂附近使居民面临不卫生的环境条件。

lemmas.def_zh: 健康地
lemmas.def_en: in a levelheaded manner

examples.en: If you eat healthily and sleep enough, your body recovers much faster.
examples.zh: 如果你饮食健康且睡眠充足，身体恢复得会快得多。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 hǣlþ（完整、健全），与 heal 和 whole 同源，核心指生理、心理或系统的完整与良好运作状态。
family_guide.core_distinction: healthy 与 unhealthy 构成直接正反义对立，两者既可修饰人或生物的状态（健康的/病态的），也可修饰生活方式、习惯或环境（有益健康的/有害健康的）。

lemmas.def_zh: 控制, 管理, 克制, 控制器, 操纵装置
lemmas.def_en: power to direct or determine

examples.en: The pilot maintained steady control of the aircraft during the violent storm.
examples.zh: 在暴风雨中，飞行员保持了对飞机的稳定控制。

lemmas.def_zh: 控制器, 管理者
lemmas.def_en: someone who maintains and audits business accounts

examples.en: The financial controller reviewed the annual budget before submitting it to management.
examples.zh: 财务主管在将年度预算提交给管理层之前进行了审查。

lemmas.def_zh: 主计员或管理员的职位或任期
lemmas.def_en: the position of controller

examples.en: During her controllership, the company significantly reduced unnecessary operational expenses and waste.
examples.zh: 在她担任财务总监期间，公司显著减少了不必要的运营开支和浪费。

lemmas.def_zh: 控制, 操纵, 抑制
lemmas.def_en: exercise authoritative control or power over

examples.en: The pilot maintained steady control of the aircraft during the violent storm.
examples.zh: 在暴风雨中，飞行员保持了对飞机的稳定控制。

lemmas.def_zh: 不受抑制的, 不受控制的, 自由的
lemmas.def_en: not being under control; out of control

examples.en: The uncontrolled bushfire quickly spread across the dry forest due to strong winds.
examples.zh: 由于强风，失控的丛林大火在干燥的森林中迅速蔓延。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中古法语及拉丁语 contrarotulus（反向卷轴/复本底册），原指用副本核对账目以确保无误，后引申为监督、核查，最终演变为现代的“控制、支配与调控”。
family_guide.core_distinction: control 涵盖抽象的支配权、克制力或对照手段；controller 则是具体行使控制功能的人（如财务总监、空管员）或硬件装置（如游戏手柄、温控器）。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 计划，方案；节目；程序；v. 编写程序；预先设定
lemmas.def_en: a plan of activities, broadcast show, or set of computer instructions (n.); to write computer code or set a device to operate automatically (v.)

examples.en: She enrolled in an intensive training program to sharpen her project management skills.
examples.zh: 她参加了一项强化培训计划，以提升自己的项目管理技能。

examples.en: The machine can be programmed to shut down automatically after two hours.
examples.zh: 这台机器可以被预先设置为两小时后自动关机。

lemmas.def_zh: 程序员；程序编制员
lemmas.def_en: a person whose job is to write code for computer software

examples.en: Skilled software programmers are highly sought after in the artificial intelligence sector.
examples.zh: 技术熟练的软件程序员在人工智能领域非常吃香。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 计划，方案；节目；程序；v. 编写程序；预先设定
lemmas.def_en: a plan of activities, broadcast show, or set of computer instructions (n.); to write computer code or set a device to operate automatically (v.)

examples.en: She enrolled in an intensive training program to sharpen her project management skills.
examples.zh: 她参加了一项强化培训计划，以提升自己的项目管理技能。

examples.en: The machine can be programmed to shut down automatically after two hours.
examples.zh: 这台机器可以被预先设置为两小时后自动关机。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 programma（pro- 提前 + gramma 字母/写成之物），本义为“提前书写公布的告示或日程”，引申为预先规划的“计划、节目”，在计算机时代进一步延伸为预设运行指令的“程序”及“编程”。
family_guide.core_distinction: program 兼具名词（计划/程序/节目）与动词（编程/预先设定），而 programmer 则是专指编写计算机代码的人（程序员）。

lemmas.def_zh: 然而；但是；尽管如此
lemmas.def_en: nevertheless; but at the same time

examples.en: The path was steep and treacherous, yet they pressed on without hesitation.
examples.zh: 道路险峻崎岖，然而他们毫不犹豫地继续前行。

examples.en: It is a simple yet remarkably effective solution to the problem.
examples.zh: 这是一个简单却极其有效的解决方案。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 giet（意为“到现在、此外”），从时间上的“持续至今”引申出逻辑上的“尽管如此、然而”，表示出人意料的转折与对比。
family_guide.core_distinction: yet 兼具连词与副词属性：作连词时用于连接分句或对等成分，意为“然而/但是”；作副词时常用于否定句或疑问句，意为“尚/还/已经”。

lemmas.def_zh: 足够
lemmas.def_en: as much as necessary; ; (`plenty' is nonstandard)

examples.en: We arrived early enough to secure the best front-row seats for the concert.
examples.zh: 我们到得足够早，抢到了音乐会前排最好的座位。

lemmas.def_zh: 充足, 够, 很多
lemmas.def_en: an adequate quantity; a quantity that is large enough to achieve a purpose

examples.en: We arrived early enough to secure the best front-row seats for the concert.
examples.zh: 我们到得足够早，抢到了音乐会前排最好的座位。

lemmas.def_zh: 充足的, 足够
lemmas.def_en: sufficient for the purpose

examples.en: We arrived early enough to secure the best front-row seats for the concert.
examples.zh: 我们到得足够早，抢到了音乐会前排最好的座位。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 genōg（达到、满足），核心概念始终为“达到所需限度或满足某种标准”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 同形多词性：副词（adv.）修饰形容词或副词且必须后置；形容词（adj.）修饰名词通常前置；名词/代词（n.）独立充当主语或宾语，指“足够的人/物/量”。

lemmas.def_zh: 每件事，所有事物，一切；最重要的东西
lemmas.def_en: all things; each thing; the most important thing

examples.en: Everything is packed and ready for tomorrow's trip.
examples.zh: 一切都已打包完毕，明天的旅行准备就绪。

examples.en: Money isn't everything, but it certainly solves a lot of problems.
examples.zh: 金钱不是一切，但确实能解决很多问题。

family_guide.root_logic: 由形容词 every（每一个）与名词 thing（事物）组合而成的复合不定代词，核心语义为指代所涉及范围内的“所有事物”或“最重要的存在”。

lemmas.def_zh: 国家的，全国性的；国民，公民
lemmas.def_en: relating to an entire nation; a citizen of a particular country

examples.en: The museum houses some of the most precious treasures in the national collection.
examples.zh: 该博物馆收藏了国家馆藏中一些最珍贵的宝物。

examples.en: All foreign nationals are required to register with local authorities upon arrival.
examples.zh: 所有外籍公民在抵达后均须向当地管理部门登记。

lemmas.def_zh: 国家的，全国性的；国民，公民
lemmas.def_en: relating to an entire nation; a citizen of a particular country

examples.en: The museum houses some of the most precious treasures in the national collection.
examples.zh: 该博物馆收藏了国家馆藏中一些最珍贵的宝物。

examples.en: All foreign nationals are required to register with local authorities upon arrival.
examples.zh: 所有外籍公民在抵达后均须向当地管理部门登记。

lemmas.def_zh: 国籍；民族，族群
lemmas.def_en: the legal status of belonging to a particular nation; an ethnic group forming part of one or more political nations

examples.en: She holds dual nationality, carrying both British and French passports.
examples.zh: 她拥有双重国籍，同时持有英国和法国护照。

lemmas.def_zh: 在全国范围内；由全国/国家层面
lemmas.def_en: across an entire nation; by the whole nation

examples.en: The new environmental regulations will be implemented nationally next month.
examples.zh: 新的环保条例将于下个月在全国范围内推行。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 natio（出生、部族、国家），核心语义始终围绕“由共同历史、法律与领土构成的国家主体”展开，派生出关于国家范畴、国民个体与国籍属性的词汇。
family_guide.core_distinction: national 作名词专指“某国国民/公民个体”（强调人）；nationality 专指“国籍”或“民族身份”（强调法律身份或族群归属）。

lemmas.def_zh: 容易的，不费力的；舒适从容的
lemmas.def_en: achieved without great effort; free from worries or problems

examples.en: The software is designed to be easy to use for beginners.
examples.zh: 该软件旨在让初学者容易上手使用。

examples.en: He has an easy, confident smile that immediately puts people at ease.
examples.zh: 他带着从容自信的微笑，立刻让人放松下来。

lemmas.def_zh: 心神不安的, 不自在的, 不稳定的, 不舒服的
lemmas.def_en: lacking a sense of security or affording no ease or reassurance

examples.en: He felt uneasy about leaving his younger sister alone in the dark house.
examples.zh: 把妹妹一个人留在黑暗的房子里，他感到心神不安。

lemmas.def_zh: 容易地，轻易地；无疑地，很大程度上
lemmas.def_en: without difficulty or effort; undoubtedly or by far

examples.en: With proper preparation, you can easily pass the examination.
examples.zh: 只要准备充分，你就能轻松通过考试。

examples.en: This is easily the best Italian restaurant in the city.
examples.zh: 这无疑是全城最棒的意大利餐厅。

lemmas.def_zh: 不自在地；不稳定地；心神不安地
lemmas.def_en: with anxiety or apprehension

examples.en: The witness shifted uneasily in his chair under the lawyer's intense questioning.
examples.zh: 在律师严厉的质问下，目击者在椅子上局促地挪动着身子。

lemmas.def_zh: 不舒适, 不安, 局促
lemmas.def_en: feelings of anxiety that make you tense and irritable

examples.en: A growing sense of uneasiness spread among the passengers as the flight was delayed.
examples.zh: 随着航班延误，乘客中弥漫起一股越来越强烈的不安。

lemmas.def_zh: 容易, 轻松, 安适
lemmas.def_en: a feeling of refreshing tranquility and an absence of tension or worry

examples.en: She solved the complicated puzzle with remarkable easiness that surprised everyone present.
examples.zh: 她以惊人的轻松解决了这道复杂的难题，让在场的每个人都很惊讶。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 aisié（处于闲适状态的），核心意象为“舒适、无压迫感、不费力气”。
family_guide.core_distinction: easy 用作形容词表示事物不费力或状态从容；easily 为其副词形式，修饰动词表示“轻而易举”，修饰最高级或比较级时表示“无疑、毫无疑问”。

lemmas.def_zh: 总统；主席；总裁；大学校长
lemmas.def_en: the head of state of a republic, or the leader of an organization, company, or university

examples.en: The president addressed the nation in a live televised broadcast.
examples.zh: 总统通过电视直播向全国发表了讲话。

examples.en: She was appointed vice president of global marketing last year.
examples.zh: 她去年被任命为全球营销副总裁。

lemmas.def_zh: 总统（或主席）职位；总统任期
lemmas.def_en: the job, position, or period of time of being a president

examples.en: His presidency was marked by significant economic reforms and diplomatic breakthroughs.
examples.zh: 他的总统任期以重大的经济改革和外交突破为标志。

examples.en: Several prominent senators are expected to campaign for the presidency next year.
examples.zh: 预计几位知名参议员将于明年竞选总统宝座。

lemmas.def_zh: 总统的；总统选举的；有总统风度的
lemmas.def_en: relating to a president or presidency; looking or behaving like a respected leader

examples.en: Voter turnout reached an all-time high in the recent presidential election.
examples.zh: 在最近的总统选举中，选民投票率创下了历史新高。

examples.en: The candidate's calm and dignified response appeared very presidential.
examples.zh: 该候选人从容得体的回应展现出了十足的总统风度。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 很没有总统样子
lemmas.def_en: not presidential

examples.en: Critics condemned his aggressive outburst on social media as completely unpresidential behavior.
examples.zh: 批评人士谴责他在社交媒体上的攻击性爆发完全没有总统风范。

lemmas.def_zh: 以总统[议长、校长等]的资格
lemmas.def_en: in a presidential manner

examples.en: The candidate spoke presidentially, addressing the nation's concerns with calm authority and grace.
examples.zh: 该候选人以总统般的沉稳权威和风度发表讲话，回应了国家的关切。

lemmas.def_en: act as president
lemmas.def_zh: 统辖, 当主人, 主持

examples.en: The senior judge was asked to preside over the highly publicized corporate trial.
examples.zh: 这位资深法官受邀主持这场备受瞩目的企业诉讼庭审。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 praesidere（prae-在前 + sedere坐），字面意为“坐在前列主持者”，引申为主持大局的国家元首、机构领导人及相关的职位与属性。
family_guide.core_distinction: president 指担任最高领导职务的具体人；presidency 指该职位、机构本身或其任期；presidential 则是相关的形容词修饰语。

lemmas.def_zh: 历史；历史学；发展史；过往经历
lemmas.def_en: the study of past events, or the whole series of events connected with someone or something

examples.en: The signing of the treaty marked a major turning point in modern history.
examples.zh: 该条约的签署标志着现代历史上的一个重大转折点。

examples.en: The company has a long history of technological innovation.
examples.zh: 这家公司拥有悠久的技术创新历史。

lemmas.def_zh: 历史（上）的；有关历史的；基于史实的
lemmas.def_en: connected with the study of history, or based on real events in the past

examples.en: The researchers analyzed a vast collection of historical documents from the archives.
examples.zh: 研究人员分析了档案馆里的大量历史文献。

examples.en: She enjoys reading historical fiction set in Victorian London.
examples.zh: 她喜欢读以维多利亚时代伦敦为背景的历史小说。

lemmas.def_zh: 有历史意义的；名载史册的
lemmas.def_en: famous, important, or likely to be remembered in history

examples.en: The two leaders met for a historic summit to negotiate the peace accord.
examples.zh: 两位领导人举行了一次具有历史意义的首脑会议以谈判和平协议。

examples.en: Today marks a historic victory for equal voting rights.
examples.zh: 今天标志着争取平等投票权历程中载入史册的胜利。

lemmas.def_zh: 从历史上看；历来；在历史上
lemmas.def_en: with reference to past times, or throughout the course of history

examples.en: Historically, gold has served as a safe haven asset during financial turmoil.
examples.zh: 从历史上看，黄金在金融动荡时期一直充当着避险资产。

examples.en: The two neighboring countries have historically shared close trading ties.
examples.zh: 这两个邻国在历史上历来保持着密切的贸易往来。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 historia（通过调查获得的知识、叙述），核心概念为“对过去事件的记录、研究与演进”。
family_guide.core_distinction: historic 强调“具重大历史意义、载入史册的”；historical 强调“历史上的、与历史学相关的、基于史实的”。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 季节；季，时令；赛季；活动期 /
lemmas.def_en: n. one of the four periods of the year, or a period of time associated with a particular activity; v. to add spices to food, or to dry wood to prepare it for use

examples.en: Strawberries are delicious and relatively inexpensive when they are in season.
examples.zh: 草莓应季上市时不仅美味，价格也相对便宜。

examples.en: Season the steak generously with salt and black pepper before searing.
examples.zh: 煎牛排前，先撒上足量的盐和黑胡椒调味。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 调味品，佐料
lemmas.def_en: substances such as salt, herbs, or spices added to food to enhance its flavor

examples.en: Taste the soup before serving and adjust the seasoning if necessary.
examples.zh: 上菜前尝尝汤的味道，如有需要可再调整一下佐料。

lemmas.def_zh: v. 给……调味；风干（木材）；使成熟、历练
lemmas.def_en: n. one of the four periods of the year, or a period of time associated with a particular activity; v. to add spices to food, or to dry wood to prepare it for use

examples.en: Strawberries are delicious and relatively inexpensive when they are in season.
examples.zh: 草莓应季上市时不仅美味，价格也相对便宜。

examples.en: Season the steak generously with salt and black pepper before searing.
examples.zh: 煎牛排前，先撒上足量的盐和黑胡椒调味。

lemmas.def_zh: 未熟透的, 未干透的, 未成熟的, 无经验的, 没有调味的, 未加作料的
lemmas.def_en: not aged or processed

examples.en: Burning unseasoned firewood produces excessive smoke and very little useful heat indoors.
examples.zh: 燃烧未干透的木柴会在室内产生过多浓烟，且几乎没有有效热量。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 satio（播种期），核心概念为“播种与成熟的适宜时机”，由此从大自然的“季节、时令”引申至让食物成熟入味的“调味”及让木材或人成熟的“历练”。
family_guide.core_distinction: season 作名词指季节或特定活动期，作动词指调味或风干历练；seasoning 则专指用于调味的佐料。

lemmas.def_zh: [机] 四冲程循环
lemmas.def_en: being one more than three

examples.en: The lawnmower runs on an efficient four-stroke engine that requires regular maintenance.
examples.zh: 这台割草机由高效的四冲程发动机驱动，需要定期保养。

lemmas.def_zh: [机] 四冲程循环
lemmas.def_en: the cardinal number that is the sum of three and one

examples.en: The lawnmower runs on an efficient four-stroke engine that requires regular maintenance.
examples.zh: 这台割草机由高效的四冲程发动机驱动，需要定期保养。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语基数词根 *kʷetwóres（四），演化为古英语 fēower，核心语义始终表示介于三和五之间的数量概念。
family_guide.core_distinction: four 兼具形容词与名词用法：作形容词修饰名词表示“四个的”；作名词指代数字“四”或“四个人/物组成的一组”。

lemmas.def_zh: 想法；主意；概念
lemmas.def_en: a thought, plan, or concept formed in the mind

examples.en: She came up with a brilliant idea to improve our team's workflow.
examples.zh: 她想出了一个改善我们团队工作流程的绝妙点子。

lemmas.def_zh: 理想；完美典范；崇高目标
lemmas.def_en: a principle, standard, or perfect example of something worth aiming for

examples.en: He dedicated his life to pursuing the democratic ideals of freedom and equality.
examples.zh: 他毕生致力于追求自由与平等的民主理想。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 观念作用, 思想作用
lemmas.def_en: the process of forming and relating ideas

examples.en: The team gathered this morning for a rapid ideation session to develop campaign concepts.
examples.zh: 团队今天上午聚集在一起进行了快速构思会议，以开发活动方案。

lemmas.def_zh: 理想化, 理想化事物
lemmas.def_en: a portrayal of something as ideal

examples.en: Her painting shows an obvious idealization of simple rural life in the eighteenth century.
examples.zh: 她的画作明显将18世纪朴素的乡村生活理想化了。

lemmas.def_zh: 理想, 虚构事物, 想象力
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being ideal

examples.en: The poet pursued an artistic ideality that rarely matched the harsh realities of life.
examples.zh: 这位诗人追求一种极少能与残酷生活现实相符的艺术理想。

lemmas.def_zh: 理想地；在理想情况下
lemmas.def_en: in the best possible way; in a perfect scenario
