examples.en: Ideally, the project should be completed before the end of this month.
examples.zh: 理想情况下，该项目应在本月底之前完成。

lemmas.def_zh: 使理想化；理想化, 形成思想, 描述理想
lemmas.def_en: consider or render as ideal

examples.en: It is common for young adults to idealize their first romantic relationships looking back.
examples.zh: 回想过去，年轻人往往会把他们的初恋理想化。

lemmas.def_zh: 形成概念, 想象；对...形成概念
lemmas.def_en: form a mental image of something that is not present or that is not the case

examples.en: Engineers must ideate creative solutions before beginning the detailed product design phase today.
examples.zh: 工程师在今天开始详细的产品设计阶段之前，必须构想出创造性的解决方案。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 观念[作用]的, 思想[作用]的
lemmas.def_en: being of the nature of a notion or concept

examples.en: The psychologist examined how ideational fluency affects creative problem-solving in young children.
examples.zh: 这位心理学家研究了观念流畅度如何影响幼儿创造性地解决问题。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 idein（看见），最初指心智所“看”到的形象或构想，后延伸至思维中的具体想法，以及追求完美终极形态的“理想”。
family_guide.core_distinction: idea 指普遍的“想法、主意”，属于中性概念；ideal 则指追求极致完美的“理想、典范”。

lemmas.def_zh: 一次，一回；曾经，一度；一旦（连词用法）
lemmas.def_en: on one occasion only; at a time in the past; as soon as

examples.en: I only met her once, but she left a lasting impression on me.
examples.zh: 我只见过她一次，但她给我留下了深刻的印象。

examples.en: The building was once a school, but it has now been converted into apartments.
examples.zh: 这栋建筑曾经是一所学校，但现在已被改造成了公寓。

examples.en: Once you make a promise, you must do your best to keep it.
examples.zh: 一旦你许下诺言，就必须尽全力去遵守。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古英语数词 one 的属格形式，核心演变逻辑为由“单一、一次”引申为时间上的“曾经、从前”以及条件连词“一旦”。

lemmas.def_zh: 白色的, 纯洁的, 白种的, 苍白的, 空白的, 幸运的
lemmas.def_en: being of the achromatic color of maximum lightness; having little or no hue owing to reflection of almost all incident light

examples.en: The mountain peaks were completely covered in fresh white snow after the midnight storm.
examples.zh: 午夜的暴风雪过后，山峰完全被新鲜的白雪覆盖了。

lemmas.def_zh: 白色, 洁白, 眼白, 白种人, 蛋白
lemmas.def_en: a member of the Caucasoid race

examples.en: The mountain peaks were completely covered in fresh white snow after the midnight storm.
examples.zh: 午夜的暴风雪过后，山峰完全被新鲜的白雪覆盖了。

lemmas.def_zh: 白, 苍白, 洁白
lemmas.def_en: the quality or state of the achromatic color of greatest lightness (bearing the least resemblance to black)

examples.en: The blinding whiteness of the arctic landscape stretched endlessly beneath the pale sun.
examples.zh: 北极地貌刺眼的洁白在苍白太阳下无尽延伸。

lemmas.def_en: turn white

examples.en: The mountain peaks were completely covered in fresh white snow after the midnight storm.
examples.zh: 午夜的暴风雪过后，山峰完全被新鲜的白雪覆盖了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语词根 *kweid-（闪光、照耀），后演变为古英语 hwīt，核心含义由“明亮耀眼”收拢为最高明度的无彩色“白”，并引申出纯洁、苍白及无字空白等意象。
family_guide.core_distinction: white 作为动词常用于固定搭配或特指涂白（如 white out），日常表达“变白/使变白”更多使用派生动词 whiten。

lemmas.def_zh: 种类, 性质, 方式
lemmas.def_en: a category of things distinguished by some common characteristic or quality

examples.en: She showed extraordinary patience and kind manners while helping the lost international tourist.
examples.zh: 在帮助那位迷路的外国游客时，她表现出了极大的耐心和亲切的态度。

lemmas.def_zh: 仁慈, 亲切, 和蔼
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being warmhearted and considerate and humane and sympathetic

examples.en: A simple act of kindness can completely change someone's difficult day for the better.
examples.zh: 一次小小的善举就能彻底改善某人艰难的一天。

lemmas.def_zh: 不仁慈, 不客气, 刻薄
lemmas.def_en: lack of sympathy

examples.en: He was deeply hurt by the sheer unkindness of his former classmates' thoughtless jokes.
examples.zh: 他因前同学那些轻率玩笑所带来的纯粹刻薄而深受伤害。

lemmas.def_zh: 亲切, 慈爱, 亲切行为
lemmas.def_en: friendliness evidence by a kindly and helpful disposition

examples.en: Her natural kindliness made every nervous newcomer feel instantly welcomed and very comfortable.
examples.zh: 她天生的和蔼让每一个紧张的新人都立刻感到受迎且很自在。

lemmas.def_zh: 亲切的, 仁慈的, 和蔼的
lemmas.def_en: having or showing a tender and considerate and helpful nature; used especially of persons and their behavior

examples.en: She showed extraordinary patience and kind manners while helping the lost international tourist.
examples.zh: 在帮助那位迷路的外国游客时，她表现出了极大的耐心和亲切的态度。

lemmas.def_zh: 和蔼的, 温和的, 爽快的
lemmas.def_en: showing or motivated by sympathy and understanding and generosity

examples.en: The kindly doctor listened patiently before explaining the treatment options to the family.
examples.zh: 那位慈祥的医生在向家属解释治疗方案前耐心地倾听。

lemmas.def_zh: 不仁慈的, 不亲切的
lemmas.def_en: lacking kindness

examples.en: Leaving him alone during such a major crisis was a deeply unkind thing to do.
examples.zh: 在遭遇如此严重的危机时丢下他一人是极不友善的做法。

lemmas.def_en: lacking in sympathy and kindness

examples.en: The harsh supervisor treated the junior staff with an unkindly coldness every single morning.
examples.zh: 这位苛刻的主管每天早晨都以不近人情的冷酷对待初级员工。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古英语表示“血缘、亲族、出身”的词根（与kin同源），后分化为“同族归类”的名词义（种类）与“对同族心存关照”的形容词义（友善的）。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词 kind 指人内在的善良或具体行为的友善，而 kindly 多强调外在流露出的慈祥、温和的神态或气质。

lemmas.def_zh: 水流，气流，电流，思潮；当前的，现行的
lemmas.def_en: a flow of water, air, or electricity, or a trend of thought; happening or existing now

examples.en: Strong underwater currents make swimming dangerous in this area.
examples.zh: 强烈的水下暗流使在这一区域游泳十分危险。

examples.en: Under current regulations, all staff members must complete the training.
examples.zh: 根据现行规定，所有员工都必须完成该项培训。

lemmas.def_zh: 货币，通货；通用，流通，普及
lemmas.def_en: the money in general use in a particular country; the state of being widely accepted or used

examples.en: Tourism is a vital source of foreign currency for the island.
examples.zh: 旅游业是该岛屿重要的外汇来源。

examples.en: The concept gained wide currency during the digital revolution.
examples.zh: 这个概念在数字化革命期间得到了广泛认可与传播。

lemmas.def_zh: 水流，气流，电流，思潮；当前的，现行的
lemmas.def_en: a flow of water, air, or electricity, or a trend of thought; happening or existing now

examples.en: Strong underwater currents make swimming dangerous in this area.
examples.zh: 强烈的水下暗流使在这一区域游泳十分危险。

examples.en: Under current regulations, all staff members must complete the training.
examples.zh: 根据现行规定，所有员工都必须完成该项培训。

lemmas.def_zh: 非本期的
lemmas.def_en: not current or belonging to the present time

examples.en: The company listed its long-term equipment purchases as noncurrent assets on the balance sheet.
examples.zh: 公司在资产负债表上将长期设备采购列为非流动资产。

lemmas.def_zh: 目前，现时
lemmas.def_en: at the present time; right now

examples.en: The software is currently undergoing beta testing.
examples.zh: 该软件目前正处于公开测试阶段。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 currere（奔跑、流动），核心逻辑为“流动与流转”：引申出物理与能量的流向（水流、电流）、时间流转至当下（现行的、当前的），以及价值符号的流动（货币、流通）。
family_guide.core_distinction: current 兼具名词（水/电/思潮流向）与形容词（当下的、现行的）；currency 则专指流转流通的媒介（货币）或观念观点的流通度/普及度。

lemmas.def_zh: 跟随，紧跟；遵循，服从；理解，听懂；关注（社交媒体）
lemmas.def_en: to go or come after someone or something; to obey or act in accordance with; to understand

examples.en: Please read and follow the instructions carefully before assembling the furniture.
examples.zh: 组装家具前，请仔细阅读并遵循说明书。

examples.en: I'm sorry, you're speaking too fast and I can't quite follow your argument.
examples.zh: 抱歉，你说得太快了，我有点跟不上你的论述。

lemmas.def_zh: 追随者，信徒；（社交媒体的）关注者，粉丝
lemmas.def_en: a person who supports, admires, or follows a particular leader, belief, or social media account

examples.en: She gained millions of followers after her travel video went viral.
examples.zh: 她的旅行视频走红后，她收获了数百万名粉丝。

examples.en: The philosopher attracted a dedicated group of followers who spread his ideas.
examples.zh: 这位哲学家吸引了一群忠实的追随者来传播他的思想。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 folgian，核心意象为“紧随其后移动”，由此引申出空间上的“跟随/尾随”、时间或逻辑上的“接续/遵循/理解”，以及现代数字语境下的“关注”。
family_guide.core_distinction: follow 是核心动词，涵盖从物理跟随到抽象服从、理解及网络关注；follower 为施事名词，既指现实中理想或信仰的追随者，也特指社交媒体上的关注者/粉丝。

lemmas.def_zh: 打架；战斗；抗争；努力争取
lemmas.def_en: to take part in a violent struggle; to struggle against difficulty or strive to achieve something

examples.en: Doctors are fighting hard to save the patient's life.
examples.zh: 医生们正在全力抢救这位病人的生命。

examples.en: They had to fight for their legal rights in court.
examples.zh: 他们必须在法庭上为自己的合法权益而抗争。

lemmas.def_zh: 战斗；打架；抗争（fight 的过去式和过去分词）
lemmas.def_en: past tense and past participle of fight

examples.en: The soldiers fought bravely against overwhelming odds.
examples.zh: 士兵们在敌众我寡的劣势下英勇作战。

examples.en: She fought off the infection and made a full recovery.
examples.zh: 她战胜了感染并完全康复。

lemmas.def_zh: 打架；战斗；抗争；努力争取
lemmas.def_en: to take part in a violent struggle; to struggle against difficulty or strive to achieve something

examples.en: Doctors are fighting hard to save the patient's life.
examples.zh: 医生们正在全力抢救这位病人的生命。

examples.en: They had to fight for their legal rights in court.
examples.zh: 他们必须在法庭上为自己的合法权益而抗争。

lemmas.def_zh: 战士；拳击手；不屈不挠的人；战斗机
lemmas.def_en: a person who fights, especially a professional boxer; someone with strong determination; a military combat aircraft

examples.en: Despite her serious illness, she has proven to be a true fighter.
examples.zh: 尽管身患重病，她却展现出了真正顽强的斗士精神。

examples.en: The air force scrambled two fighter jets to intercept the plane.
examples.zh: 空军紧急升空了两架战斗机实施拦截。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 战斗的；作战的；好战的
lemmas.def_en: engaged in or ready for military operations; displaying a combative spirit
lemmas.usage_note: 常用于固定短语，如 fighting force（战斗部队）、fighting spirit（战斗精神）、fighting chance（一线生机）。

examples.en: Despite the severe illness, she kept up a fighting spirit until the end.
examples.zh: 尽管身患重病，她直到最后一刻都保持着顽强的抗争精神。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 feohtan，核心意象为‘身体、武力或意志上的正面冲突与对抗’，由肢体肉搏引申至战争、疾病抗争及抽象利益的争夺。
family_guide.core_distinction: fight 兼作动词和名词，指战斗、冲突本身或斗志；fighter 为派生施事名词，可指拳手、富有斗志的人或战斗机。

lemmas.def_zh: 处理，应付；做生意，经营；发牌
lemmas.def_en: to take action to solve a problem; to do business; to distribute playing cards

examples.en: We need to deal with this customer complaint as soon as possible.
examples.zh: 我们需要尽快处理这起客户投诉。

lemmas.def_zh: deal的过去式及过去分词；已处理；已发牌
lemmas.def_en: past tense and past participle of deal

examples.en: The financial crisis was dealt with swiftly by the management team.
examples.zh: 管理团队迅速应对并处理了这次财务危机。

lemmas.def_zh: 处理，应付；做生意，经营；发牌
lemmas.def_en: to take action to solve a problem; to do business; to distribute playing cards

examples.en: We need to deal with this customer complaint as soon as possible.
examples.zh: 我们需要尽快处理这起客户投诉。

lemmas.def_zh: （常作 dealings）商业往来，人际交往；买卖行为
lemmas.def_en: business relations or transactions; personal interactions with others

examples.en: She is known to be completely honest and transparent in all her business dealings.
examples.zh: 她在所有的商业往来中一向以诚实和透明著称。

lemmas.def_zh: 经销商，商人；发牌员
lemmas.def_en: a person or company that buys and sells goods; someone who deals cards in a game

examples.en: They bought their new electric car directly from an authorized dealer.
examples.zh: 他们直接从一家特约授权经销商那里购买了这辆新电动汽车。

lemmas.def_zh: 代理权, 经销权
lemmas.def_en: a business established or operated under an authorization to sell or distribute a company's goods or services in a particular area

examples.en: He bought his certified pre-owned sports car directly from a local authorized dealership.
examples.zh: 他直接从当地一家授权经销店购买了那辆认证二手跑车。

lemmas.def_zh: 发错牌
lemmas.def_en: an incorrect deal

examples.en: The poker game was paused immediately because a minor misdeal occurred during the shuffle.
examples.zh: 由于洗牌期间出现了轻微的发错牌，扑克游戏立即暂停。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语表示“分配、划分”的词根，由“分发份额”引申出“买卖交易（资源的互换）”以及“处理、应对（分配精力去解决）”。
family_guide.core_distinction: deal 多指单次具体的“协议或交易”；dealing 常作复数 dealings 指长期的“商业或人际往来”；dealer 则指“特许经销商”或“发牌员”。

lemmas.def_zh: 记录, 履历, 档案, 审判记录, 最高纪录, 唱片
lemmas.def_en: anything (such as a document or a phonograph record or a photograph) providing permanent evidence of or information about past events

examples.en: The famous athlete officially broke the world record in the hundred-meter sprint yesterday.
examples.zh: 这位著名的运动员昨天在百米短跑比赛中正式打破了世界纪录。

lemmas.def_zh: 录音
lemmas.def_en: a signal that encodes something (e.g., picture or sound) that has been recorded

examples.en: She listened to the live recording of the concert through her new noise-canceling headphones.
examples.zh: 她用新买的降噪耳机听了那场音乐会的现场录音。

lemmas.def_zh: 记录员, 录音机；记录器
lemmas.def_en: equipment for making records

examples.en: The journalist placed a voice recorder on the table before starting the interview.
examples.zh: 记者在开始采访前把录音机放在了桌上。

lemmas.def_zh: 记录, 记载, 标明, 将...录音；记录, 录音, 可被录音
lemmas.def_en: make a record of; set down in permanent form

examples.en: Please record the daily expenses accurately in this shared digital spreadsheet.
examples.zh: 请在这个共享电子表格中准确记录每日支出。

lemmas.def_zh: [经] 未记帐的, 未入帐的
lemmas.def_en: actually being performed at the time of hearing or viewing

examples.en: Many early historical events remain unrecorded and lost to modern scholars.
examples.zh: 许多早期的历史事件未被记录，学者们已无从考证。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 re-（再、回）+ cord（心，引申为铭记），核心逻辑是从“重新唤起于心”演变为“记载保存以备查证”，进而衍生出录音、记录与最高成绩等含义。
family_guide.core_distinction: record (n.) 侧重记录的内容、档案或历史最好成绩；recording 指录制成的音视频成品或录音动作；recorder 指用于记录的仪器、设备或记录人员。

lemmas.def_zh: 说话，谈话；演说；讲（某种语言）
lemmas.def_en: to say words, have a conversation, or express thoughts; to know and use a language

examples.en: She is able to speak three foreign languages fluently.
examples.zh: 她能够流利地说三门外语。

examples.en: The professor was invited to speak at the international conference.
examples.zh: 教授受邀在国际会议上发表演讲。

lemmas.def_zh: （speak的过去分词）说，讲；口头的，口语的
lemmas.def_en: past participle of speak; expressed in speech rather than writing

examples.en: Children usually acquire spoken language long before they learn to read and write.
examples.zh: 儿童通常在学会读写之前很久就掌握了口头语言。

examples.en: Spanish is spoken by millions of people across Latin America.
examples.zh: 拉丁美洲有数以百万计的人讲西班牙语。

lemmas.def_zh: 讲错, 发错....的音,使讲得词不达意
lemmas.def_en: pronounce a word incorrectly

examples.en: The politician claimed that he did not misspeak during the live debate.
examples.zh: 这位政客声称他在现场辩论中并未说错话。

lemmas.def_zh: 演说，演讲；说话能力，言语；说话方式，口音
lemmas.def_en: a formal talk given to an audience; the ability to speak; spoken language or manner of speaking

examples.en: She delivered an inspiring keynote speech at the annual technology conference.
examples.zh: 她在年度科技大会上发表了一场鼓舞人心的主题演讲。

examples.en: Freedom of speech is widely recognized as a fundamental human right.
examples.zh: 言论自由被广泛公认为一项基本人权。

lemmas.def_zh: （车轮的）辐条，轮辐
lemmas.def_en: one of the thin metal bars or rods connecting the center of a wheel to its outer rim

examples.en: A broken spoke caused the bicycle wheel to wobble dangerously.
examples.zh: 一根断裂的辐条导致自行车车轮危险地晃动。

lemmas.def_zh: 演讲者，发言人；说话者；扬声器，音箱
lemmas.def_en: a person who gives a speech or speaks; an electroacoustic device that produces sound

examples.en: The keynote speaker delivered an inspiring address to the graduates.
examples.zh: 主讲人为毕业生们发表了鼓舞人心的演讲。

examples.en: He paired his smartphone with the Bluetooth speaker to play music.
examples.zh: 他将智能手机与蓝牙音箱配对以播放音乐。

lemmas.def_zh: 议长的职位
lemmas.def_en: the position of Speaker

examples.en: She launched a campaign to secure the speakership of the city council.
examples.zh: 她发起竞选以争取市议会议长的职位。

lemmas.def_zh: 说不出话
lemmas.def_en: the property of being speechless

examples.en: Her unexpected proposal struck him into absolute speechlessness for several long moments.
examples.zh: 她突如其来的求婚让他足足愣了好一阵子，说不出话来。

lemmas.def_zh: （speak的过去分词）说，讲；口头的，口语的
lemmas.def_en: past participle of speak; expressed in speech rather than writing

examples.en: Children usually acquire spoken language long before they learn to read and write.
examples.zh: 儿童通常在学会读写之前很久就掌握了口头语言。

examples.en: Spanish is spoken by millions of people across Latin America.
examples.zh: 拉丁美洲有数以百万计的人讲西班牙语。

lemmas.def_zh: 不会说话的, 哑的, 说不出话的, 无言的, 非言语所能表达的, (非正式)烂醉的
lemmas.def_en: temporarily incapable of speaking

examples.en: The surprise party left her completely speechless with tears in her eyes.
examples.zh: 这场惊喜派对让她感动得热泪盈眶，一时说不出话来。

lemmas.def_zh: unspeak的过去分词
lemmas.def_en: expressed without speech; ; ; - Emily Dickinson; ; ; - Thomas Wolfe

examples.en: There was an unspoken agreement between the partners to share all profits equally.
examples.zh: 合伙人之间存在一种平分所有利润的默契。

family_guide.root_logic: 核心动词 speak 源于古英语 specan，本义为‘发声言语、交谈表达’，派生出发言主体 speaker 及分词/形容词 spoken；名词 spoke（轮辐）虽与过去式同形，但在历史上源自表示‘木棒/细枝’的独立古词源，现引申为轮子的辐条结构。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意名词 spoke（辐条）与动词 speak 过去式同形同音但词义独立；形容词 spoken 专指‘口头的、口语的’，常与 written（书面的）相对。

lemmas.def_zh: 通知，告知；对……产生影响
lemmas.def_en: to give someone facts or information; to influence or pervade

examples.en: Please keep me informed of any new developments regarding the project.
examples.zh: 关于该项目的任何最新进展，请随时通知我。

examples.en: Her background in economics heavily informs her political decisions.
examples.zh: 她的经济学背景深刻影响了她的政治决策。

lemmas.def_zh: 提供错误消息
lemmas.def_en: give false or misleading information to

examples.en: Untrusted websites can easily misinform the public about important health issues.
examples.zh: 不可信的网站极易在重大健康问题上误导公众。

lemmas.def_zh: 信息，资料；情报
lemmas.def_en: facts provided or learned about something or someone

examples.en: For more information, please visit our official website.
examples.zh: 欲获取更多信息，请访问我们的官方网站。

examples.en: He refused to disclose any confidential information to the media.
examples.zh: 他拒绝向媒体透露任何机密信息。

lemmas.def_zh: 提供消息者, 密告者, 被调查者
lemmas.def_en: a person who supplies information

examples.en: The police protected the identity of the confidential informant during the trial.
examples.zh: 警方在审判期间保护了机密线人的身份。

lemmas.def_zh: 错误的消息, 误传
lemmas.def_en: information that is incorrect

examples.en: Social media platforms struggle to prevent the spread of dangerous medical misinformation.
examples.zh: 社交媒体平台正努力阻止危险医疗虚假信息的传播。

lemmas.def_zh: 密告者, 控告者, 通知者
lemmas.def_en: one who reveals confidential information in return for money

examples.en: The gang suspected there was an informer leaking secrets to the federal agents.
examples.zh: 该帮派怀疑有线人向联邦特工泄露秘密。

lemmas.def_zh: 提供有用信息的；增长见识的
lemmas.def_en: providing useful or interesting information

examples.en: The documentary was both entertaining and highly informative.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片既有娱乐性，又极富知识性。

examples.en: Thank you for such an informative and well-organized presentation.
examples.zh: 感谢你带来如此内容详实且组织有序的演讲。

lemmas.def_zh: 没有得到通知的, 未被告知的, 无知的, 不学无术的, 未受教育的, 蒙昧的
lemmas.def_en: not informed; lacking in knowledge or information

examples.en: Making decisions based on uninformed opinions can lead to costly business errors.
examples.zh: 基于无知见解做出的决策可能会导致代价高昂的商业错误。

lemmas.def_zh: 不提供信息的；不增长见闻的
lemmas.def_en: lacking information

examples.en: The official response was vague and uninformative, leaving many questions unanswered.
examples.zh: 官方回应含糊且缺乏实质信息，留下了许多未解的疑问。

lemmas.def_zh: 提供信息地
lemmas.def_en: in an informative manner

examples.en: The professor spoke informatively about the economic impacts of global climate change.
examples.zh: 教授就全球气候变化对经济的影响作了内容详实的发言。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于拉丁语 informare（赋予形状、塑造心智），核心演变为通过传递事实来‘塑造’认知，引申出通知、信息等义。
family_guide.core_distinction: information 是不可数名词指‘信息内容’；informative 是形容词，强调内容‘富含知识或有参考价值’。

lemmas.def_zh: 包括；包含；把……列入/算入
lemmas.def_en: to contain something as a part of something else, or to make something part of something

examples.en: The total bill includes service charges.
examples.zh: 账单总额中包含服务费。

examples.en: You should include your recent work experience on your resume.
examples.zh: 你应该在简历中列入你最近的工作经历。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 includere（in- 进入 + claudere 关闭/关上），字面义为“关在里面”，引申为把某事物作为整体的一部分“包含、计入”。
family_guide.core_distinction: include 是动词谓语（表达“包含”或“使并入”），而 including 由现在分词语法化为介词，常置于名词后引出补充列举的成分。

lemmas.def_zh: 发送，寄；派遣；促使，使变得
lemmas.def_en: to cause to go or be carried somewhere; to dispatch; to cause someone or something to move or be in a particular state

examples.en: Could you please send me the updated report before the end of the day?
examples.zh: 你能在今天下班前把更新后的报告发给我吗？

examples.en: The sudden loud noise sent the flock of pigeons scattering into the sky.
examples.zh: 突如其来的巨响惊得鸽群四处飞散。

lemmas.def_zh: 已发送信息；发件箱（邮件或即时通讯中）
lemmas.def_en: emails or messages that have been dispatched, or the folder containing them in an email application

examples.en: I checked my sent, but there is no record of the email ever going out.
examples.zh: 我查了发件箱，但没有这封邮件发出去的记录。

lemmas.def_zh: 寄件人, 发报机
lemmas.def_en: someone who transmits a message

examples.en: The package was returned because the sender wrote an invalid delivery address.
examples.zh: 包裹被退回，因为寄件人写了一个无效的送达地址。

lemmas.def_zh: 未送出(或寄发)的
lemmas.def_en: not dispatched or transmitted

examples.en: He saved the emotional letter as an unsent draft on his laptop.
examples.zh: 他把那封充满感情的信作为未发送的草稿保存在笔记本电脑里。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 sendan，核心义为“使前往、促使移动”，后演变为使信件、信息、人员或物品从一处传递到另一处。
family_guide.core_distinction: send 为动词核心词，表示“发送”的行为；sent 本为动词过去式与过去分词，在数字通信语境中常名词化指代“已发送邮件”或“发件箱”。

lemmas.def_zh: 视频；录像；电视影像
lemmas.def_en: a recording of moving visual images, or the technology of recording and broadcasting them

examples.en: She uploaded a short instructional video explaining how to use the software.
examples.zh: 她上传了一段教学短视频，讲解如何使用该软件。

examples.en: The sound quality was crystal clear, but the video kept buffering.
examples.zh: 声音非常清晰，但视频画面一直在缓冲。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 videre（看见），与 audio（我听见）相对，字面意为“我看见”，引申为用于记录、传输和播放动态画面的视讯与录像媒介。

lemmas.def_zh: 政治；政治事务；政治学；权术
lemmas.def_en: the activities associated with governance, public affairs, or the pursuit of power within an organization

examples.en: She decided to enter politics to advocate for comprehensive healthcare reform.
examples.zh: 她决定步入政坛，以倡导全面的医疗改革。

examples.en: Office politics can often undermine genuine team collaboration.
examples.zh: 办公室政治往往会破坏真正的团队协作。

lemmas.def_zh: 政治家；政客
lemmas.def_en: a person who is professionally involved in politics, especially as an elected representative

examples.en: Voters frequently criticize politicians for making promises they cannot keep.
examples.zh: 选民经常批评政客做出无法兑现的承诺。

lemmas.def_zh: 政治的；政党的；党派的
lemmas.def_en: relating to the government, public affairs, or power relations of a country

examples.en: The leaders are seeking a peaceful political solution to the border dispute.
examples.zh: 领导人们正在为边界争端寻求和平的政治解决方案。

lemmas.def_zh: 非政治性的
lemmas.def_en: not political

examples.en: The charity remains a nonpolitical organization dedicated solely to disaster relief.
examples.zh: 该慈善机构仍然是一个仅致力于救灾的非政治性组织。

lemmas.def_zh: 非政治的, 与政治无关的, 无政治意义的, 不关心政治的
lemmas.def_en: politically neutral

examples.en: He preferred to live an unpolitical life focused entirely on art and literature.
examples.zh: 他更喜欢过一种完全专注于艺术和文学的、远离政治的生活。

lemmas.def_zh: 政治上；从政治角度
lemmas.def_en: in a way that relates to politics or government policies

examples.en: The controversial decision was widely seen as politically motivated.
examples.zh: 这项有争议的决定被普遍认为是出于政治动机。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古希腊语 polis（城邦、公民），核心语义演变指代与国家治理、公民事务及权力角逐相关的一切活动、学说与身份。
family_guide.core_distinction: politics 为政治事务或政治学（总称）；politician 指从事政治活动的职业政客；political 与 politically 则分别充当其修饰事物的形容词与副词。

lemmas.def_zh: 年轻的, 无经验的, 朝气蓬勃的
lemmas.def_en: (used of living things especially persons) in an early period of life or development or growth

examples.en: The robin carefully fed its hungry young in the nest all morning.
examples.zh: 知更鸟整个上午都在巢里悉心喂养饥饿的幼鸟。

lemmas.def_zh: 青年们, 幼小动物, 崽
lemmas.def_en: any immature animal

examples.en: The robin carefully fed its hungry young in the nest all morning.
examples.zh: 知更鸟整个上午都在巢里悉心喂养饥饿的幼鸟。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自印欧原始语根 *yeu-（活力、年轻），核心语义指处于生命、存在或发展的早期阶段，引申出充满生机但尚不成熟的特质。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词 young 修饰处于早期阶段的人或事物；名词 young 则特指群体，可表示人类中的“年轻人（统称）”或动物的“幼崽”。

lemmas.def_zh: 运转；操作；经营；动手术
lemmas.def_en: to function, control a machine, manage an organization, or perform a surgical procedure

examples.en: The automated system can operate continuously without human intervention.
examples.zh: 该自动化系统无需人工干预即可持续运转。

examples.en: Doctors decided to operate on the injured player immediately.
examples.zh: 医生决定立即对受伤的运动员实施手术。

lemmas.def_zh: 运转；操作；外科手术；军事/商业行动
lemmas.def_en: the state of functioning, a surgical procedure, or an organized activity or business

examples.en: The rescue operation was launched within minutes of the distress call.
examples.zh: 救援行动在接到求救电话后几分钟内便展开了。

examples.en: The factory resumed normal operation after completing the safety inspection.
examples.zh: 工厂在完成安全检查后恢复了正常运转。

lemmas.def_zh: 操作员；接线员；运营商；经营者
lemmas.def_en: a person who operates equipment, connects telephone calls, or runs a business

examples.en: The crane operator moved the heavy container with great precision.
examples.zh: 起重机操作员极其精准地移动了沉重的集装箱。

examples.en: He contacted his mobile network operator to upgrade his data plan.
examples.zh: 他联系了移动网络运营商以升级数据套餐。

lemmas.def_zh: 特工；干员；技工
lemmas.def_en: a secret agent or detective; a worker with special skills

examples.en: Undercover operatives gathered crucial intelligence on the smuggling ring.
examples.zh: 卧底特工搜集到了关于该走私团伙的关键情报。

examples.en: Skilled factory operatives monitor the automated assembly line closely.
examples.zh: 技术熟练的工厂工人密切监控着自动化装配线。

lemmas.def_zh: operative的变形
lemmas.def_en: in a manner to produce an effect

examples.en: The hospital is operatively ready to handle the sudden surge in emergency patients.
examples.zh: 该医院在运作上已准备好应对急诊患者的激增。

lemmas.def_zh: 动作的
lemmas.def_en: having influence or producing an effect

examples.en: Psychologists use rewards to shape behavioral responses through effective operant conditioning.
examples.zh: 心理学家通过有效的操作性条件反射利用奖励来塑造行为反应。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 operari（劳作、生效，源于 opus“工作”），核心内涵从“付诸行动/发挥功能”演变为机器运转、业务管理、军事行动以及外科手术。
family_guide.core_distinction: operator 常指机械操作员、电话接线员或商业经营者；而 operative 作名词时特指秘密行动的特工、情报人员或特定工种的技术工人。

lemmas.def_zh: 训练, 教育, 对准；受训练, 锻炼
lemmas.def_en: create by training and teaching

examples.en: She decided to train every morning to prepare for her first marathon.
examples.zh: 她决定每天早上锻炼，为她的第一次马拉松做准备。

lemmas.def_zh: 火车, 列车, 行列, 长队, 一连串的后果, 顺序
lemmas.def_en: public transport provided by a line of railway cars coupled together and drawn by a locomotive

examples.en: She decided to train every morning to prepare for her first marathon.
examples.zh: 她决定每天早上锻炼，为她的第一次马拉松做准备。

lemmas.def_zh: 训练, 培养
lemmas.def_en: activity leading to skilled behavior

examples.en: Intensive physical training is required before attempting to climb this challenging mountain.
examples.zh: 在尝试攀登这座极具挑战性的高山前，需要进行高强度的体能训练。

lemmas.def_zh: 训练员, 驯马师
lemmas.def_en: one who trains other persons or animals

examples.en: A fitness trainer guided her through a safe and effective rehabilitation routine.
examples.zh: 一名健身教练指导她完成了一套安全有效的康复训练。

lemmas.def_zh: 实习生, 新兵, 受培训者
lemmas.def_en: someone who is being trained

examples.en: Each trainee must shadow an experienced technician for the first two months.
examples.zh: 每位实习生在最初两个月内必须跟随一名经验丰富的技术员学习。

lemmas.def_zh: 受训练的情况[时间], 受训者的地位[津贴]
lemmas.def_en: financial aid that enables you to get trained for a specified job

examples.en: She successfully secured a paid traineeship at a local marketing firm after graduation.
examples.zh: 毕业后，她顺利在当地一家营销公司获得了一份带薪实习岗位。

lemmas.def_zh: 未经训练的
lemmas.def_en: not disciplined or conditioned or made adept by training

examples.en: Leaving complex medical equipment to untrained staff could lead to serious accidents.
examples.zh: 把复杂的医疗设备留给未经培训的人员操作可能会导致严重事故。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 trahere（拉、拖拽），从“拉扯形成的一长串事物”（列车、裙裾）引申出“沿着特定路径引导、规范与塑造”（训练、培养）。
family_guide.core_distinction: training 指抽象的“训练过程或培训课程”（通常不可数），而 trainer 指施教的“教练、培训师”或英式英语中的“运动鞋”。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 粪便，屎；破烂，狗屁；麻烦；v. 排便；戏弄，胡扯
lemmas.def_en: n. feces; nonsense or poor-quality things; trouble; v. to defecate; to tease or deceive

examples.en: I don't give a shit about what they say behind my back.
examples.zh: 我根本不在乎他们在背后对我说三道四。

examples.en: Are you serious, or are you just shitting me?
examples.zh: 你是认真的，还是在跟我扯淡？

lemmas.def_zh: (shitty 的最高级) 劣等的, 较差的

examples.en: That was hands down the shittiest movie I have ever seen in my entire life.
examples.zh: 那绝对是我这辈子看过的最烂的电影。

lemmas.def_zh: 厕所；坐桶；[美国英语]马
lemmas.def_en: a person who defecates

examples.en: He excused himself from the dinner table to go use the shitter upstairs.
examples.zh: 他从餐桌旁告退，去使用楼上的厕所。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 摇滚乐

examples.en: The weather got even shittier as cold rain started pouring down on us.
examples.zh: 随着冰冷的雨水倾盆而下，天气变得更加糟糕了。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 劣质的，糟糕透顶的；卑鄙的，令人厌恶的
lemmas.def_en: adj. of very bad quality; unpleasant, unfair, or contemptible

examples.en: I had a really shitty day at work and just want to sleep.
examples.zh: 我今天上班糟透了，现在只想睡觉。

examples.en: It was a shitty thing to do to an old friend.
examples.zh: 对老朋友做出这种事未免太卑鄙了。

lemmas.def_en: extremely frightened

examples.en: The sudden loud bang outside the dark bedroom scared her completely shitless.
examples.zh: 漆黑卧室外突如其来的巨响把她吓得魂飞魄散。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 粪便，屎；破烂，狗屁；麻烦；v. 排便；戏弄，胡扯
lemmas.def_en: n. feces; nonsense or poor-quality things; trouble; v. to defecate; to tease or deceive

examples.en: I don't give a shit about what they say behind my back.
examples.zh: 我根本不在乎他们在背后对我说三道四。

examples.en: Are you serious, or are you just shitting me?
examples.zh: 你是认真的，还是在跟我扯淡？

lemmas.def_zh: 大便, 拉屎( shit的过去式和过去分词 ); 拉屎弄脏（某物）; 取笑; 欺骗
lemmas.def_en: give away information about somebody

examples.en: The terrified dog panicked during the thunderstorm and shat all over the living room carpet.
examples.zh: 那只受惊的狗在雷雨中惊慌失措，把大便拉得满客厅地毯都是。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语 *skit-（与 PIE *skei-‘切开、分离’相关，引申为‘排泄、分离出体外’），原始语义为排便与粪便，后在俚语和口语中广泛泛化，演变为指代劣质事物、麻烦、谎言废话及情绪发泄语。
family_guide.core_distinction: shit 兼具名词与动词词性，指代排泄物、破烂玩意或排便/戏弄行为；shitty 为其派生的形容词，专指事物或处境‘极差的、糟透的、下作的’。

lemmas.def_zh: 学习；学会；得知，获悉
lemmas.def_en: to gain knowledge of or skill in something through study, practice, or being taught; to become aware of something

examples.en: She is keen to learn new skills to advance her career.
examples.zh: 她非常渴望学习新技能以提升自己的职业发展。

examples.en: We were deeply saddened to learn of his sudden passing.
examples.zh: 获悉他突然离世的消息，我们深感悲痛。

lemmas.def_zh: 学习；得知（learn 的过去式和过去分词，主要用于英式英语）
lemmas.def_en: past tense and past participle of learn (predominantly British English)

examples.en: He learnt to ride a bicycle when he was just five years old.
examples.zh: 他刚满五岁时就学会了骑自行车。

examples.en: She has learnt an important lesson from this painful experience.
examples.zh: 她从这次痛苦的经历中吸取了重要的教训。

lemmas.def_zh: 使忘掉, 从脑中扫除掉, 抛掉以前的想法
lemmas.def_en: try to forget; put out of one's memory or knowledge

examples.en: It took months for the pianist to unlearn the bad habits from childhood lessons.
examples.zh: 这位钢琴家花了好几个月才改掉童年学琴时养成的坏习惯。

lemmas.def_zh: 学习；学问，知识
lemmas.def_en: the process of acquiring knowledge or skills; knowledge acquired through study

examples.en: Digital technology has transformed the way language learning takes place.
examples.zh: 数字技术改变了语言学习的方式。

examples.en: The university is widely respected as a center of great learning.
examples.zh: 这所大学作为深厚学问的殿堂而广受推崇。

lemmas.def_zh: 学习者, 初学者
lemmas.def_en: someone (especially a child) who learns (as from a teacher) or takes up knowledge or beliefs

examples.en: As a fast learner, she mastered the software within just a couple of days.
examples.zh: 作为一个学得很快的人，她几天内就掌握了这款软件。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 博学的；学术性的
lemmas.def_en: having or showing profound knowledge; scholarly
lemmas.usage_note: 注意作为独立形容词时读音通常为两音节 /ˈlɜːnɪd/（不同于动词过去式 /lɜːnd/）。常用搭配如 a learned professor, learned journal。

examples.en: The professor gave a learned lecture on medieval literature.
examples.zh: 教授做了一场关于中世纪文学的博学而深入的讲座。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 leornian，原义带有“循迹探求、经由经验获知”之意，演化为通过学习、练习或经历掌握知识与技能。
family_guide.core_distinction: learnt 是英式英语中常用的过去式/分词形式（与美式 learned 对应）；learning 是动名词形式，既指“学习的过程”，也指积累的“学问与知识”。

lemmas.def_zh: 班级；阶级，社会阶层；等级，品级；课
lemmas.def_en: a group of students; a social rank or division; a set or category of things having common properties

examples.en: Education is often seen as a powerful tool for upward social mobility between classes.
examples.zh: 教育常被视为实现社会阶层向上流动的有力工具。

examples.en: She missed several classes this week due to a severe cold.
examples.zh: 因为重感冒，她这周缺了几节课。

lemmas.def_zh: 分类广告（通常作复数 classifieds）
lemmas.def_en: a small advertisement placed in a newspaper, magazine, or website under a specific heading

examples.en: He placed an ad in the newspaper classifieds to sell his old bicycle.
examples.zh: 他在报纸的分类广告栏刊登了一条广告，想卖掉他的旧自行车。

lemmas.def_en: the act of distributing things into classes or categories of the same type
lemmas.def_zh: 分类，分级；类别

examples.en: The library uses a decimal classification system to organize its collection.
examples.zh: 该图书馆使用十进制分类系统来组织藏书。

lemmas.def_zh: 分类者, 分粒器, 分级机, 汉语中的量词
lemmas.def_en: a person who creates classifications

examples.en: The algorithm uses a machine learning classifier to detect spam in incoming emails.
examples.zh: 该算法使用机器学习分类器来检测收件箱中的垃圾邮件。

lemmas.def_zh: 班级；阶级，社会阶层；等级，品级；课
lemmas.def_en: a group of students; a social rank or division; a set or category of things having common properties

examples.en: Education is often seen as a powerful tool for upward social mobility between classes.
examples.zh: 教育常被视为实现社会阶层向上流动的有力工具。

examples.en: She missed several classes this week due to a severe cold.
examples.zh: 因为重感冒，她这周缺了几节课。

lemmas.def_zh: 分类, 归类, 分等
lemmas.def_en: arrange or order by classes or categories

examples.en: Biologists classify this newly discovered organism as a rare type of marine sponge.
examples.zh: 生物学家将这种新发现的有机体归类为一种罕见的海洋海绵。

lemmas.def_zh: 高级的；优雅的；有品位的
lemmas.def_en: stylish, sophisticated, and of high quality

examples.en: They celebrated their anniversary at a classy rooftop restaurant overlooking the harbor.
examples.zh: 他们在一间能俯瞰海港的高档顶楼餐厅庆祝了结婚纪念日。

lemmas.def_zh: 无类别的, 不保密的
lemmas.def_en: not subject to a security classification

examples.en: The government released several unclassified documents regarding the historic space mission yesterday.
examples.zh: 政府昨天公布了几份关于那次历史性太空任务的非机密文件。

lemmas.def_zh: 无阶级的
lemmas.def_en: favoring social equality

examples.en: The philosopher dreamed of a truly classless society where everyone enjoyed equal opportunities.
examples.zh: 这位哲学家梦想建立一个每个人都享有平等机会的真正无阶级的社会。

lemmas.def_zh: 分类上的, 类别的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or involving classification:

examples.en: Biologists revised the classificatory scheme to accommodate newly discovered marine species.
examples.zh: 生物学家修改了分类体系，以容纳新发现的海洋物种。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 classis（古罗马按财产划分的公民等级），核心概念为“划分与等级”，引申出演化为社会阶层、班级课程、品质档次及归类行为。
family_guide.core_distinction: class 兼具名词（班级/阶层/等级）与动词（分类）；classified 作名词专指报刊或网站上的“分类广告”（常作复数）；classy 为形容词，侧重“有档次、高雅的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 倒下, 落下, 来临, 失守, 阵亡, 下跌, 减弱, 倾斜, 垮台, 轮到, 变成, 降低
lemmas.def_en: descend in free fall under the influence of gravity

examples.en: Leaves begin to turn golden and fall from the branches in early autumn.
examples.zh: 初秋时节，树叶开始变黄并从树枝上落下。

lemmas.def_zh: 击倒
lemmas.def_en: cause to fall by or as if by delivering a blow

examples.en: The lumberjack used a sharp axe to fell the giant oak tree safely.
examples.zh: 伐木工用一把锋利的斧头安全地砍倒了那棵巨大的橡树。

lemmas.def_zh: fall的过去分词
lemmas.def_en: descend in free fall under the influence of gravity

examples.en: Hikers had to carefully step over a fallen tree blocking the mountain trail.
examples.zh: 徒步旅行者不得不小心地跨过一棵挡住山间小路的倒下的树。

lemmas.def_zh: 落下, 瀑布, 采伐量, 下降, 落差, 降低, 堕落, 秋天
lemmas.def_en: the season when the leaves fall from the trees

examples.en: Leaves begin to turn golden and fall from the branches in early autumn.
examples.zh: 初秋时节，树叶开始变黄并从树枝上落下。

lemmas.def_zh: 一季所伐的木材, 折缝
lemmas.def_en: the dressed skin of an animal (especially a large animal)

examples.en: The lumberjack used a sharp axe to fell the giant oak tree safely.
examples.zh: 伐木工用一把锋利的斧头安全地砍倒了那棵巨大的橡树。

lemmas.def_zh: 伐木者, 伐木机, 平缝工, 平缝装置, 接缝工, (非正式)伙伴, (非正式)家伙
lemmas.def_en: a person who fells trees

examples.en: The experienced timber feller expertly brought down the towering pine tree within minutes.
examples.zh: 那位经验丰富的伐木工在几分钟内熟练地砍倒了高耸的松树。

lemmas.def_zh: 砍伐树木的人
lemmas.def_en: a person who fells trees

examples.en: The experienced faller carefully calculated the wind direction before cutting down the massive pine.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的伐木工在砍倒那棵巨大的松树前，仔细测算了风向。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语，核心语义为“受重力、外力或失去支撑而从高处向下坠落/倒下”，由此引申出使役形态“使倒下（砍倒）”以及状态的衰退与降临。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意不及物动词 fall（倒下/掉落，过去式为 fell）与及物动词 fell（砍倒/击倒，规则变化 felled-felled）在句型及使役关系上的区别。

lemmas.def_zh: 完全的, 十足的, 完成的
lemmas.def_en: having every necessary or normal part or component or step

examples.en: The renovation gave the old apartment building a complete and stylish transformation.
examples.zh: 翻新工程使这座老旧的公寓楼焕然一新，彻底改观。

lemmas.def_zh: [经] 未完成的
lemmas.def_en: not yet finished

examples.en: Workers were ordered to secure the uncompleted bridge before the heavy storm arrived.
examples.zh: 在大风暴来临前，工人们接到命令去加固那座未完工的桥梁。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 表单填写不完整；生命能实现什么
lemmas.def_en: not complete or total; not completed

examples.en: The system rejected the form because several critical fields remained uncomplete.
examples.zh: 系统拒绝了该表单，因为有几个关键字段仍未填写完整。

lemmas.def_zh: 完成, 完工, 使圆满
lemmas.def_en: come or bring to a finish or an end

examples.en: The renovation gave the old apartment building a complete and stylish transformation.
examples.zh: 翻新工程使这座老旧的公寓楼焕然一新，彻底改观。

lemmas.def_zh: 完全地, 十分地, 圆满地
lemmas.def_en: to a complete degree or to the full or entire extent (`whole' is often used informally for `wholly')

examples.en: The loud party next door completely ruined our hopes for a quiet evening.
examples.zh: 隔壁吵闹的派对彻底毁掉了我们想要度过一个安静夜晚的希望。

lemmas.def_zh: 完成
lemmas.def_en: (American football) a successful forward pass in football

examples.en: The long-awaited highway project is finally nearing its completion ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 这条期待已久的公路工程终于提前接近完工。

lemmas.def_zh: 完全
lemmas.def_en: the state of being complete and entire; having everything that is needed

examples.en: The auditor checked the completeness of the financial records before signing the report.
examples.zh: 审计员在签署报告前检查了财务记录的完整性。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 complere（com- 加强语气 + plere 填满），核心逻辑为“全部填满”，引申为“完整的”、“去完成”以及“彻底的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: complete 兼具形容词（完整的/彻底的）与动词（完成/使圆满）用法；completion 专指“完成/完工”的事件或状态；completely 则是强调程度的“完全/彻底”。

lemmas.def_zh: 光, 光亮, 灯, 日光, 发光体, 光源, 杰出人物, 火花, 眼光
lemmas.def_en: (physics) electromagnetic radiation that can produce a visual sensation

examples.en: She switched on the reading light as darkness filled the quiet room.
examples.zh: 当夜幕笼罩安静的房间时，她打开了阅读灯。

lemmas.def_zh: 文学（literature 的非正式缩写）
lemmas.def_en: the humanistic study of a body of literature

examples.en: A single candle lit the dark hallway during the sudden power outage.
examples.zh: 在突如其来的停电期间，一支蜡烛照亮了黑暗的走廊。

lemmas.def_zh: 光亮度, (颜色的)浅淡, 轻率, 轻佻, 轻浮, 轻盈, 轻松, 轻巧, 精巧, 优美
lemmas.def_en: a feeling of joy and pride

examples.en: He admired the lightness of the fabric, which felt perfect for hot summer days.
examples.zh: 他很喜欢这种面料的轻盈质感，感觉非常适合炎热的夏天。

lemmas.def_zh: 驳运, 驳运费
lemmas.def_en: the fee charged for carrying goods in lighters

examples.en: The shipping company included extra lighterage fees for unloading cargo offshore.
examples.zh: 船运公司计入了在离岸卸货的额外驳运费。

lemmas.def_zh: 点燃, 照亮；点着, 变亮, 突降, 偶然碰到
lemmas.def_en: make lighter or brighter

examples.en: She switched on the reading light as darkness filled the quiet room.
examples.zh: 当夜幕笼罩安静的房间时，她打开了阅读灯。

lemmas.def_zh: 以驳船搬运
lemmas.def_en: transport in a flatbottom boat

examples.en: Workers will lighter the cargo from the large vessel to reach the shallow port.
examples.zh: 工人们将用驳船把大船上的货物运往浅水港。

lemmas.def_zh: 轻的, 少量的, 轻微的, 轻快的, 轻浮的, 明亮的, 淡色的, 容易的
lemmas.def_en: of comparatively little physical weight or density

examples.en: She switched on the reading light as darkness filled the quiet room.
examples.zh: 当夜幕笼罩安静的房间时，她打开了阅读灯。

lemmas.def_zh: 无光的, 不发光的
lemmas.def_en: giving no light

examples.en: The explorers stepped into the lightless cave with cautious, slow movements.
examples.zh: 探险者小心缓慢地走进了漆黑无光的洞穴。

lemmas.def_zh: 未被照亮的, 未被点燃的
lemmas.def_en: not set afire or burning

examples.en: Driving along the unlighted country road at midnight was a stressful experience.
examples.zh: 半夜在没有路灯的乡间小路上开车是一种令人紧张的经历。

lemmas.def_zh: 轻轻地, 少许, 不费力地
lemmas.def_en: without good reason

examples.en: She knocked lightly on the office door before slowly stepping inside.
examples.zh: 她轻轻敲了敲办公室的门，然后慢慢走了进去。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于日耳曼语词根，在演变中融合了‘光亮/照亮’（与拉丁语 lux 同源）与‘轻盈/微小’（与拉丁语 levis 同源）两组同形核心意象。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意区分兼具多词性的 light；lighter 作动词为专业航海航运术语（驳船转运）；lit 作名词时多为 literature（文学）的非正式日常缩略。

lemmas.def_zh: 执行，履行；表演，演出；运转
lemmas.def_en: to carry out an action, task, or function; to entertain an audience by acting, singing, or dancing

examples.en: A team of experienced surgeons performed the complex procedure without complications.
examples.zh: 一组经验丰富的外科医生顺利完成了这台复杂的手术，未出现并发症。

examples.en: The orchestra will perform Beethoven's Ninth Symphony at the concert hall tonight.
examples.zh: 该管弦乐团今晚将在音乐厅演奏贝多芬第九交响曲。

lemmas.def_zh: 演出，表演；表现，业绩；性能
lemmas.def_en: the act of presenting a play or concert; how well someone or something works or does a job

examples.en: Her captivating performance in the drama earned praise from critics worldwide.
examples.zh: 她在这部戏剧中扣人心弦的表演赢得了全球评论家的赞誉。

examples.en: The manager reviewed the quarterly performance of the sales team to set new targets.
examples.zh: 经理评估了销售团队的季度业绩，以设定新的工作目标。

lemmas.def_zh: 表演者，演艺人员；执行者，表现者
lemmas.def_en: a person who entertains an audience, such as an actor, musician, or singer; a person who achieves results in a specific way

examples.en: Talented street performers gathered around the square, drawing an enthusiastic crowd.
examples.zh: 才华横溢的街头艺人们聚集在广场周围，吸引了热情的观众。

examples.en: As a top performer in the tech department, she was quickly promoted to lead the new project.
examples.zh: 作为技术部门业绩最拔尖的员工，她很快被提拔负责领导新项目。

lemmas.def_zh: 不履行, 不实行, 不实施
lemmas.def_en: failure to act with the prudence that a reasonable person would exercise under the same circumstances

examples.en: The contractor faced heavy penalties for the nonperformance of his contractual duties.
examples.zh: 该承包商因不履行合同义务而面临巨额罚款。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语及古法语，由 per-（彻底）+ fournir（提供、完成）结合而成，核心演变逻辑为“彻底贯彻并完成某项行动”，随后引申为“执行任务”、“展现机能”以及“公开演出”。
family_guide.core_distinction: performance 聚焦于具体的“演出”、抽象的“表现/性能/绩效”（行为或结果），而 performer 则专指承担动作的“表演者”或“实干者/绩优者”（主体）。

lemmas.def_zh: 清楚的, 明确的, 澄清的
lemmas.def_en: readily apparent to the mind

examples.en: The manager gave clear instructions so everyone understood their tasks immediately.
examples.zh: 经理给出了明确的指示，大家立即明白了各自的任务。

lemmas.def_zh: 不清楚的；不明确的；难以理解的
lemmas.def_en: not easy to see, hear, or understand; uncertain

examples.en: The exact motive behind the decision remains unclear.
examples.zh: 该决定背后的确切动机目前仍不明确。

lemmas.def_zh: 清澈的, 透明的, 平静的
lemmas.def_en: clear and bright

examples.en: We could see colorful pebbles resting at the bottom of the limpid mountain stream.
examples.zh: 我们可以看到清澈的山涧底部铺着五颜六色的卵石。

lemmas.def_zh: [经] 未付清的
lemmas.def_en: not cleared; not rid of objects or obstructions

examples.en: The bank refused to process the payment due to an uncleared check.
examples.zh: 由于有一张未结清的支票，银行拒绝处理这笔付款。

lemmas.def_zh: 澄清, 清除障碍；放晴, 变清澈
lemmas.def_en: rid of obstructions

examples.en: The manager gave clear instructions so everyone understood their tasks immediately.
examples.zh: 经理给出了明确的指示，大家立即明白了各自的任务。

lemmas.def_zh: 清晰地；显然地；无疑地
lemmas.def_en: in a way that is easy to see, hear, or understand; obviously

examples.en: She spoke slowly and clearly so that everyone could understand.
examples.zh: 她语速缓慢且口齿清晰，以便每个人都能听懂。

examples.en: Clearly, there has been a serious misunderstanding.
examples.zh: 显然，这里产生了一个严重的误会。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 含糊地；不清晰
lemmas.def_en: in a manner that is unclear

examples.en: The faded sign was unclearly printed, making it difficult to find the exit.
examples.zh: 褪色的标志印得模糊不清，让人很难找到出口。

lemmas.def_zh: （林中的）空地；清除；结算
lemmas.def_en: an open space in a forest; the act of removing something

examples.en: They pitched their tents in a sunny clearing deep in the woods.
examples.zh: 他们在树林深处一片阳光充足的空地上扎下了帐篷。

lemmas.def_zh: 许可，准许；清除；清仓；净空，间隙
lemmas.def_en: official permission; the removal of unwanted things; distance between two objects

examples.en: The pilot requested clearance from the control tower to land.
examples.zh: 飞行员请求控制塔批准降落许可。

examples.en: The truck was too tall to have enough clearance under the bridge.
examples.zh: 这辆卡车过高，在桥下的通过净空高度不够。

lemmas.def_en: free from obscurity and easy to understand; the comprehensibility of clear expression
lemmas.def_zh: 清楚, 明晰

examples.en: The manager explained the complex instructions with remarkable clarity and patience.
examples.zh: 经理以极高的清晰度和耐心解释了复杂的指令。

lemmas.def_zh: 晴朗, 明白
lemmas.def_en: free from obscurity and easy to understand; the comprehensibility of clear expression

examples.en: The clearness of the mountain water amazed the hikers resting near the stream.
examples.zh: 山涧溪水的清澈让在溪边休息的徒步者赞叹不已。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 clarus（明亮的、清澈的），核心意象是“无遮挡、透光、通畅”，由此延伸出视觉上的“清澈/清晰”、认知上的“明白易懂”以及动作上的“移走障碍/放行”。
family_guide.core_distinction: clearing 常指林中开辟出的“空地”；clearance 则侧重于官方的“许可/准许”、清理行为或机械/建筑中的“安全间隙”。

lemmas.def_zh: 虽然，尽管；不过，可是
lemmas.def_en: despite the fact that; although; used to introduce a fact or opinion that makes the other part of the sentence seem surprising

examples.en: Though she was exhausted, she managed to finish the report before the deadline.
examples.zh: 虽然她疲惫不堪，但还是设法在截止日期前完成了报告。

examples.en: The plan sounds promising, though it carries some financial risks.
examples.zh: 这个方案听起来很有前景，尽管伴随着一定的财务风险。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 þēah，核心逻辑表示让步或对照，即“即使那样、尽管如此”，用于引出与前提相对立、出乎意料或补充修正的事实。

lemmas.def_zh: 是的，对（表肯定或赞同）；赞同，肯定答复；赞成票
lemmas.def_en: used to express agreement or affirmation; an affirmative reply or vote

examples.en: "Would you like some coffee?" "Yes, please."
examples.zh: “你想喝点咖啡吗？”“好的，谢谢。”

examples.en: She answered with a firm yes when asked to lead the project.
examples.zh: 当被问及是否愿意领导该项目时，她给出了坚定的肯定答复。

examples.en: The proposal was passed with twenty yeses and only two noes.
examples.zh: 该提案以二十票赞成、仅两票反对获得通过。

lemmas.def_zh: 是的，对（表肯定或赞同）；赞同，肯定答复；赞成票
lemmas.def_en: used to express agreement or affirmation; an affirmative reply or vote

examples.en: "Would you like some coffee?" "Yes, please."
examples.zh: “你想喝点咖啡吗？”“好的，谢谢。”

examples.en: She answered with a firm yes when asked to lead the project.
examples.zh: 当被问及是否愿意领导该项目时，她给出了坚定的肯定答复。

examples.en: The proposal was passed with twenty yeses and only two noes.
examples.zh: 该提案以二十票赞成、仅两票反对获得通过。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 gēse（gēa‘是’+ sīe‘愿其如此’），核心逻辑即表达肯定的应答、确认或赞同，后延伸出指代赞成行为或赞同票的名词用法。
family_guide.core_distinction: 副词作口头或书面应答表达肯定；名词则指代‘赞同的回答’或‘赞成票’（复数常作 yeses 或 yesses）。

lemmas.def_zh: 乐趣，玩乐；有趣的人或事
lemmas.def_en: enjoyment, amusement, or lighthearted pleasure

examples.en: We had a lot of fun at the beach last weekend.
examples.zh: 上周末我们在海滩玩得非常开心。

examples.en: It is not polite to make fun of other people's mistakes.
examples.zh: 取笑别人的错误是不礼貌的。

lemmas.def_zh: 滑稽人物
lemmas.def_en: an account of an amusing incident (usually with a punch line)

examples.en: He acted like the resident funny of the group, always making people smile.
examples.zh: 他就像团队里的滑稽人物，总是逗大家开心。

lemmas.def_zh: 滑稽可笑
lemmas.def_en: a comic incident or series of incidents

examples.en: The funniness of the scene caught everyone off guard, triggering loud laughter.
examples.zh: 那一幕的滑稽让所有人猝不及防，引来一阵大笑。

lemmas.def_zh: 好笑的, 有趣的, 滑稽的
lemmas.def_en: arousing or provoking laughter

examples.en: He acted like the resident funny of the group, always making people smile.
examples.zh: 他就像团队里的滑稽人物，总是逗大家开心。

lemmas.def_zh: 硬充滑稽的
lemmas.def_en: not funny; especially failing to achieve the intended humor

examples.en: His offensive and unfunny joke fell flat, causing an awkward silence.
examples.zh: 他那冒犯又不好笑的笑话冷场了，引来一阵尴尬的沉默。

lemmas.def_zh: 滑稽可笑地
lemmas.def_en: in a strange manner

examples.en: Funnily enough, we met at the airport without planning it beforehand.
examples.zh: 说来好笑，我们事前没计划却碰巧在机场遇见了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于中古英语方言词 fonne（愚弄、欺弄），其语义由早期的“戏弄、作弄”弱化演变为现代的“开玩笑、乐趣、娱乐”。
family_guide.core_distinction: fun 强调“产生愉悦与乐趣的体验”；funny 作为形容词侧重“滑稽引人发笑的”或“古怪反常的”，作为名词口语中指“笑话/趣事”（复数常指报纸连环画）。

lemmas.def_zh: 打, 打击, 碰撞, 打中, 袭击, 偶然碰上；打, 打中, 打击, 碰撞, 偶然碰上
lemmas.def_en: cause to move by striking

examples.en: The movie became a massive hit and broke several box office records worldwide.
examples.zh: 这部电影大获成功，打破了全球多项票房纪录。

lemmas.def_zh: 打击, 打, 冲撞, 讽刺
lemmas.def_en: (baseball) a successful stroke in an athletic contest (especially in baseball)

examples.en: The movie became a massive hit and broke several box office records worldwide.
examples.zh: 这部电影大获成功，打破了全球多项票房纪录。

lemmas.def_zh: 打手, 打击的人
lemmas.def_en: (baseball) a ballplayer who is batting

examples.en: The baseball coach praised the talented hitter for driving in the winning run.
examples.zh: 棒球教练称赞这位天才击球手打进了致胜一分。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺斯语，核心意象为'猛烈碰击/接触'，由此引申为物理打击、击中目标、造成冲击以及引申为大获成功的作品或点击量。
family_guide.core_distinction: hit 兼作动词（击打/达成）和名词（击打/成功之作/点击），而 hitter 专指执行击打动作的人（尤指棒球击球员）或引申为具有重大影响力的人物。

lemmas.def_zh: 能够的；有能力的；有才干的
lemmas.def_en: having the power, skill, means, or opportunity to do something; competent

examples.en: She was able to solve the complex problem in just a few minutes.
examples.zh: 她在短短几分钟内就解决了这个复杂的问题。

examples.en: He proved to be an able administrator during the crisis.
examples.zh: 事实证明，他在危机期间是一位很有才干的管理者。

lemmas.def_zh: 不能的；无法的；没有能力的
lemmas.def_en: lacking the skill, means, or opportunity to do something

examples.en: Due to a technical failure, we were unable to access the database.
examples.zh: 由于技术故障，我们无法访问数据库。

examples.en: He was unable to attend the meeting because of a family emergency.
examples.zh: 因为家里突发紧急情况，他未能出席会议。

lemmas.def_zh: 能力；才能；本领
lemmas.def_en: the physical or mental power, skill, or means to do something

examples.en: She has a remarkable ability to remain calm under extreme pressure.
examples.zh: 她拥有在巨大压力下保持冷静的非凡能力。

examples.en: The training program is designed for athletes of all ability levels.
examples.zh: 该培训项目旨在面向所有能力水平的运动员。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 habilis（易操纵的、合适的，词源同 have），核心指“具备足够的条件、能力或手段去做某事”。
family_guide.core_distinction: able 与 unable 构成直接反义对立，两者均高频用于“be (un)able to do sth”句型，表示特定情境下的能力或客观条件的具备与否。

lemmas.def_zh: 射击，开枪；投篮，射门；拍摄；疾驰
lemmas.def_en: to fire a weapon; to kick or hit a ball toward a goal; to film or photograph; to move quickly

examples.en: The director decided to shoot the entire film on location in Iceland.
examples.zh: 导演决定全片在冰岛进行实景拍摄。

examples.en: He had an open chance to shoot but decided to pass the ball instead.
examples.zh: 他本有绝佳的起脚射门机会，但最终选择了传球。

lemmas.def_zh: 射击，开火；射门，击球；镜头，照片；注射
lemmas.def_en: an act of firing a weapon; an attempt to score in sports; a photograph or film sequence; an injection

examples.en: The photographer managed to capture a stunning close-up shot of the eagle.
examples.zh: 摄影师成功捕捉到了老鹰惊艳的特写镜头。

examples.en: Neighbors reported hearing several loud shots coming from the alley.
examples.zh: 邻居们报告说听到小巷里传出几声刺耳的枪响。

lemmas.def_zh: 枪击事件；射击运动；（电影等）拍摄
lemmas.def_en: an incident where people are shot; the sport of firing guns; the process of filming

examples.en: Local authorities launched a thorough investigation into the late-night shooting.
examples.zh: 地方当局对这起深夜枪击事件展开了全面调查。

examples.en: Shooting for the documentary series is scheduled to wrap up next month.
examples.zh: 该纪录片系列的拍摄工作预计将于下个月结束。

lemmas.def_zh: 射手，枪手；射击游戏
lemmas.def_en: a person who shoots a weapon or scores in sports; a video game focused on shooting targets

examples.en: He is widely regarded as one of the most accurate three-point shooters in the league.
examples.zh: 他被公认为联盟中最精准的三分射手之一。

examples.en: Police quickly cordoned off the perimeter and apprehended the suspected shooter.
examples.zh: 警方迅速封锁周边区域并逮捕了枪击嫌疑人。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 scēotan，本义为“快速向前移动或飞掷”，后引申为“射击、发射”，并进一步衍生出“拍摄（捕捉画面）”和“植物抽芽（窜出新芽）”等相关含义。
family_guide.core_distinction: shot 侧重单次的射击动作、枪响、击球投篮或照片镜头；shooting 侧重枪击事件、射击运动或电影拍摄的过程；shooter 则是执行射击或投篮的人或工具。

lemmas.def_zh: 事实；真实情况；现实
lemmas.def_en: a thing that is known or proved to be true

examples.en: It is an established fact that regular exercise benefits both physical and mental health.
examples.zh: 规律运动有益于身心健康，这是一个公认的事实。

examples.en: I thought he was joking, but in fact, he was entirely serious.
examples.zh: 我以为他在开玩笑，但事实上，他非常认真。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 facere（做、造）的过去分词 factum，本义指“已做成的事”，演变引申为客观存在、无可辩驳的“事实”。

lemmas.def_zh: 身体, 人, 尸体, 主要部分, 团体
lemmas.def_en: the entire structure of an organism (an animal, plant, or human being)

examples.en: Regular exercise and a balanced diet are essential for maintaining a healthy body.
examples.zh: 规律运动和均衡饮食对保持健康的身体至关重要。

lemmas.def_zh: 赋以形体
lemmas.def_en: invest with or as with a body; give body to

examples.en: Regular exercise and a balanced diet are essential for maintaining a healthy body.
examples.zh: 规律运动和均衡饮食对保持健康的身体至关重要。

lemmas.def_zh: 身体的，肉体的
lemmas.def_en: relating to the human body

examples.en: The defendant was accused of causing grievous bodily harm.
examples.zh: 被告被指控造成严重人身伤害。

lemmas.def_zh: 无躯体的
lemmas.def_en: not having a material body

examples.en: In the ancient myth, bodiless spirits wandered silently through the misty forest.
examples.zh: 在古老神话中，无形的幽灵在迷雾森林中无声游荡。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 bodig，核心指人的“肉体、躯干”，后引申出“主要部分、主体”以及凝聚而成的“组织、机构”，动词化后表示“赋予形体、具象化”。
family_guide.core_distinction: body 为核心名词与动词；bodily 为派生形容词，专指“肉体的、人身的”，常用于法律与生理医学搭配（如 bodily harm, bodily fluids）。

lemmas.def_zh: 继续；持续；延伸
lemmas.def_en: to keep existing, happening, or doing something without stopping, or after an interruption

examples.en: The rain is expected to continue throughout the entire weekend.
examples.zh: 预计这场雨将持续整个周末。

examples.en: She decided to continue her studies abroad after graduating from college.
examples.zh: 大学毕业后，她决定继续出国深造。

lemmas.def_zh: 持续，继续；延续部分，续篇
lemmas.def_en: the state of continuing without interruption, or something that is added or follows on from an earlier part

examples.en: The new policy represents a continuation of the government's economic reforms.
examples.zh: 新政策体现了政府经济改革的延续。

examples.en: This novel is a direct continuation of the story from the first book.
examples.zh: 这部小说是第一本书故事情节的直接续篇。

lemmas.def_zh: 继续, 停留, 持续
lemmas.def_en: the act of continuing an activity without interruption

examples.en: The company's survival depends on the continuance of strong support from its investors.
examples.zh: 公司的生存取决于投资者持续的大力支持。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 持续的；连绵不断的
lemmas.def_en: going on without stop or interruption; sustained
lemmas.usage_note: 主要作定语，表示某状态或行动持久保持，如 continued success, continued support。

examples.en: Thank you for your continued support of our organization.
examples.zh: 感谢您对我们机构一如既往的持续支持。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 持续存在的；不断的
lemmas.def_en: remaining in force or being carried on without letup; ongoing
lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰问题、需求或过程，如 continuing problem, continuing education（继续教育）。与 continued 相比，更侧重进行中的动态感。

examples.en: Inflation poses a continuing threat to economic recovery.
examples.zh: 通货膨胀对经济复苏构成了持续的威胁。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 com-（完全）+ tenere（握住、保持），核心演变逻辑为‘紧密相连地保持住’，引申出‘不中断、继续进行’之意。
family_guide.core_distinction: continue 是动作本身（继续做或延续）；continuation 是其名词形式，既可指‘继续/持续’这一状态或行为，也可指事物物理或内容上的‘延续部分、续集’。

lemmas.def_zh: 设计, 计划
lemmas.def_en: make or work out a plan for; devise

examples.en: The engineering team spent months trying to design a more efficient solar battery.
examples.zh: 工程团队花了几个月时间试图设计出更高效的太阳能电池。

lemmas.def_zh: 设计, 图样, 方案, 企图
lemmas.def_en: the act of working out the form of something (as by making a sketch or outline or plan)

examples.en: The engineering team spent months trying to design a more efficient solar battery.
examples.zh: 工程团队花了几个月时间试图设计出更高效的太阳能电池。

lemmas.def_zh: 设计者, 谋划者, 制图者
lemmas.def_en: a person who specializes in designing architectural interiors and their furnishings

examples.en: She hired a talented interior designer to completely renovate her downtown apartment.
examples.zh: 她雇了一位才华横溢的室内设计师来彻底翻新市中心的公寓。

lemmas.def_zh: 故意地, 有计划地, 特意地
lemmas.def_en: with intention; in an intentional manner

examples.en: He spoke slowly and designedly to ensure that everyone understood his final warning.
examples.zh: 他特意放慢语速说话，以确保每个人都听懂了他的最后警告。

lemmas.def_zh: 非故意的, 非预谋的, 无意中的
lemmas.def_en: not done or made or performed with purpose or intent

examples.en: Their unexpected meeting at the train station was an entirely undesigned coincidence.
examples.zh: 他们在火车站的意外相遇完全是一场无意的巧合。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 designare（de- 标出 + signare 标记/做记号），核心逻辑由“画出记号、勾勒草图”演化为有目的的“构思、规划与设计”。
family_guide.core_distinction: design 兼具动作（构思制造）与结果（外观结构或深层意图）；designer 则特指从事设计构思的专业人员或创作者。

lemmas.def_zh: 思想, 愿望, 智力, 记忆, 心理, 情绪, 理智, 主意, 心意
lemmas.def_en: that which is responsible for one's thoughts and feelings; the seat of the faculty of reason

examples.en: Reading books is a wonderful way to relax your mind after work.
examples.zh: 下班后读书是放松心智的极佳方式。

lemmas.def_zh: 留心, 警觉
lemmas.def_en: the trait of staying aware of (paying close attention to) your responsibilities

examples.en: Practicing daily mindfulness helps reduce stress and improves your overall emotional health.
examples.zh: 每天练习正念有助于减轻压力并改善整体情绪健康。

lemmas.def_zh: 没有思维能力; 愚笨; 无知; 不注意
lemmas.def_en: total lack of meaning or ideas

examples.en: The utter mindlessness of scrolling through social media for hours exhausted him.
examples.zh: 连续数小时漫无目的地刷社交媒体让他感到精疲力竭。

lemmas.def_zh: 介意, 注意, 留心；注意, 留意, 专心于, 照看, 介意
lemmas.def_en: be offended or bothered by; take offense with, be bothered by

examples.en: Reading books is a wonderful way to relax your mind after work.
examples.zh: 下班后读书是放松心智的极佳方式。

lemmas.def_zh: 深切注意的, 留神的, 留心的
lemmas.def_en: bearing in mind; attentive to

examples.en: You should always be mindful of your tone during a professional job interview.
examples.zh: 在专业求职面试中，你应该始终留意自己的语气。

lemmas.def_zh: 没头脑的, 不小心的, 不留神的
lemmas.def_en: lacking the thinking capacity characteristic of a conscious being

examples.en: He spent the rainy afternoon engaging in mindless video games without a care.
examples.zh: 他无忧无虑地玩了一下午不动脑筋的电子游戏度过雨天。

lemmas.def_zh: 不留心的, 不注意的, 漫不经心的
lemmas.def_en: not mindful or attentive; - G.B.Shaw

examples.en: He stepped into the street, entirely unmindful of the fast approaching delivery truck.
examples.zh: 他走上街道，完全没有留意到正飞驰而来的送货卡车。

lemmas.def_zh: 不费心思地；愚蠢地
lemmas.def_en: without intellectual involvement

examples.en: She sat on the sofa, mindlessly munching popcorn while watching the comedy show.
examples.zh: 她坐在沙发上，一边看喜剧节目一边心不在焉地嚼着爆米花。

lemmas.def_zh: 谨慎地；注意地
lemmas.def_en: in a careful deliberate manner

examples.en: He mindfully prepared each ingredient before beginning to cook the complex French recipe.
examples.zh: 在开始烹饪这道复杂的法国菜谱前，他用心地准备了每样食材。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语根 *men-（思考、心智），核心意象为人类的精神与意识活动，名词指“头脑/心智”，动词引申为“将心力置于某事”，即“留心、照看、介意”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词表示思考能力、注意力或想法状态；动词则将心力外化，表示“对某事感到介意”、“留神当心”或“看管照顾”。

lemmas.def_zh: 允许，准许；使成为可能；留出（时间/金钱等）
lemmas.def_en: to give permission for someone to do something; to make it possible for something to happen

examples.en: The new software allows users to access their files remotely.
examples.zh: 这款新软件使用户能够远程访问他们的文件。

examples.en: You should allow at least an hour to get to the airport.
examples.zh: 你应该至少留出一个小时的时间去机场。

lemmas.def_zh: 【名】津贴，零花钱；限额，容许量；【动】定量供应，配售
lemmas.def_en: [n.] an amount of money or goods given regularly; an allowed limit; [v.] to allocate or ration on a regular basis

examples.en: Passengers are advised not to exceed the baggage allowance of 23 kilograms.
examples.zh: 建议乘客行李重量不要超过 23 公斤的额度。

examples.en: During the long voyage, the crew members were strictly allowanced with fresh water.
examples.zh: 在漫长的航行中，船员们的淡水供应受到了严格的定量配给。

lemmas.def_zh: 【名】津贴，零花钱；限额，容许量；【动】定量供应，配售
lemmas.def_en: [n.] an amount of money or goods given regularly; an allowed limit; [v.] to allocate or ration on a regular basis

examples.en: Passengers are advised not to exceed the baggage allowance of 23 kilograms.
examples.zh: 建议乘客行李重量不要超过 23 公斤的额度。

examples.en: During the long voyage, the crew members were strictly allowanced with fresh water.
examples.zh: 在漫长的航行中，船员们的淡水供应受到了严格的定量配给。

lemmas.def_zh: 允许的, 许可的, 容许的
lemmas.def_en: deductible according to the tax laws

examples.en: The airline strictly enforces the maximum allowable weight for each checked suitcase.
examples.zh: 航空公司严格执行每件托运行李的最大允许重量。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 alouer（赞许/分配），融合了拉丁语 laudare（赞扬）与 locare（放置/分配），核心逻辑是由“认可、许可”引申出“给予或留出固定配额”。
family_guide.core_distinction: allow 为核心动词，强调“许可或使成为可能”；allowance 主要作名词，指“准许的额度（津贴/容许量）”，作动词时则特指“定量供应、配给”。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 原因，理由；理性，理智；v. 推断，推论；讲理，劝导
lemmas.def_en: n. a cause, explanation, or the mental capacity for rational thought; v. to think logically, deduce, or persuade using arguments

examples.en: She had good reason to believe that the decision would yield positive results.
examples.zh: 她有充分的理由相信这项决定会带来积极的成果。

examples.en: The manager tried to reason with the angry client, but to no avail.
examples.zh: 经理试图和那位愤怒的客户讲道理，但无济于事。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 推理，论证；逻辑分析过程
lemmas.def_en: the process of thinking about something in a logical way in order to form a conclusion or judgment

examples.en: His line of reasoning was completely sound and convinced the entire committee.
examples.zh: 他的推理逻辑完全站得住脚，说服了整个委员会。

lemmas.def_zh: [人名] 里森纳
lemmas.def_en: someone who reasons logically

examples.en: As a sharp philosophical reasoner, she quickly identified the fatal flaw in his argument.
examples.zh: 作为一名敏锐的哲学推理者，她迅速指出了他论点中的致命缺陷。

lemmas.def_zh: 无理性, 缺乏理性, 错乱
lemmas.def_en: the state of being irrational; lacking powers of understanding

examples.en: The sudden wave of political unreason caused widespread chaos throughout the entire city.
examples.zh: 突如其来的政治失去理智在全城引起了普遍的混乱。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 原因，理由；理性，理智；v. 推断，推论；讲理，劝导
lemmas.def_en: n. a cause, explanation, or the mental capacity for rational thought; v. to think logically, deduce, or persuade using arguments

examples.en: She had good reason to believe that the decision would yield positive results.
examples.zh: 她有充分的理由相信这项决定会带来积极的成果。

examples.en: The manager tried to reason with the angry client, but to no avail.
examples.zh: 经理试图和那位愤怒的客户讲道理，但无济于事。

lemmas.def_zh: 不用理智的, 不讲道理的, 无理智的
lemmas.def_en: not based on reason or evidence

examples.en: The dog had an unreasoning fear of vacuum cleaners and hid under the bed.
examples.zh: 这只狗对吸尘器有一种毫无道理的恐惧，躲到了床底下。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 reri（认为、计算），演变为与思维计算、逻辑推演相关的“理智”、“理由”及“推理”。
family_guide.core_distinction: reason 既可指具体的“理由”或抽象的“理性能力”，也可作动词指“讲理、推论”；而 reasoning 专指抽象的“推理过程”或“逻辑链条”。

lemmas.def_zh: 黑色的
lemmas.def_en: being of the achromatic color of maximum darkness; having little or no hue owing to absorption of almost all incident light

examples.en: He wore an elegant black suit to the annual charity gala last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚他穿了一套优雅的黑色西装出席年度慈善晚会。

lemmas.def_zh: 黑色, 黑颜料
lemmas.def_en: the quality or state of the achromatic color of least lightness (bearing the least resemblance to white)

examples.en: He wore an elegant black suit to the annual charity gala last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚他穿了一套优雅的黑色西装出席年度慈善晚会。

lemmas.def_zh: 黑, 黑色, 邪恶
lemmas.def_en: the quality or state of the achromatic color of least lightness (bearing the least resemblance to white)

examples.en: The sudden power outage plunged the entire neighborhood into total blackness for hours.
examples.zh: 突如其来的停电让整个街区连续数小时陷入一片漆黑。

lemmas.def_en: make or become black

examples.en: The heavy smoke from the burning tires began to black the building's exterior.
examples.zh: 燃烧轮胎冒出的浓烟开始熏黑大楼的外墙。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语 *bhleg-（燃烧、发光），演变自燃烧后留下的炭黑灰烬，核心语义由‘炭黑’发展为‘黑暗、无光’，并进一步引申出隐秘、抵制或悲观等含义。
family_guide.core_distinction: black 词形兼具形容词、名词和动词：形容词修饰颜色或黑暗状态，名词指黑色颜料、衣物或盈利状态（in the black），动词则常指涂黑或（英式用语）联合抵制。

lemmas.def_zh: 联合；团结；结合
lemmas.def_en: to join together or cause people or groups to join together to form a single unit or pursue a common purpose

examples.en: The shared crisis helped unite the diverse community like never before.
examples.zh: 这场共同的危机促使这个多元化的社区前所未有地团结在一起。

examples.en: The two independent firms agreed to unite their efforts to compete globally.
examples.zh: 两家独立公司同意联合力量，以在全球市场展开竞争。

lemmas.def_zh: vt. (使)成立工会, (使)加入工会
lemmas.def_en: recruit for a union or organize into a union

examples.en: Employees voted decisively to unionize after months of difficult wage negotiations.
examples.zh: 经过数月艰难的薪资谈判，员工们果断投票决定成立工会。

lemmas.def_zh: 团结一致地；联合在一起地
lemmas.def_en: with cooperation and interchange

examples.en: The committee members voted unitedly to approve the proposed environmental regulations.
examples.zh: 委员会成员一致投票通过了提议的环境法规。

lemmas.def_zh: 工会；联合，结合；联盟，联邦
lemmas.def_en: the state of being joined together; an organized association of workers formed to protect their rights

examples.en: The workers voted to join the trade union to negotiate for better pay and safer working conditions.
examples.zh: 工人们投票决定加入工会，以争取更好的薪酬和更安全的工作环境。

examples.en: The treaty marked the economic and political union of the neighboring nations.
examples.zh: 该条约标志着这几个邻国在经济和政治上的联合。

lemmas.def_zh: 联合；结合；工会化
lemmas.def_en: act of forming labor unions

examples.en: The rapid unionization of warehouse workers surprised many company executives this year.
examples.zh: 今年仓库工人迅速成立工会令许多公司高管感到意外。

lemmas.def_zh: 不属于工会的, 不承认工会的
lemmas.def_en: not belonging to or not allowing affiliation with a trade union

examples.en: The firm hired nonunion contractors to finish the delayed highway project quickly.
examples.zh: 该公司聘请了非工会承包商以快速完成延期的公路项目。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 unus（一），核心概念为“使分散的多者合为一体”，引申为联合、团结或结合。

lemmas.def_zh: 结果, 影响, 效果, 印象
lemmas.def_en: a phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon

examples.en: The new law had an immediate and positive effect on traffic safety.
examples.zh: 新法律对交通安全产生了立竿见影的积极效果。

lemmas.def_zh: 效力
lemmas.def_en: power to be effective; the quality of being able to bring about an effect

examples.en: Scientists are currently testing the effectiveness of the new antiviral drug.
examples.zh: 科学家们目前正在测试这种新抗病毒药物的有效性。

lemmas.def_zh: 效应器, 效应基因
lemmas.def_en: one who brings about a result or event; one who accomplishes a purpose

examples.en: Nerve signals travel from the spinal cord to the muscle effector cells.
examples.zh: 神经信号从脊髓传导至肌肉效应细胞。

lemmas.def_zh: 有效, 功效
lemmas.def_en: power to be effective; the quality of being able to bring about an effect

examples.en: The contract explicitly defines the date of effectivity for all involved parties.
examples.zh: 该合同明确界定了各相关方的生效日期。

lemmas.def_zh: 招致, 实行, 完成
lemmas.def_en: the act of implementing (providing a practical means for accomplishing something); carrying into effect

lemmas.def_zh: 实行, 引起, 完成
lemmas.def_en: produce

examples.en: The new law had an immediate and positive effect on traffic safety.
examples.zh: 新法律对交通安全产生了立竿见影的积极效果。

lemmas.def_zh: 使发生, 实行, 完成
lemmas.def_en: produce

examples.en: The new administrative policy aims to effectuate significant reforms across the entire public sector.
examples.zh: 这项新的行政政策旨在整个公共部门促成重大改革的落实。

lemmas.def_zh: 有效的, 有力的, 实际的
lemmas.def_en: producing or capable of producing an intended result or having a striking effect; -LewisMumford

examples.en: She introduced an effective system to reduce workplace accidents and delays.
examples.zh: 她引入了一套有效的系统来减少工伤事故和延误。

lemmas.def_zh: 有效地, 有力地, 实际上
lemmas.def_en: in an effective manner

examples.en: Modern technology has effectively solved many communication issues across global teams.
examples.zh: 现代技术已有效解决了跨国团队中的许多沟通问题。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 efficere（ex- 出 + facere 做），核心意象为“从行动中制造出来”，引申为行动带来的“结果、影响”，动词则指“使发生、实现”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词 effect 专指“引起、实现（具体变革/结果）”，常搭配 change/reform，切勿与表“对……产生影响”的动词 affect 混淆。

lemmas.def_zh: 市场, 交易, 集市, 推销地区, 行情, 市面, 销路
lemmas.def_en: the world of commercial activity where goods and services are bought and sold

examples.en: Farmers gather every Saturday morning to market their fresh organic produce.
examples.zh: 农民们每周六早晨聚集在一起销售他们新鲜的有机农产品。

lemmas.def_zh: 赶集者, 市场商人
lemmas.def_en: someone who promotes or exchanges goods or services for money

examples.en: A skilled marketer must analyze consumer behavior to design better ad campaigns.
examples.zh: 熟练的市场营销人员必须分析消费者行为以设计更好的广告方案。

lemmas.def_zh: 在市场上交易, 使上市, 销售；在市场上买卖
lemmas.def_en: engage in the commercial promotion, sale, or distribution of

examples.en: Farmers gather every Saturday morning to market their fresh organic produce.
examples.zh: 农民们每周六早晨聚集在一起销售他们新鲜的有机农产品。

lemmas.def_zh: 可销售的, 销路好的, 市场的
lemmas.def_en: being in demand by especially employers

examples.en: Learning digital skills will make you far more marketable to potential employers.
examples.zh: 学习数字技能会让你在潜在雇主面前更有竞争力。

lemmas.def_zh: 不能销售的, 滞销的
lemmas.def_en: not fit for sale

examples.en: The damaged packaging made the entire batch of imported goods practically unmarketable.
examples.zh: 包装破损导致整批进口商品几乎完全滞销。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 mercatus（买卖、集市），核心概念为“货物流通与交易”，后由实体交易场所延伸至抽象的供求关系及商业推销行为。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词侧重指进行交易的场所、行业领域或市场需求；动词侧重指把产品推向市场、进行营销宣传的具体商业动作。

lemmas.def_zh: 小山羊, 小山羊肉, 小孩, 欺骗
lemmas.def_en: a young person of either sex

examples.en: Don't take him seriously, he was only kidding about moving away.
examples.zh: 别当真，他关于要搬走的话只是在开玩笑。

lemmas.def_zh: 哄骗, 嘲弄
lemmas.def_en: tell false information to for fun

examples.en: Don't take him seriously, he was only kidding about moving away.
examples.zh: 别当真，他关于要搬走的话只是在开玩笑。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺斯语，本义为“小山羊”，后作为俚语引申指“小孩子”，再由“像对待小孩一样逗弄”进一步引申出动词“开玩笑、戏弄”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词常作口语中“孩子”的统称；动词多用于非正式表达中表示“开玩笑”或“哄骗”（如 no kidding、kid oneself）。

lemmas.def_zh: 课程, 路线, 过程, 一道菜, 道路
lemmas.def_en: education imparted in a series of lessons or meetings

examples.en: Tears coursed down her face as she listened to the heartbreaking news.
examples.zh: 听到那令人心碎的消息时，泪水顺着她的脸颊滑落。

lemmas.def_zh: 追, (使)跑
lemmas.def_en: move swiftly through or over

examples.en: Tears coursed down her face as she listened to the heartbreaking news.
examples.zh: 听到那令人心碎的消息时，泪水顺着她的脸颊滑落。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 currere（跑、流动），核心意象为“奔跑或流动的路径”，由此引申出空间上的路线/航向、时间上的过程/进程、学术上的课程，以及动词的奔流。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词侧重行动轨迹、发展进程或修读的课程；动词则回归“流动”本义，侧重液体或情感在体内快速奔涌。

lemmas.def_zh: 覆盖, 掩饰, 保护, 掩护, 包括；覆盖
lemmas.def_en: provide with a covering or cause to be covered

examples.en: Thick morning fog will likely cover the valley until early afternoon.
examples.zh: 浓厚晨雾可能会一直笼罩山谷直到下午初。

lemmas.def_zh: 揭露, 揭开, 暴露, 脱帽致敬；脱帽致敬, 揭去盖子
lemmas.def_en: make visible

examples.en: Investigative reporters helped uncover the truth behind the secret corporate funding.
examples.zh: 调查记者协助揭开了该企业秘密资金背后的真相。

lemmas.def_zh: 盖子, 封面, 藉口
lemmas.def_en: a covering that serves to conceal or shelter something

examples.en: Thick morning fog will likely cover the valley until early afternoon.
examples.zh: 浓厚晨雾可能会一直笼罩山谷直到下午初。

lemmas.def_zh: 覆盖的范围, 保险总额, 新闻报导
lemmas.def_en: the total amount and type of insurance carried

examples.en: Live television coverage of the election reached millions of viewers nationwide.
examples.zh: 大选的电视现场直播覆盖了全国数百万观众。

lemmas.def_zh: 覆盖物, 掩蔽物
lemmas.def_en: a natural object that covers or envelops

examples.en: A thin covering of fresh snow blanketed the mountain village overnight.
examples.zh: 薄薄的一层新雪在一夜之间覆盖了整座山村。

lemmas.def_zh: 床罩
lemmas.def_en: a decorative bedspread (usually quilted)

examples.en: She spread a delicate floral coverlet neatly across the guest bedroom bed.
examples.zh: 她把一条精致的碎花床罩整齐地铺在客房的床上。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 覆盖的；有顶棚的；有遮蔽的
lemmas.def_en: overlaid, spread, or topped with something; having a roof or shelter
lemmas.usage_note: 既可表示物理上有覆盖物（snow-covered），也指带顶棚的设施，如 a covered market（有盖市场）、a covered walkway（有篷步道）。

examples.en: Visitors can walk through the covered bridge even on rainy days.
examples.zh: 即使在下雨天，游客也可以穿过这座有盖廊桥。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 cooperire（完全遮蔽），核心逻辑由物理上的“遮盖、掩护”延伸至抽象层面的“包含、涉及与记录报道”。
family_guide.core_distinction: cover 常指书的封面、容器盖子或掩蔽处；covering 侧重铺展在表面的具体覆盖层；coverage 则专指抽象的覆盖范围、媒体报道或保险保障。

lemmas.def_zh: 增加, 加大；增加, 繁殖
lemmas.def_en: become bigger or greater in amount

examples.en: The company plans to increase its annual investment in renewable energy research.
examples.zh: 该公司计划增加在可再生能源研发方面的年度投资。

lemmas.def_zh: 增加, 增进, 利益
lemmas.def_en: a quantity that is added

examples.en: The company plans to increase its annual investment in renewable energy research.
examples.zh: 该公司计划增加在可再生能源研发方面的年度投资。

lemmas.def_zh: 逐渐地; 越来越多地; 日益
lemmas.def_en: more and more over a period of time

examples.en: It is becoming increasingly difficult for graduates to find affordable housing.
examples.zh: 毕业生寻找负担得起的住房正变得越来越困难。

examples.en: Consumers are relying increasingly on mobile apps for everyday purchases.
examples.zh: 消费者在日常购物中越来越依赖移动应用程序。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 增加的；增强的
lemmas.def_en: made greater in size, amount, degree, or intensity
lemmas.usage_note: 常作定语，修饰抽象概念，如 increased risk, increased demand, increased awareness。

examples.en: The police presence was stepped up due to increased security concerns.
examples.zh: 由于安全担忧加剧，警方加强了戒备。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 不断增加的；渐增的
lemmas.def_en: becoming greater or larger over time
lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰趋势或发展，如 increasing number, increasing pressure, of increasing importance。

examples.en: There is an increasing demand for renewable energy sources.
examples.zh: 人们对可再生能源的需求正日益增长。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 increscere（in- 向内/加上 + crescere 生长），核心意向为“在原基础上持续生长、累积”，演变为表示数量、程度或规模的扩大与增多。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词与名词同形，但重音不同：动词读作 /ɪnˈkriːs/，名词读作 /ˈɪŋkriːs/；派生副词 increasingly 则专指“渐进地、越来越……”的发展态势。

lemmas.def_zh: 制止, 延缓, 坚持, 支持, 支撑, 用支索固定；停留, 逗留, 暂停, 坚持, 中止
lemmas.def_en: stay the same; remain in a certain state

examples.en: The judge granted an emergency stay to halt the company's planned demolition.
examples.zh: 法官批准了紧急中止令，以叫停该公司计划的拆除行动。

lemmas.def_zh: 停留, 逗留, 制止, 延缓, 停止, 支柱, 支撑物, 支索
lemmas.def_en: continuing or remaining in a place or state

examples.en: The judge granted an emergency stay to halt the company's planned demolition.
examples.zh: 法官批准了紧急中止令，以叫停该公司计划的拆除行动。

lemmas.def_zh: 滞留者, 耐性极强的人, 抑制物, 支持者
lemmas.def_en: a person or other animal having powers of endurance or perseverance

examples.en: As a long-distance runner, she proved to be a remarkable stayer under pressure.
examples.zh: 作为一名长跑运动员，事实证明她在压力下极具耐力。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 stare（站立、立定），核心逻辑是“停留在原地不动”，引申出“保持某种状态”或法律上的“暂缓执行”。

lemmas.def_zh: 死亡, 消逝, 平息, 熄灭, 漠然, 渴望；死
lemmas.def_en: pass from physical life and lose all bodily attributes and functions necessary to sustain life

examples.en: He rolled the die across the wooden table, hoping for a lucky six.
examples.zh: 他在木桌上掷出骰子，希望能掷出幸运的六点。

lemmas.def_zh: 死亡；死因；灭亡，终结
lemmas.def_en: the permanent end of all biological functions that sustain an organism; the destruction or end of something

examples.en: Regular physical exercise can significantly reduce the risk of premature death.
examples.zh: 规律的体育锻炼能够显著降低过早死亡的风险。

examples.en: The rise of digital streaming marked the slow death of the traditional video rental store.
examples.zh: 数字流媒体的兴起标志着传统录像带租赁店的缓慢消亡。

lemmas.def_zh: 骰子, 冲模
lemmas.def_en: a small cube with 1 to 6 spots on the six faces; used in gambling to generate random numbers

examples.en: He rolled the die across the wooden table, hoping for a lucky six.
examples.zh: 他在木桌上掷出骰子，希望能掷出幸运的六点。

lemmas.def_zh: 死一般的
lemmas.def_en: having the physical appearance of death

examples.en: A deathly silence filled the quiet hall after the tragic news broke.
examples.zh: 悲剧消息传出后，安静的大厅里一片死寂。

lemmas.def_zh: 不死的, 永恒的
lemmas.def_en: never dying

examples.en: The poet gained deathless fame through his timeless masterpieces of romantic literature.
examples.zh: 这位诗人凭借其永恒的浪漫主义文学杰作赢得了不朽的名声。

family_guide.root_logic: 动词 die 源自日耳曼语系（古诺斯语 deyja），核心指生命、活动或力量的终结；名词 die 源自拉丁语 dare（投掷、给予），指掷出的骰子或铸压用的模具，二者为同形异义词源。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意名词 die 的复数形态变化：表示“骰子”时现代多作 dice（单数亦常通称 dice）；表示工业“印模、冲模”时复数则规则变化为 dies。

lemmas.def_zh: 术语, 专有名词, 期限, 学期, 任期, 条件, 价钱, 关系, 地位, 项, 界石
lemmas.def_en: a word or expression used for some particular thing

examples.en: Critics term the new economic proposal a risky gamble for ordinary taxpayers.
examples.zh: 批评人士称这项新经济提案是对普通纳税人的一场危险赌博。

lemmas.def_zh: 称, 呼
lemmas.def_en: name formally or designate with a term

examples.en: Critics term the new economic proposal a risky gamble for ordinary taxpayers.
examples.zh: 批评人士称这项新经济提案是对普通纳税人的一场危险赌博。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 terminus（界限、界标），核心意象为“人为划定的边界”，由时间上的边界引申为“期限、任期、学期”，由语义上的界限引申为“术语、专门用语”，由协议的界限引申为“条款”。

lemmas.def_zh: 地方性的, 当地的, 局部的, 乡土的, 本地的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or applicable to or concerned with the administration of a city or town or district rather than a larger area

examples.en: A friendly local advised us to visit the hidden waterfall behind the village.
examples.zh: 一位热心的当地人建议我们去参观村庄后方隐秘的瀑布。

lemmas.def_zh: 当地居民, 本地新闻, 局部
lemmas.def_en: public transport consisting of a bus or train that stops at all stations or stops

examples.en: A friendly local advised us to visit the hidden waterfall behind the village.
examples.zh: 一位热心的当地人建议我们去参观村庄后方隐秘的瀑布。

lemmas.def_zh: 地点，位置；所在区域
lemmas.def_en: a particular area, neighborhood, or specific site

examples.en: Several rare bird species have been spotted in this locality.
examples.zh: 在这一带发现了几种珍稀鸟类。

lemmas.def_zh: 在本地，在当地；局部地
lemmas.def_en: in or by the people of a particular local area; in a localized way

examples.en: The restaurant is famous for using locally sourced ingredients.
examples.zh: 这家餐馆以使用本地采购的食材而闻名。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 locus（地点、位置），所有衍生词均围绕“特定地点/局部区域”展开。
family_guide.core_distinction: local 作名词指“当地人”，而 locality 指抽象或具体的“地点、区域本身”。

lemmas.def_zh: 分, 分钟, 片刻, 备忘录, 笔记
lemmas.def_en: a unit of time equal to 60 seconds or 1/60th of an hour

examples.en: The scientist discovered minute traces of rare minerals inside the ancient rock.
examples.zh: 科学家在古老岩石内部发现了微量的稀有矿物。

lemmas.def_zh: 微小, 微细, 缜密
lemmas.def_en: the property of being very small in size

examples.en: The extreme minuteness of the dust particles made them completely invisible.
examples.zh: 这些尘埃颗粒极其微小，肉眼完全无法看见。

lemmas.def_zh: 微小的, 详细的
lemmas.def_en: infinitely or immeasurably small

examples.en: The scientist discovered minute traces of rare minerals inside the ancient rock.
examples.zh: 科学家在古老岩石内部发现了微量的稀有矿物。

lemmas.def_zh: 详细地, 精密地
lemmas.def_en: in minute detail

examples.en: The detective examined the crime scene minutely, searching for any hidden clues.
examples.zh: 侦探极其细致地检查了犯罪现场，寻找任何隐藏的线索。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 minutus（变小、微细），本义为“微小之物”，后分化为名词（时间的微小分割“分钟”、事项的精炼摘抄“会议纪要”）与形容词（极微小的、细致入微的）。
family_guide.core_distinction: 两者为同形异音异义词：名词读作 /ˈmɪn.ɪt/，指时间单位或会议记录；形容词读作 /maɪˈnjuːt/，表示极小或详尽细致。

lemmas.def_zh: 投票, 选举；投票选举, 投票决定, 公认, 使投票
lemmas.def_en: express one's preference for a candidate or for a measure or resolution; cast a vote

examples.en: Citizens queued patiently outside the community center to cast their annual vote.
examples.zh: 市民们在社区中心外耐心地排队投出他们的一票。

lemmas.def_zh: 投票, 选举, 选票, 表决, 选举权, 得票数
lemmas.def_en: a choice that is made by counting the number of people in favor of each alternative

examples.en: Citizens queued patiently outside the community center to cast their annual vote.
examples.zh: 市民们在社区中心外耐心地排队投出他们的一票。

lemmas.def_zh: 选民, 投票人
lemmas.def_en: a citizen who has a legal right to vote

examples.en: Every registered voter received a detailed pamphlet explaining the upcoming reform.
examples.zh: 每位登记选民都收到了一份解释即将推行的改革的详细小册子。

lemmas.def_zh: 无投票权的, 无选举权的
lemmas.def_en: deprived of the rights of citizenship especially the right to vote

examples.en: Temporary foreign workers remained voteless despite contributing significantly to the economy.
examples.zh: 尽管对经济贡献巨大，临时外国劳工仍然没有投票权。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 votum（誓愿、期许），引申为庄重表达个人意志与选择的“投票、表决”。

lemmas.def_zh: 中心, 中心点, 中锋
lemmas.def_en: an area that is approximately central within some larger region
