examples.en: The historic town square lies directly in the center of the district.
examples.zh: 这座历史悠久的城镇广场正位于该区域的中心位置。

lemmas.def_zh: 中心, 中央, 向心性
lemmas.def_en: the property of being central

examples.en: The report emphasizes the centrality of education to long-term economic growth.
examples.zh: 该报告强调了教育对于长期经济增长的核心重要性。

lemmas.def_zh: 集中, 定中心；居中
lemmas.def_en: center upon

examples.en: The historic town square lies directly in the center of the district.
examples.zh: 这座历史悠久的城镇广场正位于该区域的中心位置。

lemmas.def_zh: 集中, 定中心；居中
lemmas.def_en: move into the center

examples.en: The discussions will centre around improving public healthcare across the entire region.
examples.zh: 讨论将集中围绕改善整个地区的公共医疗保健展开。

lemmas.def_zh: 中央的, 位在正中的
lemmas.def_en: equally distant from the extremes

examples.en: The historic town square lies directly in the center of the district.
examples.zh: 这座历史悠久的城镇广场正位于该区域的中心位置。

lemmas.def_zh: 中心的，中央的；核心的，主要的
lemmas.def_en: at or near the center of a place or thing; of primary importance

examples.en: The hotel is in a central location, within walking distance of the station.
examples.zh: 该酒店地处中心位置，距离火车站仅几步之遥。

examples.en: Technological innovation plays a central role in the company's long-term strategy.
examples.zh: 技术创新在该公司的长期战略中发挥着核心作用。

lemmas.def_zh: 中心的, 中央的
lemmas.def_en: having or situated at or near a center

examples.en: The startup adopted a user-centric design approach to improve customer satisfaction quickly.
examples.zh: 这家初创公司采用以用户为中心的设计方法，迅速提升了客户满意度。

lemmas.def_zh: 在中心, 在中央
lemmas.def_en: in or near or toward a center or according to a central role or function

examples.en: Our office is centrally located, making it very convenient for all employees.
examples.zh: 我们的办公室位于中心地带，对所有员工来说都非常方便。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 kentron（圆规针尖、刺针），由圆规画圆的定点引申为“圆心、正中点”，后进一步泛化为物理中心、活动汇聚点以及动词“聚焦/集中”。
family_guide.core_distinction: center 与 centre 为同一词的美式（-er）与英式（-re）拼写变体，词义与用法完全对应，无语义区别。

lemmas.def_zh: 事件, 物质, 原因, 素材, 实体, 重要
lemmas.def_en: a vaguely specified concern

examples.en: Your honest feedback will matter greatly as we refine our final proposal.
examples.zh: 在我们完善最终提案的过程中，您真诚的反馈将非常重要。

lemmas.def_zh: 有关系
lemmas.def_en: have weight; have import, carry weight

examples.en: Your honest feedback will matter greatly as we refine our final proposal.
examples.zh: 在我们完善最终提案的过程中，您真诚的反馈将非常重要。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 māteria（材料、实体），核心语义从有形的“物理实质”引申为抽象的“讨论/关注的实质内容（事情）”，作动词时引申为“具有实质意义、起决定作用（要紧）”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词侧重指具体的“物理实体”或抽象的“事务/问题”，动词则专指“具有重要性、产生实质影响”。

lemmas.def_zh: 目录, 名单, 明细表, 布条, 条纹, 列表, 序列, 数据清单
lemmas.def_en: a database containing an ordered array of items (names or topics)

examples.en: She checked the grocery list twice before heading out to the supermarket.
examples.zh: 在去超市之前，她仔细核对了两次购物清单。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 列表, 清单, 编目
lemmas.def_en: a database containing an ordered array of items (names or topics)

examples.en: The real estate agent updated the property listing with brand new photographs.
examples.zh: 房地产经纪人使用全新的照片更新了房产挂牌信息。

lemmas.def_zh: 双耕犁, 制表人
lemmas.def_en: English surgeon who was the first to use antiseptics (1827-1912)

examples.en: The clerk acted as the chief lister, cataloging every antique piece for the auction.
examples.zh: 该职员担任首席编目员，为拍卖会登记每一件古董。

lemmas.def_zh: 精神萎靡；无精打采
lemmas.def_en: a feeling of lack of interest or energy

examples.en: A wave of listlessness washed over her during the long, sweltering summer afternoon.
examples.zh: 在漫长闷热的夏日午后，一阵倦怠感向她袭来。

lemmas.def_zh: 列出, 列于表上, 记入名单内, 装布条；列于表上
lemmas.def_en: give or make a list of; name individually; give the names of

examples.en: Please list all your previous employers on the second page of this application.
examples.zh: 请在此申请表的第二页上列出你所有的前雇主。

lemmas.def_zh: 未编入册的, (证券等)未上市的
lemmas.def_en: not on a list

examples.en: She kept her phone number unlisted to protect her family from unwanted calls.
examples.zh: 她将电话号码设为保密，以保护家人免受骚扰电话打扰。

lemmas.def_zh: 倦怠的, 无精打采的
lemmas.def_en: lacking zest or vivacity

examples.en: The sick child looked pale and listless, showing no interest in his favorite toys.
examples.zh: 生病的孩子面色苍白、无精打采，对他最喜欢的玩具毫无兴趣。

lemmas.def_zh: 无精打采地, 冷淡地
lemmas.def_en: in a listless manner

examples.en: He stared listlessly at the television screen, too exhausted to follow the movie.
examples.zh: 他无精打采地盯着电视屏幕，筋疲力尽得看不进电影。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古日耳曼语，最初指布料的‘边缘、狭长条带’，后引申为写有连续项目的‘狭长纸条’，最终发展为现代的‘清单、列表’及‘列举’之意。
family_guide.core_distinction: list 指整体的清单或名录；listing 常指清单中的单个条目，尤指房地产房源、分类广告或股票上市信息。

lemmas.def_zh: 主要的, 较多的, 大部分的, 成年的, 严重的
lemmas.def_en: of greater importance or stature or rank

examples.en: She plans to major in computer science when she enters college next fall.
examples.zh: 她计划在明年秋季入学时主修计算机科学。

lemmas.def_zh: 主修课, 成年人, 陆军少校
lemmas.def_en: a commissioned military officer in the United States Army or Air Force or Marines; below lieutenant colonel and above captain

examples.en: She plans to major in computer science when she enters college next fall.
examples.zh: 她计划在明年秋季入学时主修计算机科学。

lemmas.def_zh: 多数, 大半
lemmas.def_en: the property resulting from being or relating to the greater in number of two parts; the main part

examples.en: The vast majority of students voted in favor of extending the library hours.
examples.zh: 绝大多数学生投票支持延长图书馆的开放时间。

lemmas.def_zh: 主修
lemmas.def_en: have as one's principal field of study

examples.en: She plans to major in computer science when she enters college next fall.
examples.zh: 她计划在明年秋季入学时主修计算机科学。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 magnus（大）的比较级 major（更大的），核心逻辑始终围绕“在规模、数量、重要性或资历上占优势”展开演变。
family_guide.core_distinction: major 作为形容词或名词侧重“重要的/主修领域”，majority 则专指统计或抽象概念上的“大多数、过半数”。

lemmas.def_zh: 每个人；所有人；大家
lemmas.def_en: every person; all people

examples.en: Everyone has the right to express their own opinion.
examples.zh: 每个人都有权表达自己的观点。

examples.en: Is everyone ready to get started?
examples.zh: 大家都准备好开始了吗？

family_guide.root_logic: 由形容词 every（每一个）与代词 one（人/个体）组合而成的复合不定代词，逻辑上指涵盖某一群体内的“每一个人”，语法上通常作单数处理。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意区分单字的代词 everyone（指“所有人”，等同于 everybody）与双字短语 every one（强调“每一个具体的人或物”，后常接 of）。

lemmas.def_zh: 检查, 阻止, 核对, 寄存, 托运；逐项相符, 开支票
lemmas.def_en: examine so as to determine accuracy, quality, or condition

examples.en: Always check your mirrors before changing lanes on a busy highway.
examples.zh: 在繁忙的高速公路上变道前，务必先检查后视镜。

lemmas.def_en: withdraw money by writing a check

examples.en: The merchant refused to cheque the funds without seeing two official forms of identification.
examples.zh: 商家在未核验两份官方身份证件前，拒绝通过支票支取这笔款项。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 检查程序, 检验程序, 检验器, 西洋跳棋
lemmas.def_en: mark into squares or draw squares on; draw crossed lines on

examples.en: The automated tool will checker the source code for common security vulnerabilities tonight.
examples.zh: 该自动化工具今晚将校验源代码中常见的安全漏洞。

lemmas.def_zh: 检查, 支票, 阻止物, 寄物牌, 象棋中将军
lemmas.def_en: a written order directing a bank to pay money

examples.en: Always check your mirrors before changing lanes on a busy highway.
examples.zh: 在繁忙的高速公路上变道前，务必先检查后视镜。

lemmas.def_zh: 制止者, 查对者, 阻止者
lemmas.def_en: an attendant who checks coats or baggage

examples.en: The automated tool will checker the source code for common security vulnerabilities tonight.
examples.zh: 该自动化工具今晚将校验源代码中常见的安全漏洞。

lemmas.def_zh: 未加抑制的, 未经检查的
lemmas.def_en: not restrained or controlled

examples.en: If left unchecked, small accounting errors can quickly become massive financial liabilities.
examples.zh: 如果听之任之，微小的做账错误很快会演变成巨大的财务负担。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于国际象棋术语‘将军’（波斯语 shāh），核心逻辑由‘遏制、阻截对手’延伸至‘设立屏障以检验、核查’，形成了‘阻碍/制约’与‘检验/核对’两条主要语义脉络。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词与名词形式同形，均兼具‘核对/检查’与‘抑制/制衡’双重核心向度，同时在日常交流中扩展出‘支票’与‘账单’等具象实物义。

lemmas.def_zh: 教；教导；教授；使懂得
lemmas.def_en: to impart knowledge or skill to someone by instruction or study

examples.en: She teaches chemistry to advanced high school students.
examples.zh: 她在当地高中向高年级学生教授化学。

lemmas.def_zh: 教（teach的过去式和过去分词）；学会
lemmas.def_en: past tense and past participle of teach

examples.en: Experience has taught him to remain calm in emergencies.
examples.zh: 经验教会了他在紧急情况下保持冷静。

lemmas.def_zh: unteach的过去式和过去分词
lemmas.def_en: cause to disbelieve; teach someone the contrary of what he or she had learned earlier

examples.en: He possessed an untaught natural talent for playing complex melodies on the piano.
examples.zh: 他在钢琴演奏复杂旋律方面拥有一种无师自通的天赋。

lemmas.def_zh: 教师；导师
lemmas.def_en: a person whose job is to teach, especially in a school

examples.en: An effective teacher encourages pupils to ask questions.
examples.zh: 一位优秀的教师会鼓励学生提出疑问。

lemmas.def_zh: 教学；教职；教诲；学说
lemmas.def_en: the profession or act of imparting knowledge; principles or ideas taught by someone

examples.en: She left corporate law to pursue a rewarding career in teaching.
examples.zh: 她辞去了公司法务的工作，转而从事更有成就感的教学职业。

lemmas.def_zh: 可教的, 听教训的
lemmas.def_en: ready and willing to be taught

examples.en: She made a serious mistake, but treated the entire failure as a teachable moment.
examples.zh: 她犯了一个严重的错误，但把这次失败当成了一次受教的契机。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语“展示、指出”（与 token“标记”同源），核心逻辑是通过示范、引导和传授让人明理或习得技能。
family_guide.core_distinction: teacher 指施教者本人；teaching 既可指教学的职业与行为，也可指（常作复数时的）教义、学说与教导。

lemmas.def_zh: 快乐的，高兴的；幸福的；乐意的，满意的
lemmas.def_en: feeling or showing pleasure, contentment, or satisfaction

examples.en: We would be more than happy to answer any questions you might have.
examples.zh: 如果您有任何疑问，我们非常乐意为您解答。

examples.en: She led a long and happy life surrounded by her family.
examples.zh: 她在家人的陪伴下度过了漫长而幸福的一生。

lemmas.def_zh: 不快乐的，悲伤的；不满意的，不悦的
lemmas.def_en: feeling sad, miserable, or dissatisfied with a situation

examples.en: A growing number of employees are unhappy with the new remote-work policy.
examples.zh: 越来越多的员工对新的远程办公政策感到不满。

lemmas.def_zh: 幸福；快乐，高兴
lemmas.def_en: the state of being happy; contentment and well-being

examples.en: True happiness often lies in the pursuit of meaningful goals rather than wealth.
examples.zh: 真正的幸福往往在于追求有意义的目标，而非财富。

lemmas.def_zh: 苦恼；忧愁
lemmas.def_en: emotions experienced when not in a state of well-being

examples.en: Her persistent unhappiness at work convinced her it was time to change careers.
examples.zh: 她在工作中持续的苦恼让她确信，是时候转换职业了。

lemmas.def_zh: 快乐地，幸福地；乐意地；幸好，令人庆幸的是
lemmas.def_en: in a happy manner; willingly; by good fortune

examples.en: They worked happily side by side throughout the afternoon.
examples.zh: 他们整个下午都开开心心地并肩工作。

examples.en: Happily, the missing documents were found safe and intact.
examples.zh: 庆幸的是，丢失的文件被完好无损地找到了。

lemmas.def_zh: 不幸福地, 不幸地
lemmas.def_en: in an unpleasant way

examples.en: The long business partnership ended unhappily amid bitter disputes over company profits.
examples.zh: 由于对公司利润的激烈争执，这段长期的商业合作不幸破裂。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古诺斯语借词 hap（运气、机会，即 happen 的词根），语义从最初的‘带来好运的、幸运的’逐渐演变为心理感受上的‘感到满足的、快乐的’。
family_guide.core_distinction: 各派生词词性与语义界限清晰，注意 happily 除表示‘快乐地’外，常作评注性状语表示‘幸好、令人庆幸的是’。

lemmas.def_zh: 返回, 归还, 回来；归还, 还, 回报, 产生, 反射, 报告, 申报, 退回
lemmas.def_en: go or come back to place, condition, or activity where one has been before

examples.en: We expect the train to return to the central station right on schedule.
examples.zh: 我们预计火车将准时返回中央车站。

lemmas.def_zh: 回来, 返回, 来回票, 归还, 报答, 利润率, 报告书
lemmas.def_en: document giving the tax collector information about the taxpayer's tax liability

examples.en: We expect the train to return to the central station right on schedule.
examples.zh: 我们预计火车将准时返回中央车站。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 re-（回、向后）+ turn（转向），核心字面义为“转回去”，引申为位置上的“返回”、物品与状态的“归还/恢复”，以及付出后获得的“回报/收益”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词与名词同形；作动词侧重动作（返回、归还），作名词除指“归来、归还”外，高频用于指商业投资的“收益/利润”及官方“申报单”。

lemmas.def_zh: 均分, 分担, 分享, 分配, 共有；分享
lemmas.def_en: have in common

examples.en: They agreed to share the remaining profits equally among all four founding partners.
examples.zh: 他们同意将剩余利润在四位创始合伙人之间均分。

lemmas.def_zh: 部分, 参与, 一份, 参股, 份额
lemmas.def_en: assets belonging to or due to or contributed by an individual person or group

examples.en: They agreed to share the remaining profits equally among all four founding partners.
examples.zh: 他们同意将剩余利润在四位创始合伙人之间均分。

lemmas.def_zh: 分配者, 共同收受者, 参与者
lemmas.def_en: someone who has or gives or receives a part or a share

examples.en: As an active sharer of knowledge, she regularly mentors junior colleagues in our team.
examples.zh: 作为一名积极的知识分享者，她经常指导我们团队中的年轻同事。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 非共享的
lemmas.def_en: not shared

examples.en: The process requires an unshared memory segment to prevent sudden data corruption.
examples.zh: 该进程需要一个非共享内存段，以防止突然发生数据损坏。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语中“剪切、切分”的词根概念，核心演变逻辑为“把整体切分出各部分”，从而引申为分配、分担以及由分切所得的“份额”与“股份”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 该词为名动同形，动词侧重“共同使用、分摊或分配”的动作，名词侧重“配额、承担的责任或公司股份”。

lemmas.def_zh: 站立，直立；位于；容忍，承受；持某种立场
lemmas.def_en: to be in an upright position on one's feet; to be situated; to endure or tolerate

examples.en: I cannot stand the constant noise coming from the construction site.
examples.zh: 我受不了建筑工地持续不断的噪音。

examples.en: The old lighthouse has stood on the cliff for over two centuries.
examples.zh: 那座老灯塔耸立在悬崖上已有两个多世纪。

lemmas.def_zh: stand 的过去式及过去分词
lemmas.def_en: past tense and past participle of stand

examples.en: Her remarkable performance stood out among all the competitors.
examples.zh: 她在所有参赛者中表现格外亮眼。

examples.en: They stood firm in their resolve despite mounting pressure.
examples.zh: 尽管压力越来越大，他们依然坚定不移。

lemmas.def_zh: 使标准化, 使合于标准, 用标准检验
lemmas.def_en: cause to conform to standard or norm

examples.en: The hospital is working hard to standardize administrative procedures across all departments.
examples.zh: 医院正努力在所有科室推行行政流程的标准化。

lemmas.def_zh: 站立，直立；位于；容忍，承受；持某种立场
lemmas.def_en: to be in an upright position on one's feet; to be situated; to endure or tolerate

examples.en: I cannot stand the constant noise coming from the construction site.
examples.zh: 我受不了建筑工地持续不断的噪音。

examples.en: The old lighthouse has stood on the cliff for over two centuries.
examples.zh: 那座老灯塔耸立在悬崖上已有两个多世纪。

lemmas.def_zh: 标准；基准；水平；规格
lemmas.def_en: an accepted or required level of quality, achievement, or measure

examples.en: The hotel maintains high standards of cleanliness and service.
examples.zh: 这家酒店始终保持着高水平的清洁与服务标准。

examples.en: His performance failed to meet the rigorous standards set by the committee.
examples.zh: 他的表现未能达到委员会设立的严苛标准。

lemmas.def_zh: 地位，声誉，资历；持续时间
lemmas.def_en: status, reputation, or rank in a group or society; the length of time something has existed

examples.en: She is an architect of high international standing.
examples.zh: 她是享有崇高国际声誉的建筑师。

examples.en: Their friendship was of long standing, dating back to primary school.
examples.zh: 他们的友谊源远流长，可以追溯到小学时代。

lemmas.def_en: standing posture
lemmas.def_zh: 准备击球姿势, 站立的姿势, 位置, 姿态

examples.en: The government maintained a firm stance against illegal trade activities.
examples.zh: 政府对非法贸易活动保持了坚定的立场。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 标准化, 规格化
lemmas.def_en: the condition in which a standard has been successfully established

examples.en: International standardization of safety rules has greatly reduced workplace manufacturing accidents.
examples.zh: 安全规则的国际标准化大大减少了车间生产事故。

lemmas.def_zh: 采伐残留木
lemmas.def_en: an organism (person or animal) that stands

examples.en: Foresters marked each mature stander to remain untouched during the harvest.
examples.zh: 林务员给每棵采伐残留木做了标记，在采伐期间保持原样。

lemmas.def_zh: 站立者, 站票观众
lemmas.def_en: someone who stands in a place where one might otherwise sit (as a spectator who uses standing room in a theater or a passenger on a crowded bus or train)

examples.en: The conductor asked every standee to move toward the back of the bus.
examples.zh: 售票员要求每位站立的乘客向公交车后部移动。

lemmas.def_zh: 标准；基准；水平；规格
lemmas.def_en: an accepted or required level of quality, achievement, or measure

examples.en: The hotel maintains high standards of cleanliness and service.
examples.zh: 这家酒店始终保持着高水平的清洁与服务标准。

examples.en: His performance failed to meet the rigorous standards set by the committee.
examples.zh: 他的表现未能达到委员会设立的严苛标准。

lemmas.def_zh: 不标准的
lemmas.def_en: not conforming to the language usage of a prestige group within a community; ; - A.R.Dunlap

examples.en: The technician struggled to repair the machine due to its nonstandard internal components.
examples.zh: 由于机器内部零件非标准，技术人员费了好大劲才修好。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语根 *sta-（站立、固定、挺直），核心意象由肉体的“直立/停驻不动”引申为抽象的“立场坚定”、“容忍承受”以及空间上的“展台/看台”与社会维度的“地位/资历”。
family_guide.core_distinction: stand 作名词侧重指具体的“货摊/看台”或抽象的“立场/态度”；standing 作名词则侧重指社会的“声誉/地位”或某一状态的“持续时间”。

lemmas.def_zh: 人类的, 似人类的, 人性的, 有同情心的
lemmas.def_en: characteristic of humanity

examples.en: It is only human to make small mistakes when working under immense pressure.
examples.zh: 在巨大的压力下工作，犯点小错误完全是人之常情。

lemmas.def_en: marked by humanistic values and devotion to human welfare
lemmas.def_zh: 人道主义的, 博爱的, 凡人论的

examples.en: The international agency provided urgent humanitarian aid to the war-torn border region.
examples.zh: 该国际机构向饱受战火蹂躏的边境地区提供了紧急人道主义援助。

lemmas.def_zh: 非人类的
lemmas.def_en: not human; not belonging to or produced by or appropriate to human beings

examples.en: Researchers are studying nonhuman primates to understand the evolution of social behavior.
examples.zh: 研究人员正在研究非人类灵长类动物，以了解社会行为的演变。

lemmas.def_zh: 非人类的,无人类属性的
lemmas.def_en: divested of human qualities or attributes

examples.en: The creature let out an unhuman shriek that echoed across the dark forest.
examples.zh: 那个生物发出一声怪异非人的尖叫，在黑暗的森林中回荡。

lemmas.def_zh: 人, 人类
lemmas.def_en: any living or extinct member of the family Hominidae characterized by superior intelligence, articulate speech, and erect carriage

examples.en: It is only human to make small mistakes when working under immense pressure.
examples.zh: 在巨大的压力下工作，犯点小错误完全是人之常情。

lemmas.def_zh: 人类（总称）；人性；仁慈，博爱
lemmas.def_en: human beings collectively; the quality of being humane or having human traits

examples.en: Climate change poses a serious and unprecedented threat to humanity.
examples.zh: 气候变化对全人类构成了严重且前所未有的威胁。

examples.en: He treated the displaced refugees with warmth, dignity, and humanity.
examples.zh: 他以温暖、尊严和人道关怀对待那些流离失所的难民。

lemmas.def_en: someone devoted to the promotion of human welfare and to social reforms
lemmas.def_zh: 人道主义者, 博爱者, 基督凡人论者

examples.en: The international agency provided urgent humanitarian aid to the war-torn border region.
examples.zh: 该国际机构向饱受战火蹂躏的边境地区提供了紧急人道主义援助。

lemmas.def_en: the doctrine that people's duty is to promote human welfare
lemmas.def_zh: 人道主义, 博爱主义

examples.en: Her deep humanitarianism motivated her to spend years working in refugee camps.
examples.zh: 她深厚的人道主义情怀促使她在难民营工作了数年。

lemmas.def_zh: 为人, 人性
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being human

examples.en: Her deep compassion and warmth revealed the true humanness of her character.
examples.zh: 她深切的同情心和温暖展现了她性格中真正的人性。

lemmas.def_zh: 从人的角度, 充满人性地, 在人力所及范围
lemmas.def_en: in the manner of human beings

examples.en: The surgeons did everything humanly possible to save the injured firefighter's life.
examples.zh: 外科医生竭尽人力所及的一切努力，试图挽救受伤消防员的生命。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 humanus（人的、人性的），与 humus（大地、泥土）同源，隐含“凡人/大地之子”之意，演变出与神、动物及机器相对的“人类”与“人性”概念。
family_guide.core_distinction: human 作名词指具体的“人/个体”，humanity 则指抽象的“人性/人道”或集合总称的“全人类”。

lemmas.def_zh: 预料，预计；期待，盼望；要求
lemmas.def_en: to think or believe that something will happen; to look forward to

examples.en: We expect the project to be completed ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 我们预计该项目将提前完成。

lemmas.def_zh: 期待，预料；期望，期望值
lemmas.def_en: a strong belief that something will happen or be the case

examples.en: The hotel exceeded all our expectations in terms of service and comfort.
examples.zh: 这家酒店在服务和舒适度方面超出了我们所有的期望。

lemmas.def_zh: 期待, 期望的事物, 嘱望, 希望, 期望, 预期
lemmas.def_en: an expectation

examples.en: Advancements in modern medicine have greatly increased average life expectancy worldwide.
examples.zh: 现代医学的进步极大地提高了全世界的平均预期寿命。

lemmas.def_zh: 出乎意外, 突然
lemmas.def_en: extraordinariness by virtue of being unexpected

examples.en: The sudden unexpectedness of the announcement caught all the employees completely off guard.
examples.zh: 这一消息公布得极为突然，让所有员工都措手不及。

lemmas.def_zh: 出乎意料的，始料不及的
lemmas.def_en: not expected or regarded as likely to happen; surprising

examples.en: The sudden announcement was completely unexpected and shocked everyone.
examples.zh: 这个突如其来的通知完全出乎意料，让所有人大为震惊。

lemmas.def_zh: 预期的, 期待的
lemmas.def_en: marked by eager anticipation

examples.en: The expectant crowd fell completely silent as the magician stepped onto the stage.
examples.zh: 当魔术师走上舞台时，满怀期待的人群完全安静了下来。

lemmas.def_zh: 出乎意料地，意外地
lemmas.def_en: in a way that was not expected or anticipated

examples.en: An old college friend turned up unexpectedly at my office yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天一位大学老友出人意料地出现在我的办公室。

lemmas.def_zh: 期待, 期待着, 期望, 预期
lemmas.def_en: in an expectant manner

examples.en: The stray dog sat expectantly by the kitchen door, hoping for some scraps.
examples.zh: 那只流浪狗满怀期待地坐在厨房门旁，希望能得到一些残羹剩饭。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ex-（向外）+ spectare（看），本义为“向外看、翘首以待”，引申为对未来事物的“预料、期待”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 派生形态规则，需注意 expectation 常以复数形式 expectations 表示“期望值”或“期望的标准”。

lemmas.def_zh: 行走，步行；散步；遛（狗）；陪同…走
lemmas.def_en: to move on foot at a moderate pace; to accompany or guide someone on foot

examples.en: I usually walk to work instead of driving to stay active.
examples.zh: 为了保持活力，我通常步行去上班而不是开车。

examples.en: He walks his dog in the neighborhood park every evening.
examples.zh: 他每天傍晚都在社区公园里遛狗。

lemmas.def_zh: 行走，步行；散步；遛（狗）；陪同…走
lemmas.def_en: to move on foot at a moderate pace; to accompany or guide someone on foot

examples.en: I usually walk to work instead of driving to stay active.
examples.zh: 为了保持活力，我通常步行去上班而不是开车。

examples.en: He walks his dog in the neighborhood park every evening.
examples.zh: 他每天傍晚都在社区公园里遛狗。

lemmas.def_zh: 步行者，徒步者；助行架，助步器；学步车
lemmas.def_en: a person who walks; a supportive frame used to assist walking

examples.en: The national park trail is well-suited for casual walkers and hikers alike.
examples.zh: 这条国家公园步道既适合散步者，也适合远足登山客。

examples.en: After hip surgery, he used a walker to regain his mobility safely.
examples.zh: 髋关节手术后，他借助助行架安全地恢复行动能力。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语表示“翻滚、转动、漫游”的词汇，后演化为以双足交替迈步为核心的“行走、散步”，并进一步引申出相关的人、工具及人生道路。
family_guide.core_distinction: walk 可兼作动词与名词，表“行走/散步”行为或“步态”；派生词 walker 既可指“步行者”，也可特指“助行架”或婴儿“学步车”。

lemmas.def_zh: 重要的；重大的；有影响力的
lemmas.def_en: having great significance, value, or consequence

examples.en: Good communication plays an important role in building a successful team.
examples.zh: 良好的沟通在打造成功团队中起着重要作用。

examples.en: It is important to review the contract carefully before signing it.
examples.zh: 在签署合同之前仔细审查非常重要。

lemmas.def_zh: 庄重的, 壮观的, 显赫的, 重大的, 最高的, 雄伟的, 宏大的, 豪华的, 傲慢的
lemmas.def_en: of behavior that is impressive and ambitious in scale or scope

examples.en: The hotel lobby featured a grand staircase made of polished marble and glowing bronze railings.
examples.zh: 酒店大堂设有一座由抛光大理石和发亮青铜栏杆打造的宏伟楼梯。

lemmas.def_zh: 不重要的
lemmas.def_en: not important

examples.en: Do not waste valuable time worrying about trivial and completely unimportant details.
examples.zh: 不要把宝贵的时间浪费在担心琐碎且完全不重要的细节上。

lemmas.def_zh: 重要地；（修饰全句）重要的是
lemmas.def_en: in an important manner; used to emphasize a significant point or statement

examples.en: He is talented, hardworking, and most importantly, honest.
examples.zh: 他很有才华，工作勤奋，而且最重要的是，他为人诚实。

examples.en: More importantly, the new policy will protect the interests of local consumers.
examples.zh: 更重要的是，新政策将保护当地消费者的利益。

lemmas.def_zh: 宏伟地, 盛大地
lemmas.def_en: in a grand manner

examples.en: The host grandly welcomed his guests and invited them into the richly decorated dining hall.
examples.zh: 主人隆重地欢迎客人们，并邀请他们进入装饰华丽的宴会厅。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 重大的, 主要的, 伟大的
lemmas.def_en: the cardinal number that is the product of 10 and 100

examples.en: The hotel lobby featured a grand staircase made of polished marble and glowing bronze railings.
examples.zh: 酒店大堂设有一座由抛光大理石和发亮青铜栏杆打造的宏伟楼梯。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being important and worthy of note
lemmas.def_zh: n. 重要性，重大

examples.en: She stressed the importance of regular exercise.
examples.zh: 她强调了定期锻炼的重要性。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being humble and unimportant
lemmas.def_zh: 不重要, 不足道

examples.en: She smiled at the relative unimportance of the minor mistakes made during the presentation.
examples.zh: 对于演讲中所犯的小错误，她因其微不足道而一笑置之。

lemmas.def_zh: 宏伟, 壮大, 伟大
lemmas.def_en: a prominent status

examples.en: The sheer grandness of the ancient cathedral left the visiting tourists completely breathless with awe.
examples.zh: 这座古老教堂的无比宏伟让前来的游客敬畏得屏息凝神。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 importare（带入、输入），后引申出“具有分量、产生重大影响”，核心意象为“有重大价值与意义的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: important 作形容词修饰名词或作表语；importantly 为副词，除修饰动词外，最常以 more importantly / most importantly 等形式作评注性状语修饰全句。

lemmas.def_zh: 需要；要求；规定
lemmas.def_en: to need something; to make something compulsory according to a law, rule, or authority

examples.en: The complex application process will require several weeks to complete.
examples.zh: 这个复杂的申请流程需要几周时间才能完成。

examples.en: All passengers are required by law to wear seatbelts at all times.
examples.zh: 法律规定所有乘客必须始终系好安全带。

lemmas.def_zh: 征用, 要求
lemmas.def_en: make a formal request for official services

examples.en: The military commander decided to requisition civilian vehicles for emergency transport.
examples.zh: 军事指挥官决定征用民用车辆用于紧急运输。

lemmas.def_zh: 必要条件；要求；需求
lemmas.def_en: something that you must have or do because of a rule or necessity

examples.en: Applicants must meet the minimum language requirements to qualify for the program.
examples.zh: 申请者必须满足最低语言要求才能获得该项目的资格。

examples.en: A valid passport is an essential requirement for international travel.
examples.zh: 有效的护照是国际旅行的必备条件。

lemmas.def_zh: 正式请求, 申请, 需要, 征用, 通知单, 申请书, 引渡要求
lemmas.def_en: the act of requiring; an authoritative request or demand, especially by a military or public authority that takes something over (usually temporarily) for military or public use

examples.en: The military commander decided to requisition civilian vehicles for emergency transport.
examples.zh: 军事指挥官决定征用民用车辆用于紧急运输。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 必需的；必修的；规定的
lemmas.def_en: necessary according to rules or regulations; compulsory
lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰课程、文件、手续等，如 required reading（必读书目）、required courses（必修课）。

examples.en: Applicants must submit all the required documents before the deadline.
examples.zh: 申请人必须在截止日期前提交所有必需的文件。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 quaerere（探寻、求索），字面为“反复索求”，演变为“因规则、法律或客观目的而必须索取或满足”，引申为“需要”与“要求”。
family_guide.core_distinction: require 是动词动作（需要、强制要求），requirement 则是其衍生的名词结果（具体规定的要求、必要条件或需求）。

lemmas.def_zh: 一起, 共同, 彼此
lemmas.def_en: in contact with each other or in proximity

examples.en: Despite the difficult crisis, she remained calm, confident, and completely together.
examples.zh: 尽管面临严峻危机，她依然保持冷静、自信且心态沉稳。

lemmas.def_en: mentally and emotionally stable

examples.en: Despite the difficult crisis, she remained calm, confident, and completely together.
examples.zh: 尽管面临严峻危机，她依然保持冷静、自信且心态沉稳。

lemmas.def_zh: 和睦, 友好
lemmas.def_en: affectionate closeness

examples.en: The holiday family dinner fostered a warm sense of closeness and togetherness.
examples.zh: 节日家庭聚餐营造出一种温暖的亲密与和睦感。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语‘to + gather’（聚到一处），核心概念为‘聚集、组合’，由物理上的‘在一起’引申为相互协作，进而引申为心理或状态上的‘整合完好、沉着有序’。
family_guide.core_distinction: 副词表示‘共同、一道’或‘接连不断’；形容词为非正式用法，专指人‘头脑清醒、做事有条理、沉着自信’。

lemmas.def_zh: 所有的, 完整的, 完全的, 纯粹的
lemmas.def_en: including all components without exception; being one unit or constituting the full amount or extent or duration; complete

examples.en: He spent the whole afternoon organizing all the messy documents in his office.
examples.zh: 他花了整整一下午整理办公室里所有杂乱的文件。

lemmas.def_zh: 全部, 全体, 整体, 完全之体系
lemmas.def_en: all of something including all its component elements or parts

examples.en: He spent the whole afternoon organizing all the messy documents in his office.
examples.zh: 他花了整整一下午整理办公室里所有杂乱的文件。

lemmas.def_zh: 全体, 一切, 完全
lemmas.def_en: an undivided or unbroken completeness or totality with nothing wanting

examples.en: Her therapeutic art sessions aim to restore emotional wholeness and inner peace.
examples.zh: 她的艺术治疗课程旨在恢复情感的完整性与内心的平静。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 hāl（完整、健康、未受损），与 heal（治愈）、health（健康）同源，核心语义始终围绕“未被分割或损坏的完整统一体”。

lemmas.def_zh: 法院, 庭院, 奉承
lemmas.def_en: an assembly (including one or more judges) to conduct judicial business

examples.en: The reckless driver seemed determined to court disaster by speeding in dense fog.
examples.zh: 那个鲁莽的司机在大雾中超速行驶，似乎注定要招致灾祸。

lemmas.def_zh: 谦恭, 礼让, 恳挚
lemmas.def_en: elegance suggestive of a royal court

examples.en: His natural courtliness and impeccable manners charmed everyone at the formal banquet.
examples.zh: 他在正式宴会上表现出的天生谦恭和无可挑剔的举止迷倒了所有人。

lemmas.def_zh: 献殷勤, 追求, 招致；求爱
lemmas.def_en: make amorous advances towards

examples.en: The reckless driver seemed determined to court disaster by speeding in dense fog.
examples.zh: 那个鲁莽的司机在大雾中超速行驶，似乎注定要招致灾祸。

lemmas.def_zh: 谦恭的, 礼让的, 有教养的
lemmas.def_en: refined or imposing in manner or appearance; befitting a royal court

examples.en: The ambassador greeted his foreign guests with courtly manners and deep respect.
examples.zh: 大使以彬彬有礼的举止和深切的敬意迎接外宾。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 cohortem（封闭的院落），由‘庭院’引申为王公贵族聚集的‘宫廷’、行使审判的‘法庭’以及特定球类‘场地’；动词则由在宫廷中博取恩宠引申为‘追求、求爱’及‘招致（灾难等）’。

lemmas.def_zh: 收到；接收；接待；受到（对待或伤害）
lemmas.def_en: to get or accept something that is sent or given; to welcome a guest; to experience or react to something

examples.en: Did you receive the confirmation email I sent you this morning?
examples.zh: 你收到我今天早上发给你的确认邮件了吗？

examples.en: The delegation received a warm welcome from the local community.
examples.zh: 代表团受到了当地社区的热烈欢迎。

lemmas.def_en: the manner in which something is greeted
lemmas.def_zh: 接待处，前台；欢迎会；接受度

examples.en: Please check in at the reception desk upon your arrival.
examples.zh: 到达后请在前台办理登记手续。

lemmas.def_zh: 接收器；电话听筒；接收者
lemmas.def_en: a piece of equipment that receives radio, television, or satellite signals; the part of a telephone you hold to your ear; a person who receives something

examples.en: She picked up the receiver and dialed her lawyer's number.
examples.zh: 她拿起听筒，拨通了律师的电话。

examples.en: The wireless microphone transmits audio directly to the receiver plugged into the camera.
examples.zh: 无线麦克风将音频直接传输到插入相机的接收器上。

lemmas.def_en: a person who receives something
lemmas.def_zh: 接受者；受捐者；获奖者

examples.en: He was the recipient of numerous literary awards.
examples.zh: 他是多项文学奖项的获得者。

lemmas.def_en: a cellular structure that is postulated to exist in order to mediate between a chemical agent that acts on nervous tissue and the physiological response
lemmas.def_zh: （生理）感受器；受体

examples.en: The virus binds to a specific receptor on the surface of human cells.
examples.zh: 该病毒与人体细胞表面的特定受体结合。

lemmas.def_en: a secretary whose main duty is to answer the telephone and receive visitors
lemmas.def_zh: 接待员

examples.en: The receptionist greeted the visitors warmly and asked them to sign the guestbook.
examples.zh: 接待员热情地问候访客，并请他们签署留言簿。

lemmas.def_zh: [经] 清算人(接收人)办公室, 清算人职能
lemmas.def_en: the state of property that is in the hands of a receiver

examples.en: The struggling airline was placed into receivership after failing to pay debts.
examples.zh: 这家陷入困境的航空公司在无力偿债后被接管清算。

lemmas.def_zh: 感受性, 接受能力
lemmas.def_en: willingness or readiness to receive (especially impressions or ideas)

examples.en: he was testing the government's receptiveness to reform
this receptiveness is the key feature in oestral behavior, enabling natural mating to occur

lemmas.def_zh: 感受性
lemmas.def_en: willingness or readiness to receive (especially impressions or ideas)

examples.en: he was testing the government's receptiveness to reform
this receptiveness is the key feature in oestral behavior, enabling natural mating to occur

lemmas.def_zh: 能接纳的
lemmas.def_en: open to arguments, ideas, or change

examples.en: The manager was surprisingly receptive to our unconventional ideas for the project.
examples.zh: 经理对我们针对该项目提出的大胆想法出奇地乐于接受。

lemmas.def_zh: 不会接受(或容纳)的, 反应不快的,接受能力不强的
lemmas.def_en: not receptive

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 recipere（re- 回/向后 + capere 拿/取），核心意象为“拿回来、接住”，引申为接收事物、接受待遇或接待人员。

lemmas.def_zh: 研究, 调查, 考察
lemmas.def_en: systematic investigation to establish facts

examples.en: She spent years doing scientific research to develop a safe vaccine.
examples.zh: 她花费数年进行科学研究以研发安全的疫苗。

lemmas.def_zh: 研究员；调查人员
lemmas.def_en: a person who carries out academic or scientific research

examples.en: Researchers at the university are working on a more efficient cancer treatment.
examples.zh: 该大学的研究人员正在开发一种更有效的癌症疗法。

lemmas.def_zh: 研究, 调查
lemmas.def_en: attempt to find out in a systematically and scientific manner

examples.en: She spent years doing scientific research to develop a safe vaccine.
examples.zh: 她花费数年进行科学研究以研发安全的疫苗。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自前缀 re-（反复、深入）+ search（搜寻），核心逻辑为“反复彻底地搜寻与核验”，引申为系统性的学术研究或深入调查。
family_guide.core_distinction: research 兼具名词与动词，作名词时多为不可数名词（常与 conduct/do 搭配）；researcher 则特指从事该活动的研究人员。

lemmas.def_zh: 单身的, 单程的, 单一的, 个别的, 孤独的, 专一的
lemmas.def_en: being or characteristic of a single thing or person

examples.en: The batter hit a sharp single into left field to score.
examples.zh: 击球手向左外野击出一记凌厉的平飞一垒打并得分。

lemmas.def_zh: 一个, 单打, 单程票
lemmas.def_en: a base hit on which the batter stops safely at first base

examples.en: The batter hit a sharp single into left field to score.
examples.zh: 击球手向左外野击出一记凌厉的平飞一垒打并得分。

lemmas.def_zh: 单一, 真诚, 独身
lemmas.def_en: without hypocrisy

examples.en: He pursued his artistic goals with an admirable singleness of purpose.
examples.zh: 他以令人钦佩的坚定专注追求着自己的艺术目标。

lemmas.def_zh: 选出；击出一垒打
lemmas.def_en: hit a single

examples.en: The batter hit a sharp single into left field to score.
examples.zh: 击球手向左外野击出一记凌厉的平飞一垒打并得分。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 singulus（单独的、个别的），核心语义始终围绕“独一无二、未成对、个别分离”展开，由修饰单一状态（adj.）引申为单个实体（n.）及单独挑选（v.）。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词表“单一的/单身的”，名词常指“单曲/单人房/单身者”，动词则高度聚焦于“单独挑出（常接 out）”。

lemmas.def_zh: 提供, 出价, 奉献, 试图, 使出现, 演出；出现, 献祭, 提议, 求婚
lemmas.def_en: make available or accessible, provide or furnish

examples.en: The company decided to offer him a higher salary and bonuses.
examples.zh: 公司决定向他提供更高的薪水和奖金。

lemmas.def_zh: 给予(物), 出价, 提议, 意图, 报价
lemmas.def_en: the verbal act of offering

examples.en: The company decided to offer him a higher salary and bonuses.
examples.zh: 公司决定向他提供更高的薪水和奖金。

lemmas.def_zh: 提供, 奉献物, 牲礼, 上市的股票(或证券等)
lemmas.def_en: something offered (as a proposal or bid)

examples.en: The tech firm announced a public offering of five million shares.
examples.zh: 该科技公司宣布公开发行五百万股股票。

lemmas.def_zh: [经] 报价(盘)人
lemmas.def_en: someone who presents something to another for acceptance or rejection

examples.en: The offeror can revoke the contract proposal before the other party accepts.
examples.zh: 在对方接受之前，发盘人可以撤销合同提议。

lemmas.def_zh: [经] 发价人
lemmas.def_en: someone who presents something to another for acceptance or rejection

examples.en: The generous offerer remained anonymous while donating millions to the local hospital.
examples.zh: 这位慷慨的捐赠人在向当地医院捐赠数百万时保持了匿名。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 offerre（ob- '向着/到面前' + ferre '带来/携带'），核心意象为'将物品或意向呈递到某人面前'，引申出'主动提供、出价、奉献'等意。
family_guide.core_distinction: offer (n.) 多指具体的提议、工作邀请或出价，而 offering (n.) 多指宗教祭品/供物，或商业上正式推出的产品、服务组合。

lemmas.def_zh: 年龄, 老年, 成年, 寿命, 时代, 时期
lemmas.def_en: how long something has existed

examples.en: Fine wines usually age gracefully in dark and cool underground cellars.
examples.zh: 优质葡萄酒通常在阴暗凉爽的地下酒窖中优雅地陈化。

lemmas.def_zh: 变老, 成熟
lemmas.def_en: begin to seem older; get older

examples.en: Fine wines usually age gracefully in dark and cool underground cellars.
examples.zh: 优质葡萄酒通常在阴暗凉爽的地下酒窖中优雅地陈化。

lemmas.def_zh: 未老化的
lemmas.def_en: not subjected to an aging process

examples.en: This fresh cocktail is best prepared with unaged rum and lime.
examples.zh: 这款新鲜的鸡尾酒最好用未经陈酿的朗姆酒和青柠调制。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 aevum（时代、寿命），核心内涵始终围绕“生命或时间的长度、跨度及增长”展开。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词表示“年龄、时代或老年状态”，动词则表示“变老、老化”或特指食品酒类的“陈化、成熟”。

lemmas.def_en: being one more than four

examples.en: She bought five fresh apples from the local farmers market yesterday morning.
examples.zh: 她昨天早上在当地农贸市场买了五个新鲜苹果。

lemmas.def_en: the cardinal number that is the sum of four and one

examples.en: She bought five fresh apples from the local farmers market yesterday morning.
examples.zh: 她昨天早上在当地农贸市场买了五个新鲜苹果。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语根 *penkʷe-（五），属于最基础的核心数词，语义直接表示数量‘五’或数字本身。
family_guide.core_distinction: five 作形容词时直接修饰名词表数量；作名词时指代数字5、含5个单位的集合、五点钟或五岁等概念。

lemmas.def_zh: 出售，售卖；推销，使接受
lemmas.def_en: to give or hand over something in exchange for money; to persuade someone of the merit of something

examples.en: They decided to sell their old apartment and move to the countryside.
examples.zh: 他们决定卖掉旧公寓，搬去乡村生活。

examples.en: It wasn't easy to sell the new strategy to the board of directors.
examples.zh: 要让董事会接受这项新策略并不容易。

lemmas.def_zh: 售出的；卖（sell的过去式和过去分词）；深信不疑的
lemmas.def_en: past and past participle of sell; having been purchased; completely convinced of something

examples.en: All tickets for the Saturday night show were sold out in minutes.
examples.zh: 周六晚演出的所有门票在几分钟内就售罄了。

examples.en: As soon as I tasted the dish, I was completely sold on the recipe.
examples.zh: 我一尝这道菜，就彻底被这个食谱征服了。

lemmas.def_zh: 卖家，售货人；畅销品
lemmas.def_en: a person or business that sells something; a product that sells well or in a specified way

examples.en: Online marketplaces protect both the buyer and the seller during transactions.
examples.zh: 在线交易平台在交易过程中同时保障买家和卖家的权益。

examples.en: This lightweight jacket has become a consistent best seller for the brand.
examples.zh: 这款轻便夹克已成为该品牌经久不衰的畅销单品。

lemmas.def_zh: 未售出的
lemmas.def_en: not disposed of by purchase

examples.en: Dozens of unsold novels were returned to the publisher after Christmas.
examples.zh: 圣诞节后，数十本未售出的小说被退回给了出版社。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语‘交付、给予’之意，后特化为‘以财物换取金钱’的核心商业行为，延伸出抽象的‘推销、使接受’。
family_guide.core_distinction: sell 为动词原形；sold 为其过去式/过去分词，常作形容词表示‘已售出的’或口语中‘被说服的’；seller 则指卖家或特定销量的商品（如 bestseller）。

lemmas.def_zh: 出现，显现；显得，似乎；出庭，登场
lemmas.def_en: to become visible; to give the impression of being; to arrive or be present publicly

examples.en: A rainbow suddenly appeared in the sky after the storm passed.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过后，天空中突然出现了一道彩虹。

examples.en: He appears to be confident, but he is actually quite nervous inside.
examples.zh: 他表面上看起来很自信，但内心其实十分紧张。

lemmas.def_zh: 外貌，外表；出现，露面
lemmas.def_en: the way that someone or something looks; the act of arriving or becoming visible

examples.en: You shouldn't judge a person's character solely by their physical appearance.
examples.zh: 你不应该仅凭外貌来评判一个人的品格。

examples.en: The famous author made a brief appearance at the opening ceremony of the book fair.
examples.zh: 这位著名作家在书展的开幕式上短暂露了面。

lemmas.def_zh: 鬼, 幽灵, 幻影
lemmas.def_en: a ghostly appearing figure

examples.en: The traveler claimed he saw a pale apparition floating through the hallway.
examples.zh: 那名旅客声称自己看到一个苍白的幽灵在走廊里飘过。

lemmas.def_zh: 显而易见的；表面上的，貌似的
lemmas.def_en: clearly visible or understood; seeming to be real or true, but perhaps not actually so

examples.en: It soon became apparent that the two sides would not reach an agreement.
examples.zh: 很快就显而易见，双方无法达成协议。

examples.en: His apparent lack of concern was merely a disguise for his anxiety.
examples.zh: 他表面上的不在乎只不过是在掩饰内心的焦虑。

lemmas.def_zh: 据透露，看来，貌似；表面上
lemmas.def_en: according to what you have heard or what seems to be true, although you are not certain

examples.en: Apparently, the company is planning to lay off hundreds of employees next month.
examples.zh: 据说，该公司计划下个月裁员数百人。

examples.en: She was apparently unharmed after the accident, but the doctor advised a full checkup.
examples.zh: 事故发生后她表面上看没有受伤，但医生建议做一次全面检查。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ad-（向、到）+ parere（显现），核心逻辑为“进入视野”，由此引申出“肉眼可见的出现/露面”以及“感官上的似乎/看起来像”。
family_guide.core_distinction: appear 是核心动词，表示“显现”或“显得”；appearance 是其名词派生词，兼具“露面/出场”这一动作与“外貌/外表”这一表象特征。

lemmas.def_zh: 房间, 空位, 场所
lemmas.def_en: an area within a building enclosed by walls and floor and ceiling

examples.en: There is plenty of room in the trunk for all your luggage.
examples.zh: 后备箱里有足够的空间放你所有的行李。

lemmas.def_en: an associate who shares a room with you

examples.en: My college roomy helped me carry all my heavy boxes upstairs.
examples.zh: 我的大学室友帮我把所有沉重的箱子搬上了楼。

lemmas.def_zh: 满房间, 满场的人
lemmas.def_en: the quantity a room will hold

examples.en: The comedian walked on stage and made the entire roomful of people laugh.
examples.zh: 喜剧演员走上舞台，逗得满屋子的人哄堂大笑。

lemmas.def_zh: 房客
lemmas.def_en: a tenant in someone's house

examples.en: The elderly landlady rented the quiet upstairs bedroom to a quiet roomer.
examples.zh: 年迈的女房东把楼上安静的卧室租给了一位安静的房客。

lemmas.def_zh: 广阔
lemmas.def_en: intellectual breadth

examples.en: Passengers appreciate the roominess of this new SUV model on long road trips.
examples.zh: 乘客们很喜欢这款新 SUV 在长途公路旅行中的宽敞空间。

lemmas.def_zh: 住宿, 居住；留宿
lemmas.def_en: live and take one's meals at or in

examples.en: She decided to room with her high school friend during her first year.
examples.zh: 她决定在大学第一年和她高中的朋友同住。

lemmas.def_zh: 广阔的, 宽敞的, 宽大的
lemmas.def_en: (of buildings and rooms) having ample space

examples.en: The master bedroom is roomy enough to accommodate a king-size bed comfortably.
examples.zh: 主卧室非常宽敞，足以舒适地放下一张特大号床。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古英语 rūm（空间、空地），核心语义从不可数的‘容纳空间/余地’演变为建筑中被隔出的‘房间’，后引申为动词‘寄宿、合住’。
family_guide.core_distinction: 作名词时可数表示具体的‘房间’，不可数表示抽象的‘空间/余地’；作动词时常与 with 搭配，指大学或寄宿期间‘与某人同住/合住’。

lemmas.def_zh: 测试, 试验, 化验；接受测验, 进行测试
lemmas.def_en: put to the test, as for its quality, or give experimental use to

examples.en: Scientists will test the water samples to check for harmful chemical pollutants.
examples.zh: 科学家将检测水样以检查是否存在有害的化学污染物。

lemmas.def_zh: 测试, 试验, 化验, 检验, 考验, 甲壳
lemmas.def_en: trying something to find out about it

examples.en: Scientists will test the water samples to check for harmful chemical pollutants.
examples.zh: 科学家将检测水样以检查是否存在有害的化学污染物。

lemmas.def_zh: 考试人, 做试验者, 试验装置, 天盖, 华盖
lemmas.def_en: someone who administers a test to determine your qualifications

examples.en: The software tester found several critical bugs just hours before the scheduled launch.
examples.zh: 软件测试员在预定发布前几个小时发现了几个关键漏洞。

lemmas.def_zh: 未经试验的, 未经考验的
lemmas.def_en: not tried or tested by experience

examples.en: Deploying this untested technology into real operations carries a significant amount of risk.
examples.zh: 将这项未经测试的技术应用于实际运营会带来相当大的风险。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 testum（用于精炼和化验贵金属的陶制坩埚），引申为通过严格的标准、实践或程序来检验事物的品质、真伪或能力。

lemmas.def_zh: 也许，可能；大概
lemmas.def_en: perhaps; possibly

examples.en: Maybe we can discuss this over coffee tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 也许我们明天早上可以一边喝咖啡一边讨论这件事。

examples.en: "Are you coming to the party tonight?" "Maybe, it depends on my workload."
examples.zh: “你今晚来参加聚会吗？”“也许吧，看我的工作量而定。”

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中古英语短语 '(it) may be'（可能是），合写演化为副词，核心表推测、不确定或委婉语气。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意副词 'maybe'（作状语，意为'也许'）与动词短语 'may be'（情态动词加系动词，作谓语）的拼写和结构差异。

lemmas.def_zh: 每，每一；按照，依据
lemmas.def_en: for each; by means of; according to

examples.en: The speed limit on this stretch of highway is 65 miles per hour.
examples.zh: 这段高速公路的限速是每小时65英里。

examples.en: The shipment was delivered on time, as per our agreement.
examples.zh: 货物已按照我们的协议准时送达。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语介词 per（通过、穿过），在英语中主要引申为表示分配比率的“每、每一”，以及在公文、商务中表示依据的“按照”。

lemmas.def_zh: 生长；成长；增加；逐渐变得；种植
lemmas.def_en: to increase in size, amount, or degree; to develop; to become gradually

examples.en: The company continues to grow rapidly in the overseas market.
examples.zh: 该公司在海外市场继续迅速扩大。

examples.en: She grows her own organic vegetables in the backyard.
examples.zh: 她在后院自己种植有机蔬菜。

lemmas.def_zh: 生长；成长；逐渐变得（grow 的过去式）
lemmas.def_en: past tense of grow

examples.en: As evening approached, the temperature grew noticeably colder.
examples.zh: 随着夜幕降临，气温明显变得更冷了。

lemmas.def_zh: 生长；成长（grow 的过去分词）；成年的；成熟的
lemmas.def_en: past participle of grow; fully developed or adult

examples.en: Online shopping has grown tremendously over the past decade.
examples.zh: 在过去的十年里，网上购物经历了巨大的增长。

examples.en: He has two grown daughters who both work as physicians.
examples.zh: 他有两个已经成年的女儿，都从事医生职业。

lemmas.def_zh: 生长；成长（grow 的过去分词）；成年的；成熟的
lemmas.def_en: past participle of grow; fully developed or adult

examples.en: Online shopping has grown tremendously over the past decade.
examples.zh: 在过去的十年里，网上购物经历了巨大的增长。

examples.en: He has two grown daughters who both work as physicians.
examples.zh: 他有两个已经成年的女儿，都从事医生职业。

lemmas.def_zh: 生长，发育；增长，增加；肿瘤，肿块
lemmas.def_en: the process of growing, developing, or increasing; a physical mass or tumor

examples.en: The tech company experienced unprecedented economic growth over the past decade.
examples.zh: 在过去的十年中，这家科技公司经历了前所未有的经济增长。

examples.en: Regular pruning encourages the healthy growth of new shoots.
examples.zh: 定期修剪有助于新芽的健康生长。

lemmas.def_zh: 栽培者, 生长物
lemmas.def_en: someone concerned with the science or art or business of cultivating the soil

examples.en: The local apple grower supplied fresh organic produce directly to our neighborhood market.
examples.zh: 当地的苹果种植者直接向我们附近的菜市场供应新鲜有机农产品。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 grōwan，核心本义为植物发芽滋长，引申为体量、数量、程度的扩大以及状态的“逐渐变得”
family_guide.core_distinction: grown 既是动词 grow 的过去分词，也独立作为形容词使用，专门修饰已发育成熟的人或生物（如 a grown man）

lemmas.def_zh: 比率, 率, 速度, 价格, 费用, 等级
lemmas.def_en: a magnitude or frequency relative to a time unit

examples.en: The central bank decided to lower the interest rate to encourage business borrowing.
examples.zh: 中央银行决定降低利率以鼓励企业借贷。

lemmas.def_zh: 等级, 额定功率, 责骂
lemmas.def_en: an appraisal of the value of something

examples.en: The hotel maintains a high rating online thanks to its exceptional customer service.
examples.zh: 由于出色的客户服务，该酒店在网上保持着很高的评分。

lemmas.def_zh: 估价, 认为, 鉴定等级, 责骂；被评价, 责骂
lemmas.def_en: assign a rank or rating to

examples.en: The central bank decided to lower the interest rate to encourage business borrowing.
examples.zh: 中央银行决定降低利率以鼓励企业借贷。

lemmas.def_zh: 捕鼠, 变节；弄蓬松
lemmas.def_en: desert one's party or group of friends, for example, for one's personal advantage

examples.en: He refused to rat on his former associates despite intense pressure from investigators.
examples.zh: 尽管受到调查人员的巨大压力，他仍拒绝出卖以前的同伙。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 reri（思考、计算、评定）的过去分词 ratus，核心语义为“经核算评定的固定数值、标准或比例”，引申为速率、比率及评价行为。
family_guide.core_distinction: rate 作名词指客观的速率、比率或固定费用，作动词指主观评估或排级；rating 专指评定产生的分级、收视率或信用评分；形近词 rat 作动词属俚语，表示背叛或告密。

lemmas.def_zh: 可能的；能做到的；潜在的
lemmas.def_en: able to be done or achieved; able to exist or happen

examples.en: Is it possible to complete the assignment by tomorrow morning?
examples.zh: 明天早上之前有可能完成这项作业吗？

examples.en: We must explore every possible solution before making a final decision.
examples.zh: 在做出最终决定之前，我们必须探讨每一种可能的解决方案。

lemmas.def_zh: 可能性；可能发生的事；机会
lemmas.def_en: a chance that something may happen or be true; a prospective option

examples.en: There is a strong possibility that the flight will be delayed due to the storm.
examples.zh: 由于暴风雨，航班极有可能延误。

examples.en: The breakthrough opens up exciting possibilities for medical research.
examples.zh: 这一突破为医学研究带来了令人兴奋的全新可能。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 posse（有能力、能够），核心语义围绕“具备实现的能力或发生的条件”，引申为“可能的”及“可能性”。

lemmas.def_zh: 代价, 价值, 费用
lemmas.def_en: the total spent for goods or services including money and time and labor

examples.en: The total cost of the renovation exceeded our initial budget by twenty percent.
examples.zh: 装修的总费用超出了我们最初预算的百分之二十。

lemmas.def_zh: 高价, 昂贵, 奢侈
lemmas.def_en: the quality possessed by something with a great price or value

examples.en: The sheer costliness of dental implants prevents many low-income patients from receiving treatment.
examples.zh: 牙种植体高昂的费用使许多低收入患者无法接受治疗。

lemmas.def_zh: 花费；使失去, 值, 使花费
lemmas.def_en: be priced at

examples.en: The total cost of the renovation exceeded our initial budget by twenty percent.
examples.zh: 装修的总费用超出了我们最初预算的百分之二十。

lemmas.def_zh: 昂贵的，耗资巨大的；代价惨重的
lemmas.def_en: costing a lot of money; causing great loss, damage, or suffering

examples.en: The government abandoned the costly infrastructure project due to budget deficits.
examples.zh: 由于预算赤字，政府放弃了那个耗资巨大的基础设施项目。

examples.en: A brief lapse in concentration proved to be a costly mistake for the goalkeeper.
examples.zh: 片刻的走神最终被证明是守门员犯下的一个代价惨重的错误。

lemmas.def_zh: 没有成本的, 不需花钱的
lemmas.def_en: costing nothing

examples.en: Sharing a warm smile is virtually costless, yet it can brighten someone's entire day.
examples.zh: 展现温暖的微笑几乎无需成本，却能照亮别人的一整天。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 constare（站立在一起、固定、耗费），核心语义为‘为了获取或维持某物所必须付出的金钱、资源或代价’。
family_guide.core_distinction: costly 虽以 -ly 结尾但为形容词，既可指金钱上的昂贵，也常特指代价惨重、后果严重的（如 costly mistake）。

lemmas.def_zh: 记得，记起；记住，牢记；代向……致意
lemmas.def_en: to have in mind a past fact, event, or person; to not forget to do something

examples.en: Please remember to turn off the lights before leaving the office.
examples.zh: 离开办公室前请务必记得关灯。

examples.en: I still clearly remember meeting her for the first time in Paris.
examples.zh: 我依然清楚地记得第一次在巴黎遇见她的情景。

lemmas.def_zh: 记错
lemmas.def_en: remember incorrectly

examples.en: It is quite possible to misremember small details after many years have passed.
examples.zh: 多年过去后，很有可能会记错一些微小的细节。

lemmas.def_zh: 回想, 记忆, 纪念品, 记忆力, 问候, 致意
lemmas.def_en: the ability to recall past occurrences

examples.en: The town built a granite monument in remembrance of the fallen soldiers.
examples.zh: 该镇修建了一座花岗岩纪念碑，以缅怀牺牲的士兵。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语前缀 re-（回、重新）+ memor（留心的、有记忆的），核心逻辑是“将过去的事物或信息重新唤回意识中”。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 视野，风景；观点，看法；v. 看待，视为；观看，审视
lemmas.def_en: n. scenery, field of vision, or an opinion; v. to regard, consider, or inspect

examples.en: The hotel room offers a spectacular view of the bay.
examples.zh: 从这家酒店房间可以饱览海湾的壮丽景色。

examples.en: In my view, the project requires further evaluation before approval.
examples.zh: 在我看来，该项目在批准前需要进一步评估。

examples.en: Experts view the market fluctuation as a temporary setback.
examples.zh: 专家们将这次市场波动视为暂时的挫折。

lemmas.def_zh: n. （电视等节目的）收看；（房屋出售前或艺术品的）实地看样，预展
lemmas.def_en: the act of watching a broadcast; an occasion to inspect a property or exhibition

examples.en: We scheduled a viewing of the house for Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 我们预约了周六上午去看这套房子。

examples.en: Peak viewing hours usually coincide with family dinner time.
examples.zh: 黄金收视时段通常与家庭晚餐时间重合。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 观众，收看者；观察器，幻灯查看仪
lemmas.def_en: a person who watches television or visual media; an optical device for inspecting images

examples.en: Millions of viewers tuned in to watch the final match live.
examples.zh: 数以百万计的观众收看了决赛的现场直播。

examples.en: The documentary engaged viewers by presenting personal stories alongside factual data.
examples.zh: 该纪录片通过将个人故事与真实数据相结合，牢牢吸引了观众。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 视野，风景；观点，看法；v. 看待，视为；观看，审视
lemmas.def_en: n. scenery, field of vision, or an opinion; v. to regard, consider, or inspect

examples.en: The hotel room offers a spectacular view of the bay.
examples.zh: 从这家酒店房间可以饱览海湾的壮丽景色。

examples.en: In my view, the project requires further evaluation before approval.
examples.zh: 在我看来，该项目在批准前需要进一步评估。

examples.en: Experts view the market fluctuation as a temporary setback.
examples.zh: 专家们将这次市场波动视为暂时的挫折。

lemmas.def_zh: 看得见的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being viewed

examples.en: These private documents are only viewable by authorized personnel within the human resources department.
examples.zh: 这些私密文件仅供人力资源部门的授权人员查看。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 videre（看见），核心意象从物理层面的“用眼睛看（景象、视野）”引申至认知层面的“用心智看（看法、观点）”。
family_guide.core_distinction: view 侧重视野、景观或抽象观点；viewing 强调特定的观看行为、收视或看房/预展活动；viewer 专指观众或观察设备。

lemmas.def_zh: 眼睛, 视力, 看
lemmas.def_en: the organ of sight

examples.en: She rubbed her sleepy eye as the morning sunlight streamed through the curtains.
examples.zh: 当晨光透过窗帘洒进来时，她揉了揉惺忪的睡眼。

lemmas.def_zh: 小孔, 孔眼, 针眼, 金属圈
lemmas.def_en: a small hole (usually round and finished around the edges) in cloth or leather for the passage of a cord or hook or bar

examples.en: He carefully threaded the sturdy shoelace through the top metal eyelet of his boot.
examples.zh: 他小心翼翼地将结实的鞋带穿过靴子顶部的金属鞋眼。

lemmas.def_zh: 看, 注视
lemmas.def_en: look at

examples.en: She rubbed her sleepy eye as the morning sunlight streamed through the curtains.
examples.zh: 当晨光透过窗帘洒进来时，她揉了揉惺忪的睡眼。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 有……眼的；有眼状斑纹的（通常构成复合词）
lemmas.def_en: having an eye or eyes or eyelike features of a specified kind; often used in combination
lemmas.usage_note: 几乎总是用于构成复合词，如 blue-eyed（蓝眼睛的）、wide-eyed（天真的；睁大双眼的）。

examples.en: She gazed at the carnival attractions with wide-eyed wonder.
examples.zh: 她睁大好奇的双眼注视着嘉年华上的各种游乐设施。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语及古英语 ēage（眼睛），核心语义由视觉器官延伸至“注视、观察的目光”以及“判断力、孔眼”等抽象与具象概念。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词侧重指生理器官、注视的目光或审美鉴赏力；动词则侧重“仔细打量、审视”或“垂涎、盯上”，多带有警惕、探究或欲望色彩。

lemmas.def_zh: 介绍, 引见, 赠送, 提出, 呈现, 上演；举枪瞄准
lemmas.def_en: give an exhibition of to an interested audience

examples.en: All team members must be present at the annual strategy meeting tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 所有团队成员明天上午都必须出席年度战略会议。

lemmas.def_zh: 现在, 礼品, 瞄准
lemmas.def_en: the period of time that is happening now; any continuous stretch of time including the moment of speech

examples.en: All team members must be present at the annual strategy meeting tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 所有团队成员明天上午都必须出席年度战略会议。

lemmas.def_zh: 出席，到场；存在；仪态，气场；（机构、军事等力量的）驻扎或影响力
lemmas.def_en: the state or fact of being present; an impressive manner or aura; the existence or influence of a group or force in an area

examples.en: She had an extraordinary stage presence that captivated the audience the moment she stepped out.
examples.zh: 她具有非凡的舞台气场，一登台就俘获了全场观众。

examples.en: The company has expanded its online presence to reach younger consumers across the globe.
examples.zh: 该公司扩大了其线上业务覆盖面，以触达全球更年轻的消费群体。

lemmas.def_zh: 报告，演讲；展示；颁发
lemmas.def_en: a formal talk or display showing and explaining an idea or product; the act of giving an award

examples.en: His sales presentation was clear, engaging, and thoroughly convincing.
examples.zh: 他的销售演讲清晰、引人入胜且极具说服力。

lemmas.def_zh: 演讲人；主持人；颁奖嘉宾
lemmas.def_en: a person who introduces or hosts a show, or delivers a formal presentation

examples.en: The TV presenter smoothly guided the conversation through challenging topics.
examples.zh: 电视主持人流畅地引导谈话穿插于几个棘手的话题之间。

lemmas.def_zh: 陈述, 描写, 叙述, 呈现, 展示物, 描画, 画像, 赠送, 赠送物, 演出, 提出, 呈递
lemmas.def_en: an accusation of crime made by a grand jury on its own initiative

examples.en: The official presentment of the evidence took several hours in the grand courtroom.
examples.zh: 在大法庭上对证据的正式陈述持续了几个小时。

lemmas.def_zh: 现在的, 出席的
lemmas.def_en: temporal sense; intermediate between past and future; now existing or happening or in consideration

examples.en: All team members must be present at the annual strategy meeting tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 所有团队成员明天上午都必须出席年度战略会议。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 praeesse（prae- '在前面' + esse '存在'），核心语义是“置于眼前”，由此分化出空间上的“在场”、时间上的“当下（展现在眼前的时刻）”以及动作上的“呈现、端到面前”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意发音与重音：动词 present 读作 /prɪˈzent/（重音在后，表展现、赠予），而名词/形容词 present 读作 /ˈpreznt/（重音在前，表礼物、目前、在场的）。

lemmas.def_zh: 火；火灾；炉火；开火，枪炮声；激情，热情
lemmas.def_en: the state of combustion or flames; an instance of destructive burning; the shooting of weapons; strong emotion or passion

examples.en: The building was completely destroyed by a devastating fire.
examples.zh: 该建筑在一场破坏性极大的火灾中彻底被毁。

examples.en: The soldiers returned fire when attacked by insurgents.
examples.zh: 遭到叛军袭击时，士兵们开火还击。

lemmas.def_zh: 开火，射击；解雇；（陶器等的）烧制
lemmas.def_en: the act of discharging a gun; the dismissal of an employee; the process of baking ceramics in a kiln

examples.en: The sudden firing of the CEO caught investors off guard.
examples.zh: 首席执行官的突然被解雇让投资者措手不及。

examples.en: These delicate clay pots require a high-temperature firing.
examples.zh: 这些精致的黏土陶罐需要经过高温烧制。

lemmas.def_zh: 不发火, 失败
lemmas.def_en: an explosion that fails to occur

examples.en: The unexpected engine misfire caused the vintage sports car to jerk violently forward.
examples.zh: 发动机的意外不发火导致那辆老爷跑车猛烈向前颠簸。

lemmas.def_zh: 火；火灾；炉火；开火，枪炮声；激情，热情
lemmas.def_en: the state of combustion or flames; an instance of destructive burning; the shooting of weapons; strong emotion or passion

examples.en: The building was completely destroyed by a devastating fire.
examples.zh: 该建筑在一场破坏性极大的火灾中彻底被毁。

examples.en: The soldiers returned fire when attacked by insurgents.
examples.zh: 遭到叛军袭击时，士兵们开火还击。

lemmas.def_zh: 不发火, 失败
lemmas.def_en: fail to fire or detonate

examples.en: The company's new advertising campaign misfired completely and received widespread criticism.
examples.zh: 该公司的新广告宣传彻底失败，遭到了广泛的批评。

lemmas.def_zh: 炽热的, 热烈的, 暴躁的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by intense emotion

examples.en: The politician gave a fiery speech that ignited massive protests across the country.
examples.zh: 这位政客发表了一场激昂的演讲，引发了全国范围内的大规模抗议。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语词根，本义为自然界的“燃烧之火”，后由“火药点火发火”引申出射击与开火，再借由“扫地出门/如同被烈火清除”衍生出解雇，以及借由“如火般炙热”衍生出热情与激情。
family_guide.core_distinction: fire (n.) 常指具体的火焰、火灾或抽象的火力与激情；firing (n.) 为动名词转化而来的动作或事件名词，特指“开火射击”、“解雇裁员”或陶器的“烧制工艺”过程。

lemmas.def_zh: 食物，食品；（植物的）养料；精神食粮
lemmas.def_en: any nutritious substance that people or animals eat or drink, or that plants absorb, to maintain life and growth

examples.en: Eating a balanced diet rich in fresh, whole foods is essential for long-term health.
examples.zh: 摄入富含新鲜天然食物的均衡饮食对长期健康至关重要。

examples.en: The professor's lecture provided plenty of food for thought on environmental ethics.
examples.zh: 教授的讲座为环境伦理学提供了大量引人深思的内容。

lemmas.def_zh: 缺乏食物的
lemmas.def_en: being without food

examples.en: The hikers spent a cold, foodless night stranded on the mountain.
examples.zh: 徒步旅行者们在山上被困，度过了一个寒冷且缺乏食物的夜晚。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于原始印欧语根 *pa-（意为‘喂养、守护’，与 feed、foster 同源），核心指一切能维持生命、提供营养以供生长发育的物质。

lemmas.def_zh: 经历, 经验, 体验
lemmas.def_en: the accumulation of knowledge or skill that results from direct participation in events or activities

examples.en: She gained valuable practical experience while working for the tech firm.
examples.zh: 她在一家科技公司工作期间获得了宝贵的实践经验。

lemmas.def_zh: 经历, 经验, 体验
lemmas.def_en: go or live through

examples.en: She gained valuable practical experience while working for the tech firm.
examples.zh: 她在一家科技公司工作期间获得了宝贵的实践经验。

lemmas.def_zh: 经验的, 根据经验的, 经验上的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or resulting from experience

examples.en: The museum offers an experiential learning program designed for young students.
examples.zh: 该博物馆为年轻学生提供了一套体验式学习项目。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 experiri（尝试、检验），核心逻辑是通过亲身“经受考验与尝试”来获取见识与感知。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名动同形：名词既可表示抽象累积的“经验”（不可数），也可指具体的某次“经历”（可数）；动词则强调“亲身经历、体验或遭遇”。

lemmas.def_zh: 教育；培养；教导
lemmas.def_en: to provide with knowledge, skills, or training through formal instruction

examples.en: The campaign aims to educate the public about the risks of heart disease.
examples.zh: 该活动旨在向公众普及心脏病风险的相关常识。

examples.en: She was educated at one of the country's most prestigious universities.
examples.zh: 她毕业于该国最负盛名的一所大学。

lemmas.def_zh: 教育；培养；学历
lemmas.def_en: the process of receiving or giving systematic instruction, especially at a school or university

examples.en: Investing in early childhood education yields significant long-term social benefits.
examples.zh: 对幼儿教育的投资能带来显著的长期社会效益。

examples.en: He moved abroad to pursue higher education in computer science.
examples.zh: 他出国攻读计算机科学的高等学历。

lemmas.def_zh: 教育工作者；教师；教育家
lemmas.def_en: a person who provides instruction or education, such as a teacher or school administrator

examples.en: Experienced educators often adapt their teaching styles to meet diverse student needs.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的教育工作者往往会调整教学风格，以满足不同学生的需求。

examples.en: She is recognized internationally as an innovative educator and researcher.
examples.zh: 她被国际公认为一位具有创新精神的教育家与研究学者。

lemmas.def_zh: 教育家, 教育理论家
lemmas.def_en: a specialist in the theory of education

examples.en: The renowned educationist proposed innovative reforms to modernize the school curriculum.
examples.zh: 这位著名的教育家提出了对学校课程进行现代化改革的创新方案。

lemmas.def_zh: 教育家
lemmas.def_en: a specialist in the theory of education

examples.en: The prominent educationalist argued for curriculum reforms to encourage critical thinking in classrooms.
examples.zh: 这位著名教育家主张进行课程改革，以鼓励课堂上的批判性思维。

lemmas.def_zh: 教育的；有教育意义的
lemmas.def_en: relating to education, or providing useful knowledge or learning experiences

examples.en: The museum offers a wide variety of educational programs for young children.
examples.zh: 该博物馆为幼童提供了丰富多样的教育项目。

examples.en: Watching the historical documentary turned out to be both entertaining and educational.
examples.zh: 观看这部历史纪录片既富有趣味又很有教育意义。

lemmas.def_zh: 未受教育的, 无知的
lemmas.def_en: not having a good education

examples.en: The survey showed that many uneducated citizens were unaware of their rights.
examples.zh: 调查显示，许多未受过教育的公民并不了解自己的权利。

lemmas.def_zh: 教育的, 教育上的, 教育性的
lemmas.def_en: resulting in education

examples.en: Volunteering in the local community proved to be an educative journey.
examples.zh: 在当地社区做志愿者被证明是一段富有教育意义的历程。

lemmas.def_zh: 教育地, 教育上地, 有关教育地
lemmas.def_en: in an educational manner

examples.en: The new policy aims to support children from educationally disadvantaged backgrounds.
examples.zh: 新政策旨在资助那些来自教育条件较差背景的儿童。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 educere（e- 向外 + ducere 引导），核心意象为“向外引导”，引申为启发心智、传授知识技能的“教育与培养”。
family_guide.core_distinction: educational 意为“教育的、有教育意义的”（侧重事物性质）；而易混形容词 educated 意为“受过良好教育的、有教养的”（侧重人的状态）。

lemmas.def_zh: 新闻；消息，音讯
lemmas.def_en: newly received information about recent events, or reports of these in the media

examples.en: I have some exciting news to share with the rest of the team.
examples.zh: 我有一些令人振奋的好消息要和团队其他人分享。

examples.en: The news was so unexpected that everyone in the room fell silent.
examples.zh: 这则消息来得太突然，房间里的所有人都陷入了沉默。

lemmas.def_zh: 多新闻的，成话题的，爱闲话的( newsy的名词复数 )

examples.en: The local newsies gathered at the café every morning to trade gossip.
examples.zh: 那些爱聊闲话的人每天早晨都聚集在咖啡馆里交换八卦。

lemmas.def_zh: 多新闻的, 有报道价值的, 爱闲话的
lemmas.def_en: full of news

examples.en: My grandmother always sends long, newsy letters filled with family updates.
examples.zh: 祖母总是寄来内容丰富、长篇累牍的信，满是家里的近况。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自形容词 new（新）的中世纪复数借译形式，原指“新鲜事物”，后引申为“最新消息、新闻报道”，现代英语中固定作为不可数名词使用。

lemmas.def_zh: 在……之内；在……范围以内；不超过
lemmas.def_en: inside the limits, space, or time of; not beyond

examples.en: The package should arrive within three business days.
examples.zh: 包裹应在三个工作日内送达。

examples.en: Success is well within your reach if you stay focused.
examples.zh: 只要你保持专注，成功便完全触手可及。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语复合词，由 wið（在……近旁/并列）加 innan（在……内部）构成，核心语义始终为“处于某空间、时间、能力或规则的界限之内”。

lemmas.def_zh: 拯救，挽救；节省，节约；积攒；保存（数据）
lemmas.def_en: to keep safe from harm, loss, or ruin; to store or avoid spending money, time, or energy

examples.en: Doctors worked through the night to save the patient's life.
examples.zh: 医生们彻夜奋战以挽救这名患者的生命。

examples.en: We are trying to save enough money for a down payment on a house.
examples.zh: 我们正在努力攒够买房首付的钱。

lemmas.def_zh: 节约，节省；积蓄，存款（常用复数 savings）
lemmas.def_en: a reduction in the amount of time or money needed; money that has been kept and not spent

examples.en: Switching to public transport resulted in a significant saving on fuel.
examples.zh: 改乘公共交通显著节省了燃油开支。

examples.en: She invested all her life savings into opening a small bakery.
examples.zh: 她把毕生积蓄都投入到了开一家小烘焙坊中。

lemmas.def_zh: 救星，挽救者；救世主（首字母大写时特指耶稣基督）
lemmas.def_en: a person who rescues someone or something from danger, harm, or failure

examples.en: The new manager was hailed as the company's savior after turning profits around.
examples.zh: 新经理让公司扭亏为盈后，被誉为公司的救星。

examples.en: To the local community, the philanthropist was seen as an educational savior.
examples.zh: 在当地社区看来，这位慈善家堪称教育领域的救星。

lemmas.def_zh: 救助者, 救世主, 救星
lemmas.def_en: a teacher and prophet born in Bethlehem and active in Nazareth; his life and sermons form the basis for Christianity (circa 4 BC - AD 29)

examples.en: The fresh investment proved to be the saviour of the struggling company.
examples.zh: 这笔新投资成了这家陷入困境的公司的救星。

lemmas.def_zh: 节省...的器具, 节约装置, 省俭的人
lemmas.def_en: someone who saves something from danger or violence

examples.en: Using public transport instead of driving can be a great money saver.
examples.zh: 乘坐公共交通而不是开车可以帮你省下一大笔钱。

lemmas.def_zh: 未获救的,未获拯救的(尤指宗教上未赦免永劫的)
lemmas.def_en: in danger of the eternal punishment of Hell

examples.en: The power cut caused him to lose an hour of unsaved work.
examples.zh: 停电让他丢失了一个小时未保存的工作内容。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 salvus（安全、完好无损），核心语义是使人或事物免遭伤害、毁灭或损耗，由此引申出'拯救、保护'与'节省、保留'两条主要语义线。
family_guide.core_distinction: saving 强调动作本身带来的'节约'或保留下来的'积蓄'（常作复数 savings）；savior 则特指实施救援行动的'救星'或'救世主'。

lemmas.def_zh: 重大事件；公开活动；比赛项目
lemmas.def_en: a thing that happens, especially something important; a planned public or social occasion

examples.en: The annual technology conference is the biggest industry event of the year.
examples.zh: 一年一度的科技大会是本年度最重大的行业活动。

examples.en: In the unlikely event of an emergency, passengers should remain calm and follow the crew's instructions.
examples.zh: 万一发生紧急情况，乘客应保持冷静并听从乘务人员的指示。

lemmas.def_zh: 被期望但未实现的事, 被期望但结果使人扫兴的事
lemmas.def_en: an anticipated event that turns out to be far less significant than was expected

examples.en: The much-hyped product launch turned out to be a complete nonevent.
examples.zh: 那场大肆炒作的新品发布会结果让人大失所望，毫无看点。

lemmas.def_zh: 变故多的, 多事的, 重要的
lemmas.def_en: full of events or incidents

examples.en: After an eventful journey full of unexpected delays, we finally arrived home.
examples.zh: 经历了一段充满意外延误、多灾多难的旅程后，我们终于到家了。

lemmas.def_zh: 太平无事的, 平静无事的
lemmas.def_en: marked by no noteworthy or significant events

examples.en: We had an uneventful flight and landed safely ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 我们的飞行一路平稳无事，并且提前安全降落。

lemmas.def_zh: 太平无事地
lemmas.def_en: in an uneventful manner

examples.en: The rest of the quiet afternoon passed completely uneventfully at the office.
examples.zh: 在办公室里，那个宁静下午的剩余时间极其平淡地过去了。

lemmas.def_zh: 结果为, 终于发生
lemmas.def_en: come out in the end

examples.en: The prolonged negotiations between the companies did not eventuate in a final agreement.
examples.zh: 两家公司之间旷日持久的谈判最终并未促成协议的达成。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 evenire（e- 向外 + venire 来），字面意为“浮现出来、发生的事情”，引申为重要事件、活动或结果。

lemmas.def_zh: 社会的, 群居的, 社交的
lemmas.def_en: relating to human society and its members

examples.en: The department is hosting a holiday social for staff members this Friday.
examples.zh: 该部门将于本周五为全体员工举办一场节日联欢会。

lemmas.def_zh: 非社会的, 厌恶社交的, 不喜交际的, 孤僻的
lemmas.def_en: not seeking or given to association; being or living without companions

examples.en: He hated working unsocial hours because it ruined his family life.
examples.zh: 他讨厌在非正常工作时间加班，因为这毁了他的家庭生活。

lemmas.def_zh: 在社交上；在社会层面上
lemmas.def_en: in a way that relates to society or friendly social interaction

examples.en: He often feels socially awkward when meeting people for the first time.
examples.zh: 他在初次见人时往往会觉得社交局促、不自在。

examples.en: The company strives to be both environmentally and socially responsible.
examples.zh: 该公司努力在环境和社会两个层面上都履行好责任。

lemmas.def_zh: 联欢会
lemmas.def_en: a party of people assembled to promote sociability and communal activity

examples.en: The department is hosting a holiday social for staff members this Friday.
examples.zh: 该部门将于本周五为全体员工举办一场节日联欢会。

lemmas.def_zh: 好交际, 社交性, 社交行为, 社会性, 群居性
lemmas.def_en: the tendency to associate with others and to form social groups

examples.en: Humans naturally develop sociality as they interact regularly with their peers.
examples.zh: 人类在与同伴的日常互动中自然而然地发展出了社交性。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 socius（同伴、伙伴），核心概念是“结伴与群聚”，引申为与人际相处、社会结构及联谊活动相关的各种属性。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意 social 作名词时专指“联谊聚会”；作形容词时兼指宏观的“社会的”与微观的“社交的/爱交际的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 价格，价钱；代价 (n.)；给……定价，标价 (v.)
lemmas.def_en: the amount of money required to buy something, or an unwelcome cost (n.); to set the price of something (v.)

examples.en: The company priced its new laptop competitively to attract college students.
examples.zh: 该公司为其新款笔记本电脑制定了极具竞争力的价格，以吸引大学生。

examples.en: He achieved career success, but at the price of his personal relationships.
examples.zh: 他获得了事业上的成功，但却以牺牲人际关系为代价。

lemmas.def_zh: 价格，价钱；代价 (n.)；给……定价，标价 (v.)
lemmas.def_en: the amount of money required to buy something, or an unwelcome cost (n.); to set the price of something (v.)

examples.en: The company priced its new laptop competitively to attract college students.
examples.zh: 该公司为其新款笔记本电脑制定了极具竞争力的价格，以吸引大学生。

examples.en: He achieved career success, but at the price of his personal relationships.
examples.zh: 他获得了事业上的成功，但却以牺牲人际关系为代价。

lemmas.def_zh: 无价的；极其珍贵的；极具价值的
lemmas.def_en: having a value beyond any price; extremely valuable or precious

examples.en: The museum houses a priceless collection of ancient Roman coins.
examples.zh: 这家博物馆收藏了一批极其珍贵的古罗马钱币。

lemmas.def_zh: 昂贵的, 价格高的
lemmas.def_en: having a high price

examples.en: The downtown restaurants are quite pricey, so we chose a cheaper café.
examples.zh: 市中心的餐馆相当昂贵，所以我们选了一家更便宜的咖啡馆。

lemmas.def_zh: 昂贵的, 价格高的
lemmas.def_en: having a high price

examples.en: The hotel was undeniably comfortable, but the restaurant turned out to be quite pricy.
examples.zh: 这家酒店确实很舒服，但餐厅的价格却相当昂贵。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 pretium（价值、报酬、代价），核心概念始终围绕事物在经济或抽象意义上‘衡量出的价值或付出的代价’展开。
family_guide.core_distinction: priceless 中的后缀 -less 表示‘无法用价格衡量的’，指极其珍贵、无价，切勿望文生义误当作‘毫无价值’（valueless/worthless）。

lemmas.def_zh: 赞同；同意；意见一致；商定
lemmas.def_en: to have the same opinion, or to accept a proposal or condition

examples.en: I completely agree with your assessment of the current market trends.
examples.zh: 我完全赞同你对当前市场趋势的评估。

examples.en: After hours of discussion, they finally agreed on a date for the meeting.
examples.zh: 经过数小时的讨论，他们终于敲定了开会日期。

lemmas.def_zh: 协议；协定；一致；同意
lemmas.def_en: a decision or arrangement between people or groups, or the state of sharing the same opinion

examples.en: The two companies signed a binding agreement to merge operations.
examples.zh: 两家公司签署了一份具有法律约束力的合并协议。

examples.en: We are in total agreement about the importance of early childhood education.
examples.zh: 在幼儿教育的重要性这一问题上，我们的意见完全一致。

lemmas.def_zh: 适合；一致
lemmas.def_en: pleasantness resulting from agreeable conditions

examples.en: Her natural agreeableness made her an extremely popular member of the team.
examples.zh: 她天生的随和脾气使她成为团队中极其受欢迎的一员。

lemmas.def_zh: 令人愉快的, 同意的
lemmas.def_en: conforming to your own liking or feelings or nature; ; ; - Disraeli

examples.en: We spent an agreeable afternoon walking through the sunlit botanical gardens.
examples.zh: 我们在阳光普照的植物园里漫步，度过了一个惬意的下午。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 gratus（令人愉悦的），经古法语演变为“让人称心如意”，进而引申为双方在意志或意见上“感到满意、取得一致、赞同”。
family_guide.core_distinction: agree 是动词动作（表示赞同、达成共识），agreement 是其名词形式（既可指抽象的“一致、赞同”，也可指具象的“协议、合同”）。

lemmas.def_zh: 签名, 打手势表达；签名
lemmas.def_en: mark with one's signature; write one's name (on)

examples.en: A sudden drop in temperature is often a sign of incoming rain.
examples.zh: 气温骤降往往是即将来雨的征兆。

lemmas.def_en: denote or connote
lemmas.def_zh: v. 表示，意味着；具有重要性

examples.en: A nod of the head usually signifies agreement.
examples.zh: 点头通常表示赞同。

lemmas.def_zh: 符号, 招牌, 征兆, 正负号, 手势
lemmas.def_en: a perceptible indication of something not immediately apparent (as a visible clue that something has happened)

examples.en: A sudden drop in temperature is often a sign of incoming rain.
examples.zh: 气温骤降往往是即将来雨的征兆。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 签署, 签字
lemmas.def_en: language expressed by visible hand gestures

examples.en: The official signing of the trade agreement is scheduled for tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 该贸易协议的正式签署定于明天上午进行。

lemmas.def_en: your name written in your own handwriting
lemmas.def_zh: 签名，署名；特色，标志

examples.en: He added his signature to the contract, finalizing the partnership.
examples.zh: 他在合同上签了字，从而敲定了这一合作。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being significant
lemmas.def_zh: 重要性, 意义, 意味

examples.en: Scientists are still trying to understand the historical significance of this discovery.
examples.zh: 科学家们仍在试图理解这一发现的历史重要性。

lemmas.def_zh: 签名者, 使用手势语者
lemmas.def_en: someone who can use sign language to communicate

examples.en: Each signer of the petition must provide a valid email address.
examples.zh: 请愿书的每位签署人都必须提供有效的电子邮件地址。

lemmas.def_en: the phonological or orthographic sound or appearance of a word that can be used to describe or identify something
lemmas.def_zh: 信号物

examples.en: In modern semiotics, the spoken word serves as a primary cultural signifier.
examples.zh: 在现代符号学中，口头语言充当了主要的文化能指。

lemmas.def_zh: 含义, 意义, 表示
lemmas.def_en: the message that is intended or expressed or signified

examples.en: Scholars debated the subtle signification of this ancient symbol found on the stone monument.
examples.zh: 学者们争论着在石碑上发现的这个古老符号的微妙含义。

lemmas.def_zh: 重大的；显著的；有意义的
lemmas.def_en: sufficiently great or important to be worthy of attention; noteworthy

examples.en: There has been a significant increase in online sales over the past year.
examples.zh: 过去一年中，线上销售额出现了显著增长。

examples.en: Her research made a significant contribution to the field of neuroscience.
examples.zh: 她的研究对神经科学领域做出了重大贡献。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 无符号的, 未签名的
lemmas.def_en: lacking a signature

examples.en: The editor refused to publish the unsigned letter received in the mail.
examples.zh: 编辑拒绝发表邮寄过来的那封未签名的信件。

lemmas.def_zh: 无足轻重的, 无意义的, 不足道的
lemmas.def_en: attributable to chance

examples.en: The clinical trial showed statistically nonsignificant differences between the two treatment groups.
examples.zh: 临床试验显示两个治疗组之间的差异在统计学上微不足道。

lemmas.def_zh: 显著地；相当大程度上；意味深长地
lemmas.def_en: in a sufficiently great or important way; in a way that suggests a special meaning

examples.en: The new treatment has significantly reduced the recovery time for patients.
examples.zh: 新疗法显著缩短了患者的康复时间。

examples.en: He paused and looked significantly at his partner before answering the question.
examples.zh: 在回答问题前，他停顿了一下，意味深长地看了搭档一眼。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 signum（标记、记号），核心语义从“制作记号/以记号表达”衍生出“签名确认”、“标志征兆”以及“签约聘用”等含义。
family_guide.core_distinction: sign (n.) 指静态的“标记、迹象或招牌”；signing (n.) 常指动态的“签署行为/仪式”或体育/演艺界的“新签约成员”。

lemmas.def_zh: 日期, 约会, 枣椰树
lemmas.def_en: the specified day of the month

examples.en: Please check the expiration date printed on the bottom of the carton.
examples.zh: 请检查印在纸箱底部的有效日期。

lemmas.def_zh: 约会, 定日期；注明日期, 过时
lemmas.def_en: go on a date with

examples.en: Please check the expiration date printed on the bottom of the carton.
examples.zh: 请检查印在纸箱底部的有效日期。

lemmas.def_zh: 未标日期的
lemmas.def_en: not bearing a date

examples.en: Police found an undated diary entry that provided clues about the disappearance.
examples.zh: 警方发现了一篇未注明明日期的日记，提供了失踪线索。

lemmas.def_zh: 无日期的, 无限期的, 远古的, 经住时间考验的, 无伴侣的
lemmas.def_en: having no known beginning and presumably no end

examples.en: Her classic black dress possesses a dateless elegance that never fades.
examples.zh: 她那件经典的黑色连衣裙具有永不过时的优雅。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 data littera（给出的信函），原指写信落款的“给定时间与地点”，后核心引申为特定的“日历时间”，再衍生出约定时间的“约会”以及“确定年代、过时”等含义。
family_guide.core_distinction: 该词为名动同形词，均共享“时间/日期”与“浪漫约会”两条核心语义主线。

lemmas.def_zh: 社区；社群；团体；界
lemmas.def_en: a group of people living in the same place or sharing common interests, identity, or characteristics

examples.en: The new sports center has received strong support from the local community.
examples.zh: 新建体育中心得到了当地社区的大力支持。

examples.en: Participating in neighborhood events fosters a strong sense of community.
examples.zh: 参与社区活动有助于培养强烈的归属感。

lemmas.def_zh: 公有的, 公社的
lemmas.def_en: for or by a group rather than individuals; - Paul Roche

examples.en: Students share a communal kitchen and living area in the university dormitory.
examples.zh: 学生们在大学宿舍里共用一个公共厨房和起居区。

lemmas.def_zh: 社区地；公有地
lemmas.def_en: by a group of people rather than an individual

examples.en: the mills were owned communally

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 communis（共同的、共享的），核心概念是由共同利益、地理位置或身份认同而联结在一起的群体。

lemmas.def_zh: 释放, 解除, 放松, 豁免, 免除, 发布, 放弃, 让与
lemmas.def_en: release, as from one's grip

examples.en: The studio plans to release the new documentary worldwide next Friday.
examples.zh: 该工作室计划下周五在全球范围内发布这部新纪录片。

lemmas.def_zh: 释放, 发泄, 豁免, 发行, 释放证书；发布
lemmas.def_en: merchandise issued for sale or public showing (especially a record or film)

examples.en: The studio plans to release the new documentary worldwide next Friday.
examples.zh: 该工作室计划下周五在全球范围内发布这部新纪录片。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 laxare（放松、解开），经由古法语演变而来，核心逻辑为“解除束缚，使受约束之人或物恢复自由”，由此引申出人身的释放、情绪的宣泄、信息的公开及产品的发售。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词与名词形式同形同音（均读作 /rɪˈliːs/），语义高度对应，均覆盖“释放、发布、发泄”等核心义项。

lemmas.def_zh: 类型, 样式, 典型, 榜样, 标志, 符号, 型, 式
lemmas.def_en: a subdivision of a particular kind of thing

examples.en: Which type of accommodation do you prefer when traveling abroad?
examples.zh: 你出国旅行时更喜欢哪种类型的住宿？

lemmas.def_zh: 打字员
lemmas.def_en: someone paid to operate a typewriter

examples.en: The experienced typist can transcribe sixty words per minute without any errors.
examples.zh: 这位经验丰富的打字员每分钟可以准确无误地录入六十个词。

lemmas.def_zh: 打字；作为代表, 测定类型, 用打字机打
lemmas.def_en: write by means of a keyboard with types

examples.en: Which type of accommodation do you prefer when traveling abroad?
examples.zh: 你出国旅行时更喜欢哪种类型的住宿？

lemmas.def_zh: 代表, 象征, 为...之典型
lemmas.def_en: embody the essential characteristics of or be a typical example of

examples.en: These stone cottages typify the traditional architecture of the rural region.
examples.zh: 这些石屋是该乡村地区传统建筑风格的典型代表。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 典型的, 正规的
lemmas.def_en: being or serving as an illustration of a type

examples.en: The soil sample represents a typic profile commonly found in this valley.
examples.zh: 该土壤样本代表了该山谷中常见的典型剖面特征。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 typos（印记、模型），核心逻辑从“印记模版”引申出“具有共同特征的类型”，后随印刷术发展出“铅字/字样”，再进一步衍生出动词“打字”。

lemmas.def_zh: 报告, 解释, 估价, 理由, 利润, 算账, 帐目
lemmas.def_en: a record or narrative description of past events

examples.en: She opened a new savings account at the local bank yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天在当地银行开了一个新的储蓄账户。

lemmas.def_zh: 问责制，责任，义务
lemmas.def_en: the fact or condition of being accountable; responsibility

examples.en: The new regulations aim to improve financial transparency and corporate accountability.
examples.zh: 新规旨在提高财务透明度和企业问责机制。

lemmas.def_zh: 会计，会计师
lemmas.def_en: a person whose job is to keep or inspect financial accounts

examples.en: Small business owners often hire a certified accountant to handle tax returns.
examples.zh: 小型企业主通常会聘请执业会计师来处理税务申报。

lemmas.def_zh: 会计工作, 会计学
lemmas.def_en: the occupation of maintaining and auditing records and preparing financial reports for a business

examples.en: He earned a degree in accountancy before joining a major financial firm.
examples.zh: 在加入一家大型金融公司之前，他获得了会计学学位。

lemmas.def_zh: 报帐, 解释, 导致, 报偿, 占, 杀死；认为
lemmas.def_en: be the sole or primary factor in the existence, acquisition, supply, or disposal of something

examples.en: She opened a new savings account at the local bank yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天在当地银行开了一个新的储蓄账户。

lemmas.def_zh: 负有责任的，有解释义务的
lemmas.def_en: required or expected to justify actions or decisions; responsible

examples.en: Elected officials should be held accountable to the public.
examples.zh: 民选官员应当对公众负责。

lemmas.def_zh: 无法解释的, 无责任的
lemmas.def_en: not to be accounted for or explained

examples.en: For some unaccountable reason, the train came to a sudden halt.
examples.zh: 出于某种无法解释的原因，火车突然停了下来。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语与拉丁语词根 computare（计算、清点），由'记账、算账'延伸至'陈述、解释'，并进一步引申出'为结果负责'的责任含义。
family_guide.core_distinction: accountant 指具体的'会计人员'，而 accountability 指抽象的'问责机制与责任承担'。

lemmas.def_zh: 大学；综合性高等学府
lemmas.def_en: a high-level educational institution where students study for degrees and academic research is done

examples.en: After finishing high school, she went to university to study modern languages.
examples.zh: 高中毕业后，她上了大学学习现代语言。

examples.en: The university is widely recognized for its cutting-edge medical research.
examples.zh: 这所大学因其前沿的医学研究而享誉广泛。
