lemmas.def_zh: 是，对，好啊（口语非正式表达）
lemmas.def_en: used as an informal equivalent of 'yes' to express agreement, confirmation, or compliance

examples.en: "Are you coming with us tonight?" "Yeah, sounds great!"
examples.zh: “你今晚和我们一起去吗？”“去啊，听起来很棒！”

examples.en: "That was a tough exam." "Yeah, tell me about it."
examples.zh: “那场考试可真难。”“就是说啊，太难了。”

family_guide.root_logic: 源于副词 yes 在日常口语中的弱化与随意变体，用于非正式场合表达肯定、同意或随声附和。

lemmas.def_zh: 很可能；大概；几乎肯定
lemmas.def_en: almost certainly; as is likely to happen or be true

examples.en: It will probably rain this afternoon, so don't forget to take an umbrella.
examples.zh: 今天下午很可能会下雨，所以别忘了带伞。

examples.en: This is probably the best cup of coffee I have ever had.
examples.zh: 这大概是我喝过的最好喝的一杯咖啡了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语词根 prob-（检验、证明），演变为“经得起验证的、合理的”，最终派生出表示“大概、极有可能”的副词含义。
family_guide.core_distinction: 常与 possibly 区分：probably 表示可能性很大（通常大于50%），possibly 仅表示有微弱可能（也许、或许）。

lemmas.def_zh: 美；美丽；美人；绝妙之处
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being pleasing to the senses or mind; an attractive feature or advantage

examples.en: The sheer beauty of the landscape took her breath away.
examples.zh: 大自然绝美纯粹的风光令她屏息凝神。

examples.en: The beauty of this solution is its absolute simplicity.
examples.zh: 这个解决方案的绝妙之处在于其极致的简洁。

lemmas.def_zh: 美化
lemmas.def_en: the act of making something more beautiful

examples.en: The town council launched a beautification project to plant colorful flowers along Main Street.
examples.zh: 镇议会发起了一项美化工程，在主街沿途种植色彩缤纷的花卉。

lemmas.def_zh: 美容师
lemmas.def_en: someone who works in a beauty parlor

examples.en: The experienced beautician recommended a gentle skincare routine for her sensitive skin.
examples.zh: 这位经验丰富的美容师为她的敏感肌推荐了一套温和的护肤流程。

lemmas.def_zh: 美化者

examples.en: Trees serve as a natural beautifier for noisy urban streetscapes.
examples.zh: 树木是喧闹城市街景的天然美化物。

lemmas.def_zh: 美丽的；出色的；美好的
lemmas.def_en: pleasing the senses or mind aesthetically; very good or skillfully done

examples.en: She was wearing a beautiful handcrafted necklace.
examples.zh: 她戴着一条精美的手工项链。

examples.en: The striker scored with a beautiful curled shot into the top corner.
examples.zh: 前锋用一记漂亮的弧线球直挂死角破门。

lemmas.def_zh: 美丽的
lemmas.def_en: (poetic )beautiful, especially to the sight

examples.en: The morning sun illuminated the beauteous landscape of the quiet mountain valley.
examples.zh: 清晨的阳光照亮了幽静山谷的美丽景色。

lemmas.def_zh: 优美地；出色地；极其顺利地
lemmas.def_en: in a way that pleases the senses; very well or successfully

examples.en: The old apartment has been beautifully restored to its former glory.
examples.zh: 这栋老公寓经过精美修复，重现了往日的光彩。

examples.en: Everything worked out beautifully in the end.
examples.zh: 最终一切都进展得极为顺利。

lemmas.def_zh: 美化, 变美, 修饰
lemmas.def_en: make more beautiful

examples.en: Volunteers gathered on Saturday to plant colorful flowers and beautify the park.
examples.zh: 志愿者们周六集合种植鲜艳的花朵以美化公园。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 bellus（美丽、迷人），核心概念始终围绕视觉、听觉或心灵上的“愉悦与美感”，由此延伸出指代美好特质的名词、形容词及副词。

lemmas.def_zh: v. 拜访，探望；参观，游览；n. 访问，拜访；参观，逗留
lemmas.def_en: to go to see someone socially or go to a place; an act of going to see a person or place

examples.en: We decided to visit an art gallery while we were in Paris.
examples.zh: 在巴黎期间，我们决定去参观一家美术馆。

examples.en: The doctor paid a home visit to the elderly patient.
examples.zh: 医生对那位高龄患者进行了上门出诊探视。

lemmas.def_zh: v. 拜访，探望；参观，游览；n. 访问，拜访；参观，逗留
lemmas.def_en: to go to see someone socially or go to a place; an act of going to see a person or place

examples.en: We decided to visit an art gallery while we were in Paris.
examples.zh: 在巴黎期间，我们决定去参观一家美术馆。

examples.en: The doctor paid a home visit to the elderly patient.
examples.zh: 医生对那位高龄患者进行了上门出诊探视。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 访问者，来客；游客，参观者
lemmas.def_en: a person who visits someone or goes to see a place, especially for sightseeing

examples.en: The museum attracts millions of foreign visitors every year.
examples.zh: 该博物馆每年吸引数以百万计的外国游客。

lemmas.def_zh: 访问, 探望, 视察
lemmas.def_en: an annoying or frustrating or catastrophic event

examples.en: The separated father was granted weekly visitation rights with his young daughter.
examples.zh: 分居的父亲获得了每周探望年幼女儿的权利。

lemmas.def_zh: 贵宾, 幽魂
lemmas.def_en: someone who visits

examples.en: A rare migratory bird became a welcome visitant to our local sanctuary.
examples.zh: 一只稀有的候鸟成了我们当地保护区的稀客。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 videre（看）的意向体 visere（前去查看、探视），核心语义演变为“亲自前往某地或找某人进行会面、观察或逗留”。
family_guide.core_distinction: visit 兼具动词与名词形式，指访问行为或逗留期；visitor 为施事名词后缀 -or 派生词，专指“来访者”或“游客”。

lemmas.def_zh: 经济；经济体制；节约
lemmas.def_en: the system of trade and industry by which wealth is made and used; the careful use of resources

examples.en: Tourism plays a vital role in boosting the local economy.
examples.zh: 旅游业在促进当地经济发展中起着至关重要的作用。

examples.en: She buys groceries in bulk for reasons of economy.
examples.zh: 出于节约的考虑，她总是成批购买食品杂货。

lemmas.def_zh: 经济学家
lemmas.def_en: a specialist who studies, analyzes, and predicts economic trends

examples.en: Most economists predict that interest rates will continue to fall this year.
examples.zh: 大多数经济学家预测今年利率将继续下降。

lemmas.def_zh: 节约者, 节约装置
lemmas.def_en: a frugal person who limits spending and avoids waste

examples.en: Installing a modern boiler economizer significantly reduced the factory's fuel consumption.
examples.zh: 安装现代锅炉省煤器显著降低了工厂的燃料消耗。

lemmas.def_zh: 经济的；经济学的；有利可图的
lemmas.def_en: relating to the trade, industry, or money of a country; financially viable

examples.en: The government is implementing new economic reforms to curb inflation.
examples.zh: 政府正在推行新的经济改革以抑制通货膨胀。

lemmas.def_zh: 节约的；省钱的；经济实惠的
lemmas.def_en: not using a lot of fuel, money, or other resources; cost-effective

examples.en: Hybrid cars are an economical choice for city commuters.
examples.zh: 混合动力汽车对城市通勤者而言是一个经济实惠的选择。

lemmas.def_zh: 不经济的, 浪费的
lemmas.def_en: wasteful of resources

examples.en: Operating the old coal plant has become uneconomic compared to solar energy.
examples.zh: 与太阳能相比，运行这座旧燃煤电厂已经变得很不经济。

lemmas.def_zh: 不经济的, 浪费的
lemmas.def_en: inefficient in use of time and effort and materials

examples.en: Driving an old, fuel-heavy truck to work every day is simply uneconomical.
examples.zh: 每天开一辆耗油的老旧卡车上班实在太不划算了。

lemmas.def_zh: 在经济上；节俭地，合算地
lemmas.def_en: in a way that relates to the economy; in a way that avoids waste

examples.en: The island has become economically dependent on foreign aid.
examples.zh: 该岛在经济上已经严重依赖外国援助。

examples.en: The program was designed to use the allocated budget economically.
examples.zh: 该项目旨在精打细算地使用分配的预算。

lemmas.def_zh: 节约, 节省, 有效地利用
lemmas.def_en: use cautiously and frugally

examples.en: We need to economize on electricity by turning off lights during the day.
examples.zh: 我们需要在白天关灯，以此来节省用电。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 oikonomia（oikos 家 + nemein 管理），原指'家政管理'，后引申为整个社会的资源配置体系（经济）以及对资源的高效利用（节约）。
family_guide.core_distinction: economic 指'与宏观经济或经济学相关的'；economical 则专指'节约的、划算的、省钱省资源的'。

lemmas.def_zh: 结婚；娶；嫁；为……主持婚礼
lemmas.def_en: to become legally joined to someone as husband or wife; to perform a marriage ceremony

examples.en: They decided to marry after dating for nearly seven years.
examples.zh: 在交往了将近七年后，他们决定结婚。

examples.en: The local priest will marry the young couple this Saturday.
examples.zh: 当地的神父将于本周六为这对年轻夫妇主持婚礼。

lemmas.def_zh: 婚姻；婚姻关系；婚礼
lemmas.def_en: the legal or formal union of two people as partners in a relationship

examples.en: Mutual trust and open communication are the keys to a successful marriage.
examples.zh: 相互信任与坦诚沟通是婚姻美满的关键。

examples.en: Their marriage took place in a small village church.
examples.zh: 他们的婚礼在一座乡村小教堂举行。

lemmas.def_zh: 未婚的, 单身的
lemmas.def_en: not married or related to the unmarried state

examples.en: He remained unmarried for most of his life, focusing entirely on his career.
examples.zh: 他大半辈子都保持单身，全心投入到事业中。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 maritus（丈夫、配偶）及其动词 maritare，核心语义指男女在法律、宗教或世俗约定下结合为伴侣。
family_guide.core_distinction: marry 为核心动词，表示结婚的动作或主持结合；marriage 为派生名词，表示婚姻制度、婚姻关系或婚礼仪式。

lemmas.def_zh: 忍受，承受；具有，带有；生育，结出（果实）
lemmas.def_en: to carry, endure, or support; to give birth to or produce

examples.en: She could hardly bear the pain of losing her best friend.
examples.zh: 她几乎无法承受失去挚友的痛苦。

examples.en: The orchard bears sweet apples every autumn.
examples.zh: 这座果园每年秋天都会结出甘甜的苹果。

lemmas.def_zh: 承受，承担（bear的过去分词）；由……携带/传播的
lemmas.def_en: past participle of bear; carried, sustained, or transmitted

examples.en: All additional travel expenses will be borne by the company.
examples.zh: 所有额外的差旅费用将全部由公司承担。

examples.en: Water-borne pathogens can spread rapidly after heavy flooding.
examples.zh: 暴雨洪水过后，水传播的病原体会迅速扩散。

lemmas.def_zh: [adj.] 出生的；天生的；[n.] 出生者，具有某种身份降生的人（常用于复合词）
lemmas.def_en: brought into existence by birth; having a natural talent or inclination; (as noun) one born

examples.en: She was born in a quiet village and grew into a born leader.
examples.zh: 她出生在一个宁静的村庄，后来成为了一位天生的领袖。

examples.en: In ancient tradition, special privileges were granted to the first-born.
examples.zh: 在古代传统中，头生子（头胎）享有特殊的特权。

lemmas.def_zh: 举止，风度；关系，影响；方位，方向；轴承
lemmas.def_en: manner or posture; relation or relevance; direction or position

examples.en: His modest bearing and calm demeanor earned the respect of his peers.
examples.zh: 他谦逊的风度和平静的举止赢得了同侪的尊敬。

examples.en: Recent economic changes have a direct bearing on our investment strategy.
examples.zh: 近期的经济变化直接关系到我们的投资策略。

lemmas.def_zh: 带信人, 票据持有人, 搬运者
lemmas.def_en: someone whose employment involves carrying something

examples.en: Please hand this confidential package directly to the bearer of the official letter.
examples.zh: 请将这个机密包裹直接交给持公函的人。

lemmas.def_zh: [adj.] 出生的；天生的；[n.] 出生者，具有某种身份降生的人（常用于复合词）
lemmas.def_en: brought into existence by birth; having a natural talent or inclination; (as noun) one born

examples.en: She was born in a quiet village and grew into a born leader.
examples.zh: 她出生在一个宁静的村庄，后来成为了一位天生的领袖。

examples.en: In ancient tradition, special privileges were granted to the first-born.
examples.zh: 在古代传统中，头生子（头胎）享有特殊的特权。

lemmas.def_zh: 无法忍受的, 承受不住的
lemmas.def_en: incapable of being put up with

examples.en: The summer heat in this tiny room without air conditioning became completely unbearable.
examples.zh: 在这个没有空调的小房间里，夏天的酷热让人完全无法忍受。

lemmas.def_zh: 未诞生的, 未来的, 在胎内的
lemmas.def_en: not yet brought into existence

examples.en: Expectant mothers must eat well to ensure the health of their unborn child.
examples.zh: 准妈妈必须健康饮食，以确保腹中胎儿的发育健康。

lemmas.def_zh: 可忍受的, 支承得住的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being borne though unpleasant

examples.en: A cool breeze from the ocean made the afternoon heat much more bearable.
examples.zh: 海上吹来的凉风让午后的酷暑变得好受多了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 beran，核心意象为“负重、承载”，后引申出心理上的“承受/忍耐”、物理上的“携带/具有”，以及身体孕育并产出生命（即“生育/出生”）。
family_guide.core_distinction: born 专用于生命出生的被动态与形容词/名词化（“出生/天生的”）；borne 则是 bear 的通用过去分词，用于表达“承担、承受、由……携带（传播）”。

lemmas.def_zh: 电话, 受话器, 耳机
lemmas.def_en: electronic equipment that converts sound into electrical signals that can be transmitted over distances and then converts received signals back into sounds

examples.en: Please leave your mobile phone in your bag during the final examination period.
examples.zh: 期末考试期间，请将手机放在书包里。

lemmas.def_zh: 语音学, 语音体系, 表音拼法
lemmas.def_en: the branch of acoustics concerned with speech processes including its production and perception and acoustic analysis

examples.en: Understanding the principles of phonetics can greatly improve your ability to pronounce foreign words accurately.
examples.zh: 理解语音学原理可以极大地提高你准确发音外语单词的能力。

lemmas.def_zh: 发声
lemmas.def_en: the sound made by the vibration of vocal folds modified by the resonance of the vocal tract

examples.en: The speech therapist helped the patient improve phonation through daily vocal exercises.
examples.zh: 言语治疗师通过日常发声练习帮助患者改善发声。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 色情电话；电话访谈；网络电话
lemmas.def_en: the person initiating a telephone call

examples.en: The radio host took a quick phoner with a famous director yesterday morning.
examples.zh: 昨天上午，电台主持人对一位著名导演进行了简短的电话访谈。

lemmas.def_zh: 打电话给；打电话
lemmas.def_en: get or try to get into communication (with someone) by telephone

examples.en: Please leave your mobile phone in your bag during the final examination period.
examples.zh: 期末考试期间，请将手机放在书包里。

lemmas.def_zh: 语音的, 语音学的, 表示语音的, 语音差异的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to speech sounds

examples.en: The dictionary provides phonetic transcriptions to help learners pronounce difficult words correctly.
examples.zh: 这本词典提供了音标转写，以帮助学习者正确拼读难词。

lemmas.def_zh: 音的, 语音的, 语音学的, 有声的, 声学的, 浊音的
lemmas.def_en: pertaining to the phonic method of teaching reading

examples.en: The teacher used interactive phonic games to help young children recognize letter sounds.
examples.zh: 老师通过互动语音游戏帮助幼儿辨识字母发音。

lemmas.def_zh: 按照发音地, 语音学上
lemmas.def_en: by phonetics

examples.en: phonetically realized

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 phonē（声音、话音），原本是 telephone（远距离传声）的缩写，后独立成词，既作名词指电话设备，也引申作动词表示“打电话”。
family_guide.core_distinction: phone 作名词主要指电话或手机等通话设备；作动词则指“致电、打电话”的动作。

lemmas.def_zh: 攻击, 抨击, 动手干；攻击
lemmas.def_en: launch an attack or assault on; begin hostilities or start warfare with

examples.en: Wild animals will rarely attack humans unless they feel cornered or threatened.
examples.zh: 野生动物很少攻击人类，除非它们感到走投无路或受到威胁。

lemmas.def_zh: 攻击, 抨击
lemmas.def_en: (military) an offensive against an enemy (using weapons)

examples.en: Wild animals will rarely attack humans unless they feel cornered or threatened.
examples.zh: 野生动物很少攻击人类，除非它们感到走投无路或受到威胁。

lemmas.def_zh: 袭击者，攻击者；（体育中的）进攻队员
lemmas.def_en: a person, animal, or group that attacks someone or something

examples.en: The victim fought off the masked attacker and managed to escape.
examples.zh: 受害者击退了蒙面袭击者并成功逃脱。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语与意大利语，本义为“附着、扣住”，后引申为“冲上去与敌交手”，演变出“暴力攻击、猛烈抨击、（疾病等）突然侵袭”的核心语义。
family_guide.core_distinction: attack 兼具动词与名词，侧重攻击行为、言论抨击或疾病发作过程；attacker 为施动者名词，专指实施攻击的人、动物或进攻方力量。

lemmas.def_zh: 使联合, 使发生联系；交往
lemmas.def_en: make a logical or causal connection

examples.en: Many people associate the sweet scent of pine trees with cold winter holidays.
examples.zh: 许多人会把松树的甜香与寒冷的冬日假期联系在一起。

lemmas.def_zh: 同伴, 伙伴, 关联的事物
lemmas.def_en: a person who joins with others in some activity or endeavor

examples.en: Many people associate the sweet scent of pine trees with cold winter holidays.
examples.zh: 许多人会把松树的甜香与寒冷的冬日假期联系在一起。

lemmas.def_zh: 协会
lemmas.def_en: a formal organization of people or groups of people

examples.en: She decided to join the local neighborhood association to help improve community safety.
examples.zh: 她决定加入当地社区协会，以帮助改善社区治安。

lemmas.def_zh: 联合的, 结合的, 联想的, 引起联合的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by or causing or resulting from the process of bringing ideas or events together in memory or imagination

examples.en: The human brain has remarkable associative power when recalling distant childhood memories.
examples.zh: 人类大脑在回忆久远的童年记忆时具有非凡的联想能力。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ad-（向、靠近）+ sociare（联合，来自 socius“同伴”），核心逻辑是从“结为同伴”延伸至人际间的“交往、合伙”以及心智上的“联想、关联”。
family_guide.core_distinction: associate 作名词专指“伙伴、合伙人”等具体的人；association 则指“协会、社团”等组织，或“关联、联想”这一抽象关系与心理活动。

lemmas.def_zh: 要求, 认领, 主张；提出要求, 主张, 断言
lemmas.def_en: assert or affirm strongly; state to be true or existing

examples.en: He claimed that he had finished the entire report before the noon deadline.
examples.zh: 他声称自己在中午截止之前就已经完成了整份报告。

lemmas.def_zh: 要求, 要求权, 断言, 权利
lemmas.def_en: an assertion of a right (as to money or property)

examples.en: He claimed that he had finished the entire report before the noon deadline.
examples.zh: 他声称自己在中午截止之前就已经完成了整份报告。

lemmas.def_zh: 提出要求者, 原告
lemmas.def_en: someone who claims a benefit or right or title

examples.en: The insurance company contacted the claimant to verify the recent accident details.
examples.zh: 保险公司联系了索赔人，以核实近期事故的详细情况。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 clamare（大声呼喊），核心意象是由“高声宣告”引申为“公开声称某事为真”或“高调主张属于自己的权益/索赔”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词与名词同形同源，均统一在“声称（事实）”与“索求/主张（权益）”两条主干语意脉络下。

lemmas.def_zh: 银行；储备库；河岸；存入（银行）；指望（与on连用）
lemmas.def_en: a financial establishment; a riverbank; to deposit money; to rely on

examples.en: I need to open a business account at the local bank.
examples.zh: 我需要在当地银行开立一个对公账户。

examples.en: You shouldn't bank on getting a promotion this early in your career.
examples.zh: 你不应该指望在职业生涯这么早的阶段就能获得晋升。

lemmas.def_zh: 银行家；银行高级职员；庄家
lemmas.def_en: a senior official or owner of a bank; the keeper of the bank in a game

examples.en: Investment bankers play a crucial role in corporate mergers and acquisitions.
examples.zh: 投资银行家在企业并购中扮演着至关重要的角色。

lemmas.def_zh: 银行；储备库；河岸；存入（银行）；指望（与on连用）
lemmas.def_en: a financial establishment; a riverbank; to deposit money; to rely on

examples.en: I need to open a business account at the local bank.
examples.zh: 我需要在当地银行开立一个对公账户。

examples.en: You shouldn't bank on getting a promotion this early in your career.
examples.zh: 你不应该指望在职业生涯这么早的阶段就能获得晋升。

lemmas.def_zh: 银行能接受的
lemmas.def_en: guaranteed to bring a profit

examples.en: Casting such a bankable star guarantees massive ticket sales on opening weekend.
examples.zh: 起用这样一位有票房号召力的明星能保证首映周末的巨额票房。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中古日耳曼语表示“长凳、台子”的词根，早期货币兑换商在长椅/柜台上营业演变为现代“金融机构”，另一分支则引申为隆起的土堆或“河岸”。
family_guide.core_distinction: banker 通常指银行业高管或资深金融从业者，普通基层柜员一般称为 teller 或 bank clerk。

lemmas.def_zh: 过去, 昔时, 往事, 早年经历, 过去时
lemmas.def_en: the time that has elapsed

examples.en: You cannot change the past, so focus all your energy on the future.
examples.zh: 你无法改变过去，所以把精力都放在未来吧。

lemmas.def_zh: 过去的, 结束的, 卸任的, 过去时的
lemmas.def_en: earlier than the present time; no longer current

examples.en: You cannot change the past, so focus all your energy on the future.
examples.zh: 你无法改变过去，所以把精力都放在未来吧。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自动词 pass 的古过去分词形式（passed），核心语义为“已经走过、流逝的”，引申为时间上的“过去”或空间上的“越过”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意 past（名词/形容词/介词/副词）常与动词 pass 的过去式 passed 混淆：past 表示状态或时间，passed 则特指“通过、经过”的动作。

lemmas.def_zh: 软片, 薄膜, 胶卷, 电影
lemmas.def_en: a form of entertainment that enacts a story by sound and a sequence of images giving the illusion of continuous movement

examples.en: The young director plans to film her new psychological thriller in northern Canada.
examples.zh: 这位年轻导演计划在加拿大北部拍摄她的新心理惊悚片。

lemmas.def_zh: 覆以薄膜, 拍摄；生薄膜, 拍电影
lemmas.def_en: make a film or photograph of something

examples.en: The young director plans to film her new psychological thriller in northern Canada.
examples.zh: 这位年轻导演计划在加拿大北部拍摄她的新心理惊悚片。

lemmas.def_zh: 薄膜的, 薄的, 朦胧的
lemmas.def_en: so thin as to transmit light

examples.en: She wore a filmy white dress that fluttered softly in the evening breeze.
examples.zh: 她穿着一件在晚风中轻轻飘动的薄纱白裙。

lemmas.def_zh: 尚未拍成影片的
lemmas.def_en: not recorded on film or tape

examples.en: The author's best-selling novel remains unfilmed despite several attempts by Hollywood studios.
examples.zh: 尽管好莱坞影业多次尝试，这位作家的畅销小说仍未被拍成电影。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语‘filmen’（薄皮、膜），核心意象为‘薄层’，后指涂有感光乳剂的‘胶卷/底片’，进而引申出放映的‘电影’及动词‘拍摄’。

lemmas.def_zh: 例子，实例；榜样，楷模；前车之鉴，警示
lemmas.def_en: a specific fact or item that illustrates a general rule; a person or thing that serves as a model to be imitated or avoided

examples.en: She set a fine example for her younger colleagues through her dedication and integrity.
examples.zh: 她以敬业和正直为年轻同事树立了良好的榜样。

examples.en: This historic church is a classic example of Gothic architecture.
examples.zh: 这座历史悠久的教堂是哥特式建筑的经典范例。

lemmas.def_zh: 模范, 榜样, 原型, 标本
lemmas.def_en: something to be imitated

examples.en: Her clean and efficient code served as an exemplar for the entire team.
examples.zh: 她整洁高效的代码成了全团队的学习榜样。

lemmas.def_zh: 例证, 范例
lemmas.def_en: showing by example

examples.en: Her selfless devotion to charity served as a perfect exemplification of kindness.
examples.zh: 她对慈善事业的无私奉献是善良品质的完美范例。

lemmas.def_zh: 可仿效的, 可做模范的, 惩戒性的, 示范的
lemmas.def_en: worthy of imitation

examples.en: exemplary behavior
model citizens

lemmas.def_zh: 例证, 例示
lemmas.def_en: be characteristic of

examples.en: Her remarkable dedication and courage perfectly exemplify the core values of our medical team.
examples.zh: 她非凡的奉献与勇气完美体现了我们医疗团队的核心价值观。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 exemplum（ex- 拿出 + emere 提取），本义为“挑出来作为代表的样本”，后演变指代用来说明情况的“例子”、值得效仿的“榜样”或引以为戒的“惩戒”。

lemmas.def_zh: 个性, 字符, 人物, 性质, 品格, 资格
lemmas.def_en: an imaginary person represented in a work of fiction (play or film or story)

examples.en: His quiet response under intense pressure revealed his true moral character.
examples.zh: 他在巨大压力下的沉着应对展现了他真实的道德品质。

lemmas.def_en: a prominent attribute or aspect of something
lemmas.def_zh: 特性, 特征, 特色

examples.en: Patience is a key characteristic of any successful educator or parent.
examples.zh: 耐心是任何成功的教育者或父母的关键特质。

lemmas.def_zh: 特性描述, 人物之塑造
lemmas.def_en: a graphic or vivid verbal description

examples.en: The critic praised the novel for its subtle and realistic characterization of the villain.
examples.zh: 评论家赞赏该小说对反派角色细致入微且逼真的塑造。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 字符
lemmas.def_en: engrave or inscribe characters on

examples.en: His quiet response under intense pressure revealed his true moral character.
examples.zh: 他在巨大压力下的沉着应对展现了他真实的道德品质。

lemmas.def_zh: 描绘...的特性, 刻划...的性格
lemmas.def_en: describe or portray the character or the qualities or peculiarities of

examples.en: Bright colors and bold brushstrokes characterize the painter's latest collection of portraits.
examples.zh: 鲜明的色彩和大胆的笔触是这位画家最新肖像画作的特征。

lemmas.def_zh: 表示...的特性, 成为/是...的特性, 刻划/描述...的性格；在文艺作品中塑造人物, 描绘性格
lemmas.def_en: be characteristic of

examples.en: Frequent delays and poor communication characterise the current public transport system.
examples.zh: 频繁延误和沟通不畅是目前公共交通系统的典型特征。

lemmas.def_en: typical or distinctive
lemmas.def_zh: 特性的, 特有的, 有特色的

examples.en: Patience is a key characteristic of any successful educator or parent.
examples.zh: 耐心是任何成功的教育者或父母的关键特质。

lemmas.def_en: distinctive and not typical
lemmas.def_zh: 无典型特征的；不典型的

examples.en: Her sudden angry outburst was completely uncharacteristic of her gentle personality.
examples.zh: 她突然发脾气与她一贯温柔的性格完全不符。

lemmas.def_zh: 无特征的, 无特点的, 无个性的
lemmas.def_en: lacking distinct or individual characteristics; dull and uninteresting

examples.en: The new office building was criticized for being completely bland and characterless.
examples.zh: 这座新的办公楼因平淡乏味、毫无特色而受到批评。

lemmas.def_en: in characteristic manner
lemmas.def_zh: 表示特性地

examples.en: He responded characteristically with a witty remark that broke the heavy tension.
examples.zh: 他一如既往地用一句幽默风趣的话打破了沉闷的气氛。

lemmas.def_en: in uncharacteristic manner
lemmas.def_zh: 不典型地；非同寻常地

examples.en: The usually bustling train station was uncharacteristically quiet late on Sunday evening.
examples.zh: 平日繁忙的火车站周日深夜出奇地安静。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 kharaktēr（雕刻工具、印记），核心由物理上的“刻痕、烙印”引申为抽象的“内在特征、品质”，再进一步扩展为文学中的“角色”与书写中的“字符”。
family_guide.core_distinction: character 指人或事物本身的“品质、性格”或作品中的“角色”，而 characterization 侧重指对这些特质进行“刻画、塑造”的行为或艺术手法。

lemmas.def_zh: 到期的, 应得的, 应付的, 约定的
lemmas.def_en: owed and payable immediately or on demand

examples.en: The final project report is due by noon on Friday without exception.
examples.zh: 期末项目报告必须在周五中午前提交，概无例外。

lemmas.def_zh: 应得的东西, 应付款
lemmas.def_en: that which is deserved or owed

examples.en: The final project report is due by noon on Friday without exception.
examples.zh: 期末项目报告必须在周五中午前提交，概无例外。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 debere（欠下、应当），核心概念始终围绕“在道义、法律或时间上所欠的、理应得到的或预定应当发生的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词指“到期的、预定的或应有的”；名词指“应得的报酬/荣誉”或复数 dues 表示“应缴的会费/费用”。

lemmas.def_zh: 保持; 依然是; 留下; 剩余
lemmas.def_en: to continue to exist, stay in the same state, or be left after other parts are gone

examples.en: Despite significant pressure from critics, interest rates are expected to remain stable.
examples.zh: 尽管面临来自批评者的巨大压力，预计利率仍将保持稳定。

examples.en: Very little remained of the ancient temple after centuries of erosion.
examples.zh: 历经数个世纪的风化侵蚀，这座古庙所剩无几。

lemmas.def_zh: 削价出售(图书)
lemmas.def_en: sell cheaply as remainders

examples.en: After a brief introduction, the speaker devoted the remainder of his lecture to case studies.
examples.zh: 简短介绍之后，演讲者将剩余的时间用于案例研究。

lemmas.def_zh: 剩余物, 其他人, 残余, 余数
lemmas.def_en: something left after other parts have been taken away

examples.en: After a brief introduction, the speaker devoted the remainder of his lecture to case studies.
examples.zh: 简短介绍之后，演讲者将剩余的时间用于案例研究。

lemmas.def_en: a small part or portion that remains after the main part no longer exists
lemmas.def_zh: 残余部分，遗迹

examples.en: Remnants of the ancient wall can still be seen today.
examples.zh: 古城墙的遗迹今天依然可见。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 剩余的；遗留的
lemmas.def_en: continuing to exist or be left after other parts or things have been used or removed
lemmas.usage_note: 前置定语，修饰名词，如 the remaining time, remaining issues, remaining funds。

examples.en: The remaining tickets will go on sale tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 剩余的门票将于明早开始发售。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 remanere（re- '留下' + manere '停留'），核心意象是‘在变动、离去或消耗之后依然留驻或留存’。
family_guide.core_distinction: remain 是不及物动词，表状态或位置的保持与留存；remainder 作名词指‘剩余的人、物或余数’，作动词则特指出版领域‘廉价抛售（滞销书）’。

lemmas.def_zh: 代表；象征；表现，描绘
lemmas.def_en: to act or speak on behalf of someone, or to symbolize something

examples.en: A local law firm was hired to represent the company in court.
examples.zh: 一家本地律所受聘代表该组织出庭。

examples.en: The dove is often used to represent peace.
examples.zh: 鸽子常被用来象征和平。

lemmas.def_zh: 不如实地叙述(或说明), 不称职地代表
lemmas.def_en: represent falsely

examples.en: The politician accused the media of deliberately trying to misrepresent his economic policies.
examples.zh: 这位政客指责媒体故意歪曲他的经济政策。

lemmas.def_zh: 代表；销售代表；典型
lemmas.def_en: a person chosen or appointed to act or speak for another or others

examples.en: Please contact our customer service representative if you have any questions.
examples.zh: 如果您有任何疑问，请联系我们的客户服务代表。

examples.en: Elected representatives from each district gathered for the annual conference.
examples.zh: 来自各选区的当选代表聚集在一起参加年会。

lemmas.def_zh: 代表（权）；表现，描绘；正式陈述，交涉
lemmas.def_en: the act of presenting or symbolizing, or the state of being represented

examples.en: Employees demanded better representation on the board of directors.
examples.zh: 员工要求在董事会中拥有更好的代表权。

examples.en: The movie was praised for its realistic representation of working-class life.
examples.zh: 这部电影因对工人阶级生活的写实描绘而受到赞誉。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 错误表示法
lemmas.def_en: a misleading falsehood

examples.en: The contract was voided due to a clear fraudulent misrepresentation of facts.
examples.zh: 由于对事实存在明显的欺诈性虚假陈述，该合同被作废。

lemmas.def_zh: 非代表性的, 不典型的
lemmas.def_en: not exemplifying a class

examples.en: A survey of ten students is entirely unrepresentative of the entire university.
examples.zh: 对十名学生的调查完全不能代表全校学生的情况。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自前缀 re-（再次、表强调）+ present（呈现、出席），核心逻辑为“使某物再次显现或在场”，引申为代为出面、象征或呈现。
family_guide.core_distinction: representative 指具体的“代表者/代理人”，而 representation 侧重抽象的“代表权、陈述行为或艺术表现”。

lemmas.def_zh: 图画, 照片, 景色, 美丽如画的人(或物), 化身, 生动的描述, 想像, 形象思维
lemmas.def_en: a visual representation (of an object or scene or person or abstraction) produced on a surface

examples.en: He hung a framed picture of his family above his wooden study desk.
examples.zh: 他在木质书桌上方挂了一幅装裱好的家庭合影。

lemmas.def_en: a graphic or vivid verbal description
lemmas.def_zh: 描写, 叙述

examples.en: The novel offers a vivid depiction of rural life in the nineteenth century.
examples.zh: 这部小说生动地描绘了19世纪的乡村生活。

lemmas.def_zh: 画, 拍摄, 用图说明, 描写, 想像
lemmas.def_en: imagine; conceive of; see in one's mind

examples.en: He hung a framed picture of his family above his wooden study desk.
examples.zh: 他在木质书桌上方挂了一幅装裱好的家庭合影。

lemmas.def_en: show in, or as in, a picture
lemmas.def_zh: v. 描绘，描画；描写，叙述

examples.en: The novel depicts life in rural England during the nineteenth century.
examples.zh: 这部小说生动地描绘了19世纪英国乡村的生活。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 pictura（源于 pingere，意为“描画”），核心逻辑是从“通过颜料勾画出的具象视觉图像”延伸到“照片、影视”以及头脑中“建构的想象或总体局势”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词常指实体画作、照片或抽象的“全局”，动词则主要指在脑海中“想象、构想”或视觉上“描绘”。

lemmas.def_zh: 锯子, 谚语
lemmas.def_en: a condensed but memorable saying embodying some important fact of experience that is taken as true by many people

examples.en: The carpenter picked up a sharp hand saw to cut the wooden board.
examples.zh: 木匠拿起一把锋利的手锯来切割木板。

lemmas.def_zh: 锯木工；锯工
lemmas.def_en: a person whose occupation is sawing timber or working in a sawmill

examples.en: The experienced sawyer carefully guided the massive logs through the mill blade.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的锯木工小心翼翼地引导粗大的原木穿过磨坊锯片。

lemmas.def_zh: 锯, 锯开, 来回移动；拉锯, 移动
lemmas.def_en: cut with a saw

examples.en: The carpenter picked up a sharp hand saw to cut the wooden board.
examples.zh: 木匠拿起一把锋利的手锯来切割木板。

lemmas.def_zh: saw的过去分词
lemmas.def_en: cut with a saw

examples.en: A pile of fresh sawn timber lay stacked near the edge of the workshop.
examples.zh: 一堆刚锯好的木材整齐地堆在车间角落旁。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语词根 *sek-（切割），演化出带齿的切削工具及相应的动作，并衍生出专业从事锯木的人员。
family_guide.core_distinction: saw 既指锯子工具也可作切割动词；sawyer 则是专门以锯切木料为职业的工匠。

lemmas.def_zh: 界限, 边界, 限度, 极限, 限制
lemmas.def_en: the greatest possible degree of something

examples.en: Drivers must obey the maximum speed limit when traveling through residential neighborhoods.
examples.zh: 司机在穿行居民区时必须遵守最高速度限制。

lemmas.def_zh: 限制, 缺陷, 限额
lemmas.def_en: a principle that limits the extent of something

examples.en: A lack of sufficient funding proved to be the main limitation of the project.
examples.zh: 事实证明，缺乏充足的资金是该项目的主要局限。

lemmas.def_zh: 限制物, 限幅器
lemmas.def_en: (electronics) a nonlinear electronic circuit whose output is limited in amplitude; used to limit the instantaneous amplitude of a waveform (to clip off the peaks of a waveform)

examples.en: The delivery van is equipped with an engine limiter to prevent excessive speeding.
examples.zh: 这辆送货车装有发动机限速器，以防止过度超速。

lemmas.def_zh: limitless（无限的）的变形
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being infinite; without bound or limit

examples.en: Staring into the clear night sky, he was struck by the limitlessness of space.
examples.zh: 凝视着清朗的夜空，他被宇宙的无限浩瀚深深震撼。

lemmas.def_zh: 限制, 限定
lemmas.def_en: place limits on (extent or access)

examples.en: Drivers must obey the maximum speed limit when traveling through residential neighborhoods.
examples.zh: 司机在穿行居民区时必须遵守最高速度限制。

lemmas.def_zh: 无限的, 不受限制的, 无条件的
lemmas.def_en: having no limits in range or scope; - Philip Rahv

examples.en: Subscribers enjoy unlimited access to the digital library throughout the year.
examples.zh: 订户全年中可以无限访问该数字图书馆。

lemmas.def_zh: 无限的, 无界限的
lemmas.def_en: without limits in extent or size or quantity

examples.en: Children possess a limitless imagination that fuels their creative everyday play.
examples.zh: 孩子们拥有无限的想象力，为他们每天的创意玩乐提供源泉。

lemmas.def_zh: 有限地
lemmas.def_en: in a limited manner

examples.en: This rare medical treatment is only limitedly available in remote regions.
examples.zh: 这种罕见的医疗手段在偏远地区只能有限地获得。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 limes（边界、界限），核心概念指空间、数量或程度等不可或不应逾越的“边界、界线”。
family_guide.core_distinction: limit 多指外在设定或客观存在的“上限、终点或界线”；limitation 则多指内在固有的“局限性、缺陷或制约条件”。

lemmas.def_zh: 系列；连续；连续剧；系列赛
lemmas.def_en: a number of similar or related things coming one after another; a set of radio or television programs

examples.en: The university is hosting a series of lectures on climate change this semester.
examples.zh: 该大学本学期正在举办一系列关于气候变化的讲座。

examples.en: Her novel was adapted into a highly successful television drama series.
examples.zh: 她的小说被改编成了一部非常成功的电视连续剧。

lemmas.def_en: a serialized set of programs
lemmas.def_zh: n. 连载作品；系列剧

examples.en: The television serial kept viewers glued to their screens for weeks.
examples.zh: 这部电视连续剧让观众数周以来一直守在荧幕前。

lemmas.def_en: in regular succession without gaps
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 连贯的；连续的

examples.en: The television serial kept viewers glued to their screens for weeks.
examples.zh: 这部电视连续剧让观众数周以来一直守在荧幕前。

lemmas.def_en: in a serial manner
lemmas.def_zh: [计] 可连续地

examples.en: The laboratory tested the water samples serially to track daily changes.
examples.zh: 实验室对水样进行了连续检测，以追踪每日的变化。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 serere（连接、编织、排成行），核心语义表示将同类事物依次编排、串联而成的“连续体”或“系列”。

lemmas.def_zh: 早晨，上午；黎明
lemmas.def_en: the early part of the day from sunrise until noon

examples.en: I usually go for a jog early in the morning before work.
examples.zh: 我通常在清晨上班前去慢跑。

examples.en: She spent the entire morning preparing the quarterly report.
examples.zh: 她花了一整个上午准备季度报告。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 morgen（早晨、黎明），后结合名词后缀 -ing，指从日出到正午之间的时光段落。

lemmas.def_zh: 儿子；男后代；（年长者对年轻男性的亲切称呼）孩子
lemmas.def_en: a male child in relation to his parents; a familiar form of address to a boy or young man

examples.en: They have two daughters and a seven-year-old son.
examples.zh: 他们有两个女儿和一个七岁的儿子。

examples.en: He followed in his father's footsteps, proving the old adage 'like father, like son'.
examples.zh: 他继承了父亲的衣钵，印证了“有其父必有其子”这句老话。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语 *suHnú-（出生者、所生之人），核心语义自古英语 sunu 以来一直稳定指代“男性的后代”。

lemmas.def_zh: 实践, 练习, 实行, 惯例, 习惯, 开业
lemmas.def_en: a customary way of operation or behavior

examples.en: Daily piano practice helped him master the complex piece quite quickly.
examples.zh: 每天的钢琴练习帮助他很快掌握了这首复杂的曲子。

lemmas.def_zh: 实际性, 实用性, 实际事物
lemmas.def_en: concerned with actual use rather than theoretical possibilities

examples.en: She questioned the practicality of implementing such an expensive new system.
examples.zh: 她对实施如此昂贵的新系统的实用性提出了质疑。

lemmas.def_zh: 实践, 实行, 练习, 实习, 业务
lemmas.def_en: carry out or practice; as of jobs and professions

examples.en: Daily piano practice helped him master the complex piece quite quickly.
examples.zh: 每天的钢琴练习帮助他很快掌握了这首复杂的曲子。

lemmas.def_zh: 实践, 实行, 练习, 实习, 从事(职业)
lemmas.def_en: engage in a rehearsal (of)

examples.en: You need to practise speaking English regularly to build true fluency.
examples.zh: 你需要定期练习说英语以建立真正的流利度。

lemmas.def_zh: 实际的, 现实的, 实用性的
lemmas.def_en: concerned with actual use or practice

examples.en: He gave me practical advice on how to fix the broken door.
examples.zh: 他就如何修理坏掉的门给了我实用的建议。

lemmas.def_zh: 未经练习的, 不熟练的, 无实际经验的, 未实行过的, 未经反复实践过的
lemmas.def_en: not having had extensive practice

examples.en: His unpracticed hands fumbled nervously with the tiny guitar strings.
examples.zh: 他未经练习的手笨拙紧张地拨弄着细小的琴弦。

lemmas.def_zh: 未经练习的, 不熟练的, 无实际经验的, 未实行过的, 未经反复实践过的
lemmas.def_en: not having had extensive practice

examples.en: She felt awkward singing because her unpractised voice sounded slightly cracked.
examples.zh: 她觉得唱歌很尴尬，因为她未加练习的声音听起来有些沙哑。

lemmas.def_zh: 几乎, 差不多, 事实上
lemmas.def_en: almost; nearly

examples.en: It was practically midnight by the time we finished the team project.
examples.zh: 当我们完成团队项目时，时间实际上已经是半夜了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 praktikos（适于行动的），核心语义从“付诸实际行动”衍生出“反复演练以熟练”、“实际应用”及“常态化做法”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 美式英语中 practice 名动同形；英式英语中 practice 专作名词，practise 专作动词；practically 除“实际上”外口语常作“几乎”解。

lemmas.def_zh: 位置，场所；遗址，工地；网站
lemmas.def_en: a place where a building, town, etc. is located, or where an event took place; a website

examples.en: Hard hats must be worn at all times on the construction site.
examples.zh: 在施工现场必须时刻佩戴安全帽。

examples.en: The archaeological team discovered ancient ruins at the burial site.
examples.zh: 考古队在该墓葬遗址发掘出了古代遗迹。

lemmas.def_zh: 坐，就坐；位于，坐落于
lemmas.def_en: to rest the body with the torso upright supported by the hips; to be situated in a particular place

examples.en: The historic castle sits majestically on a cliff overlooking the sea.
examples.zh: 这座历史悠久的城堡雄伟地矗立在俯瞰大海的悬崖上。

examples.en: Please sit down and make yourself comfortable.
examples.zh: 请坐，别客气。

family_guide.root_logic: 核心逻辑围绕“放置、安顿与停留的位置”展开，从身体的安坐（sit）延伸至具体事物安置的空间或网络场所（site）。
family_guide.core_distinction: sit 为动词，侧重“就坐、位于”的动作或状态；site 为名词，指具体的“场地、地点或网络站点”。

lemmas.def_zh: 未来，将来；前途，前景；将来的，未来的
lemmas.def_en: the time or events that will come after the present; happening or existing in the time ahead

examples.en: She is optimistic about the future of artificial intelligence in healthcare.
examples.zh: 她对人工智能在医疗领域的未来前景持乐观态度。

examples.en: We must protect our planet's natural resources for future generations.
examples.zh: 我们必须为了子孙后代保护地球的自然资源。

lemmas.def_zh: 将来, 未来, 未来的事, 远景
lemmas.def_en: the time yet to come

examples.en: Ancient prophets claimed to see glimpses of futurity in strange dreams.
examples.zh: 古代先知声称在奇怪的梦境中看到了未来的景象。

lemmas.def_zh: 未来，将来；前途，前景；将来的，未来的
lemmas.def_en: the time or events that will come after the present; happening or existing in the time ahead

examples.en: She is optimistic about the future of artificial intelligence in healthcare.
examples.zh: 她对人工智能在医疗领域的未来前景持乐观态度。

examples.en: We must protect our planet's natural resources for future generations.
examples.zh: 我们必须为了子孙后代保护地球的自然资源。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 futurus（即将发生的），本为动词 esse（存在）的将来分词形式，核心概念指“即将到来的时间、状态或存在”。

lemmas.def_zh: 回答, 反驳, 适应, 响应, 符合；回答, 答应, 负责, 符合, 成功
lemmas.def_en: react verbally

examples.en: Please answer the door while I finish preparing dinner in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 请去开一下门，我还在厨房里准备晚餐。

lemmas.def_zh: 答案, 回答, 回报, 答辩
lemmas.def_en: a statement (either spoken or written) that is made to reply to a question or request or criticism or accusation

examples.en: Please answer the door while I finish preparing dinner in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 请去开一下门，我还在厨房里准备晚餐。

lemmas.def_zh: 回答者, 解答者, 答辩者
lemmas.def_en: someone who responds

examples.en: The quiz show host thanked the quick answerer for his response.
examples.zh: 问答节目的主持人感谢了那位反应敏捷的答题者。

lemmas.def_zh: 负责任
lemmas.def_en: responsibility to someone or for some activity

examples.en: Democratic governance requires public answerability from all elected state officials.
examples.zh: 民主治理要求所有当选的政府官员对公众负责。

lemmas.def_zh: 有责任的, 可回答的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being answered

examples.en: Managers are directly answerable to the board for their departmental budgets.
examples.zh: 经理们直接向董事会就其部门预算负责。

lemmas.def_zh: 无法回答的, 没有责任的
lemmas.def_en: impossible to answer

examples.en: The sudden tragedy left many grieving families with painful, unanswerable questions.
examples.zh: 这起突如其来的悲剧给许多悲痛的家庭留下了痛苦且无法解答的疑问。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 andswaru（and- 反向 + swaru 誓言/表态），核心逻辑是‘对外界提问、呼叫或挑战做出针锋相对的回应或交代’。

lemmas.def_zh: 领域, 田地, 场地, 战场, 场, 域
lemmas.def_en: a piece of land cleared of trees and usually enclosed

examples.en: The coach decided to field two rookie players in the championship.
examples.zh: 教练决定在冠军赛中派两名新秀球员上场。

lemmas.def_zh: 外场员, 守队队员
lemmas.def_en: a member of the baseball team that is in the field instead of at bat

examples.en: The nimble fielder caught the flying baseball just before it landed.
examples.zh: 敏捷的守备队员在棒球落地前一把接住了它。

lemmas.def_zh: 使...晒在场上, 使上场
lemmas.def_en: catch or pick up (balls) in baseball or cricket

examples.en: The coach decided to field two rookie players in the championship.
examples.zh: 教练决定在冠军赛中派两名新秀球员上场。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，本义为“开阔平坦的平地或田野”，后引申为开展特定活动的开阔场所（运动场、战场），再抽象为知识与活动的“专门领域”；动词化后引申出“派上场地”、“在防守位接球”以及“在现场应对接应（提问、请求）”之义。

lemmas.def_zh: 国王，君主；（某领域的）巨头，王者
lemmas.def_en: the male ruler of an independent state; a person or thing regarded as the finest or most important in a sphere

examples.en: Charles III was crowned king in a historic ceremony.
examples.zh: 查尔斯三世在具有历史意义的仪式上加冕为王。

examples.en: He was widely regarded as the undisputed king of blues guitar.
examples.zh: 他被公认为无可争议的布鲁斯吉他之王。

lemmas.def_zh: 王国；领域，界（生物分类）
lemmas.def_en: a country ruled by a king or queen; a realm or major division in natural classification

examples.en: The ancient kingdom prospered through trade and diplomacy.
examples.zh: 这个古老的王国依靠贸易和外交繁荣昌盛。

examples.en: Fungi were eventually classified into their own separate kingdom.
examples.zh: 真菌最终被单独归为一个独立的生物界。

lemmas.def_zh: 君主身分, 王位, 王权
lemmas.def_en: the dignity or rank or position of a king

examples.en: He inherited the heavy burdens of kingship at a very young age.
examples.zh: 他在很小的时候就继承了王位的沉重负担。

lemmas.def_zh: 国王的, 高贵的, 威严的
lemmas.def_en: having the rank of or resembling or befitting a king

examples.en: He entered the grand banquet hall with an impressive and kingly grace.
examples.zh: 他带着令人肃然起敬的国王般的高雅风度走进了盛大的宴会厅。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 cyning（部族首领、贵族之子），核心意为“最高统治者”，派生出表示管辖疆域或状态的后缀 -dom，构成“王国”或“领域”。
family_guide.core_distinction: king 指统治者个体（国王）；kingdom 指其统辖的疆域、国度或分类学上的“界/领域”。

lemmas.def_zh: 挑选，选择；采，摘；剔，扒
lemmas.def_en: to choose from a group; to gather fruit or flowers; to remove unwanted matter with the fingers or a pointed tool

examples.en: She was picked to lead the new research project.
examples.zh: 她被挑选出来负责领导这个新的研究项目。

examples.en: The children spent the afternoon picking fresh strawberries.
examples.zh: 孩子们花了一下午的时间采摘新鲜草莓。

lemmas.def_zh: 拆开(缝线、针脚等)
lemmas.def_en: become or cause to become undone by separating the fibers or threads of

examples.en: She had to carefully unpick the seam after making a sewing mistake.
examples.zh: 缝错之后，她不得不小心翼翼地拆开接缝处。

lemmas.def_zh: 采摘，采集；挑选；(复数 pickings) 残余物，油水
lemmas.def_en: the act of gathering or selecting; (plural) scraps, leftovers, or easily obtained gains

examples.en: The apple-picking season begins in early autumn.
examples.zh: 苹果采摘季在初秋开始。

examples.en: Late arrivals found slim pickings at the buffet table.
examples.zh: 迟到的人发现自助餐桌上几乎没有什么可挑的食物了。

lemmas.def_zh: 啄者, 啄物, 采摘者, 采摘机, 挖掘者, 古董收集者
lemmas.def_en: a person who chooses or selects out

examples.en: The experienced fruit picker filled several wooden baskets before early noon.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的采摘工在中午前就装满了几个木筐。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于日耳曼语系中表示“用尖锐物刺、戳、啄”的动作，后引申为精细地“摘取”、“剔除”以及由此衍生出的“挑选”。
family_guide.core_distinction: pick 是动作本体（挑选、采摘）；picking 是采摘/挑选的过程或行为，其复数 pickings 常特指挑选后剩下的碎屑残余或轻易获得的油水。

lemmas.def_zh: 想知道，纳闷；感到惊奇，惊叹；惊奇，惊叹；奇迹，奇观
lemmas.def_en: to desire to know something; to feel admiration; a feeling of surprise and admiration; a marvelous thing

examples.en: I was wondering if you could give me some advice on this project.
examples.zh: 我不知道您是否能就这个项目给我一些建议。

examples.en: The child looked up at the fireworks in awe and wonder.
examples.zh: 那个孩子带着敬畏与惊奇抬头仰望烟花。

lemmas.def_zh: 想知道，纳闷；感到惊奇，惊叹；惊奇，惊叹；奇迹，奇观
lemmas.def_en: to desire to know something; to feel admiration; a feeling of surprise and admiration; a marvelous thing

examples.en: I was wondering if you could give me some advice on this project.
examples.zh: 我不知道您是否能就这个项目给我一些建议。

examples.en: The child looked up at the fireworks in awe and wonder.
examples.zh: 那个孩子带着敬畏与惊奇抬头仰望烟花。

lemmas.def_zh: 惊奇, 惊叹
lemmas.def_en: the feeling aroused by something strange and surprising

examples.en: The children stared in silent wonderment as the magician pulled a rabbit from his hat.
examples.zh: 当魔术师从帽子里变出一只兔子时，孩子们惊讶得目瞪口呆。

lemmas.def_zh: 极好；精彩
lemmas.def_en: admirable excellence

examples.en: She often reflected on the wonderfulness of nature during her quiet morning walks.
examples.zh: 在清晨安静的散步中，她常常沉思于大自然的美妙。

lemmas.def_zh: 极好的，精彩的；令人惊叹的
lemmas.def_en: inspiring delight, pleasure, or admiration; extremely good

examples.en: We had a wonderful time exploring the historic coastal town.
examples.zh: 我们在这座历史悠久的沿海小镇度过了一段美妙的时光。

lemmas.def_zh: 令人惊奇的
lemmas.def_en: extraordinarily good or great ; used especially as intensifiers

examples.en: Standing atop the mountain peak, we enjoyed a wondrous view of the green valley below.
examples.zh: 站在山顶上，我们欣赏着下方绿色山谷的奇妙景色。

lemmas.def_zh: 极好地，精彩地；非常，极其
lemmas.def_en: in an extremely good or impressive way; remarkably

examples.en: The new treatment has worked wonderfully well for most patients.
examples.zh: 这种新疗法对大多数患者都取得了极佳的效果。

lemmas.def_zh: 惊奇地, 非常, 极其
lemmas.def_en: (used as an intensifier) extremely well

examples.en: her voice is superbly disciplined
the colors changed wondrously slowly

lemmas.def_zh: 惊讶地
lemmas.def_en: in a curious and questioning manner

examples.en: He looked wonderingly at the strange, ancient symbols carved into the stone wall.
examples.zh: 他惊讶地看着刻在石墙上的那些奇怪而古老的符号。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 wundor（奇迹、惊异），核心意象是由未知或非凡事物引发的内心震动，由此派生出对未知的‘好奇探究（想知道）’以及对卓越事物的‘惊叹赞美（极好的）’。
family_guide.core_distinction: wonder 保留了强烈的“好奇、疑问与惊奇”双重色彩（如想知道、奇迹），而派生词 wonderful 则已高度泛化为日常积极评价，意为“极好的、精彩的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 单项数据；基准点，基准面
lemmas.def_en: a single piece of information, or a fixed starting point used as a reference

examples.en: Each datum was verified independently before being included in the final analysis.
examples.zh: 在纳入最终分析之前，每一项数据都经过了独立核对。

examples.en: Mean sea level serves as the vertical datum for topographic mapping.
examples.zh: 平均海平面被用作地形测绘的高程基准面。

lemmas.def_zh: 数据；资料；信息
lemmas.def_en: facts, statistics, or items of information collected together for reference or analysis

examples.en: The research team collected and analyzed raw data from multiple clinical trials.
examples.zh: 研究团队收集并分析了来自多项临床试验的原始数据。

examples.en: Data privacy and security have become paramount concerns in the digital era.
examples.zh: 在数字时代，数据隐私与安全已成为重中之重。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 dare（给予）的中性过去分词 datum，原意为“被给予之物”，引申为论证或计算的“已知前提”，最终演变为表示分析与处理的“数据或信息”。
family_guide.core_distinction: datum 为单数形式，特指“单条数据”或测量测绘中的“基准点”（日常极少用）；data 为其复数形式，在现代英语中多作不可数或集合名词，泛指“数据、资料”。

lemmas.def_zh: 向北方, 在北方
lemmas.def_en: in a northern direction

examples.en: Cold arctic winds are expected to blow steadily from the north tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 预计明早寒冷的北极风将持续从北方吹来。

lemmas.def_zh: 北方, 北
lemmas.def_en: the region of the United States lying to the north of the Mason-Dixon line

examples.en: Cold arctic winds are expected to blow steadily from the north tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 预计明早寒冷的北极风将持续从北方吹来。

lemmas.def_zh: 北的, 北方的
lemmas.def_en: situated in or facing or moving toward or coming from the north

examples.en: Cold arctic winds are expected to blow steadily from the north tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 预计明早寒冷的北极风将持续从北方吹来。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语表示“左侧”的词根（古人在日出东方时面向太阳，其左手侧即为北方），演变出表示指南针四大基本方位之一的核心概念。
family_guide.core_distinction: north 为同形多词性词，通过句法位置区分：修饰动词作状语为副词（向北），作主宾介补为名词（北方/北部），修饰名词为形容词（北方的）。

lemmas.def_zh: 警察, 警察当局, 治安
lemmas.def_en: the force of policemen and officers

examples.en: Volunteers helped police the crowded festival grounds to ensure everyone remained safe.
examples.zh: 志愿者们协助在拥挤的节日场地维持治安，以确保大家的安全。

lemmas.def_zh: 维持治安, 管辖
lemmas.def_en: maintain the security of by carrying out a patrol

examples.en: Volunteers helped police the crowded festival grounds to ensure everyone remained safe.
examples.zh: 志愿者们协助在拥挤的节日场地维持治安，以确保大家的安全。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 polis（城邦、城市），原指城邦治理与公共行政，后特化为“维持公共秩序与执法”的机构及行为。

lemmas.def_zh: 控诉, 加罪于, 使充满, 使充电, 使承担；冲锋, 要价, 收费
lemmas.def_en: to make a rush at or sudden attack upon, as in battle

examples.en: The prosecutor decided to charge the suspect with grand theft late yesterday afternoon.
examples.zh: 昨天傍晚，检察官决定以重大盗窃罪起诉该嫌疑人。

lemmas.def_zh: 指控, 费用, 冲锋, 电荷, 炸药, 主管, 被托管人, 命令
lemmas.def_en: an impetuous rush toward someone or something

examples.en: The prosecutor decided to charge the suspect with grand theft late yesterday afternoon.
examples.zh: 昨天傍晚，检察官决定以重大盗窃罪起诉该嫌疑人。

lemmas.def_zh: 充电器, 冲锋者, 战马
lemmas.def_en: formerly a strong swift horse ridden into battle

examples.en: I accidentally left my phone charger on the desk before heading to the airport.
examples.zh: 去机场前，我不小心把手机充电器落在了桌子上。

lemmas.def_zh: 没有负荷的, 未装弹药的, 不付费用的, 没有被指控的, 无电荷的
lemmas.def_en: of a particle or body or system; having no charge

examples.en: Neutrons are uncharged particles that reside within the dense nucleus of an atom.
examples.zh: 中子是存在于原子致密核心中的不带电粒子。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自晚期拉丁语 carricare（装车/承载负荷），核心意象为“施加载荷”：引申出加收金钱（经济负担）、课以罪名或职责（责任/法律负担）、注入电力（电荷负荷）以及如战车般全力冲锋。
family_guide.core_distinction: charge 兼作核心动词与名词，覆盖收费、控告、充电、掌管等多元抽象概念；charger 则具体指赋予电力的设备（充电器）或承载重负冲锋的载体（古战马）。

lemmas.def_zh: 红的, 红色的, 红肿的, 流血的
lemmas.def_en: of a color at the end of the color spectrum (next to orange); resembling the color of blood or cherries or tomatoes or rubies

examples.en: The company's finances remained in the red despite their aggressive cost-cutting measures.
examples.zh: 尽管采取了激进的削减成本措施，该公司的财务状况仍然处于亏损状态。

lemmas.def_zh: 红色, 红颜料, 赤字
lemmas.def_en: red color or pigment; the chromatic color resembling the hue of blood

examples.en: The company's finances remained in the red despite their aggressive cost-cutting measures.
examples.zh: 尽管采取了激进的削减成本措施，该公司的财务状况仍然处于亏损状态。

lemmas.def_zh: 红, 红色
lemmas.def_en: a response of body tissues to injury or irritation; characterized by pain and swelling and redness and heat

examples.en: Applying a cold compress helped reduce the painful swelling and redness on his ankle.
examples.zh: 冷敷有助于减轻他脚踝处的疼痛肿胀和发红。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语词根 *reudh-（血色、红色），为人类最古老的基础色彩词之一，后引申出面色潮红、财务亏损（赤字）及政治倾向等隐喻义。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词主要描述物体的颜色、面色潮红或财务赤字状态；名词则指代该色彩本身或特指亏损状态（如 in the red）。

lemmas.def_zh: 第三的；三分之一的；第三；三分之一
lemmas.def_en: constituting number three in an ordered sequence; one of three equal parts of something

examples.en: She finished in third place in the international piano competition.
examples.zh: 她在国际钢琴比赛中获得了第三名。

examples.en: Nearly a third of the company's annual budget is allocated to research and development.
examples.zh: 公司近三分之一的年度预算被分配给了研发。

lemmas.def_zh: 第三的；三分之一的；第三；三分之一
lemmas.def_en: constituting number three in an ordered sequence; one of three equal parts of something

examples.en: She finished in third place in the international piano competition.
examples.zh: 她在国际钢琴比赛中获得了第三名。

examples.en: Nearly a third of the company's annual budget is allocated to research and development.
examples.zh: 公司近三分之一的年度预算被分配给了研发。

lemmas.def_zh: 第三
lemmas.def_en: in the third place

examples.en: Thirdly, we must evaluate the environmental impact of this construction project carefully.
examples.zh: 第三，我们必须仔细评估这个建设项目对环境的影响。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 þridda，由基数词 three 演变而来，核心指按序列排在第二之后的位置或等分为三份中的一份。

lemmas.def_zh: 包含，需要；牵涉，使卷入；使参与
lemmas.def_en: to include or affect someone or something; to cause someone to participate in an activity

examples.en: The research project involves collecting data from hundreds of participants.
examples.zh: 该研究项目需要从数百名受试者中收集数据。

examples.en: She has been actively involved in community service for years.
examples.zh: 多年来，她一直积极参与社区服务。

lemmas.def_zh: 参与，加入；卷入，牵连；情感关联
lemmas.def_en: the act or state of taking part in an activity, event, or situation

examples.en: Parental involvement is crucial to a child's educational development.
examples.zh: 家长的参与对孩子的教育成长至关重要。

examples.en: He denied any involvement in the financial fraud.
examples.zh: 他否认自己卷入了那起金融诈骗案。

lemmas.def_zh: 卷绕, 内卷, 回旋
lemmas.def_en: reduction in size of an organ or part (as in the return of the uterus to normal size after childbirth)

examples.en: Fierce market competition led to a painful involution within the domestic technology sector.
examples.zh: 激烈的市场竞争导致国内科技行业内部出现了痛苦的内卷。

lemmas.def_zh: [医]未受累的; 壁上观
lemmas.def_en: not involved

examples.en: He preferred to remain completely uninvolved in the bitter disputes between his colleagues.
examples.zh: 他宁愿完全不卷入同事之间激烈的争吵中。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 involvere（in- '进入' + volvere '卷'），字面意为'卷入其中'，引申出'包含、牵连、参与'的核心逻辑。
family_guide.core_distinction: involve 是表示'牵涉、需要或使参与'的动作与状态动词；involvement 是其名词形式，强调'参与的程度、卷入的状态或牵连关系'。

lemmas.def_zh: 发动机，引擎；机车；动力，推动力
lemmas.def_en: a machine with moving parts that converts power into motion; a primary source of power or progress

examples.en: The mechanic checked the car's engine to find out why it was making that strange noise.
examples.zh: 技工检查了汽车发动机，想查明产生异响的原因。

examples.en: Small businesses are widely regarded as the main engine of economic growth.
examples.zh: 小型企业被普遍视为经济增长的主要引擎。

lemmas.def_zh: 工程师, 工兵
lemmas.def_en: a person who uses scientific knowledge to solve practical problems

examples.en: The chief engineer worked tirelessly to design a more fuel-efficient hybrid engine.
examples.zh: 总工程师不知疲倦地工作，以设计出更省油的混合动力引擎。

lemmas.def_zh: 设计, 监造, 精明地处理, 策划
lemmas.def_en: design as an engineer

examples.en: The chief engineer worked tirelessly to design a more fuel-efficient hybrid engine.
examples.zh: 总工程师不知疲倦地工作，以设计出更省油的混合动力引擎。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ingenium（天资、巧思、精妙的发明），后引申为依靠智慧设计出的“精巧机械/动力源”（engine），进而衍生出设计和操控机械的“工程师”（engineer n.）以及“精巧设计、暗中谋划”（engineer v.）。
family_guide.core_distinction: engine 指动力机械或核心推动力；engineer 名词指工程专业人员或机车司机，动词则侧重通过技术或智谋“精心策划、设计实现”。

lemmas.def_zh: 片刻，瞬间；特定时刻；重要性
lemmas.def_en: a very brief period of time; a particular point in time; importance or significance

examples.en: Can you wait a moment? I'll be with you shortly.
examples.zh: 你能稍等片刻吗？我马上就好。

examples.en: Winning the championship was the proudest moment of her career.
examples.zh: 赢得冠军是她职业生涯中最自豪的时刻。

examples.en: The outcome of these negotiations is of great moment to both nations.
examples.zh: 这些谈判的结果对两国而言都具有重大意义。

lemmas.def_zh: 重大的, 重要的
lemmas.def_en: of very great significance

examples.en: Signing the historic peace treaty was a momentous occasion for both war-torn nations.
examples.zh: 签署历史性的和平条约对这两个饱受战争蹂躏的国家来说是一个重大时刻。

lemmas.def_zh: 瞬间的, 刹那间的
lemmas.def_en: lasting for a markedly brief time

examples.en: After a momentary hesitation, she signed the contract and handed it back.
examples.zh: 稍作犹豫后，她签下了合同并递了回去。

lemmas.def_zh: 暂时地, 立刻, 随时地
lemmas.def_en: for an instant or moment

examples.en: we paused momentarily before proceeding
a cardinal perched momently on the dogwood branch

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 momentum（由 movere'移动'缩合而来，指微小的变动或推动力），引申出“极短的时间/瞬间”以及“能打破平衡的重要分量/重要性”两条语义脉络。
family_guide.core_distinction: 派生形容词 momentary 承接“短暂的时间”，意为“短暂的、片刻的”；momentous 承接“重要的分量”，意为“重大的、关键的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 严重的，危急的；严肃的，认真的
lemmas.def_en: demanding careful thought; severe in effect; not joking or trifling

examples.en: Climate change poses a serious threat to global food security.
examples.zh: 气候变化对全球粮食安全构成了严重威胁。

examples.en: Are you serious about quitting your job and traveling the world?
examples.zh: 你是真打算辞职去环游世界吗？

lemmas.def_zh: 严重地；严肃地，认真地；非常，极其
lemmas.def_en: in a solemn manner; to a severe degree; genuinely or extremely

examples.en: Two passengers were seriously injured in the crash.
examples.zh: 两名乘客在事故中受了重伤。

examples.en: You shouldn't take his teasing so seriously.
examples.zh: 你没必要把他的取笑太当真。

lemmas.def_zh: 严重性；严肃，认真
lemmas.def_en: the state or quality of being severe, grave, or earnest

examples.en: The government failed to realize the full seriousness of the economic crisis.
examples.zh: 政府未能充分意识到这场经济危机的严重性。

examples.en: The sudden seriousness in her tone caught everyone's attention.
examples.zh: 她语气中骤然流露出的严肃引起了所有人的注意。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 serius（重大的、有分量的），核心语义为“非同儿戏、不可轻视”，引申为后果上的“严重”与态度上的“严肃、认真”。

lemmas.def_zh: 父亲，母亲，双亲之一；抚育，做……的父母
lemmas.def_en: a father or mother; to care for or act as a parent to a child

examples.en: Both parents were invited to attend the annual school conference.
examples.zh: 学校邀请父母双方出席年度家长会。

examples.en: It can be challenging to parent a teenager who is seeking independence.
examples.zh: 抚育一个追求独立的青春期孩子可能极具挑战性。

lemmas.def_zh: 为人父母；父母身份；父母的状态或经历
lemmas.def_en: the state, role, or experience of being a parent

examples.en: Many young couples find that parenthood completely shifts their daily priorities.
examples.zh: 许多年轻夫妇发现为人父母彻底改变了他们日常生活的重心。

lemmas.def_zh: 出身, 血统, 门第, 起源
lemmas.def_en: the state of being a parent

examples.en: The pedigree certificate clearly proved the prize-winning dog was of royal parentage.
examples.zh: 血统证书清楚地证明这只获奖犬出身高贵。

lemmas.def_zh: 父亲，母亲，双亲之一；抚育，做……的父母
lemmas.def_en: a father or mother; to care for or act as a parent to a child

examples.en: Both parents were invited to attend the annual school conference.
examples.zh: 学校邀请父母双方出席年度家长会。

examples.en: It can be challenging to parent a teenager who is seeking independence.
examples.zh: 抚育一个追求独立的青春期孩子可能极具挑战性。

lemmas.def_zh: 父母的；亲代的；作为父母应有的
lemmas.def_en: relating to, characteristic of, or provided by a parent

examples.en: Children usually thrive under consistent parental guidance and emotional warmth.
examples.zh: 在父母始终如一的引导与情感温暖下，孩子们通常能茁壮成长。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 无父母的
lemmas.def_en: having no parent or parents or not cared for by parent surrogates

examples.en: The charitable organization provides warm shelter and education for many parentless children.
examples.zh: 该慈善机构为许多失去双亲的儿童提供温暖的住所和教育。

lemmas.def_zh: 父母般地; 像双亲地
lemmas.def_en: in a parental manner

examples.en: The caring teacher spoke parentally to the upset student after class ended today.
examples.zh: 今天下课后，那位充满关爱的老师像父母般安慰了沮丧的学生。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 parere（生育、产出），核心含义为“生育后代的人”，后自然引申出抚育行为及作为父母的身份与属性
family_guide.core_distinction: parental 是形容词（表示父母的、亲代的属性或职责），parenthood 是抽象名词（表示为人父母的身份、状态或历程）

lemmas.def_zh: 通常的；寻常的；惯常的
lemmas.def_en: happening, done, or used most of the time; normal

examples.en: She arrived at the office at the usual time.
examples.zh: 她按往常的时间到达了办公室。

examples.en: As usual, he ordered a cup of black coffee.
examples.zh: 和平常一样，他点了一杯黑咖啡。

lemmas.def_zh: 不寻常的；罕见的；独特的
lemmas.def_en: not common, rare, or different from what is expected

examples.en: It is unusual for him to be late for such an important meeting.
examples.zh: 像这样重要的会议他居然迟到，实在很不寻常。

examples.en: The gallery is displaying some unusual works of modern art.
examples.zh: 画廊正在展出一些风格独特的现代艺术作品。

lemmas.def_zh: 通常；一般；按惯例
lemmas.def_en: under normal conditions; generally

examples.en: I usually take the subway to work to avoid traffic.
examples.zh: 我通常乘地铁上班以避开拥堵。

examples.en: Public museums are usually closed on Mondays.
examples.zh: 公立博物馆通常在周一闭馆。

lemmas.def_zh: 异常地；格外；异乎寻常地
lemmas.def_en: in an uncommon or unexpected way; exceptionally

examples.en: The weather has been unusually warm for this time of year.
examples.zh: 对于每年的这个时节来说，天气异常暖和。

examples.en: She was unusually quiet during the entire discussion.
examples.zh: 在整个讨论过程中，她都格外安静。

lemmas.def_zh: 不寻常性
lemmas.def_en: uncommonness by virtue of being unusual

examples.en: The absolute unusualness of the bright green sky signaled an approaching violent storm.
examples.zh: 明亮绿色天空的异常景象预示着一场猛烈的风暴即将到来。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 usus（使用、习惯），由“习惯使用的”引申为“惯常的、通常的”；加前缀 un- 表反义否定，加后缀 -ly 表方式、频率或程度。
family_guide.core_distinction: usually 侧重表示发生的惯例与频次（“通常、往往”），而 unusually 侧重表示反常的状态或异乎寻常的程度（“异常地、格外”）。

lemmas.def_zh: 主要的，最重要的；(水、电、燃气等的) 总管道，干线
lemmas.def_en: chief in size, importance, or extent; a principal pipe or line in a distribution system

examples.en: The main entrance to the building is closed for renovation.
examples.zh: 该大楼的正门因翻修而暂时关闭。

examples.en: Workers had to shut off the gas at the main to repair the leak safely.
examples.zh: 工人们不得不关闭燃气总阀以便安全维修泄漏处。

lemmas.def_zh: 主要地，大部分，首要的是
lemmas.def_en: more than anything else; for the most part

examples.en: The workforce consists mainly of young, tech-savvy graduates.
examples.zh: 该团队的员工主要由精通技术的年轻大学毕业生组成。

lemmas.def_zh: 主要的，最重要的；(水、电、燃气等的) 总管道，干线
lemmas.def_en: chief in size, importance, or extent; a principal pipe or line in a distribution system

examples.en: The main entrance to the building is closed for renovation.
examples.zh: 该大楼的正门因翻修而暂时关闭。

examples.en: Workers had to shut off the gas at the main to repair the leak safely.
examples.zh: 工人们不得不关闭燃气总阀以便安全维修泄漏处。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语中表示“力量、体量”的词根（与 might 同源），后引申出“最重要的、最核心的”以及承载主体输送的“总管道、干线”。
family_guide.core_distinction: main 作形容词通常只作前置定语修饰核心事物，作名词常指水电气等主管道；mainly 则作副词修饰谓语、表语或介词短语，表示“大体上、主要地”。

lemmas.def_zh: 位置, 地位, 身分, 形势, 姿势, 立场, 职位, 状态, 阵地
lemmas.def_en: the particular portion of space occupied by something

examples.en: She applied for a senior management position within the international marketing firm.
examples.zh: 她申请了那家跨国营销公司的高管职位。

lemmas.def_zh: [化] 定位器
lemmas.def_en: (computer science) the actuator that moves a read/write head to the proper data track

examples.en: The technician calibrated the pneumatic valve positioner to ensure precise flow control.
examples.zh: 技术人员校准了气动阀门定位器，以确保精确的流量控制。

lemmas.def_zh: 安置, 决定...的位置
lemmas.def_en: cause to be in an appropriate place, state, or relation

examples.en: She applied for a senior management position within the international marketing firm.
examples.zh: 她申请了那家跨国营销公司的高管职位。

lemmas.def_zh: 假设, 安置, 布置
lemmas.def_en: put (something somewhere) firmly

examples.en: Several scientists posit that liquid water once flowed freely across the Martian surface.
examples.zh: 一些科学家假设液态水曾一度在火星表面自由流淌。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ponere（放置、安放），核心概念是“被安置的状态”，引申为空间上的“位置”、身体的“姿势”、职场与社会的“地位/职位”，以及思维层面的“立场”。

lemmas.def_zh: 来源, 水源, 根源, 原始资料, 源
lemmas.def_en: the place where something begins, where it springs into being

examples.en: The local restaurant sources its organic vegetables directly from nearby family farms.
examples.zh: 这家当地餐馆直接从附近的家庭农场采购有机蔬菜。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 来源, 源程序
lemmas.def_en: get (a product) from another country or business

examples.en: The local restaurant sources its organic vegetables directly from nearby family farms.
examples.zh: 这家当地餐馆直接从附近的家庭农场采购有机蔬菜。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 surgere（升起、涌现），本义为泉水涌出的源头，引申为一切事物、信息或资源的起因、发源地及获取途径。

lemmas.def_zh: 新近的；近来的
lemmas.def_en: happened, begun, or done not long ago

examples.en: In recent years, remote work has become increasingly popular.
examples.zh: 近年来，远程办公变得越来越普遍。

examples.en: The company's recent survey revealed high levels of customer satisfaction.
examples.zh: 该公司最近的调查显示顾客满意度很高。

lemmas.def_zh: 最近；不久前
lemmas.def_en: at a recent time; not long ago

examples.en: She has recently started learning Spanish.
examples.zh: 她最近开始学习西班牙语。

examples.en: Until quite recently, very little was known about the disease.
examples.zh: 直到最近，人们对这种疾病还知之甚少。

lemmas.def_zh: 崭新, 新近
lemmas.def_en: a time immediately before the present

examples.en: The algorithm gives higher weight to articles based on their recency.
examples.zh: 该算法根据文章的新近程度赋予其更高的权重。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 recens（新鲜的、新近的），核心逻辑指“在时间跨度上距离当下不远、新近发生或出现的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: recent 为形容词修饰名词（如 in recent years），recently 为副词修饰动词或全句（常与现在完成时或一般过去时连用）。

lemmas.def_zh: 机会, 意外, 可能性
lemmas.def_en: a possibility due to a favorable combination of circumstances

examples.en: A chance meeting at the airport completely changed the course of his career.
examples.zh: 机场的一次偶然相遇彻底改变了他的职业生涯轨迹。

lemmas.def_zh: 不幸, 灾难
lemmas.def_en: an unpredictable outcome that is unfortunate

examples.en: By pure mischance, our luggage was sent to entirely the wrong destination.
examples.zh: 真倒霉，我们的行李被完全送错了目的地。

lemmas.def_zh: 偶然发生；冒险
lemmas.def_en: be the case by chance

examples.en: A chance meeting at the airport completely changed the course of his career.
examples.zh: 机场的一次偶然相遇彻底改变了他的职业生涯轨迹。

lemmas.def_en: occurring or appearing or singled out by chance

examples.en: A chance meeting at the airport completely changed the course of his career.
examples.zh: 机场的一次偶然相遇彻底改变了他的职业生涯轨迹。

lemmas.def_zh: 不确定的, 偶然发生的
lemmas.def_en: of uncertain outcome; especially fraught with risk; - New Yorker

examples.en: Investing all your savings in that new startup is a chancy proposition.
examples.zh: 把你所有的积蓄投资在那家初创公司是件冒险的事。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于拉丁语表示“落下”的词根（引申指掷骰子落下），核心逻辑从“不可控的随机落下”演化为“偶然、机会与冒险”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 同形三性：名词表示“机会/可能性/偶然”，动词表示“碰巧发生或冒险”，形容词则专用于修饰名词表示“偶然的/意外的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 步骤, 步, 步幅, 脚步声, 踏级, 步伐, 短距离, 步态, 手段, 等级
lemmas.def_en: any maneuver made as part of progress toward a goal

examples.en: Carefully step over the wet paint so you do not ruin the floor.
examples.zh: 小心跨过未干的油漆，免得弄脏地板。

lemmas.def_zh: 踏错, 错误, 失策
lemmas.def_en: an unintentional but embarrassing blunder

examples.en: A single diplomatic misstep could derail the fragile ongoing peace negotiations completely.
examples.zh: 一次外交失策就可能彻底破坏脆弱的和平谈判。

lemmas.def_zh: 踏, 以步测量, 跨步, 使成阶梯状；跨步, 轻快地走, 跳舞, 踩, 踏上, 行走
lemmas.def_en: shift or move by taking a step

examples.en: Carefully step over the wet paint so you do not ruin the floor.
examples.zh: 小心跨过未干的油漆，免得弄脏地板。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 stæpe，核心本义为“脚的移动与落下”，由此自然延伸出具体的物理空间移动（迈步、台阶）以及抽象的推进过程（步骤、措施）。
family_guide.core_distinction: step 兼作名词与动词，名词侧重于指代移动的幅度、踏足的台阶或行动的节点/措施，动词则侧重于落脚、行走的具体动作。

lemmas.def_zh: 引用，引证；提供参考资料（动词）；参考，查阅；参考文献；推荐信（名词）
lemmas.def_en: to cite or provide sources (verb); a mention, source of information, or letter of recommendation (noun)

examples.en: All borrowed data must be properly referenced in your final paper.
examples.zh: 期末论文中所有引用的数据都必须规范注明出处。

examples.en: Keep this manual handy for future reference.
examples.zh: 把这本手册放在手边，以备日后参考查阅。

lemmas.def_zh: 谈及，提及；参考，查阅；转介，推荐
lemmas.def_en: to mention or direct attention to; to consult for information; to send to someone for help

examples.en: The speaker didn't directly refer to the recent controversy during his lecture.
examples.zh: 演讲者在讲座中并未直接提及最近的那场争议。

examples.en: Her family doctor referred her to a specialist for further tests.
examples.zh: 她的家庭医生把她转介给了一位专科医生做进一步检查。

lemmas.def_zh: 担任裁判；审阅评审（论文）（动词）；裁判员；（学术）审稿人；推荐人（名词）
lemmas.def_en: to act as a judge or review a paper (verb); an official in a match, peer reviewer, or reference person (noun)

examples.en: He was chosen to referee the championship final this weekend.
examples.zh: 他被选定在本周末担任冠军总决赛的裁判。

examples.en: The journal sends each submitted manuscript to at least two independent referees.
examples.zh: 该期刊会将每篇投稿稿件送交至少两位独立的审稿人进行同行评审。

lemmas.def_zh: 引用，引证；提供参考资料（动词）；参考，查阅；参考文献；推荐信（名词）
lemmas.def_en: to cite or provide sources (verb); a mention, source of information, or letter of recommendation (noun)

examples.en: All borrowed data must be properly referenced in your final paper.
examples.zh: 期末论文中所有引用的数据都必须规范注明出处。

examples.en: Keep this manual handy for future reference.
examples.zh: 把这本手册放在手边，以备日后参考查阅。

lemmas.def_zh: 担任裁判；审阅评审（论文）（动词）；裁判员；（学术）审稿人；推荐人（名词）
lemmas.def_en: to act as a judge or review a paper (verb); an official in a match, peer reviewer, or reference person (noun)

examples.en: He was chosen to referee the championship final this weekend.
examples.zh: 他被选定在本周末担任冠军总决赛的裁判。

examples.en: The journal sends each submitted manuscript to at least two independent referees.
examples.zh: 该期刊会将每篇投稿稿件送交至少两位独立的审稿人进行同行评审。

lemmas.def_zh: 转诊，转介；推荐，引荐；被转介的人
lemmas.def_en: the act of directing someone to another place/person for advice or treatment; a recommendation

examples.en: You usually need a referral from your primary care physician to see a dermatologist.
examples.zh: 看皮肤科医生通常需要基层全科医生的转诊单。

examples.en: A large portion of the agency's new clients come through word-of-mouth referrals.
examples.zh: 该机构的大部分新客户都来自于口碑推荐。

lemmas.def_zh: 指示物
lemmas.def_en: something referred to; the object of a reference

examples.en: In linguistics, a word is merely a symbol pointing directly to its real-world referent.
examples.zh: 在语言学中，单词只是直接指向其现实世界指示物的符号。

lemmas.def_zh: 与...有关的, 有所指的
lemmas.def_en: referring or pointing to something

examples.en: The poem uses rich referential language that draws upon ancient Greek mythology.
examples.zh: 这首诗使用了丰富的指涉性语言，借鉴了古希腊神话。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 re-（回、向后）+ ferre（带来、携带），核心逻辑为“引导回到某处”，引申为将注意力引向某处（提及、查阅）、将人引向专业机构（转介）或将争议交由第三方处理（裁决）。
family_guide.core_distinction: reference 侧重于知识与文献的“查阅、引证”或求职中的“推荐信”；referral 侧重于医疗或业务流程中的“转诊、转介”；referee 则专指执掌裁决的“裁判”或学术“审稿人”。

lemmas.def_zh: 贸易, 商业, 交易, 生意, 职业, 顾客, 信风
lemmas.def_en: the commercial exchange (buying and selling on domestic or international markets) of goods and services

examples.en: Many developing nations rely heavily on foreign trade to boost their economies.
examples.zh: 许多发展中国家严重依赖对外贸易来提振经济。

lemmas.def_zh: 商人；交易员
lemmas.def_en: a person who buys and sells goods, currency, or financial shares

examples.en: Stock traders reacted swiftly to the central bank's unexpected interest rate cut.
examples.zh: 股票交易员对央行出人意料的降息举措迅速作出了反应。

lemmas.def_zh: 进行交易, 做买卖, 经商, 对换, 购物；用...进行交换
lemmas.def_en: engage in the trade of

examples.en: Many developing nations rely heavily on foreign trade to boost their economies.
examples.zh: 许多发展中国家严重依赖对外贸易来提振经济。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中古英语及中古低地德语，本义为“轨道、足迹”（与 tread 同源），后引申指“常规的行当、职业路径”，再进一步发展为货物流转的“贸易与交易”。
family_guide.core_distinction: trade 兼具名词与动词属性，指贸易活动或交易行为本身；trader 则是从事贸易活动的主体，现代常特指金融市场的证券或商品交易员。

lemmas.def_zh: 靠近, 近似于
lemmas.def_en: move towards

examples.en: As we neared the mountain summit, the icy wind became much stronger.
examples.zh: 当我们接近山顶时，刺骨的寒风变得强劲得多。

lemmas.def_zh: 接近, 走近
lemmas.def_en: move towards

examples.en: As we neared the mountain summit, the icy wind became much stronger.
examples.zh: 当我们接近山顶时，刺骨的寒风变得强劲得多。

lemmas.def_zh: 近的, 近亲的, 近似的
lemmas.def_en: not far distant in time or space or degree or circumstances

examples.en: As we neared the mountain summit, the icy wind became much stronger.
examples.zh: 当我们接近山顶时，刺骨的寒风变得强劲得多。

lemmas.def_zh: 接近；密切；近似
lemmas.def_en: the spatial property resulting from a relatively small distance

examples.en: The hotel’s nearness to the subway station makes it ideal for tourists.
examples.zh: 该酒店靠近地铁站，非常适合游客入住。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古英语表示“接近”的词根（原本为比较级形式，意为“更近”），后演变为主干词，核心统一表达空间、时间或状态上的“距离小、向目标靠拢”。
family_guide.core_distinction: near 兼具多词性：介词接宾语表示位置或状态邻近（near the station）；形容词修饰名词表示距离或时间临近（near future）；动词表示动态的“逐渐接近”（nearing completion）。

lemmas.def_zh: （两者中）任一的；（两者中）每个的，两方的
lemmas.def_en: one or the other of two; each of two

examples.en: You can park on either side of the street.
examples.zh: 你可以把车停在街道的任意一侧。

examples.en: Either candidate would make an excellent team leader.
examples.zh: 两位候选人中的任何一位都能成为优秀的团队领导。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语表示“两者中任一个”的复合词结构，核心语义聚焦于在两个既定对象中进行选择（任一），或指代两方中的每一方。

lemmas.def_zh: 相符合，一致；给予，授予
lemmas.def_en: to give or grant someone power, status, or recognition; to be consistent or in agreement with something

examples.en: Her version of events accords perfectly with the evidence.
examples.zh: 她对事情经过的描述与证据完全吻合。

examples.en: The visiting dignitary was accorded a warm reception.
examples.zh: 来访的要人受到了热烈接待。

lemmas.def_zh: 一致；依照，依据
lemmas.def_en: conformity or agreement with a rule, principle, or wish

examples.en: The contract was signed in strict accordance with local laws.
examples.zh: 该合同的签署严格符合当地法律法规。

lemmas.def_zh: 一致的, 相符合的, 调和的
lemmas.def_en: being in agreement or harmony; often followed by `with'; -Thomas Hardy

examples.en: His daily actions are always accordant with his deeply held personal values.
examples.zh: 他的日常行为始终与他内心深处的价值观相符。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ad-（趋向）与 cord-（心），字面义为“合心”，引申出“意见一致、符合”以及“怀着善意给予（待遇、地位等）”的双重核心含义。
family_guide.core_distinction: accord 作动词强调“相符”或“授予”，作名词时多指“协定”；accordance 仅作名词，常用于固定短语 in accordance with（依据、依照）。

lemmas.def_zh: 完美的, 完好的, 理想的, 熟练的, 精确的, 完成式的
lemmas.def_en: being complete of its kind and without defect or blemish

examples.en: She spent years in France trying to perfect her accent and fluency.
examples.zh: 她在法国待了数年，努力完善自己的口音和流利度。

lemmas.def_zh: 可使完美的, 可完成的
lemmas.def_en: capable of becoming or being made perfect

examples.en: Engineers believe that the current battery technology is flawed but easily perfectible.
examples.zh: 工程师们认为现有的电池技术虽有缺陷，但易于改进完善。

lemmas.def_zh: 使完美, 修改, 使精通, 改善, 使熟练
lemmas.def_en: make perfect or complete

examples.en: She spent years in France trying to perfect her accent and fluency.
examples.zh: 她在法国待了数年，努力完善自己的口音和流利度。

lemmas.def_zh: 完美地；完全地，极其
lemmas.def_en: in a flawless manner; completely or entirely

examples.en: I understand your concerns perfectly well.
examples.zh: 我完全理解你的顾虑。

examples.en: The dress fits her perfectly.
examples.zh: 这条裙子她穿起来再合身不过了。

lemmas.def_zh: 完美，完善；极致
lemmas.def_en: the state or quality of being without fault or defect

examples.en: She pursued artistic perfection throughout her entire life.
examples.zh: 她一生都在追求艺术上的极致完美。

lemmas.def_zh: 至善论者, 过分挑剔者, 追求尽善尽美者, 圆满论者
lemmas.def_en: a person who is displeased by anything that does not meet very high standards

examples.en: As a perfectionist, he rewrote the opening chapter at least ten times.
examples.zh: 作为一个完美主义者，他将开篇第一章至少重写了十遍。

lemmas.def_zh: 至善论, 过度追求尽善尽美, 圆满论
lemmas.def_en: a disposition to feel that anything less than perfect is unacceptable

examples.en: His extreme perfectionism caused him undue stress and constant project delays.
examples.zh: 他极端的完美主义给自己带来了不必要的压力并导致项目延期。

lemmas.def_zh: 可完美性, 可改善性
lemmas.def_en: the capability of becoming perfect

examples.en: The philosopher argued for the moral perfectibility of humanity over time.
examples.zh: 这位哲学家主张人类的道德随着时间推移具有可改善性。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 perficere（per- 完全 + facere 制作/完成），本义为“彻底完成的”，引申出“毫无瑕疵的”、“完全的”及“使之趋于极致”。
family_guide.core_distinction: perfect 形容词与动词同形但重音不同：形容词读 /ˈpɜːfɪkt/，动词读 /pəˈfekt/；perfection 为其抽象名词形态。

lemmas.def_zh: 婴孩
lemmas.def_en: a very young child (birth to 1 year) who has not yet begun to walk or talk

examples.en: Stop trying to baby him; he needs to learn independence.
examples.zh: 别再娇惯他了，他需要学会独立。

lemmas.def_zh: 婴儿时代, 幼稚
lemmas.def_en: the early stage of growth or development

examples.en: She has kept a few cherished mementos from her daughter's babyhood.
examples.zh: 她保留了几件珍贵的女儿婴儿时期的纪念品。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 婴儿
lemmas.def_en: treat with excessive indulgence

examples.en: Stop trying to baby him; he needs to learn independence.
examples.zh: 别再娇惯他了，他需要学会独立。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于模仿婴儿咿呀学语的拟声词，核心意象为“幼小且需呵护”，后由名词“婴儿”自然引申出动词“像对待婴儿一样娇惯、悉心照顾”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词作核心指婴儿或亲手打造的心血项目；动词则侧重“过分纵容、溺爱”或“格外小心翼翼地对待”。

lemmas.def_zh: 喝，饮；喝酒
lemmas.def_en: to take liquid into the mouth and swallow it; to consume alcohol

examples.en: Make sure you drink plenty of water during hot weather.
examples.zh: 天气炎热时务必多喝水。

examples.en: He doesn't drink, so he offered to be the designated driver.
examples.zh: 他不喝酒，所以主动提出当指定驾驶员。

lemmas.def_zh: 喝，饮（drink 的过去式）
lemmas.def_en: past tense of drink

examples.en: She drank a cup of hot tea before going to bed.
examples.zh: 她睡前喝了一杯热茶。

lemmas.def_zh: 喝，饮；喝酒
lemmas.def_en: to take liquid into the mouth and swallow it; to consume alcohol

examples.en: Make sure you drink plenty of water during hot weather.
examples.zh: 天气炎热时务必多喝水。

examples.en: He doesn't drink, so he offered to be the designated driver.
examples.zh: 他不喝酒，所以主动提出当指定驾驶员。

lemmas.def_zh: drink的过去式
lemmas.def_en: a chronic drinker

examples.en: The police pulled him over because he was visibly drunk.
examples.zh: 警察将他拦下，因为他明显喝醉了。

lemmas.def_zh: 饮者, 酒徒
lemmas.def_en: a person who drinks liquids

examples.en: He is known to be a heavy drinker on the weekends.
examples.zh: 大家都知道他周末经常开怀畅饮。

lemmas.def_zh: 酒鬼
lemmas.def_en: a chronic drinker

examples.en: The village drunkard stumbled out of the noisy pub and wandered into the dark alley.
examples.zh: 村里的酒鬼跌跌撞撞地走出嘈杂的酒吧，游荡进黑暗的小巷。

lemmas.def_zh: 喝醉了的
lemmas.def_en: stupefied or excited by a chemical substance (especially alcohol)

examples.en: The police pulled him over because he was visibly drunk.
examples.zh: 警察将他拦下，因为他明显喝醉了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 drincan，本义指“吞咽液体”，在日常演变中特化出“饮酒”之意，并进一步衍生出描述过量饮酒状态（醉）的形、名派生词。
family_guide.core_distinction: drank 是过去式动词；drunk 作形容词表示“喝醉的”（常作表语），作名词指“醉汉/酒鬼”，勿与过去分词作定语的 drunken 混淆。

lemmas.def_zh: 收集，采集；聚集；收取，领取
lemmas.def_en: to bring together things or people from different places; to gather

examples.en: She likes to collect rare coins and stamps from around the world.
examples.zh: 她喜欢收集来自世界各地的罕见钱币和邮票。

examples.en: A small crowd began to collect outside the courthouse.
examples.zh: 法院外开始聚集起一小群人。

lemmas.def_zh: 收藏品，收集物；收集，聚集；（服装等）系列
lemmas.def_en: a group of objects gathered together; the act or process of collecting

examples.en: The museum boasts an extensive collection of modern art.
examples.zh: 该博物馆拥有丰富的现代艺术藏品。

examples.en: The fashion designer unveiled her new spring collection in Milan.
examples.zh: 这位时装设计师在米兰发布了她的春季新系列。

lemmas.def_zh: 收藏家；收集者；征收员，催缴员
lemmas.def_en: a person who collects objects of a particular type, or someone who collects money owed

examples.en: He is an avid collector of antique books and manuscripts.
examples.zh: 他是一位古籍和手稿的狂热收藏家。

examples.en: She works as a tax collector for the municipal government.
examples.zh: 她在市政府担任税务征收员。

lemmas.def_zh: [经] 可收回的
lemmas.def_en: things considered to be worth collecting (not necessarily valuable or antique)

examples.en: Vintage action figures have become a popular collectible among adults.
examples.zh: 老式可动人偶已成为成年人间颇受欢迎的收藏品。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 不安的, 狼狈的, 未收集的
lemmas.def_en: not brought together in one place

examples.en: Several parcels remained uncollected at the neighborhood post office.
examples.zh: 社区邮局里有好几个包裹仍未被领取。

lemmas.def_zh: [财]不能收回的款项
lemmas.def_en: not capable of being collected

examples.en: The bank had to write off the overdue loan as uncollectible debt.
examples.zh: 银行不得不将该笔逾期贷款注销为死账坏账。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 colligere（com- 共同 + legere 挑选/聚集），核心逻辑为“从不同地方挑选并汇聚到一处”。
family_guide.core_distinction: collection 指收集的行为、过程或聚集而成的“成果/藏品”（事物），collector 则指执行收集动作的“人”（主体）。

lemmas.def_zh: 城镇，市镇；市中心，商业区
lemmas.def_en: a built-up area larger than a village and smaller than a city, with defined boundaries and local government

examples.en: She grew up in a quiet coastal town with a population of just a few thousand.
examples.zh: 她在一个人口只有几千人的宁静海滨小镇长大。

examples.en: Are you going into town this afternoon to run some errands?
examples.zh: 你今天下午要去市中心办点事吗？

lemmas.def_zh: （北美等地的）镇区，乡；（南非的）黑人居住区
lemmas.def_en: a subdivision of a county in North America with local government; a segregated urban settlement for non-white people in South Africa

examples.en: The township provides essential public services such as road maintenance and emergency response.
examples.zh: 该镇区提供诸如道路维护和应急响应等基本公共服务。

examples.en: Soweto is one of the most famous townships established outside Johannesburg during the apartheid era.
examples.zh: 索韦托是种族隔离时期在约翰内斯堡郊外建立的最著名的黑人居住区之一。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 tūn（围场、村庄住宅），核心意象为被围聚的人类定居点，后指规模介于乡村与城市之间的城镇，并衍生出相应的基层行政区划概念。
family_guide.core_distinction: town 指实体聚落“城镇”或市中心；township 多指行政管理意义上的“镇区/乡”，或特指南非历史上的有色人种聚集区。

lemmas.def_zh: 路，道路，马路；途径，手段
lemmas.def_en: a specially prepared hard surface for vehicles and people to travel on; a way or route leading to a specific result

examples.en: We hit the road early in the morning to avoid the heavy holiday traffic.
examples.zh: 我们一清早就上路了，以避开拥挤的假期车流。

examples.en: Continuous practice and dedication are the only reliable road to mastering a language.
examples.zh: 持续的练习和专注是掌握一门语言唯一可靠的途径。

lemmas.def_zh: 无路的
lemmas.def_en: lacking pathways

examples.en: The research team hiked through miles of roadless wilderness to reach camp.
examples.zh: 科研队徒步穿过数英里无路的荒野到达营地。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 rād（骑行、旅程），与 ride 同源，原指‘骑马出行的旅途’，后具体化指代供人车通行的‘道路’，并引申为通向特定结果的‘途径’。

lemmas.def_zh: 面孔的一部分(如眼、口等), 特征, 容貌, 特色, 特写
lemmas.def_en: a prominent attribute or aspect of something

examples.en: Tonight's concert will feature several guest performances by famous local artists.
examples.zh: 今晚的音乐会将由几位当地知名艺术家担任特邀嘉宾演出。

lemmas.def_zh: 是...的特色, 特写, 放映；起重要作用
lemmas.def_en: have as a feature

examples.en: Tonight's concert will feature several guest performances by famous local artists.
examples.zh: 今晚的音乐会将由几位当地知名艺术家担任特邀嘉宾演出。

lemmas.def_zh: 无特色的, 平凡的
lemmas.def_en: lacking distinguishing characteristics or features

examples.en: They drove across a vast and featureless desert under the scorching sun.
examples.zh: 他们在炎炎烈日下驱车穿过一片广袤而单调的沙漠。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 facere（做、形成），原指‘成型之物的外观与轮廓’，由此演变出‘外貌面容’与‘显著特征’，动词进一步引申为‘以……为特色/主打’。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词侧重指事物具有代表性的‘特点、要素或特写报道’；动词则表示‘突出展示、起用……主演或作为主要构成’。

lemmas.def_zh: 可获得的；可利用的；有空的
lemmas.def_en: able to be used or obtained; free to see or talk to people

examples.en: Tickets are readily available online or at the box office.
examples.zh: 门票可以在网上或售票处轻松买到。

examples.en: The manager is not available to take your call right now.
examples.zh: 经理现在没空接听您的电话。

lemmas.def_zh: 无法得到的；难以获取的；没空的
lemmas.def_en: not able to be used, bought, or accessed; too busy to meet or talk

examples.en: The item you requested is temporarily unavailable.
examples.zh: 您所申请的物品暂时缺货。

examples.en: The senator was unavailable for comment on the allegations.
examples.zh: 该参议员抽不出空对这些指控发表评论。

lemmas.def_zh: 可利用性；可得性；空闲时间
lemmas.def_en: the state of being able to be used or obtained; the state of being free to do something

examples.en: Hotel prices fluctuate depending on room availability.
examples.zh: 酒店价格会根据空房情况浮动。

examples.en: Please let me know your availability for a brief meeting this week.
examples.zh: 请告诉我你本周哪天有空开个简短的会议。

lemmas.def_zh: 效用, 利益
