lemmas.def_en: a means of serving

examples.en: They tried every possible solution, but all their efforts were to no avail.
examples.zh: 他们尝试了所有可能的解决方案，但所有的努力都毫无效果。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 无效性, 不可用性
lemmas.def_en: the quality of not being available when needed

examples.en: The temporary unavailability of the server disrupted our daily operations.
examples.zh: 服务器的暂时不可用打乱了我们的日常运营。

lemmas.def_zh: 有用, 有利；有利于
lemmas.def_en: use to one's advantage

examples.en: They tried every possible solution, but all their efforts were to no avail.
examples.zh: 他们尝试了所有可能的解决方案，但所有的努力都毫无效果。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 valere（有力量、有价值），演变为“能发挥效用、派得上用场的”，引申为“可利用的、可获得的”或人的“有空的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 模型, 模范, 模特儿
lemmas.def_en: a hypothetical description of a complex entity or process

examples.en: She worked part-time to model autumn clothes for a local boutique.
examples.zh: 她做兼职为当地一家精品店展示秋装做模特。

lemmas.def_zh: [计]模型作者, 造型者, 模型工
lemmas.def_en: a person who creates models

examples.en: The talented 3D modeler created realistic textures for the upcoming video game.
examples.zh: 这位才华横溢的三维建模师为即将推出的电子游戏制作了逼真的纹理。

lemmas.def_zh: 做模型, 做模特儿；使模仿, 塑造
lemmas.def_en: plan or create according to a model or models

examples.en: She worked part-time to model autumn clothes for a local boutique.
examples.zh: 她做兼职为当地一家精品店展示秋装做模特。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 modulus（小度量，modus'尺度、方式'的指小词），核心语义由'标准、衡量尺度'演化为'事物的范本、模拟表现物或供人效仿的标准'。

lemmas.def_zh: 相当，颇；宁可，宁愿；更确切地说；相反
lemmas.def_en: to a fairly large degree; used to indicate preference, correction, or contrast

examples.en: I think I would rather stay in tonight than go to the party.
examples.zh: 我想我今晚宁愿呆在家里，也不想去参加派对。

examples.en: The exam was rather more difficult than we had expected.
examples.zh: 这次考试比我们预想的要难得多。

examples.en: He didn't panic; rather, he calmly assessed the situation.
examples.zh: 他没有惊慌失措，相反，他冷静地评估了局势。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语表示“更早、更快”的比较级形式（rathe 的比较级），语义从“时间上更抢先”演变为“意愿上更倾向（宁可）”，进而虚化出修正常见表达（确切地说）与程度修饰（相当、颇）。

lemmas.def_zh: 不久；很快；早
lemmas.def_en: in or after a short time; early

examples.en: The doctor said she should be able to go home soon.
examples.zh: 医生说她应该很快就能回家了。

examples.en: Please let us know your decision as soon as possible.
examples.zh: 请尽快让我们知道你的决定。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 sōna，本义为“立刻、马上”，后语义逐渐弱化为“不久、在较短时间内”。

lemmas.def_zh: 是否；无论（是……还是……）
lemmas.def_en: expressing a doubt or choice between alternatives; indicating that something is true in either case

examples.en: I haven't decided whether to accept the job offer or stay where I am.
examples.zh: 我还没决定是接受这份工作邀请还是留守原地。

examples.en: Whether we win or lose, we must give it our all.
examples.zh: 无论胜负如何，我们都必须全力以赴。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语表示“两者之中的哪一个”，核心演化为引导二选一的选择从句、间接疑问从句或表示“无论何种情况”的让步从句。

lemmas.def_zh: 代理人，经纪人；特工，间谍；动因，媒介/剂
lemmas.def_en: a person who acts on behalf of another; a person who works secretly for an intelligence organization; a substance that causes a particular effect

examples.en: She decided to hire a literary agent to help pitch her novel to major publishers.
examples.zh: 她决定聘请一位文学经纪人，帮她把小说推介给各大出版社。

examples.en: Soap acts as an emulsifying agent that allows water and oil to mix.
examples.zh: 肥皂作为一种乳化剂，能使水和油融合在一起。

lemmas.def_zh: 代理机构，中介公司；（政府）专门机构/局；能动性，作为
lemmas.def_en: a business or organization providing a specific service; a government department; the capacity to act independently and make choices

examples.en: The advertising agency launched a nationwide campaign to rebrand the company.
examples.zh: 这家广告公司发起了一场全国性的宣传活动，以重塑该公司的品牌形象。

examples.en: Education empowers individuals and gives them a greater sense of personal agency.
examples.zh: 教育能够赋能个人，并让他们拥有更强的主观能动性。

lemmas.def_zh: 代理商的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to an agent or agency

examples.en: The company redefined its agential agreements to attract more regional distributors.
examples.zh: 该公司重新修订了代理协议，以吸引更多区域分销商。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 agere（行动、驱使、做），核心语义围绕“行动的施加者”展开，延伸至“代为行事的人/机构”或“产生作用的媒介/力量”。
family_guide.core_distinction: agent 侧重具体的“执行者、代理人或作用媒介”（个体/物质），而 agency 侧重“代理机构、专门服务局”或抽象的“自主行动力/作用”。

lemmas.def_zh: 从前的, 前者的
lemmas.def_en: referring to the first of two things or persons mentioned (or the earlier one or ones of several)

examples.en: He consulted his former manager before making the big career transition.
examples.zh: 在做出重大职业转变前，他咨询了前任经理。

lemmas.def_zh: 从前, 以前
lemmas.def_en: at a previous time

examples.en: The grand mansion was formerly used as a hospital during wartime.
examples.zh: 这座宏伟的宅邸在战时曾被用作医院。

lemmas.def_zh: 起形成作用的人(或物), 模型, 样板
lemmas.def_en: the first of two or the first mentioned of two

examples.en: He consulted his former manager before making the big career transition.
examples.zh: 在做出重大职业转变前，他咨询了前任经理。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 forma（最初的、在前的，与 fore/first 同源），核心逻辑指时间或次序上“更在前的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词 former 表示“从前的”或“前者的”；加 the 转化为代名词 the former 专指两者中的“前者”（与 the latter 相对）；副词 formerly 则表示“从前、昔日”。

lemmas.def_zh: 穿；戴；留（发、须）；磨损；经受
lemmas.def_en: to have clothing or accessories on the body; to damage or become damaged by continuous use

examples.en: She usually wears a simple silver necklace to work.
examples.zh: 她上班通常戴着一条简约的银项链。

examples.en: Constant friction will eventually wear down the surface.
examples.zh: 持续的摩擦最终会磨损表面。

lemmas.def_zh: 穿；戴；磨损（wear 的过去式）
lemmas.def_en: past tense of wear

examples.en: He wore a tailored navy suit to the annual gala.
examples.zh: 他穿着一套定制的藏青色西装出席了年度盛会。

lemmas.def_zh: wear的过去分词
lemmas.def_en: be dressed in

examples.en: His favorite hiking boots were worn down after years of rough use.
examples.zh: 经过多年的粗暴磨损，他最心爱的登山靴已经破旧不堪。

lemmas.def_zh: 用旧的, 穿旧的
lemmas.def_en: affected by wear; damaged by long use

examples.en: His favorite hiking boots were worn down after years of rough use.
examples.zh: 经过多年的粗暴磨损，他最心爱的登山靴已经破旧不堪。

lemmas.def_zh: 不(再)适合穿戴的, 破旧的,不合身的
lemmas.def_en: not suitable for wear or able to be worn

examples.en: The sweater shrunk in the wash, making it completely unwearable.
examples.zh: 那件毛衣洗后缩水了，变得完全没法穿。

lemmas.def_zh: 衣服
lemmas.def_en: a covering designed to be worn on a person's body

examples.en: The company sells comfortable wearables designed for everyday office workers.
examples.zh: 该公司销售专为日常上班族设计的舒适服装。

lemmas.def_zh: 穿用者
lemmas.def_en: a person who wears or carries or displays something as a body covering or accessory

examples.en: The bright jacket keeps the wearer clearly visible in heavy rain.
examples.zh: 这件鲜艳的夹克让穿用者在暴雨中清晰可见。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 werian（穿戴、披盖），从身体的“穿戴、佩戴”引申出因长期穿用使用而导致的“磨损、消耗、衰竭”。
family_guide.core_distinction: wore 是过去式谓语动词；worn 兼具动词过去分词与独立形容词用法，作形容词时特指器物“磨损破旧”或人容颜“疲惫憔悴”。

lemmas.def_zh: 木板, 甲板, 膳食, 会议桌
lemmas.def_en: a committee having supervisory powers

examples.en: Passengers must show their tickets before they board the morning train.
examples.zh: 乘客在登上早班火车前必须出示车票。

lemmas.def_zh: 寄膳者, 寄膳宿者
lemmas.def_en: a tenant in someone's house

examples.en: The host family welcomed a new boarder for the upcoming semester.
examples.zh: 寄宿家庭迎来了下学期的新寄膳宿者。

lemmas.def_zh: 乘船, 供膳食, 用板覆盖；搭伙
lemmas.def_en: get on board of (trains, buses, ships, aircraft, etc.)

examples.en: Passengers must show their tickets before they board the morning train.
examples.zh: 乘客在登上早班火车前必须出示车票。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古英语意为“木板”，由平整的木板引申出就餐的桌子（伙食/寄宿）、会议桌（董事会/委员会）以及船身侧舷（上船/登机/乘车）。

lemmas.def_zh: 快的，迅速的；敏捷的；短暂的
lemmas.def_en: done with speed; taking or lasting only a short time; prompt

examples.en: Let me have a quick look at your report before the meeting starts.
examples.zh: 会议开始前让我快速看一眼你的报告。

examples.en: She was quick to notice the subtle change in his tone.
examples.zh: 她敏锐地察觉到了他语气中的微妙变化。

lemmas.def_zh: 快速地，迅速地；立刻
lemmas.def_en: at a fast speed; rapidly; after a short time

examples.en: He quickly realized that he had taken the wrong train.
examples.zh: 他很快意识到自己坐错了火车。

examples.en: The wildfire spread quickly due to the strong winds.
examples.zh: 由于强风，山火迅速蔓延开来。

lemmas.def_zh: 急速, 迅速, 速度
lemmas.def_en: skillful performance or ability without difficulty

examples.en: Her remarkable quickness of mind helped solve the crisis in minutes.
examples.zh: 她敏捷的思维帮助在几分钟内化解了危机。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 cwic（活着的、有生气的），由“生机勃勃、反应灵敏”引申出“迅速的、短暂敏捷的”现代核心含义。
family_guide.core_distinction: quick 主要作形容词修饰人或事物的性质（口语中偶作副词），quickly 为标准副词，用于修饰动作完成的速度。

lemmas.def_zh: 电影；电影院
lemmas.def_en: a story or event recorded by a camera as a series of moving images and shown in a cinema or on a screen

examples.en: We decided to go to the movies this weekend to catch the latest sci-fi blockbuster.
examples.zh: 我们决定这个周末去看电影，看最新上映的科幻大片。

examples.en: Her debut movie received rave reviews at the international film festival.
examples.zh: 她的导演处女作在国际电影节上获得了极高评价。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自短语 moving picture（活动画面）的口语缩略形式（move + -ie），字面即“会动的图像”，演变为现代指代电影的标准口语词汇。

lemmas.def_zh: 种族, 人种, 赛跑, 比赛, 急流, 人类, 同道, 姜根
lemmas.def_en: any competition

examples.en: Paramedics had to race against time to save the injured hiker.
examples.zh: 医护人员必须与时间赛跑以挽救受伤的徒步者。

lemmas.def_zh: 比赛者, 游蛇属黑蛇
lemmas.def_en: someone who drives racing cars at high speeds

examples.en: The skilled racer took the sharp corner without losing any speed.
examples.zh: 这位技术娴熟的赛手没有减速就通过了急转弯。

lemmas.def_zh: 赛跑, 竞赛, 疾走；与...赛跑, 使疾走, 使猛转
lemmas.def_en: move fast

examples.en: Paramedics had to race against time to save the injured hiker.
examples.zh: 医护人员必须与时间赛跑以挽救受伤的徒步者。

lemmas.def_zh: 人种的, 种族的
lemmas.def_en: of or related to genetically distinguished groups of people

examples.en: The new law aims to eliminate racial discrimination in the workplace.
examples.zh: 新法律旨在消除工作场所中的种族歧视。

lemmas.def_zh: 保持原味的, 活泼的, 生动的, 为竞赛设计的
lemmas.def_en: full of zest or vigor

examples.en: The author became famous after publishing a racy novel about high society.
examples.zh: 该作家在出版了一部描写上流社会的活泼大胆的小说后成名。

lemmas.def_zh: 非种族（歧视）的
lemmas.def_en: not racial; having nothing to do with race or races

examples.en: They fought hard to establish a completely nonracial and democratic society.
examples.zh: 他们努力建立一个完全无种族偏见的民主社会。

lemmas.def_zh: 按人种, 人种上
lemmas.def_en: with respect to race

examples.en: The neighborhood has become a vibrant, racially integrated community over time.
examples.zh: 随着时间推移，该社区已成为一个充满活力的多种族融合社区。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于历史上的同形异源演变，现代英语中并存两大核心意象：一是表示速度维度的“奔跑、竞赛”，二是表示生物与社会维度的“血统、种族”。
family_guide.core_distinction: race 可兼指“比赛”与“种族”，但派生形容词 racial 专指“种族的/人种的”，与速度竞争无关。

lemmas.def_zh: 常见的，普遍的；共同的，共有的；普通的，平常的
lemmas.def_en: occurring or found often; shared by two or more people or things; ordinary

examples.en: Fatigue and headaches are common symptoms of stress.
examples.zh: 疲倦和头痛是压力的常见症状。

examples.en: They put aside their differences to work toward a common goal.
examples.zh: 他们搁置分歧，为了一个共同的目标而努力。

lemmas.def_zh: 不寻常的，罕见的；非凡的，突出的
lemmas.def_en: not frequently experienced or occurring; unusual or remarkable

examples.en: It is not uncommon for young children to feel anxious about the dark.
examples.zh: 年幼的孩子害怕黑暗是屡见不鲜的事。

examples.en: She possesses uncommon courage in the face of adversity.
examples.zh: 面对逆境，她展现出了非凡的勇气。

lemmas.def_zh: 通常，往往；普遍地
lemmas.def_en: very often; usually; by most people

examples.en: The plant is commonly known as the peace lily.
examples.zh: 这种植物通常被称为白掌（和平百合）。

examples.en: These two terms are commonly confused with each other.
examples.zh: 这两个术语经常被互相混淆。

lemmas.def_zh: 非常, 极其, 罕见地, 难得地, 非凡地
lemmas.def_en: exceptionally

examples.en: It was an uncommonly warm day for the middle of December.
examples.zh: 对十二月中旬而言，那天异常温暖。

lemmas.def_zh: 常见的，普遍的；共同的，共有的；普通的，平常的
lemmas.def_en: occurring or found often; shared by two or more people or things; ordinary

examples.en: Fatigue and headaches are common symptoms of stress.
examples.zh: 疲倦和头痛是压力的常见症状。

examples.en: They put aside their differences to work toward a common goal.
examples.zh: 他们搁置分歧，为了一个共同的目标而努力。

lemmas.def_zh: 平民, 自费学生, 有共用权的人
lemmas.def_en: a person who holds no title

examples.en: The prince shocked everyone by choosing to marry a local commoner.
examples.zh: 王子选择与一位当地平民结婚，震惊了所有人。

lemmas.def_zh: 共同特性, 平民百姓
lemmas.def_en: a class composed of persons lacking clerical or noble rank

examples.en: Despite their different backgrounds, the two artists share a striking creative commonality.
examples.zh: 尽管背景不同，这两位艺术家在创作上却有着惊人的共同特性。

lemmas.def_zh: 普通, 平凡, 共性
lemmas.def_en: the state of being that is commonly observed

examples.en: The plain commonness of the design made it blend into the background.
examples.zh: 该设计的普通平凡使其融入了背景之中。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 communis（com- 共同 + munis 责任/职责，引申为共同承担或拥有的），核心语义从“公众共有的、共享的”延伸为“普遍经历的、常见的、平民的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: common 兼作形容词（普遍的、共同的）和名词（公地、共有特征），其否定前缀派生词 uncommon 侧重强调“罕见的、异乎寻常的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 公园；园区；停放（车辆）；暂搁（想法等）
lemmas.def_en: a large public green area, or an area for a specific purpose (n.); to bring a vehicle to a halt and leave it, or to set aside temporarily (v.)

examples.en: We took a peaceful stroll through the park after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后我们在公园里悠闲地散了会儿步。

examples.en: It is difficult to find a space to park downtown during rush hour.
examples.zh: 在高峰时段，市中心很难找到停车位。

examples.en: Let's park that proposal for now and focus on urgent matters.
examples.zh: 我们先把那个提议放一放，专注于眼前紧急的事务。

lemmas.def_zh: 公园；园区；停放（车辆）；暂搁（想法等）
lemmas.def_en: a large public green area, or an area for a specific purpose (n.); to bring a vehicle to a halt and leave it, or to set aside temporarily (v.)

examples.en: We took a peaceful stroll through the park after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后我们在公园里悠闲地散了会儿步。

examples.en: It is difficult to find a space to park downtown during rush hour.
examples.zh: 在高峰时段，市中心很难找到停车位。

examples.en: Let's park that proposal for now and focus on urgent matters.
examples.zh: 我们先把那个提议放一放，专注于眼前紧急的事务。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 停放着的，停泊的
lemmas.def_en: (of a vehicle) left in a particular place temporarily
lemmas.usage_note: 常作定语修饰车辆，如 a parked car, parked vehicles。

examples.en: The delivery truck collided with a parked car along the narrow street.
examples.zh: 那辆送货卡车在狭窄的街道上撞上了一辆停放着的轿车。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古法语“围场”，最初指圈定用于狩猎或圈存牲畜的封闭场地，后引申为公共休闲的“公园”以及集中停放车辆设备的场地，进而衍生出动词“停放（车辆）”。

lemmas.def_zh: 目标，目的；（体育）球门，进球得分
lemmas.def_en: an aim or desired result; the area into which a ball must be put to score, or the point scored

examples.en: She set a clear goal and worked tirelessly to achieve it.
examples.zh: 她确立了一个明确的目标，并不懈努力去实现它。

examples.en: The striker scored a stunning goal in the final minutes of the match.
examples.zh: 前锋在比赛的最后几分钟打进了一记精彩的进球。

lemmas.def_zh: （比赛结果）零比零的
lemmas.def_en: having no points scores

examples.en: The exciting match surprisingly ended in a goalless draw last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚那场精彩的比赛出人意料地以零比零握手言和。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于中世纪英语表示“边界、终点界标”的词汇，后演化为球类比赛中的“球门/终点”，最终抽象引申为人生或行动意图达成的“目标”。

lemmas.def_zh: 准备好的, 备用的, 可以使用的
lemmas.def_en: completely prepared or in condition for immediate action or use or progress

examples.en: They began to ready the old cabin for the harsh winter months.
examples.zh: 他们开始整理准备好这间老木屋，以迎接严酷的寒冬。

examples.en: The crew boarded the readied aircraft just minutes before scheduled departure.
examples.zh: 机组人员在预定起飞前几分钟登上了备妥的飞机。

lemmas.def_zh: 没预备的, 没准备的, 不敏捷的
lemmas.def_en: not prepared or in a state of readiness; slow to understand or respond

examples.en: The sudden market shift caught several unready businesses completely off guard.
examples.zh: 突如其来的市场变化让几家毫无准备的企业措手不及。

lemmas.def_zh: 预备好的状态, 现款
lemmas.def_en: poised for action

examples.en: They began to ready the old cabin for the harsh winter months.
examples.zh: 他们开始整理准备好这间老木屋，以迎接严酷的寒冬。

lemmas.def_zh: 预备, 准备, 敏捷
lemmas.def_en: the state of having been made ready or prepared for use or action (especially military action)

examples.en: The troops maintained constant readiness to respond quickly to any sudden emergency.
examples.zh: 部队保持随时戒备状态，以便迅速应对任何突发紧急情况。

lemmas.def_zh: 迅速地, 轻易地, 乐意地
lemmas.def_en: without much difficulty

examples.en: He readily accepted the challenging assignment without asking for extra compensation.
examples.zh: 他欣然接受了这项艰巨的任务，没有要求任何额外报酬。

lemmas.def_zh: 使准备好
lemmas.def_en: prepare for eating by applying heat

examples.en: They began to ready the old cabin for the harsh winter months.
examples.zh: 他们开始整理准备好这间老木屋，以迎接严酷的寒冬。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语表示“适于骑行、有条理”的词汇，核心语义聚焦于“处于完备、敏捷待命的状态”，由此引申出就绪、现成及欣然行动之意。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词 ready 多用于固定搭配（如 at the ready 处于戒备状态）或俚语指现款，而 readiness 专指抽象的“准备就绪”或“意愿”；副词 readily 兼有“乐意地”和“容易地”两层含义。

lemmas.def_zh: 科学；自然科学；学科
lemmas.def_en: the systematic study of the physical and natural world through observation and experiment

examples.en: Recent advances in medical science have led to breakthroughs in cancer treatment.
examples.zh: 医学科学的最新进展促成了癌症治疗的重大突破。

lemmas.def_zh: 科学家；科研工作者
lemmas.def_en: a person who is studying or has expert knowledge of one or more natural or physical sciences

examples.en: A team of research scientists is analyzing the soil samples from the expedition.
examples.zh: 一个科研专家团队正在分析此次考察采集的土壤样本。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 scire（知道、认知），从“获得知晓的体系”演变为系统的“科学知识”，进而派生出从事科学探索的人。
family_guide.core_distinction: science 指科学学科或知识体系本身，scientist 指从事科学研究的个体专家。

lemmas.def_zh: 大学；学院；高等专科学校；学会，公会
lemmas.def_en: an institution of higher education or specialized professional training; an organized body of persons engaged in a common pursuit

examples.en: She decided to live in a dormitory during her first year of college.
examples.zh: 她决定大学第一年住在学校宿舍里。

examples.en: He was recently elected as a fellow of the Royal College of Physicians.
examples.zh: 他最近当选为英国皇家内科医学院的院士。

lemmas.def_en: an associate that one works with
lemmas.def_zh: 同事, 同僚

examples.en: My colleague helped me finish the financial report before the Friday deadline.
examples.zh: 我的同事在周五截止日期前帮我完成了财务报告。

lemmas.def_zh: 学校的, 大学的, 大学生的, 社团的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by or having authority vested equally among colleagues; ; - Merle Fainsod

examples.en: The faculty members maintain a collegial and deeply supportive work environment.
examples.zh: 全体教职员工保持着融洽协作且极具支持性的工作环境。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 collegium（由 col- 共同 + leg- 聚集/法律 构成），原指‘为了共同职责结合在一起的群体或协会’，后引申为提供高等教育的学术共同体（学院/大学）或行业专门学会。

lemmas.def_zh: 在……之中；在……之间；作为……之一
lemmas.def_en: in the middle of or surrounded by others; being a member of a larger group

examples.en: She felt completely relaxed among close friends.
examples.zh: 在挚友之间，她感到彻底的放松。

examples.en: The novel is widely considered among the greatest literary works of the century.
examples.zh: 这部小说被广泛认为是本世纪最伟大的文学作品之一。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语“on gemang”（处于人群或混合物中），核心逻辑表示置身于三者及以上的群体、复数对象或包围环境之中。

lemmas.def_zh: 我自己；我亲自
lemmas.def_en: used as the object of a verb or preposition when the speaker is also the subject; used to emphasize 'I' personally

examples.en: I accidentally cut myself while preparing dinner.
examples.zh: 我做晚饭时不小心切到了自己。

examples.en: I prefer to handle this matter myself rather than delegate it.
examples.zh: 我更倾向于亲自处理这件事，而不是委派给他人。

family_guide.root_logic: 由物主代词 'my'（我的）与名词 'self'（自身/本人）复合而成，核心用于第一人称单数的反身指代（动作作用于自身）或语气强调（亲自）。

lemmas.def_zh: 你自己；你亲自
lemmas.def_en: used as the object of a verb or preposition when the person spoken to is the subject, or used for emphasis

examples.en: Please make yourself at home and have some coffee.
examples.zh: 请随意，当成自己家一样，喝点咖啡吧。

examples.en: You don't need anyone's permission to be yourself.
examples.zh: 做你自己无需获得任何人的允许。

family_guide.root_logic: 由形容词性物主代词 your 与表示主体的 self 复合而成，用作第二人称单数的反身代词或强调代词，指代听话者本人。
family_guide.core_distinction: yourself 专用于指代单一听话者（单数），指代两个或两个以上的人时须使用复数形式 yourselves。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 商店，店铺；储备，储藏量；v. 储存，储藏；（在电脑中）存储
lemmas.def_en: n. a shop, or a supply kept for future use; v. to keep or accumulate for future use, or to hold data

examples.en: She bought some fresh groceries at the local convenience store.
examples.zh: 她在当地的便利店买了些新鲜食品。

examples.en: Squirrels store nuts in autumn to ensure they have food for the winter.
examples.zh: 松鼠在秋天储存坚果，以确保冬天有食物吃。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 储存，储藏；存储空间；保管
lemmas.def_en: the action or method of storing something; space available for keeping things or data

examples.en: We put our furniture into storage while the new apartment was being renovated.
examples.zh: 新公寓装修期间，我们把家具放进了仓库保管。

examples.en: My smartphone is running out of internal storage capacity.
examples.zh: 我的智能手机内部存储空间快用完了。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 商店，店铺；储备，储藏量；v. 储存，储藏；（在电脑中）存储
lemmas.def_en: n. a shop, or a supply kept for future use; v. to keep or accumulate for future use, or to hold data

examples.en: She bought some fresh groceries at the local convenience store.
examples.zh: 她在当地的便利店买了些新鲜食品。

examples.en: Squirrels store nuts in autumn to ensure they have food for the winter.
examples.zh: 松鼠在秋天储存坚果，以确保冬天有食物吃。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 estorer（装备、供应、建立），其核心逻辑是“为了应对未来需求而准备或留存”，后引申出具体的“储备量”以及售卖储备货品的“商店”。
family_guide.core_distinction: store 既可指具体的“店铺”或“储备物”，也可作动词表示“储存”；storage 则是纯名词，专指“储存行为、储藏状态或可用的存储空间”。

lemmas.def_zh: 完成, 结束, 用完, 毁掉；结束
lemmas.def_en: come or bring to a finish or an end

examples.en: Please finish reading the final report before submitting your official feedback.
examples.zh: 请在提交正式反馈意见之前读完这份最终报告。

lemmas.def_zh: 完成, 结束, 末道漆, 磨光, 完美
lemmas.def_en: a decorative texture or appearance of a surface (or the substance that gives it that appearance)

examples.en: The wooden dining table has a smooth and elegant glossy finish.
examples.zh: 这张木质餐桌表面光滑，带有优雅的光泽。

lemmas.def_zh: 完工者, 精整工, 整理工, 精轧机, 末道清棉机, 决定性的事件
lemmas.def_en: (baseball) a relief pitcher who can protect a lead in the last inning or two of the game

examples.en: Every marathon finisher received a commemorative medal at the final gate.
examples.zh: 每位马拉松完赛者都在终点处获得了一枚纪念奖牌。

lemmas.def_zh: 未完成的
lemmas.def_en: not brought to the desired final state

examples.en: He left the draft unfinished before rushing out to catch the train.
examples.zh: 他在匆忙赶火车之前，留下了未完成的草稿。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 finis（界限、尽头、终结），核心逻辑是“到达边界或最终状态”，由此衍生出“完成/结束事物”以及“给物体做最后一道加工修饰（使表面达到最终状态）”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动名词 finish 兼具“终结”与“表面打磨/饰面”两层含义，而否定形容词 unfinished 同样可指“未做完的”或“（木材、建筑等）未经最后涂装修饰的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 位置, 空间, 距离, 太空, 空白, 间隔, (期刊等的)篇幅
lemmas.def_en: the unlimited expanse in which everything is located

examples.en: There is enough space in the trunk for three large travel suitcases.
examples.zh: 后备箱里有足够的空间放三个大旅行箱。

lemmas.def_zh: 宽广；宽敞
lemmas.def_en: spatial largeness and extensiveness (especially inside a building)

examples.en: The high ceilings add a pleasant sense of spaciousness to the living room.
examples.zh: 高挑的天花板为客厅增添了宜人的宽敞感。

lemmas.def_zh: 空间性
lemmas.def_en: any property relating to or occupying space

examples.en: Modern architecture often explores the fluid relationship between structure and spatiality.
examples.zh: 现代建筑常常探讨结构与空间性之间的流动关系。

lemmas.def_zh: 隔开, 分隔；留间隔
lemmas.def_en: place at intervals

examples.en: There is enough space in the trunk for three large travel suitcases.
examples.zh: 后备箱里有足够的空间放三个大旅行箱。

lemmas.def_zh: 空间的；与空间相关的
lemmas.def_en: relating to space and the relationship, position, or size of things in it

examples.en: Architects must possess excellent spatial awareness when designing structures.
examples.zh: 建筑师在设计建筑物时必须具备出色的空间感知能力。

lemmas.def_zh: 广大的, 宽广的
lemmas.def_en: very large in expanse or scope

examples.en: They recently moved into a spacious apartment near the central city park.
examples.zh: 他们最近搬进了市中心公园附近一套宽敞的公寓。

lemmas.def_zh: 空间的, 存在于空间的
lemmas.def_en: pertaining to or involving or having the nature of space

examples.en: The artist created an impressive spacial installation using mirrors and neon lights.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家利用镜子和霓虹灯创作了一个令人印象深刻的空间装置。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 空间地
lemmas.def_en: with regard to space

examples.en: The researchers mapped how the animal populations were spatially distributed across the island.
examples.zh: 研究人员绘制了岛上动物种群在空间分布上的图谱。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 spatium（广度、间隔、延展），核心意象指代物质之间未被占用的“空隙、距离”或三维“延展维度”。
family_guide.core_distinction: space 作动词时特指“按间隔排列”，其派生形容词 spatial 则专用于学术和技术语境，表示“空间维度的、与空间相关的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 做标记于, 留意, 打分数, 表明, 标志, 记录；作记号, 记得分
lemmas.def_en: attach a tag or label to

examples.en: The teacher will mark the final exam papers over the coming weekend.
examples.zh: 老师将在即将到来的周末批改期末试卷。

lemmas.def_zh: 标志, 分数, 马克, 痕迹, 斑点, 靶子, 刻度, 记号, 符号, 戳记, 标准, 起跑线
lemmas.def_en: a number or letter indicating quality (especially of a student's performance)

examples.en: The teacher will mark the final exam papers over the coming weekend.
examples.zh: 老师将在即将到来的周末批改期末试卷。

lemmas.def_zh: 印记, 印, 分
lemmas.def_en: a distinguishing symbol

examples.en: The leopard has distinctive black markings across its golden-yellow fur coat.
examples.zh: 这只花豹金黄色的皮毛上有着独特的黑色斑纹。

lemmas.def_zh: 作记号的人, 记分员, 书签, 纪念碑, 里程碑, 标识物, 标记
lemmas.def_en: some conspicuous object used to distinguish or mark something

examples.en: She used a red permanent marker to highlight the most important deadlines.
examples.zh: 她用红色记号笔标出了最重要的截止日期。

lemmas.def_zh: 显著地, 醒目地, 明显地
lemmas.def_en: in a clearly noticeable manner

examples.en: Patient recovery rates improved markedly after the introduction of the new treatment.
examples.zh: 采用新疗法后，患者的康复率显著提高。

lemmas.def_zh: 未被注意的, 无记号的, 无标志的
lemmas.def_en: not having an identifying mark

examples.en: The detectives arrived at the crime scene in an unmarked police vehicle.
examples.zh: 便衣刑警乘一辆无标志的警车抵达了案发现场。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语，核心语义为“边界、可见的界标”，后演化为“留下印记、做符号”，进而引申出“标志时刻、评估打分”等抽象含义。
family_guide.core_distinction: mark 侧重印记、污痕或分数本身；marking 多指动植物体表的天然斑纹、路面划线或阅卷行为；marker 则指用作标志的物体、工具（如马克笔）或生物指示标志。

lemmas.def_zh: 享受，喜爱；享有，拥有（有益之物）
lemmas.def_en: to take pleasure in something; to possess and benefit from something

examples.en: I really enjoy reading historical fiction in my spare time.
examples.zh: 闲暇时我非常喜欢读历史小说。

examples.en: The company continues to enjoy a strong reputation worldwide.
examples.zh: 该公司在全球范围内持续享有良好声誉。

lemmas.def_zh: 乐趣，享受；享有，使用（权）
lemmas.def_en: the state or process of taking pleasure in something; a source of pleasure

examples.en: She plays the piano purely for her own enjoyment.
examples.zh: 她弹钢琴纯粹是为了自得其乐。

examples.en: The bad weather slightly spoiled our enjoyment of the trip.
examples.zh: 糟糕的天气稍微减损了我们旅途的兴致。

lemmas.def_zh: enjoy的变形
lemmas.def_en: a person who delights in having or using or experiencing something

examples.en: As a passionate enjoyer of classical music, he attends every local symphony concert.
examples.zh: 作为古典音乐的狂热爱好者，他参加了当地每一场交响音乐会。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自前缀 en-（使处于……状态）+ joy（快乐），核心逻辑是“使置身于喜悦中”，引申为从人事物中体验到乐趣或享有某种益处。

lemmas.def_zh: 存在；生存，存活
lemmas.def_en: to have actual being or objective reality; to stay alive

examples.en: Scientists are still investigating whether life can exist on other planets.
examples.zh: 科学家们仍在研究其他星球上是否存在生命。

examples.en: It is difficult for a family to exist on such a small income.
examples.zh: 一个家庭仅靠这么一点收入很难维持生计。

lemmas.def_zh: 存在，实在；生存，生活方式
lemmas.def_en: the state or fact of living or having objective reality; a way of living

examples.en: This ancient tradition came into existence several centuries ago.
examples.zh: 这项古老的传统形成于几个世纪之前。

examples.en: She led a quiet and peaceful existence in the countryside.
examples.zh: 她在乡间过着平静安详的生活。

lemmas.def_zh: 不存在的事, 无, 不存在的东西
lemmas.def_en: the state of not existing

examples.en: Ancient philosophers frequently debated the mysterious boundary between absolute existence and nonexistence.
examples.zh: 古代哲学家经常辩论绝对存在与虚无之间的神秘界限。

lemmas.def_zh: 现存的；存在的
lemmas.def_en: having reality or being; currently existing

examples.en: The new regulations apply to both newly built and already existent structures.
examples.zh: 新规既适用于新建建筑，也适用于现存建筑。

examples.en: Many philosophic debates focus on whether ideas are real and existent entities.
examples.zh: 许多哲学争论都集中在观念是否属于真实存在的实体。

lemmas.def_zh: 有关存在的
lemmas.def_en: derived from experience or the experience of existence; - Benjamin Farrington; - John Dewey

examples.en: Climate change poses a serious existential threat to low-lying island nations worldwide.
examples.zh: 气候变化对全球低洼岛国构成了严重的生存威胁。

lemmas.def_zh: 不存在的
lemmas.def_en: not having existence or being or actuality

examples.en: Public transportation in this remote mountain village is practically nonexistent during winter.
examples.zh: 在冬季，这个偏远山村的公共交通几乎不存在。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 exsistere（ex- '向外' + sistere '站立'），本义为'显露、站立出来'，后引申为客观上有形态、有实体地'存在、活着'。
family_guide.core_distinction: existent 作形容词表示'现存的、存在的'（强调客观事实，现代英语也常由 existing 代替），区别于名词形式 existence（存在状态）及动词 exist（存在/生存）。

lemmas.def_zh: 出售，销售；特卖，减价促销；销售量（常用复数）
lemmas.def_en: the exchange of goods or property for money; an event where items are sold at reduced prices; the quantity sold

examples.en: The apartment is officially up for sale, but the owner is in no rush to sell.
examples.zh: 这套公寓已正式挂牌出售，但房主并不急于出手。

examples.en: I managed to get this designer coat on sale at a fifty percent discount.
examples.zh: 我在降价特卖时以五折的优惠买到了这件名牌大衣。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 sala（交付、转让），核心语义是指通过出让物品所有权以换取金钱的行为，并延伸指代降价特卖活动及销售总量。

lemmas.def_zh: 高品质的；纤细的；晴朗的；健康的
lemmas.def_en: of high quality; thin or delicate; sunny and dry; well

examples.en: She has a fine eye for detail in architectural design.
examples.zh: 她在建筑设计方面对细节有着敏锐的鉴赏力。

examples.en: The artist used a fine brush to paint the delicate feathers.
examples.zh: 画家用一支细画笔来描绘细腻的羽毛。

lemmas.def_zh: （潜水时）用脚蹼划水；割取（鱼等）的鳍
lemmas.def_en: to swim using fins or flippers; to remove the fins from a fish

examples.en: The diver finned slowly through the reef to avoid kicking up silt.
examples.zh: 潜水员轻轻打水游过礁石区，以免扬起泥沙。

lemmas.def_zh: 细致地；精巧地；切碎地
lemmas.def_en: into very small pieces; in a subtle, delicate, or excellent manner

examples.en: Add two tablespoons of finely chopped parsley to the sauce.
examples.zh: 在酱汁中加入两汤匙切碎的欧芹末。

examples.en: The engine is a finely tuned piece of machinery.
examples.zh: 这台发动机是一件经过精准调校的机械装置。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 扫描
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being very good indeed

examples.en: The extreme fineness of the optical scanner allows it to capture microscopic details.
examples.zh: 该光学扫描仪极高的精细度使其能够捕捉微观细节。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 finis（界限、终点），引申出“发展到极致、完备成型”之意，进而在英语中演化出“优良、精细、纤小”等核心语义。
family_guide.core_distinction: fine 为基础形容词（优良/纤细）；finely 为副词，多修饰加工方式（如切碎、精调）；fin 作动词则特指（潜水时）打水划行或切除鱼鳍。

lemmas.def_zh: 温习, 检讨, 评论, 再检察, 复审；复习功课, 写评论
lemmas.def_en: look at again; examine again

examples.en: The supervisory committee will review your project proposal at tomorrow morning's meeting.
examples.zh: 监督委员会将在明天上午的会议上审查你的项目提案。

lemmas.def_zh: 检讨, 复习, 回顾, 检阅, 评论
lemmas.def_en: a new appraisal or evaluation

examples.en: The supervisory committee will review your project proposal at tomorrow morning's meeting.
examples.zh: 监督委员会将在明天上午的会议上审查你的项目提案。

lemmas.def_zh: 评论者, 书评作者, 评论家, 剧评家, 报刊评论家
lemmas.def_en: someone who reads manuscripts and judges their suitability for publication

examples.en: The literary reviewer praised the young author for her remarkably vivid storytelling.
examples.zh: 这位文学评论家称赞了这位年轻作家极其生动的叙事能力。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 re-（再次）+ view（看），核心语义为“再次查看”，引申出“审查/复审”、“复习备考”以及“发表评论”等多维含义。

lemmas.def_zh: 到达, 达到, 伸出, 延伸, 影响；达到, 延伸, 伸出手, 传到
lemmas.def_en: reach a destination, either real or abstract

examples.en: We hope to reach our holiday destination before the heavy snow begins.
examples.zh: 我们希望在大雪来临之前到达度假目的地。

lemmas.def_zh: 伸出, 延伸, 区域, 范围, 流域, 岬
lemmas.def_en: the limits within which something can be effective

examples.en: The rare bird can only be found in the upper reaches of the river.
examples.zh: 这种珍稀鸟类只能在河流的上游区域找到。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古英语，核心意象为“肢体向前伸展”，由此引申出空间上的“触碰、抵达”、认知与目标上的“达成”，以及社交上的“联系与影响”。

lemmas.def_zh: 前面, 开头, 前线, 阵线, 态度
lemmas.def_en: the side that is forward or prominent

examples.en: A united front is essential for the team to win the championship.
examples.zh: 建立统一的阵线对于球队赢得冠军至关重要。

lemmas.def_zh: 额骨, 祭坛(前面的)帏帘, (建筑物的)正面
lemmas.def_en: an adornment worn on the forehead

examples.en: The museum displays an ancient frontal decorated with gold and silk.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出了一件饰有黄金和丝绸的古老祭坛帏帘。

lemmas.def_zh: 房子的正面, 前方, 临街地
lemmas.def_en: the extent of land abutting on a street or water

examples.en: The new hotel boasts a wide frontage along the main shopping street.
examples.zh: 这家新酒店在主要的商业街上拥有宽阔的临街面。

lemmas.def_zh: 面对, 朝向, 对抗；朝向
lemmas.def_en: be oriented in a certain direction, often with respect to another reference point; be opposite to

examples.en: A united front is essential for the team to win the championship.
examples.zh: 建立统一的阵线对于球队赢得冠军至关重要。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or located in the front

examples.en: A united front is essential for the team to win the championship.
examples.zh: 建立统一的阵线对于球队赢得冠军至关重要。

lemmas.def_zh: 前面地
lemmas.def_en: in, at, or toward the front

examples.en: The troops decided not to attack frontally due to heavy enemy defenses.
examples.zh: 由于敌军防守严密，部队决定不从正面进攻。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 frons（额头、面容），核心意象为身体或物体朝外的“最前端”，由此衍生出空间上的“正面/前线”、抽象的“外观/掩护假象”，以及动词的“面对/主导”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 同形多词性转换：名词强调前端空间、战线或伪装门面；形容词定语表示前方的；动词表示朝向某处或担任公众代表/领衔人物。

lemmas.def_zh: 快速的, 紧的
lemmas.def_en: acting or moving or capable of acting or moving quickly

examples.en: He decided to fast for twenty-four hours before the medical procedure.
examples.zh: 他决定在医疗手术前禁食二十四小时。

lemmas.def_zh: 绝食, 斋戒
lemmas.def_en: abstain from certain foods, as for religious or medical reasons

examples.en: He decided to fast for twenty-four hours before the medical procedure.
examples.zh: 他决定在医疗手术前禁食二十四小时。

lemmas.def_zh: 要塞, 巩固, 迅速
lemmas.def_en: a rate (usually rapid) at which something happens

examples.en: The rebels hid safely inside their mountain fastness for several months.
examples.zh: 叛军在他们的山中要塞里安全地躲藏了数月。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语核心词根，本义为“牢固、坚挺、坚守”，后引申为紧随不舍的“快速”（形容词），以及恪守戒律不食的“斋戒、禁食”（动词）。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词 fast 现主要表示“快速的”（保留少数如 fast asleep, hold fast 的“牢固”古义）；动词 fast 专指在宗教或健康背景下的“禁食/斋戒”。

lemmas.def_zh: 为……提供资金；筹措资金；贷款购买；财政；金融；财务状况
lemmas.def_en: to provide money or funds for; the management of large amounts of money

examples.en: The commercial bank agreed to finance the construction of the new hospital.
examples.zh: 该商业银行同意为新医院的建设提供资金。

examples.en: She works in international finance and advises multinational corporations.
examples.zh: 她从事国际金融工作，为跨国公司提供咨询服务。

lemmas.def_zh: 为……提供资金；筹措资金；贷款购买；财政；金融；财务状况
lemmas.def_en: to provide money or funds for; the management of large amounts of money

examples.en: The commercial bank agreed to finance the construction of the new hospital.
examples.zh: 该商业银行同意为新医院的建设提供资金。

examples.en: She works in international finance and advises multinational corporations.
examples.zh: 她从事国际金融工作，为跨国公司提供咨询服务。

lemmas.def_zh: 财政的；金融的；财务的
lemmas.def_en: connected with money, banking, or investments

examples.en: The startup sought independent financial advice before launching its initial public offering.
examples.zh: 这家初创公司在首次公开募股前寻求了独立的财务建议。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 非财务性；非金融性；非金融
lemmas.def_en: not involving financial matters

examples.en: Job satisfaction is an important nonfinancial reward for many dedicated employees.
examples.zh: 工作满意度是许多敬业员工的重要非财务回报。

lemmas.def_zh: 经济上；财政上；财务方面
lemmas.def_en: in a way that relates to money or financial resources

examples.en: The venture proved to be financially viable despite initial market skepticism.
examples.zh: 尽管最初市场持怀疑态度，但事实证明这项投资在经济上是可行的。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 finer（了结、结算），核心义由“支付款项以解决债务”引申为现代的“资金筹集、分配与金钱管理”。
family_guide.core_distinction: finance 作动词强调“出资/融资行为”，作名词侧重“资金本身或金融体系”；派生词 financial 与 financially 词义规则，分别作定语和状语修饰经济财务状态。

lemmas.def_zh: 使相配, 使比赛, 与...竞争；结婚, 相配
lemmas.def_en: be compatible, similar or consistent; coincide in their characteristics

examples.en: We watched an exciting tennis match that lasted for over three hours.
examples.zh: 我们观看了一场持续了三个多小时的精彩网球比赛。

lemmas.def_zh: 错配, 使...成不相配的婚姻
lemmas.def_en: match badly; match two objects or people that do not go together

examples.en: There is a clear mismatch between his stated goals and his actions.
examples.zh: 他的既定目标与实际行动之间存在明显的脱节。

lemmas.def_zh: 比赛, 火柴, 对手
lemmas.def_en: lighter consisting of a thin piece of wood or cardboard tipped with combustible chemical; ignites with friction

examples.en: We watched an exciting tennis match that lasted for over three hours.
examples.zh: 我们观看了一场持续了三个多小时的精彩网球比赛。

lemmas.def_zh: 错配
lemmas.def_en: a bad or unsuitable match

examples.en: There is a clear mismatch between his stated goals and his actions.
examples.zh: 他的既定目标与实际行动之间存在明显的脱节。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 匹配程序, 配对程序
lemmas.def_en: someone who arranges (or tries to arrange) marriages for others

examples.en: The algorithm includes a pattern matcher to identify duplicate text files.
examples.zh: 该算法包含一个模式匹配程序，用于识别重复的文本文件。

lemmas.def_zh: 无比的, 无匹敌的, 不相配的
lemmas.def_en: of the remaining member of a pair, of socks e.g.

examples.en: Her dedication to public service remains unmatched by any other candidate.
examples.zh: 她对公共服务的奉献精神是其他任何候选人都无法比拟的。

lemmas.def_zh: 无敌的, 无比的
lemmas.def_en: eminent beyond or above comparison

examples.en: The soprano received a standing ovation for her matchless vocal performance.
examples.zh: 这位女高音因其无可比拟的歌唱表现赢得了全场起立鼓掌。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语‘伴侣、对等者’，核心逻辑始终围绕‘平等对等、彼此契合或互为对手’展开，引申出配对、相称以及力量相当的竞争较量（火柴一义则源自古法语‘灯芯’的词形融合）。

lemmas.def_zh: 数字, 价格, 图形, 形状
lemmas.def_en: a diagram or picture illustrating textual material

examples.en: I figure we should leave early to avoid the heavy morning traffic.
examples.zh: 我认为我们应该早点出发，以避开早晨拥挤的交通。

lemmas.def_zh: 定形, 成形
lemmas.def_en: representing figuratively as by emblem or allegory

examples.en: The artist explored the delicate figuration of human forms in his sculptures.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家在他的雕塑作品中探索了人体形态的精致定形。

lemmas.def_zh: 描绘, 表示, 演算, 认为；计算, 出现, 估计
lemmas.def_en: judge to be probable

examples.en: I figure we should leave early to avoid the heavy morning traffic.
examples.zh: 我认为我们应该早点出发，以避开早晨拥挤的交通。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 figura（外形、塑造），核心概念是‘勾画出的轮廓’，由可见的‘人体轮廓/外貌’、‘数字/图表符号’延伸到心智中的‘构想、计算与理解’。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词侧重可见的具体轮廓（身材、人物、数字、图表），动词则侧重心理建构或在局势中‘显现轮廓’（认为、计算、起作用）。

lemmas.def_zh: 虽然；尽管
lemmas.def_en: in spite of the fact that; even though

examples.en: Although the weather was terrible, they decided to carry on with the hike.
examples.zh: 虽然天气很糟糕，他们还是决定继续徒步。

examples.en: He decided to accept the job offer, although the salary was lower than he expected.
examples.zh: 尽管薪水低于预期，他还是决定接受这份工作邀请。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中古英语复合结构“all + though”，字面意为“全然如此；即便全都这样”，核心逻辑是引出让步状语从句，以已知或退让的事实来反衬主句的转折结果。
family_guide.core_distinction: 家族成员单一；常与 though 辨析：although 仅用作从属连词且语气更正式，不可像 though 那样置于句末作副词。

lemmas.def_zh: 最初的, 原始的, 有创意的
lemmas.def_en: preceding all others in time or being as first made or performed

examples.en: The author kept the original manuscript safely locked in his office desk.
examples.zh: 作者将手稿的原作安全地锁在办公室的抽屉里。

lemmas.def_zh: 非原先的, 无独创精神的, 模仿的, 抄袭的
lemmas.def_en: not original; not being or productive of something fresh and unusual; ; - Gwethalyn Graham

examples.en: Critics dismissed the new movie as an unoriginal copy of older thrillers.
examples.zh: 影评人批评这部新电影是对老派惊悚片的缺乏创意的抄袭。

lemmas.def_zh: 原物, 原作
lemmas.def_en: an original creation (i.e., an audio recording) from which copies can be made

examples.en: The author kept the original manuscript safely locked in his office desk.
examples.zh: 作者将手稿的原作安全地锁在办公室的抽屉里。

lemmas.def_zh: 创意, 新奇, 独创能力, 原始
lemmas.def_en: the ability to think and act independently

examples.en: Her interior designs always show great originality and a sense of fun.
examples.zh: 她的室内设计总是展现出极高的独创性和趣味感。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 负有不可推卸的
lemmas.def_en: uncreativeness due to a lack of originality

examples.en: The critic dismissed the script due to the blatant unoriginality of its main plot.
examples.zh: 批评家因该剧本主线情节毫无新意而对其不屑一顾。

lemmas.def_zh: 本来, 原来, 最初, 就起源而论, 独创地
lemmas.def_en: in an original manner

examples.en: We had originally planned to travel by train, but we decided to fly instead.
examples.zh: 我们原本打算坐火车旅行，但后来决定改乘飞机。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 origo（起源、源头），核心意象为“自源头而来的”，因此引申出“最初的/原本的”，以及由此衍生出的“未受抄袭的/独创的、新颖的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意 original 作名词时指具体的“原件、原作”，而非抽象的“起源、根源”（后者用 origin）。

lemmas.def_zh: 政策；方针；原则；保险单
lemmas.def_en: a set of ideas or plans that is used as a basis for making decisions, especially in politics, economics, or business; a document showing an agreement with an insurance company

examples.en: The company has adopted a strict policy against remote work, requiring all staff to return to the office.
examples.zh: 公司采取了严格禁止远程办公的政策，要求所有员工重返办公室。

examples.en: You should check the terms of your insurance policy to see what types of damage are covered.
examples.zh: 你应该查看保险单条款，确认涵盖了哪些类型的损失。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 polis（城邦）及 politeia（公民事务、治理），引申为组织或个人处理公共或私人事务的行为准则与既定方针。

lemmas.def_zh: 母亲, 修女院长
lemmas.def_en: a woman who has given birth to a child (also used as a term of address to your mother)

examples.en: My mother taught me the importance of kindness and patience during my childhood years.
examples.zh: 我的母亲在我童年时期教会了我善良与耐心的重要性。

lemmas.def_zh: 母道, 母性, 母亲们
lemmas.def_en: the kinship relation between an offspring and the mother

examples.en: She found that balancing a demanding career with early motherhood was an immense challenge.
examples.zh: 她发现，在忙碌的事业与初为人母的生活之间取得平衡是个巨大的挑战。

lemmas.def_zh: 产生, 照看, 收养
lemmas.def_en: care for like a mother

examples.en: My mother taught me the importance of kindness and patience during my childhood years.
examples.zh: 我的母亲在我童年时期教会了我善良与耐心的重要性。

lemmas.def_zh: 母亲的
lemmas.def_en: befitting a mother; warm and nurturing

examples.en: The teacher offered some gentle, motherly advice to comfort the visibly distressed young student.
examples.zh: 老师提供了些许温和而慈母般的建议，以安慰那位明显沮丧的学生。

lemmas.def_zh: 无母的
lemmas.def_en: having no living or known mother

examples.en: The charity works tirelessly to support motherless children across several impoverished rural communities.
examples.zh: 该慈善机构不知疲倦地工作，以支持几个贫困农村社区的丧母儿童。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语核心亲属词，本义指女性亲生父母，后自然引申为生命的起源、孕育之地，以及动词层面的悉心照护或过度关切。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词侧重身份与源头（母亲、发源地），动词则侧重行为过程，常含“像母亲般呵护”或带有轻微负面色彩的“过分溺爱/管得太宽”。

lemmas.def_zh: 颜色, 面色, 颜料, 外貌
lemmas.def_en: a visual attribute of things that results from the light they emit or transmit or reflect

examples.en: Bright shades of color filled the artist's canvas, creating a vibrant and cheerful mood.
examples.zh: 明亮的色彩填满了画家的画布，营造出充满活力且欢快的氛围。

lemmas.def_zh: （人的天然）肤色，发色；着色剂，色素；着色风格
lemmas.def_en: the natural color of someone's skin, hair, and eyes; a substance used to change color

examples.en: Pastel shades look best on someone with pale coloring.
examples.zh: 柔和的粉彩色调穿在肤色白皙的人身上最好看。

examples.en: The recipe calls for a few drops of natural food coloring.
examples.zh: 这个食谱需要几滴天然食用色素。

lemmas.def_zh: 着色, 特色, 色彩, 天然颜色
lemmas.def_en: the timbre of a musical sound

examples.en: The vivid coloration of the tropical frog warns predators that its skin is poisonous.
examples.zh: 这种热带青蛙鲜艳的体色警告捕食者它的皮肤有毒。

lemmas.def_zh: 善于运用色彩的画家, 配色师, 着色师
lemmas.def_en: a painter able to achieve special effects with color

examples.en: The director hired an experienced colorist to enhance the visual tone of the film.
examples.zh: 导演聘请了一位经验丰富的调色师来提升电影的视觉色调。

lemmas.def_zh: 把...涂上颜色, 粉饰, 使脸红, 歪曲；变色
lemmas.def_en: add color to

examples.en: Bright shades of color filled the artist's canvas, creating a vibrant and cheerful mood.
examples.zh: 明亮的色彩填满了画家的画布，营造出充满活力且欢快的氛围。

lemmas.def_zh: 使...有色彩
lemmas.def_en: add color to

examples.en: The studio decided to colorize the classic black-and-white documentary for modern television audiences.
examples.zh: 电影制片厂决定给这部经典黑白纪录片上色，以面向现代电视观众。

lemmas.def_en: having or capable of producing colors

examples.en: Bright shades of color filled the artist's canvas, creating a vibrant and cheerful mood.
examples.zh: 明亮的色彩填满了画家的画布，营造出充满活力且欢快的氛围。

lemmas.def_zh: 五彩斑斓的，色彩鲜艳的；丰富多彩的，生动有趣的
lemmas.def_en: having bright colors; full of interest, variety, or excitement

examples.en: The dancers wore colorful traditional costumes during the parade.
examples.zh: 游行期间，舞者们穿着鲜艳夺目的传统服装。

examples.en: He led a colorful life before becoming an acclaimed writer.
examples.zh: 在成为广受好评的作家之前，他过着丰富多彩的生活。

lemmas.def_zh: 无色的
lemmas.def_en: lacking in variety and interest

examples.en: Pure water is a completely colorless and odorless liquid under normal room temperature conditions.
examples.zh: 纯净水在常温条件下是一种完全无色无味的液体。

lemmas.def_zh: 未染色的, 本色的, 未加彩色的, 未着色的, (喻)未加渲染的, 不夸张的
lemmas.def_en: without color

examples.en: The furniture was crafted from uncolored oak, preserving the natural beauty of the wood.
examples.zh: 这件家具由未染色的橡木制成，保留了木材的天然美感。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 color（颜色、外貌、肤色），核心语义始终围绕“视觉色彩与外观表现”展开，并引申出“上色、润色”及“带有特定视角/偏见”的抽象内涵。
family_guide.core_distinction: color 作定语形容词专指技术上的“彩色的（非黑白）”；colorful 强调“色彩缤纷的”或比喻意义上的“生动丰富的”；coloring 侧重天然肤色/发色或添加的着色剂（色素）。

lemmas.def_zh: 进军, 前进, 交界；使行军, 使行进
lemmas.def_en: march in a procession

examples.en: The soldiers had to march through the heavy rain to reach the base camp.
examples.zh: 士兵们不得不冒着大雨行军以抵达大本营。

lemmas.def_zh: 三月, 进行, 行军, 步伐, 长途跋涉, 进行曲, 边界
lemmas.def_en: the month following February and preceding April

examples.en: The soldiers had to march through the heavy rain to reach the base camp.
examples.zh: 士兵们不得不冒着大雨行军以抵达大本营。

lemmas.def_zh: 边界地区居民, 行进者, 游行者, 行军者
lemmas.def_en: an inhabitant of a border district

examples.en: Each peaceful marcher carried a sign advocating for civil rights and fair labor laws.
examples.zh: 每位和平游行者都举着倡导民权和公平劳动法的标语牌。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 marcher（踏步、行进），核心意象为步伐整齐、坚定、有节奏的推进，后引申为示威抗议以及事物不可阻挡的发展进程。

lemmas.def_zh: 六的，六个的；六，六个
lemmas.def_en: equivalent to the number five plus one; the number 6

examples.en: She works six days a week at the hospital.
examples.zh: 她每周在医院工作六天。

examples.en: The shop closes at six in the evening.
examples.zh: 这家店晚上六点关门。

lemmas.def_zh: 六的，六个的；六，六个
lemmas.def_en: equivalent to the number five plus one; the number 6

examples.en: She works six days a week at the hospital.
examples.zh: 她每周在医院工作六天。

examples.en: The shop closes at six in the evening.
examples.zh: 这家店晚上六点关门。

lemmas.def_zh: 得六分的击球
lemmas.def_en: the cardinal number that is the sum of five and one

examples.en: The batsman hit a spectacular sixer that sent the ball flying into the crowd.
examples.zh: 击球手击出一记精彩的六分球，球径直飞入了人群中。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语数词根 *swéḱs，经原始日耳曼语进入古英语，语义始终稳定指代基数词“六”，兼具限定修饰（形容词）与实体代指（名词）功能。

lemmas.def_zh: 税, 税款, 重负, 会费
lemmas.def_en: charge against a citizen's person or property or activity for the support of government

examples.en: The government introduced a new environmental tax to discourage the use of plastic bags.
examples.zh: 政府出台了一项新的环保税，以限制塑料袋的使用。

lemmas.def_zh: 课税, 征税, 抽税, 税款, 估定的税额
lemmas.def_en: charge against a citizen's person or property or activity for the support of government

examples.en: High levels of taxation often spark intense debate about government spending and economic growth.
examples.zh: 高额征税往往会引发关于政府支出和经济增长的激烈辩论。

lemmas.def_zh: 可征税性
lemmas.def_en: liability to taxation

examples.en: The accountant thoroughly reviewed the taxability of the foreign income earned by the client.
examples.zh: 会计师彻底审查了该客户获得的海外收入的应税资格。

lemmas.def_zh: 课以税, 使负重荷, 斥责
lemmas.def_en: levy a tax on

examples.en: The government introduced a new environmental tax to discourage the use of plastic bags.
examples.zh: 政府出台了一项新的环保税，以限制塑料袋的使用。

lemmas.def_zh: 可征税的, 应征税的
lemmas.def_en: (of goods or funds) subject to taxation

examples.en: Bonus payments are treated as taxable income under the current state and federal regulations.
examples.zh: 根据现行的州和联邦法规，奖金被视为应纳税所得。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 应征税；不补课税的
lemmas.def_en: (of goods or funds) not subject to taxation

examples.en: Certain employee benefits, such as basic health insurance, are considered nontaxable perks by law.
examples.zh: 根据法律，某些员工福利（如基本医疗保险）被视为非应税待遇。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 taxare（估价、评定），核心逻辑由对财富的“评估与核算”引申为强制收取的“税费”，进一步引申出施加“沉重负担与考验”之意。
family_guide.core_distinction: tax 多指具体的单项税费、税种（可数）或具体的负担；taxation 则是抽象概念，专指征税行为、国家税收制度或总体税收。

lemmas.def_zh: 西方, 西部
lemmas.def_en: the countries of (originally) Europe and (now including) North America and South America

examples.en: The sun begins to set slowly in the west.
examples.zh: 太阳开始在西方缓缓落下。

lemmas.def_zh: 西风
lemmas.def_en: the winds from the west that occur in the temperate zones of the Earth

examples.en: A chilly westerly blew across the plains all afternoon.
examples.zh: 整个下午都有一股寒冷的西风吹过平原。

lemmas.def_zh: 西方的, 向西的
lemmas.def_en: situated in or facing or moving toward the west

examples.en: The sun begins to set slowly in the west.
examples.zh: 太阳开始在西方缓缓落下。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语中表示‘傍晚、夜晚’的词根，即太阳落下的方位，核心概念始终为‘西方’。
family_guide.core_distinction: west 作为名词表示西方、西部方位或西方世界；作为形容词修饰名词，表示西部的、向西的或自西向东吹的（如风）。

lemmas.def_zh: 连结, 联合, 挽住；连接起来
lemmas.def_en: make a logical or causal connection

examples.en: A new highway will link the two neighboring cities.
examples.zh: 一条新公路将连接这两个相邻的城市。

lemmas.def_zh: 环, 连结物, 链接, 火把
lemmas.def_en: the means of connection between things linked in series

examples.en: A new highway will link the two neighboring cities.
examples.zh: 一条新公路将连接这两个相邻的城市。

lemmas.def_zh: 联合, 连锁, 结合, 联动
lemmas.def_en: an associative relation

examples.en: Scientists study the close linkage between diet and health.
examples.zh: 科学家研究饮食与健康之间的紧密联系。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺斯语，原始核心意象为锁链中的“单环（ring of a chain）”，由此演化为物理上的“连接、系紧”以及抽象层面的“纽带、关联与互联网链接”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词强调“使相连、建立关联”的动作，名词指代“环节、纽带、关联物或超链接”本身。

lemmas.def_zh: 父亲, 祖先, 长辈, 神父, 创始者
lemmas.def_en: a male parent (also used as a term of address to your father)

examples.en: His father taught him how to ride a bicycle.
examples.zh: 他的父亲教他如何骑自行车。

lemmas.def_zh: 当...的父亲, 保护, 创作, 发明, 培养
lemmas.def_en: make children

examples.en: His father taught him how to ride a bicycle.
examples.zh: 他的父亲教他如何骑自行车。

lemmas.def_zh: 无父的
lemmas.def_en: having no living father

examples.en: The charity provides support for poor fatherless children.
examples.zh: 该慈善机构为贫困的单亲丧父儿童提供支持。

lemmas.def_zh: 父亲的, 如父亲的, 慈爱的
lemmas.def_en: like or befitting a father or fatherhood; kind and protective

examples.en: He gave the young man some warm, fatherly advice.
examples.zh: 他给那个年轻人提了一些温和、如父亲般的建议。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语表示男系亲代的核心词，基本义为‘父亲’，后引申指始祖、先驱、神职人员，动词化后引申为‘成为……的生父’或‘开创/奠基’。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词侧重身份（父亲/奠基人/神父），动词侧重行为（生物学意义上的生育或象征意义上的创立发端）。

lemmas.def_zh: 风扇, 迷, 狂热者, 爱好者
lemmas.def_en: a device for creating a current of air by movement of a surface or surfaces

examples.en: She turned on the electric fan to cool down.
examples.zh: 她打开电风扇来降温。

lemmas.def_zh: 粉丝群体；粉丝圈，迷界
lemmas.def_en: the community, subculture, or state of being fans of a particular person, team, fictional universe, or hobby

examples.en: The sci-fi franchise has one of the most dedicated fandoms in pop culture history.
examples.zh: 这部科幻作品拥有流行文化史上最忠诚的粉丝群体之一。

lemmas.def_zh: 煽动, 刺激, 吹拂；飘动, 成扇形散开
lemmas.def_en: strike out (a batter), (of a pitcher)

examples.en: She turned on the electric fan to cool down.
examples.zh: 她打开电风扇来降温。

family_guide.root_logic: 现代英语中的 fan 融合了两大来源：一是指扇风器具及吹拂、煽动的动作（源自拉丁语 vannus）；二是指狂热爱好者（由 fanatic 截短而来），并由此派生出爱好者文化群体 fandom。
family_guide.core_distinction: fan 指单个狂热爱好者或具体的扇子/风扇，而 fandom 带有后缀 -dom，指围绕某一对象形成的整个粉丝群体、圈子或文化生态。

lemmas.def_zh: 休息, 睡眠, 安息, 稍息, 静止, 支架, 休息处, 其余者, 剩余部分
lemmas.def_en: something left after other parts have been taken away

examples.en: You should take a short rest after long hours.
examples.zh: 长时间工作后，你应该稍作休息。

lemmas.def_zh: 不安的状态, 动荡的局面
lemmas.def_en: a state of agitation or turbulent change or development

examples.en: The rising prices caused widespread social unrest in cities.
examples.zh: 物价上涨在城市中引发了广泛的社会动荡。

lemmas.def_zh: 坐立不安；不安定
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being ceaselessly moving or active

examples.en: His inner restlessness made it hard to sit still.
examples.zh: 他内心的不安让他很难安静地坐着。

lemmas.def_zh: 雷斯特（人名）
lemmas.def_en: a person who rests

examples.en: Mr. Rester will lead the morning meeting today.
examples.zh: 雷斯特先生今天将主持早会。

lemmas.def_zh: 宁静；安憩
lemmas.def_en: the attribute of being restful

examples.en: The quiet garden offered a sense of pure restfulness.
examples.zh: 宁静的花园带来了一种纯粹的安憩感。

lemmas.def_zh: 休息, 睡, 长眠, 安心, 静止, 停止, 安置, 依赖；使休息, 使支撑, 把...寄托于
lemmas.def_en: not move; be in a resting position

examples.en: You should take a short rest after long hours.
examples.zh: 长时间工作后，你应该稍作休息。

lemmas.def_zh: 不安静的, 慌张的, 休息不充分的
lemmas.def_en: worried and uneasy

examples.en: The tired child grew restless during the long flight.
examples.zh: 疲倦的孩子在漫长的飞行中变得焦躁不安。

lemmas.def_zh: 给人休息的, 素雅的, 安静的
lemmas.def_en: affording physical or mental rest

examples.en: They enjoyed a restful weekend in a small mountain cabin.
examples.zh: 他们在山间小屋度过了一个宁静放松的周末。

lemmas.def_zh: 不安地；慌张地
lemmas.def_en: in a restless manner

examples.en: He paced restlessly around the room, waiting for news.
examples.zh: 他在房间里不安地来回踱步，等待着消息。

lemmas.def_zh: 平安地；安静地
lemmas.def_en: in a restful manner

examples.en: The tired baby slept restfully through the whole night.
examples.zh: 疲惫的婴儿安稳地睡了一整夜。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 ræst，核心语义为‘停止活动、处于安歇或平静状态’，由此衍生出身体休整、心理安宁以及表示其反义‘动荡、焦躁’的派生词。
family_guide.core_distinction: unrest 常指群体或社会层面的‘动乱、动荡’；restless 则侧重指个体身心‘坐立难安的、焦躁不宁的’。

lemmas.def_zh: 在……后面；落后于；支持；是……的原因
lemmas.def_en: at or to the back of; later than or less advanced than; in support of; being the cause or explanation for

examples.en: The team worked late to ensure the project wouldn't fall behind schedule.
examples.zh: 团队加班加点工作，以确保项目进度不会落后。

examples.en: We all wondered what real motives lay behind his unexpected decision.
examples.zh: 我们都在琢磨他这个出人意料的决定背后究竟有什么真实动机。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语前缀 be-（在……边）加 hindan（后方），核心意象为“在……的背面”，由此引申出空间后方、时间滞后、抽象落后以及“居于幕后支持或造成影响”的多重含义。

lemmas.def_zh: 不；否（主要用于特定古旧短语或外来表达中）
lemmas.def_en: not; no (chiefly archaic, dialectal, or in set phrases)

examples.en: The committee debated whether or non the new policy should be enforced immediately.
examples.zh: 委员会就这项新政策是否应当立即生效展开了辩论。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语副词 non（意为“不、非”），现代英语中极少作为独立副词单独使用（多用于特定固定短语或借词表达），绝大多数情况下演化为高频否定前缀 non-。
family_guide.core_distinction: 作为独立副词使用时含义为“不、否”（多见于古旧或方言表达如 whether or non），现代英语中更常作为否定前缀（non-）附加于其他词前。

lemmas.def_zh: 相当，颇；完全，十分；（用于赞同）确实如此
lemmas.def_en: to a fairly high degree; completely or entirely; used to express agreement

examples.en: The exam was quite difficult, but most students managed to pass.
examples.zh: 这次考试相当难，但大多数学生还是及格了。

examples.en: I'm not quite sure what you mean, so could you explain it again?
examples.zh: 我不太完全明白你的意思，你能再解释一遍吗？

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 quitte（免除的、清白的，与 quit/quiet 同源），原义为“彻底地、完全地”（即债务或义务彻底结清），后在现代英语中衍生出程度弱化后的“相当、颇”之意。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意拼写与词义极易混淆的同源词：quite（副词，相当/完全）、quiet（形容词，安静的）、quit（动词，放弃/停止）。

lemmas.def_zh: 连接；加入；结合；参与
lemmas.def_en: to connect two or more things together; to become a member of a group or participate in an activity

examples.en: A narrow bridge joins the small island to the mainland.
examples.zh: 一座窄桥将小岛与大陆连接了起来。

examples.en: Would you like to join us for dinner after the meeting?
examples.zh: 会议结束后你愿意和我们一起吃晚饭吗？

lemmas.def_en: the place where two or more things come together
lemmas.def_zh: 连接, 会合处, 交叉点

examples.en: Turn left when you reach the junction of the two main highways.
examples.zh: 到达两条主干道交汇处时向左转。

lemmas.def_zh: 接合, 连接, 接缝
lemmas.def_en: an event that occurs at a critical time

examples.en: At this critical juncture, we must carefully consider all available options.
examples.zh: 在这个关键时刻，我们必须仔细考虑所有可行的方案。

lemmas.def_zh: 细工木匠, 接合者, 接合物
lemmas.def_en: a person who likes to join groups

examples.en: The skilled joiner built beautiful custom wooden cabinets.
examples.zh: 这位熟练的细木工制作了精美的定制木柜。

lemmas.def_zh: 由妻子继承的遗产
lemmas.def_en: (law) an estate secured to a prospective wife as a marriage settlement in lieu of a dower

examples.en: Her marriage settlement guaranteed a modest jointure to support her after his passing.
examples.zh: 她的婚前协议确保了一笔适度的遗产，以维持他去世后她的生活。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 iungere（连接、结合），核心逻辑始终围绕“将两个或多个独立实体连为一体”或“成为某个群体/活动的一部分”。

lemmas.def_zh: 忘记；遗忘；忽略
lemmas.def_en: to fail to remember; to deliberately stop thinking about something

examples.en: Don't forget to lock the door when you leave.
examples.zh: 出门时别忘了锁门。

lemmas.def_zh: 忘记；遗忘（forget 的过去式）
lemmas.def_en: past tense of forget

examples.en: I completely forgot about our appointment yesterday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我完全忘了昨天下午我们有约。

lemmas.def_zh: forget的过去分词
lemmas.def_en: dismiss from the mind; stop remembering

examples.en: I have completely forgotten where I left my keys.
examples.zh: 我完全忘记把钥匙落在哪里了。

lemmas.def_zh: forget的过去分词
lemmas.def_en: not noticed inadvertently

examples.en: I have completely forgotten where I left my keys.
examples.zh: 我完全忘记把钥匙落在哪里了。

lemmas.def_zh: 健忘的, 易忘的
lemmas.def_en: (of memory) deficient in retentiveness or range

examples.en: As he grew older, he became increasingly forgetful about where he left his glasses.
examples.zh: 随着年龄增长，他越来越容易忘记把眼镜放在哪里。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 忽视
lemmas.def_en: tendency to forget

examples.en: Her occasional forgetfulness is completely normal after working such long and exhausting hours.
examples.zh: 在工作这么长时间且疲惫不堪之后，她偶尔健忘完全正常。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 forgietan，由前缀 for-（表偏离、丧失）和 gietan（获取、抓住）构成，字面逻辑为‘未能抓住’，引申指‘从记忆中脱落、遗忘’。
family_guide.core_distinction: forgot 为过去式；forgotten 作动词时为过去分词，强调遗忘的动作或完成态；作形容词时强调‘被遗忘的、被冷落忽视的’客观状态。

lemmas.def_zh: 放下, 掉下, 下降；使滴下, 放下, 丢失, 遗漏
lemmas.def_en: let fall to the ground

examples.en: Please be careful not to drop that fragile porcelain vase on the floor.
examples.zh: 请小心，不要把那个易碎的瓷花瓶摔在地上。

lemmas.def_zh: 滴, 微量, 落下, 空投
lemmas.def_en: a shape that is spherical and small

examples.en: Please be careful not to drop that fragile porcelain vase on the floor.
examples.zh: 请小心，不要把那个易碎的瓷花瓶摔在地上。

lemmas.def_zh: 小滴
lemmas.def_en: a tiny drop

examples.en: A single droplet of water rolled slowly down the cold glass surface.
examples.zh: 一滴水珠沿着冰冷的玻璃表面缓缓滑落。

lemmas.def_zh: 滴管, 落下的人(或物)
lemmas.def_en: pipet consisting of a small tube with a vacuum bulb at one end for drawing liquid in and releasing it a drop at a time

examples.en: Use a clean glass dropper to add two small drops of medicine directly.
examples.zh: 用干净的玻璃滴管直接滴入两小滴药水。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，核心意象为“（液体）凝成颗粒状下落”，后引申为任何物体受重力掉落、数值下降或微小的量。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词主要表示“落下、掉落、降低或放弃”的动作，名词则指“水滴、微量、跌幅”等具体物或状态。

lemmas.def_zh: v. 上升，升起，上涨；n. 增加，上升，增幅
lemmas.def_en: v. to move upward, ascend, or increase; n. an upward movement or an increase in amount, number, or level

examples.en: Global temperatures continue to rise at an alarming rate.
examples.zh: 全球气温继续以惊人的速度上升。

examples.en: The company reported a sharp rise in profits this quarter.
examples.zh: 公司报告本季度利润大幅增长。

lemmas.def_zh: v. 上升，升起，上涨（rise 的过去分词）
lemmas.def_en: past participle of rise; having moved upward, increased, or appeared

examples.en: The price of crude oil has risen steadily over the past few months.
examples.zh: 在过去的几个月里，原油价格持续上涨。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 玫瑰，蔷薇；玫瑰色；罗盘方位盘
lemmas.def_en: a prickly shrub that bears fragrant flowers; a compass card or circular design

examples.en: She cut a fresh red rose from the garden to place on the dining table.
examples.zh: 她从花园里剪下一朵新鲜的红玫瑰放在餐桌上。

lemmas.def_zh: v. 上升，升起，上涨；n. 增加，上升，增幅
lemmas.def_en: v. to move upward, ascend, or increase; n. an upward movement or an increase in amount, number, or level

examples.en: Global temperatures continue to rise at an alarming rate.
examples.zh: 全球气温继续以惊人的速度上升。

examples.en: The company reported a sharp rise in profits this quarter.
examples.zh: 公司报告本季度利润大幅增长。

lemmas.def_zh: 起床者, 叛徒, 起义者, 竖板
lemmas.def_en: a person who rises (especially from bed)

examples.en: My roommate is an early riser who always goes for a morning run.
examples.zh: 我的室友是个早起的人，总是去晨跑。

lemmas.def_zh: 蔷薇状, 蔷薇色, 淡红色, 美好, 愉快
lemmas.def_en: a rosy color (especially in the cheeks) taken as a sign of good health

lemmas.def_zh: 蔷薇色的, 玫瑰红色的
lemmas.def_en: reflecting optimism

examples.en: Cold morning air gave the young children delightfully rosy cheeks during their walk.
examples.zh: 清晨凛冽的空气让散步的孩子们脸上泛起讨喜的红晕。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 rīsan（起身、升起），核心意象为“由低到高、从隐到显的向上运动”，后引申至数量增长、地位提升及发源兴起。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词 rise 的过去分词为 risen，过去式 rose 恰好与表示花卉的名词 rose（玫瑰，源自拉丁语 rosa）同形同音，需注意区分词源与词性。

lemmas.def_zh: 愿, 想要, 希望, 祝愿；希望
lemmas.def_en: hope for; have a wish

examples.en: I sincerely wish you the best of luck with your upcoming job interview.
examples.zh: 我由衷祝愿你在即将到来的求职面试中一切顺利。

lemmas.def_zh: 希望, 愿望, 祝愿, 命令, 请求
lemmas.def_en: a specific feeling of desire

examples.en: I sincerely wish you the best of luck with your upcoming job interview.
examples.zh: 我由衷祝愿你在即将到来的求职面试中一切顺利。

lemmas.def_zh: 愿望的, 渴望的, 一厢情愿的
lemmas.def_en: having or expressing desire for something

examples.en: Relying on luck alone to pass the difficult exam is merely wishful thinking.
examples.zh: 单凭运气来通过这场高难度考试纯属一厢情愿。

lemmas.def_zh: 怀有希望地; 渴望地, 希望地
lemmas.def_en: in a wishful manner

examples.en: The little boy looked wishfully through the window at the shiny new bicycle.
examples.zh: 小男孩满怀渴望地透过窗户看着那辆崭新的自行车。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语词根，核心义为“追求、渴求”，在现代英语中演变为表达对某种情况的向往期盼（常带虚拟色彩）或对他人的良好祝愿。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词与名词同形；动词接宾语从句时多用虚拟语气表达难以实现的期盼，接双宾语时表祝愿；名词常指具体许下的心愿，复数形式 wishes 常特指节日或离别时的祝福。

lemmas.def_zh: 特别的, 独有的, 挑剔的, 详尽的
lemmas.def_en: unique or specific to a person or thing or category

examples.en: She is extremely particular about the exact temperature of her morning green tea.
examples.zh: 她对早晨绿茶的具体温度要求极为挑剔。

lemmas.def_zh: 一项(或条、点), 个别项目, 详细说明
lemmas.def_en: a fact about some part (as opposed to general)

examples.en: She is extremely particular about the exact temperature of her morning green tea.
examples.zh: 她对早晨绿茶的具体温度要求极为挑剔。

lemmas.def_zh: 特殊性, 特质, 个性, 细致, 苛求
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being particular and pertaining to a specific case or instance

examples.en: Every regional dialect has its own unique particularity that reflects local cultural traditions.
examples.zh: 每种地方方言都有反映当地文化传统的独特特性。

lemmas.def_zh: 特别, 格外, 尤其, 详细地, 细致地
lemmas.def_en: to a distinctly greater extent or degree than is common

examples.en: The traffic downtown was particularly heavy this morning due to unexpected road construction.
examples.zh: 由于突发的道路施工，今早市中心的交通格外拥堵。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 particula（小部分，part 的指小词），核心逻辑为“局限于单独个体或细部”，进而引申出“特定的”、“关注细节的（挑剔）”以及“细节”之意。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词 particular 兼具“特定的”与“挑剔的”；名词多以复数 particulars 出现表示“具体细节/资料”；副词 particularly 则专指“尤其、格外”。

lemmas.def_zh: 相似的；类似的；相仿的
lemmas.def_en: having a resemblance in appearance, character, or quantity, without being identical

examples.en: Her management style is quite similar to that of her predecessor.
examples.zh: 她的管理风格与她的前任十分相似。

examples.en: The two houses are remarkably similar in design and layout.
examples.zh: 这两栋房子在设计和布局上惊人地相似。

lemmas.def_zh: 同样地；类似地
lemmas.def_en: in a similar way; likewise

examples.en: The first experiment failed, and the second attempt produced similarly disappointing results.
examples.zh: 第一次实验失败了，第二次尝试同样产生了令人失望的结果。

examples.en: Adults need seven to eight hours of sleep; similarly, teenagers require adequate rest to function well.
examples.zh: 成年人需要七到八小时的睡眠；同样地，青少年也需要充足的休息来保持良好状态。

lemmas.def_zh: 相似；相仿；相似点
lemmas.def_en: the state or fact of being similar, or a feature that things have in common

examples.en: There is a striking similarity between the two brothers.
examples.zh: 这两兄弟之间有一种惊人的相似之处。

examples.en: Researchers found several points of similarity between the two languages.
examples.zh: 研究人员在这两种语言之间发现了几处相似点。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 similis（相像、如同），核心语义表示“在特征、外观或性质上相仿但不完全等同”。

lemmas.def_zh: 俱乐部, 木棍, 球棒
lemmas.def_en: a team of professional baseball players who play and travel together

examples.en: They decided to club together to buy an expensive wedding gift for them.
examples.zh: 他们决定凑钱为他们买一份昂贵的结婚礼物。

lemmas.def_zh: 用棍棒打, 缴纳；联合起来
lemmas.def_en: unite with a common purpose

examples.en: They decided to club together to buy an expensive wedding gift for them.
examples.zh: 他们决定凑钱为他们买一份昂贵的结婚礼物。

lemmas.def_zh: 象俱乐部的, 爱交际的, 排外的
lemmas.def_en: effusively sociable

examples.en: The board members maintain a very clubby atmosphere that excludes most outside opinions.
examples.zh: 董事会成员维持着一种排外的小圈子氛围，排斥大多数外界意见。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺斯语中表示“粗木棒、肿块”的词根，由“沉重的木块”引申出“聚合的一团人”，从而演变出“棍棒”、“棍棒击打”以及“社团/俱乐部”并行的语义脉络。

lemmas.def_zh: 有时；间或；偶尔
lemmas.def_en: on some occasions rather than all the time; occasionally

examples.en: Sometimes it is best to step back and rethink the entire problem.
examples.zh: 有时候退一步重新思考整个问题是最好的选择。

examples.en: I usually walk to work, but sometimes I take the bus when it rains.
examples.zh: 我平时步行上班，但下雨时偶尔也会坐公交车。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 some（某些）与 times（次数/时候，保留副词属格词尾 -s）复合而成，字面即“在某些时候”，引申指非经常性的“有时、偶尔”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意区分 sometimes（有时，频度副词）、sometime（某时，指不确定的时间点）与 some time（一段时间，短语）。

lemmas.def_zh: 夫妻，情侣；一对，两个；几个，三两个；连接，结合
lemmas.def_en: two people or things considered together; a romantic pair; to join or link together

examples.en: The young couple decided to spend their anniversary in Paris.
examples.zh: 这对年轻夫妇决定在巴黎度过他们的结婚纪念日。

examples.en: High inflation, coupled with supply shortages, slowed down economic growth.
examples.zh: 高通胀加上供应短缺，放缓了经济增长。

lemmas.def_zh: 连接件，联轴器，管接头；（系统或组件间的）耦合，联结
lemmas.def_en: a device for connecting parts of machinery or pipes; the pairing or linking of things together

examples.en: A cracked pipe coupling caused the water leak in the basement.
examples.zh: 管道接头破裂导致了地下室漏水。

examples.en: Loose coupling between software modules makes the system easier to maintain.
examples.zh: 软件模块之间的松散耦合使系统更易于维护。

lemmas.def_zh: 连结者, 连接器, 耦合器, 车钩
lemmas.def_en: a mechanical device that serves to connect the ends of adjacent objects

examples.en: The technician quickly replaced the broken coupler between the two train passenger cars.
examples.zh: 技术人员迅速更换了这两节客运车厢之间损坏的车钩。

lemmas.def_zh: 夫妻，情侣；一对，两个；几个，三两个；连接，结合
lemmas.def_en: two people or things considered together; a romantic pair; to join or link together

examples.en: The young couple decided to spend their anniversary in Paris.
examples.zh: 这对年轻夫妇决定在巴黎度过他们的结婚纪念日。

examples.en: High inflation, coupled with supply shortages, slowed down economic growth.
examples.zh: 高通胀加上供应短缺，放缓了经济增长。

lemmas.def_zh: 解开...的钩, 松开(狗等)的套索
lemmas.def_en: disconnect or separate

examples.en: The railway worker had to uncouple the engine before moving it into storage.
examples.zh: 铁路工人必须先解开机车的车钩，才能将其移入库房。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 copula（纽带、联结），核心逻辑为“将两样事物捆绑或连接在一起”，由此引申出“一对/伴侣”、“相连/结合”以及具体的“连接件”。
family_guide.core_distinction: couple 作名词指“人或事物的成对组合/夫妻”，作动词表“连接、结合”；coupling 则是动名词派生词，常指具体的机械“联结器/接头”或抽象系统间的“耦合”。

lemmas.def_zh: 一段时间，时期；（课）节；句号；生理期
lemmas.def_en: a specific length of time; a lesson in school; a punctuation mark (full stop)

examples.en: The country went through a prolonged period of economic instability.
examples.zh: 该国经历了一段漫长的经济不稳定时期。

examples.en: Don't forget to put a period at the end of every complete sentence.
examples.zh: 别忘了在每个完整句子的末尾加上句号。

lemmas.def_zh: 期刊
lemmas.def_en: a publication that appears at fixed intervals

examples.en: The university library subscribes to a prestigious monthly periodical on modern medical science.
examples.zh: 这所大学图书馆订阅了一本关于现代医学的著名月刊。

lemmas.def_zh: 定期地；周期性地；偶尔，间歇地
lemmas.def_en: at recurring intervals of time; from time to time

examples.en: Important files should be backed up periodically to avoid data loss.
examples.zh: 重要文件应定期备份，以防数据丢失。

examples.en: The committee meets periodically to review the project's overall progress.
examples.zh: 委员会定期碰头，以审查项目的整体进展。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 periodos（周而复始的路线/循环，由 peri- 围绕 + hodos 道路构成），核心语义指“周而复始的时间段”或“一个完整周期的终结”，引申出特定时期、句号及周期性发生的动作。
family_guide.core_distinction: period 作为名词指具体的一段界限分明的“时间”或“句号”；副词 periodically 则表示动作“定期地、间歇性地”反复发生。

lemmas.def_zh: 听，倾听；听从，听信
lemmas.def_en: give one's attention to a sound; pay attention to advice or requests

examples.en: She sat quietly, listening to the gentle rhythm of the waves.
examples.zh: 她静静地坐着，倾听着海浪温柔的节律。

examples.en: If you had listened to my warning, we wouldn't be in this mess.
examples.zh: 如果你当初听从了我的警告，我们现在就不会陷入这般困境。

lemmas.def_zh: 倾听者；（广播、播客等的）听众，收听者
lemmas.def_en: a person who listens, especially carefully or to a broadcast

examples.en: He is a patient listener who never interrupts when others speak.
examples.zh: 他是一位有耐心的倾听者，别人说话时从不打断。

examples.en: The weekly podcast has attracted over a million regular listeners.
examples.zh: 这档每周播客已经吸引了超过一百万的固定听众。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 hlysnan（留心听、注意），核心含义是“主动、有意识地集中注意力去听取声音或建议”。
family_guide.core_distinction: listen 为动词核心词，表示倾听或听从的行为；listener 为名词后缀 -er 派生词，既指人际互动中的倾听者，也指广播、播客等媒介的受众。

lemmas.def_zh: 兄弟；同胞；教友；铁哥们
lemmas.def_en: a male sibling; a close male friend or fellow member of a group

examples.en: He shared an apartment with his older brother during college.
examples.zh: 大学期间他和哥哥合租了一间公寓。

examples.en: The soldiers fought side by side and regarded each other as brothers.
examples.zh: 士兵们并肩作战，视彼此为亲兄弟。

lemmas.def_zh: 兄弟情谊；手足之情；兄弟会；行业公会
lemmas.def_en: the bond of friendship between people; an association of men united for common purposes

examples.en: The shared ordeal forged an unbreakable sense of brotherhood among the survivors.
examples.zh: 共同的磨难在幸存者之间铸就了牢不可破的手足之情。

examples.en: He was formally accepted into the secretive brotherhood last year.
examples.zh: 他于去年被正式接纳进那个隐秘的兄弟会组织。

lemmas.def_zh: 兄弟的, 亲兄弟似的, 亲切的
lemmas.def_en: like or characteristic of or befitting a brother

examples.en: He offered some warm, brotherly advice to help his friend through the crisis.
examples.zh: 他提出了一些兄弟般热心的建议，帮助朋友度过危机。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自印欧语根 *bhrāter-（兄弟），本义指具有血缘关系的男性同胞，后引申指代拥有共同信仰、目标或深厚羁绊的同伴及群体关系。
family_guide.core_distinction: brother 指具体的“兄弟”个体或同伴；brotherhood 是抽象名词，指“兄弟情谊/手足之情”或组织化的“兄弟会/团体”。

lemmas.def_zh: 建议，提议；暗示，表明
lemmas.def_en: to propose an idea or plan; to imply or indicate indirectly

examples.en: I suggest taking a short break before we make the final decision.
examples.zh: 我建议我们在做最终决定之前稍作休息。

examples.en: The latest evidence strongly suggests that the theory is correct.
examples.zh: 最新证据有力地表明这一理论是正确的。

lemmas.def_zh: 建议，提议；暗示；微量，少许
lemmas.def_en: an idea put forward for consideration; a subtle hint or slight trace

examples.en: The manager welcomed our suggestions on how to improve efficiency.
examples.zh: 经理对我们就如何提高效率提出的建议表示欢迎。

examples.en: There was just a faint suggestion of a smile on his face.
examples.zh: 他的脸上带着一丝若有若无的笑意。

lemmas.def_zh: 易受影响, 易受暗示性
lemmas.def_en: susceptibility or responsiveness to suggestion

examples.en: High suggestibility can sometimes make young children vulnerable to misleading and biased questions.
examples.zh: 高暗示感受性有时会让年幼的孩子容易受到误导性和偏见性问题的影响。

lemmas.def_zh: 提示性的, 影射的, 暗示的
lemmas.def_en: tending to suggest or imply

examples.en: The doctor found several symptoms highly suggestive of a severe respiratory bacterial infection.
examples.zh: 医生发现了几种极能提示严重呼吸道细菌感染的症状。

lemmas.def_zh: 易受影响的, 可提议的, 容易受暗示的
lemmas.def_en: susceptible or responsive to suggestion

examples.en: Tired people are often more suggestible and easily persuaded by clever advertising tactics.
examples.zh: 疲惫的人往往更容易受暗示，容易被巧妙的广告策略说服。

lemmas.def_zh: 提示地；引起联想地；暗示地
lemmas.def_en: in a suggestive manner

examples.en: She smiled suggestively at him before quietly walking out of the crowded room.
examples.zh: 在悄悄走出拥挤的房间之前，她意味深长地向他笑了笑。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 sub-（从下往上）+ gerere（带来），本义为‘从下方悄悄递上来’，引申为委婉提出想法（建议）或间接流露出某种迹象（暗示、表明）。

lemmas.def_zh: 拉，拖；画，描绘；吸引；得出（结论）；（与……）打成平手
lemmas.def_en: to pull or drag; to produce a picture; to attract; to arrive at a conclusion; to finish a game with equal scores

examples.en: She drew the curtains to let in the morning sunlight.
examples.zh: 她拉开窗帘，让清晨的阳光照进来。

examples.en: The festival is expected to draw huge crowds this weekend.
examples.zh: 预计本周末该节日将吸引大量人群。

lemmas.def_zh: 动词 draw 的过去分词（用于完成时与被动语态）
lemmas.def_en: past participle of the verb draw

examples.en: Valuable conclusions have been drawn from the experimental data.
examples.zh: 从实验数据中得出了宝贵的结论。

lemmas.def_zh: 拉，拖；画，描绘；吸引；得出（结论）；（与……）打成平手
lemmas.def_en: to pull or drag; to produce a picture; to attract; to arrive at a conclusion; to finish a game with equal scores

examples.en: She drew the curtains to let in the morning sunlight.
examples.zh: 她拉开窗帘，让清晨的阳光照进来。

examples.en: The festival is expected to draw huge crowds this weekend.
examples.zh: 预计本周末该节日将吸引大量人群。

lemmas.def_zh: 图画，素描；制图（艺术或技法）；抽签
lemmas.def_en: a picture made with a pencil, pen, or crayon; the art or technique of making such pictures; an act of selecting tickets randomly

examples.en: He made a detailed architectural drawing of the ancient palace.
examples.zh: 他绘制了一幅详尽的古代宫殿建筑图纸。

lemmas.def_zh: 动词 draw 的过去式
lemmas.def_en: past tense of the verb draw

examples.en: She drew a deep breath and stepped onto the stage.
examples.zh: 她深吸了一口气，走上了舞台。

lemmas.def_en: a boxlike container in a piece of furniture; made so as to slide in and out
lemmas.def_zh: 抽屉, 开票人

examples.en: Please put the extra office supplies inside the bottom drawer of the wooden desk.
examples.zh: 请将多余的办公用品放进木桌最底下的抽屉里。

lemmas.def_zh: 付款人
lemmas.def_en: the person (or bank) who is expected to pay a check or draft when it is presented for payment

examples.en: The drawee bank refused to honor the cheque due to insufficient funds in the account.
examples.zh: 由于账户余额不足，受票银行拒绝兑付该支票。

lemmas.def_zh: 动词 draw 的过去分词（用于完成时与被动语态）
lemmas.def_en: past participle of the verb draw

examples.en: Valuable conclusions have been drawn from the experimental data.
examples.zh: 从实验数据中得出了宝贵的结论。

lemmas.def_zh: 未拉开的, 未抽出的, 不拉的
lemmas.def_en: not represented in a drawing

examples.en: The company decided to keep its undrawn credit line as a safety reserve.
examples.zh: 该公司决定保留未提取的信贷额度作为安全储备。

family_guide.root_logic: 核心源于古英语“拖、拉、拽”（pull/drag），由此演化出拉动线条（绘画）、拉出/抽取（结论、抽签）、吸引（拉拢视线人流）以及双方拉平（平局）等多元语义分支。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词 draw 常指平局、抽奖或有吸引力之物，drawing 专指素描图纸；drawn 既是过去分词，又可作形容词特指面容因疲劳痛苦而“憔悴紧绷的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 部门；（大学的）系；局，司，部；（个人的）职权范围
lemmas.def_en: a specialized division of a large organization such as a company, university, or government

examples.en: She was recently promoted to head of the marketing department.
examples.zh: 她最近被提升为市场部主管。

examples.en: I'm afraid that's not my department; you'll need to ask technical support.
examples.zh: 恐怕那不属于我的职权范围，你得去问技术支持人员。

lemmas.def_zh: 部门的, 各部的, 分科的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a department

examples.en: All staff members are required to attend the departmental meeting this Friday morning.
examples.zh: 所有员工均须参加本周五早上的部门会议。

lemmas.def_zh: departmental的变形
lemmas.def_en: dependent on a department

examples.en: The overall operating budget was distributed departmentally according to their projected annual needs.
examples.zh: 总体运营预算根据各部门预计的年度需求进行了分配。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自词根 part（分开、划分），经法语前缀 de-（分开）和名词后缀 -ment 构成，核心语义即从整体中‘划分出来的独立部分或职能单元’。

lemmas.def_zh: 找出……的位置；坐落于，使安置于
lemmas.def_en: to discover the exact position of something; to establish or position in a particular place

examples.en: Rescue workers are struggling to locate the survivors beneath the rubble.
examples.zh: 救援人员正竭尽全力在废墟下搜寻幸存者的位置。

examples.en: The tech firm decided to locate its regional headquarters in Singapore.
examples.zh: 该科技公司决定将其区域总部设立在新加坡。

lemmas.def_zh: 位置，地点；（电影的）外景拍摄地
lemmas.def_en: a particular place or position; a site away from a studio where filming takes place

examples.en: The hotel is in a prime location within walking distance of all major sights.
examples.zh: 该酒店地理位置优越，步行即可到达所有主要景点。

examples.en: Much of the fantasy series was shot on location in New Zealand.
examples.zh: 这部奇幻剧集的大部分镜头都是在新西兰实地取景拍摄的。

lemmas.def_zh: 定位器, 雷达, 无线电定位器
lemmas.def_en: a person who fixes the boundaries of land claims

examples.en: She attached a digital key locator to her bag to track it easily.
examples.zh: 她在包上挂了一个数字寻物定位器，以便轻松追踪。

lemmas.def_zh: [英]=locator
lemmas.def_en: a person who fixes the boundaries of land claims

examples.en: The rescue team used an advanced locater device to find the missing hikers.
examples.zh: 救援队使用先进的定位装置寻找失踪的徒步旅行者。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 未分区空间
lemmas.def_en: lacking a particular location

examples.en: Several ancient artifacts mentioned in historical texts remain unlocated to this day.
examples.zh: 历史文献中提及的几件古代文物至今仍未找到确切位置。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 locus（地点），核心逻辑即围绕“定点”展开，引申为“探明……的具体位置”或“将……安置于某处”。
family_guide.core_distinction: locate 是动作（探查位置或落户安放），location 是状态或具体承载物（物理位置、场地或外景地）。

lemmas.def_zh: 狗, 坏蛋
lemmas.def_en: a member of the genus Canis (probably descended from the common wolf) that has been domesticated by man since prehistoric times; occurs in many breeds

examples.en: He takes his dog for a long walk in the park every morning.
examples.zh: 他每天早晨都带他的狗在公园里长时间散步。

lemmas.def_zh: 犟劲
lemmas.def_en: persistent determination

examples.en: Her sheer doggedness helped her overcome multiple rejections and finally launch the startup.
examples.zh: 她纯粹的坚韧执着帮她克服了多次拒绝，最终创立了公司。

lemmas.def_zh: 跟踪, 尾随
lemmas.def_en: go after with the intent to catch

examples.en: He takes his dog for a long walk in the park every morning.
examples.zh: 他每天早晨都带他的狗在公园里长时间散步。

lemmas.def_zh: 顽强地；固执地
lemmas.def_en: with obstinate determination

examples.en: The detective doggedly pursued every single clue until the mystery was fully solved.
examples.zh: 侦探顽强地追踪每一个线索，直到谜团彻底解开。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 顽强的；坚韧不拔的；坚持不懈的
lemmas.def_en: having or showing tenacity and grim persistence
lemmas.usage_note: 常用于修饰意志、决心、努力等，如 dogged determination / persistence。

examples.en: Her dogged determination finally helped her achieve her dream.
examples.zh: 她坚韧不拔的毅力最终帮助她实现了梦想。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 docga（最初指强壮的犬种），后取代 hound 成为犬类的通称；动词引申自猎犬追踪猎物的特性，比喻“如影随形地尾随”或“持续困扰”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 作名词指犬类动物；作动词指持续困扰或紧紧尾随，常用于被动或隐喻抽象问题（如伤病、丑闻）。

lemmas.def_zh: 接住；捉住；赶上（交通工具）；感染（疾病）
lemmas.def_en: to intercept and hold something moving; to capture; to board in time

examples.en: Hurry up if you want to catch the last train home.
examples.zh: 你想赶上回家的末班车就得快点了。

examples.en: He reached out quickly to catch the falling glass.
examples.zh: 他迅速伸手接住了掉落的玻璃杯。

lemmas.def_zh: 捉住；接住；陷入（catch 的过去式与过去分词）
lemmas.def_en: past tense and past participle of catch

examples.en: We were caught in a sudden downpour on the way to the station.
examples.zh: 我们在去车站的路上遭遇了一场突如其来的暴雨。

examples.en: The thief was caught red-handed trying to break into the store.
examples.zh: 小偷企图破门潜入商店时被当场抓获。

lemmas.def_zh: 捕手；捕捉器；捕捉者
lemmas.def_en: a person or thing that catches, especially the baseball player behind the home plate

examples.en: The catcher gave a subtle sign to the pitcher before the next throw.
examples.zh: 捕手在下一次投球前向投手做了一个微妙的暗号。

examples.en: She hung a traditional dream catcher above her bed to ward off nightmares.
examples.zh: 她在床头挂了一个传统的捕梦网以驱除噩梦。

lemmas.def_zh: 排水区, 集水, 流域
lemmas.def_en: a structure in which water is collected (especially a natural drainage area)

examples.en: Heavy rainfall throughout the catchment area significantly raised the river water levels.
examples.zh: 整个集水区的强降雨显著提高了河流水位。

lemmas.def_zh: 易记住的, 欺骗性的, 不规则发生的
lemmas.def_en: having concealed difficulty

examples.en: The commercial features a catchy tune that gets stuck in your head instantly.
examples.zh: 这则广告有一首朗朗上口的曲调，让人一听就忘不掉。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 captare（追逐、力图抓住），核心语义由动作演变为“通过拦截、追逐或机缘巧合而捉住、接住或获取某物”。
family_guide.core_distinction: catch 为动词原形及现在式；caught 为其不规则过去式和过去分词；catcher 为名词后缀 -er 构成的动作发出者或工具（常特指棒球捕手）。

lemmas.def_zh: 文化；文明；培养物；修养
lemmas.def_en: the customs and beliefs of a particular group; cells or bacteria grown for scientific study

examples.en: The festival is a vibrant celebration of local art, food, and traditional culture.
examples.zh: 该节日是对当地艺术、美食与传统文化的热烈庆祝。

examples.en: The lab technician examined the bacterial culture under a microscope.
