examples.en: Researchers used advanced satellite tags to track the seasonal migration of wild birds.
examples.zh: 研究人员使用先进的卫星标签来追踪野生鸟类的季节性迁徙。

lemmas.def_zh: 无足迹的, 无路的
lemmas.def_en: having no tracks

examples.en: The explorers ventured bravely into the vast, trackless wilderness without any modern maps.
examples.zh: 探险家们勇敢地踏入了广阔无路的荒野，没有任何现代地图。

lemmas.def_zh: (经济萧条以后)开始回升的; 无路径的; 无脚印的, 无足迹的
lemmas.def_en: lacking pathways

examples.en: Skiers woke up early to glide down the fresh, untracked powder on the mountain.
examples.zh: 滑雪者早早醒来，在山上未留足迹的新鲜粉雪上滑行。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于日耳曼语系中表示“足迹、车辙”的词根，核心意象为“留下的痕迹”，由此引申出“小径、轨道、曲目”等实体名词，以及“循迹追踪、记录过程”的动词含义。
family_guide.core_distinction: track 兼作核心动词（追踪、记录）与名词（轨迹、轨道、曲目）；tracker 则是后缀 -er 派生的施事名词，专指追踪者或追踪设备/程序。

lemmas.def_zh: 总数, 总额
lemmas.def_en: a quantity of money

examples.en: Her persistent silence in this matter does not necessarily amount to an admission of guilt.
examples.zh: 她在此事上一贯的沉默并不必然等同于认罪。

lemmas.def_zh: 总计, 等同
lemmas.def_en: be tantamount or equivalent to

examples.en: Her persistent silence in this matter does not necessarily amount to an admission of guilt.
examples.zh: 她在此事上一贯的沉默并不必然等同于认罪。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ad montem（朝向山、向上），本义为“向上堆叠”，引申为累计达到的“数量、总额”以及逻辑上“等同于、发展至某种结果”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词 amount 通常修饰不可数事物的数量或资金总额（不同于修饰可数名词的 number）；动词常构成固定搭配 amount to，表示“总计达到”或“等同于”。

lemmas.def_zh: 风格, 时尚, 文体, 风度, 字体, 类型；风格, 样式
lemmas.def_en: how something is done or how it happens

examples.en: The magazine editors chose to style the models in vintage twentieth-century fashion.
examples.zh: 杂志编辑们选择为模特打造二十世纪的复古时尚造型。

lemmas.def_zh: 文体学家, 时装设计师
lemmas.def_en: an artist who is a master of a particular style

examples.en: The celebrity hired a top stylist to design an elegant red carpet outfit.
examples.zh: 这位名人聘请了一位顶级造型师来设计一套优雅的红毯服装。

lemmas.def_zh: 式样设计者；装潢设计师；时装设计师；发型设计师
lemmas.def_en: someone who cuts or beautifies hair

examples.en: She bought a modern heated hair styler to quickly straighten her unruly curls.
examples.zh: 她买了一个现代加热美发造型器，以便快速拉直她不听话的卷发。

lemmas.def_zh: 风格上的仿效, 因袭
lemmas.def_en: the act of stylizing; causing to conform to a particular style

examples.en: The extreme stylization of the animation characters gave the series a distinctly retro feel.
examples.zh: 动画角色极其强烈的风格化处理赋予了该剧独特的复古感。

lemmas.def_zh: 称呼, (根据新款式)设计, 使合潮流
lemmas.def_en: designate by an identifying term

examples.en: The magazine editors chose to style the models in vintage twentieth-century fashion.
examples.zh: 杂志编辑们选择为模特打造二十世纪的复古时尚造型。

lemmas.def_zh: 使风格化, 使程式化
lemmas.def_en: represent according to a conventional style

examples.en: Graphic artists often stylize complex natural shapes to create sleek, modern corporate logos.
examples.zh: 平面艺术家经常将复杂的自然形状风格化，以创造时尚现代的企业标志。

lemmas.def_zh: 格式上的, 体裁上的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to style (especially in the use of language)

examples.en: The author made several stylistic changes to make the prose flow naturally.
examples.zh: 作者对文风做了几处改动，以使行文更加流畅自然。

lemmas.def_zh: 在文体上
lemmas.def_en: in a rhetorically stylistic manner

examples.en: stylistically complex

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 stilus（古代刻写蜡板的尖笔），由书写工具引申为书写笔触与行文方式，最终泛化为个人独特的风格、行为方式、时尚品味及对其进行塑造或命名的动作
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词侧重指独特的风格、行为方式或时尚品味；动词侧重设计发型/服装等外在造型，或指自称/冠以特定头衔

lemmas.def_zh: 升起, 举起, 唤起, 提高, 使出现, 使复活, 提出, 筹集, 饲养
lemmas.def_en: raise the level or amount of something

examples.en: The manager decided to raise her salary after she completed the major project.
examples.zh: 经理在她完成那个重大项目后决定给她加薪。

lemmas.def_zh: 上升, 高地, 增高
lemmas.def_en: the amount a salary is increased

examples.en: The manager decided to raise her salary after she completed the major project.
examples.zh: 经理在她完成那个重大项目后决定给她加薪。

lemmas.def_zh: 提高者, 饲养者, 招募者
lemmas.def_en: a bridge partner who increases the partner's bid

examples.en: As an experienced cattle raiser, he knows how to keep his livestock healthy.
examples.zh: 作为一名经验丰富的养牛户，他深谙牲畜的保健之道。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 凸起的；高出周围的；提高的
lemmas.def_en: elevated above the surrounding surface; higher than normal
lemmas.usage_note: 常用于描述凸起的地势、图案或雕刻，如 a raised platform / raised lettering。

examples.en: The blind can read books printed in raised dots called Braille.
examples.zh: 盲人可以阅读用凸点印制的盲文书籍。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺斯语 reisa（使升起、使站立），核心语义为‘使向上或显现’，引申出提升位置/数量、抚育成长、筹集款项及提出议题等及物动作。
family_guide.core_distinction: 及物动词 raise 需接宾语（如 raise prices/funds），与不及物动词 rise（自身上升）形成对比；作名词时在美式英语中特指加薪（英式常用 rise）。

lemmas.def_zh: 阶段, 舞台, 场所, 戏剧, 站, 驿站, 级, 层, 脚手架
lemmas.def_en: any distinct time period in a sequence of events

examples.en: The actors walked onto the stage and began their passionate performance.
examples.zh: 演员们走上舞台，开始了他们充满激情的表演。

lemmas.def_zh: 老练的人, 老手, 演员
lemmas.def_en: someone who supervises the physical aspects in the production of a show and who is in charge of the stage when the show is being performed

examples.en: The old stager handled the unexpected technical glitch with calm confidence.
examples.zh: 那位经验丰富的老手从容自信地化解了突发的设备故障。

lemmas.def_zh: 上演, 表演, 筹划；适于上演, 乘驿车旅行
lemmas.def_en: perform (a play), especially on a stage

examples.en: The actors walked onto the stage and began their passionate performance.
examples.zh: 演员们走上舞台，开始了他们充满激情的表演。

lemmas.def_zh: 不带女伴参加晚会
lemmas.def_en: attend a dance or a party without a female companion

examples.en: Several colleagues chose to go stag to the annual office celebration.
examples.zh: 几位同事选择独自一人去参加公司的年度庆典。

lemmas.def_zh: 做作的
lemmas.def_en: having characteristics of the stage especially an artificial and mannered quality

examples.en: Her stagey gestures and exaggerated tone ruined an otherwise serious speech.
examples.zh: 她做作的手势和夸张的语调破坏了一场本应严肃的演讲。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 未载入；未缓存；未临时存储
lemmas.def_en: not performed on the stage

examples.en: Please review your unstaged changes before committing the code to the repository.
examples.zh: 将代码提交到仓库之前，请先检查未暂存的更改。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 stare（站立），最初指站立或停留的‘立足平台’，引申出戏剧表演的‘舞台’以及进程中停留的‘阶段’，动词则引申为‘搬上舞台’或‘策划组织’。

lemmas.def_zh: 社会；协会，社团；上流社会
lemmas.def_en: the aggregate of people living together in an ordered community; an organization formed for a particular purpose

examples.en: Education plays a vital role in the continuous progress of modern society.
examples.zh: 教育在现代社会的持续进步中发挥着至关重要的作用。

examples.en: She actively participated in the university's debate society.
examples.zh: 她积极参与大学辩论社的各项活动。

lemmas.def_zh: 社会的；社会层面的（尤指宏观制度、结构或整体环境）
lemmas.def_en: relating to society or social relations, especially at a macro-structural or institutional level

examples.en: Rapid advances in artificial intelligence have triggered profound societal changes.
examples.zh: 人工智能的快速发展引发了深刻的社会变革。

examples.en: The research focuses on the intense societal pressure young graduates face today.
examples.zh: 该研究聚焦于当今年轻毕业生所面临的巨大社会压力。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 socius（同伴、伙伴），由“人与人结伴同行”演变为有组织的“共同体/社会”及相关组织机构。
family_guide.core_distinction: society 是名词实体（社会、社团/协会）；societal 为形容词，侧重宏观制度、结构与整体维度的“社会层面的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 教堂, 礼拜, 教会
lemmas.def_en: one of the groups of Christians who have their own beliefs and forms of worship

examples.en: Many villagers gather at the local church every Sunday morning for worship.
examples.zh: 许多村民每周日早晨都会聚集在当地教堂做礼拜。

lemmas.def_zh: 使人接受宗教仪式
lemmas.def_en: perform a special church rite or service for

examples.en: Many villagers gather at the local church every Sunday morning for worship.
examples.zh: 许多村民每周日早晨都会聚集在当地教堂做礼拜。

lemmas.def_zh: 把...开除出教会
lemmas.def_en: exclude from a church or a religious community

examples.en: The strict council decided to unchurch the member for violating their rules.
examples.zh: 严格的教会委员会因该成员违规决定将其逐出教会。

lemmas.def_zh: 教会的, 适于教会的
lemmas.def_en: resembling or suggesting or appropriate to a church

examples.en: The grand choir filled the hall with solemn and churchly melodies.
examples.zh: 宏大的合唱团让整个大厅回荡着庄严肃穆的教会旋律。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古希腊语 kyriakon（属于主的房屋），核心概念围绕基督教的崇拜场所、礼拜仪式及宗教组织体系演变而来。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词用于指代教堂建筑、礼拜仪式或教会体制；动词属于传统宗教专门用法，特指产妇在产后接受祈祷感恩仪式。

lemmas.def_zh: 猜测, 臆测
lemmas.def_en: expect, believe, or suppose

examples.en: Can you guess how many jellybeans are inside this glass jar?
examples.zh: 你能猜出这个玻璃罐里装了多少颗软糖吗？

lemmas.def_zh: 猜测, 臆测
lemmas.def_en: a message expressing an opinion based on incomplete evidence

examples.en: Can you guess how many jellybeans are inside this glass jar?
examples.zh: 你能猜出这个玻璃罐里装了多少颗软糖吗？

lemmas.def_zh: 推测者；猜测者
lemmas.def_en: a person who guesses

examples.en: She proved to be a lucky guesser and won the trivia contest easily.
examples.zh: 事实证明她猜得真准，轻而易举就赢得了问答比赛。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于中古英语，核心概念为“瞄准、估计”，引申为在缺乏确凿事实或充分信息时，凭直觉或零散线索做出的推断与假想。

lemmas.def_zh: 块, 片, 篇, 碎片, 部分, 部件, 标准量
lemmas.def_en: a separate part of a whole

examples.en: Detectives tried to piece together all the evidence found at the crime scene.
examples.zh: 侦探们试图把犯罪现场发现的所有证据拼凑在一起。

lemmas.def_zh: 修补, 修理, 拼合, 接线头；吃零食
lemmas.def_en: to join or unite the pieces of

examples.en: Detectives tried to piece together all the evidence found at the crime scene.
examples.zh: 侦探们试图把犯罪现场发现的所有证据拼凑在一起。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于晚期拉丁语/高卢语，核心意象为“从整体分割下来的部分”，后引申指单件物品、特定创作作品，动词则引申为“把各部分拼凑在一起”。

lemmas.def_zh: 适合, 安装, 使合身, 使适应, 使合格；适合, 符合, 合身
lemmas.def_en: be agreeable or acceptable to

examples.en: Running every morning helps him stay fit and active throughout the day.
examples.zh: 每天晨跑帮助他保持健康的体魄和一整天的活力。

lemmas.def_zh: 适宜, 合身, 发作, 痉挛
lemmas.def_en: a display of bad temper

examples.en: Running every morning helps him stay fit and active throughout the day.
examples.zh: 每天晨跑帮助他保持健康的体魄和一整天的活力。

lemmas.def_zh: 适合, 合宜, 合理, 恰当, 健康
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being suitable

examples.en: She joined the local gym to improve her overall physical fitness.
examples.zh: 她加入了当地的健身房以增强整体身体素质。

lemmas.def_zh: 试穿, 试衣, 装配, 装置
lemmas.def_en: making or becoming suitable; adjusting to circumstances

examples.en: The bride scheduled another dress fitting to ensure the gown looked perfect.
examples.zh: 新娘安排了又一次试衣，以确保婚纱看起来完美无瑕。

lemmas.def_zh: 裁剪和试样的服装工人/裁缝, 装配工, 钳工
lemmas.def_en: someone who fits a garment to a particular person

examples.en: An experienced fitter inspected the industrial pipes to prevent any gas leaks.
examples.zh: 一名经验丰富的装配工检查了工业管道，以防止气体泄漏。

lemmas.def_zh: 适宜的, 对的, 准备好的
lemmas.def_en: meeting adequate standards for a purpose

examples.en: Running every morning helps him stay fit and active throughout the day.
examples.zh: 每天晨跑帮助他保持健康的体魄和一整天的活力。

lemmas.def_zh: 适切地, 适合地
lemmas.def_en: in an appropriate manner

examples.en: The evening ended fittingly with a spectacular display of colorful fireworks.
examples.zh: 夜晚在绚烂的烟花秀中恰到好处地落下了帷幕。

family_guide.root_logic: 核心语义围绕“合适、匹配与恰当”，由物理层面的“尺寸合身、安装到位”延伸至抽象层面的“适宜、胜任”，并进一步引申出身体机能的“健康良好（fit/fitness）”；名词“发作”则源于同形异源的历史合流。
family_guide.core_distinction: fitting 指具体的“配件、附件”或“试衣过程”，fitness 侧重整体的“健康状态或适宜性”，而 fitter 则指专职的“装配工或试衣师”。

lemmas.def_zh: 意识到，认识到；实现（目标、愿望）；变卖为现款
lemmas.def_en: to become fully aware of something as a fact; to achieve something desired or promised

examples.en: She suddenly realized that she had left her keys inside the car.
examples.zh: 她突然意识到自己把钥匙落在车里了。

examples.en: It took years of dedication for him to realize his dream of becoming a surgeon.
examples.zh: 经过多年的专注努力，他终于实现了成为外科医生的梦想。

lemmas.def_zh: 意识到；实现（realize 的英式拼写）
lemmas.def_en: British English spelling of realize

examples.en: I didn't realise how late it had gotten until the train stopped running.
examples.zh: 直到火车停运，我才意识到时间已经这么晚了。

lemmas.def_zh: 领悟，认识，意识到；实现，达成
lemmas.def_en: an act of becoming fully aware of something; the achievement of something desired or anticipated

examples.en: The sudden realization of danger made him freeze in his tracks.
examples.zh: 猛然意识到危险让他顿时停住了脚步。

examples.en: The project represents the realization of a vision first proposed a decade ago.
examples.zh: 该项目代表了十年前首次提出的愿景的真正实现。

lemmas.def_zh: 没有实现的, 没能实现的; 未实现
lemmas.def_en: of persons; marked by failure to realize full potentialities

examples.en: She felt a deep sadness over her many unrealized artistic ambitions.
examples.zh: 她对自己许多未实现的艺术抱负感到深深的遗憾。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于 real（真实的）加动词后缀 -ize，核心语义为“使变为现实”，后延伸至心智层面指“在头脑中将其作为事实而认清/意识到”。
family_guide.core_distinction: realize 为美式英语首选拼写，realise 为英式英语通用拼写；realization 则是对应的名词形式，兼具“领悟”与“实现”双重语义。

lemmas.def_zh: 自然的, 自然界的, 本能的, 天然的, 物质的, 正常的, 原始的, 自然数的
lemmas.def_en: in accordance with nature; relating to or concerning nature

examples.en: Fresh fruit is packed with natural vitamins that boost your immune system.
examples.zh: 新鲜水果富含能增强免疫系统的天然维生素。

lemmas.def_zh: 不自然的, 反常的, 不近人情的
lemmas.def_en: not in accordance with or determined by nature; contrary to nature

examples.en: The silence in the crowded room felt completely unnatural and unsettling.
examples.zh: 拥挤房间里的寂静让人感觉极不自然且心神不定。

lemmas.def_zh: 自然地；顺理成章地，当然
lemmas.def_en: in a relaxed or normal way; as might be expected; of course

examples.en: Try to relax and act naturally in front of the camera.
examples.zh: 在镜头前尽量放松，表现得自然一点。

examples.en: Naturally, we will keep you updated on any progress.
examples.zh: 一有任何进展，我们当然会及时向您通报。

lemmas.def_zh: 违反习俗地; 不自然地; 勉强地; 不近人情地
lemmas.def_en: in an unnatural way

examples.en: His skin looked unnaturally pale after spending weeks recovering indoors.
examples.zh: 在室内修养数周后，他的肤色显得异常苍白。

lemmas.def_zh: 白痴
lemmas.def_en: someone regarded as certain to succeed

examples.en: Fresh fruit is packed with natural vitamins that boost your immune system.
examples.zh: 新鲜水果富含能增强免疫系统的天然维生素。

lemmas.def_zh: 自然, 当然
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being natural or based on natural principles

examples.en: The actor delivered his lines with remarkable ease and charming naturalness.
examples.zh: 这位演员台词说得格外自如，带着迷人的自然流露。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 不自然；自然性；非自然性
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being unnatural or not based on natural principles

examples.en: Critics noted the stiffness and unnaturalness of the digital characters' expressions.
examples.zh: 批评人士指出了数字角色表情的僵硬与不自然。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于拉丁语 natura（自然、本性），核心逻辑从“大自然的、生来具有的”引申为“非人工的、符合常理的或天生擅长的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: natural 兼具形容词（天然的/正常的）与名词（具某方面天赋之人）；副词 naturally 既可修饰动作（自然地），也常作句子评注副词表示“理所当然、当然”。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 手臂；扶手；分支机构；武器（常用复数 arms）；v. 武装；装备；备战
lemmas.def_en: n. the upper human limb; a division or branch; weapons (in plural); v. to supply with weapons or defensive equipment

examples.en: She sat reading by the window with a cat curled up in her arms.
examples.zh: 她坐在窗边看书，怀里蜷缩着一只猫。

examples.en: The research arm of the university secured significant government funding.
examples.zh: 该大学的研究分支机构获得了一笔可观的政府资助。

examples.en: Before entering the negotiation, he armed himself with all the relevant data.
examples.zh: 在进入谈判之前，他用所有相关数据把自己武装了起来。

lemmas.def_en: protective covering made of metal and used in combat
lemmas.def_zh: 盔甲, 潜水服, 装甲

examples.en: The museum displayed a complete suit of medieval knight armor in the hall.
examples.zh: 博物馆在大厅里展出了一套完整的中世纪骑士盔甲。

lemmas.def_zh: 军备, 军队, 武器
lemmas.def_en: weaponry used by military or naval force

examples.en: The nation increased its armament production amid rising regional tensions.
examples.zh: 在该地区局势日益紧张之际，该国增加了武器生产。

lemmas.def_en: a worker skilled in making armor or arms
lemmas.def_zh: 兵器制造者, 军械士

examples.en: The royal armorer carefully inspected every newly forged sword before the battle.
examples.zh: 皇家军械士在战前仔细检查了每一把新锻造的宝剑。

lemmas.def_zh: 臂章, 臂钏, 小海湾
lemmas.def_en: a band worn around the arm for decoration

examples.en: She wore an ornate gold armlet that caught the evening sunlight.
examples.zh: 她戴着一只华丽的金色臂钏，在夕阳下闪闪发光。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 手臂；扶手；分支机构；武器（常用复数 arms）；v. 武装；装备；备战
lemmas.def_en: n. the upper human limb; a division or branch; weapons (in plural); v. to supply with weapons or defensive equipment

examples.en: She sat reading by the window with a cat curled up in her arms.
examples.zh: 她坐在窗边看书，怀里蜷缩着一只猫。

examples.en: The research arm of the university secured significant government funding.
examples.zh: 该大学的研究分支机构获得了一笔可观的政府资助。

examples.en: Before entering the negotiation, he armed himself with all the relevant data.
examples.zh: 在进入谈判之前，他用所有相关数据把自己武装了起来。

lemmas.def_en: equip with armor
lemmas.def_zh: 为...装甲

examples.en: The museum displayed a complete suit of medieval knight armor in the hall.
examples.zh: 博物馆在大厅里展出了一套完整的中世纪骑士盔甲。

lemmas.def_en: used of animals; without protective covering
lemmas.def_zh: 不穿戴盔甲的, 非装甲的

examples.en: The troops were extremely vulnerable in the unarmored truck during the ambush.
examples.zh: 伏击期间，部队在这辆没有装甲防护的卡车里极其脆弱。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语根 *ar-（拼接、连合），本义指关节连接的“手臂”，后由“手持器械”引申为“武器（常作复数 arms）”及动词“武装、装备”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 作名词单数时主要指身体部位“手臂”，复数 arms 专指“武器/军火”；作动词时既可指配备真枪实弹，也可引申为用知识或信息“武装”。

lemmas.def_zh: 尤其，特别；格外
lemmas.def_en: to a great degree; particularly or above all others

examples.en: I love all kinds of fruit, especially mangoes and strawberries.
examples.zh: 我喜欢各种水果，尤其是芒果和草莓。

examples.en: The traffic was bad, especially during the morning rush hour.
examples.zh: 交通状况很糟糕，特别是在早高峰期间。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 species（种类、外观），派生出 special（特有的、特别的），后缀 -ly 构成副词，核心表“格外突出、尤其”之意。
family_guide.core_distinction: especially 侧重“尤其、特别”（用于强调程度或突出某个个体）；specially 则侧重“专门、特意”（强调为特定目的而做）。

lemmas.def_zh: 平均的, 中等的, 平常的
lemmas.def_en: approximating the statistical norm or average or expected value

examples.en: The average lifespan of domestic cats is around fifteen years.
examples.zh: 家猫的平均寿命大约在十五年左右。

lemmas.def_zh: 平均, 平均数, 一般水平, 海损
lemmas.def_en: a statistic describing the location of a distribution

examples.en: The average lifespan of domestic cats is around fifteen years.
examples.zh: 家猫的平均寿命大约在十五年左右。

lemmas.def_zh: 平均数；平均水平；平庸
lemmas.def_en: the state of being that is average; indicates normality but with connotations of mediocrity

examples.en: The sheer averageness of the performance disappointed the demanding audience.
examples.zh: 这场演出平庸的表现让挑剔的观众大失所望。

lemmas.def_zh: 算出...平均数, 平均做, 均分, 使平衡；平均为, 呈中间色
lemmas.def_en: amount to or come to an average, without loss or gain

examples.en: The average lifespan of domestic cats is around fifteen years.
examples.zh: 家猫的平均寿命大约在十五年左右。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古法语 avarie（海损），原指海运中按比例分摊货损费用，后引申为数学上的“平均分摊”，再进一步泛化指“平常、中间水平”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 该词族形态高度统一，形容词、名词与动词同形，均围绕“按总数均摊”及“常规中等状态”展开，无复杂派生词区别。

lemmas.def_zh: 基督；救世主；耶稣
lemmas.def_en: the title given to Jesus of Nazareth, regarded by Christians as the Messiah

examples.en: Christians believe that Jesus Christ was resurrected from the dead.
examples.zh: 基督徒相信耶稣基督已经从死里复活。

examples.en: Many classical painters depicted scenes from the life of Christ.
examples.zh: 许多古典画家都描绘过基督生平的场景。

lemmas.def_zh: 基督教徒，基督徒
lemmas.def_en: a person who adheres to or believes in Christianity

examples.en: She was raised in a devout family and remained a practicing Christian all her life.
examples.zh: 她在虔诚的家庭中长大，一生都是一位虔诚的基督徒。

examples.en: The charity was originally founded by a group of local Christians.
examples.zh: 该慈善机构最初由一群当地的基督徒创立。

lemmas.def_zh: 不信奉基督教的, 异教徒的, 违反礼俗常规的, 极糟的, 极不适当的
lemmas.def_en: not of a Christian faith

examples.en: Refusing to help the homeless was seen as cruel and unchristian.
examples.zh: 拒绝帮助无家可归者被视为残酷且不近人情的做法。

lemmas.def_zh: 如基督徒的, 有基督徒性质的
lemmas.def_en: becoming to or like a Christian

examples.en: She treated her bitter rivals with genuine warmth and christianly forgiveness.
examples.zh: 她以真正的热情和博爱的宽恕对待她的宿敌。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 khristos（受膏者），对应希伯来语中的“弥赛亚”，核心语义指受上帝膏立的救世主，后延伸至其追随者与信仰体系。
family_guide.core_distinction: Christ 专指受膏的救世主耶稣本人；Christian 则指追随基督的信徒（基督徒）。

lemmas.def_zh: 照片；相片
lemmas.def_en: a picture produced using a camera; short for photograph

examples.en: She showed me an old family photo taken during their trip to Italy.
examples.zh: 她给我看了一张全家人去意大利旅行时拍的旧照片。

examples.en: The tourists stopped in front of the castle to pose for a photo.
examples.zh: 游客们在城堡前停下脚步摆姿势拍照。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 phōs（光），后作为 photograph（光影记录）的日常简写，核心语义即指“照片”。

lemmas.def_zh: 移开，拿走；脱下；消除，去除；免职
lemmas.def_en: take off or away from the position occupied; get rid of

examples.en: Please remove your shoes before entering the house.
examples.zh: 进屋前请脱鞋。

examples.en: He was removed from his post following allegations of corruption.
examples.zh: 在受到腐败指控后，他被免去了职务。

lemmas.def_zh: 移走，清除；切除；免职，罢免
lemmas.def_en: the act of taking something or someone away

examples.en: The surgical removal of the tumor was completely successful.
examples.zh: 肿瘤切除手术非常成功。

examples.en: The opposition party demanded the prime minister's removal from office.
examples.zh: 反对党要求罢免首相的职务。

lemmas.def_zh: 移转者, 搬家公司, 脱涂剂
lemmas.def_en: a solvent that removes a substance (usually from a surface)

examples.en: Apply a mild stain remover to the fabric before washing it.
examples.zh: 清洗织物之前，先在上面涂抹温和的去污剂。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 re-（离开，移走）+ move（移动），核心语义为“从原处移开”，引申为脱下衣物、消除痕迹或免除职务。
family_guide.core_distinction: remove 为动词表示移动、去除或免职的动作；removal 为其名词形式，指移走、消除或罢免的行为与过程。

lemmas.def_zh: 军事的, 军人的, 适于战争的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the study of the principles of warfare

examples.en: The government announced a significant increase in the annual military budget.
examples.zh: 政府宣布大幅增加年度军事预算。

lemmas.def_zh: 军国主义的
lemmas.def_en: imbued with militarism

lemmas.def_zh: 非军事
lemmas.def_en: not associated with soldiers or the military

examples.en: The satellite will be used entirely for nonmilitary and scientific purposes.
examples.zh: 该卫星将完全用于非军事的科研目的。

lemmas.def_zh: 不符合军事规程的, 非军事的, 不象军人的, 与军人身分不相称的
lemmas.def_en: not associated with soldiers or the military

examples.en: His slouching posture and casual attitude seemed remarkably unmilitary to everyone.
examples.zh: 在所有人看来，他松散的站姿和随意的态度完全不像军人。

lemmas.def_zh: 在军事上
lemmas.def_en: with respect to the military

examples.en: The allied forces were militarily superior throughout the brief border conflict.
examples.zh: 在短暂的边境冲突中，盟军在军事上始终占据绝对优势。

lemmas.def_zh: 使军事化, 使军国化, 鼓吹军国主义
lemmas.def_en: lend a military character to (a country), as by building up a military force

examples.en: The government decided not to militarize the disputed border to prevent further conflicts.
examples.zh: 政府决定不对争议边界实施军事化，以防止进一步的冲突。

lemmas.def_zh: 军队
lemmas.def_en: the military forces of a nation

examples.en: He decided to join the military right after graduating from high school.
examples.zh: 高中毕业后，他便决定参军。

lemmas.def_zh: 军国主义, 尚武精神, 好战精神
lemmas.def_en: a political orientation of a people or a government to maintain a strong military force and to be prepared to use it aggressively to defend or promote national interests

examples.en: The rise of aggressive militarism during that era eventually triggered a global conflict.
examples.zh: 那个时代好战军国主义的兴起最终引发了一场全球冲突。

lemmas.def_zh: 军事化, 军国主义化
lemmas.def_en: act of assembling and putting into readiness for war or other emergency:

examples.en: The rapid militarization of the island raised serious concerns among neighboring nations.
examples.zh: 该岛屿的迅速军事化引发了邻国的严重担忧。

lemmas.def_zh: 军国主义者, 军事家
lemmas.def_en: a person who advocates war or warlike policies

examples.en: The militarist faction argued that only increased defense spending could ensure national security.
examples.zh: 军国主义派系辩称，唯有增加国防开支才能确保国家安全。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 miles（士兵），核心概念贯穿“军队、军人以及国防武力运作”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 同形异词性：形容词修饰与军队或战争相关的属性，名词常与定冠词连用（the military）特指军队整体或军方。

lemmas.def_zh: 岩石；石块；坚强支柱；摇滚乐；摇晃；震撼
lemmas.def_en: a large piece of stone; a reliable source of support; to move gently back and forth; to shock deeply

examples.en: She has been an absolute rock for her family throughout the crisis.
examples.zh: 在整个危机期间，她一直是全家绝对的坚强支柱。

examples.en: The sudden corruption scandal rocked the entire tech industry.
examples.zh: 这起突发的腐败丑闻震动了整个科技行业。

lemmas.def_zh: 落基山脉
lemmas.def_en: the chief mountain range of western North America; extends from British Columbia to northern New Mexico; forms the continental divide

examples.en: We spent a wonderful week hiking through the snowy peaks of the Rockies.
examples.zh: 我们在白雪皑皑的落基山脉徒步旅行，度过了美好的一周。

lemmas.def_zh: 摇的人, 摇杆
lemmas.def_en: an attendant who rocks a child in a cradle

examples.en: The grandmother sat quietly in her wooden rocker, knitting a warm sweater.
examples.zh: 祖母静静地坐在木制摇椅上，织着一件温暖的毛衣。

lemmas.def_zh: 岩石；石块；坚强支柱；摇滚乐；摇晃；震撼
lemmas.def_en: a large piece of stone; a reliable source of support; to move gently back and forth; to shock deeply

examples.en: She has been an absolute rock for her family throughout the crisis.
examples.zh: 在整个危机期间，她一直是全家绝对的坚强支柱。

examples.en: The sudden corruption scandal rocked the entire tech industry.
examples.zh: 这起突发的腐败丑闻震动了整个科技行业。

lemmas.def_zh: 多岩石的；崎岖的；不稳定的；艰难波折的
lemmas.def_en: covered with or made of rock; unstable or full of difficulties

examples.en: The couple managed to stay together despite a rocky start to their marriage.
examples.zh: 尽管婚姻开局磕磕绊绊，这对夫妇还是设法走在了一起。

examples.en: Hikers navigated the steep, rocky path with extreme caution.
examples.zh: 徒步旅行者极其小心地穿行在陡峭多石的小路上。

family_guide.root_logic: 名词源自古法语指坚硬的“岩石”（引申为稳固依靠），动词源自古英语指“前后摇摆”（引申为震撼与摇滚），两者在现代英语中兼具硬朗稳固与动态震撼的特质。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词 rocky 同时承接了“石”与“摇”的双重特质，既指地势“多岩石的/坎坷的”，也常隐喻关系或局面的“动荡不稳/困难重重的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 投, 掷, 抛, 发射, 摔下, 匆匆穿上(或脱下), 抛弃, 摆脱；丢, 掷, 抛
lemmas.def_en: propel through the air

examples.en: The athlete managed to throw the heavy javelin across the entire field.
examples.zh: 这名运动员成功将沉重的标枪掷过了整个场地。

lemmas.def_zh: 投；掷；抛（throw 的过去式）
lemmas.def_en: past tense of throw

examples.en: He threw his coat onto the sofa and rushed to answer the phone.
examples.zh: 他把外套往沙发上一扔，便匆忙跑去接电话。

lemmas.def_zh: 投；掷；抛（throw 的过去分词）；（被动或比喻）被甩出；感到困惑措手不及
lemmas.def_en: past participle of throw; also used informally to describe being unsettled or perplexed

examples.en: The speaker was visibly thrown by the hostile question from the audience.
examples.zh: 听众提出的带有敌意的问题显然让演讲者有些措手不及。

lemmas.def_zh: 投掷, 掷骰子, 冒险
lemmas.def_en: the act of throwing (propelling something with a rapid movement of the arm and wrist)

examples.en: The athlete managed to throw the heavy javelin across the entire field.
examples.zh: 这名运动员成功将沉重的标枪掷过了整个场地。

lemmas.def_zh: 投掷者, 发射器, 喷射器, 制陶坯的工人
lemmas.def_en: a person who twists silk or rayon filaments into a thread or yarn

examples.en: The skilled potter shaped the wet clay swiftly on the spinning wheel.
examples.zh: 这位熟练的陶工在旋转的轮盘上迅速将湿粘土塑形。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 þrāwan（本义为“扭转、旋转”，后演化为通过手臂扭转发力将物体“投、掷、抛”出），并进一步引申出猛烈甩落、使陷入某种状态或比喻性的“举办（聚会）”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 该词族包含不规则动词的三态变化（throw-threw-thrown）；名词 throw 既指“投掷”动作或距离，在日常家居中也常指“沙发披毯、盖毯”。

lemmas.def_zh: 解释；说明；阐明
lemmas.def_en: to make something clear or easy to understand by describing or giving information about it

examples.en: The professor used a simple analogy to explain the complex concept to the students.
examples.zh: 教授用了一个简单的类比向学生们解释这个复杂的概念。

examples.en: She had to explain to her manager why the project deadline was missed.
examples.zh: 她不得不向经理说明为什么错过了项目的截止日期。

lemmas.def_en: a statement that makes something comprehensible by describing the relevant structure or operation or circumstances etc.
lemmas.def_zh: 解释, 说明, 辩解, 表明

examples.en: His clear explanation helped the students grasp the complicated physics concept quickly.
examples.zh: 他清晰的解释帮助学生们迅速掌握了这个复杂的物理概念。

lemmas.def_zh: 说明的, 解释的, 辩明的
lemmas.def_en: serving or intended to explain or make clear

examples.en: The instruction manual includes several explanatory diagrams to help users assemble it.
examples.zh: 说明书附带了几张解释性图表，以帮助用户进行组装。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语前缀 ex-（出、彻底）+ planus（平坦），本义为“摊平、铺平”，引申为“把晦涩难懂的问题展开铺平，使其清晰易懂”。

lemmas.def_zh: 减少；降低；缩小；使沦为
lemmas.def_en: to make something smaller or less in size, amount, degree, or price

examples.en: Regular exercise can significantly reduce the risk of heart disease.
examples.zh: 规律运动可以显著降低患心脏病的风险。

examples.en: The company was forced to reduce its operating costs to survive the crisis.
examples.zh: 为了度过危机，公司被迫缩减运营成本。

lemmas.def_zh: 减少；缩小；削减；降价
lemmas.def_en: the act of decreasing something, or the amount by which it is made smaller

examples.en: The new policy led to a dramatic reduction in carbon emissions.
examples.zh: 新政策促使碳排放量大幅减少。

examples.en: Staff members are entitled to a 20% price reduction on all purchases.
examples.zh: 员工购买所有商品均可享受八折优惠。

lemmas.def_zh: 渐缩管, 缩减者, 还原剂
lemmas.def_en: a substance capable of bringing about the reduction of another substance as it itself is oxidized; used in photography to lessen the density of a negative or print by oxidizing some of the loose silver

examples.en: The plumber installed a pipe reducer to connect two different sized tubes safely.
examples.zh: 水管工安装了一个异径接头，以安全连接两根不同尺寸的管道。

lemmas.def_zh: [化]还原剂
lemmas.def_en: a substance capable of bringing about the reduction of another substance as it itself is oxidized; used in photography to lessen the density of a negative or print by oxidizing some of the loose silver

examples.en: In this chemical reaction, carbon monoxide acts as an effective reducing agent.
examples.zh: 在这个化学反应中，一氧化碳充当了有效的还原剂。

lemmas.def_zh: 减少的, 还原论的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by or causing diminution or curtailment;  - R.H.Rovere

examples.en: His simple explanation was criticized for being far too reductive and misleading.
examples.zh: 他简单的解释因过于片面和具有误导性而受到批评。

lemmas.def_zh: 可缩小的, 可降低的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being reduced; - Edmund Wilson

examples.en: Most complex mathematical equations are easily reducible to simpler forms with practice.
examples.zh: 通过练习，大多数复杂的数学方程式都可以轻易简化。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 不可约的
lemmas.def_en: not altered by reduction

examples.en: The artist presented the unreduced version of the mural to the gallery committee.
examples.zh: 艺术家向画廊委员会展示了这幅未经缩减的原版壁画。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 reducere（re-向后/回 + ducere引导/带来），原义为'带回、退回'，后引申为在数量、尺寸、程度或地位上'缩减、降低'。
family_guide.core_distinction: reduce 是表示'减少、降级'的核心动词，而 reduction 是其对应的名词形式，指缩减的动作、状态或缩减的幅度。

lemmas.def_zh: 钥匙, 键, 解答, 关键, 要害, 基调, 线索, 答案, 暗礁
lemmas.def_en: metal device shaped in such a way that when it is inserted into the appropriate lock the lock's mechanism can be rotated

examples.en: She realized she had left her car key inside the locked apartment.
examples.zh: 她意识到自己把车钥匙落在了锁着的公寓里。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 键, 密钥
lemmas.def_en: serving as an essential component

examples.en: She realized she had left her car key inside the locked apartment.
examples.zh: 她意识到自己把车钥匙落在了锁着的公寓里。

lemmas.def_zh: 调音, 锁上, 提供线索；使用钥匙
lemmas.def_en: identify as in botany or biology, for example

examples.en: She realized she had left her car key inside the locked apartment.
examples.zh: 她意识到自己把车钥匙落在了锁着的公寓里。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古英语，本义为开锁的物理‘钥匙’，引申出‘开启枢纽、决定性因由’的核心意象，进而发展为名词‘关键/琴键/按键’、形容词‘至关重要的’及动词‘用键盘输入/使适应匹配’。
family_guide.core_distinction: 本组为同形不同词性：名词指具象的钥匙/按键或抽象的关键，形容词强调核心不可或缺，动词多指录入数据（key in）或调整适应（key to）。

lemmas.def_zh: 公平的, 按规则进行的, 不好不坏的, 晴朗的, 美丽的
lemmas.def_en: free from favoritism or self-interest or bias or deception; conforming with established standards or rules

examples.en: The judge made a very fair decision that satisfied both opposing parties.
examples.zh: 法官做出了一个非常公正的判决，令双方都感到满意。

lemmas.def_zh: 不公平的, 不正直的, 不正当的
lemmas.def_en: not fair; marked by injustice or partiality or deception

examples.en: Many workers complained about the unfair treatment they received from their new manager.
examples.zh: 许多员工抱怨他们受到了新经理的不公平对待。

lemmas.def_zh: 美观地, 公平地, 相当地, 清楚地
lemmas.def_en: to a moderately sufficient extent or degree

examples.en: The test was fairly difficult, but most students managed to pass it successfully.
examples.zh: 考试相当难，但大多数学生还是顺利通过了。

lemmas.def_zh: 不正当地；不公平地
lemmas.def_en: in an unfair manner

examples.en: She felt that she was unfairly blamed for the project's sudden financial failure.
examples.zh: 她觉得自己为该项目突然的财务失败背了黑锅，很不公平。

lemmas.def_zh: 晴朗, 光明正大, 美丽
lemmas.def_en: conformity with rules or standards

examples.en: The committee is deeply committed to ensuring absolute fairness in the selection process.
examples.zh: 委员会坚定地致力于确保选拔过程的绝对公正。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 不公平, 不公正, 不正当
lemmas.def_en: partiality that is not fair or equitable

examples.en: Citizens marched through the capital to protest the evident unfairness of the system.
examples.zh: 市民们在首都游行，抗议该体制显而易见的不公。

lemmas.def_zh: 转晴
lemmas.def_en: join so that the external surfaces blend smoothly

examples.en: The judge made a very fair decision that satisfied both opposing parties.
examples.zh: 法官做出了一个非常公正的判决，令双方都感到满意。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 fæger（美丽、宜人），语义由外貌的‘美好’延伸至气象的‘晴朗’与事物的‘尚可’，并在伦理与规则中升华为‘公平、合理’的核心义。
family_guide.core_distinction: fairly 最常作程度副词表示‘相当/尚可’（语气弱于 quite/very），仅在修饰动词时表示‘公正地’；而 fair 作动词多为气象短语（转晴）或工程造船术语（使平滑顺畅）。

lemmas.def_zh: 单位；单元；部件；（组织、机构的）部门；单件
lemmas.def_en: an individual thing, person, or group regarded as single and complete, or a standard measure used in calculations

examples.en: The family is often regarded as the basic unit of society.
examples.zh: 家庭通常被视为社会的基本单位。

examples.en: Each apartment unit is equipped with an independent heating system.
examples.zh: 每个公寓单元都配有独立的供暖系统。

lemmas.def_zh: 统一, 联合, 一致
lemmas.def_en: an occurrence that involves the production of a union

examples.en: The eventual unification of the two rival groups brought long-awaited regional peace.
examples.zh: 两个对立团体的最终联合带来了人们期待已久的地区和平。

lemmas.def_zh: 统一者

examples.en: The new president presented himself as a great unifier for the divided nation.
examples.zh: 新总统将自己展现为这个分裂国家的伟大统领者。

lemmas.def_zh: 统一, 使成一体
lemmas.def_en: become one

examples.en: The campaign aims to unify communities across the region through shared cultural events.
examples.zh: 该活动旨在通过共同的文化盛事来团结整个地区的各个社区。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 unus（一），核心语义为“作为一个单独且完整的独立个体或度量标准”，引申指构成整体的单个部分或系统单元。

lemmas.def_zh: 解决；解答；破解
lemmas.def_en: find an answer to, explanation for, or means of dealing with a problem or mystery

examples.en: Experts are working around the clock to solve the complex technical problem.
examples.zh: 专家们正在夜以继日地工作，以解决这一复杂的技术难题。

examples.en: The detective finally gathered enough evidence to solve the murder case.
examples.zh: 侦探终于搜集到了足够的证据，破获了这起谋杀案。

lemmas.def_zh: [化] 溶剂合物; 溶剂化物
lemmas.def_en: cause a solvation in (a substance)

examples.en: Polar molecules readily solvate metal ions, stabilizing them throughout the entire chemical reaction.
examples.zh: 极性分子很容易溶剂化金属离子，在整个化学反应中使其保持稳定。

lemmas.def_zh: 解决办法，答案；溶液
lemmas.def_en: a means of solving a problem; a liquid mixture in which a solute is dissolved

examples.en: We need to find a practical and sustainable solution to the housing shortage.
examples.zh: 我们需要为住房短缺问题找到切实可行且可持续的解决办法。

examples.en: Clean the wound gently with a mild saline solution.
examples.zh: 用温和的生理盐水溶液轻轻清洗伤口。

lemmas.def_zh: 溶剂
lemmas.def_en: a liquid substance capable of dissolving other substances

examples.en: Water is often called a universal solvent because it dissolves many substances.
examples.zh: 水常被称为通用溶剂，因为它能溶解许多物质。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 解算机, 求解程序
lemmas.def_en: a thinker who focuses on the problem as stated and tries to synthesize information and knowledge to achieve a solution

examples.en: The engineer developed an automated solver to handle complex equations quickly.
examples.zh: 工程师开发了一个自动求解程序，以便快速处理复杂方程。

lemmas.def_zh: 偿付能力, 溶解力
lemmas.def_en: the ability to meet maturing obligations as they come due

examples.en: The audit confirmed the company's financial solvency despite recent market fluctuations.
examples.zh: 审计确认了该公司在近期市场波动下仍具有财务偿付能力。

lemmas.def_zh: [化学] 溶解；[化学] 溶剂化作用；溶化
lemmas.def_en: a chemical process in which solvent molecules and molecules or ions of the solute combine to form a compound

lemmas.def_zh: 未解释的, 未解决的
lemmas.def_en: not solved

examples.en: The mysterious theft has remained unsolved for more than two decades.
examples.zh: 这起神秘的盗窃案二十多年来一直未破。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 solvere（解开、松绑），核心逻辑是由“解开绳结/束缚”引申为“解开难题、化解困境”，并在物质层面延伸为“溶解”。
family_guide.core_distinction: solution 既是 solve 的动作结果（解决方案/答案），也保留了词源的物理意涵指“溶液”。

lemmas.def_zh: 科技；技术；工艺
lemmas.def_en: the application of scientific knowledge for practical purposes, especially in industry

examples.en: Advances in digital technology have transformed the way we work and learn.
examples.zh: 数字技术的进步彻底改变了我们的工作与学习方式。

examples.en: The startup is developing cutting-edge technology to improve battery efficiency.
examples.zh: 这家初创公司正在研发前沿技术以提高电池效率。

lemmas.def_zh: 工艺师, 技术员
lemmas.def_en: a person who uses scientific knowledge to solve practical problems

examples.en: A skilled technologist was hired to upgrade the laboratory's diagnostic equipment.
examples.zh: 实验室聘请了一位熟练的技术员来升级诊断设备。

lemmas.def_zh: 科技的；技术的；工艺的
lemmas.def_en: relating to, characterized by, or resulting from technology

examples.en: Rapid technological change requires workers to continuously update their skills.
examples.zh: 快速的技术变革要求劳动者不断更新技能。

examples.en: The company has maintained its technological edge through continuous innovation.
examples.zh: 该公司通过持续创新保持了其技术优势。

lemmas.def_zh: 技术上地；科技地
lemmas.def_en: by means of technology

examples.en: The country has become technologically advanced in renewable energy systems.
examples.zh: 该国在可再生能源系统方面在技术上已变得非常先进。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 tekhnē（技艺、工艺）与 -logy（学科、论述），核心逻辑指将工艺与科学知识系统化应用于实际生产与生活的“技术手段与体系”。

lemmas.def_zh: 纸, 文件, 文章, 报纸, 证券, 证件
lemmas.def_en: a material made of cellulose pulp derived mainly from wood or rags or certain grasses

examples.en: Please write down your contact details on a clean sheet of paper.
examples.zh: 请在一张干净的纸上写下你的联系方式。

lemmas.def_zh: 用纸糊, 贴壁纸于, 用纸包装；贴壁纸
lemmas.def_en: cover with paper

examples.en: Please write down your contact details on a clean sheet of paper.
examples.zh: 请在一张干净的纸上写下你的联系方式。

lemmas.def_zh: 薄如纸的
lemmas.def_en: thin and paperlike

examples.en: The onion's outer skin was thin and papery to the touch.
examples.zh: 洋葱的外皮很薄，摸起来像纸一样。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古希腊语/拉丁语 papyrus（莎草纸），核心含义围绕“纸制材料”，并引申至写在纸上的报纸、学术论文与法律文件，动词引申为贴壁纸或以薄层遮掩。

lemmas.def_zh: 在上面；向更高处；在前文；在更高层次
lemmas.def_en: at or to a higher place, point, or level; earlier in a text

examples.en: We looked out of the plane window at the clouds stretching far above.
examples.zh: 我们透过飞机舷窗，望着远处高高蔓延的云层。

examples.en: For further details, please refer to the conditions stated above.
examples.zh: 欲知更多详情，请参阅上文陈述的条件。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语复合形式（on + be + ufan），本义为‘在上方’，由此引申出空间位置的高处、数量级别的超出以及文书篇章的前文。

lemmas.def_zh: 蓝色的, 下流的, 忧郁的
lemmas.def_en: of the color intermediate between green and violet; having a color similar to that of a clear unclouded sky; - Helen Hunt Jackson

examples.en: She felt unusually blue after hearing the disappointing news about her job.
examples.zh: 听到关于工作的令人失望的消息后，她感到格外忧郁。

lemmas.def_zh: 蓝色
lemmas.def_en: blue color or pigment; resembling the color of the clear sky in the daytime

examples.en: She felt unusually blue after hearing the disappointing news about her job.
examples.zh: 听到关于工作的令人失望的消息后，她感到格外忧郁。

lemmas.def_zh: 蓝, 沮丧, 忧郁
lemmas.def_en: blue color or pigment; resembling the color of the clear sky in the daytime

examples.en: The intense blueness of the ocean surprised the tourists on their arrival.
examples.zh: 大海浓郁的蔚蓝色让刚抵达的游客们惊叹不已。

lemmas.def_zh: 染成蓝色；变蓝
lemmas.def_en: turn blue

examples.en: She felt unusually blue after hearing the disappointing news about her job.
examples.zh: 听到关于工作的令人失望的消息后，她感到格外忧郁。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于日耳曼语表颜色的词根，由天空和海洋的天然色泽引申至忧郁、沮丧的情感意象，并进一步衍生出使变蓝或工业发蓝防锈等动作。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词常用作颜色修饰或表达情绪低落；名词代指蓝色本身或天空、海洋；动词则专指使变蓝或对金属进行发蓝防锈处理。

lemmas.def_zh: 炎热的，烫的；辛辣的；热门的，抢手的；激烈的
lemmas.def_en: having a high temperature; producing a burning sensation in the mouth; currently very popular; intense

examples.en: Be careful with that bowl of soup; it's extremely hot.
examples.zh: 小心那碗汤，它非常烫。

examples.en: Artificial intelligence has become one of the hottest topics in the tech industry.
examples.zh: 人工智能已成为科技行业中最热门的话题之一。

lemmas.def_zh: 暑热, 热烈, 热心
lemmas.def_en: the presence of heat

examples.en: The unexpected hotness of the chili sauce caught everyone by surprise.
examples.zh: 辣椒酱出人意料的辛辣让所有人都措手不及。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 hāt，本义为温度极高，后经隐喻引申至辛辣刺激、情绪热烈以及公众关注度高（热门、抢手）等抽象语义。

lemmas.def_zh: 宣布；宣告；声称；播报
lemmas.def_en: to make something known publicly and officially

examples.en: The company announced plans to expand into international markets.
examples.zh: 该公司宣布了向国际市场扩张的计划。

examples.en: A voice over the loudspeaker announced the delayed departure.
examples.zh: 扩音器里传出一个声音，播报航班延误起飞的消息。

lemmas.def_zh: 公告；告示；通知；发表
lemmas.def_en: a formal public statement about a fact, occurrence, or intention

examples.en: The prime minister is expected to make an official announcement tomorrow.
examples.zh: 预计首相将于明天发表正式声明。

examples.en: We were surprised by the sudden announcement of their wedding.
examples.zh: 他们突然宣布婚讯，让我们感到十分意外。

lemmas.def_zh: 广播员；播音员；报幕员
lemmas.def_en: a person who introduces programs or reads information on radio, television, or over a public address system

examples.en: The radio announcer delivered the morning news in a calm voice.
examples.zh: 电台播音员用平静的声音播报了早间新闻。

examples.en: Passengers listened carefully as the station announcer called out the next train.
examples.zh: 当车站广播员报出下一班列车时，乘客们都仔细听着。

lemmas.def_zh: 未经宣布的
lemmas.def_en: without warning or announcement; ; - M.A.D.Howe

examples.en: The inspector paid an unannounced visit to the factory yesterday morning.
examples.zh: 检查员昨天上午对这家工厂进行了突击访问。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ad-（向、朝）+ nuntiare（报告、传讯，源自 nuntius 信使），核心逻辑为“正式向公众传达/报告讯息”，演化为公开宣布或播报。
family_guide.core_distinction: announcement 指宣告的内容或公告本身，而 announcer 指负责通报、播音的人员。

lemmas.def_zh: 建立，创立；确立，证实；使立足
lemmas.def_en: to set up on a firm or permanent basis; to achieve acceptance or prove beyond doubt

examples.en: The two countries agreed to establish diplomatic relations next month.
examples.zh: 两国同意于下月建立外交关系。

examples.en: She has quickly established a reputation as an insightful researcher.
examples.zh: 她迅速树立了作为一名富有洞察力的研究人员的声誉。

lemmas.def_zh: 建立，创立；机构，营业场所；统治集团，建制派（常作 the Establishment）
lemmas.def_en: the action of establishing; an organization, institution, or business; the traditional ruling elite

examples.en: The establishment of the new fund aims to support young entrepreneurs.
examples.zh: 新基金的设立旨在支持青年创业者。

examples.en: His radical views were fiercely opposed by the medical establishment.
examples.zh: 他的激进观点遭到了医学界权威阶层的强烈反对。

lemmas.def_zh: 未确立的, 未被确认的,尚无成就的
lemmas.def_en: not established

examples.en: The young scientist struggled for funding due to her unestablished reputation.
examples.zh: 这位年轻科学家因名气尚低而难以获得资助。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 stabilis（稳固的，源于 stare 站立），核心逻辑是“使某事物稳固地立足”，引申出创立、确立和证实等义
family_guide.core_distinction: establish 为动作（建立、证实）；establishment 既可指建立的行为，也可实体化指代建立起的“机构/企业”，或引申指把持权力的“既得利益集团/建制派”。

lemmas.def_zh: 特殊的, 明确的, 具有特效的, 特定地, 具体地
lemmas.def_en: (sometimes followed by `to') applying to or characterized by or distinguishing something particular or special or unique

examples.en: The teacher gave specific instructions on how to complete the final project.
examples.zh: 老师就如何完成期末项目给出了具体的指导。

lemmas.def_zh: 非特异性的
lemmas.def_en: not caused by a specific agent; used also of staining in making microscope slides

examples.en: The doctor noted that fatigue is a nonspecific symptom of many illnesses.
examples.zh: 医生指出，疲劳是许多疾病的非特异性症状。

lemmas.def_zh: 非特定的,不具体的,不确定的
lemmas.def_en: not detailed or specific

examples.en: His reply was too unspecific to help us solve the technical issue.
examples.zh: 他的回答太不具体，无法帮助我们解决技术问题。

lemmas.def_zh: 具体地，明确地；特意，专门地
lemmas.def_en: in a precise or detailed manner; expressly for a particular purpose

examples.en: The training course was designed specifically for newly recruited engineers.
examples.zh: 该培训课程是专门为新聘工程师设计的。

examples.en: He specifically asked not to be disturbed during the meeting.
examples.zh: 他特别交代开会期间不要打扰他。

lemmas.def_zh: 特效药, 特性
lemmas.def_en: a fact about some part (as opposed to general)

examples.en: The teacher gave specific instructions on how to complete the final project.
examples.zh: 老师就如何完成期末项目给出了具体的指导。

lemmas.def_zh: 特异性, 专一性, 特殊性, 特性, 特征
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being specific rather than general

examples.en: The new blood test boasts high specificity for detecting the rare virus.
examples.zh: 这种新的血液检测在检测该罕见病毒方面具有很高的特异性。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 species（种类）与 -ficus（制造/促成），字面义为“赋予特定种类的”，核心逻辑由“界定种类的”引申为“明确的、具体的、特定的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词 specific 表示具体的或特定的；名词 specific 常用复数形式 specifics，专指“具体细节/事项”。

lemmas.def_zh: 盒子, 箱, 方框, 一巴掌
lemmas.def_en: a (usually rectangular) container; may have a lid

examples.en: He placed the delicate glass vase into a sturdy cardboard box.
examples.zh: 他把精致的玻璃花瓶放进了一个坚固的纸箱里。

lemmas.def_zh: 拳师
lemmas.def_en: someone who fights with his fists for sport

examples.en: The professional boxer trained rigorously every morning before the championship match.
examples.zh: 这名职业拳击手在冠军赛前每天早晨都进行严格训练。

lemmas.def_zh: 装...入盒中, 装箱, 打耳光；拳击
lemmas.def_en: put into a box

examples.en: He placed the delicate glass vase into a sturdy cardboard box.
examples.zh: 他把精致的玻璃花瓶放进了一个坚固的纸箱里。

lemmas.def_zh: 似盒子的, 盒状的
lemmas.def_en: resembling a box in rectangularity

examples.en: He replaced his boxy old jacket with a sleek, modern tailored suit.
examples.zh: 他换下了那件方方正正的旧夹克，穿上了一套修身时髦的西装。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于黄杨木（boxwood），最初指由其制成的坚固“容器/盒子”，引申出“装箱”与封闭空间；另一同音古源表“掌击”，演变为现代的“拳击”之意。
family_guide.core_distinction: box 兼具容器（名词）与装箱/拳击（动词）两类含义；boxer 则专指人（拳击手），复数形式 boxers 常指平角内裤。

lemmas.def_zh: 在里面
lemmas.def_en: within a building

examples.en: It started raining heavily, so the children quickly ran inside to play.
examples.zh: 外面开始下大雨，于是孩子们迅速跑进屋里去玩。

lemmas.def_zh: 内部, 内脏, 内幕
lemmas.def_en: the region that is inside of something

examples.en: He was arrested after leaking sensitive inside information to rival companies for money.
examples.zh: 他因为了钱向竞争对手公司泄露敏感内部信息而被捕。

lemmas.def_zh: 内部的, 秘密的, 户内的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or being on the side closer to the center or within a defined space

examples.en: He was arrested after leaking sensitive inside information to rival companies for money.
examples.zh: 他因为了钱向竞争对手公司泄露敏感内部信息而被捕。

family_guide.root_logic: 由前缀 in-（在……内）与 side（侧、边）组合而成，核心意象始终为“位于内部或朝向内侧”，演变出副词、名词及形容词等不同语法功能。
family_guide.core_distinction: 副词作状语表示动作的方向或地点（向/在里面）；名词指具体的内部空间或表面；形容词作定语，既可表物理内部（如 inside pocket），也可引申指圈内/内幕的（如 inside information）。

lemmas.def_zh: 运动, 游戏, 娱乐, 消遣, 玩笑
lemmas.def_en: an active diversion requiring physical exertion and competition

examples.en: He walked into the office today sporting an expensive new designer leather jacket.
examples.zh: 他今天走进办公室时身上得意地穿着一件昂贵的新名牌皮夹克。

lemmas.def_zh: 游戏, 参加体育运动, 戏弄, 产生变种；炫耀, 使产生变种
lemmas.def_en: wear or display in an ostentatious or proud manner

examples.en: He walked into the office today sporting an expensive new designer leather jacket.
examples.zh: 他今天走进办公室时身上得意地穿着一件昂贵的新名牌皮夹克。

lemmas.def_zh: 非运动的, 不爱好运动的, 不光明正大的, 不公正的
lemmas.def_en: violating accepted standards or rules

examples.en: Tripping an opponent deliberately is widely considered an unsporting move on the field.
examples.zh: 故意绊倒对手被广泛认为是球场上不光彩的行为。

lemmas.def_zh: 在体育运动方面
lemmas.def_en: so as to be sporting; in a sporting manner

examples.en: Despite the painful loss, the tennis champion sportingly applauded his young opponent's victory.
examples.zh: 尽管遭遇痛失，这位网球冠军还是很有风度地为年轻对手的胜利鼓掌。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 desport（娱乐、消遣，由 dis- '分离/离开' + portare '携带' 构成，本义为'使人从劳作中脱离转向放松'），后演变为体育运动（n.）及特意展示/穿戴（v.）。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词侧重体育竞技或大度开朗的人（good sport）；动词在现代英语中最常用于引申义，表示引人注目地穿戴某种服饰或留某种发型。

lemmas.def_zh: 利益
lemmas.def_en: financial assistance in time of need

examples.en: Thousands of low-income families will directly benefit from the government's new healthcare policy.
examples.zh: 成千上万的低收入家庭将直接受益于政府的新医疗政策。

lemmas.def_zh: 慈善, 善行, 赠物
lemmas.def_en: doing good; feeling beneficent

examples.en: The new community hospital was built through the pure beneficence of a local donor.
examples.zh: 这所新的社区医院是靠一位当地捐赠者的纯粹善行建成的。

lemmas.def_zh: 有益于；受益
lemmas.def_en: derive a benefit from

examples.en: Thousands of low-income families will directly benefit from the government's new healthcare policy.
examples.zh: 成千上万的低收入家庭将直接受益于政府的新医疗政策。

lemmas.def_zh: 有益的，有利的
lemmas.def_en: having a good, helpful, or favorable effect

examples.en: Adequate sleep is highly beneficial to cognitive performance.
examples.zh: 充足的睡眠对认知能力极为有益。

examples.en: Both nations worked to secure a mutually beneficial trade agreement.
examples.zh: 两国共同努力达成了一项互利共赢的贸易协定。

lemmas.def_zh: 仁慈的, 慈善的, 善行的
lemmas.def_en: doing or producing good

examples.en: The local community prospered greatly thanks to the beneficent actions of local donors.
examples.zh: 多亏了当地捐赠者的善举，当地社区得到了极大的繁荣。

lemmas.def_zh: 受益地；获利地；有使用权地
lemmas.def_en: in a beneficial manner

examples.en: The new organic fertilizer interacted beneficially with the soil, greatly boosting crop yields.
examples.zh: 这种新型有机肥料对土壤产生了有益的作用，极大地提高了农作物产量。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 bene（好）与 facere（做），核心逻辑为“带来好处、行善事”，后引申为“利益、受惠、有益的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: benefit 兼作名词（益处/福利）与动词（使受益/受惠于），形容词 beneficial 专指事物“有益的、有利的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 使...满足, 使...安心
lemmas.def_en: satisfy in a limited way

examples.en: Most of the online video content is freely accessible to the public.
examples.zh: 大部分在线视频内容都可以供公众免费获取。

lemmas.def_zh: 包含，容纳；抑制，控制（感情或局势）
lemmas.def_en: to hold or have within; to control or restrain

examples.en: This document contains confidential information about the project.
examples.zh: 该文件包含关于该项目的机密信息。

examples.en: She could barely contain her excitement when she heard the news.
examples.zh: 听到这个消息时，她几乎无法抑制内心的兴奋。

lemmas.def_zh: 用集装箱装
lemmas.def_en: package in a container

examples.en: Shipping companies began to containerize freight to make global maritime transport much faster.
examples.zh: 航运公司开始将货物集装箱化，以使全球海上运输更快。

lemmas.def_zh: 内容, 满足, 意义, 要旨
lemmas.def_en: everything that is included in a collection and that is held or included in something

examples.en: Most of the online video content is freely accessible to the public.
examples.zh: 大部分在线视频内容都可以供公众免费获取。

lemmas.def_en: one of the large landmasses of the earth
lemmas.def_zh: 大洲，大陆

examples.en: Africa is the second-largest continent in the world.
examples.zh: 非洲是世界第二大洲。

lemmas.def_zh: 容器；集装箱，货柜
lemmas.def_en: an object for holding or carrying things; a large metal box for transporting goods

examples.en: Store the leftovers in an airtight container in the fridge.
examples.zh: 将剩菜存放在密封容器中并放入冰箱。

examples.en: Thousands of shipping containers are unloaded at the port every day.
examples.zh: 港口每天都有成千上万个海运集装箱被卸下。

lemmas.def_zh: 抑制, 牵制, 遏制
lemmas.def_en: a policy of creating strategic alliances in order to check the expansion of a hostile power or ideology or to force it to negotiate peacefully

examples.en: The government focused on the rapid containment of the viral outbreak across cities.
examples.zh: 政府将重点放在迅速遏制疫情在各城市的蔓延上。

lemmas.def_zh: 满足, 使人满意的事物, 满意
lemmas.def_en: happiness with one's situation in life

examples.en: True contentment often comes from appreciating simple pleasures rather than wealth.
examples.zh: 真正的满足往往来自于体味简单的快乐，而非金钱财富。

lemmas.def_zh: 自制
lemmas.def_en: the exercise of self constraint in sexual matters

examples.en: Practicing emotional continence helped him remain calm under extreme professional pressure.
examples.zh: 保持情绪上的克制帮助他在巨大的工作压力下依然从容镇定。

lemmas.def_zh: 满足;安份
lemmas.def_en: the state of being contented with your situation in life

examples.en: A deep sense of contentedness filled the room as the family gathered.
examples.zh: 全家团聚时，房间里洋溢着一种深切的知足与安详。

lemmas.def_zh: 满足地；安心地
lemmas.def_en: with equanimity

examples.en: The cat purred contentedly by the fireplace on a cold winter night.
examples.zh: 在寒冷的冬夜里，猫咪在壁炉旁心满意足地打着呼噜。

lemmas.def_en: of or pertaining to or typical of Europe
lemmas.def_zh: 大陆的，大陆性的

examples.en: The region experiences a harsh continental climate with freezing winters.
examples.zh: 该地区属于严酷的大陆性气候，冬季十分寒冷。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 continere（con- 共同 + tenere 握住），核心逻辑为“收拢并握在内部”，引申出物理上的“容纳/包含”以及抽象上的“抑制/控制”。
family_guide.core_distinction: contain 为核心动词（包含/遏制），container 则为动作的载体名词，特指日常容器或运输用的集装箱。

lemmas.def_zh: 细节, 详情
lemmas.def_en: an isolated fact that is considered separately from the whole

examples.en: The official report will detail the precise sequence of events leading to failure.
examples.zh: 官方报告将详细阐述导致失败的一系列确切事件。

lemmas.def_zh: 详述, 选派；画详图
lemmas.def_en: provide details for

examples.en: The official report will detail the precise sequence of events leading to failure.
examples.zh: 官方报告将详细阐述导致失败的一系列确切事件。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 详细的；细致的；详尽的
lemmas.def_en: having many details or giving a lot of information; paying great attention to detail
lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰说明、分析、计划或报告，如 a detailed account / detailed instructions。

examples.en: The police asked for a detailed description of the suspect.
examples.zh: 警方要求提供关于嫌疑人的详细描述。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 détailler（dé- 分开 + tailler 切割），本义为“切成小块”，引申为把整体拆解成微小的部分进行审视、记录或执行，即“细节”与“逐一详述”。

lemmas.def_zh: 在线的；联网的；网上的
lemmas.def_en: connected to, served by, or available through a computer network, especially the internet

examples.en: More consumers are turning to online shopping for convenience and better prices.
examples.zh: 为了图方便和更优惠的价格，越来越多的消费者转向网上购物。

examples.en: The university offers a wide range of online courses for remote learners.
examples.zh: 该大学为远程学习者提供了种类丰富的在线课程。

family_guide.root_logic: 由介词 on（处于……状态）与 line（线路）合成，原指设备接入通信或铁路线路，现专门引申为接入互联网或计算机系统的‘在线’状态。

lemmas.def_zh: 安全的, 可靠的, 平安的, 稳健的, 有把握的
lemmas.def_en: free from danger or the risk of harm

examples.en: The manager locked the store cash and jewelry securely in the heavy safe.
examples.zh: 经理把店里的现金和珠宝安全地锁在沉重的保险箱里。

lemmas.def_zh: 不安全的, 不安稳的, 危险的
lemmas.def_en: lacking in security or safety

examples.en: Engineers warned that the decaying wooden bridge was unsafe for heavy truck traffic.
examples.zh: 工程师警告说，年久失修的木桥对重型卡车通行来说是不安全的。

lemmas.def_zh: 保险箱, 冷藏室
lemmas.def_en: strongbox where valuables can be safely kept

examples.en: The manager locked the store cash and jewelry securely in the heavy safe.
examples.zh: 经理把店里的现金和珠宝安全地锁在沉重的保险箱里。

lemmas.def_zh: [表]安全, 保险, 平安, 没受伤, 无损, 无害, 谨慎, 稳健, 一定, 稳定, 可靠
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being safe

examples.en: Rigorous tests confirmed the absolute safeness of the newly developed domestic drinking water.
examples.zh: 严格的测试证实了新开发的生活饮用水的绝对安全性。

lemmas.def_zh: 安全地, 确实地
lemmas.def_en: with safety; in a safe manner

examples.en: Despite the dense fog, the pilot landed the passenger aircraft safely on schedule.
examples.zh: 尽管大雾弥漫，飞行员还是按时将客机安全降落。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 salvus（完好无损的、健康的），经古法语 sauf 演变为英语 safe，核心语义始终贯穿“未受侵害、完好无损、免于危险”的意象。
family_guide.core_distinction: safe 既可作形容词表示“安全的”，亦可名词化特指存放贵重物品的“保险箱”；unsafe 为其直接前缀否定形式。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 墙，墙壁；屏障，障碍；v. 用墙围住；筑墙封堵
lemmas.def_en: n. a continuous vertical brick or stone structure; a barrier; v. to enclose, surround, or fortify with walls

examples.en: The garden is protected from the wind by a high stone wall.
examples.zh: 这座花园由一堵高高的石墙挡风护卫着。

examples.en: The workers had to wall up the old doorway to create a separate room.
examples.zh: 工人们不得不把旧门道用砖墙封堵起来，以隔出一个独立的房间。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 墙，墙壁；屏障，障碍；v. 用墙围住；筑墙封堵
lemmas.def_en: n. a continuous vertical brick or stone structure; a barrier; v. to enclose, surround, or fortify with walls

examples.en: The garden is protected from the wind by a high stone wall.
examples.zh: 这座花园由一堵高高的石墙挡风护卫着。

examples.en: The workers had to wall up the old doorway to create a separate room.
examples.zh: 工人们不得不把旧门道用砖墙封堵起来，以隔出一个独立的房间。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 vallum（壁垒、城墙），核心语义指起分隔、防御或围合作用的垂直隔断结构，后引申出心理屏障及封闭隔绝等动作。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词指物理阻隔或防护的墙体及抽象屏障；动词则表示用墙围起、封闭或阻断（常与 up、off、in 连用）。

lemmas.def_zh: 门；出入口；途径，门路
lemmas.def_en: a movable barrier used to close off an entrance to a building, room, or vehicle; a means of access

examples.en: Please make sure the front door is locked before going to bed.
examples.zh: 睡觉前请务必确认前门已经锁好。

examples.en: A good education can open the door to countless opportunities.
examples.zh: 良好的教育能为无尽的机遇敞开大门。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语中表示“门、通道”的词根，核心指建筑物、房间或车辆的出入口构件，常引申为通往某种机会或状态的途径。
family_guide.core_distinction: 本词族衍生词多为与空间方位结合的复合词（如 indoor, outdoor, doorway），核心词 door 特指门板本身或通行的门户。

lemmas.def_zh: 运气；好运；侥幸
lemmas.def_en: success or failure brought by chance rather than one's own actions; good fortune

examples.en: I wish you the best of luck in your new career.
examples.zh: 祝你在新的职业生涯中一切顺利。

examples.en: With a bit of luck, we should finish the project before Friday.
examples.zh: 如果运气好的话，我们周五前就能完成这个项目。

lemmas.def_zh: (unlucky 的最高级) a. 不吉利的, 不祥的, 不幸的

examples.en: He felt like the unluckiest person alive after missing his flight by minutes.
examples.zh: 在以数分钟之差错过了航班后，他觉得自己是世界上最倒霉的人。

lemmas.def_zh: 幸运的；带来好运的；侥幸的
lemmas.def_en: having, bringing, or resulting from good luck

examples.en: She considered herself lucky to have survived the accident unharmed.
examples.zh: 她觉得自己能在事故中毫发无伤真是太幸运了。

examples.en: Seven is widely regarded as a lucky number in many Western cultures.
examples.zh: 在许多西方文化中，数字七被普遍视为吉祥数字。

lemmas.def_zh: 不幸的；倒霉的；不吉利的
lemmas.def_en: having or bringing bad luck; ill-fated

examples.en: The team was unlucky to lose the match in the final minute.
examples.zh: 该队在最后一分钟输掉比赛，实在太倒霉了。

examples.en: In some cultures, spilling salt is believed to be unlucky.
examples.zh: 在某些文化中，打翻盐被认为是不吉利的。

lemmas.def_zh: 不幸的, 坏运气的
lemmas.def_en: having or bringing misfortune

examples.en: The luckless travelers found themselves stranded at the airport when their flight canceled.
examples.zh: 航班被取消后，这群倒霉的旅客发现自己滞留在了机场。

lemmas.def_zh: 幸运地；幸好；幸亏
lemmas.def_en: it is fortunate that; by good fortune

examples.en: Luckily, the rain stopped just before the outdoor ceremony began.
examples.zh: 幸好在室外仪式开始前雨就停了。

examples.en: I left my wallet on the bus, but luckily someone handed it in.
examples.zh: 我把钱包落在了公交车上，但万幸的是有人捡到并交了上去。

lemmas.def_zh: 不幸地, 偏巧, 偏偏
lemmas.def_en: by bad luck

examples.en: Unluckily, heavy rain started to fall right as we set out on hike.
examples.zh: 不幸的是，正当我们出发徒步时，天开始下起大雨。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中古低地德语或中古荷兰语，核心指非人力所能掌控的“偶然机缘”，后引申为带来利益或顺境的“好运”。
family_guide.core_distinction: luck为核心名词（表运气本身），lucky与unlucky为对称的肯定与否定形容词，luckily则常作评注性副词修饰全句。

lemmas.def_zh: 进入；参加，加入；输入（信息）
lemmas.def_en: to come or go into a place; to become a member or participant; to record or key in data

examples.en: Please knock before you enter the office.
examples.zh: 进办公室前请敲门。

examples.en: You need to enter your username and password to log in.
examples.zh: 你需要输入用户名和密码才能登录。

examples.en: Over a hundred athletes have entered the competition this year.
examples.zh: 今年有一百多名运动员报名参加了这项比赛。

lemmas.def_en: attract; cause to be enamored
lemmas.def_zh: 使出神, 使入迷

examples.en: Security guards stood alertly outside the main entrance to check every visitor's identification.
examples.zh: 保安警惕地站在正门外，检查每位访客的身份证件。

lemmas.def_zh: 进入；入口；登记，条目；参赛作品
lemmas.def_en: an act of going or coming in; a place of entrance; an item recorded in a list, diary, or dictionary; something entered in a competition

examples.en: The thieves gained entry to the museum through a broken window.
examples.zh: 窃贼通过一扇破损的窗户潜入了博物馆。

examples.en: Check the dictionary entry if you are unsure of the word's pronunciation.
examples.zh: 如果你拿不准这个单词的发音，可以查阅词典中的词条。

lemmas.def_en: something that provides access (to get in or get out)
lemmas.def_zh: 入口, 进入点, 入场, 入学, 进入, 开始(阶段), 就任

examples.en: Security guards stood alertly outside the main entrance to check every visitor's identification.
examples.zh: 保安警惕地站在正门外，检查每位访客的身份证件。

lemmas.def_zh: 新会员, 新成员, 进入者
lemmas.def_en: a commodity that enters competition with established merchandise

examples.en: Each entrant in the design competition must submit an original poster by Friday.
examples.zh: 每位设计比赛的参赛者必须在周五前提交一张原创海报。

lemmas.def_zh: 入场许可, 主菜
lemmas.def_en: the principal dish of a meal

examples.en: For the main course, she ordered the grilled salmon entree with roasted vegetables.
examples.zh: 至于主菜，她点了烤三文鱼配烤蔬菜。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 intrare（进入），核心意象为“由外至内地移动或跨越边界”，后引申出加入组织、参加活动以及将信息录入系统等含义。

lemmas.def_zh: 交叉, 横过, 越过
lemmas.def_en: travel across or pass over

examples.en: A golden cross stood proudly at the top of the ancient stone church.
examples.zh: 一座金色的十字架巍然立于古老石砌教堂的顶端。

lemmas.def_zh: 使不交叉
lemmas.def_en: change from a crossed to an uncrossed position

examples.en: She decided to uncross her legs and stretch comfortably after sitting for hours.
examples.zh: 坐了几个小时后，她决定不再翘二郎腿，舒舒服服地伸展一下。

lemmas.def_zh: 十字架, 十字架形物件, 交叉, 十字标, 交叉路, 磨难, 杂交
lemmas.def_en: a wooden structure consisting of an upright post with a transverse piece

examples.en: A golden cross stood proudly at the top of the ancient stone church.
examples.zh: 一座金色的十字架巍然立于古老石砌教堂的顶端。

lemmas.def_zh: 横越, 横渡, 交叉点, 渡口
lemmas.def_en: traveling across

examples.en: Pedestrians should always use the marked crossing when they cross this busy street.
examples.zh: 行人穿过这条繁忙的街道时应始终走人行横道。

lemmas.def_zh: 坏脾气
lemmas.def_en: an irritable petulant feeling

examples.en: Her sudden crossness surprised everyone at the peaceful family dinner table.
examples.zh: 在平静的家庭晚餐上，她突然发脾气让所有人都感到意外。

lemmas.def_zh: 生气的, 交叉的, 相反的
lemmas.def_en: extending or lying across; in a crosswise direction; at right angles to the long axis

examples.en: The manager was extremely cross about the costly delay in the project.
examples.zh: 经理对项目代价高昂的延误感到非常生气。

lemmas.def_zh: 横地, 相反地, 故意为难地
lemmas.def_en: in an ill-natured manner

examples.en: "Stop making so much noise," he said crossly to his younger brother.
examples.zh: “别吵了，”他没好气地对弟弟说道。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于拉丁语 crux（十字架），核心意象为两条线“交叉”或“横向跨越”，由此衍生出空间上的“穿越/横贯”、物理形态上的“十字交叉”、物种与事物的“杂交/结合”，以及人际心理上与人意愿相违背而产生的“抵触、恼怒”。
family_guide.core_distinction: cross 兼具动词、名词与形容词，含义广泛；crossing 则是由动词派生出来的专用名词，特指人行横道、交叉路口或水陆横渡的过程。

lemmas.def_zh: 产生，引起；发电，产生（能量）
lemmas.def_en: to produce or create something; to cause something to exist

examples.en: The proposed tax cuts are expected to generate thousands of new jobs.
examples.zh: 拟议的减税措施预计将创造数千个新的就业岗位。

examples.en: Solar panels absorb sunlight and convert it to generate electricity.
examples.zh: 太阳能电池板吸收阳光并将其转化为电能。

lemmas.def_zh: 一代人，世代；产生，发生
lemmas.def_en: all people born around the same time; the process of producing something

examples.en: Cultural values and traditions have been passed down from generation to generation.
examples.zh: 文化价值观和传统被代代相传。

examples.en: The city relies heavily on clean power generation from wind farms.
examples.zh: 该市严重依赖风力发电场产生的清洁能源。

lemmas.def_zh: 发电机；发生器
lemmas.def_en: a machine that produces electricity or other energy

examples.en: When the main power grid failed, the hospital's backup generator kicked in immediately.
examples.zh: 当主电网发生故障时，医院的备用发电机立即启动了。

lemmas.def_zh: 生殖的, 世代的, 代与代之间的, 一代的, 生育的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a generation

examples.en: There is a clear generational divide regarding attitudes toward remote work.
examples.zh: 在对远程办公的态度上存在着明显的代际差异。

lemmas.def_zh: 生殖的, 生产的, 有生殖力的
lemmas.def_en: having the ability to produce or originate

examples.en: The artist explores the creative and generative power of modern artificial intelligence.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家探索了现代人工智能的创造力与生成力。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语词根 gen-（出生、产生），核心语义指通过自然过程或人工手段“从无到有地产生、创造”。
family_guide.core_distinction: generation 侧重“产生的过程/动作”或由出生决定的“一代人”；generator 则指执行产生动作的“发电机、发生器或创造者”。

lemmas.def_zh: 协助，帮助；促进
lemmas.def_en: to help someone do something or provide aid

examples.en: The software is designed to assist teachers in grading assignments more efficiently.
examples.zh: 该软件旨在协助教师更高效地批改作业。

examples.en: Several local volunteers were on hand to assist with the rescue efforts.
examples.zh: 几名当地志愿者在场协助救援工作。

lemmas.def_zh: 助手，助理
lemmas.def_en: a person who helps someone in their work or duty

examples.en: She hired a personal assistant to manage her busy travel schedule.
examples.zh: 她雇了一名私人助理来管理自己繁忙的行程安排。

examples.en: He started his career as a laboratory assistant at a biomedical company.
examples.zh: 他的职业生涯始于一家生物医药公司的实验室助理。

lemmas.def_zh: 帮助，援助，支持
lemmas.def_en: help or support provided to someone

examples.en: The charitable foundation provides financial assistance to students from low-income families.
examples.zh: 该慈善基金会向低收入家庭的学生提供经济援助。

examples.en: Please do not hesitate to contact our customer support if you need further assistance.
examples.zh: 如果您需要进一步的帮助，请随时联系我们的客户支持。

lemmas.def_zh: 为残疾人设计的
lemmas.def_en: giving assistance

examples.en: Modern assistive technology allows visually impaired students to read digital textbooks easily.
examples.zh: 现代辅助技术使视障学生能够轻松阅读电子教科书。

lemmas.def_zh: 无助的, 独力的
lemmas.def_en: unsupported by other people

examples.en: The patient made a full recovery and can now walk unassisted again.
examples.zh: 病人已完全康复，现在又可以独立行走了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 assistere（ad- '在旁边' + sistere '站立'），本义为'站在身旁'，引申为在旁给予支持、协助。
family_guide.core_distinction: assistant 通常指提供协助的'人'（助手、助理），而 assistance 指抽象的'帮助行为或援助'（不可数名词）。

lemmas.def_zh: 情况，处境；局势；位置
lemmas.def_en: a set of circumstances in which one finds oneself; a state of affairs

examples.en: We need to carefully assess the current situation before making any major decisions.
examples.zh: 在做出任何重大决定之前，我们需要仔细评估目前的局势。

examples.en: She managed to handle a very delicate situation with great tact and patience.
examples.zh: 她以极大的圆通与耐心化解了一场非常棘手的局面。

lemmas.def_en: determine or indicate the place, site, or limits of, as if by an instrument or by a survey
lemmas.def_zh: 使位于；使处于（某种背景中）

examples.en: The committee tried to situate the event in its proper historical context.
examples.zh: 委员会试图将该事件置于恰当的历史背景中来考量。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 situs（地点、位置），由物理上的“坐落位置”引申为抽象语境下的“处境、局势或状况”。

lemmas.def_zh: 语言；言语；表达方式；计算机编程语言
lemmas.def_en: a system of communication used by a particular community; a method of expressing thoughts and feelings

examples.en: She is fluent in three foreign languages, including Spanish and Japanese.
examples.zh: 她精通三门外语，包括西班牙语和日语。

examples.en: Non-verbal communication, such as body language, plays a crucial role in human interaction.
examples.zh: 肢体语言等非言语交流在人际互动中起着至关重要的作用。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 lingua（舌头），经古法语演变为人类用以发音、表达和交流的符号系统，后引申为一切系统的沟通或表达方式。

lemmas.def_zh: 影像, 肖像, 想象, 图像, 形象, 翻版；图像
lemmas.def_en: an iconic mental representation

examples.en: The company hired a public relations firm to improve its public image.
examples.zh: 该公司聘请了一家公关公司来改善其公众形象。

lemmas.def_en: the ability to form mental images of things or events
lemmas.def_zh: 肖像, 比喻, 雕刻

examples.en: The poet relies on vivid natural imagery to evoke a sense of deep solitude.
examples.zh: 这位诗人依靠生动的自然意象来唤起一种深切的孤独感。

lemmas.def_zh: 作...的像, 反映, 想象, 象征
lemmas.def_en: render visible, as by means of MRI

examples.en: The company hired a public relations firm to improve its public image.
examples.zh: 该公司聘请了一家公关公司来改善其公众形象。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 imago（肖像、模仿），核心意象为“对现实事物的复制与投射”，由此衍生出具象的图像、心智中的心象/意象，以及公众眼中的人设与形象。

lemmas.def_zh: 奖品, 裁定, 判决
lemmas.def_en: a grant made by a law court

examples.en: The committee decided to award the prestigious scholarship to the top student.
examples.zh: 委员会决定将这项享有盛誉的奖学金授予最优秀的学生。

lemmas.def_zh: 授予, 给予
lemmas.def_en: give, especially as an honor or reward

examples.en: The committee decided to award the prestigious scholarship to the top student.
examples.zh: 委员会决定将这项享有盛誉的奖学金授予最优秀的学生。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语‘审视、审查’，核心逻辑是由权威机构或评审经过正式评估后做出的‘官方裁决’或‘授予奖励’。

lemmas.def_zh: 材料, 物资, 素材, 布料, 资料
lemmas.def_en: the tangible substance that goes into the makeup of a physical object

examples.en: This durable jacket is made from a waterproof and breathable synthetic material.
examples.zh: 这件耐磨夹克是由一种防水透气的合成材料制成的。

lemmas.def_zh: 实质性, 物质性, 实体
lemmas.def_en: relevance requiring careful consideration

examples.en: The auditors carefully assessed the materiality of the missing financial records.
examples.zh: 审计人员仔细评估了缺失财务记录的实质重要性。

lemmas.def_zh: 物质的, 肉体的, 重要的
lemmas.def_en: concerned with worldly rather than spiritual interests

examples.en: This durable jacket is made from a waterproof and breathable synthetic material.
examples.zh: 这件耐磨夹克是由一种防水透气的合成材料制成的。

lemmas.def_zh: 非物质的, 文化的
lemmas.def_en: not consisting of matter

examples.en: Traditional folk songs represent an invaluable part of our nonmaterial cultural heritage.
examples.zh: 传统民歌代表了我们非物质文化遗产中极其宝贵的一部分。

lemmas.def_zh: 实质上, 重大, 物质上
lemmas.def_en: with respect to material aspects

examples.en: The new evidence did not materially affect the final outcome of the trial.
examples.zh: 新证据并未对审判的最终结果产生实质性影响。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 materia（木材、原材、根基），核心语义指构成现实实体的“原料/物质”，后引申为创作或思考的“素材/内容”，以及具有决定作用的“实质性”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 作名词时主要指物理材料或信息资料；作形容词时既可对应精神指“物质的、有形的”，也可在正式或法律语境中表示“关键的、实质性的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 商店, 工厂, 车间
lemmas.def_en: a mercantile establishment for the retail sale of goods or services

examples.en: She decided to shop around online before buying such an expensive laptop.
examples.zh: 在购买这么昂贵的笔记本电脑之前，她决定先在网上货比三家。

lemmas.def_zh: 购物者
lemmas.def_en: someone who visits stores in search of articles to buy

examples.en: The alert shopper found a fantastic discount on fresh produce this morning.
examples.zh: 精明的顾客今天早晨在新鲜果蔬上发现了一个极好的折扣。

lemmas.def_zh: 购物, 到处寻找；选购
lemmas.def_en: do one's shopping

examples.en: She decided to shop around online before buying such an expensive laptop.
examples.zh: 在购买这么昂贵的笔记本电脑之前，她决定先在网上货比三家。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语表示“棚屋、货摊”的词汇，原指制作或销售货物的工棚，后演变为固定的“商店、车间”，并转类为动词“购物、挑选商品”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词侧重指买卖货物的实体场所或手工作坊；动词侧重指巡视、比较并购买商品的动态行为。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 中间，中央；腰部；adj. 中间的，中等的；v. 把……放在中间；（球类运动）传中
lemmas.def_en: n. the central point, part, or position; adj. situated at an equal distance from the ends or edges; v. to place in the center, or to pass/hit a ball toward the center.

examples.en: She woke up in the middle of the night.
examples.zh: 她在半夜醒了过来。

examples.en: He grew up as the middle child of three brothers.
examples.zh: 他是三兄弟中的老二。

examples.en: The winger drove to the baseline and middled the ball into the penalty area.
examples.zh: 边锋突到底线，随后将球传中送入禁区。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 中间，中央；腰部；adj. 中间的，中等的；v. 把……放在中间；（球类运动）传中
lemmas.def_en: n. the central point, part, or position; adj. situated at an equal distance from the ends or edges; v. to place in the center, or to pass/hit a ball toward the center.

examples.en: She woke up in the middle of the night.
examples.zh: 她在半夜醒了过来。

examples.en: He grew up as the middle child of three brothers.
examples.zh: 他是三兄弟中的老二。

examples.en: The winger drove to the baseline and middled the ball into the penalty area.
examples.zh: 边锋突到底线，随后将球传中送入禁区。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 中间，中央；腰部；adj. 中间的，中等的；v. 把……放在中间；（球类运动）传中
lemmas.def_en: n. the central point, part, or position; adj. situated at an equal distance from the ends or edges; v. to place in the center, or to pass/hit a ball toward the center.

examples.en: She woke up in the middle of the night.
examples.zh: 她在半夜醒了过来。

examples.en: He grew up as the middle child of three brothers.
examples.zh: 他是三兄弟中的老二。

examples.zh: 边锋突到底线，随后将球传中送入禁区。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 middel（由 mid 衍生），核心语义始终围绕“处于两端或边界之间的中心位置或阶段”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 该词拼写完全相同，由名词自然兼类转换为形容词和动词（动词多用于体育传中或航海/工业定位），含义高度统一于“中心”。

lemmas.def_zh: 飞, 飞翔, 飘扬, 逃走；飞, 飞越, 使飘扬, 逃出
lemmas.def_en: travel through the air; be airborne

examples.en: Migratory birds usually fly south during the cold autumn and winter months.
examples.zh: 候鸟通常在寒冷的秋冬季节向南飞。

lemmas.def_zh: 飞；飞行（fly 的过去式）
lemmas.def_en: past tense of fly

examples.en: An eagle flew high above the mountain peaks.
examples.zh: 一只老鹰在山峰高处翱翔。

lemmas.def_zh: 飞；飞行（fly 的过去分词）
lemmas.def_en: past participle of fly

examples.en: She has flown thousands of miles on international business trips.
examples.zh: 她因跨国商务旅行飞行了数万英里。

lemmas.def_zh: 苍蝇, 两翼昆虫, 飞行
lemmas.def_en: two-winged insects characterized by active flight

examples.en: Migratory birds usually fly south during the cold autumn and winter months.
examples.zh: 候鸟通常在寒冷的秋冬季节向南飞。

lemmas.def_zh: （广告）传单；乘飞机的人；飞行物
lemmas.def_en: a printed sheet of paper advertising an event or product; a person or thing that flies

examples.en: Volunteers were handing out flyers for the upcoming concert.
examples.zh: 志愿者们正在分发即将举行的音乐会的传单。

examples.en: As a frequent flyer, she enjoys priority boarding privileges.
examples.zh: 作为常客，她享有优先登机的特权。

lemmas.def_zh: 飞行者, 快船, 快车
lemmas.def_en: someone who travels by air

examples.en: She handed out a colorful flier promoting the upcoming local charity concert.
examples.zh: 她分发了一张色彩鲜艳的传单，宣传即将举行的当地慈善音乐会。

lemmas.def_zh: 敏捷的
lemmas.def_en: (British informal) not to be deceived or hoodwinked

examples.en: Migratory birds usually fly south during the cold autumn and winter months.
examples.zh: 候鸟通常在寒冷的秋冬季节向南飞。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 flēogan，核心意象为“在空中扇动双翼或急速移动”，后引申出具体的飞行昆虫（苍蝇）、裤子开襟构造、宣传单页以及口语俚语中的“敏锐、时髦”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词 fly 的不规则变化为 flew（过去式）和 flown（过去分词）；名词 flyer 既可指“乘机旅客（如 frequent flyer）”，更常指街头派发的“传单”。

lemmas.def_zh: 原料, 要素, 东西, 材料, 素质, 织品, 废物, 废话
lemmas.def_en: the tangible substance that goes into the makeup of a physical object

examples.en: He packed all his personal stuff into a cardboard box and moved out.
examples.zh: 他把所有的个人物品装进一个纸箱，然后搬了出去。

lemmas.def_zh: 填塞工人, (非正式)贩卖假货的人
lemmas.def_en: a craftsman who stuffs and mounts the skins of animals for display

examples.en: The pillow stuffer quickly filled each cotton casing with soft synthetic fibers.
examples.zh: 填塞工人迅速用柔软的合成纤维装满每个棉质外罩。

lemmas.def_zh: 装填；狼吞虎咽
lemmas.def_en: cram into a cavity

examples.en: Don't stuff your pockets with candy right before dinner time.
examples.zh: 晚饭前别把糖果塞满你的口袋。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 estoffe（织物、装备、材料），本义为制造或填充某物所需的原料，后在名词中泛化为各种“东西、琐事”，在动词中演变为“填满、塞满”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 同一词形既作不可数名词指代泛泛的“东西/材料”，也作动词表示动作“填塞、塞满”。

lemmas.def_zh: 使皱缩, 使缩短, 感染, 订约, 缔结；皱缩, 订约, 收缩
lemmas.def_en: enter into a contractual arrangement

examples.en: Both parties agreed to contract under the newly proposed business terms.
examples.zh: 双方同意根据新提议的商业条款订立契约。

lemmas.def_zh: 合约, 婚约, 契约
lemmas.def_en: a binding agreement between two or more persons that is enforceable by law

examples.en: Both parties agreed to contract under the newly proposed business terms.
examples.zh: 双方同意根据新提议的商业条款订立契约。

lemmas.def_zh: 立契约的人, 承包商
lemmas.def_en: someone (a person or firm) who contracts to build things

examples.en: We hired a licensed contractor to remodel the entire kitchen.
examples.zh: 我们雇佣了一位有执照的承包商来翻修整个厨房。

lemmas.def_zh: 收缩, 缩写式, 害病
lemmas.def_en: (physiology) a shortening or tensing of a part or organ (especially of a muscle or muscle fiber)

examples.en: Cold weather causes the contraction of certain metal railway tracks.
examples.zh: 寒冷的天气会导致某些金属铁轨收缩。

lemmas.def_zh: 挛缩
lemmas.def_en: an abnormal and usually permanent contraction of a muscle

examples.en: Physical therapy helped prevent joint contracture after the patient spent weeks in bed.
examples.zh: 在患者卧床数周后，物理治疗有助于防止关节挛缩。

lemmas.def_zh: 契约的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or part of a binding legal agreement

examples.en: Both companies must fulfill their contractual obligations before the joint venture can proceed.
examples.zh: 两家公司都必须履行其合同义务，合资项目方可推进。

lemmas.def_zh: 合约地；合同性地；契约规定地
lemmas.def_en: by virtue of a contract

examples.en: they were contractually responsible

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 contractus（con-‘共同’ + trahere‘拉、扯’），核心逻辑为‘拉到一起’：物理上拉紧聚合引申为‘收缩’，把各方意愿拉拢到一起引申为‘订立契约/合同’，把病气揽到身上引申为‘染病’。
family_guide.core_distinction: contract 作动词重音在后（/kənˈtrækt/），作名词重音在前（/ˈkɒntrækt/）；contractor 特指依照合同承揽特定工程或业务的‘承包商/独立工’。

lemmas.def_zh: 抱歉的；遗憾的；难过的；同情的
lemmas.def_en: feeling regret, sympathy, or sadness; apologetic

examples.en: I'm deeply sorry for the misunderstanding caused by my delay.
examples.zh: 对于因我的延误而造成的误解，我深表歉意。

examples.en: We were very sorry to hear the sad news about your grandmother.
examples.zh: 听到关于你祖母的不幸消息，我们感到非常难过。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古英语 sārig（痛苦的、悲伤的，与 sore 同源），核心语义从肉体创痛引申为内心的歉疚、遗憾与同情。

lemmas.def_zh: 挤进, 使塞满, 混杂, 压碎, 使堵塞；堵塞, 轧住, 拥挤
lemmas.def_en: press tightly together or cram

examples.en: Traffic began to jam the highway during the evening rush hour.
examples.zh: 晚高峰期间，车辆开始堵塞高速公路。

lemmas.def_zh: 果酱, 拥塞之物, 堵塞, 困境
lemmas.def_en: preserve of crushed fruit

examples.en: Traffic began to jam the highway during the evening rush hour.
examples.zh: 晚高峰期间，车辆开始堵塞高速公路。

family_guide.root_logic: 核心本义为“用力挤压、塞满”，由此引申出物体因挤压而“卡住”、空间因人车挤满而“堵塞”、比喻陷入“窘境”，以及把水果捣碎熬煮成的“果酱”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词与名词同形，动词指“卡住/挤入/即兴演奏”等动作，名词则表“交通拥堵/果酱/窘境”等状态或事物。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 血液；血统，家族；v. 使（新兵、猎犬等）初次体验/经受战火考验
lemmas.def_en: n. the red fluid circulating in the veins and arteries; family lineage; v. to give someone their first experience of battle or strenuous activity

examples.en: Regularly donating blood is a simple act that saves lives.
examples.zh: 定期献血是一项能挽救生命的简单善举。

examples.en: The manager chose to blood several young players in the cup match.
examples.zh: 主教练选择在杯赛中让几名年轻小将初试身手。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 血液；血统，家族；v. 使（新兵、猎犬等）初次体验/经受战火考验
lemmas.def_en: n. the red fluid circulating in the veins and arteries; family lineage; v. to give someone their first experience of battle or strenuous activity

examples.en: Regularly donating blood is a simple act that saves lives.
examples.zh: 定期献血是一项能挽救生命的简单善举。

examples.en: The manager chose to blood several young players in the cup match.
examples.zh: 主教练选择在杯赛中让几名年轻小将初试身手。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 流血的，染血的；残暴惨烈的；[英式俚语] 该死的，非常的；v. 使流血；把…弄上血迹
lemmas.def_en: adj. covered with blood; involving much bloodshed; (informal) used for emphasis or to express anger; v. to stain with blood or cause to bleed

examples.en: The protracted civil war was one of the bloodiest conflicts of the decade.
examples.zh: 这场旷日持久的内战是这十年中最血腥惨烈的冲突之一。

examples.en: He slipped on the sharp rocks, badly bloodying his knees.
examples.zh: 他在锋利的岩石上滑倒，磕得双膝鲜血直流。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 流血的，染血的；残暴惨烈的；[英式俚语] 该死的，非常的；v. 使流血；把…弄上血迹
lemmas.def_en: adj. covered with blood; involving much bloodshed; (informal) used for emphasis or to express anger; v. to stain with blood or cause to bleed

examples.en: The protracted civil war was one of the bloodiest conflicts of the decade.
examples.zh: 这场旷日持久的内战是这十年中最血腥惨烈的冲突之一。

examples.en: He slipped on the sharp rocks, badly bloodying his knees.
examples.zh: 他在锋利的岩石上滑倒，磕得双膝鲜血直流。

lemmas.def_zh: 无血色的, 不流血的, 没精神的
lemmas.def_en: destitute of blood or apparently so; - John Dryden

examples.en: The military coup was surprisingly bloodless, with no casualties reported.
examples.zh: 这场军事政变出人意料地未流一滴血，据报道无人员伤亡。

lemmas.def_zh: 血迹斑斑地, 残忍地
lemmas.def_en: involving a great bloodshed

examples.en: The fierce battle ended bloodily on the muddy hillside at dusk.
examples.zh: 激烈的战斗在黄昏时分的泥泞山坡上血腥地结束了。

lemmas.def_zh: bloodless的变形
lemmas.def_en: without bloodshed; in a bloodless manner; without shedding blood

examples.en: The disputed territory was bloodlessly handed over after extensive negotiations.
examples.zh: 经过广泛的谈判，这片争议领土被和平移交。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 blōd，核心本义为维持生命且在体内流动的“血液”，由此自然引申为“血统/亲缘”、“流血/杀戮”，并在动词层面上发展出“使初尝血腥（经受考验）”与“沾染血迹”的涵义。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词 blood 专用于引申义“使初试身手/经受实战洗礼”；动词 bloody 则侧重物理层面的“使流血/沾上血”；形容词 bloody 除“血污的、惨烈的”外，在英式口语中还广泛用作表示愤怒或强调的加重语气词。

lemmas.def_zh: 冒...的危险, 冒险干
lemmas.def_en: expose to a chance of loss or damage

examples.en: He was unwilling to risk losing his steady job for that venture.
examples.zh: 他不愿为了那次投机而冒失去稳定工作的风险。

lemmas.def_zh: 冒险, 危险, 保险额
lemmas.def_en: a source of danger; a possibility of incurring loss or misfortune

examples.en: He was unwilling to risk losing his steady job for that venture.
examples.zh: 他不愿为了那次投机而冒失去稳定工作的风险。

lemmas.def_zh: 富有冒险性的事, 危险
lemmas.def_en: a state of danger involving risk

examples.en: Investors were worried about the extreme riskiness of the volatile stock market.
examples.zh: 投资者担心动荡的股市具有极高的风险性。

lemmas.def_zh: 有风险的；冒险的；危险的
lemmas.def_en: involving the possibility of danger, failure, or loss
