examples.en: Driving fast on icy roads is an extremely risky behavior.
examples.zh: 在结冰的路面上超速行驶是一种极其危险的行为。

lemmas.def_zh: 无危险的
lemmas.def_en: thought to be devoid of risk

examples.en: Treasury bonds are often considered a nearly riskless financial investment.
examples.zh: 国债通常被认为是一种几乎无风险的金融投资。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自航海用语中船只触碰暗礁的危险，核心语义演变为“潜在的损失、危险”，进而引申出名词“风险”与动词“冒……的危险”。
family_guide.core_distinction: risk 兼作名词（风险本身）和动词（拿……冒险/冒着……风险），risky 为其形容词派生词，强调事物充满不确定性或危险。

lemmas.def_zh: 旅游, 观光旅行, 任期
lemmas.def_en: a journey or route all the way around a particular place or area

examples.en: The famous rock band will tour several European cities this summer.
examples.zh: 这支著名摇滚乐队今年夏天将巡演数个欧洲城市。

lemmas.def_en: the business of providing services to tourists
lemmas.def_zh: 观光业, 游览

examples.en: International tourism plays an extremely vital role in boosting the small island's economy.
examples.zh: 国际旅游业在促进这个小岛的经济方面发挥着至关重要的作用。

lemmas.def_zh: 观光客, 旅行者
lemmas.def_en: someone who travels for pleasure

examples.en: Every tourist stopped to take photos in front of the historic palace.
examples.zh: 每位游客都停下来在这座历史悠久的宫殿前拍照。

lemmas.def_zh: 游览车
lemmas.def_en: someone who travels for pleasure

examples.en: He bought a reliable tourer to travel across the continent comfortably.
examples.zh: 他买了一辆可靠的游览车，以便舒适地横穿大陆。

lemmas.def_zh: 旅行, 周游, 巡回；周游, 观光, 游历, 使巡回演出
lemmas.def_en: make a tour of a certain place

examples.en: The famous rock band will tour several European cities this summer.
examples.zh: 这支著名摇滚乐队今年夏天将巡演数个欧洲城市。

lemmas.def_zh: 游览者的, 游览者喜欢的
lemmas.def_en: visited by throngs of tourists

examples.en: We avoided the touristy restaurants and found a quiet local diner instead.
examples.zh: 我们避开了游客扎堆的餐馆，转而找到一家安静的当地小吃店。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 tour（回转、圈），核心意象为‘绕行一圈后返回’，演化为巡回、周游、观光等含义。
family_guide.core_distinction: tourist 指具体的观光客（人），而 tour 既作名词表示旅行、巡回路线或参观，也可直接作动词表示在某地游历或巡演。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 植物；工厂，车间；v. 种植，播种；牢固树立
lemmas.def_en: a living organism grown in earth; a factory or industrial site; to place seeds or flora in soil to grow

examples.en: Water the house plants regularly, but avoid overwatering.
examples.zh: 定期给室内植物浇水，但注意不要浇过头。

examples.en: They decided to plant native shrubs along the garden fence.
examples.zh: 他们决定沿着花园篱笆种上一些本土灌木。

examples.en: The automaker announced plans to build a new assembly plant.
examples.zh: 该汽车制造商宣布了建设一座新组装厂的计划。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 种植，栽植；栽种的花木群
lemmas.def_en: the activity of putting seeds or plants into the ground; a group of planted trees or flowers

examples.en: Early spring is usually the ideal window for tree planting.
examples.zh: 早春通常是植树的理想时机。

examples.en: The garden design incorporates dense plantings of ornamental grasses.
examples.zh: 该花园设计融入了密集种植的观赏草组合。

lemmas.def_zh: 种植者, 耕作者, 种植机, 花盆
lemmas.def_en: the owner or manager of a plantation

examples.en: She placed a ceramic planter with blooming roses by the front window.
examples.zh: 她在前窗旁放了一个盛开着玫瑰的花盆。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 植物；工厂，车间；v. 种植，播种；牢固树立
lemmas.def_en: a living organism grown in earth; a factory or industrial site; to place seeds or flora in soil to grow

examples.en: Water the house plants regularly, but avoid overwatering.
examples.zh: 定期给室内植物浇水，但注意不要浇过头。

examples.en: They decided to plant native shrubs along the garden fence.
examples.zh: 他们决定沿着花园篱笆种上一些本土灌木。

examples.en: The automaker announced plans to build a new assembly plant.
examples.zh: 该汽车制造商宣布了建设一座新组装厂的计划。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 未投入
lemmas.def_en: not planted

examples.en: Half of the farmland remained unplanted due to the severe spring drought.
examples.zh: 由于春季严重干旱，一半农田仍未播种。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 planta（脚底、插条），核心动作是用脚踩实固定入土，由此演变出动词“种植/设立”，名词“植物”，以及牢固建立在地面上的“工厂/成套设施”。
family_guide.core_distinction: plant 既是可数名词（植物；工厂），也是动词（种植）；planting 则主要强调“种植动作/播种过程”或园艺中“成批栽植的景观组合”。

lemmas.def_zh: 黄金, 钱财, 金块, 金色, 宝贵
lemmas.def_en: coins made of gold

examples.en: The athlete was awarded a pure gold medal for her record-breaking performance.
examples.zh: 这位运动员因创纪录的出色表现被授予一枚纯金奖牌。

lemmas.def_zh: 金的, 似金的, 金色的, 金制的
lemmas.def_en: made from or covered with gold

examples.en: The athlete was awarded a pure gold medal for her record-breaking performance.
examples.zh: 这位运动员因创纪录的出色表现被授予一枚纯金奖牌。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语词根 *ghel-（发光、发黄），本义指具有闪烁光泽的黄色贵金属，后引申出金牌、财富及高贵美好的象征义。
family_guide.core_distinction: gold 作为形容词通常指“纯金制成的”或具体颜色（如 gold watch），而派生词 golden 多用于比喻意义（如 golden age 黄金时代、golden opportunity 绝佳机会）。

lemmas.def_zh: 选择, 精选品, 选择权
lemmas.def_en: the person or thing chosen or selected

examples.en: Customers have a wide choice of fresh fruits at the weekend market.
examples.zh: 顾客在周末集市上有丰富的优质水果可供选择。

lemmas.def_zh: 精选的, 挑三拣四的, 上等的
lemmas.def_en: of superior grade

examples.en: The chef selected only choice cuts of beef for the banquet.
examples.zh: 厨师只为宴会挑选了上等的牛肉。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古法语 choisir（挑选），与动词 choose 同源，核心逻辑是由“挑选、取舍”延伸至名词“选择”以及形容词“精挑细选的、优质的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词 choice 表示选择的行为、权利或对象；形容词 choice 则专指经精心挑选出的“上等的、优质的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 准备；预备；调制；使做好心理准备
lemmas.def_en: to make ready or get set in advance for a future event or purpose

examples.en: She spent weeks preparing for the medical school entrance exam.
examples.zh: 她花了数周时间准备医学院的入学考试。

examples.en: The chef prepared a special dish to welcome the guests.
examples.zh: 主厨特意准备了一道特色菜来招待客人。

lemmas.def_zh: 准备（过程）；筹备工作；制剂
lemmas.def_en: the process of making ready, or the arrangements made for an event

examples.en: Preparations for the international conference are already well underway.
examples.zh: 国际会议的各项筹备工作已在紧锣密鼓地进行中。

examples.en: Careful preparation is essential to delivering a successful presentation.
examples.zh: 充分的准备是完成一次成功演讲的关键。

lemmas.def_zh: 准备状态, 战备状态
lemmas.def_en: the state of having been made ready or prepared for use or action (especially military action)

examples.en: The country improved its disaster preparedness after the severe earthquake.
examples.zh: 严重地震发生后，该国提高了其备灾水平。

lemmas.def_zh: 预备性的, 准备性的
lemmas.def_en: preceding and preparing for something

examples.en: The athletes completed several preparatory drills before entering the championship match.
examples.zh: 运动员们在进入冠军争夺战前完成了几项准备性训练。

lemmas.def_zh: 无准备的, 即席的, 不期而遇的
lemmas.def_en: without preparation; not prepared for; ; ; - R.E.Danielson

examples.en: She felt completely unprepared for the difficult questions during the interview.
examples.zh: 面对面试中的难题，她感到毫无准备。

lemmas.def_zh: 准备性的, 预备性的
lemmas.def_en: preceding and preparing for something

examples.en: They completed the preparative steps before launching the new research project.
examples.zh: 在启动新研究项目之前，他们完成了准备工作。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自前缀 pre-（提前）与拉丁语 parare（装备、安排），核心逻辑即“为了应对将来的事情提前做好安排或装备”。
family_guide.core_distinction: prepare 表示准备的动作；preparation 既可表示准备的过程（不可数），也常用于复数指具体的筹备工作与措施（可数）。

lemmas.def_zh: 列队行进, 用锉刀做；归档, 申请, 锉, 琢磨
lemmas.def_en: record in a public office or in a court of law

examples.en: Please file these important contracts in the cabinet by the end of the day.
examples.zh: 请在今天结束前把这些重要合同归档到柜子里。

lemmas.def_en: make full, also in a metaphorical sense
lemmas.def_zh: 装满, 填充, 弥漫, 供给, 满足, 供应；充满, 变得沉重；填充；填充

examples.en: Please fill the glass with cold water before you sit down.
examples.zh: 坐下前请把玻璃杯倒满凉水。

lemmas.def_zh: 档案, 公文箱, 文件夹, 文件, 卷宗, 锉刀
lemmas.def_en: a set of related records (either written or electronic) kept together

examples.en: Please file these important contracts in the cabinet by the end of the day.
examples.zh: 请在今天结束前把这些重要合同归档到柜子里。

lemmas.def_en: a quantity sufficient to satisfy
lemmas.def_zh: 满足, 装满, 充分, 填方

examples.en: Please fill the glass with cold water before you sit down.
examples.zh: 坐下前请把玻璃杯倒满凉水。

lemmas.def_zh: 锉, 琢磨, 锉屑
lemmas.def_en: the entering of a legal document into the public record

examples.en: Iron filings were scattered across the paper during the magnetic field experiment.
examples.zh: 在磁场实验中，铁屑散落在纸上。

lemmas.def_zh: 装填者, 补白, 装填物
lemmas.def_en: used for filling cracks or holes in a surface

examples.en: The short article served as a filler on the newspaper's back page.
examples.zh: 这篇短文被用作报纸封底的补白。

lemmas.def_zh: 文件编档员, 文件装钉员, 锉磨工人
lemmas.def_en: a party who files a notice with a law court

examples.en: The office filer organized thousands of medical records alphabetically this morning.
examples.zh: 办公室档案员今天上午按字母顺序整理了数千份医疗记录。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 filum（线），古人将公文串在线绳上保存与查阅，后引申为将文件按序存放、正式提交申请或诉讼，以及像绳线一样排成单列行进。
family_guide.core_distinction: file 指单个具体的文件、档案或归档动作；filing 则侧重指归档/提交的行为过程，或向官方提交的成套申报与备案材料。

lemmas.def_zh: 收拾行李；打包；塞满，挤满
lemmas.def_en: to put items into containers or bags for travel/storage; to fill a space tightly

examples.en: I haven't even started to pack for my trip tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 我明天早上的旅行甚至都还没开始收拾行李。

examples.en: Thousands of excited fans packed into the stadium to watch the concert.
examples.zh: 成千上万兴奋的歌迷挤满了体育场观看演唱会。

lemmas.def_zh: 包装, 打包
lemmas.def_en: put into a box

examples.en: A heavy package was delivered to our doorstep early this morning.
examples.zh: 今天一大早，一个沉重的包裹被送到了我们家门口。

lemmas.def_zh: 从包裹中取出, 卸下, 打开；打开包裹
lemmas.def_en: remove from its packing

examples.en: We were exhausted and decided to unpack our luggage the next morning.
examples.zh: 我们精疲力竭，决定第二天早上再打开行李。

lemmas.def_zh: 包裹, 套装软件, 包, 包装用物, 程序包
lemmas.def_en: a collection of things wrapped or boxed together

examples.en: A heavy package was delivered to our doorstep early this morning.
examples.zh: 今天一大早，一个沉重的包裹被送到了我们家门口。

lemmas.def_zh: 包装工人, 罐头食品工人, 打包机, 搬家工人, 批发商, 罐头食品厂经理
lemmas.def_en: a workman employed to pack things into containers

examples.en: He worked as a fruit packer in the warehouse during his summer break.
examples.zh: 暑假期间，他在仓库里当水果包装工。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 未包装的, 非封装的, 非封锁的
lemmas.def_en: not packaged or put into packets

examples.en: Buying unpackaged produce helps reduce the unnecessary use of single-use plastic.
examples.zh: 购买未包装的农产品有助于减少一次性塑料的使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 核心意象为“将物品捆扎、装入或塞紧”，由此延伸出收拾行李、打包货物，以及进一步派生出的商业包装与成套方案。
family_guide.core_distinction: pack 侧重“收拾、装入或塞满”的基本动作；package 作动词侧重商品的“特制外包装”或抽象概念的“整体包装与策划”，作名词指“包裹”或“一揽子方案”。

lemmas.def_zh: 合伙人, 股东, 伙伴, 伴侣
lemmas.def_en: a person's partner in marriage

examples.en: The university decided to partner with local businesses to fund the research.
examples.zh: 该大学决定与当地企业合作来资助这项研究。

lemmas.def_zh: 合伙, 合股, 合作关系
lemmas.def_en: the members of a business venture created by contract

examples.en: The two companies formed a strategic partnership to expand their global market.
examples.zh: 两家公司建立了战略合作关系以拓展全球市场。

lemmas.def_zh: 与...合伙, 组成一对；做伙伴, 当助手
lemmas.def_en: provide with a partner

examples.en: The university decided to partner with local businesses to fund the research.
examples.zh: 该大学决定与当地企业合作来资助这项研究。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 pars（部分），核心逻辑是“分担份额、共享一部分的人”，由此引申为共同行动的伙伴、配偶及合作行为。
family_guide.core_distinction: partner 指具体的“合作者/搭档/伴侣”或动词“合作”；partnership 则指抽象的“合作关系”或具体的“合伙企业/组织”。

lemmas.def_zh: 医学的, 内科的, 药的
lemmas.def_en: relating to the study or practice of medicine

examples.en: He must pass a routine medical before starting his new flight job.
examples.zh: 在开始新的飞行工作之前，他必须通过常规体检。

lemmas.def_zh: 药用的；有疗效的
lemmas.def_en: having the properties of medicine; helpful in curing illness or relieving pain

examples.en: This plant has been used for medicinal purposes for centuries.
examples.zh: 几个世纪以来，这种植物一直被用于药用目的。

examples.en: The hot springs are believed to have strong medicinal properties.
examples.zh: 人们认为这些温泉具有显著的疗效。

lemmas.def_zh: 医学, 医疗, 医术, 内科, 医药
lemmas.def_en: involving medical practice

examples.en: The injured player was declared medically fit to rejoin the soccer team.
examples.zh: 受伤的队员被医生认定在医学上适合重返足球队。

lemmas.def_zh: 用药物, 当做药
lemmas.def_en: in a medicinal manner

examples.en: This rare mountain herb has been used medicinally by local tribes for centuries.
examples.zh: 几个世纪以来，当地部落一直将这种罕见的高山草药入药。

lemmas.def_zh: 医生, 体格检查
lemmas.def_en: a thorough physical examination; includes a variety of tests depending on the age and sex and health of the person

examples.en: He must pass a routine medical before starting his new flight job.
examples.zh: 在开始新的飞行工作之前，他必须通过常规体检。

lemmas.def_zh: 药, 医学, 内科
lemmas.def_en: the branches of medical science that deal with nonsurgical techniques

examples.en: Take this prescribed medicine twice a day after meals to relieve your pain.
examples.zh: 饭后每天服用两次这种处方药以减轻疼痛。

lemmas.def_en: (medicine) something that treats or prevents or alleviates the symptoms of disease
lemmas.def_zh: 药物治疗, 药物处理, 医药

examples.en: The doctor advised him to take his medication with a full meal.
examples.zh: 医生建议他随正餐一起服用药物。

lemmas.def_zh: 给...用药
lemmas.def_en: treat medicinally, treat with medicine

examples.en: Take this prescribed medicine twice a day after meals to relieve your pain.
examples.zh: 饭后每天服用两次这种处方药以减轻疼痛。

lemmas.def_zh: 用药治疗
lemmas.def_en: impregnate with a medicinal substance

examples.en: Doctors decided not to medicate the mild symptoms and advised rest instead.
examples.zh: 医生决定不对这些轻微症状进行药物治疗，而是建议卧床休息。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 medicus（医生）及动词 mederi（医治、照护），核心语义始终围绕“疾病的诊疗、医药及健康评估”展开。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词指“医疗的、医学的”；名词为日常及行业特指用法，专指入职、参军或投保等所需的“全面体格检查”。

lemmas.def_zh: 行为准则，规范；代号，密码；程序代码
lemmas.def_en: a system of rules, principles, secret symbols, or computer instructions

examples.en: All employees are required to adhere strictly to the corporate code of conduct.
examples.zh: 所有员工都必须严格遵守公司的行为准则。

examples.en: She spent hours debugging the code to ensure the software runs smoothly.
examples.zh: 她花了数小时调试代码以确保软件顺利运行。

lemmas.def_zh: 编码器
lemmas.def_en: a person who designs and writes and tests computer programs

examples.en: The junior coder fixed several critical bugs in the application overnight.
examples.zh: 初级程序员连夜修复了应用程序中的几个关键漏洞。

lemmas.def_zh: 法典编纂
lemmas.def_en: the act of codifying; arranging in a systematic order

examples.en: The formal codification of maritime laws made global shipping practices much safer worldwide.
examples.zh: 海商法的正式法典化使全球航运业务变得安全得多。

lemmas.def_zh: （英式口语）戏弄，开玩笑；哄骗
lemmas.def_en: to play a joke on, tease, or kid someone

examples.en: Don't get upset—he was only codding you.
examples.zh: 别生气——他只是在跟你开玩笑。

lemmas.def_zh: 编成法典
lemmas.def_en: organize into a code or system, such as a body of law

examples.en: The committee worked for months to codify the traditional rules into law.
examples.zh: 委员会花费了数月时间将这些传统规则编成法典。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 codex（原指涂蜡写字板、树干，引申为手抄书法典），核心意象为“系统记录的条文或代表意义的符号”，现代扩展指行为准则、密码及计算机代码。
family_guide.core_distinction: cod（英式口语，意为戏弄、开玩笑）与 code 词源不同，属于形近异源词，需注意含义区分。

lemmas.def_zh: 声音, 嗓音, 嗓子, 愿望, 发言权, 表达, 喉舌, 语态
lemmas.def_en: the distinctive quality or pitch or condition of a person's speech

examples.en: Employees were encouraged to voice their concerns during the town hall meeting.
examples.zh: 员工们被鼓励在全体大会上表达自己的关切。

lemmas.def_zh: 无声
lemmas.def_en: a disorder of the vocal organs that results in the loss of voice

examples.en: The documentary highlights the political voicelessness of marginalized rural communities.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片突显了边缘化农村社区在政治上缺乏发言权的现状。

lemmas.def_zh: 表达, 吐露, 调音
lemmas.def_en: give voice to

examples.en: Employees were encouraged to voice their concerns during the town hall meeting.
examples.zh: 员工们被鼓励在全体大会上表达自己的关切。

lemmas.def_zh: 无声的
lemmas.def_en: produced without vibration of the vocal cords

examples.en: The charity gives a voice to the poor and voiceless citizens of the city.
examples.zh: 该慈善机构为该市贫困且无发言权的市民发声。

lemmas.def_zh: 未说出的
lemmas.def_en: produced without vibration of the vocal cords

examples.en: A wave of unvoiced resentment rippled through the crowded meeting room.
examples.zh: 拥挤的会议室里弥漫着一股未言明的怨恨情绪。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 vox（声音、言语），核心逻辑从生理层面的“嗓音、发声”延伸至隐喻层面的“表达观点、发言权与心声”。

lemmas.def_zh: 尝试, 企图
lemmas.def_en: make an effort or attempt

examples.en: He made a brave attempt to climb the steep hill in the rain.
examples.zh: 他冒雨做了一次勇敢的尝试，去攀登那座陡峭的山丘。

lemmas.def_zh: 尝试, 企图
lemmas.def_en: earnest and conscientious activity intended to do or accomplish something

examples.en: He made a brave attempt to climb the steep hill in the rain.
examples.zh: 他冒雨做了一次勇敢的尝试，去攀登那座陡峭的山丘。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. （尤指犯罪）未遂的
lemmas.def_en: having been tried without success, especially referring to a crime
lemmas.usage_note: 常与犯罪行为连用，如 attempted murder（谋杀未遂）、attempted robbery（抢劫未遂）。

examples.en: He was arrested and charged with attempted robbery.
examples.zh: 他被捕并被指控抢劫未遂。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ad-（朝向）+ temptare（试探、触摸），核心逻辑是‘主动伸手去试探与检验’，演变为克服困难去‘尝试、企图’做某事。

lemmas.def_zh: 主要的, 首位的
lemmas.def_en: most important element

examples.en: The police chief announced new safety measures during the morning press conference.
examples.zh: 警察局长在上午的新闻发布会上宣布了新的安全措施。

lemmas.def_zh: 淘气的, 有害的, 恶作剧的, 胡搅的
lemmas.def_en: naughtily or annoyingly playful

examples.en: The mischievous puppy ran off with one of my favorite leather shoes.
examples.zh: 那只淘气的小狗叼着我最喜欢的一只皮鞋跑了。

lemmas.def_zh: 领袖, 酋长, 长官, 主要部分
lemmas.def_en: a person who is in charge

examples.en: The police chief announced new safety measures during the morning press conference.
examples.zh: 警察局长在上午的新闻发布会上宣布了新的安全措施。

lemmas.def_zh: 损害, 伤害, 灾祸, 恶作剧, 淘气
lemmas.def_en: reckless or malicious behavior that causes discomfort or annoyance in others

examples.en: Those energetic boys are always getting into mischief after school lets out.
examples.zh: 那些精力充沛的男孩子们放学后总是到处恶作剧。

lemmas.def_zh: 恶作剧
lemmas.def_en: an attribute of mischievous children

examples.en: A spark of pure mischievousness shone brightly in the little girl's eyes.
examples.zh: 小女孩的眼中闪烁着单纯淘气的光芒。

lemmas.def_zh: 主要地
lemmas.def_en: for the most part

examples.en: His success was chiefly due to relentless hard work and patient dedication.
examples.zh: 他的成功主要是由于坚持不懈的努力和耐心的付出。

lemmas.def_zh: 有害地; 淘气地
lemmas.def_en: in a disobedient or naughty way

examples.en: She smiled mischievously before hiding the birthday present behind her back.
examples.zh: 她恶作剧般地笑了一下，然后把生日礼物藏到了身后。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 caput（头），由“头部”引申出“首脑、领袖”以及“最重要的、首要的”等核心概念。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词侧重“首要的”或“首席的”，名词则指代具体的“首领、主管”或“酋长”。

lemmas.def_zh: 失败；未能（做到）；不及格；失灵，衰退
lemmas.def_en: to be unsuccessful in achieving a goal; to not do something expected; to stop functioning properly

examples.en: Many startups fail within their first three years due to cash flow problems.
examples.zh: 许多初创公司因为现金流问题在成立前三年内便告失败。

examples.en: The government failed to warn citizens about the impending financial crisis.
examples.zh: 政府未能就即将到来的金融危机向民众发出预警。

lemmas.def_zh: 失败；未成功；故障，失灵；未能（做到）
lemmas.def_en: lack of success in doing or achieving something; the condition or fact of not functioning; an omission of expected action

examples.en: The initiative ended in complete failure due to poor planning.
examples.zh: 由于规划不周，这项倡议以彻底失败告终。

examples.en: The pilot made an emergency landing following an unexpected engine failure.
examples.zh: 在发动机意外发生故障后，飞行员进行了紧急迫降。

lemmas.def_zh: 缺点，弱点，缺陷
lemmas.def_en: a weakness, fault, or deficiency in someone's character or in a system

examples.en: Impatience was his greatest failing, though he was otherwise a brilliant manager.
examples.zh: 缺乏耐心是他最大的弱点，不过在其他方面他都是一位出色的管理者。

examples.en: The report exposed serious failings in the hospital's emergency response procedures.
examples.zh: 该报告揭露了该医院在应急响应流程上的严重缺陷。

lemmas.def_zh: 可靠的；经久不衰的；无穷尽的
lemmas.def_en: not liable to failure

examples.en: We are deeply grateful for her unfailing support during this challenging period.
examples.zh: 我们对她在这个艰难时期给予的始终如一的支持深表感激。

lemmas.def_zh: 无穷尽地, 经久不衰地; 可靠地
lemmas.def_en: without fail

examples.en: He was unfailingly polite to every single customer who entered the busy store.
examples.zh: 他对进入这家繁忙商店的每一位顾客都始终彬彬有礼。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 fallere（欺骗、落空、犯错），核心概念由“期待落空”引申为“未能达成预期、能力不足或失去功能”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词 fail 表“失败”或“未能做到”；名词 failing 通常特指人性或系统中的“缺点、弱点”，不同于泛指失败事实或状态的 failure。

lemmas.def_zh: 负有责任的；引起……的；有责任心的，可靠的
lemmas.def_en: having an obligation to do something; being the primary cause of an event; sensible and able to be trusted

examples.en: She is directly responsible for overseeing the company's daily operations.
examples.zh: 她直接负责监管公司的日常运营。

examples.en: We need to find a mature and responsible person to look after the children.
examples.zh: 我们需要找一个成熟且有责任心的人来照看孩子。

lemmas.def_zh: 责任，职责；义务；承担责任
lemmas.def_en: a duty or obligation to deal with something; the state of being accountable

examples.en: The manager refused to take responsibility for the team's failure.
examples.zh: 经理拒绝为团队的失败承担责任。

examples.en: Caring for elderly parents is considered a moral responsibility.
examples.zh: 照顾年迈的父母被视为一种道德义务。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 respondere（回应、承诺），核心逻辑为“对自己的行为或承诺做出回应”，引申为承担后果、履行职责及可靠性。
family_guide.core_distinction: responsible 为形容词，侧重“负有责任的”状态或人“有责任心”的特质；responsibility 为名词，既指抽象的“问责/责任心”，也指具体的“职责/任务”。

lemmas.def_zh: 争吵，争辩；论证，主张
lemmas.def_en: exchange divergent or opposite views, typically heatedly; give reasons in support of an idea or theory

examples.en: They often argue about small household chores.
examples.zh: 他们经常为琐碎的家务事争吵。

examples.en: The defense attorney argued that there was no conclusive evidence.
examples.zh: 辩护律师主张目前缺乏决定性的证据。

lemmas.def_zh: 争吵，争论；论点，论据
lemmas.def_en: a heated exchange of opposite views; a reason or set of reasons given to persuade others

examples.en: They had a fierce argument over how to divide the profits.
examples.zh: 他们就如何分配利润发生了一场激烈的争吵。

examples.en: She presented a compelling argument in favor of renewable energy.
examples.zh: 她提出了一个支持可再生能源的有力论据。

lemmas.def_zh: 争论, 辩论, 论证, 论据
lemmas.def_en: a discussion in which reasons are advanced for and against some proposition or proposal

examples.en: Her clear argumentation convinced the judges to rule entirely in her client's favor.
examples.zh: 她清晰有力的论证说服了法官，作出了完全有利于其委托人的裁决。

lemmas.def_zh: 争辩者, 辩论者
lemmas.def_en: someone who engages in debate

examples.en: As a skilled arguer, she easily dismantled her opponent's weak points.
examples.zh: 作为一名老练的辩论者，她轻松击破了对手的弱点。

lemmas.def_zh: 好辩的, 引起争论的, 论证式的
lemmas.def_en: given to or characterized by argument

examples.en: Lack of adequate sleep made the tired clerk unusually argumentative with every customer.
examples.zh: 睡眠不足使得这位疲惫的店员对每位顾客都显得格外好辩。

lemmas.def_zh: 可辩论的, 可论证的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being supported by argument

examples.en: It is arguable whether the new tax policy will actually benefit small businesses.
examples.zh: 这项新税收政策是否真能惠及小企业，尚存争议。

lemmas.def_zh: 无可争辩的
lemmas.def_en: against which no argument can be made

examples.en: The positive economic impact of the project is an unarguable fact.
examples.zh: 该项目对经济的积极影响是一个无可争辩的事实。

lemmas.def_zh: 激辩地
lemmas.def_en: in a disputatious manner

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 arguere（澄清、证明、阐明），后引申为通过摆事实讲道理来“论证”，以及意见不合时的“争辩”。
family_guide.core_distinction: argue 是动词动作（争辩、论证）；argument 是其名词形式，既可指感性的“争吵”，也可指理性的“论点、论据”。

lemmas.def_zh: 干净的, 清白的, 简洁的
lemmas.def_en: free from dirt or impurities; or having clean habits

examples.en: Please make sure your bedroom is completely clean before dinner starts.
examples.zh: 晚餐开始前，请务必把你的卧室彻底打扫干净。

lemmas.def_zh: 不洁净的, 不纯洁的, 行为不检的
lemmas.def_en: soiled or likely to soil with dirt or grime

examples.en: The water from the stagnant pond was deemed unclean and unsafe to drink.
examples.zh: 死水塘里的水被认为不干净，饮用不安全。

lemmas.def_zh: 爱清洁的, 干净的, 清洁的
lemmas.def_en: habitually clean

examples.en: Cats are cleanly animals that spend hours grooming themselves every day.
examples.zh: 猫是爱清洁的动物，每天花几个小时梳理自己。

lemmas.def_zh: 清理, 使干净, 出空；被搞干净
lemmas.def_en: make clean by removing dirt, filth, or unwanted substances from

examples.en: Please make sure your bedroom is completely clean before dinner starts.
examples.zh: 晚餐开始前，请务必把你的卧室彻底打扫干净。

lemmas.def_zh: 打扫，清扫，保洁（行为或过程）
lemmas.def_en: the activity or process of removing dirt and making things tidy

examples.en: The carpets are in desperate need of a deep cleaning.
examples.zh: 这些地毯急需进行一次彻底的深度清洗。

lemmas.def_zh: 清洁工，保洁员；清洁剂，吸尘器等清洁工具
lemmas.def_en: a person employed to clean, or a substance/device used for cleaning

examples.en: Spray the countertop with a kitchen cleaner and wipe it down.
examples.zh: 往操作台上喷上厨房清洁剂，然后擦拭干净。

examples.en: The office cleaners arrive every evening after everyone has left.
examples.zh: 办公室保洁员每天傍晚等所有人都离开后过来打扫。

lemmas.def_zh: 清洁, 干净
lemmas.def_en: the habit of keeping free of superficial imperfections

examples.en: The restaurant maintains high standards of cleanliness in its modern kitchen.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅在现代化的厨房里保持着高标准的清洁。

lemmas.def_zh: 不纯洁；不干净
lemmas.def_en: the state of being unsanitary

examples.en: The ancient religious ritual aimed to purge the community of moral uncleanness.
examples.zh: 这种古老的宗教仪式旨在清除社区道德上的不洁。

lemmas.def_zh: 清洁, 干净
lemmas.def_en: the state of being clean; without dirt or other impurities

examples.en: The impressive cleanness of the hotel room immediately put the guests at ease.
examples.zh: 酒店房间令人印象深刻的整洁度立刻让客人们感到舒心。

lemmas.def_zh: [医]不清洁
lemmas.def_en: lack of cleanly habits

examples.en: Chronic uncleanliness in public areas can quickly lead to severe health hazards.
examples.zh: 公共区域长期不洁会迅速引发严重的健康隐患。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 clǣne（纯洁、无杂质的），核心概念是“排除污垢、杂质或多余阻碍的状态”，后自然引申为使其洁净的动作及相关的行为、工具与人员。
family_guide.core_distinction: cleaning 指清洁的“行为或过程”；cleaner 则指执行清洁的“人员”或用于清洁的“工具/清洗剂”。

lemmas.def_zh: 骑（马、自行车等）；乘，坐（车等）；依赖于
lemmas.def_en: to sit on and control a horse, bicycle, etc., or travel in a vehicle

examples.en: She learned to ride a bicycle when she was five years old.
examples.zh: 她五岁时就学会了骑自行车。

lemmas.def_zh: 使摆脱；免除；清除
lemmas.def_en: to free someone or something from an undesirable person or thing

examples.en: We need to rid the garden of these persistent weeds.
examples.zh: 我们需要把花园里的这些顽固杂草清除干净。

lemmas.def_zh: 骑；乘（ride 的过去式）
lemmas.def_en: past tense of ride

examples.en: They rode through the mountains for two days to reach the village.
examples.zh: 他们骑行穿行山区两天，才到达那个村庄。

lemmas.def_zh: 骑；乘（ride 的过去分词）；充斥…的，饱受…困扰的（常构成复合词）
lemmas.def_en: past participle of ride; full of or dominated by something unpleasant

examples.en: He has ridden motorcycles across more than twenty countries.
examples.zh: 他曾骑摩托车穿越了二十多个国家。

lemmas.def_zh: 骑（马、自行车等）；乘，坐（车等）；依赖于
lemmas.def_en: to sit on and control a horse, bicycle, etc., or travel in a vehicle

examples.en: She learned to ride a bicycle when she was five years old.
examples.zh: 她五岁时就学会了骑自行车。

lemmas.def_zh: 骑马（运动）；乘车；（英国历史上的）行政区
lemmas.def_en: the sport or activity of riding horses; travelling on or in something

examples.en: Horse riding has been her passion since childhood.
examples.zh: 骑马从童年起就一直是她的热爱所在。

lemmas.def_zh: 骑手，骑马（或车）的人；（合同或法案的）附加条款
lemmas.def_en: a person who rides a horse, bicycle, or motorcycle; an additional clause attached to a document

examples.en: All bicycle riders are strongly advised to wear helmets.
examples.zh: 强烈建议所有自行车骑手佩戴头盔。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 rīdan（骑行、向前行进），核心概念为“借助坐骑或交通载具移动”，由此衍生出骑乘动作、乘坐体验、动词形态变化及施事者名物化。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意 rode 为一般过去式，ridden 为过去分词；rid 拼写相近但实为不同来源动词（表示摆脱），切勿混淆。

lemmas.def_zh: 拉, 拖, 拔, 牵, 撕开, 吸引；拉, 拖, 拔, 有吸引力
lemmas.def_en: cause to move by pulling

examples.en: Help me pull this heavy wooden table across the living room floor.
examples.zh: 帮我把这张沉重的木桌拉过客厅地板。

lemmas.def_zh: 拉, 拖, 拔, 拉力, 牵引力, 划船, 吸引
lemmas.def_en: the act of pulling; applying force to move something toward or with you

examples.en: He gave the heavy wooden door a firm pull, but it remained firmly shut.
examples.zh: 他用力拉了拉厚重的木门，但门依然紧闭。

lemmas.def_zh: 拉的人, 拔具, 拉出器
lemmas.def_en: someone who applies force so as to cause motion toward herself or himself

examples.en: You will need a specialized nail puller to remove those rusty old floorboards.
examples.zh: 你需要一把专用的拔钉器来拆除那些生锈的旧地板。

family_guide.root_logic: 核心语义为“施加力量将某物移向自身或沿受力方向移动”，进而引申为牵引力、吸引力以及抽象的影响力。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词表示拉扯、拔出或移动的具体动作；名词既指单次拉动或牵引力，也常用于比喻引力、诱惑或人际影响力。

lemmas.def_zh: 申请；应用，适用；涂抹；专心致志（与oneself连用）
lemmas.def_en: to make a formal request; to put into practical operation; to spread onto a surface; to work hard at a task

examples.en: She decided to apply for a scholarship to fund her graduate studies.
examples.zh: 她决定申请奖学金以资助她的研究生学业。

examples.en: These safety guidelines apply to all workers on the construction site.
examples.zh: 这些安全指南适用于建筑工地上的所有工人。

lemmas.def_zh: 误用, 滥用
lemmas.def_en: apply to a wrong thing or person; apply badly or incorrectly

examples.en: It is dangerous to misapply statistical methods to support an already biased conclusion.
examples.zh: 滥用统计方法来支持已有偏见的结论是很危险的。

lemmas.def_zh: 申请，申请表；实际应用，运用；应用程序（App）；涂抹，敷用
lemmas.def_en: a formal request to an authority; the practical use of an idea or method; a computer software program; the act of putting something on a surface

examples.en: You need to submit your job application before the end of the month.
examples.zh: 你需要在月底之前提交求职申请。

examples.en: The new research has practical applications in the treatment of diabetes.
examples.zh: 这项新研究在治疗糖尿病方面具有实际应用价值。

lemmas.def_en: a person who requests or seeks something such as assistance or employment or admission
lemmas.def_zh: n. 申请人，应征者

examples.en: Each job applicant must submit a résumé and a portfolio.
examples.zh: 每位求职申请人必须提交一份简历和作品集。

lemmas.def_en: relevance by virtue of being applicable to the matter at hand
lemmas.def_zh: 适用性, 应用性

examples.en: Experts questioned the real-world applicability of the theory under extreme economic conditions.
examples.zh: 专家们质疑该理论在极端经济条件下的实际适用性。

lemmas.def_zh: 误用, 滥用
lemmas.def_en: wrong use or application

examples.en: The audit revealed an accidental misapplication of research funds last fiscal year.
examples.zh: 审计显示，上一财政年度出现了一笔科研经费的不当使用。

lemmas.def_zh: 灌肠器, 填充器
lemmas.def_en: a person who requests or seeks something such as assistance or employment or admission

examples.en: The kit comes with a precision applier to spread the glue completely evenly.
examples.zh: 该工具包配有一个精密涂抹器，以便将胶水涂得非常均匀。

lemmas.def_en: capable of being applied; having relevance
lemmas.def_zh: 合适的, 可应用的

examples.en: Please indicate whether the special discount is applicable to international online orders.
examples.zh: 请说明该特别折扣是否适用于国际在线订单。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 应用的, 适用的
lemmas.def_en: readily applicable or practical

examples.en: Haskell is a well-known programming language that supports applicative functors.
examples.zh: Haskell 是一种支持应用函子的著名编程语言。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ad-（向）+ plicare（折叠/贴近），核心意象是“使贴附、相连”，演化出“涂敷于表面”、“应用/适用（将规则对号入座）”以及“申请、潜心于（使自身挂钩于某目标）”。
family_guide.core_distinction: applicant 常指提出申请的人，application 指申请本身或应用软件，而 applicable 表示某规章或理论“适用的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 建立，制定；着手实行；提起（诉讼）
lemmas.def_en: to introduce, establish, or initiate a system, rule, or legal process

examples.en: The government plans to institute a series of economic reforms next year.
examples.zh: 政府计划在明年推行一系列经济改革。

examples.en: The company has instituted legal proceedings against its former partner.
examples.zh: 该公司已对其前合伙人提起法律诉讼。

lemmas.def_zh: 使制度化, 使成为惯常的行为, 使一成不变, 把...送进疯人院
lemmas.def_en: cause to be admitted; of persons to an institution

examples.en: The company seeks to institutionalize these ethical practices across all regional branches.
examples.zh: 该公司试图在所有区域分部将这些道德规范制度化。

lemmas.def_zh: 机构，团体；制度，习俗
lemmas.def_en: a large organization founded for a specific purpose, or an established custom or system

examples.en: Universities, hospitals, and charities are all essential public institutions.
examples.zh: 大学、医院和慈善机构都是必不可少的公共机构。

examples.en: Marriage is often seen as a fundamental social institution.
examples.zh: 婚姻常被视为一项基本的社会制度。

lemmas.def_zh: 机构的，组织的；制度上的
lemmas.def_en: relating to an established organization, system, or society-wide practice

examples.en: The policy change is designed to attract more institutional investors to the market.
examples.zh: 这项政策变革旨在吸引更多机构投资者进入市场。

examples.en: The committee identified deep-seated institutional problems within the department.
examples.zh: 委员会指出了该部门内部根深蒂固的体制性问题。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 个人生活中非惯常
lemmas.def_en: not committed to an institution

lemmas.def_zh: institutional的变形
lemmas.def_en: by an institution

examples.en: The university is institutionally committed to promoting diversity across all its academic departments.
examples.zh: 该大学在制度上致力于促进所有学术部门的多样性。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 in-（向内、设立）+ statuere（立起、安置），核心逻辑为“建立、设立”，引申出建立组织（机构）、推行制度以及制度化等含义。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词 institute 强调“着手实行/设立机制”；名词 institution 既指具体的公共机构，也可指抽象的传统制度；institutional 则指属于机构或制度层面的特征。

lemmas.def_zh: 丧失，遗失；损失，亏损；去世，哀痛
lemmas.def_en: the fact or process of losing something or someone; an amount of money lost; death or bereavement

examples.en: The company reported a substantial financial loss in the third quarter.
examples.zh: 该公司报告第三季度出现了巨额财务亏损。

examples.en: She struggled to cope with the sudden loss of her mother.
examples.zh: 她难以承受母亲突然离世的巨大悲痛。

lemmas.def_zh: 无损的; 无损耗; 无耗
lemmas.def_en: characterized by or causing no dissipation of energy

examples.en: Audiophiles prefer lossless audio formats because they preserve the original recording quality perfectly.
examples.zh: 音响发烧友更喜欢无损音频格式，因为它们完美保留了原始录音质量。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 有损耗的, 有损失的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by or causing dissipation of energy

examples.en: Using a lossy compression format will reduce file size while slightly degrading image quality.
examples.zh: 使用有损压缩格式会减小文件大小，但会略微降低图像质量。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 los（丧失、毁灭），与动词 lose 同源，核心逻辑指因脱离、剥夺或减少而导致的“丧失、损失或亏损”的状态及结果。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意 loss 为名词（损失/丧失），易与动词 lose（丢失/输掉）及形容词 lost（迷失的/失去的）在词性上产生混淆。

lemmas.def_zh: 测量, 测度, 估量, 权衡, 调节, 拿(自己或自己的力量等)作较量；度量
lemmas.def_en: determine the measurements of something or somebody, take measurements of

examples.en: The tailor will carefully measure your shoulders before cutting the expensive imported fabric.
examples.zh: 在裁剪昂贵的进口布料之前，裁缝会仔细测量你的肩宽。

lemmas.def_zh: 尺寸, 量度器, 量度标准, 测量, 量具, 程度, 范围, 限度, 分寸, 措施, 方法
lemmas.def_en: any maneuver made as part of progress toward a goal

examples.en: The tailor will carefully measure your shoulders before cutting the expensive imported fabric.
examples.zh: 在裁剪昂贵的进口布料之前，裁缝会仔细测量你的肩宽。

lemmas.def_zh: 测量，度量；尺寸，大小
lemmas.def_en: the act or process of measuring; the size, length, or amount of something obtained by measuring

examples.en: The tailor took precise measurements before cutting the fabric for the suit.
examples.zh: 裁缝在裁剪西装面料前进行了精确的尺寸测量。

examples.en: Accurate measurement of time is essential for modern satellite navigation systems.
examples.zh: 时间的精准测量对现代卫星导航系统至关重要。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 测量仪表, 测量器
lemmas.def_en: a person who makes measurements

examples.en: The laser measurer provides highly accurate distance readings in just a few seconds.
examples.zh: 这款激光测量仪仅需几秒钟即可提供高度精确的距离读数。

lemmas.def_zh: 可测量性
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being measurable

examples.en: The project manager emphasized the measurability of goals to track overall team progress.
examples.zh: 项目经理强调了目标的可衡量性，以跟踪团队的整体进展。

lemmas.def_zh: 可测量的, 不久的, 重要的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being measured

examples.en: The new marketing campaign led to a measurable increase in website traffic immediately.
examples.zh: 新的营销活动立即带来了网站访问量可衡量的增长。

lemmas.def_zh: 不可测的, 无法测定的, 没有限度的
lemmas.def_en: impossible to measure

examples.en: The true environmental impact of the chemical spill remains largely unmeasured for now.
examples.zh: 目前，化学品泄漏对环境造成的真正影响在很大程度上仍无法估量。

lemmas.def_zh: 无法计量的, 不可测的, 无限的
lemmas.def_en: impossible to measure

examples.en: A mother's deep love for her newborn child is truly vast and unmeasurable.
examples.zh: 母亲对新生儿深沉的爱确实是广阔无垠、无法计量的。

lemmas.def_zh: 无限的, 不可量的
lemmas.def_en: without limits in extent or size or quantity

examples.en: They looked up in awe at the measureless expanse of the starry night sky.
examples.zh: 他们敬畏地抬头仰望繁星密布、浩瀚无垠的夜空。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语表示“度量、尺度”的词根，由物理上的“丈量大小”引申出抽象的“权衡评估”以及制度上的“规范/防范措施”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词 measure 常用作抽象的“措施、手段”或“衡量基准”；measurement 则专指具体的“测量动作”或测得的“尺寸、数据”。

lemmas.def_zh: 跳舞
lemmas.def_en: move in a graceful and rhythmical way

examples.en: Guests will dance together on the terrace until midnight under the bright moonlight.
examples.zh: 客人们将在明亮的月光下在露台上共舞直至午夜。

lemmas.def_zh: 跳舞, 舞蹈, 舞会
lemmas.def_en: an artistic form of nonverbal communication

examples.en: Guests will dance together on the terrace until midnight under the bright moonlight.
examples.zh: 客人们将在明亮的月光下在露台上共舞直至午夜。

lemmas.def_zh: 舞蹈演员, 跳舞者
lemmas.def_en: a performer who dances professionally

examples.en: The principal dancer executed a flawless leap across the stage during the final act.
examples.zh: 首席舞蹈演员在最后一幕中在舞台上完成了一次无可挑剔的跳跃。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 dancier，核心概念为伴随节奏的身体律动，后自然引申为动作、舞蹈艺术、舞会及跳舞的人。

lemmas.def_zh: 特别喜爱的人（或事物）；（比赛中的）夺冠热门
lemmas.def_en: a person or thing that is best liked; a competitor thought most likely to win

examples.en: Out of all the dishes on the menu, the seafood pasta is my absolute favorite.
examples.zh: 在菜单上的所有菜品中，海鲜意面绝对是我的最爱。

examples.en: The reigning champion is the clear favorite to win the tournament this year.
examples.zh: 卫冕冠军显然是今年锦标赛的夺冠大热门。

lemmas.def_zh: 特别喜爱的人（或事物）；（比赛中的）夺冠热门（英式拼写）
lemmas.def_en: British English spelling of favorite; a person or thing that is preferred to all others

examples.en: That homemade chocolate cake has always been a firm favourite with the children.
examples.zh: 那款自制的巧克力蛋糕一直以来都深受孩子们的最爱。

examples.en: The horse started as the hot favourite, but failed to place in the final sprint.
examples.zh: 这匹马一开始是大热门，却在最后的冲刺阶段未能取得名次。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 favor（恩惠、支持），核心语义演变为“受到格外青睐、最受偏爱的人或事物”。
family_guide.core_distinction: favorite 为美式英语拼写，favourite 为英式及英联邦英语拼写，二者在词义与用法上完全一致。

lemmas.def_zh: 努力；尽力；费力的尝试；心血
lemmas.def_en: physical or mental energy needed to do something; a determined attempt

examples.en: Learning a foreign language takes a great deal of time and effort.
examples.zh: 学习一门外语需要付出大量的时间和心血。

examples.en: The team made every effort to meet the tight deadline.
examples.zh: 团队竭尽全力以赶在紧迫的截止日期前完成任务。

lemmas.def_zh: effortless的变形
lemmas.def_en: the quality of requiring little effort

examples.en: The pianist performed the complex sonata with an apparent effortlessness that amazed everyone.
examples.zh: 钢琴家以显而易见的从容自若演奏了复杂的奏鸣曲，令人惊叹。

lemmas.def_zh: 不作努力地, 不费力地
lemmas.def_en: without effort or apparent effort

examples.en: She effortlessly solved the complex mathematical puzzle that had baffled her entire class.
examples.zh: 她毫不费力地解开了难倒全班同学的复杂数学难题。

lemmas.def_zh: 容易的, 不费力气的
lemmas.def_en: requiring or apparently requiring no effort

examples.en: His charismatic speech seemed entirely effortless, though he had practiced it for weeks.
examples.zh: 他富有魅力的演讲看似毫不费力，尽管他已经练习了数周。

lemmas.def_zh: 显示努力的,充满努力的,需要努力的
lemmas.def_en: requiring great physical effort

examples.en: Learning to speak a completely foreign language is an effortful but highly rewarding journey.
examples.zh: 学习一门完全陌生的外语是一个需要付出努力但极有收获的过程。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语前缀 ex-（彻底、出）+ fortis（力量、坚强），字面意为“竭尽全力使出力量”，演变为指身体或精神上的“努力、付出心血”。

lemmas.def_zh: 东方，东部；东方的，向东的
lemmas.def_en: the direction towards the point of the horizon where the sun rises; lying towards or facing the east

examples.en: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.
examples.zh: 太阳从东方升起，在西方落下。

examples.en: They decided to take a road trip along the east coast.
examples.zh: 他们决定沿着东海岸进行一次自驾游。

lemmas.def_zh: 东方，东部；东方的，向东的
lemmas.def_en: the direction towards the point of the horizon where the sun rises; lying towards or facing the east

examples.en: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.
examples.zh: 太阳从东方升起，在西方落下。

examples.en: They decided to take a road trip along the east coast.
examples.zh: 他们决定沿着东海岸进行一次自驾游。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语 *aus-（照耀、黎明），与代表曙光的词源同源，以太阳初升的方向引申指代“东方”。
family_guide.core_distinction: east 可兼作名词和形容词：作名词指代东方方位或东部地理区域；作形容词修饰朝东的方位、地点或来自东方的风。

lemmas.def_zh: 宽阔的；广泛的；充分张开的；偏离目标的
lemmas.def_en: having a large distance between sides; comprehensive in scope; fully open

examples.en: The store offers a wide range of organic products to meet growing demand.
examples.zh: 这家商店提供种类繁多的有机产品，以满足日益增长的需求。

examples.en: Her eyes went wide with astonishment when she heard the news.
examples.zh: 听到这个消息时，她因震惊而瞪大了眼睛。

lemmas.def_zh: 广泛地；普遍地；大大地
lemmas.def_en: over a large area; by a great many people; to a great extent

examples.en: His theories are now widely accepted throughout the scientific community.
examples.zh: 他的理论现在在整个科学界得到了广泛认可。

examples.en: Prices can vary widely depending on the brand and quality.
examples.zh: 根据品牌和质量的不同，价格差异可能会非常大。

lemmas.def_zh: 广泛; 宽
lemmas.def_en: the property of being wide; having great width

examples.en: The sheer wideness of the canyon took our breath away as we approached it.
examples.zh: 当我们靠近峡谷时，其极为宽阔的景象让我们惊叹不已。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 wīd，核心意象为“两端距离大、展开度高”，由物理空间上的“宽阔”自然引申为范畴、程度或视角的“广泛与全面”。
family_guide.core_distinction: wide 作副词时偏向具体的物理张开或彻底程度（如 open wide, wide awake），而 widely 侧重大范围、普遍性或程度上的巨大差异（如 widely accepted, differ widely）。

lemmas.def_zh: (adv.) 独自地，单独地；单单，仅仅；(adj.) 单独的，独自一人的
lemmas.def_en: (adv.) without anyone else; only; (adj.) having no other people present

examples.en: She prefers to live alone and enjoys the quiet independence it brings.
examples.zh: 她喜欢独自生活，享受由此带来的安静与独立。

examples.en: After the guests left, he was finally alone in the apartment.
examples.zh: 客人离开后，公寓里终于只剩下他一个人。

examples.en: You cannot rely on talent alone; hard work is equally essential.
examples.zh: 你不能单靠天赋，努力同样不可或缺。

lemmas.def_zh: (adv.) 独自地，单独地；单单，仅仅；(adj.) 单独的，独自一人的
lemmas.def_en: (adv.) without anyone else; only; (adj.) having no other people present

examples.en: She prefers to live alone and enjoys the quiet independence it brings.
examples.zh: 她喜欢独自生活，享受由此带来的安静与独立。

examples.en: After the guests left, he was finally alone in the apartment.
examples.zh: 客人离开后，公寓里终于只剩下他一个人。

examples.en: You cannot rely on talent alone; hard work is equally essential.
examples.zh: 你不能单靠天赋，努力同样不可或缺。

lemmas.def_zh: 孤独感
lemmas.def_en: a disposition toward being alone

examples.en: He found a strange sense of peaceful aloneness while walking through the dense forest.
examples.zh: 在穿过茂密的森林漫步时，他体会到了一种奇特的静谧孤独感。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中古英语 all one（完全是一），核心逻辑表示“完全单一无伴”及由此引申的“仅仅、唯独”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 作形容词时只作表语，强调客观“单独无伴”（不同于情感上感到寂寞的 lonely）；作副词时表示“独自地”行动，或紧随名词/代词表示“单单、唯独”。

lemmas.def_zh: 绿色的, 未成熟的, 新鲜的, 青春的, 无经验的, 脸色发青的
lemmas.def_en: of the color between blue and yellow in the color spectrum; similar to the color of fresh grass

examples.en: The new recruit is still too green to handle such a high-stakes negotiation alone.
examples.zh: 这名新员工还太缺乏经验，无法独自处理如此高风险的谈判。

lemmas.def_zh: 绿色, 绿色颜料
lemmas.def_en: green color or pigment; resembling the color of growing grass

examples.en: The city launched a major project to green several old industrial zones.
examples.zh: 该市启动了一项重大项目，旨在使几个旧工业区绿化起来。

lemmas.def_zh: 绿叶, 绿树, 装饰用的绿树枝或叶
lemmas.def_en: green foliage

examples.en: Potted plants and fresh greenery transformed the dull office into a lively space.
examples.zh: 盆栽植物和清新的绿植将沉闷的办公室变成了充满生机的地方。

lemmas.def_zh: 绿色, 新鲜, 未熟
lemmas.def_en: the lush appearance of flourishing vegetation

examples.en: The sudden greenness of the valley after the rain surprised all the hikers.
examples.zh: 雨后山谷陡增的绿意让所有徒步旅行者感到惊喜。

lemmas.def_en: turn or become green

examples.en: The city launched a major project to green several old industrial zones.
examples.zh: 该市启动了一项重大项目，旨在使几个旧工业区绿化起来。

lemmas.def_zh: 绿色地, 未熟练
lemmas.def_en: with green color

examples.en: The newly hired apprentice handled the complex machinery greenly and with hesitation.
examples.zh: 新雇用的学徒生疏且犹豫地操作着复杂的机器。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语表示“生长”的词根（与 grow 同源），核心义指植物生长时展现的生机盎然的青翠色彩，后引申出未成熟、缺乏经验以及现代的环保与生态意识。
family_guide.core_distinction: green 兼作形、名、动词：形容词除表颜色外多引申为‘环保的’或‘无经验的’；名词常指草坪、高尔夫果岭或绿叶蔬菜（复数）；动词多指城市绿化或环保生态化改造。

lemmas.def_zh: 表达；表示；表露
lemmas.def_en: to communicate thoughts, feelings, or ideas through words, actions, or art

examples.en: She found it difficult to express her true feelings in front of others.
examples.zh: 她觉得很难在别人面前表达自己的真实感受。

examples.en: Words cannot express how grateful I am for your help.
examples.zh: 言语无法表达我对你帮助的感激之情。

lemmas.def_zh: 表达；表情，神色；词语，说法
lemmas.def_en: the act of making known feelings or thoughts; a look on a face; a word or phrase

examples.en: Freedom of expression is considered a fundamental human right.
examples.zh: 表达自由被视为一项基本人权。

examples.en: A puzzled expression appeared on his face when he heard the news.
examples.zh: 听到这个消息时，他脸上露出了困惑的表情。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 可表达性
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being expressive

examples.en: Critics praised the extraordinary expressiveness of the young violinist's solo performance.
examples.zh: 评论家盛赞了这位年轻小提琴手独奏中非凡的表现力。

lemmas.def_zh: 明白地, 清楚地, 特意地
lemmas.def_en: with specific intentions; for the express purpose

examples.en: The rules expressly forbid employees from sharing internal documents with the public.
examples.zh: 规定明确禁止员工向公众分享内部文件。

lemmas.def_zh: 表现地；意味深长地；表示地
lemmas.def_en: with expression; in an expressive manner

examples.en: The actor moved his hands expressively to convey the character's hidden sorrow.
examples.zh: 演员富有表现力地挥动手臂，以传达角色内心深处的悲伤。

lemmas.def_zh: 表达的, 富于表情的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by expression

examples.en: Her expressive dark eyes revealed everything she was trying hard to conceal.
examples.zh: 她那双富于表现力的黑眼睛暴露了她极力掩饰的一切。

lemmas.def_zh: 无表情的, 呆板的
lemmas.def_en: deliberately impassive in manner

examples.en: The guard remained completely expressionless while the tourists asked dozens of questions.
examples.zh: 面对游客提出的数十个问题，警卫始终面无表情。

lemmas.def_zh: 不明说的, 未表达的
lemmas.def_en: not made explicit

examples.en: Years of unexpressed resentment finally caused the close friendship to fall apart.
examples.zh: 多年未宣泄的怨恨最终导致了这段深厚友谊的破裂。

lemmas.def_zh: 可表现的, 可榨出的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being expressed

examples.en: Some profound human emotions are hardly expressible in simple everyday language.
examples.zh: 人类的某些深沉情感很难用简单的日常语言来表达。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ex- (向外) + premere (挤压)，原意为“向外挤出”，引申为将内心的思想、情绪“推至外在示人”，即“表达、表露”。
family_guide.core_distinction: express 是动作核心（动词），强调表达与抒发；expression 是其名词派生，涵盖抽象的“表达过程/言论”，并进一步具体化为“面部表情”和“词句表达”。

lemmas.def_zh: 他们自己；她们自己；它们自己
lemmas.def_en: used as the object of a verb or preposition to refer back to a plural subject, or used to emphasize them

examples.en: They managed to solve the complicated problem all by themselves.
examples.zh: 他们全靠自己解决了那个复杂的问题。

examples.en: The directors themselves attended the emergency meeting.
examples.zh: 董事们亲自参加了这次紧急会议。

family_guide.root_logic: 由第三人称复数代词 them 与名词复数 selves 复合而成，用作第三人称复数的反身代词或强调代词，指代前面已提及的人或事物本身。

lemmas.def_zh: 向...挑战, 要求, 怀疑；挑战, 对(证据等)表示异议
lemmas.def_en: take exception to

examples.en: Finding affordable housing in this city remains a significant challenge for newcomers.
examples.zh: 在这座城市寻找经济适用房对新来者而言仍是一个重大挑战。

lemmas.def_zh: 挑战, 盘问
lemmas.def_en: a demanding or stimulating situation

examples.en: Finding affordable housing in this city remains a significant challenge for newcomers.
examples.zh: 在这座城市寻找经济适用房对新来者而言仍是一个重大挑战。

lemmas.def_zh: 挑战者
lemmas.def_en: the contestant you hope to defeat

examples.en: The young challenger fought bravely but lost against the defending boxing champion.
examples.zh: 年轻的挑战者英勇拼搏，但最终输给了卫冕拳击冠军。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 无可置辩的, 不必回避的, 不可挑战的
lemmas.def_en: not open to challenge

examples.en: The forensic evidence provided by the detectives proved completely unchallengeable in court.
examples.zh: 侦探提供的法医证据在法庭上被证实是无可置疑的。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 应回避的, 可拒绝的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being challenged

examples.en: The committee's hasty decision remains legally challengeable under existing local regulations.
examples.zh: 根据现行地方法规，该委员会草率的决定在法律上仍可被质疑。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 calumnia（指控、诬蔑），经古法语演变为向权威或合法性提出“指责、质疑”，后引申为向某人或某事发出“挑战”与“考验”。
family_guide.core_distinction: challenge 兼作动词与名词，指行动或面临的艰巨任务/质疑；challenger 则是发起竞争或质疑的人（挑战者）。

lemmas.def_zh: 通路, 入口, 接近, 进入, 使用权, 发作
lemmas.def_en: the right to enter

examples.en: You need an administrator password to access the company's private server.
examples.zh: 你需要管理员密码才能访问公司的内部服务器。

lemmas.def_zh: 易接近, 可进入
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being at hand when needed

examples.en: The city improved the accessibility of public transportation for elderly disabled citizens.
examples.zh: 该市改善了公共交通对于老年残障市民的无障碍性。

lemmas.def_zh: 到达, 即位, 增加, 同意, 发作, 正式接受
lemmas.def_en: a process of increasing by addition (as to a collection or group)

examples.en: The museum librarian will accession these historical manuscripts into the official archive.
examples.zh: 博物馆图书管理员将把这些历史手稿正式登记归档。

lemmas.def_zh: 易接近的, 可进入的, 可使用的, 易受影响的, 可理解的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being reached

examples.en: The remote mountain resort is only accessible by four-wheel-drive vehicles in winter.
examples.zh: 这座偏远的山间度假胜地在冬季只有开四驱车才能到达。

lemmas.def_zh: 达不到的, 难以接近
lemmas.def_en: capable of being reached only with great difficulty or not at all

examples.en: The high mountain cave remained unaccessible due to heavy snow and ice.
examples.zh: 由于大雪和积冰，那座高山洞穴依然难以涉足。

lemmas.def_zh: 访问, 存取, 接近, 使用
lemmas.def_en: obtain or retrieve from a storage device; as of information on a computer

examples.en: You need an administrator password to access the company's private server.
examples.zh: 你需要管理员密码才能访问公司的内部服务器。

lemmas.def_zh: 登记入册
lemmas.def_en: make a record of additions to a collection, such as a library

examples.en: The museum librarian will accession these historical manuscripts into the official archive.
examples.zh: 博物馆图书管理员将把这些历史手稿正式登记归档。

lemmas.def_zh: 同意, 正式加入, 就任, 继任
lemmas.def_en: yield to another's wish or opinion

examples.en: The management finally decided to accede to the workers' demands for higher wages.
examples.zh: 管理层最终决定同意工人们提高工资的要求。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 accedere（ad- 向前 + cedere 行走，即'走近、靠近'），引申为'进入的途径'与'获取/使用的权利'，现代衍生出物理通行、信息存取及无障碍性等语义网络。
family_guide.core_distinction: access 侧重'途径或权限'（名）及'存取/进入'（动）；accessible 强调'可达性或易懂性'；accessibility 专指'无障碍程度或易获取性'。

lemmas.def_zh: 球, 舞会, 球状物
lemmas.def_en: round object that is hit or thrown or kicked in games

examples.en: The children spent the warm afternoon playing ball in the local park.
examples.zh: 孩子们在当地公园玩球，度过了一个温暖的下午。

lemmas.def_zh: 捏成球形
lemmas.def_en: form into a ball by winding or rolling

examples.en: The children spent the warm afternoon playing ball in the local park.
examples.zh: 孩子们在当地公园玩球，度过了一个温暖的下午。

family_guide.root_logic: 核心意象为“圆形团块、球体”，作名词指球或团状物（亦同形借指盛大舞会），作动词则引申为“捏成球状”或“身体蜷缩成球状”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词常指实体球体、运动用球或舞会；动词主要用于描述将手、纸张等物理形态“捏拢成团”的动作（如 ball one's fists）。

lemmas.def_zh: 使惊奇；使诧异；使猝不及防
lemmas.def_en: to cause someone to feel wonder or astonishment; to come upon unexpectedly

examples.en: Her calm reaction to the bad news surprised everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 她对坏消息的平静反应让房间里的所有人都感到惊讶。

examples.en: We decided to surprise our parents with a trip abroad for their anniversary.
examples.zh: 我们决定送父母一次出国旅行，作为给他们结婚纪念日的惊喜。

lemmas.def_zh: 使惊奇；使诧异；使猝不及防
lemmas.def_en: to cause someone to feel wonder or astonishment; to come upon unexpectedly

examples.en: Her calm reaction to the bad news surprised everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 她对坏消息的平静反应让房间里的所有人都感到惊讶。

examples.en: We decided to surprise our parents with a trip abroad for their anniversary.
examples.zh: 我们决定送父母一次出国旅行，作为给他们结婚纪念日的惊喜。

lemmas.def_zh: 惊异
lemmas.def_en: the act of surprising someone

examples.en: In information theory, surprisal measures how unexpected an event actually is.
examples.zh: 在信息论中，惊异度衡量一个事件实际上的出人意料程度。

lemmas.def_zh: 出人意料地；惊人地
lemmas.def_en: in an unexpected way; more or less than would be expected

examples.en: Despite the harsh weather, the flight was surprisingly smooth.
examples.zh: 尽管天气恶劣，飞行过程却出奇地平稳。

examples.en: Surprisingly, only a few people showed up for the guest lecture.
examples.zh: 出人意料的是，只有寥寥几人来听特邀讲座。

lemmas.def_zh: 不令人吃惊的
lemmas.def_en: not causing surprise

examples.en: Given the poor weather conditions, the flight delay was entirely unsurprising.
examples.zh: 考虑到恶劣的天气条件，航班延误完全不足为奇。

lemmas.def_zh: 不觉得惊奇
lemmas.def_en: not surprised or expressing surprise

examples.en: She seemed completely unsurprised by the news of his sudden departure.
examples.zh: 得知他突然离开的消息，她似乎一点也不感到惊讶。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 surprendre（sur- 上方/超出 + prendre 抓取），本义为“突袭、猝不及防被抓住”，后引申为在心理上“使人出其不意、感到惊讶”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意派生形容词中 surprised 指“人感到惊讶的”，surprising 指“事物令人惊讶的”，副词 surprisingly 常置于句首或形容词前作评注。

lemmas.def_zh: 选择, 挑选
lemmas.def_en: pick out, select, or choose from a number of alternatives

examples.en: You need to select the best candidates from this qualified pool.
examples.zh: 你需要从这群合格的人选中挑选出最优秀的人。

lemmas.def_zh: 挑选出来的, 极好的
lemmas.def_en: of superior grade

examples.en: You need to select the best candidates from this qualified pool.
examples.zh: 你需要从这群合格的人选中挑选出最优秀的人。

lemmas.def_zh: 选择的, 选择性的
lemmas.def_en: tending to select; characterized by careful choice; - John Mason Brown

examples.en: Top universities have become extremely selective in their recent admissions processes.
examples.zh: 顶尖大学在最近的招生录取中变得极为挑剔。

lemmas.def_zh: 未经选择的,随意选定的,非精选的
lemmas.def_en: not selected

examples.en: The unselected items will be automatically returned to the main warehouse.
examples.zh: 未被选中的物品将自动退回主仓库。

lemmas.def_zh: 选择, 选文, 精选品
lemmas.def_en: the act of choosing or selecting

examples.en: The bookstore offers a wide selection of rare historical fiction novels.
examples.zh: 这家书店提供了精选的大量珍稀历史小说。

lemmas.def_zh: 选择者, 选择器
lemmas.def_en: a person who chooses or selects out

examples.en: Use the rotary selector on the panel to change operating modes.
examples.zh: 使用面板上的旋转选择器来更改操作模式。

lemmas.def_zh: 选择性, 选择度
lemmas.def_en: the property of being selective

examples.en: The new chemical catalyst shows high selectivity in this specific reaction.
examples.zh: 这种新型化学催化剂在该特定反应中表现出高选择性。

lemmas.def_zh: 有选择地
lemmas.def_en: by selection; in a selective manner

examples.en: The brain selectively processes important sensory inputs while ignoring minor distractions.
examples.zh: 大脑有选择地处理重要的感官输入，同时忽略微小的干扰。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 se-（分离、离开）+ legere（挑选、收集），核心逻辑是“从中分拣挑选”，引申出“选择”的行为、结果及“精选优越”的属性。
family_guide.core_distinction: select (adj.) 侧重事物本身“经过精挑细选的、顶尖排他的”；selective (adj.) 侧重挑选主体或机制“有选择性的、挑剔的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 到达，抵达；到来，发生
lemmas.def_en: to reach a destination; to come or happen

examples.en: We are expected to arrive at the airport well before noon.
examples.zh: 我们预计在中午之前到达机场。

examples.en: Spring has finally arrived after a long, harsh winter.
examples.zh: 漫长严酷的冬季过后，春天终于到来了。

lemmas.def_zh: 到达，到来；到达的人或物
lemmas.def_en: the act of reaching a place; a person or thing that has arrived

examples.en: Please check the information screen for the estimated arrival time.
examples.zh: 请查看信息屏了解预计到达时间。

examples.en: The museum welcomed thousands of new arrivals during the exhibition.
examples.zh: 展览期间，博物馆迎来了成千上万的新到访者。

lemmas.def_zh: 到达者
lemmas.def_en: someone who arrives (or has arrived)

examples.en: Every late arriver was required to sign in at the front desk.
examples.zh: 每位迟到者都必须在前台登记签到。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ad-（向、到）+ ripa（岸边），本义为船只“靠岸”，后引申为“到达目的地”或某事“来临”。

lemmas.def_zh: 医院
lemmas.def_en: an institution providing medical and surgical treatment and nursing care for sick or injured people

examples.en: She was rushed to the hospital immediately after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故发生后，她被立即送往医院。

examples.en: He had to spend two weeks in hospital recovering from the surgery.
examples.zh: 他不得不住院两周以从手术中康复。

lemmas.def_zh: 医院收容, 住院治疗
lemmas.def_en: a period of time when you are confined to a hospital

examples.en: Severe respiratory infections often lead to immediate hospitalization for elderly patients.
examples.zh: 严重呼吸道感染往往会导致老年患者立即住院治疗。

lemmas.def_zh: 送...进医院治疗
lemmas.def_en: admit into a hospital

examples.en: Doctors decided to hospitalize him after his fever failed to subside.
examples.zh: 他的高烧迟迟不退，医生决定让他住院治疗。

lemmas.def_zh: 使住院, 把...送进医院治疗
lemmas.def_en: admit into a hospital

examples.en: The clinic had to hospitalise several injured victims after the highway crash.
examples.zh: 高速公路发生车祸后，诊所不得不将几名受伤者送院治疗。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 hospes（客人/主人），经由 hospitale（收容所/客栈）演变为现代专门救治伤病人员的“医院”。

lemmas.def_zh: 枪
lemmas.def_en: a weapon that discharges a missile at high velocity (especially from a metal tube or barrel)

examples.en: The security guard reached instinctively for his gun during the tense standoff.
examples.zh: 在紧张的对峙中，保安本能地将手伸向了配枪。

lemmas.def_zh: 炮手, 炮长, 机关枪手, 带枪猎人
lemmas.def_en: a serviceman in the artillery

examples.en: The skilled gunner accurately hit the designated target from a long distance.
examples.zh: 训练有素的炮手从远距离准确击中了指定目标。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 枪
lemmas.def_en: shoot with a gun

examples.en: The security guard reached instinctively for his gun during the tense standoff.
examples.zh: 在紧张的对峙中，保安本能地将手伸向了配枪。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于中世纪一门名为 Gunnhildr（古诺斯语，意为‘战斗’）的巨型弩炮，后演变为各类管状火器的统称，并引申出‘持枪开火’以及使引擎轰鸣加速等动作含义。

lemmas.def_zh: 黑暗的, 暗的, 深色的, 隐密的, 模糊的, 无知的
lemmas.def_en: devoid of or deficient in light or brightness; shadowed or black

examples.en: We walked down the dark hallway without using our mobile phone flashlights.
examples.zh: 我们没用手机手电筒，沿着漆黑的走廊往前走。

lemmas.def_zh: 黑暗, 夜, 黄昏, 模糊
lemmas.def_en: absence of light or illumination

examples.en: We walked down the dark hallway without using our mobile phone flashlights.
examples.zh: 我们没用手机手电筒，沿着漆黑的走廊往前走。

lemmas.def_zh: 黑暗, 暗, 深色, 隐密, 模糊, 无知
lemmas.def_en: absence of light or illumination

examples.en: A thick blanket of darkness fell rapidly over the entire quiet valley.
examples.zh: 浓重深沉的黑暗迅速笼罩了整座寂静的山谷。

lemmas.def_zh: 暗, 黑, 呈黑
lemmas.def_en: without light

examples.en: He smiled darkly before revealing his ruthless plan to take over power.
examples.zh: 在透露夺权的残酷计划之前，他阴沉地笑了一下。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 deorc，核心含义为“无光或光线微弱”，引申出“颜色深”、“未知、神秘”及情绪上的“阴郁、邪恶”等意象。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词 dark 常与介词固定搭配表示时间或具体无光环境（如 after dark, in the dark）；而 darkness 侧重表示“黑暗的状态与性质”，更具文学色彩和抽象隐喻意义。

lemmas.def_zh: 病人, 承受者
lemmas.def_en: a person who requires medical care

examples.en: The doctor carefully explained the treatment options to the anxious patient.
examples.zh: 医生耐心地向焦虑的病人解释了各种治疗方案。

lemmas.def_en: good-natured tolerance of delay or incompetence
lemmas.def_zh: 耐心，耐性，忍耐力

examples.en: Teaching toddlers requires an incredible amount of patience.
examples.zh: 教幼儿需要极大的耐心。

lemmas.def_zh: 忍耐的, 容忍的, 有耐性的, 坚忍的
lemmas.def_en: enduring trying circumstances with even temper or characterized by such endurance

examples.en: The doctor carefully explained the treatment options to the anxious patient.
examples.zh: 医生耐心地向焦虑的病人解释了各种治疗方案。

lemmas.def_zh: 耐心地；有毅力地
lemmas.def_en: with patience; in a patient manner

examples.en: The passengers waited patiently in line until the boarding gates finally opened.
examples.zh: 乘客们耐心地排队等候，直到登机口终于开放。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 pati（承受、忍受），演变为承受病痛折磨的人（病人）以及能忍耐延误或困境而不急躁的品质（耐心的）。
family_guide.core_distinction: 同形多词性词：作名词指接受诊疗的“患者”，作形容词指具有宽容忍耐品质的“有耐心的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 同盟, 联盟, 盟约
lemmas.def_en: an association of sports teams that organizes matches for its members

examples.en: Several local charities decided to league together to provide better community support.
examples.zh: 几家当地慈善机构决定联合起来，以提供更好的社区支持。

lemmas.def_zh: 组联盟, (使)加盟
lemmas.def_en: unite to form a league

examples.en: Several local charities decided to league together to provide better community support.
examples.zh: 几家当地慈善机构决定联合起来，以提供更好的社区支持。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ligare（捆绑、系紧），核心逻辑是通过契约或利益将人、组织或群体“绑在一起”，由此引申出同盟、联赛及结盟之意。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词常指制度化的“联赛”或政治层面的“同盟”，亦常用于成语 in league with（与…勾结）；动词则表“结盟、联合”，常与 together 连用。

lemmas.def_zh: 网络, 广播网, 网状物
lemmas.def_en: an interconnected system of things or people

examples.en: The company plans to network all its branch offices to improve internal communication.
examples.zh: 该公司计划将其所有分支机构联网，以改善内部沟通。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 网络
lemmas.def_en: communicate with and within a group

examples.en: The company plans to network all its branch offices to improve internal communication.
examples.zh: 该公司计划将其所有分支机构联网，以改善内部沟通。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 net（网）与 work（构造/产物）复合而成，核心意象为“纵横交织的网状结构”，随时代演进延伸至广播、交通、计算机以及人际交往等多种互联系统。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词侧重指已形成的网状系统或人脉圈子；动词则侧重于“建立人际关系”的社交行为或将设备“连入网络”的动作。

lemmas.def_zh: 注意, 通知, 评论, 提及, 关注；注意
lemmas.def_en: discover or determine the existence, presence, or fact of

examples.en: The manager posted a brief notice regarding the upcoming schedule changes yesterday.
examples.zh: 经理昨天张贴了一张关于即将到来的日程变动的简短通知。

lemmas.def_en: inform (somebody) of something
lemmas.def_zh: 通知, 通告, 报告

examples.en: Please notify the front desk immediately if you need extra towels or pillows.
examples.zh: 如果您需要额外的毛巾或枕头，请立即通知前台。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 通知人, 通告人

examples.en: The official notifier delivered the court summons directly to the company's legal office.
examples.zh: 正式通知人将法院传票直接送达至该公司的法务办公室。

lemmas.def_zh: 注意, 布告, 通知, 预告, 短评
lemmas.def_en: an announcement containing information about an event; ; ; "a notice of sale

examples.en: The manager posted a brief notice regarding the upcoming schedule changes yesterday.
examples.zh: 经理昨天张贴了一张关于即将到来的日程变动的简短通知。

lemmas.def_en: an accusation of crime made by a grand jury on its own initiative
lemmas.def_zh: 通知, 通告, 告示

examples.en: She received an instant notification on her watch confirming that the payment succeeded.
examples.zh: 她的手表收到了一条即时通知，确认付款已经成功。

lemmas.def_zh: 显而易见的, 显著的, 值得注意的
lemmas.def_en: capable or worthy of being perceived

examples.en: There has been a noticeable improvement in her spoken English this semester.
examples.zh: 这学期她的英语口语有了显而易见的提高。

lemmas.def_zh: 不被注意的, 被忽视的
lemmas.def_en: not noticed

examples.en: His quiet contributions to the project did not go unnoticed by management.
examples.zh: 他对该项目的默默奉献并未被管理层忽视。

lemmas.def_zh: 不显明[显著]的
lemmas.def_en: not obtrusive or undesirably noticeable

examples.en: The tiny scratch on the back of the phone was almost unnoticeable.
examples.zh: 手机背面那道微小的划痕几乎难以察觉。

lemmas.def_en: requiring that official notification be given
lemmas.def_zh: 须申报的

examples.en: Doctors are legally required to report any case of a notifiable disease.
examples.zh: 法律规定医生必须上报任何法定须申报的疾病病例。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 notitia（知晓、认识），核心概念是“使进入意识”，后分化为感知动作（注意到）与传递信息的工具（布告、通知）。
family_guide.core_distinction: notice 兼具动词（感知）与名词（通知/注意力）属性；noticeable 则是其衍生形容词，强调特征明显、“极易被察觉”。

lemmas.def_zh: 杯子, 茶杯, 优胜杯
lemmas.def_en: a small open container usually used for drinking; usually has a handle

examples.en: He gently cupped the fragile injured bird in his warm hands.
examples.zh: 他用温暖的双手轻轻把那只受伤的弱小鸟儿捧成杯状。

lemmas.def_zh: 使成杯状, 为...拔火罐
lemmas.def_en: form into the shape of a cup

examples.en: He gently cupped the fragile injured bird in his warm hands.
examples.zh: 他用温暖的双手轻轻把那只受伤的弱小鸟儿捧成杯状。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 cupa（桶、容器），核心义为“凹陷的盛液容器”，后自然引申为容器的容积单位、奖杯，以及动作“使手弯曲成杯状托住/包住”。

lemmas.def_zh: 向前地
lemmas.def_en: at or to or toward the front; ; ; ; (`forrad' and `forrard' are dialectal variations)

examples.en: Please forward this important email to the entire design team right away.
examples.zh: 请立即将这封重要邮件转寄给整个设计团队。

lemmas.def_zh: 促进...的生长, 转寄, 运送
lemmas.def_en: send or ship onward from an intermediate post or station in transit

examples.en: Please forward this important email to the entire design team right away.
examples.zh: 请立即将这封重要邮件转寄给整个设计团队。

lemmas.def_zh: 向前的, 早的, 迅速的, 在前的, 进步的
lemmas.def_en: at or near or directed toward the front

examples.en: Please forward this important email to the entire design team right away.
examples.zh: 请立即将这封重要邮件转寄给整个设计团队。

lemmas.def_zh: 提前, 提早, 早熟, 热心
lemmas.def_en: offensive boldness and assertiveness

examples.en: Some conservative guests were taken aback by the young artist's bold forwardness.
examples.zh: 一些保守的宾客被这位年轻艺术家的鲁莽冒失吓了一跳。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 fore-（在前）与 -ward（朝向）构成，核心语义始终围绕“朝向前方”以及在空间、时间或行动上的“推进与向前”。
family_guide.core_distinction: forward 同形多词性：副词表示“向前地/朝未来”，动词表示“转发/推进”，形容词除表“前方的”外还可引申指态度“冒失的、过于主动的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 贫穷的, 贫乏的, 不幸的, 可怜的, 拙劣的, 卑鄙的
lemmas.def_en: deserving or inciting pity; ; ; - Galsworthy

examples.en: The government introduced new social programs to support the urban working poor.
examples.zh: 政府推出了新的社会救助项目以支持城市劳动贫民。

lemmas.def_zh: 身体不舒服的
lemmas.def_en: somewhat ill or prone to illness

examples.en: She stayed home from work today because she was feeling quite poorly.
examples.zh: 她今天没去上班，因为她感觉身体很不舒服。

lemmas.def_zh: [经] 低劣的, 不良的
lemmas.def_en: people without possessions or wealth (considered as a group)

examples.en: The government introduced new social programs to support the urban working poor.
examples.zh: 政府推出了新的社会救助项目以支持城市劳动贫民。

lemmas.def_zh: 贫穷, 缺乏, 拙劣
lemmas.def_en: the state of having little or no money and few or no material possessions

examples.en: The poorness of the soil prevented the farmers from growing quality crops.
examples.zh: 土壤的贫瘠阻碍了农民们种植优质农作物。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 pauper（生产极少的、贫穷的），核心意象为“匮乏、不足”，由此引申出物质贫困、质量低劣、身心欠佳以及令人怜悯等语义。
family_guide.core_distinction: poor 作形容词表示贫穷、劣质或可怜，作名词（通常加 the）指穷人这一群体；poorly 作形容词时主要作表语，特指身体不适、生病。

lemmas.def_zh: 使惊奇；使惊叹
lemmas.def_en: to surprise someone greatly; to fill with wonder

examples.en: Her ability to stay calm under intense pressure never ceases to amaze me.
examples.zh: 她在巨大压力下保持镇定的能力总让我惊叹不已。

examples.en: The magician managed to amaze the audience with a series of unbelievable illusions.
examples.zh: 魔术师用一系列令人难以置信的幻术让观众赞叹不已。

lemmas.def_zh: 令人惊讶地；出奇地
lemmas.def_en: in a way that causes great surprise or wonder; remarkably

examples.en: Amazingly, all the passengers survived the plane crash without serious injuries.
examples.zh: 令人称奇的是，所有乘客在空难中均未受重伤、幸免于难。

examples.en: Despite its age, the vintage car runs amazingly well.
examples.zh: 尽管有些年头了，这辆老爷车开起来却出奇地顺畅。

lemmas.def_zh: 惊愕, 惊异
lemmas.def_en: the feeling that accompanies something extremely surprising

examples.en: She stared in complete amazement as the magician made the coin disappear.
examples.zh: 当魔术师把硬币变没时，她完全惊愕地盯着看。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 大为惊奇的；震惊的
lemmas.def_en: extremely surprised or filled with wonder
lemmas.usage_note: 主语通常是人，常用于 be amazed at/by sth 或 be amazed to find...

examples.en: I was amazed at how quickly the children learned the new language.
examples.zh: 孩子们学新语言之快令我大为吃惊。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 令人惊异的；了不起的
lemmas.def_en: causing great surprise or wonder; astonishing
lemmas.usage_note: 主语多为事物，常修饰成就、经历或景色，如 an amazing discovery / achievement。

examples.en: She has an amazing ability to stay calm under intense pressure.
examples.zh: 她有一种在巨大压力下保持镇静的惊人能力。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语‘使陷入迷局、发愣’（与 maze 迷宫同源），语义演变为因极度意外或不可思议而让人目瞪口呆、惊叹不已。
family_guide.core_distinction: amaze 是动作本身（使……惊叹），而副词 amazingly 常置于句首作评注性状语，或修饰形容词表示程度‘出奇地、不可思议地’。

lemmas.def_zh: 执行，贯彻；处死，处决；（计算机）运行
lemmas.def_en: to carry out a plan, order, or course of action; to carry out a death sentence; to run a computer program

examples.en: The team executed the marketing strategy with remarkable precision.
examples.zh: 团队极其精准地执行了该营销策略。

examples.en: He was executed for treason after a secret military trial.
examples.zh: 在秘密军事审判后，他因叛国罪被处决。

lemmas.def_zh: 高级管理人员，主管；行政部门
lemmas.def_en: a person with senior managerial responsibility in an organization

examples.en: She met with top business executives to discuss the pending merger.
examples.zh: 她与多位商界高管会面，商讨即将进行的合并事宜。

lemmas.def_zh: 执行，实行；处决，死刑；（技巧、艺术的）表现，技法
lemmas.def_en: the carrying out of a plan or order; the carrying out of a death sentence; the skill or style of an artistic or athletic performance

examples.en: Even a brilliant idea is worthless without effective execution.
examples.zh: 如果没有有效的执行力，再绝妙的想法也毫无价值。

examples.en: The pianist's technical execution of the piece was flawless.
examples.zh: 这位钢琴家对这首曲目的演奏技艺堪称完美。

lemmas.def_zh: 刽子手
lemmas.def_en: an official who inflicts capital punishment in pursuit of a warrant

examples.en: The masked executioner stepped onto the wooden scaffold and raised his sharp axe.
examples.zh: 蒙面的刽子手走上木质断头台，举起了锋利的斧头。

lemmas.def_zh: 执行者
lemmas.def_en: a person appointed by a testator to carry out the terms of the will

examples.en: He appointed his trusted elder brother as the sole executor of his will.
examples.zh: 他指定深受信赖的哥哥作为他遗嘱的唯一执行人。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 exsequi（ex- 彻底 + sequi 跟随），原义为“一直跟随到底”，后引申为“彻底贯彻、付诸实行”，并进一步延伸出“依法执行判决（尤指死刑）”之意。
family_guide.core_distinction: executive 指代负责执行决策的“高管/行政负责人”；execution 侧重指执行的“动作、过程或执行力”，亦指“处决”。

lemmas.def_zh: 根据, 证据, 迹象
lemmas.def_en: your basis for belief or disbelief; knowledge on which to base belief

examples.en: The police searched the entire apartment carefully but found no conclusive evidence.
examples.zh: 警方仔细搜查了整套公寓，但没有发现决定性的证据。

lemmas.def_zh: [经] 证据, 凭证
lemmas.def_en: provide evidence for; stand as proof of; show by one's behavior, attitude, or external attributes

examples.en: The police searched the entire apartment carefully but found no conclusive evidence.
examples.zh: 警方仔细搜查了整套公寓，但没有发现决定性的证据。

lemmas.def_en: clearly revealed to the mind or the senses or judgment
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 明显的，显而易见的

examples.en: It became evident that the project would not be finished on time.
examples.zh: 显而易见，该项目无法按时完成了。

lemmas.def_zh: 证据的, 根据证据的
lemmas.def_en: pertaining to or constituting evidence

examples.en: The judge dismissed the case due to a lack of sufficient evidentiary support.
examples.zh: 由于缺乏充分的证据支持，法官驳回了该案件。

lemmas.def_zh: 证据的, 可作证据的, 提供证据的
lemmas.def_en: serving as or based on evidence

examples.en: The recovered weapon holds significant evidential value for the upcoming criminal trial.
examples.zh: 追回的凶器对即将进行的刑事审判具有重大的证据价值。

lemmas.def_en: unmistakably (`plain' is often used informally for `plainly')
lemmas.def_zh: adv. 显然；看来，据说

examples.en: She was evidently upset by the sudden change in plans.
examples.zh: 她显然对计划的突然变动感到心烦意乱。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 e-（向外）与 videre（看），本义为“显而易见、看得清楚之物”，由此引申出“用来证实事实的根据、迹象或证明行为”。

lemmas.def_zh: 街区, 木块, 石块, 块
lemmas.def_en: a solid piece of something (usually having flat rectangular sides)

examples.en: A fallen tree fell across the road and blocked traffic for two hours.
examples.zh: 一棵倒下的树横在路上，阻碍了交通两个小时。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 阻滞物, 阻滞剂, 阻滞抗体
lemmas.def_en: a football player whose responsibility is to block players attempting to stop an offensive play

examples.en: The doctor prescribed a beta blocker to help lower her high blood pressure.
examples.zh: 医生开了一种β受体阻滞剂来帮助降低她的高血压。

lemmas.def_zh: 封锁, 妨碍
lemmas.def_en: the physical condition of blocking or filling a passage with an obstruction

examples.en: The plumber managed to clear the blockage in the kitchen drain pipe quickly.
examples.zh: 水管工迅速排除了厨房排水管中的堵塞物。

lemmas.def_zh: 阻塞, 封锁, 使成块状
lemmas.def_en: render unsuitable for passage

examples.en: A fallen tree fell across the road and blocked traffic for two hours.
examples.zh: 一棵倒下的树横在路上，阻碍了交通两个小时。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 解锁, 解块
lemmas.def_en: clear or remove an obstruction from

examples.en: Please unblock my phone number so we can finally discuss the project details.
examples.zh: 请把我的电话号码解除拉黑，这样我们才能讨论项目细节。

lemmas.def_zh: 短而结实的, 斑驳的
lemmas.def_en: resembling a block in shape

examples.en: The building was an unattractive, blocky structure made entirely of gray concrete.
examples.zh: 那座建筑是一栋难看的、完全由灰色混凝土建成的块状结构。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语中代表“大木头”的词根，由“笨重坚实的块状实体”引申出“作为障碍物去阻拦、遮挡”的核心动作与概念。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词表示具体的块状物、街区或抽象障碍；动词表示阻挡、堵塞通道或拦截通信等动作。

lemmas.def_zh: 消息, 通讯, 讯息, 教训, 预言, 广告词
lemmas.def_en: a communication (usually brief) that is written or spoken or signaled

examples.en: I left an urgent voice message on his phone early this morning.
examples.zh: 今天一大早我就在他的手机上留了一条紧急语音留言。

lemmas.def_zh: 通知；通报, 报告, 报信
lemmas.def_en: send a message to

examples.en: I left an urgent voice message on his phone early this morning.
examples.zh: 今天一大早我就在他的手机上留了一条紧急语音留言。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 mittere（派遣、发送），核心逻辑指‘被派送传递出的信息、旨意或使命’。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词常指传递的具体信息、留言或深层寓意；动词则特指通过电子通讯手段（如即时通讯、短信）给某人发送信息。

lemmas.def_zh: 梦，梦境；梦想，愿望；做梦；想象，梦想
lemmas.def_en: a series of images and thoughts occurring during sleep; a cherished ambition; to experience dreams or imagine something desirable

examples.en: She woke up suddenly in the middle of a vivid dream.
examples.zh: 她突然从一个清晰逼真的梦境中醒来。

examples.en: He always dreamed of becoming an architect.
examples.zh: 他一直梦想着成为一名建筑师。

lemmas.def_zh: 做梦的人, 梦想者
lemmas.def_en: someone who is dreaming

examples.en: He is an impractical dreamer who spends all day imagining great adventures.
examples.zh: 他是个不切实际的梦想家，整天幻想宏大的冒险。

lemmas.def_zh: 心不在焉; 模糊; 轻柔; 绝妙
lemmas.def_en: a relaxed comfortable feeling

examples.en: Her persistent dreaminess during the meeting suggested that she was not paying attention.
examples.zh: 她在会议中持续的心不在焉表明她根本没有专心。

lemmas.def_zh: 梦，梦境；梦想，愿望；做梦；想象，梦想
lemmas.def_en: a series of images and thoughts occurring during sleep; a cherished ambition; to experience dreams or imagine something desirable

examples.en: She woke up suddenly in the middle of a vivid dream.
examples.zh: 她突然从一个清晰逼真的梦境中醒来。

examples.en: He always dreamed of becoming an architect.
examples.zh: 他一直梦想着成为一名建筑师。

lemmas.def_zh: 做梦；想到，梦想（dream 的过去式及过去分词）
lemmas.def_en: past tense and past participle of dream

examples.en: I never dreamt that our small project would achieve such global success.
examples.zh: 我做梦也没想到我们这个小项目会取得如此巨大的全球成功。

lemmas.def_zh: 空幻的, 梦想的
lemmas.def_en: dreamy in mood or nature

examples.en: The film had a dreamy, atmospheric quality that captivated critics and audiences alike.
examples.zh: 这部电影有一种梦幻而富有氛围感的特质，吸引了评论家和观众。

lemmas.def_zh: 无梦的, 不做梦的
lemmas.def_en: untroubled by dreams

examples.en: After the exhausting hike, she fell into a deep and dreamless sleep.
examples.zh: 经过疲惫的徒步后，她陷入了一场深沉而无梦的睡眠。

lemmas.def_zh: 梦想不到的, 意外的
lemmas.def_en: not imagined even in a dream

examples.en: The new invention opened up undreamed possibilities for modern renewable energy solutions.
examples.zh: 这项新发明为现代可再生能源解决方案开启了未曾梦想过的可能。

lemmas.def_zh: 爱梦想地, 梦似地, 朦胧地
lemmas.def_en: in a dreamy manner

examples.en: She gazed dreamily out the window, completely lost in her own romantic thoughts.
examples.zh: 她若有所思地望着窗外，完全沉浸在自己的浪漫思绪中。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 drēam（欢乐、音乐、欢闹），在中古英语期受古诺斯语影响，核心语义定型为睡眠中的“幻象、梦境”，进而引申为清醒时的“愿景、梦想与想象”。
family_guide.core_distinction: dream 可兼作名词与动词；dreamt 为动词 dream 的不规则过去式/过去分词形式，英式英语中较常用（读音为 /dremt/），美式英语则多用规则形式 dreamed。

lemmas.def_zh: 投递，递送；履行，兑现；发表，宣布；接生
lemmas.def_en: to bring goods or letters to a place; to achieve or produce what is expected; to give a speech

examples.en: The courier delivered the parcel directly to my doorstep.
examples.zh: 快递员把包裹直接送到了我家门口。

examples.en: The team worked around the clock to deliver the promised results on time.
examples.zh: 团队夜以继日地工作，以按时兑现所承诺的成果。

lemmas.def_zh: 递送，交付；交货的物品；演讲/表达风格；分娩
lemmas.def_en: the act of taking goods to people; an item brought; the manner of speaking; childbirth

examples.en: We offer free delivery on all domestic orders over fifty dollars.
examples.zh: 凡境内订单满五十美元，我们均提供免费送货服务。

examples.en: His ideas were brilliant, but his flat delivery put half the audience to sleep.
examples.zh: 他的观点非常精彩，但平淡乏味的演讲风格让一半听众昏昏欲睡。

lemmas.def_zh: 解脱, 解救, 释放, 判决
lemmas.def_en: recovery or preservation from loss or danger

examples.en: The stranded hikers prayed for deliverance as the winter storm grew worse.
examples.zh: 随着冬季暴风雪愈演愈烈，滞留的徒步者祈求能获救解脱。

lemmas.def_zh: 救助者, 引渡人, 交付者
lemmas.def_en: a teacher and prophet born in Bethlehem and active in Nazareth; his life and sermons form the basis for Christianity (circa 4 BC - AD 29)

examples.en: The brave firefighter was hailed as the deliverer of the trapped family.
examples.zh: 那位勇敢的消防员被赞颂为被困一家的救援者。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 deliberare（de- '彻底' + liberare '释放'），本义为‘解脱、释放’，后引申为将物品/承诺‘释放交出’，衍生出‘递送’、‘兑现’、‘发表’等核心义项。
family_guide.core_distinction: deliver 是核心动词，涵盖实物投递、承诺兑现与言语发表；delivery 是其名词形式，既指交付行为或交付物，也特指演讲或投球的风格与技巧。

lemmas.def_zh: 受喜爱的，受欢迎的；大众的，流行的
lemmas.def_en: liked, enjoyed, or admired by many people; intended for or suited to the taste of ordinary people

examples.en: Cycling has become an increasingly popular way to commute in big cities.
examples.zh: 在大城市中，骑自行车已经成为一种越来越受欢迎的通勤方式。

examples.en: Contrary to popular belief, bats are not completely blind.
examples.zh: 与普遍的看法相反，蝙蝠并非完全失明。

lemmas.def_zh: 不受欢迎的；引起反感的，不得人心的
lemmas.def_en: not liked or supported by the majority of people

examples.en: The mayor introduced an unpopular tax hike right before the election.
examples.zh: 市长在选举前夕推出了一项不得人心的加税政策。

lemmas.def_zh: 受欢迎，普及；声望，知名度
lemmas.def_en: the state or condition of being liked, admired, or supported by a large number of people

examples.en: The video game has surged in popularity among teenagers worldwide.
examples.zh: 这款电子游戏在全球青少年群体中的人气急剧上升。

lemmas.def_zh: 不受欢迎, 失人心
lemmas.def_en: the quality of lacking general approval or acceptance

examples.en: The tax hike led to the sudden unpopularity of the ruling political party.
examples.zh: 增税导致执政党突然失去了民心。

lemmas.def_zh: 通俗地, 平易地, 通过民众
lemmas.def_en: among the people

examples.en: The rare geological formation is popularly known among tourists as the Dragon Rock.
examples.zh: 这一罕见的地质构造在游客中通俗地被称为“龙岩”。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 populus（人民、大众），核心语义脉络从“属于人民的、大众的”引申为“受大众欢迎或认可的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: popular 与 unpopular 构成正反评价形容词；popularity 则指代“受人喜爱的程度或声望”这一抽象概念。

lemmas.def_zh: v. 涉及，与……有关；使担忧；n. 担忧，顾虑；关切的事
lemmas.def_en: to relate to, affect, or make anxious; a feeling of worry, or a matter of interest and importance

examples.en: The new regulations concern all employees who work remotely.
examples.zh: 新规定涉及所有远程办公的员工。

examples.en: What concerns me most is the lack of proper safety equipment.
examples.zh: 最让我担忧的是缺乏合格的安全防护设备。

examples.en: Rising energy costs have become a serious concern for local businesses.
examples.zh: 不断上涨的能源成本已成为当地企业极为担忧的问题。

lemmas.def_zh: v. 涉及，与……有关；使担忧；n. 担忧，顾虑；关切的事
lemmas.def_en: to relate to, affect, or make anxious; a feeling of worry, or a matter of interest and importance

examples.en: The new regulations concern all employees who work remotely.
examples.zh: 新规定涉及所有远程办公的员工。

examples.en: What concerns me most is the lack of proper safety equipment.
examples.zh: 最让我担忧的是缺乏合格的安全防护设备。

examples.en: Rising energy costs have become a serious concern for local businesses.
examples.zh: 不断上涨的能源成本已成为当地企业极为担忧的问题。

lemmas.def_zh: 漫不经心, 不关心, 冷淡
lemmas.def_en: the trait of remaining calm and seeming not to care; a casual lack of concern

examples.en: His complete unconcern about his declining grades deeply worried his school teachers.
examples.zh: 他对不断下滑的成绩表现出的漠不关心让老师们深感担忧。

lemmas.def_zh: 漠不关心的
lemmas.def_en: lacking in interest or care or feeling

examples.en: She remained unconcerned about the dark clouds and continued her afternoon picnic.
examples.zh: 她对乌云漠不关心，继续享受她的午后野餐。

lemmas.def_zh: 漫不经心地, 不在乎地, 漠不关心地
lemmas.def_en: in an unconcerned manner

examples.en: He walked unconcernedly past the warning sign and stepped onto the thin ice.
examples.zh: 他漫不经心地走过警告牌，踏上了薄冰。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 concernere（con- 共同 + cernere 筛查/审视），本义为“联系在一起审视”，引申出“与……相关”，进而发展为“引起注意、牵挂与担忧”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 该词兼具动词与名词，动词核心表示“涉及”或“使担忧”，名词核心表示“关切的事”或“忧虑的情绪”。

lemmas.def_zh: 质量，品质；特性，特质；优质
lemmas.def_en: the standard of something as measured against other things; a distinctive attribute or characteristic

examples.en: The company has always prioritized product quality over profit margins.
examples.zh: 这家公司始终将产品质量置于利润率之上。

examples.en: Empathy and resilience are essential qualities of an effective leader.
examples.zh: 共情力与坚韧是高效领导者必不可少的特质。

lemmas.def_en: an attribute that must be met or complied with and that fits a person for something
lemmas.def_zh: 资格, 条件, 限制

examples.en: A nursing degree is an essential qualification for working in this clinic.
examples.zh: 护理专业学位是在这家诊所工作的必备资质。

lemmas.def_zh: 资格赛，预选赛；出线者；（语法）修饰语，限定词
lemmas.def_en: a match or contest to decide who advances; a competitor that qualifies; a word that limits the meaning of another
